tours.title: Half-Day Tour Conical Hat Making, Cooking Class And Cycling
tours.summary: You will be warmly welcomed by the host with a cup of traditional Vietnamese tea inside an ancient house, a perfect showcase of Northern Delta architecture. You will be captivated by the wooden structure, adorned with in
tours.contentHtml:
9:30 You will be warmly welcomed by the host with a cup of traditional Vietnamese tea inside an ancient house, a perfect showcase of Northern Delta architecture. You will be captivated by the wooden structure, adorned with intricate carvings and traditional furnishings that give the house a deeply venerable and timeless atmosphere.
10:00 You will move inside the Tonkin conical hat workshop to begin your journey of discovery and hands-on experience. You will meet local artisans who have dedicated decades of their lives to this craft.
  • Making a conical hat is a multi-step process that requires immense patience and skillful hands, utilizing simple, natural materials like bamboo and palm leaves brought from forests hundreds of kilometers away. First, you will receive a clear introduction to the materials and the step-by-step hat-making process. After that, you will observe the artisans at work and receive their personal guidance to challenge your own hands-on skills – from flattening the palm leaves to stitching and painting your own imaginative designs onto the hat. This is a truly special experience, as you will get to take your custom hat home as a meaningful souvenir of your journey.
  • Throughout the visit and workshop, you will also have the chance to interact with the warm-hearted, authentic local people. Don’t forget to capture beautiful photos with our impressive displays made from conical hats and familiar countryside items like bamboo carrying poles, an ancient water well, and a traditional water tank... all creating a nostalgic, rustic ambiance set within a lush green garden.
  • Though it takes only about 1 to 2 hours, I am certain you will feel completely satisfied with your wise choice. You will gain a genuine insight into the Vietnamese countryside, connect with passionate artisans, and enjoy an experiential journey that is truly hard to find anywhere else.”

11:30 You join a cooking class to learn how to make a delicious food called “Nem Ran”. You will be introduced ingredients mixed together and guidance to roll the Vietnamese spring rolls and fry the spring rolls.
12:00 A delicious, home-cooked meal will be served you inside the traditional house. You have a short rest after lunch.
You continue taking a leisurely bike ride to soak in the scenic countryside and rustic villages and lush green rice and vegetable fields. Say good bye to the family to go back your hotel.

tours.titleZh: 半日游：斗笠制作、烹饪课与骑行
tours.summaryZh: 在北部三角洲古宅中品尝传统茶，参观东京斗笠工坊，亲手制作并彩绘斗笠带回家，参加春卷烹饪课，享用家常午餐，并骑行游览乡村田野。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
9:30 主人将在一座古宅内用一杯越南传统茶热情欢迎您，这座古宅是北部三角洲建筑的完美典范。您将被这座木结构建筑深深吸引，精致的雕刻和传统陈设赋予老宅庄重而永恒的氛围。
10:00 随后您将走进东京（Tonkin）斗笠工坊，开启探索与亲手体验之旅。您将结识为这门手艺奉献了数十年光阴的当地工匠。
  • 制作斗笠需要多道工序，既考验耐心，也离不开灵巧的双手，所用材料是竹子和从数百公里外森林运来的棕榈叶等朴素的天然材料。首先，您将详细了解材料和制作斗笠的每一步流程。之后，您将观摩工匠们的操作，并在他们的亲自指导下挑战自己的动手能力–从压平棕榈叶，到缝制，再到在斗笠上绘制您富有创意的图案。这是一次真正特别的体验，因为您可以把亲手定制的斗笠带回家，作为旅程中意义非凡的纪念品。
  • 在整个 参观和工坊体验中，您还有机会与热情淳朴的当地人互动。别忘了与我们用斗笠和熟悉的乡村物品布置的精彩展示合影留念，例如 竹扁担、古老的水井和传统的蓄水缸..，这一切在郁郁葱葱的绿色庭院中营造出怀旧质朴的氛围。
  • 虽然只需1至2小时，但我相信您一定会对这个明智的选择感到十分满意。您将真正了解越南乡村，与充满热情的工匠结缘，享受一段在别处难以找到的体验之旅。”

11:30 您将参加一堂 烹饪课，学习 如何制作一道名为“Nem Rán”的美味佳肴。您将了解馅料的调配，并在指导下卷制越南春卷并油炸。
12:00 在传统老宅内为您奉上美味的家常午餐。午餐后可稍作休息。
随后您继续悠闲地 骑行 ，沉浸在风景如画的乡村、质朴的村庄以及郁郁葱葱的稻田和菜地中。与主人一家道别后返回酒店。

tours.titleZh: 斗笠村体验之旅：烹饪课与骑行
tours.summaryZh: 上午：司机将在老城区或河内歌剧院接您。随后出发前往以17世纪起便以斗笠闻名的Chuong斗笠村。从河内市中心出发行驶30公里后
tours.contentHtmlZh:
上午08:00： 您的司机将在 老城区或河内歌剧院接您。随后我们将出发前往 Chuong斗笠村， 该村自17世纪起便以斗笠闻名。

  • 从河内市中心行驶30公里后，您将抵达 Chuong村， 这里有300年的斗笠制作历史。您将拜访一户世代传承这门手艺的家庭。

9:30 主人将在一座古宅中以一杯越南传统茶热情迎接您，这座古宅是北部三角洲建筑风格的完美代表。木结构上装饰着精美的雕刻和传统家具，让整座房屋散发出深厚古朴、历久弥新的气息，定会令您着迷。

10:00 您将进入 东京斗笠工坊 ，开启探索与亲手体验之旅。在这里，您将见到毕生致力于这门手艺数十年的当地匠人。

  • 制作一顶斗笠需要多道工序，既需要极大的耐心，也需要灵巧的双手，使用竹子、藤条和从数百公里外森林运来的棕榈叶等简单的天然材料。
  • 首先，您将清楚地了解材料和逐步制作斗笠的过程。您将观察匠人的工作，并在他们的亲自指导下挑战自己的动手能力——从压平棕榈叶，到缝制，再到在斗笠上绘制您自己充满想象力的图案。这是一次真正特别的体验，因为您可以把亲手定制的斗笠带回家，作为这趟旅程有意义的纪念品。

  • 在整个参观和工坊期间，您还有机会与热情真诚的当地人交流。别忘了在我们精心布置的展示前拍下美丽的照片，这些展示由斗笠和扁担、古井、传统水缸等熟悉的乡村物件组成……营造出一种怀旧质朴的氛围，坐落于郁郁葱葱的绿色花园之中。
  • 虽然只需1到2小时，但我确信您会对自己明智的选择感到十分满意。您将真正了解越南乡村，与充满热情的匠人建立联系，享受一次在其他地方难以找到的体验之旅。”

11:30 您将参加一堂 烹饪课，学习如何 制作一道美味的菜肴“Nem Ran”（炸春卷）。您将了解各种食材的混合方法，并在指导下学习包卷越南春卷和油炸春卷。

12:00 一顿美味的 家常饭菜 将在传统民居中为您奉上。午餐后可稍作休息。

13:30： 继续悠闲地 骑行 ，沉浸于乡村田园风光、质朴的村落以及郁郁葱葱的稻田和菜地之中。

与主人一家道别，乘车返回您的酒店。

tours.title: Paradise Delight Ha Long Bay Cruise
tours.summary: Paradise Delight Cruise – Journey Through the World Natural Heritage Operated by Vietlook Travel – a trusted Vietnam based travel company specializing in premium tours for international travelers. With many years of expe
tours.contentHtml:
Paradise Delight Cruise – Journey Through the World Natural Heritage

Operated by Vietlook Travel – a trusted Vietnam based travel company specializing in premium tours for international travelers.

With many years of experience serving guests from around the world, Vietlook Travel is committed to delivering authentic, well curated, and seamless travel experiences across Vietnam. Our international-standard services, professional guides, and carefully selected partners ensure comfort, safety, and unforgettable journeys for every guest.

08:45 – Arrival at Tuan Chau Marina | Check-in

Guests arrive at Tuan Chau Marina, complete check-in procedures, and board Paradise Delight Cruise. Enjoy a welcome drink while relaxing in an elegant setting with soft onboard music as the journey begins.

09:15 – Cruise Departure | Breakfast Onboard

The cruise sets sail to explore the breathtaking beauty of Ha Long Bay. Breakfast is served from 09:15 – 10:15, allowing guests to admire the magnificent limestone karsts rising from emerald waters.

10:30 – Visit Titop Island

Stop at Titop Island, where guests may choose to:

  • Hike to the island’s peak for a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay
  • Or relax and swim at the pristine white-sand beach

11:30 – Explore Luon Cave

Guests experience Luon Cave by bamboo boat or kayak, gliding through a peaceful and unspoiled natural landscape.

(Guests who prefer to stay onboard may relax, enjoy music, and take in the tranquil scenery.)

12:15 – Premium Buffet Lunch

Enjoy a lavish buffet lunch featuring a wide selection of dishes, including local Ha Long specialties and refined international cuisine.

13:30 – Visit Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave

The cruise continues to Sung Sot Cave, the most famous and spectacular cave in Ha Long Bay. Marvel at the impressive formations of stalactites and stalagmites, creating a truly awe-inspiring natural masterpiece.

15:00 – Relaxation Time | Afternoon Tea & Happy Hour

Return to the cruise for leisure time:

  • Enjoy Afternoon Tea
  • Take advantage of Happy Hour (Buy 1 Get 1 Free)
  • Relax, take photos, and savor the peaceful bay atmosphere

16:30 – Disembarkation | End of Journey

Paradise Delight Cruise returns to Tuan Chau Marina. Guests disembark and conclude an unforgettable full-day Ha Long Bay cruise experience.

NOTES

  • The itinerary is subject to change without prior notice due to weather or cruising conditions
  • Wi-Fi connection may be interrupted due to geographical conditions in the bay
  • Bamboo boat or kayak services are not included and require an additional charge

INCLUSIONS

  • 7-hour Ha Long Bay cruise program
  • Welcome drink
  • Breakfast onboard
  • Premium buffet lunch
  • Afternoon Tea
  • Onboard insurance, taxes, and service charges

EXCLUSIONS

  • Hotel accommodation
  • Transportation to/from the cruise terminal
  • Beverages not mentioned in the inclusions
  • Karaoke and other entertainment services
  • Tips and personal expenses not listed above
tours.titleZh: 下龙湾天堂之悦游轮
tours.summaryZh: 天堂之悦游轮——穿越世界自然遗产之旅。由Vietlook Travel运营——一家值得信赖的越南本土旅行公司，专注于为国际游客提供高品质旅游产品。多年来，Vietlook Travel服务来自世界各地的宾客
tours.contentHtmlZh:
天堂之悦游轮——穿越世界自然遗产之旅

由Vietlook Travel运营——一家值得信赖的越南本土旅行公司，专注于为国际游客提供高品质旅游产品。

多年来，Vietlook Travel服务来自世界各地的宾客，致力于在越南各地提供地道、精心策划且顺畅无忧的旅行体验。我们的国际标准服务、专业导游和精心挑选的合作伙伴，确保每位宾客舒适、安全，并拥有难忘的旅程。

08:45 – 抵达Tuần Châu码头 | 办理登船手续

宾客抵达Tuần Châu码头，办理登船手续，登上天堂之悦游轮（Paradise Delight）。在优雅的环境中享用欢迎饮品，伴着船上轻柔的音乐放松身心，旅程就此开启。

09:15 – 游轮起航 | 船上早餐

游轮启航，探索下龙湾令人叹为观止的美景。早餐供应时间为09:15 – 10:15，您可以边用餐边欣赏翡翠色海水中拔地而起的壮丽石灰岩山峰。

10:30 – 游览Titop岛

停靠Titop岛，宾客可选择：

  • 徒步登上岛顶，欣赏下龙湾全景
  • 或在原始的白沙滩上放松游泳

11:30 – 探索Luồn洞

宾客乘坐竹筏或皮划艇游览Luồn洞，在宁静未经雕琢的自然风光中滑行。

（喜欢留在船上的宾客可以放松身心，聆听音乐，欣赏静谧的风景。）

12:15 – 精选自助午餐

享用丰盛的自助午餐，菜品种类繁多，包括下龙湾地方特色菜和精致的国际美食。

13:30 – 游览惊奇洞（Sửng Sốt）

游轮继续前往惊奇洞，这是下龙湾最著名、最壮观的溶洞。惊叹于钟乳石和石笋的壮丽造型，构成一幅真正令人敬畏的天然杰作。

15:00 – 休闲时光 | 下午茶 & 欢乐时光

返回游轮享受悠闲时光：

  • 享用下午茶
  • 享受欢乐时光（买一送一）
  • 放松身心、拍照留念，品味海湾的宁静氛围

16:30 – 下船 | 旅程结束

天堂之悦游轮返回Tuần Châu码头。宾客下船，结束一次难忘的下龙湾全日游轮体验。

注意事项

  • 受天气或航行条件影响，行程可能在不另行通知的情况下变更
  • 受海湾地理条件影响，Wi-Fi连接可能中断
  • 竹筏或皮划艇服务不包含在内，需另行付费

  • 欢迎饮品
  • 船上早餐
  • 精选自助午餐
  • 下午茶
  • 船上保险、税费及服务费

费用不包含

  • 酒店住宿
  • 往返游轮码头的交通
  • 费用包含项目中未提及的饮品
  • 卡拉OK及其他娱乐服务

tours.title: Ha Noi Cultural Day Trip
tours.summary: Experience a full day of culture, history, and local traditions with Vietlook Travel. This private journey takes you from bustling Hanoi to three of the region’s most charming heritage sites. Itinerary 08:00 – Pick-up fr
tours.contentHtml:
Experience a full day of culture, history, and local traditions with Vietlook Travel. This private journey takes you from bustling Hanoi to three of the region’s most charming heritage sites.

Itinerary

08:00 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your private car and knowledgeable local guide will meet you at your accommodation in Hanoi to begin the day.

09:30 – Van Phuc Silk Village

Visit Vietnam’s best-known silk-producing village. Learn about the traditional weaving process, observe artisans crafting intricate silk products, and explore a wide selection of high-quality handmade items.

11:00 – Thay Pagoda

Continue to Thay Pagoda, one of the most peaceful and spiritually significant pagodas in northern Vietnam. Surrounded by mountains and tranquil lakes, it offers a picturesque setting and insight into Vietnam’s Buddhist heritage.

12:30 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese meal prepared with fresh, seasonal ingredients.

14:00 – Duong Lam Ancient Village

Step back in time as you explore one of Vietnam’s oldest villages. Walk through narrow alleys lined with laterite houses, visit ancient temples and the village gate, and experience the slow and peaceful rhythm of rural life.

15:30 – Return to Hanoi

Relax in your private car as we drive you back to your hotel or original pick-up point.

Why Choose This Tour?

  • Private and comfortable transportation

  • Friendly, experienced English-speaking guide

tours.title: HANOI’S INSIDER GOOD MORNING – AFTERNOON TOUR
tours.summary: Our team takes guests to sample the best dishes that Vietnam has to offer! This is a great way to see parts of the city that most tourists don’t have the chance to see or even hear about. We’ll take you to the most popul
tours.contentHtml:
Our team takes guests to sample the best dishes that Vietnam has to offer! This is a great way to see parts of the city that most tourists don’t have the chance to see or even hear about. We’ll take you to the most popular street stalls, hidden alleyways, and, of course, to where the locals love to hang out with their friends.

ITINERARY

  • We pick you up and drive through narrow streets to the meeting point to join the group at the historic Old Quarter. Our first stop is the French Quarter to visit the Hanoi Opera House, where you will learn about French colonial architecture and history.
  • Next, we head to our second destination: Long Bien Bridge, a magnificent structure built more than a hundred years ago. It spans the Red River and connects the Hoan Kiem and Long Bien districts. The bridge provides shelter to locals living on boats underneath, and only motorbikes and bicycles can traverse it so off we go!
  • Our next attraction takes you along the riverside to the Red River Island to visit a Hidden Gem Village. Here, you will see the poorer part of local life, observe farming activities, and have the chance to meet and chat with the people living on the island. Our guide will also take you to visit a local family to learn about their daily life.
  • Then we drive through the Banana Farm to admire the beautiful green vegetable fields along the way. We will also visit a Kumquat Farm these small trees are traditional gifts during Tet, the Vietnamese Lunar New Year, symbolizing luck, health, wealth, fertility, and peace.
  • Our next ride takes us to visit Tran Quoc Pagoda, located on West Lake one of the largest lakes in Hanoi. At certain points, you will have a panoramic view of the city with beautiful homes and stunning scenery, as well as see parts of the wealthy residential area.
  • We then drive to Thanh Nien Street next to West Lake and Truc Bach Lake, where we stop at the Monument of John McCain. Here you will see the site where he was shot down and learn the story behind it.
  • Continuing the ride, we pass by the Botanical Garden and small alleys with narrow houses to visit Huu Tiep Lake and the B-52 crash site. This U.S. bomber was shot down during the 1972 bombing raids over Hanoi a poignant reminder of recent history.
  • After a short scooter ride toward Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, our riders will stop at a viewpoint where you can see the Presidential Palace, Parliament Building, and other government offices. Our guide will share stories and history about Hanoi.
  • Our next stop is to enjoy Vietnamese coffee, including the famous Hanoi specialty Egg Coffee.
  • We then get back on the scooter and head to a local restaurant for you to enjoy authentic Vietnamese cuisine. After lunch, our riders will take you back to your hotel or drop you off anywhere you prefer. Just let us know goodbye

Included

  • Scooter, fuel, helmet

  • Experienced professional riders

  • English-speaking guides

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • All entrance fees & cold water throughout the tour

  • Free pick-up and drop-off

  • Raincoat (if needed)
tours.titleZh: 河内早晚深度游
tours.summaryZh: 我们的团队将带您品尝越南最棒的美食！这是一个了解这座城市大多数游客没有机会看到、甚至从未听说过的角落的绝佳方式。我们会带您去最受欢迎的街边小摊
tours.contentHtmlZh:
我们的团队将带您品尝越南最棒的美食！这是一个了解这座城市大多数游客没有机会看到、甚至从未听说过的角落的绝佳方式。我们会带您去最受欢迎的街边小摊、隐秘的小巷，当然还有当地人最爱与朋友聚会的地方。

行程安排

  • 我们接上您后穿过狭窄的街道前往集合点，在历史悠久的老城区与团队会合。第一站是法国区，参观河内歌剧院，您将了解法国殖民时期的建筑与历史。
  • 接下来前往第二站：龙编桥，这座宏伟的建筑已有一百多年历史。大桥横跨红河，连接还剑区和龙编区。桥下的船上还居住着当地居民，大桥为他们遮风避雨，而且只有摩托车和自行车才能通行，出发吧！
  • 下一个景点沿着河岸前往红河沙洲，参观一个隐秘的世外村落。在这里，您将看到当地较为朴素的生活，观察农耕活动，并有机会与岛上居民见面交谈。导游还会带您拜访一户当地家庭，了解他们的日常生活。
  • 随后我们穿过香蕉园，欣赏沿途美丽的绿色菜地。我们还将参观金桔园——这种小树是越南农历新年（春节/Tết）的传统礼物，象征着好运、健康、财富、多子和平安。
  • 接着前往镇国寺，它坐落在西湖畔，西湖是河内最大的湖泊之一。在某些地点，您可以俯瞰城市全景，欣赏漂亮的住宅和迷人的风景，同时也能看到部分富人居住区。
  • 然后我们前往西湖和竹帛湖旁的青年路，在约翰·麦凯恩纪念碑前停留。在这里您将看到他被击落的地点，并了解背后的故事。
  • 继续前行，我们经过植物园和狭窄房屋林立的小巷，参观友接湖（Hữu Tiệp）和B-52坠毁遗址。这架美军轰炸机在1972年轰炸河内期间被击落，是对近代历史的沉痛提醒。
  • 乘坐踏板摩托车短途前往胡志明陵后，我们的骑手将在一处观景点停留，您可以看到总统府、国会大厦和其他政府机关。导游将为您讲述河内的故事和历史。
  • 下一站，享用越南咖啡，包括河内著名的特色蛋咖啡。
  • 随后我们再次骑上摩托车，前往当地餐厅，让您品尝地道的越南美食。午餐后，我们的骑手会送您回酒店，或送您到任何您想去的地方。告诉我们一声就好，再见！

tours.title: HANOI BICYCLE BACKSTREET TOUR 4.5 HOURS
tours.summary: Detailed Itinerary 8:00 AM (or 1:00 PM): Your tour guide will pick you up from your hotel lobby and transfer you to our bicycle shop to choose a suitable bike. Once you meet your local guide, you’ll get comfortable with
tours.contentHtml:
Detailed Itinerary

8:00 AM (or 1:00 PM): Your tour guide will pick you up from your hotel lobby and transfer you to our bicycle shop to choose a suitable bike. Once you meet your local guide, you’ll get comfortable with your bicycle and receive a safety briefing. Then we’ll begin our ride!

We will cycle to see the amazing alley where the train passes through the residential area. Riding along the train track, you will explore part of the French Quarter with its old French colonial architecture. We will continue cycling through Ngoc Ha Flower Village, passing small narrow alleys and dark roads, seeing tall and narrow houses, and experiencing lively backstreets with chances to meet the friendly local people of Hanoi.

After a long ride through narrow streets, you will visit the site of an American B-52 aircraft that was shot down during the Christmas Bombing in 1972, now known as B-52 Lake. We then continue biking to one of the most beautiful areas of Hanoi West Lake where you can stop to enjoy a panoramic view of the city.

Next, we will cycle back into the narrow roads to visit a local market and ride through the narrowest streets in Hanoi so you can see and feel how local people live. We then ride up to the Red River to visit a hidden village where locals grow their own crops such as vegetables, corn, bananas, and many types of fruits. You will have a chance to visit a local family living on the island in simple houses, yet always friendly and welcoming. This experience will help you learn and understand more about local life in different parts of the city.

After that, we continue cycling along the Red River bank to see the green farmlands and head to Long Bien Bridge the historic and oldest bridge in Hanoi where you can enjoy the views, history, and take photos.

To end the tour, we will take you to enjoy street food and a traditional egg coffee, then drop you off back at your hotel.

Tour Includes

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Special backstreet bicycle experience

  • Quality mountain bike provided

  • All entry fees + free water during the tour

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • For groups of 3 or more people, we provide one support staff member to take care of the group for added safety and security
tours.titleZh: 河内小巷骑行游（4.5小时）
tours.summaryZh: 行程详情：上午8:00（或下午1:00），导游在酒店大堂接您，并送您前往我们的自行车店挑选合适的自行车。与当地向导见面后，您可以先熟悉一下自行车
tours.contentHtmlZh:
行程详情

上午8:00（或下午1:00）：导游在酒店大堂接您，并送您前往我们的自行车店挑选合适的自行车。与当地向导见面后，您可以先熟悉一下自行车，并听取安全须知。然后我们就开始骑行啦！

我们将骑行前往观赏火车穿过居民区的神奇小巷。沿着铁轨骑行，您将探索法国区的一部分，欣赏古老的法式殖民建筑。我们将继续骑行穿过玉河花村（Ngọc Hà），经过狭窄的小巷和昏暗的小路，看到高而窄的房屋，体验热闹的后街生活，还有机会结识友善的河内当地人。

在小街小巷中骑行许久之后，您将参观1972年圣诞大轰炸期间被击落的美军B-52轰炸机遗址，如今被称为B-52湖。随后我们继续骑行前往河内最美的地区之一——西湖，您可以在此停留，欣赏城市的全景。

接下来，我们将骑回狭窄的小路，参观当地市场，并骑行穿过河内最狭窄的街道，让您亲眼看到并感受当地人的生活方式。随后我们骑行至红河，探访一个隐秘的村落，当地人在这里种植自己的农作物，如蔬菜、玉米、香蕉和各种水果。您将有机会拜访居住在沙洲岛上的当地家庭，他们的房屋虽然简朴，却总是热情友好、欢迎来客。这段体验将帮助您更深入地了解城市不同角落的当地生活。

之后，我们继续沿红河岸边骑行，欣赏绿色的农田，并前往龙编桥——河内历史最悠久的古桥，您可以在这里欣赏风景、了解历史并拍照留念。

行程最后，我们将带您品尝街头小吃和传统蛋咖啡，然后送您返回酒店。

  • 专业英语导游

  • 特色后街自行车体验

  • 提供优质山地自行车

  • 所有门票 + 行程中免费饮用水

  • 当地餐厅午餐

  • 3人及以上团队，我们将安排一名协助人员照看团队，以确保更高的安全保障

tours.title: War Tour Of Hanoi
tours.summary: An Insight Into The Vietnam War War is a memory that peace lovers do not wish to recall, but it happened on the beautiful land of Vietnam. While there is an abundance of information available, this tour focuses on a sele
tours.contentHtml:
An Insight Into The Vietnam War

War is a memory that peace lovers do not wish to recall, but it happened on the beautiful land of Vietnam. While there is an abundance of information available, this tour focuses on a select few key locations that offer an intimate and personal look into the war’s impact on Hanoi.

2 Time Slots Every Day

  • 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM

  • 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM

Itinerary

  • 8:00 AM: Pickup at your hotel

  • 8:30 AM: Visit Hoa Lo Prison, built and used by French rulers in Vietnam for political prisoners, and later by the government of North Vietnam for war prisoners. This building is also known as “Hanoi Hilton” and “hosted” some American prisoners, including Senator John McCain and Pete Peterson, the United States’ first post-war ambassador to Vietnam in 1997.

  • 10:00 AM: Continue to the B-52 Victory Museum, which displays relics of the B-52 Stratofortress, an aircraft that played a major role in the American War. On the way back, you will also see a small lake that contains the wreckage of a B-52 bomber shot down over Hanoi in 1972 (now called B-52 Lake).

  • 11:00 AM: Visit the Back Market, a bustling market that became notorious during the Vietnam War. The Hanoi bazaar is a chaotic maze of zigzagging alleyways, filled with local vendors selling everything from food to wartime relics. This is a place where history comes alive, and you will be fascinated by the stories it holds.

  • 11:30 AM: Have lunch at a local restaurant

  • 12:30 PM: Return to your hotel

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Quality mountain bike provided

  • All entry fees + free water during the tour

tours.titleZh: 河内战争历史游
tours.summaryZh: 深入了解越南战争：战争是热爱和平的人们不愿回忆的往事，但它确实发生在美丽的越南土地上。虽然相关资料十分丰富，但这趟行程只聚焦于少数几个关键地点……
tours.contentHtmlZh:
深入了解越南战争

战争是热爱和平的人们不愿回忆的往事，但它确实发生在美丽的越南土地上。虽然相关资料十分丰富，但这趟行程只聚焦于少数几个关键地点，带您近距离、深入地了解战争对河内的影响。

每天2个时段

  • 上午8:00 – 中午12:00

  • 下午1:00 – 下午5:00

行程安排

  • 上午8:00：酒店接客

  • 上午8:30：参观还剑区的火炉监狱（Hỏa Lò），这里由法国殖民统治者修建，最初用于关押政治犯，后来被北越政府用来关押战俘。该建筑也被称为“河内希尔顿”，曾“接待”过一些美国战俘，其中包括参议员约翰·麦凯恩，以及1997年美国战后首任驻越南大使皮特·彼得森。

  • 上午10:00：继续前往B-52胜利博物馆，馆内陈列着B-52同温层堡垒轰炸机的遗物，这种飞机在越南战争中扮演了重要角色。返程途中，您还将看到一个小湖，湖中留有1972年在河内上空被击落的B-52轰炸机残骸（如今被称为B-52湖）。

  • 上午11:00：参观后市场（Back Market），这是一个在越南战争期间声名远扬的热闹市场。这座河内集市宛如一座混乱的迷宫，蜿蜒曲折的小巷纵横交错，当地商贩在这里售卖从食品到战时遗物的各式商品。这里是历史鲜活再现的地方，它所承载的故事一定会让您着迷。

  • 上午11:30：在当地餐厅享用午餐

  • 下午12:30：返回酒店

  • 专业英语导游

  • 提供优质山地自行车

tours.title: Hanoi Bicycle Sunset Tour
tours.summary: Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour 16:00: Our tour guide will pick you up and transfer you to our bicycle store, where you will choose a suitable bike. After a short briefing about the itinerary, we will start riding along t
tours.contentHtml:
Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour

16:00: Our tour guide will pick you up and transfer you to our bicycle store, where you will choose a suitable bike. After a short briefing about the itinerary, we will start riding along the Red River bank, passing the Opera House and the Ceramic Road.

We then visit Long Bien Bridge and a quiet island where farmers grow vegetables and fruits, followed by a visit to a local market. After that, you will enjoy an amazing ride to West Lake, where we can admire the panoramic view of the sunset. This is a great place for beautiful photos.

From there, we continue riding to Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the 1,000 year old Citadel and B52 Lake, where a military aircraft was shot down and has remained in the lake since the war. We also cycle past some of Hanoi’s most famous landmarks such as Train Street, the French Quarter, and the Old Quarter.

After the ride, we return to the Old Quarter to enjoy dinner at a famous local street food restaurant, where you will taste traditional Vietnamese dishes. Then you will try the iconic egg coffee before being transferred back to your hotel.

Tour Includes

  • Mountain bikes

  • Experienced English-speaking cycling tour guide

  • Street food dinner

  • All entrance fees and bottled water

  • Free pick-up and drop-off

  • Rain poncho (if needed)
tours.titleZh: 河内日落骑行游
tours.summaryZh: 行程详情：16:00，导游接您前往我们的自行车店，您可以在这里挑选合适的自行车。简短介绍行程后，我们将沿着红河岸边出发，途经歌剧院和陶瓷壁画长廊。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
行程详情

16:00：导游接您前往我们的自行车店，您可以在这里挑选合适的自行车。简短介绍行程后，我们将沿着红河岸边出发，途经歌剧院和陶瓷壁画长廊。

随后我们参观龙编桥和一座宁静的沙洲岛，当地农民在岛上种植蔬菜和水果，接着前往当地市场逛一逛。之后，您将骑行前往西湖，在那里欣赏日落的全景美景，这里是拍摄美照的绝佳地点。

接着，我们继续骑行前往胡志明陵、拥有千年历史的升龙皇城，以及B52湖——战争期间一架军用飞机在此被击落，残骸至今仍留在湖中。我们还会骑行经过河内一些最著名的地标，如火车街、法国区和老城区。

骑行结束后，我们回到老城区，在一家著名的当地街头小吃餐厅享用晚餐，品尝传统越南美食。随后您还将尝试标志性的蛋咖啡，然后送您返回酒店。

行程包含

  • 山地自行车

  • 经验丰富的英语骑行导游

  • 街头小吃晚餐

  • 所有门票及瓶装水

  • 免费接送

  • 雨披（如有需要）

tours.title: Hanoi Coffee Tour
tours.summary: Dive into the coffee culture of Hanoi with our Hanoi Coffee Tour and learn traditional coffee-making techniques while creating three local favorites: creamy egg coffee, unique salt coffee, and refreshing coconut coffee.
tours.contentHtml:
Dive into the coffee culture of Hanoi with our Hanoi Coffee Tour and learn traditional coffee-making techniques while creating three local favorites: creamy egg coffee, unique salt coffee, and refreshing coconut coffee.

What You Will Do In The Workshop

  • Discover the rich history of Vietnamese coffee and its cultivation across the country.

  • Gain hands-on experience brewing coffee using a phin, the traditional Vietnamese coffee filter.

  • Taste the distinctive flavors of pure Vietnamese coffee, learn how to identify differences among the beans, and recognize high-quality coffee.

  • Master the art of making three iconic Vietnamese coffee drinks: egg coffee, salt coffee, and coconut coffee, while learning the stories behind each recipe.

  • Enjoy the coffee drinks you’ve crafted during the workshop.

  • Receive a Vietnamese coffee filter (phin) and detailed recipes to recreate the delicious drinks at home.

Inclusions

  • All ingredients and tools necessary for the workshop.

  • Bread with condensed milk to accompany the coffee.

  • Coffee recipes (provided as a PDF file).

  • A Vietnamese coffee filter (phin).

  • An English-speaking local guide.

Exclusions

  • Additional food or drinks at the host location.

  • Pick-up and drop-off service.
tours.titleZh: 河内咖啡之旅
tours.summaryZh: 通过我们的河内咖啡之旅，深入了解河内的咖啡文化，学习传统咖啡制作技艺，亲手制作三款当地人气饮品：绵密的蛋咖啡、独特的海盐咖啡和清爽的椰子咖啡。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
通过我们的 河内咖啡之旅 ，深入了解河内的咖啡文化，学习传统咖啡制作技艺，亲手制作三款当地人气饮品：绵密的蛋咖啡、独特的海盐咖啡和清爽的椰子咖啡。

工作坊体验内容

  • 了解越南咖啡丰富的历史及其在全国各地的种植情况。

  • 亲手体验使用越南传统咖啡滴滤壶（phin）冲泡咖啡。

  • 品尝纯正越南咖啡的独特风味，学习辨别不同咖啡豆之间的差异，并识别优质咖啡。

  • 掌握制作三款越南标志性咖啡饮品的技艺：蛋咖啡、海盐咖啡和椰子咖啡，同时了解每道配方背后的故事。

  • 品尝您在工作坊中亲手制作的咖啡饮品。

  • 获赠一个越南咖啡滴滤壶（phin）和详细配方，让您在家也能重现美味饮品。

tours.title: Discover Vietnam’s Culinary Culture Experience
tours.summary: Cooking is a key part of culture, and through this experience, participants will gain valuable insights into the history, rituals, and values connected to various cuisines. It’s a delicious way to explore cultural legaci
tours.contentHtml:
Cooking is a key part of culture, and through this experience, participants will gain valuable insights into the history, rituals, and values connected to various cuisines. It’s a delicious way to explore cultural legacies.

The experience provides a communal setting where people can bond over food. Participants will connect with fellow learners, chefs, and instructors, creating a sense of community and shared experience.

Exploring diverse cuisines broadens horizons and fosters an appreciation for global flavors, ingredients, and cooking techniques. This encourages tolerance and understanding of different cultures.

Itinerary

  • 9:00 AM: Pickup at your hotel

  • 9:30 – 10:00 AM: Walkthrough the local “wet” market to purchase ingredients and experience a fascinating glimpse into Vietnamese culture with the guidance of our Cultural Storytellers.

  • Learn useful Vietnamese phrases for daily communication.

  • 10:15 AM: Arrive at the kitchen

    • Enjoy the Kitchen’s signature welcome drink made from 100% natural herbs.

    • Discover the Vietnamese words and cultural beliefs behind each ingredient.

    • Learn how to prepare authentic Vietnamese traditional dishes under the guidance of our Cultural Storytellers.

    • Decorate your dishes creatively.

    • Celebrate your cooking achievements with a toast of local wine.

  • 12:15 PM: Enjoy your delicious creations in a beautiful garden villa.

  • 1:15 PM: Return to your hotel.

Our Menu

  • NỘM HOA CHUỐI | BANANA FLOWER SALAD: A special appetizer made with fresh banana flowers, vegetables, and herbs.

  • BÚN CHẢ | OBAMA NOODLES – BBQ (PORK) WITH DIPPING SAUCE: A sweet and sour dipping sauce served with flavorful marinated BBQ pork, enjoyed by Chef Anthony Bourdain and former US President Barack Obama.

  • NEM | VIETNAMESE FRIED SPRING-ROLLS: Crispy spring rolls paired with Bun Cha for the perfect flavor combination. Imagine dipping the spring rolls into sweet and sour sauce for an unforgettable taste experience
tours.titleZh: 越南美食文化体验
tours.summaryZh: 烹饪是文化的重要组成部分，通过这次体验，参与者将深入了解各种菜系背后的历史、仪式和价值观。这是探索文化遗产的美味方式。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
烹饪是文化的重要组成部分，通过这次体验，参与者将深入了解各种菜系背后的历史、仪式和价值观。这是探索文化遗产的美味方式。

这次体验营造了一个人们可以围绕美食联络感情的集体氛围。参与者将结识同学、厨师和导师，建立社群感和共同的体验。

探索多元菜系可以开阔视野，增进对世界各地风味、食材和烹饪技巧的欣赏，从而促进对不同文化的包容与理解。

行程安排

  • NEM | 越南炸春卷：酥脆的春卷与烤肉米线搭配，风味绝佳。想象一下将春卷蘸上酸甜酱汁，那是令人难忘的味觉体验

tours.title: Hanoi Bicycle To Red River Island Countryside
tours.summary: Detailed Itinerary of the Tour Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel and take you to our bicycle parking lot, where you can select a suitable bike for your ride. We will start cycling through the Old Quarter, r
tours.contentHtml:
Detailed Itinerary of the Tour

  • Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel and take you to our bicycle parking lot, where you can select a suitable bike for your ride.
  • We will start cycling through the Old Quarter, riding through narrow streets before crossing the Red River via Long Bien Bridge the oldest bridge in Hanoi, built during the French colonial era over 100 years ago. Enjoy scenic views of the Red River, watch the boats float beneath, and observe the green vegetable farms on the island.
  • We will start cycling through the Old Quarter, riding through narrow streets before crossing the Red River via Long Bien Bridge the oldest bridge in Hanoi, built during the French colonial era over 100 years ago. Enjoy scenic views of the Red River, watch the boats float beneath, and observe the green vegetable farms on the island.
  • We will then cycle into the island countryside, where local farmers live and work, offering a glimpse into their daily lives. Here, you will have the opportunity to visit a family living on a floating house on the Red River. You can learn about their way of life and traditions, with our guide helping facilitate interaction with the family.
  • Continuing our journey, we will cycle through dirt roads and rural villages, heading toward various farms. Enjoy the vast green landscapes, including corn farms, banana farms, and vegetable farms, where you’ll meet the farmers and engage in conversations to better understand their daily routines.
  • We will then cycle up to a kumquat farm, where you can observe locals working and cultivating the fruit.
  • Next, we will visit a local family, giving you a chance to interact with them, learn more about their culture, and hear about their daily lives.
  • Finally, we will cycle past West Lake for a beautiful view of Hanoi, before passing the railway train track on our way back to your hotel.
  • End of the tour, we will take you back to your hotel.

Tour Includes

  • Professional English speaking guide

  • Quality mountain bike provided

  • All entry fees + free water during the tour

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • For groups of 3 or more people, a support guide will accompany the group to ensure safety and security during the tour.
tours.titleZh: 河内骑行至红河岛乡村
tours.summaryZh: 行程详情 我们的导游将到酒店接您，并带您前往自行车停放处，您可以在这里挑选一辆合适的自行车。我们将从老城区出发开始骑行，
tours.contentHtmlZh:
行程详情

  • 我们的导游将到酒店接您，并带您前往自行车停放处，您可以在这里挑选一辆合适的自行车。
  • 我们将从老城区出发开始骑行，穿过狭窄的街巷，然后经由龙边桥跨越红河。龙边桥是河内最古老的桥梁，建于100多年前的法国殖民时期。您可以欣赏红河的秀丽景色，看船只从桥下划过，并观赏沙洲上的绿色菜园。
  • 我们将从老城区出发开始骑行，穿过狭窄的街巷，然后经由龙边桥跨越红河。龙边桥是河内最古老的桥梁，建于100多年前的法国殖民时期。您可以欣赏红河的秀丽景色，看船只从桥下划过，并观赏沙洲上的绿色菜园。
  • 随后我们骑行进入沙洲乡村，当地农民在这里生活劳作，让您一窥他们的日常生活。在这里，您将有机会拜访一户居住在红河水上船屋的家庭，了解他们的生活方式和传统，导游将协助您与这户人家交流互动。
  • 继续前行，我们将骑过土路和乡村，前往各个农场。尽情欣赏广阔的绿色田野，包括玉米地、香蕉园和菜园，您将遇见当地农民并与他们交谈，更好地了解他们的日常生活。
  • 接着我们将骑行前往一座金桔农场，您可以观看当地人如何种植和照料这种水果。
  • 然后我们将拜访一户当地人家，让您有机会与他们互动，进一步了解他们的文化，倾听他们的日常生活。
  • 最后，我们将骑行经过西湖，欣赏河内的美丽景色，再越过铁路轨道返回您的酒店。
  • 行程结束，我们将送您回酒店。

  • 提供优质山地自行车

tours.title: Visit Hanoi And Countryside By Bicycle
tours.summary: Detailed Itinerary Of the Tour 08:00 AM: Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, homestay, or residence and transfer you to our office or bicycle store, where you can choose the most suitable bicycle for
tours.contentHtml:
Detailed Itinerary Of the Tour

  • 08:00 AM: Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, homestay, or residence and transfer you to our office or bicycle store, where you can choose the most suitable bicycle for your ride. The adventure begins as we cycle through the French Quarter, admiring the beautiful French architecture.

  • Our first stop will be St. Joseph’s Cathedral, one of the oldest churches in Hanoi. You will have time to explore and learn about its history while taking pictures.

  • We then continue cycling through the Old Quarter, passing narrow roads and alleys, to reach the Railway Train Track. Here, you will cycle along the tracks, observing the houses built next to the railway, offering a glimpse into the daily lives of locals living close to the train line.

  • On this short tour of Hanoi, we will visit key landmarks such as Le Nin Park and Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. You will stop outside the mausoleum to take pictures and learn about the history of Vietnam’s beloved leader.

  • We will cycle along Thanh Nien Road, passing West Lake and Truc Bach Lake, two of Hanoi’s most beautiful lakes. You will also visit the John McCain Monument before heading to Tran Quoc Pagoda, one of the oldest pagodas in Hanoi.

  • Next, we will cycle through a small alley to visit a local market, where you will see fresh food sold by vendors and get an insight into the daily life of the locals. You will also have the chance to sample some tropical fruits.

  • Continuing along the Red River Island, we will explore the countryside, cycling past banana farms and corn farms along the riverside. We will then visit the Floating Village and meet a local family to learn about their life on the island.

  • We will cycle along the riverbank to visit the Long Bien Bridge, a historic structure built by the French during the colonial era (1898-1902). From the bridge, you will enjoy a panoramic view of the city, the river, and the surrounding countryside, all while learning about the historical significance of this iconic bridge.

  • After a full day of exploration, we will return to your hotel, marking the end of your tour.

Tour Includes:

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Quality mountain bike provided

  • All entry fees + free water during the tour

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • For groups of 3 or more people, a support guide will accompany the group to ensure safety and security during the tour.
tours.titleZh: 骑行游览河内及乡村
tours.summaryZh: 行程详情：上午08:00，导游从您的酒店、Airbnb、民宿或住所接您，并送您前往我们的办公室或自行车店，您可以在这里挑选最适合自己的自行车
tours.contentHtmlZh:
行程详情

  • 上午08:00：导游从您的酒店、Airbnb、民宿或住所接您，并送您前往我们的办公室或自行车店，您可以在这里挑选最适合自己的自行车。冒险就此开始，我们将骑行穿过法国区，欣赏美丽的法式建筑。

  • 第一站是圣若瑟大教堂，河内最古老的教堂之一。您可以在此参观、了解它的历史并拍照留念。

  • 随后我们继续骑行穿过老城区，经过狭窄的道路和小巷，抵达铁路火车轨道。在这里，您将沿着铁轨骑行，看到紧挨铁路而建的房屋，一窥住在铁路沿线的当地人的日常生活。

  • 在这趟河内短途游览中，我们将参观列宁公园和胡志明陵等重要地标。您将在陵墓外停留拍照，并了解越南人民爱戴的领袖的历史。

  • 我们将沿青年路（Thanh Niên）骑行，经过西湖和竹帛湖——河内最美的两座湖泊。您还将参观约翰·麦凯恩纪念碑，然后前往镇国寺，这是河内最古老的寺庙之一。

  • 接下来，我们将骑行穿过一条小巷，参观当地市场，您将看到小贩售卖的新鲜食材，深入了解当地人的日常生活。您还有机会品尝一些热带水果。

  • 沿着红河沙洲继续前行，我们将探索乡村风光，沿河岸骑行经过香蕉园和玉米地。随后我们将参观水上村庄，拜访一户当地家庭，了解他们在岛上的生活。

  • 我们将沿河岸骑行，参观龙编桥，这是法国人在殖民时期（1898-1902年）修建的历史建筑。在桥上，您可以欣赏城市、河流和周边乡村的全景，同时了解这座标志性大桥的历史意义。

  • 经过充实的一天探索后，我们将送您返回酒店，行程到此结束。

行程包含：

  • 专业英语导游

  • 提供优质山地自行车

  • 所有门票 + 行程中免费饮用水

  • 当地餐厅午餐

  • 3人及以上团队将有一名协助向导随行，确保行程中的安全与保障。

tours.title: Hanoi Bicycle Tours Explore The Red River Delta
tours.summary: Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour 8:00 AM: Our Hanoi Bicycle Tour Team will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, or homestay and take you to our bicycle store where you can choose a bike that suits you. After getting comfor
tours.contentHtml:
Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour

  • 8:00 AM: Our Hanoi Bicycle Tour Team will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, or homestay and take you to our bicycle store where you can choose a bike that suits you. After getting comfortable with your bicycle and receiving a safety briefing, we’ll begin our ride.
  • Our guide will lead you as we leave the busy city and head onto the back roads, dirt trails, and rural countryside paths. The first stop will be Long Bien Bridge, where you will enjoy stunning panoramic views of Hanoi city and the Red River. Cycling across the middle of the bridge, you’ll have the chance to observe the vast island below, where local farmers work, providing a spectacular view of both the city and the river.
  • We’ll then continue cycling through several villages and rural areas, immersing ourselves in the serene countryside. Pedal through bright green rice paddies while stopping to visit local cottages and marvel at the vast expanses of farmland. During this journey, you’ll also meet local residents, and our guide will lead you past the most picturesque and fascinating landscapes in the Red River Delta.
  • In addition to the cycling, we will visit Co Loa Citadel, a significant historical site dating back to 257 BC, offering insight into the country’s ancient history.
  • Our next stop will be a local market, where you can experience the vibrant atmosphere, followed by a visit to a fruit farm where you’ll have the chance to pick and enjoy tropical fruits.
  • We will then enjoy lunch at a Vietnamese family’s home, where they will cook and serve a delicious traditional meal.
  • After lunch, we will continue cycling through the villages and stop to visit local families. This provides an opportunity to meet the locals, learn about their farming practices, and understand their daily lives.
  • We will then ride along the Red River bank, heading back to Hanoi, with an expected arrival time around 4:00 PM – 4:30 PM.

Tour Includes

  • Professional English-speaking guide
  • Quality mountain bike provided
  • Free pick-up and drop-off service
  • All entry fees + free water during the tour
  • Lunch at a local family home
  • For groups of 3 or more, we provide a backup guide to ensure the safety and security of the group

行程详情

  • 上午8:00：我们的河内自行车之旅团队将到您的酒店、Airbnb或民宿接您，并带您前往我们的自行车店，您可以在那里选择适合自己的自行车。熟悉自行车并接受安全讲解后，我们便开始骑行。
  • 导游将带领大家离开繁忙的城市，驶入小路、土路和乡间小径。第一站是龙编桥，您将欣赏河内市区和红河的壮丽全景。骑行至桥中央时，您有机会俯瞰下方广阔的江心岛，当地农民在那里耕作，城市与河流的景色尽收眼底，十分壮观。
  • 随后我们将继续骑行穿过几个村庄和乡村地区，沉浸于宁静的田园风光之中。踏着单车穿越翠绿的稻田，并停下来参观当地农舍，惊叹于广阔的农田。旅途中，您还将遇到当地居民，导游会带您经过红河三角洲最风景如画、最迷人的景观。
  • 除了骑行，我们还将参观古螺古城，这是一处可追溯至公元前257年的重要历史遗址，让您了解这个国家古老的历史。
  • 下一站是当地市场，您可以感受热闹的氛围，随后参观一座水果农场，您将有机会采摘并品尝热带水果。
  • 随后我们将在一户越南人家中享用午餐，主人将烹制并端上美味的传统饭菜。
  • 午餐后，我们将继续骑行穿过村庄，并停下来拜访当地家庭。这是一个结识当地人、了解他们的农耕方式和日常生活的机会。
  • 随后我们将沿着红河岸边骑行返回河内，预计下午4:00 – 4:30抵达。

行程包含

  • 专业英语导游
  • 提供优质山地自行车
  • 免费接送服务
  • 所有门票 + 行程中免费饮用水
  • 当地家庭午餐
  • 3人及以上团队，我们将配备一名备用导游，以确保团队的安全

tours.title: HA GIANG EASY RIDER – 4 DAYS
tours.summary: This 4 day Ha Giang Easy Rider adventure is designed for travelers who want to fully explore the most spectacular landscapes of Northern Vietnam. From the clay-house villages of Nam Dam to the iconic Lũng Cú Flagpole, th
tours.contentHtml:
This 4 day Ha Giang Easy Rider adventure is designed for travelers who want to fully explore the most spectacular landscapes of Northern Vietnam. From the clay-house villages of Nam Dam to the iconic Lũng Cú Flagpole, the legendary Mã Pí Lèng Pass, the hidden waterfall of Du Già, and countless remote villages this journey offers unmatched scenery, culture, history, and unforgettable local experiences.

Ride safely with professional Easy Riders and enjoy authentic stays, ethnic cuisine, and breathtaking views throughout your trip.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang (Sleeper Bus)

Pick-up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter and transfer to Ha Giang by luxury private-cabin sleeper bus.

Overnight in a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Nam Dam Village – Lung Tam Handicraft Village – Yen Minh

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30
Tour begins at our homestay in Ha Giang. Safety briefing with your tour guide and Easy Riders.

After leaving the city, the landscape changes dramatically as you move deeper into the mountains. Highlights include:

  • Bac Sum Pass – panoramic viewpoint, tea break

  • Quan Ba Heaven Gate – stunning mountain panorama

  • Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

Continue to:

  • Nam Dam Village – an authentic Dao ethnic village

    • Learn about clay-house architecture

    • Explore the village for ~2.5 hours

    • Enjoy local specialties in Quan Ba

After lunch, continue riding through small hidden valleys and back roads only locals know, offering untouched landscapes seldom visited by self-riders.

Visit:

  • Lung Tam Village – famous for hemp weaving and ethnic handicrafts

    • Visit a local family to see the traditional weaving process

Continue to Yen Minh Town for dinner and overnight stay.

Day 2: Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Lung Cu Flagpole – Lo Lo Chai Village – Dong Van Town

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, ride to:

  • Tham Ma Slope – iconic 9-section winding road

  • Sủng Là Valley – ancient houses and preserved H’Mong culture

Visit:

  • Lung Cu Flagpole – the northernmost point of Vietnam

    • Spectacular views over China–Vietnam border

    • Explore Lo Lo Chai Village, home of the Lô Lô ethnic minority

Lunch at a local restaurant.

Continue to:

  • H’Mong King Palace (Vương Family Residence) – historical royal home

  • Arrive in Đồng Văn Town for homestay, dinner, and free night exploration

Day 3: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Lung Ho – Mau Due – Du Gia Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, begin the most iconic section of the Ha Giang Loop:

  • Ma Pi Leng Pass – “King of Vietnam’s mountain passes”, 2,000m altitude

  • Sky Path Ride – overlook the Nho Que River valley and limestone cliffs

Take unforgettable photos from multiple viewpoints along the pass.

Continue riding through remote ethnic villages:

  • Lung Ho

  • Mau Due

  • Meo Vac Town (lunch stop)

In the afternoon, ride deeper into the mountains toward Du Gia Village, known for:

  • Amazing tiered rice fields

  • 7 ethnic groups living peacefully together

  • Rich culture and warm hospitality

Dinner and overnight with a Tay minority family. Enjoy “happy water” in the evening.

Day 4: Du Gia – Du Gia Waterfall – Duong Thuong Valley – Thai An Road – Bac Me – Ha Giang City → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast:

  • Visit Du Gia Waterfall, a pristine hidden gem

  • Say farewell to the host family

  • Continue riding through dramatic landscapes

Highlights of the final day:

  • Duong Thuong Valley – wide open mountain panorama

  • Thai An Road – rugged mountain trail

  • Bac Me – scenic valley region

Arrive back in Ha Giang City in the afternoon.

16:00 – Board the limousine bus back to Hanoi.

Trip ends upon arrival.

Tour Price per Person (USD)

292 USD – SIC Group Tour

348 USD – Private Tour

Tour Includes

  • Round-trip transport Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang

    • Luxury private cabin sleeper bus (7:30–8:00 pm pickup)

    • Limousine bus (3:00–3:30 pm pickup)

  • Free night in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private room in homestays

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Experienced Easy Riders

  • All entrance fees

  • Motorbike, fuel

  • Protective gear: helmet, pads, raincoat

  • Drinking water (1 bottle/day)

Tour Excludes

  • Border entry permit

  • Tips for guides and riders

  • Personal drinks (coffee, beer, etc.)
tours.titleZh: 河江摩托骑行游 – 4天
tours.summaryZh: 这趟4天河江Easy Rider探险之旅，带您从Nậm Đăm泥屋村落到龙谷旗台、传奇的马皮岭山口和Du Già隐秘瀑布，由专业骑手安全带队，享受地道住宿、民族美食和令人屏息的美景。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟4天河江Easy Rider探险之旅，专为想全面领略越南北部最壮丽风光的旅行者设计。从Nậm Đăm的泥屋村落，到标志性的龙谷（Lũng Cú）旗台、传奇的马皮岭（Mã Pí Lèng）山口、Du Già隐秘的瀑布，以及无数偏远村寨，这段旅程带来无与伦比的风景、文化、历史和难忘的当地体验。

由专业Easy Rider骑手带您安全骑行，全程享受地道的住宿、民族特色美食和令人屏息的美景。

行程概览

河内 → 河江（卧铺巴士）

在河内老城区的酒店接客，乘坐豪华独立包厢卧铺巴士前往河江。

在河江市的传统民宿过夜。

行程安排

第1天：河江市 – Bắc Sum山口 – Quản Bạ天门 – Nậm Đăm村 – Lũng Tám手工艺村 – Yên Minh

含餐：午餐、晚餐

08:30
行程从我们在河江的民宿开始。与导游和Easy Rider骑手一起进行安全须知讲解。

离开市区后，随着深入群山，景色变化巨大。亮点包括：

  • Bắc Sum山口——全景观景点，茶歇

  • Quản Bạ天门——令人惊叹的山景全景

  • 双峰山（仙女乳峰）

继续前往：

  • Nậm Đăm村——地道的瑶族村寨

    • 了解泥屋建筑

    • 探索村庄约2.5小时

    • 品尝Quản Bạ当地特色美食

午餐后，继续骑行穿过只有当地人才知道的幽静小山谷和乡间小路，欣赏自驾者很少到访的原始风光。

参观：

  • Lũng Tám村——以亚麻编织和民族手工艺闻名

    • 拜访当地人家，观看传统编织过程

继续前往Yên Minh镇用晚餐并过夜。

第2天：Yên Minh – Thẩm Mã坡 – 苗王府 – 龙谷旗台 – Lô Lô Chải村 – 同文镇

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

早餐后，骑行前往：

  • Thẩm Mã坡——标志性的九道弯盘山路

  • Sủng Là山谷——古老的房屋和保存完好的苗族文化

参观：

  • 龙谷（Lũng Cú）旗台——越南最北端

    • 俯瞰壮观的中越边境景色

    • 探索Lô Lô Chải村，这里是倮倮族（Lô Lô）少数民族的家园

在当地餐厅享用午餐。

继续前往：

  • 苗王府（王家府邸）——历史悠久的王府

  • 抵达同文镇（Đồng Văn），入住民宿、享用晚餐，晚间自由探索

第3天：同文 – 志愿青年纪念碑 – 马皮岭山口 – Nho Quế河观景台 – Mèo Vạc – Lũng Hồ – Mậu Duệ – Du Già村

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

早餐后，开始河江环线最具标志性的路段：

  • 马皮岭山口（Mã Pí Lèng）——“越南山口之王”，海拔2,000米

  • 天空之路骑行——俯瞰Nho Quế河谷和石灰岩悬崖

在山口沿途的多个观景点拍摄难忘的照片。

继续骑行穿过偏远的少数民族村寨：

  • Lũng Hồ

  • Mậu Duệ

  • Mèo Vạc镇（午餐停留）

下午，深入群山骑行前往Du Già村，这里以以下特色闻名：

  • 令人惊叹的层层梯田

  • 7个民族和睦共处

  • 丰富的文化和热情的待客之道

与岱族家庭共进晚餐并过夜。晚间可享用“快乐水”。

第4天：Du Già – Du Già瀑布 – Đường Thượng山谷 – Thái An公路 – Bắc Mê – 河江市 → 河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

早餐后：

  • 参观Du Già瀑布，一处未经雕琢的隐秘瑰宝

  • 与寄宿家庭告别

  • 继续骑行穿越壮丽的风景

最后一天的亮点：

  • Đường Thượng山谷——开阔的山地全景

  • Thái An公路——崎岖的山间小道

  • Bắc Mê——风景优美的山谷地区

下午返回河江市。

16:00 – 登上返回河内的豪华小巴。

抵达后行程结束。

每人行程价格 (USD)

292 USD – SIC拼团游

348 USD – 私人包团游

行程包含

  • 河内 ↔ 河江往返交通

    • 豪华独立包厢卧铺巴士（晚上7:30–8:00接客）

    • 豪华小巴（下午3:00–3:30接客）

  • 河江市免费住宿一晚（传统民居）

  • 住宿：民宿独立房间

  • 餐食：早餐 – 午餐 – 晚餐

  • 专业英语导游

  • 经验丰富的Easy Rider骑手

  • 所有门票

  • 摩托车、燃油

  • 防护装备：头盔、护具、雨衣

  • 饮用水（每天1瓶）

行程不包含

  • 边境通行证

  • 给导游和骑手的小费

  • 个人饮品（咖啡、啤酒等）

tours.title: HA GIANG EASY RIDER – 3 DAYS
tours.summary: This 3 day Ha Giang Easy Rider tour is designed for travelers who want a deeper, more immersive experience in the majestic landscapes of Ha Giang. Explore winding mountain passes, limestone formations, ethnic minority vi
tours.contentHtml:
This 3 day Ha Giang Easy Rider tour is designed for travelers who want a deeper, more immersive experience in the majestic landscapes of Ha Giang. Explore winding mountain passes, limestone formations, ethnic minority villages, waterfalls, and the legendary Mã Pí Lèng Pass. Ride with experienced Easy Riders and enjoy authentic local culture, homestays, and breathtaking scenery every moment of the journey.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang (Sleeper Bus / Limousine Bus)

Pick-up at your hotel in the Hanoi Old Quarter. Travel to Ha Giang by luxury sleeper bus (private cabin) or limousine bus. Overnight in a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van Town

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30

Tour starts at our homestay in Ha Giang City. Your guide and Easy Riders will brief you on safety before the ride.

As soon as you enter the mountain region, the scenery transforms dramatically. You will stop at:

  • Bac Sum Pass – famous winding pass overlooking valleys

  • Quan Ba Heaven Gate

  • Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

Continue through the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark, a UNESCO-recognized landscape filled with limestone mountains, rice terraces, and remote ethnic villages. See locals farming, working the hillsides, and living their traditional lifestyle.

Lunch in Yen Minh Town.

In the afternoon, visit:

  • Tham Ma Slope – iconic winding slope

  • Vuong Family Residence (H’Mong King Palace) – former home of the H’Mong royal family

Arrive in Dong Van Town, check in at the homestay, enjoy dinner, and explore the town at night.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Lung Ho – Mau Due – Du Gia Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, head toward the most iconic section of the Ha Giang Loop.

Experience:

  • Ma Pi Leng Pass – the “King of Passes” in Vietnam, with craggy cliffs and dramatic mountain walls

  • Sky Path Downhill Ride – offering panoramic views over the spectacular valley and emerald Nho Que River

This is considered the most breathtaking view in all of Ha Giang.

Continue riding through remote ethnic villages:

  • Lung Ho

  • Mau Due

  • Meo Vac Town (lunch stop)

In the afternoon, follow a scenic mountain trail toward Du Gia Village, home to 7 ethnic minority groups living harmoniously. This village is known for its peaceful ambiance, green rice fields, and preserved traditional culture.

Check in at a Tay ethnic homestay and enjoy dinner with “happy water”.

Day 3: Du Gia Village – Du Gia Waterfall – Duong Thuong Valley – Thai An Road – Bac Me – Ha Giang City → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast, walk to the Du Gia Waterfall, a hidden gem tucked into lush forest.

Continue riding through:

  • Duong Thuong Valley – dramatic mountain landscapes

  • Thai An Road – known for its rugged terrain and beautiful views

  • Bac Me area

Arrive in Ha Giang City in the afternoon.

16:00

Board the limousine bus back to Hanoi.

Tour Price per Person (USD)

216 USD – SIC Group Tour

264 USD – Private Tour

Tour Includes

  • Round-trip transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang

    • Luxury private-cabin sleeper bus (7:30–8:00 pm pickup)

    • Limousine bus (3:00–3:30 pm pickup)

  • Free homestay in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Homestay accommodation with private room

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Experienced Easy Riders

  • Motorbike, fuel

  • Entrance fees

  • Protective gear: helmet, armor, raincoat

  • Drinking water (1 bottle/day)

Tour Excludes

  • Border entry permit (if required)

  • Tips for guide and riders

  • Personal drinks (coffee, beer, etc.)
tours.titleZh: 河江摩托骑行游 – 3天
tours.summaryZh: 这条3天河江Easy Rider之旅专为希望深度体验河江壮丽风光的旅行者设计：蜿蜒山路、石灰岩地貌、少数民族村寨、瀑布和传说中的马皮岭。与经验丰富的车手同行，体验地道文化和民宿。拼团216美元，私人团264美元。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这条为期3天的 河江 Easy Rider摩托之旅，专为希望在河江壮丽风光中获得更深入、更沉浸体验的旅行者设计。探索蜿蜒的山路、石灰岩地貌、少数民族村寨、瀑布以及传说中的马皮岭（Mã Pí Lèng）。与经验丰富的Easy Rider车手同行，一路尽享地道的当地文化、民宿体验和令人叹为观止的风景。

行程概览

河内 → 河江（卧铺大巴/豪华商务巴士）

在河内老城区酒店接客。乘豪华卧铺大巴（独立包厢）或豪华商务巴士前往河江。夜宿河江市传统民宿。

行程安排

第1天：河江市 – 北森岭 – Quản Bạ天门 – 双峰山 – 安明 – 探马坡 – 苗王府 – 同文镇

餐食：午餐、晚餐

08:30

行程从我们位于河江市的民宿开始。出发前，导游和Easy Rider车手会为您讲解安全事项。

一进入山区，风景便发生巨大变化。您将在以下地点停留：

  • 北森岭——俯瞰山谷的著名盘山公路

  • Quản Bạ天门

  • 双峰山（仙女乳峰）

继续穿越同文喀斯特高原地质公园，这处联合国教科文组织认可的景观遍布石灰岩山峰、梯田和偏远的少数民族村寨。您将看到当地人耕作、在山坡上劳作，过着传统的生活。

在安明镇享用午餐。

下午参观：

  • 探马坡——标志性的蜿蜒坡道

  • 王家官邸（苗王府）——昔日苗族王室的故居

抵达同文镇，入住民宿，享用晚餐，并在夜晚漫步探索小镇。

第2天：同文 – 青年志愿者纪念碑 – 马皮岭 – 峨河观景台 – 苗旺 – Lũng Hồ – Mậu Duệ – 都嘉村

餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

早餐后，前往河江环线最具标志性的路段。

体验：

  • 马皮岭——越南的“山口之王”，悬崖嶙峋，山壁雄奇

  • 天空之路下坡骑行——尽览壮丽山谷和碧绿峨河的全景

这被认为是整个河江最令人惊叹的风景。

继续骑行穿越偏远的少数民族村寨：

  • Lũng Hồ

  • Mậu Duệ

  • 苗旺镇（午餐停留）

下午，沿风景秀丽的山路前往都嘉村，这里居住着7个少数民族，和睦共处。村子以宁静的氛围、绿色的稻田和保存完好的传统文化而闻名。

入住岱族（Tay）民宿，晚餐配上“快乐水”（当地米酒）。

第3天：都嘉村 – 都嘉瀑布 – 阳上谷 – Thái An公路 – 北梅 – 河江市 → 河内

餐食：早餐、午餐

早餐后，步行前往都嘉瀑布，这是隐藏在茂密森林中的秘境。

继续骑行穿越：

  • 阳上谷——雄奇壮丽的山地景观

  • Thái An公路——以崎岖地形和优美风景而闻名

  • 北梅地区

下午抵达河江市。

16:00

乘豪华商务巴士返回河内。

每人团费（美元）

216美元——SIC拼团游

264美元——私人定制游

费用包含

  • 河内 ↔ 河江往返交通

    • 豪华独立包厢卧铺大巴（晚上7:30–8:00接客）

    • 豪华商务巴士（下午3:00–3:30接客）

  • 河江市免费民宿（传统民居）

  • 民宿住宿，独立房间

  • 餐食：早餐 – 午餐 – 晚餐

  • 专业英语导游

  • 经验丰富的Easy Rider车手

  • 摩托车、燃油

  • 门票

  • 防护装备：头盔、护具、雨衣

  • 饮用水（每天1瓶）

费用不含

  • 边境通行证（如需要）

  • 导游和车手小费

  • 个人饮品（咖啡、啤酒等）

tours.title: HA GIANG EASY RIDER – 2 DAYS
tours.summary: This Ha Giang Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers seeking an authentic and adventurous journey through one of the most spectacular landscapes in Vietnam. Travel on the back of experienced Easy Riders, explore breath
tours.contentHtml:
This Ha Giang Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers seeking an authentic and adventurous journey through one of the most spectacular landscapes in Vietnam. Travel on the back of experienced Easy Riders, explore breathtaking passes, ethnic villages, limestone karsts, and the legendary Mã Pí Lèng Pass overlooking the emerald Nho Que River.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang (By Sleeper Bus / Limousine Bus)

You will be picked up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter and transferred to Ha Giang by luxury sleeper bus or limousine (depending on your booking). Overnight in a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Slope – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van Town

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30

The tour begins at our homestay in Ha Giang City. Your guide and Easy Riders will brief you on safety before starting the journey.

As you enter the mountainous area, the scenery changes dramatically. You will stop at:

  • Bac Sum Slope – a beautiful viewpoint

  • Quan Ba Heaven Gate – overlooking the iconic

  • Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

Travel through the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark, a UNESCO-recognized geological treasure filled with limestone formations, rice terraces, and remote ethnic villages.

Lunch at a local restaurant in Yen Minh Town.

Continue to:

  • Tham Ma Slope – famous for its winding curves

  • H’Mong King Palace (Vuong Family Residence) – the historical home of the H’Mong royal family

Arrive in Dong Van Town, check in at the homestay, and enjoy dinner with local dishes.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Ha Giang → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast, begin the most stunning part of the journey:

  • Visit the Volunteer Youth Monument

  • Conquer the legendary Ma Pi Leng Pass, known as the most beautiful pass in Vietnam

  • Enjoy panoramic views over the Nho Que River and deep valleys

This is the highlight of the Ha Giang Loop—breathtaking cliffs, dramatic mountains, and unforgettable viewpoints.

Ride toward Meo Vac, then return through scenic backroads to Yen Minh and continue to Ha Giang City.

Along the way, you will encounter various ethnic groups such as the H’Mong, Tay, and Dao—recognizable by their colorful traditional clothing and highland lifestyle.

17:00

Tour ends in Ha Giang City.

20:30

Board the private-cabin sleeper bus back to Hanoi.

Tour Price (USD per person)

148 USD – SIC Group Tour

192 USD – Private Tour

Tour Includes

  • Round-trip transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang

    • Luxury sleeper bus (private cabin) OR limousine bus

  • Free homestay in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private room in homestay

  • Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Experienced Easy Riders

  • Motorbikes & fuel

  • Protective gear: helmet, raincoat

  • All entrance fees

  • Drinking water (1 bottle/day)

Tour Excludes

  • Border entry permit (if required)

  • Tips for guide and riders

  • Personal drinks (beer, coffee, etc.)
tours.titleZh: 河江摩托骑行游 – 2天
tours.summaryZh: 这趟河江Easy Rider之旅，非常适合渴望体验地道、冒险旅程的旅行者，带您穿越越南最壮丽的风光之一。坐在经验丰富的Easy Rider后座，探索令人惊叹的山口、少数民族村寨、石灰岩喀斯特地貌……
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟河江Easy Rider之旅，非常适合渴望体验地道、冒险旅程的旅行者，带您穿越越南最壮丽的风光之一。坐在经验丰富的Easy Rider后座，探索令人惊叹的山口、少数民族村寨、石灰岩喀斯特地貌，以及传奇的马皮岭（Mã Pí Lèng）山口，俯瞰碧绿的乐河（Nho Quế）。

行程概览

河内 → 河江（乘卧铺巴士/商务巴士）

我们将在河内老城区的酒店接您，乘豪华卧铺巴士或商务巴士（视您的预订而定）前往河江。夜宿河江市的传统民宿。

行程安排

第1天：河江市 – 北森坡（Bắc Sum） – 官坝天门（Quản Bạ） – 双峰山（Twin Mountains） – 安明（Yên Minh） – 谭马坡（Thẩm Mã） – 苗王府 – 同文县城（Đồng Văn）

用餐：午餐、晚餐

08:30

行程从我们位于河江市的民宿开始。出发前，导游和Easy Rider会为您讲解安全须知。

进入山区后，沿途风景变化万千。您将在以下地点停留：

  • 北森坡 – 绝美观景点

  • 官坝天门 – 俯瞰标志性的

  • 双峰山（仙女胸山）

穿越同文喀斯特高原地质公园，这是联合国教科文组织认定的地质瑰宝，遍布石灰岩地貌、梯田和偏远的少数民族村寨。

在安明镇的当地餐厅享用午餐。

继续前往：

  • 谭马坡 – 以蜿蜒曲折的弯道而闻名

  • 苗王府（王氏家族宅邸） – 苗族王室家族的历史故居

抵达同文县城，入住民宿，享用当地特色晚餐。

第2天：同文 – 志愿青年纪念碑 – 马皮岭山口 – 乐河观景台 – 苗旺（Mèo Vạc） – 河江 → 河内

用餐：早餐、午餐

早餐后，开启旅程中最震撼的一段：

  • 参观志愿青年纪念碑

  • 征服传奇的马皮岭山口，它被誉为越南最美的山口

  • 纵览乐河和深谷的全景

这是河江环线的精华所在——惊心动魄的悬崖、雄奇壮观的山峦和令人难忘的观景点。

骑行前往苗旺，然后沿风景优美的乡间小路返回安明，继续前往河江市。

沿途您将遇到苗族、岱族和瑶族等多个少数民族，他们以色彩斑斓的传统服饰和高原生活方式而令人印象深刻。

17:00

行程在河江市结束。

20:30

乘坐独立包厢卧铺巴士返回河内。

团费（美元/人）

148美元 – SIC拼团游

192美元 – 私人团

团费包含

  • 河内 ↔ 河江往返交通

    • 豪华卧铺巴士（独立包厢）或商务巴士

  • 河江市免费民宿（传统民居）

  • 住宿：民宿独立房间

  • 餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

  • 专业英语导游

  • 经验丰富的Easy Rider

  • 摩托车及油费

  • 防护装备：头盔、雨衣

  • 所有门票

  • 饮用水（每天1瓶）

团费不包含

  • 边境通行证（如需要）

  • 导游和骑手小费

  • 个人饮品（啤酒、咖啡等）

tours.title: SAIGON MIDNIGHT SIGHTSEEING ADVENTURE
tours.summary: Saigon Midnight Sightseeing Adventure, operated by Vietlook Travel, is a late night city experience designed for international travelers who want to explore Ho Chi Minh City in a calm, atmospheric, and lively setting aft
tours.contentHtml:
Saigon Midnight Sightseeing Adventure, operated by Vietlook Travel, is a late night city experience designed for international travelers who want to explore Ho Chi Minh City in a calm, atmospheric, and lively setting after dark. When the city cools down and traffic becomes lighter, Saigon reveals a different charm filled with lights, local nightlife, and peaceful streets.

This tour combines iconic landmarks, historical sites, local neighborhoods, night markets, and street food, allowing travelers to see how the city transitions from day to night. It is an ideal choice for visitors who enjoy sightseeing, cultural stories, and local flavors while experiencing the unique energy of Saigon at midnight.

TOUR SCHEDULE

10:00 PM – 02:00 AM

Price: 44 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Ba Son Bridge

Admire Ba Son Bridge, a modern landmark spanning the Saigon River. At night, the bridge offers beautiful views of the city skyline and reflects the rapid urban development of Ho Chi Minh City.

Banh Mi, the World’s Best Sandwich

Stop to enjoy one of the most famous Vietnamese street foods, banh mi. This crispy French style baguette is filled with a variety of meats, fresh vegetables, herbs, and sauces, creating a well balanced and flavorful local favorite.

Thich Quang Duc Monument

Visit the Thich Quang Duc Monument and learn about its historical and cultural significance. Your guide will explain the background of an important event in 1963 related to the Buddhist movement in Vietnam and why this monument remains meaningful today.

Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment and Sugarcane Juice

Explore Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment, one of the oldest apartment complexes in Saigon, built in 1968. Experience the authentic atmosphere of local residential life and enjoy a refreshing glass of freshly pressed sugarcane juice.

Biggest Flower Market in District Ten

Visit the largest flower market in District Ten during its lively night hours. Learn about local customs of buying and using flowers and have the opportunity to create a lotus flower arrangement by yourself. The lotus is the national flower of Vietnam.

Vietnamese Coffee, Smoothie, or Fresh Fruit Juice

Relax at a local shop and choose between Vietnamese coffee, a smoothie, or a freshly prepared fruit juice. This stop offers a chance to enjoy popular local beverages while taking a short break.

Little French Town in the City Center

Walk through an area often referred to as the Little French Town in District One. Discover elegant colonial era architecture, charming streets, and buildings that reflect the lasting French influence on Saigon’s urban design.

Party Street, the Never Sleep Area

End the tour at the famous Party Street, known for its vibrant nightlife. Observe the lively atmosphere filled with bars, restaurants, and music, and experience how Saigon stays active and energetic late into the night.
tours.titleZh: 西贡午夜观光探险
tours.summaryZh: 西贡午夜观光探险之旅由Vietlook Travel运营，是专为国际旅行者设计的深夜城市体验，让您在夜幕降临后以宁静、浓郁而又热闹的方式探索胡志明市。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
西贡午夜观光探险之旅由Vietlook Travel运营，是专为国际旅行者设计的深夜城市体验，让您在夜幕降临后以宁静、浓郁而又热闹的方式探索胡志明市。当城市渐渐降温、交通变得稀疏时，西贡展现出别样的魅力，处处是灯光、本地夜生活和宁静的街巷。

本行程融合标志性地标、历史遗迹、本地街区、夜市和街头美食，让旅行者看到这座城市如何从白天过渡到夜晚。对于喜爱观光、文化故事和地道风味，并想感受西贡午夜独特活力的游客来说，这是理想之选。

行程时间

10:00 PM – 02:00 AM

价格：每人 44 USD

行程亮点与安排

巴升大桥

欣赏横跨西贡河的现代地标巴升大桥。夜晚，大桥可饱览城市天际线的美景，也映照出胡志明市飞速的城市发展。

越南法棍，世界上最好的三明治

停下来品尝越南最著名的街头美食之一——越南法棍（banh mi）。这种酥脆的法式长棍面包夹有各种肉类、新鲜蔬菜、香草和酱料，风味均衡，是备受当地人喜爱的美味。

释广德纪念碑

参观释广德纪念碑，了解其历史与文化意义。导游将讲解1963年与越南佛教运动相关的一起重要事件的背景，以及这座纪念碑至今仍具意义的原因。

Nguyen Thien Thuat公寓与甘蔗汁

探访Nguyen Thien Thuat公寓，这是西贡最古老的公寓楼群之一，建于1968年。体验本地居民生活的真实氛围，并品尝一杯现榨的清爽甘蔗汁。

第十郡最大的花卉市场

在夜间热闹的时段参观第十郡最大的花卉市场。了解当地买花和用花的习俗，并有机会亲手制作莲花插花。莲花是越南的国花。

越南咖啡、冰沙或鲜榨果汁

在当地小店放松休息，可选择越南咖啡、冰沙或现制果汁。在短暂休息的同时，品尝当地人气饮品。

市中心的法国小镇

漫步于第一郡常被称为“法国小镇”的区域。欣赏优雅的殖民时期建筑、迷人的街道，以及体现法国对西贡城市设计长久影响的建筑。

派对街，不夜城

行程在著名的派对街结束，这里以活力四射的夜生活闻名。感受酒吧、餐厅和音乐交织的热闹氛围，体验西贡深夜依然活跃而充满能量的一面。

tours.title: AMBASSADOR DAY CRUISE – HALONG BAY
tours.summary: Experience the Ambassador Day Cruise, one of the most luxurious day cruises in Halong Bay. The vessel offers spacious twin sundecks with 360 degree views over the bay, elegant lounges, two fine dining restaurants, two ba
tours.contentHtml:
Experience the Ambassador Day Cruise, one of the most luxurious day cruises in Halong Bay. The vessel offers spacious twin sundecks with 360 degree views over the bay, elegant lounges, two fine dining restaurants, two bars, and an open air Jacuzzi. Sightseeing, premium cuisine, and entertainment come together for a memorable journey through this UNESCO World Heritage Site.

ITINERARY

08:00 – Check-in and Transfer to Ambassador Day Cruise

Guests check in at the Ambassador’s Lounge located on the first floor of Halong International Cruise Port. After check-in, guests are transferred to the Ambassador Day Cruise vessel.

09:00 – Light Breakfast Onboard

Enjoy a light breakfast while the cruise departs the port and sails into the majestic landscape of Halong Bay and Bai Tu Long Bay.

10:30 – Visit Sung Sot Cave

Explore Sung Sot Cave, the largest and most remarkable cave in Halong Bay, with its dramatic stalactites and rock formations.

11:30 – Visit Titov Island

Arrive at Titov Island. Guests may swim in the clear turquoise water or climb to the top of the island for panoramic views of the bay.

12:00 – Premium Lunch at the Restaurant

Savor a premium lunch at the cruise restaurant while the vessel continues cruising through scenic parts of Halong Bay.

13:30 – Visit Luon Cave

Enjoy optional kayaking or a bamboo boat ride around Luon Cave to admire the cave’s interior and surrounding emerald waters. (*Kayaking and rowing boat services have additional charges.)

14:20 – Afternoon Tea

Relax with afternoon tea in the restaurant areas on the third and fourth floors while soaking in the views.

15:00 – Live Music Entertainment

Enjoy live music on the sundeck as part of afternoon entertainment (weather permitting).

16:00 – Disembarkation

Return to Halong International Cruise Port and disembark. The day cruise concludes.

WHAT IS INCLUDED

  • Full day cruise itinerary and program as described above.

  • One light breakfast onboard.

  • One premium lunch at the cruise restaurant.

  • Afternoon tea.

  • Onboard insurance, tax, and service charges.

  • Entrance and sightseeing fees for all scheduled visits.

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED

  • Airfare and airport transfers.

  • Visa arrangements and onboard cabins.

  • Transportation to and from Halong Bay.

  • Beverages (except those included in the meal set, if stated by operator).

  • Kayaking and bamboo boat rowing at Luon Cave (*charges apply separately).

  • Massage, spa treatments, and personal expenses.

  • Tips and gratuities.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • The itinerary may be subject to change depending on weather and cruising conditions.

  • Internet access onboard may be limited due to geographical conditions of the bay.

HIGHLIGHTS OF AMBASSADOR DAY CRUISE

  • Stunning views of limestone karsts and emerald waters.

  • Elegant dining with premium cuisine.

  • Spacious sundecks and panoramic vistas.

  • Multiple entertainment options including live music.

  • Outdoor Jacuzzi pool and luxury facilities onboard
tours.titleZh: 大使号一日游轮 – 下龙湾
tours.summaryZh: 体验大使一日游轮，下龙湾最豪华的一日游轮之一。游轮拥有宽敞的双层日光甲板，可360度欣赏海湾美景，还设有优雅的休息厅、两间高级餐厅、两个酒吧和一个露天按摩浴池。观光、顶级美食与娱乐汇聚一处，带来穿越这处联合国教科文组织世界遗产地的难忘旅程。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
体验大使一日游轮， 下龙湾最豪华的一日游轮之一。游轮拥有宽敞的双层日光甲板，可360度欣赏海湾美景，还设有优雅的休息厅、两间高级餐厅、两个酒吧和一个露天按摩浴池。观光、顶级美食与娱乐汇聚一处，带来穿越这处联合国教科文组织世界遗产地的难忘旅程。

行程安排

08:00 – 办理登记并接驳前往大使一日游轮

游客在位于下龙国际游轮码头一楼的大使贵宾厅办理登记。登记完成后，游客将被接驳至大使一日游轮。

09:00 – 船上轻食早餐

游轮驶离码头，驶入下龙湾和白龙尾湾壮美的风光之中，您可以享用轻食早餐。

10:30 – 参观惊讶洞(Sửng Sốt)

探索惊讶洞，这是下龙湾最大、最引人注目的溶洞，拥有壮观的钟乳石和岩石景观。

11:30 – 参观天宫岛(Titov)

抵达天宫岛。游客可在清澈碧绿的海水中游泳，或登上岛顶俯瞰海湾全景。

12:00 – 餐厅享用高级午餐

在游轮餐厅享用高级午餐，游轮继续穿行于下龙湾的风景区。

13:30 – 参观Luồn洞

自选皮划艇或竹筏船游览Luồn洞，欣赏洞内景观及周围碧绿的水域。（*皮划艇和划船服务需另外收费。）

14:20 – 下午茶

在三楼和四楼的餐厅区域享用下午茶，同时欣赏美景。

15:00 – 现场音乐娱乐

在日光甲板上欣赏现场音乐，作为下午娱乐活动的一部分（视天气而定）。

16:00 – 下船

返回下龙国际游轮码头并下船。一日游轮行程结束。

费用包含

  • 上述完整的一日游轮行程及活动。

  • 船上轻食早餐一份。

  • 游轮餐厅高级午餐一份。

  • 下午茶。

  • 船上保险、税费及服务费。

  • 所有安排景点的门票及观光费用。

费用不含

  • 机票及机场接送。

  • 签证办理及船上客房。

  • 往返下龙湾的交通。

  • 饮品（餐套内含的饮品除外，如运营方注明）。

  • Luồn洞的皮划艇和竹筏划船（*费用另计）。

  • 按摩、水疗项目及个人消费。

  • 小费及赏金。

重要提示

  • 行程可能因天气和航行状况而有所调整。

  • 由于海湾的地理条件，船上网络可能受限。

大使一日游轮亮点

  • 欣赏石灰岩峰林与碧绿海水的迷人景色。

  • 高级美食，优雅用餐。

  • 宽敞的日光甲板，全景视野。

  • 包括现场音乐在内的多种娱乐选择。

  • 船上设有户外按摩浴池和豪华设施

tours.title: LUNA HALONG CRUISE
tours.summary: – 09:00 Check-in and Transfer to Luna Halong Cruise Guests check in at Halong International Cruise Port, Bai Chay Ward, Halong City. After check-in, guests are transferred to Luna Halong Cruise and welcomed on board. 09:
tours.contentHtml:
08:30 – 09:00

Check-in and Transfer to Luna Halong Cruise

Guests check in at Halong International Cruise Port, Bai Chay Ward, Halong City.

After check-in, guests are transferred to Luna Halong Cruise and welcomed on board.

09:15 – 09:30

Cruise Departure

Luna Halong Cruise departs the port.

The journey to discover the breathtaking beauty of Ha Long Bay officially begins.

10:45 – 11:30

Surprising Cave Exploration

Visit Surprising Cave (Sung Sot Cave), a magnificent limestone cave filled with impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

This cave is ranked among the top ten most beautiful caves in the world by the Czech Association of Travel Agents and Brokers.

Titop Island Visit

Arrive at Titop Island.
Guests may swim in the crystal-clear turquoise water or climb to the top of the island to enjoy a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay.

International Buffet Lunch

Enjoy a premium buffet lunch at Luna Halong Cruise’s luxurious restaurant.

Luon Cave Discovery

Optional visit to Luon Cave, one of the most unique caves in Ha Long Bay.
Guests can choose to explore the cave by bamboo boat rowed by local people or by kayaking through the calm waters.

Teabreak Party and Live Music

Relax on the sundeck while enjoying a sunset teabreak party accompanied by live music on the fourth floor of the cruise.

Tour End

Welcome drink upon boarding.

Seven-hour Ha Long Bay day cruise itinerary.

English-speaking and Vietnamese-speaking tour guide.

Premium international buffet lunch with nearly one hundred Asian and European dishes.

Ha Long Bay entrance ticket.

Taxes, travel insurance, and service charge.

Round-trip transportation between Hanoi and Ha Long.

Cabin on board.

Kayaking or bamboo boat service at Luon Cave.

Spa and massage services, mineral bath.

Beverages.

Tips, personal expenses, and all other services not clearly mentioned above.

tours.contentHtmlZh:
08:30 – 09:00

办理登记并转乘前往Luna下龙湾游轮

客人在下龙市白寨坊（Bãi Cháy）的下龙国际游轮码头办理登记手续。

登记完成后，客人将被接驳至Luna下龙湾游轮，并在船上受到欢迎。

09:15 – 09:30

游轮启航

Luna下龙湾游轮驶离码头。

探索下龙湾惊艳之美的旅程就此正式开始。

10:45 – 11:30

惊讶洞探秘

参观惊讶洞（Sửng Sốt洞），这是一座雄伟壮观的石灰岩溶洞，洞内布满令人叹为观止的钟乳石和石笋。

该洞被捷克旅行社与经纪人协会评为世界十大最美洞穴之一。

11:45 – 12:30

游览梯子岛（Titop）

抵达梯子岛（Titop）。
客人可以在清澈的碧绿海水中畅游，或登上岛顶，欣赏下龙湾的全景。

12:30 – 13:30

国际自助午餐

在Luna下龙湾游轮豪华的餐厅享用高品质自助午餐。
菜单由专业厨师精心烹制，涵盖近百道亚洲和欧洲美食。

13:45 – 14:45

天堂洞（Luồn洞）探秘

可自选参观Luồn洞，这是下龙湾最独特的洞穴之一。
客人可选择乘坐当地人划的竹筏游览山洞，或划皮划艇穿越平静的水面。

15:00 – 16:00

下午茶会与现场音乐

在游轮四楼的日光甲板上放松身心，在现场音乐的陪伴下享受日落下午茶会。

16:30

行程结束

游轮返回码头。

客人下船，行程正式结束。

费用包含

登船欢迎饮品。

7小时下龙湾一日游轮行程。

英语和越南语导游。

高品质国际自助午餐，涵盖近百道亚洲和欧洲美食。

下龙湾门票。

税费、旅游保险及服务费。

费用不包含

河内与下龙之间的往返交通。

船上客房。

Luồn洞的皮划艇或竹筏服务。

水疗和按摩服务、矿物浴。

饮品。

小费、个人开销以及上述未明确提及的所有其他服务。

tours.title: PHU QUOC CITY TOUR
tours.summary: Visit a pearl farm to learn about the culture and process of pearl cultivation on Phu Quoc Island. Continue to the Sim Wine Factory to discover how local sim wine and products are produced, with opportunities to sample a
tours.contentHtml:
Visit a pearl farm to learn about the culture and process of pearl cultivation on Phu Quoc Island. Continue to the Sim Wine Factory to discover how local sim wine and products are produced, with opportunities to sample and taste them.

Stop at a local pepper farm to learn about different types of peppercorns and traditional farming methods. Visit a fish sauce factory to understand how this essential ingredient in Vietnamese cuisine is made.

Travel uphill to Ho Quoc Pagoda, a peaceful Buddhist temple overlooking the sea. Enjoy lunch at Sao Beach, followed by free time to relax, swim, and sunbathe on one of Phu Quoc’s most beautiful beaches.

Visit Coconut Tree Prison, a historical relic from the French Colonial period and the Vietnam War. End the tour with a walking visit to Sunset Town, featuring Mediterranean-style architecture, the Clock Tower, and the Kiss Bridge, offering stunning panoramic sea views.

ITINERARY

08:45 – 09:00

Pick-up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are kindly requested to contact us in advance.

Pearl Farm

Learn about the history and techniques of pearl farming on Phu Quoc Island.

Sim Wine Factory

Discover the production of local sim wine and sim-based products.

Local Pepper Farm

Visit a family-run pepper garden and learn about pepper harvesting.

Fish Sauce Factory

Learn about the traditional process of producing Phu Quoc fish sauce.

Ho Quoc Pagoda

Visit a scenic Buddhist temple located on the hillside overlooking the sea.

Sao Beach

Enjoy lunch and free time for relaxing, swimming, and sunbathing.

Coconut Tree Prison

Visit the historical war museum and prison site.

15:30

Check-in at Sunset Town.

Walking tour to explore the Kiss Bridge, Clock Tower, and surrounding areas.

On the way back, guests may choose to stop at Sunset Sanato or the Night Market in Duong Dong Town.

Entrance tickets and return transportation are at guests’ own expense.

16:30

Return to your hotel.

TOUR PRICE

Without Lunch

  • Adults (from 10 years old): 10 USD per person

  • Children (from 5 to 9 years old): 6 USD per child

  • Children under 5 years old: Free of charge

With Lunch

  • Adults (from 10 years old): 20 USD per person

  • Children (from 5 to 9 years old): 10 USD per child

  • Children under 5 years old: Free of charge

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Round-trip transportation by air-conditioned car

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • One bottle of drinking water per guest

  • Set menu lunch (if booked in advance)

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least twenty-four hours before departure.

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

  • Entrance ticket to Kiss Bridge

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Guests who wish to stop at Sunset Sanato or the Night Market in Duong Dong Ward on the way back should inform the tour guide in advance. Entrance tickets and return transportation are at guests’ own expense.

  • Guests are advised to bring towels, spare clothes, swimwear, comfortable shoes or flip-flops, and some cash.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

  • Children aged ten years and above are charged the adult price.

  • Children aged from five to nine years are charged fifty percent of the adult price.

  • Children under five years old are free of charge.

Age is determined by year of birth.

PAYMENT POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date or on the tour day.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date.

CANCELLATION POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • Cancellation two days before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: fifty percent of the tour value will be charged.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

Weather-related cancellations for beach tours:

  • If the Port Authority does not allow the tour to operate, Vietlook Travel will cancel the tour and provide a full refund.

  • If the Port Authority allows the tour to proceed and guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

TIPS FOR GUESTS

What to Bring

  • Towels

  • Environmentally friendly sunscreen

  • Change of clothes and swimwear

  • Comfortable shoes or flip-flops

  • Personal necessities

  • Essential items for children, if traveling with kids

Vietlook Travel and its staff are not responsible for any lost, misplaced, or stolen items.

HEALTH AND SAFETY NOTICE

  • This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility or wheelchair users.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible or liable for any health-related issues that may occur during or after the tour.
tours.titleZh: 富国岛市区游
tours.summaryZh: 参观珍珠养殖场，了解富国岛珍珠养殖的文化与工艺。接着前往桃金娘酒（Sim）酒厂，探秘当地桃金娘酒及相关产品的制作过程，并有机会品尝试饮。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
参观珍珠养殖场，了解富国岛珍珠养殖的文化与工艺。接着前往桃金娘酒（Sim）酒厂，探秘当地桃金娘酒及相关产品的制作过程，并有机会品尝试饮。

在当地胡椒园停留，了解不同种类的胡椒和传统种植方法。参观鱼露工厂，了解这种越南美食中不可或缺的调味品是如何制作的。

登上山坡前往护国寺，这是一座俯瞰大海的宁静佛寺。在星滩（Bãi Sao）享用午餐，之后自由活动，在富国岛最美的海滩之一放松、游泳和日光浴。

参观椰树监狱，这是法国殖民时期和越南战争期间的历史遗迹。行程最后步行游览日落小镇（Sunset Town），这里有地中海风格的建筑、钟楼和接吻桥，可欣赏壮丽的海景全景。

行程安排

08:45 – 09:00

在阳东（Dương Đông）街区的酒店接客。

入住阳东街区以外的游客，敬请提前与我们联系。

珍珠养殖场

了解富国岛珍珠养殖的历史和技术。

桃金娘酒（Sim）酒厂

探秘当地桃金娘酒及桃金娘系列产品的生产。

当地胡椒园

参观家庭经营的胡椒园，了解胡椒的采收。

鱼露工厂

了解富国岛鱼露的传统制作工艺。

护国寺

参观位于山坡上、俯瞰大海的风景秀丽的佛寺。

星滩（Bãi Sao）

享用午餐，并自由活动，放松、游泳和日光浴。

椰树监狱

参观历史战争博物馆和监狱遗址。

15:30

在日落小镇打卡。

步行游览接吻桥、钟楼及周边区域。

返程途中，游客可选择在日落沙滩酒吧（Sunset Sanato）或阳东镇夜市停留。

门票及返程交通费用由游客自理。

16:30

返回酒店。

团费

不含午餐

  • 成人（10岁及以上）：10美元/人

  • 儿童（5至9岁）：6美元/人

  • 5岁以下儿童：免费

含午餐

  • 成人（10岁及以上）：20美元/人

  • 儿童（5至9岁）：10美元/人

  • 5岁以下儿童：免费

团费包含

  • 空调汽车往返交通

  • 英语导游

  • 每位游客一瓶饮用水

  • 套餐午餐（需提前预订）

纯素、素食或儿童餐等特殊餐食要求，须在预订时或至少在出发前二十四小时告知。

团费不含

  • “团费包含”中未提及的个人消费

  • 接吻桥门票

重要提示

  • 希望在返程途中在日落沙滩酒吧（Sunset Sanato）或阳东街区夜市停留的游客，应提前告知导游。门票及返程交通费用由游客自理。

  • 建议游客携带毛巾、换洗衣物、泳衣、舒适的鞋子或人字拖，以及少量现金。

儿童价格政策

  • 十岁及以上儿童按成人价格收费。

  • 五至九岁儿童按成人价格的百分之五十收费。

取消政策

tours.title: FISHING TRIP SUNRISE “BIG FISH” FISHING
tours.summary: This private fishing tour is suitable for guests who enjoy sport fishing or would like to experience big fish fishing in Phu Quoc. Guests can choose between a morning sunrise fishing trip or an afternoon fishing trip wit
tours.contentHtml:
This private fishing tour is suitable for guests who enjoy sport fishing or would like to experience big fish fishing in Phu Quoc. Guests can choose between a morning sunrise fishing trip or an afternoon fishing trip with sunset views.

Swimming is available during the tour. Any fish caught will be freshly prepared and cooked on board by the crew.

ITINERARY

Morning Fishing Trip (05:00 – 13:30)

05:15 – 05:30

Pick up at the hotel in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are requested to contact Vietlook Travel in advance.

Transfer to An Thoi Harbor and board the private fishing boat.

Enjoy sunrise at sea. Breakfast and Vietnamese coffee are served on board.

Fishing activities begin. Guests drop their fishing lines and wait for their catches.

Live fresh-cut squid or normal squid bait is used to catch large fish.

Swimming is available when sea conditions allow.

Lunch is served on board. Fish caught during the trip will be prepared and cooked by the crew.

13:30
Return to An Thoi Harbor and transfer back to the hotel.

Afternoon Fishing Trip (13:30 – 18:30)

13:15 – 13:30

Pick up at the hotel in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are requested to contact Vietlook Travel in advance.

Transfer to An Thoi Harbor and board the private fishing boat.

Late lunch is served on board before fishing activities begin.

Fishing activities take place in the late afternoon, one of the best times for fishing.

Swimming is available when sea conditions allow.

A light snack is served while enjoying the sunset at sea.

18:30
Return to An Thoi Harbor and transfer back to the hotel.

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Private air-conditioned car and private boat.

  • English-speaking tour guide.

  • Mineral water.

  • Meals on board according to the selected tour option.

  • Fishing equipment.

  • Snorkeling equipment including mask, snorkel, and fins.

  • Life jackets.

  • Ten live squid bait per guest.

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses.

  • Additional live squid bait beyond the included amount.

BREAKFAST

  • Bread.

  • Omelette.

  • Coffee.

  • Lipton tea.

  • Fresh milk.

  • Fresh fruit.

LUNCH

  • Shrimp and pork cooked in a clay pot.

  • Fried chicken.

  • Fried eggs.

  • Stir-fried morning glory with garlic.

  • Salad.

  • Vegetable soup with minced pork.

  • Steamed rice.

  • Fresh fruit.

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least twenty-four hours before departure.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

Children under five years old:
Free of charge.

Children from five to nine years old:
Charged at fifty percent of the adult price.

Children aged ten years and above:
Charged at the adult price.

PAYMENT POLICY

Groups of one to five guests

Full payment must be completed no later than one day before the tour date.
Otherwise, the booking will be automatically cancelled.

Groups of six guests or more

Full payment must be completed no later than two days before the tour date.
Otherwise, the booking will be automatically cancelled.

CANCELLATION POLICY

Groups of one to five guests

Cancellation one day before the tour date:
No cancellation fee will be charged.

Cancellation on the tour date:
One hundred percent of the total tour value will be charged as a cancellation fee.

Groups of six guests or more

Cancellation two days before the tour date:
No cancellation fee will be charged.

Cancellation one day before the tour date:
Fifty percent of the total tour value will be charged as a cancellation fee.

Cancellation on the tour date:
One hundred percent of the total tour value will be charged as a cancellation fee.

HEALTH AND SAFETY

Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible for any health-related issues during or after the tour.
tours.titleZh: 日出海钓“大鱼”之旅
tours.summaryZh: 这趟私人钓鱼之旅适合喜爱运动钓鱼或想在富国岛体验大鱼垂钓的宾客。宾客可以选择清晨日出钓鱼之旅，或欣赏日落美景的下午钓鱼之旅。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟私人钓鱼之旅适合喜爱运动钓鱼或想在富国岛体验大鱼垂钓的宾客。宾客可以选择清晨日出钓鱼之旅，或欣赏日落美景的下午钓鱼之旅。

行程中可以游泳。所钓到的鱼将由船员在船上现场新鲜烹制。

行程安排

清晨钓鱼之旅（05:00 – 13:30）

05:15 – 05:30

在Dương Đông坊的酒店接客。

前往安泰港（An Thới），登上私人钓鱼船。

垂钓活动开始。宾客放下鱼线，等待鱼儿上钩。

使用现切鲜活鱿鱼或普通鱿鱼作饵来钓大鱼。

13:30

在Dương Đông坊的酒店接客。

垂钓活动开始前，船上供应迟午餐。

垂钓活动在傍晚进行，这是钓鱼的最佳时段之一。

如有特殊餐食需求，如纯素、素食或儿童餐，须在预订时告知，或至少在出发前二十四小时告知。

免费。
