  • Mud bath and relaxation at Hon Tam Island.
  • In the evening, enjoy music and drinks at Sailing Club or Louisiane Brewhouse.

DAY 3 COUNTRYSIDE AND LOCAL CULTURE

  • Meals included Breakfast Lunch and Dinner
  • Visit a traditional ancient house.
  • Join a cooking class with a local family.
  • Experience traditional handicrafts such as mat weaving and conical hat making.
  • In the evening, visit Nha Trang Night Market for local food and souvenir shopping.

DAY 4 BA HO WATERFALLS AND AIRPORT TRANSFER

  • Meals included Breakfast and Lunch
  • Visit Ba Ho Waterfalls.
  • Walk through lush natural surroundings, swim in natural pools and enjoy fresh mountain air.
  • Return to the hotel and transfer to the airport.
  • End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

35 US dollars per person.

TOUR INCLUSIONS

Transportation by air conditioned car.

Three nights accommodation at four star hotel, two persons per room.

Sunset cruise.

Canoe for island tours.

Three lunches and three dinners.

English speaking tour guide.

Bottled water during the tour.

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

Value added tax.

Personal expenses.

Services not mentioned in the itinerary.

CHILD POLICY

Children under one meter free of charge.

Children from one meter to one meter twenty nine charged seventy percent of adult price.

Children from one meter twenty nine and above charged adult price.
tours.titleZh: 芽庄四天三晚游
tours.summaryZh: Vietlook Travel 是一家专业旅游公司，为来越南的国际游客提供高品质的芽庄旅游及其他旅行套餐。我们擅长设计清晰、有条理的芽庄行程，并由经验丰富的英语导游带队。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
Vietlook Travel 是一家专业旅游公司，为来越南的国际游客提供高品质的芽庄旅游及其他旅行套餐。

我们擅长设计清晰、有条理的芽庄行程，并由经验丰富的英语导游带队。

我们的目标是让每一位参加芽庄之旅的游客都能获得地道的本地体验、文化探索和舒适的旅程。

行程安排

第1天 市区游览与日落游船

含餐 午餐和晚餐

  • 08:00 在酒店或金兰(Cam Ranh)机场接客。
  • 参观芽庄市区主要景点：
  • 芽庄大教堂
  • 龙山寺
  • 婆那加占婆塔
  • 钟屿(Hòn Chồng)岬角
  • 海洋研究所
  • 傍晚，乘坐游船欣赏芽庄湾日落。

第2天 跳岛游体验

  • 含餐 早餐、午餐和晚餐
  • 游览墨岛(Hòn Mun)。
  • 水肺潜水体验。
  • 在泥岛(Hòn Tằm)享受泥浴放松。
  • 晚上，在 Sailing Club 或 Louisiane Brewhouse 欣赏音乐、品尝饮品。

第3天 乡村与当地文化

  • 含餐 早餐、午餐和晚餐
  • 参观传统古屋。
  • 与当地家庭一起参加烹饪课程。
  • 体验编织草席、制作斗笠等传统手工艺。
  • 晚上，游览芽庄夜市，品尝当地美食并购买纪念品。

第4天 巴湖瀑布与机场接送

  • 含餐 早餐和午餐
  • 游览巴湖(Ba Hồ)瀑布。
  • 漫步郁郁葱葱的自然环境，在天然水潭中游泳，呼吸清新的山间空气。
  • 返回酒店并前往机场。
  • 行程结束。

团费

每人35美元。

行程包含

空调汽车交通。

三晚四星级酒店住宿，每间两人。

日落游船。

跳岛游独木舟。

三顿午餐和三顿晚餐。

英语导游。

行程中的瓶装水。

行程不含

增值税。

个人消费。

行程中未提及的服务。

儿童政策

身高一米以下儿童免费。

身高一米至一米二十九的儿童收取成人票价的百分之七十。

身高一米二十九及以上的儿童按成人票价收费。

tours.title: NHA TRANG – DA LAT – MUI NE – MEKONG DELTA – HO CHI MINH
tours.summary: This 7 day private journey offers a well balanced exploration of Southern and Central Vietnam, combining coastal relaxation, highland scenery, desert landscapes, and river life in the Mekong Delta. Travelers will experie
tours.contentHtml:
This 7 day private journey offers a well balanced exploration of Southern and Central Vietnam, combining coastal relaxation, highland scenery, desert landscapes, and river life in the Mekong Delta. Travelers will experience the vibrant seaside city of Nha Trang, the cool climate and flower filled hills of Da Lat, the golden sand dunes of Mui Ne, and the cultural richness of the Mekong Delta before concluding in Ho Chi Minh City.

Price: USD 520 / pax (based on 2 persons)

DAY 1: ARRIVAL IN NHA TRANG – CITY TOUR

Meals: Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Nha Trang

Upon arrival at Cam Ranh International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by Vietlook Travel’s English-speaking guide and transferred by private car to Nha Trang city.

Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, offering an introduction to the fresh and flavorful coastal cuisine of Nha Trang.

In the afternoon, begin a gentle city exploration:

  • Local Coffee Experience: Relax at a local café and enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee, a key part of daily life in Vietnam.

  • Nha Trang Cathedral (Stone Church): A French Gothic-style church located on a small hill, reflecting the city’s colonial heritage.

  • Po Nagar Cham Towers: An ancient Cham temple complex built before 781 A.D., representing the spiritual and architectural legacy of the Cham civilization.

  • Dam Market: The largest local market in Nha Trang, ideal for purchasing local specialties and souvenirs.

At 18:30, enjoy dinner at a local restaurant.

Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Nha Trang.

DAY 2: NHA TRANG – DA LAT

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, depart at 08:30 for Da Lat, traveling through scenic mountain roads and highland landscapes.

En route and upon arrival, visit:

  • Cau Dat Tea Plantation: A vast tea farm surrounded by rolling hills, famous for its fresh air and green scenery.

  • Linh Phuoc Pagoda: One of Da Lat’s most impressive Buddhist temples, entirely decorated with intricate mosaic artwork.

  • Da Lat Railway Station: Built in 1932 by French architects Moncet and Reveron, this is the oldest railway station in Vietnam.

  • Stairway to Heaven (Nấc Thang Lên Thiên Đường): A popular viewpoint and photo spot overlooking Da Lat’s countryside.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Visit Xuan Huong Lake, Da Lat Square, enjoy coffee at Doha Coffee, and free time at Big C Supermarket.

  • Check in at your hotel in Da Lat.

Dinner at 18:00.

Optional visit to Da Lat Night Market.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 3: DA LAT FULL DAY SIGHTSEEING

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

Breakfast at the hotel.

At 08:30, begin a full day of sightseeing:

  • Datanla Waterfall: A lively natural attraction with multiple small waterfalls, surrounded by pine forest (optional adventure activities available).

  • Tuyen Lam Lake: A peaceful lake set among pine-covered hills, offering beautiful scenery and fresh air.

  • Happy Hills: A scenic lakeside area ideal for photography and relaxation.

  • Hydrangea Flower Farm: Expansive hillside flower fields showcasing Da Lat’s most iconic blooms.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Van Thanh Flower Village: One of Da Lat’s largest flower-growing villages, famous for roses and vegetables.

  • Hoa Son Dien Trang: A popular eco-tourism site known for its forest setting and unique photo spots.

  • Mê Linh Coffee Farm: Enjoy coffee while overlooking coffee plantations and countryside views.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 4: DA LAT – MUI NE | SUNSET TOUR

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Mui Ne

Breakfast at the hotel.

Check out at 08:30 and transfer to Mui Ne by private car.

Arrive around 12:00, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, then check in and relax.

At 15:00, join the Mui Ne sunset tour:

  • Fairy Stream: A shallow stream surrounded by colorful sand formations in shades of red, white, orange, and pink.

  • Mui Ne Fishing Village: Observe daily coastal life, fishing boats, and local fishermen at work.

  • Red Sand Dunes: Gentle slopes offering beautiful sunset views and excellent photo opportunities.

At 18:00, enjoy a BBQ seafood dinner at a local restaurant.

Return to hotel.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 5: MUI NE – MEKONG DELTA – HO CHI MINH CITY

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Ho Chi Minh City

After breakfast, depart at 07:30 for the Mekong Delta.

Arrive in My Tho and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Board a motorboat to Phoenix Island (Con Phung).

  • Take a horse cart ride to a cultural performance area to enjoy Đờn Ca Tài Tử, a traditional Southern Vietnamese folk music recognized by UNESCO, along with seasonal tropical fruits.

  • Cruise on a traditional hand-rowing boat through narrow canals shaded by coconut trees.

  • Visit a bee-keeping farm to taste honey tea.

  • Stop at a coconut candy workshop to learn about local handicrafts.

At 17:00, return to Ho Chi Minh City by private car.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 6: HO CHI MINH CITY – FREE TIME / OPTIONAL EXPLORATION

Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Free day at leisure for shopping, walking around the city, or optional tours.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 7: HO CHI MINH CITY – DEPARTURE

Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Private transfer to the airport for your departure.

TOUR PRICE: USD 520 / PERSON (2 PAX)

Included:

  • Private air-conditioned transportation

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Meals: 5 lunches & 4 dinners

  • Entrance fees as mentioned

  • 5 nights in 3-star hotels

  • Mekong Delta boat trips

  • Airport transfers

Not Included:

  • Jeep ride at sand dunes

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses
tours.titleZh: 芽庄—大叻—美奈—湄公河三角洲—胡志明市
tours.summaryZh: 这趟7天私人定制之旅均衡探索越南南部和中部，融合海滨休闲、高原风光、沙漠景观以及湄公河三角洲的水乡生活。旅行者将体验活力四射的海滨城市芽庄
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟7天私人定制之旅均衡探索越南南部和中部，融合海滨休闲、高原风光、沙漠景观以及湄公河三角洲的水乡生活。旅行者将体验活力四射的海滨城市芽庄、气候凉爽且遍布鲜花的大叻山城、美奈金色的沙丘，以及湄公河三角洲丰富的文化，最后抵达胡志明市结束行程。

价格：USD 520 / 人（按2人计算）

第1天：抵达芽庄 – 市区游

含餐：午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：芽庄

抵达金兰国际机场后，Vietlook Travel的英语导游将热情迎接您，并乘坐私人汽车送您前往芽庄市。

在当地餐厅享用午餐，初步品味芽庄新鲜美味的海滨美食。

下午，开始轻松的市区探索：

  • 当地咖啡体验：在当地咖啡馆放松，品尝地道的越南咖啡，这是越南日常生活的重要组成部分。

  • 芽庄大教堂（石头教堂）：坐落于小山丘上的法式哥特风格教堂，体现了这座城市的殖民遗产。

  • 婆那加占婆塔：建于公元781年之前的古老占族寺庙建筑群，代表着占族文明的精神与建筑遗产。

  • 谭市场：芽庄最大的本地市场，非常适合购买当地特产和纪念品。

18:30，在当地餐厅享用晚餐。

晚上自由活动。

住宿：芽庄。

第2天：芽庄 – 大叻

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：大叻

早餐后，08:30出发前往大叻，途经风景秀丽的山路和高原风光。

途中及抵达后，参观：

  • Cầu Đất茶园：被连绵起伏的山丘环绕的广阔茶园，以清新空气和绿色风光闻名。

  • 灵福寺：大叻最令人印象深刻的佛教寺庙之一，全寺以精美的马赛克艺术装饰。

  • 大叻火车站：由法国建筑师Moncet和Reveron于1932年设计建造，是越南最古老的火车站。

  • 天堂之梯（Nấc Thang Lên Thiên Đường）：人气观景和拍照点，可俯瞰大叻乡村风光。

在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午：

  • 参观春香湖、大叻广场，在Doha Coffee品尝咖啡，并在Big C超市自由活动。

  • 入住大叻酒店。

18:00晚餐。

可自选参观大叻夜市。

住宿：大叻。

第3天：大叻全天观光

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：大叻

酒店享用早餐。

08:30开始全天观光：

  • Datanla瀑布：充满活力的自然景点，有多处小瀑布，松林环绕（可自选冒险活动）。

  • Tuyền Lâm湖：坐落于松林覆盖山丘之间的宁静湖泊，风景优美，空气清新。

  • 快乐山丘：风景优美的湖畔区域，非常适合摄影和放松。

  • 绣球花农场：山坡上的大片花田，展现大叻最具代表性的花卉。

在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午：

  • Vạn Thành花村：大叻最大的花卉种植村之一，以玫瑰和蔬菜闻名。

  • Hoa Sơn Điền Trang：人气生态旅游景点，以森林环境和独特的拍照点而闻名。

  • Mê Linh咖啡农场：一边品尝咖啡，一边俯瞰咖啡种植园和乡村风光。

在当地餐厅用晚餐。

住宿：大叻。

第4天：大叻 – 美奈 | 日落之旅

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：美奈

酒店享用早餐。

08:30退房，乘私人汽车前往美奈。

12:00左右抵达，在当地餐厅享用午餐，然后入住并休息。

15:00，参加美奈日落之旅：

  • 仙女溪：浅浅的溪流，四周是红、白、橙、粉等色彩缤纷的沙丘地貌。

  • 美奈渔村：观察海滨日常生活、渔船和忙碌的当地渔民。

  • 红沙丘：缓坡沙丘，可欣赏美丽的日落景色，是绝佳的拍照地点。

18:00，在当地餐厅享用海鲜烧烤晚餐。

返回酒店。

住宿：美奈。

第5天：美奈 – 湄公河三角洲 – 胡志明市

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：胡志明市

早餐后，07:30出发前往湄公河三角洲。

抵达美拖，在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午：

  • 乘机动船前往凤岛（Con Phụng）。

  • 乘马车前往文化表演区，欣赏被联合国教科文组织认可的越南南部传统民间音乐Đờn Ca Tài Tử，并品尝时令热带水果。

  • 乘坐传统手划船，穿行于椰树成荫的狭窄水道。

  • 参观养蜂场，品尝蜂蜜茶。

  • 在椰子糖作坊停留，了解当地手工艺。

17:00，乘私人汽车返回胡志明市。

在当地餐厅用晚餐。

住宿：胡志明市。

第6天：胡志明市 – 自由活动 / 自选探索

含餐：早餐

酒店享用早餐。

全天自由活动，可购物、漫步城市或参加自选行程。

住宿：胡志明市。

第7天：胡志明市 – 送机

含餐：早餐

酒店享用早餐。

专车送您前往机场，搭乘航班离开。

团费：USD 520 / 人（2人）

费用包含：

  • 私人空调车辆交通

  • 英语导游

  • 餐食：5顿午餐 & 4顿晚餐

  • 所列景点门票

  • 3星级酒店5晚

  • 湄公河三角洲游船

  • 机场接送

费用不含：

  • 沙丘吉普车体验

  • 增值税

  • 个人消费

tours.title: HA GIANG – CAO BANG EASY RIDER – 5 DAYS
tours.summary: This 5 day Ha Giang – Cao Bang Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers seeking a deeper journey into Northern Vietnam. The route combines the world–famous Ha Giang Loop with the remote, untouched landscapes of Cao Bang,
tours.contentHtml:
This 5 day Ha Giang – Cao Bang Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers seeking a deeper journey into Northern Vietnam. The route combines the world–famous Ha Giang Loop with the remote, untouched landscapes of Cao Bang, including Ma Pi Leng Pass, Me Pia Slope, Nguom Ngao Cave, and the legendary Ban Gioc Waterfall – the largest and one of the most beautiful waterfalls in Vietnam.

Ride through dramatic mountains, ethnic minority villages, terraced rice fields, and UNESCO recognized geoparks. Enjoy authentic homestays, local culture, and travel safely with professional Easy Riders.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang.

Pick up from your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter and transfer to Ha Giang by luxury private cabin sleeper bus.

Overnight at a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Detailed Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30 – Tour starts from our homestay in Ha Giang City.
Safety briefing with your Easy Riders before departure.

Highlights of the day:

  • Ride into the mountains with dramatic scenery changes

  • Stop at Bac Sum Pass for panoramic views

  • Visit Quan Ba Heaven Gate and admire the spectacular landscape

  • See the famous Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

  • Enjoy lunch in Yen Minh Town

In the afternoon, continue to:

  • Tham Ma Slope – an iconic winding mountain road and popular photo spot

  • H’Mong King Palace (Vuong Family Residence) – former royal residence of the H’Mong family

Arrive in Dong Van Town in the late afternoon.
Dinner and overnight in a local homestay.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Sky Path – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Bao Lac

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, prepare for the most spectacular part of the Ha Giang Loop:

  • Ride along Ma Pi Leng Pass – known as the “King of Vietnam’s mountain passes”

  • Follow the Sky Path, overlooking the deep canyon and emerald Nho Que River

  • Stop at multiple viewpoints for unforgettable photos

Continue riding through rural villages:

  • Lung Ho

  • Mau Due

  • Meo Vac (lunch stop)

From Meo Vac, ride into the mountainous trail area of Cao Bang province and arrive at Bao Lac Town.
Dinner and overnight with a Tay ethnic family at a local homestay.

Day 3: Bao Lac – Me Pia Slope – Phia Thap Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

Today’s 130 km ride takes you through some of the most breathtaking landscapes in Northeast Vietnam:

  • Remote mountains and limestone formations

  • Peaceful ethnic minority villages

  • Misty passes and hidden valleys

Main stop:

  • Me Pia Slope – a dramatic zig–zag mountain pass with spectacular viewpoints

In the afternoon, continue to Phia Thap Village, known for its traditional craft culture and beautiful surroundings.
Check in at a local homestay. Dinner and overnight with the host family.

Day 4: Phia Thap – Nguom Ngao Cave – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Ban Gioc

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

A full day of natural wonders and scenic landscapes:

  • Visit Nguom Ngao Cave, one of the most impressive caves in Northern Vietnam

  • Make scenic photo stops along forested roads and mountain viewpoints

  • Ride through terraced rice fields and rolling mountain passes

Continue to:

  • Ban Gioc Waterfall – Vietnam’s most magnificent waterfall, located on the Vietnam–China border

    • Take a bamboo raft ride to approach the falls closer

    • Admire the towering cliffs, emerald water, and lush green surroundings

Overnight in the Ban Gioc area at a local homestay.

Day 5: Ban Gioc – God’s Eye Mountain – Cao Bang City → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast:

  • Depart Ban Gioc and ride to Thung Mountain, home to the iconic God’s Eye Mountain (Nui Thung)

  • Enjoy final scenic stops and viewpoints on the way back to Cao Bang City

Lunch at a local restaurant in Cao Bang.

12:30 – Board the limousine bus back to Hanoi.
End of tour upon arrival in Hanoi.

Price per Person

  • 440 USD / person – SIC Tour

Tour Includes

  • Transfer Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang ↔ Cao Bang ↔ Hanoi

    • Luxury private–cabin sleeper bus

    • Limousine bus

  • Free overnight at homestay in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private rooms in homestays during the tour

  • All meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Professional English–speaking tour guide

  • Experienced Easy Riders

  • Motorbike and fuel

  • All entrance fees as per itinerary

  • Protective gear: helmet, pads, raincoat

  • Drinking water during the tour (1 bottle per person per day)

Tour Excludes

  • Border permit (if required)

  • Tips for guide and riders

  • Personal drinks (coffee, beer, soft drinks, etc.)
tours.titleZh: 河江—高平摩托骑行游 – 5天
tours.summaryZh: 这趟5天的河江 – 高平Easy Rider之旅，非常适合希望深度探索越南北部的旅行者。路线将举世闻名的河江环线与高平偏远、未经雕琢的自然风光相结合，包括马皮岭山口、Mẻ Pia坡、Ngườm Ngao洞……
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟5天的河江 – 高平Easy Rider之旅，非常适合希望深度探索越南北部的旅行者。路线将举世闻名的河江环线与高平偏远、未经雕琢的自然风光相结合，包括马皮岭（Mã Pí Lèng）山口、Mẻ Pia坡、Ngườm Ngao洞，以及传奇的板约（Bản Giốc）瀑布——越南最大、也是最美的瀑布之一。

骑行穿越雄奇的山峦、少数民族村寨、层层梯田以及联合国教科文组织认定的地质公园。体验地道的民宿和当地文化，并在专业Easy Rider的陪同下安全出行。

行程概览

河内 → 河江。

在河内老城区的酒店接客，乘豪华独立包厢卧铺巴士前往河江。

夜宿河江市的传统民宿。

详细行程

第1天：河江市 – 北森山口（Bắc Sum） – 官坝天门（Quản Bạ） – 双峰山 – 安明（Yên Minh） – 谭马坡（Thẩm Mã） – 苗王府 – 同文（Đồng Văn）

用餐：午餐、晚餐

08:30 – 行程从我们位于河江市的民宿开始。
出发前，与您的Easy Rider一起进行安全讲解。

当天亮点：

  • 骑行进入山区，沿途风景变化万千

  • 在北森山口停留，欣赏全景

  • 参观官坝天门，欣赏壮丽的景色

  • 观赏著名的双峰山（仙女胸山）

  • 在安明镇享用午餐

下午继续前往：

  • 谭马坡 – 标志性的蜿蜒山路，热门拍照地点

  • 苗王府（王氏家族宅邸） – 苗族王室家族的旧居

傍晚抵达同文县城。
在当地民宿享用晚餐并入住。

第2天：同文 – 志愿青年纪念碑 – 马皮岭山口 – 天空之路 – 乐河（Nho Quế）观景台 – 苗旺（Mèo Vạc） – 保乐（Bảo Lạc）

用餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

早餐后，准备迎接河江环线最壮观的一段：

  • 骑行马皮岭山口——被誉为“越南山口之王”

  • 沿着天空之路骑行，俯瞰深邃的峡谷和碧绿的乐河

  • 在多个观景点停留，留下难忘的照片

继续骑行穿越乡村：

  • Lũng Hồ

  • Mậu Duệ

  • 苗旺（午餐停留）

从苗旺出发，骑行进入高平省的山区小径，抵达保乐镇。
在当地民宿与岱族家庭共进晚餐并留宿。

第3天：保乐 – Mẻ Pia坡 – Phia Thap村

用餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

今天130公里的骑行，将带您领略越南东北部一些最震撼的自然风光：

  • 偏远的山峦和石灰岩地貌

  • 宁静的少数民族村寨

  • 云雾缭绕的山口和隐秘的山谷

主要停留点：

  • Mẻ Pia坡 – 惊险的之字形山口，拥有壮观的观景点

下午继续前往Phia Thap村，这里以传统手工艺文化和优美的环境而闻名。
入住当地民宿，与房东一家共进晚餐并留宿。

第4天：Phia Thap – Ngườm Ngao洞 – 板约瀑布 – 板约

用餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

充满自然奇观和优美风光的一整天：

  • 参观Ngườm Ngao洞，越南北部最令人印象深刻的洞穴之一

  • 沿着林间公路和山间观景点，在风景优美处停留拍照

  • 骑行穿越层层梯田和起伏的山口

继续前往：

  • 板约瀑布 – 越南最壮观的瀑布，位于中越边境

    • 乘坐竹筏，更近距离地接近瀑布

    • 欣赏高耸的悬崖、碧绿的湖水和郁郁葱葱的绿色环境

夜宿板约地区的当地民宿。

第5天：板约 – 上帝之眼山（Thủng山） – 高平市 → 河内

用餐：早餐、午餐

早餐后：

  • 离开板约，骑行前往Thùng山，这里有标志性的上帝之眼山（Núi Thủng）

  • 在返回高平市的途中，享受最后的风景停留和观景点

在高平的当地餐厅享用午餐。

12:30 – 登上返回河内的商务巴士。
抵达河内后行程结束。

每人团费

  • 440美元/人 – SIC拼团

团费包含

  • 接送河内 ↔ 河江 ↔ 高平 ↔ 河内

    • 豪华独立包厢卧铺巴士

    • 商务巴士

  • 河江市民宿免费住宿一晚（传统民居）

  • 住宿：行程期间入住民宿独立房间

  • 全部餐食：早餐 – 午餐 – 晚餐

  • 专业英语导游

  • 经验丰富的Easy Rider

  • 摩托车及油费

  • 行程内所有门票

  • 防护装备：头盔、护具、雨衣

  • 行程期间的饮用水（每人每天1瓶）

团费不包含

  • 边境通行证（如需要）

  • 导游和骑手小费

  • 个人饮品（咖啡、啤酒、软饮等）

tours.title: NHA TRANG – DA LAT – MUI NE – HO CHI MINH CITY
tours.summary: Nha Trang – Da Lat – Mui Ne – Ho Chi Minh City itinerary is one of our signature programs, carefully designed to showcase Vietnam’s diverse landscapes, from coastal beaches and highland retreats to desert dunes and vibra
tours.contentHtml:
Nha Trang – Da Lat – Mui Ne – Ho Chi Minh City itinerary is one of our signature programs, carefully designed to showcase Vietnam’s diverse landscapes, from coastal beaches and highland retreats to desert dunes and vibrant city life.

Vietlook Travel is a Vietnam based local tour operator specializing in tailor made and packaged tours for international travelers.

Price: USD 450 / pax (based on 2 persons)

DAY 1: ARRIVAL IN NHA TRANG – CITY TOUR

Meals: Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Nha Trang

Upon arrival at Cam Ranh International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by Vietlook Travel’s English-speaking guide and transferred by private vehicle to Nha Trang city. After enjoying lunch at a local restaurant, the journey begins with an introduction to the city’s cultural and historical highlights.

  • Po Nagar Cham Towers: An ancient Cham religious complex dating back to before 781 A.D., showcasing unique architecture and spiritual significance.

  • Long Son Pagoda: A peaceful Buddhist site famous for its giant white Buddha statue and panoramic views over Nha Trang.

  • Nha Trang Cathedral: A French Gothic-style church built during the colonial period, representing the city’s architectural heritage.

After the tour, check in to your hotel and relax.
Dinner will be served at a local restaurant in the evening.
You may explore Nha Trang Night Market on your own before resting overnight.

DAY 2: NHA TRANG – DA LAT (SCENIC DRIVE)

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, depart for Da Lat City by private car. The journey offers scenic views of mountains, forests, and rural landscapes.

Upon arrival in Da Lat, enjoy lunch before starting an afternoon city tour:

  • Van Thanh Flower Village: The largest flower-growing area in Da Lat, well known for its rose cultivation.

  • Crazy House: A uniquely designed architectural attraction, reflecting artistic creativity and fantasy.

  • Domaine de Marie Church: A peaceful hilltop church featuring French colonial architecture and beautiful surroundings.

  • Da Lat Railway Station: The oldest railway station in Vietnam, built in 1932, notable for its distinctive design.

Visit Da Lat Square and enjoy free time for coffee or shopping before checking in at the hotel.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Optional visit to Da Lat Night Market.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 3: DA LAT FULL DAY SIGHTSEEING

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, begin a full day exploring Da Lat’s natural beauty and spiritual landmarks:

  • Linh Phuoc Pagoda: A remarkable Buddhist temple decorated entirely with colorful mosaic materials.

  • Hydrangea Flower Farm: Vast flower fields thriving in Da Lat’s cool climate.

  • Stairway to Heaven: A popular viewpoint offering scenic photos of the surrounding landscape.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Datanla Waterfall: A beautiful natural site surrounded by pine forest.

  • Robin Hill Cable Car: A scenic ride overlooking Da Lat’s highland scenery.

  • Truc Lam Zen Monastery: A tranquil monastery located near Tuyen Lam Lake.

  • Happy Hills: A peaceful lakeside area ideal for photography.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Free evening at leisure.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 4: DA LAT – MUI NE | SUNSET TOUR

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Mui Ne

After breakfast, check out and travel from the Central Highlands to the coastal town of Mui Ne.

Upon arrival, enjoy lunch and check in at the hotel.
In the afternoon, join a sunset tour:

  • Fairy Stream: A gentle walk through shallow water surrounded by colorful sand formations.

  • Mui Ne Fishing Village: Observe the daily life of local fishermen along the coast.

  • Red Sand Dunes: A perfect spot to admire the sunset over the dunes.

Dinner with BBQ seafood at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 5: MUI NE – HO CHI MINH CITY | CITY TOUR

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch | Overnight: Ho Chi Minh City

After breakfast, check out and visit:

  • White Sand Dunes: A spectacular desert-like landscape. Optional jeep or quad bike ride available at extra cost.

Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City.
Lunch at a local restaurant, followed by a city tour:

  • Notre Dame Cathedral

  • Central Post Office

  • Tan Dinh (Pink) Church

Check in at the hotel.

Free time for shopping, walking tours, or relaxation.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 6: HO CHI MINH CITY – DEPARTURE

Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Private transfer to the airport approximately 2.5 hours before departure.

TOUR PRICE: USD 450 / PERSON

Included:

  • Private air-conditioned transportation

  • English-speaking guide throughout the tour

  • 5 lunches and 4 dinners

  • Entrance fees as mentioned

  • 5 nights in 3-star hotels

  • Airport transfers

Not Included:

  • Jeep or quad bike at White Sand Dunes

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses
tours.titleZh: 芽庄—大叻—美奈—胡志明市
tours.summaryZh: 芽庄 – 大叻 – 美奈 – 胡志明市行程是我们的招牌线路之一，精心设计，旨在展现越南多样的风光，从海滨沙滩、高原休闲胜地，到沙漠般的沙丘和活力四射的都市生活。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
芽庄 – 大叻 – 美奈 – 胡志明市行程是我们的招牌线路之一，精心设计，旨在展现越南多样的风光，从海滨沙滩、高原休闲胜地，到沙漠般的沙丘和活力四射的都市生活。

Vietlook Travel是一家总部位于越南的本地旅行社，专为国际旅行者提供定制和套餐旅游服务。

价格：USD 450 / 人（按2人计算）

第1天：抵达芽庄 – 市区游

含餐：午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：芽庄

抵达金兰国际机场后，Vietlook Travel的英语导游将热情迎接您，并乘坐专车送您前往芽庄市。在当地餐厅享用午餐后，旅程从介绍这座城市的文化和历史亮点开始。

  • 婆那加占婆塔：古老的占族宗教建筑群，可追溯至公元781年之前，展现独特的建筑风格和精神意义。

  • 龙山寺：宁静的佛教圣地，以巨大的白色佛像和俯瞰芽庄的全景而闻名。

  • 芽庄大教堂：殖民时期建造的法式哥特风格教堂，代表这座城市的建筑遗产。

游览结束后，入住酒店并休息。
晚上在当地餐厅用晚餐。
休息前，您可自行逛逛芽庄夜市。

第2天：芽庄 – 大叻（风景自驾路线）

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：大叻

早餐后，乘私人汽车前往大叻市。沿途可欣赏山峦、森林和乡村风光。

抵达大叻后，先享用午餐，下午开始市区游：

  • Vạn Thành花村：大叻最大的花卉种植区，以玫瑰种植闻名。

  • 疯狂屋：设计独特的建筑景点，体现艺术创意与奇幻色彩。

  • Domaine de Marie教堂：宁静的山顶教堂，拥有法式殖民建筑和优美的周边环境。

  • 大叻火车站：越南最古老的火车站，建于1932年，以独特的设计著称。

参观大叻广场，自由活动时间可喝咖啡或购物，随后入住酒店。

在当地餐厅用晚餐。

可自选参观大叻夜市。

住宿：大叻。

第3天：大叻全天观光

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：大叻

早餐后，开启全天探索大叻自然美景和精神地标之旅：

  • 灵福寺：一座非凡的佛教寺庙，全寺以五彩缤纷的马赛克材料装饰而成。

  • 绣球花农场：在大叻凉爽气候中盛开的大片花田。

  • 天堂之梯：人气观景点，可拍摄周边风光美照。

在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午：

  • Datanla瀑布：松林环绕的美丽自然景观。

  • 罗宾山缆车：乘缆车俯瞰大叻高原风光。

  • 竹林禅院：位于Tuyền Lâm湖附近的静谧寺院。

  • 快乐山丘：宁静的湖畔区域，非常适合摄影。

在当地餐厅用晚餐。

晚上自由活动。

住宿：大叻。

第4天：大叻 – 美奈 | 日落之旅

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：美奈

早餐后退房，从中部高原前往海滨小镇美奈。

抵达后享用午餐并入住酒店。
下午参加日落之旅：

  • 仙女溪：在浅水中轻松漫步，四周是五彩斑斓的沙丘地貌。

  • 美奈渔村：观察沿海渔民的日常生活。

  • 红沙丘：欣赏沙丘日落的绝佳地点。

在当地餐厅享用海鲜烧烤晚餐。

住宿：美奈。

第5天：美奈 – 胡志明市 | 市区游

含餐：早餐、午餐 | 住宿：胡志明市

早餐后退房，参观：

  • 白沙丘：壮观的类沙漠景观。可自选乘坐吉普车或沙滩车（需另付费）。

前往胡志明市。
在当地餐厅享用午餐，随后开始市区游：

  • 圣母大教堂

  • 中央邮局

  • 新定（粉红）教堂

入住酒店。

自由活动时间，可购物、漫步游览或休息。

住宿：胡志明市。

第6天：胡志明市 – 送机

含餐：早餐

酒店享用早餐。

起飞前约2.5小时专车送往机场。

团费：USD 450 / 人

费用包含：

  • 私人空调车辆交通

  • 全程英语导游

  • 5顿午餐和4顿晚餐

  • 所列景点门票

  • 3星级酒店5晚

  • 机场接送

费用不含：

  • 白沙丘吉普车或沙滩车

  • 增值税

  • 个人消费

tours.title: HANOI – CAT CAT VILLAGE – FANSIPAN
tours.summary: Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 2 days – 1 night exploring the most iconic attractions of Sapa, including Cat Cat Village and Fansipan Peak – “The Roof of Indochina”. You will enjoy comfortable hote
tours.contentHtml:
Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 2 days – 1 night exploring the most iconic attractions of Sapa, including Cat Cat Village and Fansipan Peak – “The Roof of Indochina”. You will enjoy comfortable hotel accommodations, convenient transportation, and friendly services throughout your journey.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa – Cat Cat Village

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30

Pickup from your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter or at the bus station. Board the sleeper bus and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45

Travel along the highway to Lao Cai with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue along the mountain road toward Sapa Town, enjoying views of valleys and terraced rice fields.

13:00

Arrive in Sapa Town, where ethnic H’Mong, Dzao and Tay people wear traditional colorful costumes.

  • Welcome drink

  • Itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Walk to Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people. Discover traditional houses, daily lifestyle, local crafts, and trek to the French-built hydro-power station and Cat Cat Waterfall. Trek uphill to return to Sapa with beautiful late-afternoon scenery.
Trekking distance: 2.5 km – approx. 2 hours

16:30

Return to Sapa. Dinner and overnight at hotel with free evening activities.

Day 2: Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

08:00

After breakfast, driver and tour guide transfer you to the Cable Car Station. Enjoy a 20-minute cable car ride with spectacular mountain views.

09:00

Arrive at 2,800 meters altitude. Explore the spiritual pagoda complex, take photos, and climb 600 steps to the summit of

Fansipan Peak – The Roof of Indochina.

Total time: approx. 1.5 hours sightseeing & photo taking

11:30

Return to the Cable Car Station and then to Sapa Town.

12:00 – 13:00

Back to the hotel, check out, have lunch, and enjoy free time.

13:30

Gather at the hotel for the return trip to Hanoi.

14:00

Board the bus back to Hanoi with two comfort breaks.

20:30 – 21:00

Arrive in Hanoi. Trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Modern sleeper bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (guide not available on bus)

  • Hotel accommodation (double/twin sharing; 3★ / 4★ / 5★ options)

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 dinner, 1 breakfast

  • Entrance tickets for mentioned sites

  • Local guide for Cat Cat Village and Fansipan transfer

Trip Excludes

  • Cable car ticket Sapa – Fansipan – Sapa:

    • 32 USD/person (weekdays)

    • 34 USD/person (Saturday)

  • Beverages, personal expenses, travel insurance, government tax

  • Items not clearly mentioned

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD/person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD/person (round trip)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat: 25 USD/person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble: 16 USD/person (round trip)

What to Bring

  • Warm clothing, hat, scarf (Sapa is cold September–March)

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Vietnam Dong cash (ATMs may not work well; USD/EUR/AUD accepted)

  • Personal medicine

Tour Price per Person (USD)

82 USD / person (3★)

92 USD / person (4★)

118 USD / person (5★)
tours.titleZh: 河内—猫猫村—番西邦峰
tours.summaryZh: 沙坝之旅专为想用2天1晚探索沙坝最具代表性景点的旅行者设计，包括猫猫村和番西邦峰——“印度支那屋脊”。全程您将享受舒适的酒店住宿
tours.contentHtmlZh:
沙坝之旅专为想用2天1晚探索沙坝最具代表性景点的旅行者设计，包括猫猫村（Cát Cát）和番西邦峰（Fansipan）——“印度支那屋脊”。全程您将享受舒适的酒店住宿、便捷的交通和友好的服务。

行程安排

第1天：河内–沙坝–猫猫村

餐食：午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30

在河内老城区酒店或巴士站接您。乘坐卧铺巴士前往沙坝。

07:30 – 11:45

沿高速公路前往老街，途中休息一次。

11:45 – 13:00

继续沿山路前往沙坝镇，欣赏山谷和梯田的风光。

13:00

抵达沙坝镇，苗族、瑶族和岱族人民身着传统的五彩服饰。

  • 欢迎饮品

  • 行程介绍

  • 享用越南地方菜肴午餐

  • 酒店入住

14:30

步行前往猫猫村，这里是黑苗族人的家园。探访传统民居、日常生活方式和当地手工艺，并徒步前往法国人修建的水电站和猫猫瀑布。再上坡徒步返回沙坝，欣赏傍晚的美丽景色。
徒步距离：2.5公里——约2小时

16:30

返回沙坝。晚餐并入住酒店，晚间自由活动。

第2天：沙坝–番西邦峰–河内

餐食：早餐、午餐

08:00

早餐后，司机和导游送您前往缆车站。乘坐20分钟的缆车，欣赏壮丽的山景。

09:00

抵达海拔2.800米处。探索灵性寺庙群，拍照留念，并攀登600级台阶登上

回到酒店，退房、用午餐，并享受自由时间。

13:30

在酒店集合，准备返回河内。

14:00

乘上返回河内的巴士，途中休息两次。

20:30 – 21:00

抵达河内。行程结束。

tours.title: HO CHI MINH CITY – MUI NE – MEKONG DELTA – CU CHI TOUR
tours.summary: This five day four night tour at Vietlook Travel combines southern Vietnam’s natural landscapes, cultural heritage, and historical landmarks. Travelers will experience the vibrant city life of Ho Chi Minh City, the sand
tours.contentHtml:
This five day four night tour at Vietlook Travel combines southern Vietnam’s natural landscapes, cultural heritage, and historical landmarks. Travelers will experience the vibrant city life of Ho Chi Minh City, the sand dunes and fishing villages of Mui Ne, the unique waterways and local lifestyle of the Mekong Delta, and the historic Cu Chi Tunnels. The tour includes private transportation, English speaking guides, local meals, and comfortable three-star accommodation.

HO CHI MINH CITY – MUI NE – MEKONG DELTA – CU CHI TOUR

Price: 338 USD per person

Based on a group of two people

DETAILED ITINERARY

DAY 1: MUI NE SUNSET TOUR

Lunch included

Overnight in Mui Ne

Morning

Pick up at the airport and transfer to Mui Ne.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant. Check in at the hotel and relax.

Afternoon

At 03:15 PM, depart from the hotel for sightseeing.

Visit Fairy Stream, a spectacular natural site with vibrant orange-red stream water and unique sand formations.

Observe the daily life of fishermen at the Mui Ne Fishing Village. Boats return from the sea, women sort the catch, and the atmosphere reflects traditional coastal life.

Visit the Red Sand Dunes, which offer excellent photography opportunities with their striking red sand and gentle slopes.

Evening

At 06:00 PM, enjoy a fresh barbecue seafood dinner at a local restaurant. Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 2: MUI NE SUNRISE TOUR – HO CHI MINH CITY

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Early Morning

At 05:30 AM, the tour guide and driver will pick you up for the sunrise tour at White Sand Dunes. Optional activities include quad bike rides, ostrich riding, and sand sliding (at personal expense).

Return to the hotel for breakfast and free time for swimming or relaxing at the resort.

Midday

Check out at 12:00 PM and have lunch before departing for Ho Chi Minh City.

Late Afternoon

Check in at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City at 05:00 PM. Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market.

DAY 3: MEKONG DELTA TOUR

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Morning

At 08:15 AM, depart from Ho Chi Minh City for My Tho city by private car.

Board a motorboat at the pier and cruise along the Mekong River. Observe floating houses and local fish farming activities.

Continue to Thoi Son Islet (Unicorn Island) and take a horse cart to a performance site to enjoy traditional Vietnamese music, “Đàn Ca Tài Tử,” recognized by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage. Seasonal tropical fruits will also be served.

Take a small hand-rowing boat along a creek lined with coconut trees to experience the Mekong Delta lifestyle. Visit a local bee farm and enjoy honey tea.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant. Visit a coconut candy workshop and sample freshly made candies.

Afternoon

Return to Ho Chi Minh City by private car. Free evening.

DAY 4: CU CHI TUNNELS – HO CHI MINH CITY CITY TOUR

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Morning

At 08:30 AM, depart for the Cu Chi Tunnels, approximately 60 kilometers from Ho Chi Minh City. Explore the extensive tunnel network used during the Vietnam War and learn about the history of the region. Optional shooting experience with rifles is available.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon

Return to Ho Chi Minh City and enjoy a city tour: visit Ho Chi Minh City Hall, Nguyen Hue Walking Street, and Coffee Apartment for local coffee.

Visit the Pink Church, famous for its unique architecture and striking pink color.

Continue to Saigon Central Post Office, one of Asia’s grandest post offices. Learn about Vietnam’s cultural history and try sending mail the traditional way.

Evening

Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market near the hotel.

DAY 5: DEPARTURE

Breakfast included

Depending on your flight schedule, pick up at the hotel and transfer to the airport. The tour ends.

TOUR INCLUSIONS

  • Private car pickup and drop off

  • English speaking tour guide

  • Four local lunches

  • Entrance tickets to all attractions

  • Four nights accommodation in three-star hotels

  • Mekong Delta boat ride

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

  • Jeep service at sand dunes

  • Value added tax

  • Personal expenses

  • Visa fees
tours.titleZh: 胡志明市—美奈—湄公河三角洲—古芝地道游
tours.summaryZh: 这趟5天4晚的Vietlook Travel行程融合了越南南部的自然风光、文化遗产和历史地标。旅行者将体验胡志明市的繁华都市生活、美奈的沙丘与渔村、湄公河三角洲独特的水道与当地生活方式，以及历史悠久的古芝地道。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟5天4晚的Vietlook Travel行程融合了越南南部的自然风光、文化遗产和历史地标。旅行者将体验胡志明市的繁华都市生活、美奈的沙丘与渔村、湄公河三角洲独特的水道与当地生活方式，以及历史悠久的古芝地道。行程包含私家车接送、英语导游、当地餐食和舒适的三星级住宿。

胡志明市–美奈–湄公河三角洲–古芝之旅

价格：每人338美元

以2人团为基准

详细行程

第1天：美奈日落之旅

含午餐

美奈住宿

上午

机场接机，前往美奈。

中午

在当地餐厅用午餐。酒店入住并休息。

下午

03:15 PM，从酒店出发观光。

参观仙女溪，这是一处壮观的自然景点，溪水呈鲜艳的橙红色，沙地地貌独特。

在美奈渔村观察渔民的日常生活。渔船从海上归来，妇女们分拣渔获，氛围展现出传统的海滨生活。

参观红沙丘，红色的沙子和缓缓的坡度为摄影提供了绝佳机会。

晚上

06:00 PM，在当地餐厅享用新鲜的烧烤海鲜晚餐。晚间自由活动。

美奈住宿。

第2天：美奈日出之旅–胡志明市

含早餐和午餐

胡志明市住宿

清晨

05:30 AM，导游和司机接您前往白沙丘观日出。可选活动包括沙滩摩托车、骑鸵鸟和滑沙（费用自理）。

返回酒店用早餐，并有自由时间在度假村游泳或休息。

中午

12:00 PM退房并用午餐，然后启程前往胡志明市。

傍晚

05:00 PM入住胡志明市酒店。自由时间可逛滨城夜市。

第3天：湄公河三角洲之旅

含早餐和午餐

胡志明市住宿

上午

08:15 AM，乘私家车从胡志明市出发前往美荻市。

在码头登上机动船，沿湄公河航行。观察水上房屋和当地养鱼活动。

继续前往泰山洲（独角兽岛，Thới Sơn），乘马车前往表演场地，欣赏被联合国教科文组织列为非物质文化遗产的越南传统音乐“才子弹唱（Đàn Ca Tài Tử）”。还将供应时令热带水果。

乘坐手划小船，沿着两岸椰树成行的小溪，体验湄公河三角洲的生活方式。参观当地养蜂场，品尝蜂蜜茶。

中午

在当地餐厅用午餐。参观椰子糖作坊，品尝现做的糖果。

下午

乘私家车返回胡志明市。晚间自由活动。

第4天：古芝地道–胡志明市市区游

含早餐和午餐

胡志明市住宿

上午

08:30 AM，出发前往古芝地道，距胡志明市约60公里。探索越南战争期间使用的庞大地道网络，了解该地区的历史。可选择射击步枪体验。

中午

在当地餐厅用午餐。

下午

返回胡志明市，享受市区游：参观胡志明市政厅、阮惠步行街和咖啡公寓（Coffee Apartment）品尝当地咖啡。

参观粉红教堂，以其独特的建筑和醒目的粉红色闻名。

继续前往西贡中央邮局，这是亚洲最宏伟的邮局之一。了解越南的文化历史，并尝试以传统方式寄信。

晚上

自由时间，可逛酒店附近的滨城夜市。

第5天：离境

含早餐

根据您的航班时间，从酒店接送前往机场。行程结束。

行程包含

  • 私家车接送

  • 英语导游

  • 四顿当地午餐

  • 所有景点门票

  • 四晚三星级酒店住宿

  • 湄公河三角洲乘船游

行程不包含

  • 沙丘吉普车服务

  • 增值税

  • 个人开销

  • 签证费

tours.title: HANOI – SAPA – CAT CAT – LAO CHAI – TA VAN – TRAM TON – SILVER WATERFALL
tours.summary: This tour is designed for travelers who want to spend more time exploring Sapa’s highlights, including Tram Ton Pass, Silver Waterfall, and the most beautiful ethnic villages. With comfortable hotel stays, friendly servi
tours.contentHtml:
This tour is designed for travelers who want to spend more time exploring Sapa’s highlights, including Tram Ton Pass, Silver Waterfall, and the most beautiful ethnic villages. With comfortable hotel stays, friendly services, and a cost much lower than night trains, Vietlook Travel ensures you enjoy an unforgettable Sapa experience.

Destinations include: Sapa Town, Cat Cat Village, Y Linh Ho, Lao Chai, Ta Van Village, Tram Ton Pass (Heaven Gate), Silver Waterfall, Salmon Farm.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa – Cat Cat Village

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30

Meet at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45

Follow the highway to Lao Cai City with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

Drive along the mountain road to Sapa Town, enjoying views of valleys and terraced rice fields.

13:00

Arrive in Sapa Town and meet ethnic groups in colorful traditional clothing.

  • Welcome drink

  • Itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Walk to Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people. Explore traditional houses, observe daily activities, and trek to the French-built hydro-power station and Cat Cat Waterfall. Then trek uphill back to Sapa with beautiful late-afternoon scenery.
Trekking distance: 2.5 km – approx. 2 hours

16:30

Return to Sapa. Dinner at 18:00. Overnight at the hotel.

Day 2: Y Linh Ho – Lao Chai – Ta Van Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

07:00 – 07:45

Breakfast at the hotel. Prepare light backpack for trekking.

08:00

A short drive to Y Linh Ho. Begin trekking through rice terraces and along the Mường Hoa River to Lao Chai Village of the Black H’Mong people. Continue to Ta Van Village, home of the Dzay ethnic minority.

Trekking distance: 9 km – approx. 4 hours

11:30

Pickup at Ta Van Bridge and transfer back to Sapa.

12:00 – Evening

Lunch and free time to explore Sapa Town on your own.

Dinner and overnight at the hotel.

Day 3: Tram Ton Pass – Silver Waterfall – Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

06:00 – 08:00

Breakfast at hotel and meet your tour guide.

08:00

Start a 12 km road trip to Tram Ton Pass (Heaven Gate), known as the highest pass in Vietnam and the most stunning mountain viewpoint in Northern Vietnam.

Continue to Silver Waterfall (Thác Bạc) and visit the local salmon farm.

12:00 – 13:00

Return to Sapa. Shower at the hotel, lunch, and free time to relax.

13:30

Gather with the group at the hotel.

14:00

Board the bus back to Hanoi with two comfort breaks.

20:30 – 21:00

Arrive at Hanoi bus stop. Trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Sleeper bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (guide not available on bus)

  • English-speaking local guide in Sapa

  • Meals: 3 lunches, 2 dinners, 2 breakfasts

  • Entrance fees to all mentioned sites

  • Hotel accommodation (3★ / 4★ / 5★) – twin/double sharing

  • Insurance during bus travel

Trip Excludes

  • Beverages, personal expenses, VAT, travel insurance

  • Services not clearly mentioned

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD/person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD/person (round trip)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat: 25 USD/person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble: 16 USD/person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Under 5 years old (under 1m): Free of charge (sharing bed/berth with parents)

  • 5 – 8 years old: 75% of adult price

  • 9+ years old: Adult price

Notes

  • Elderly guests should avoid the 9 km trek during rainy conditions.

  • Children under 6 years old and guests with mobility issues should not join the long trek.

  • Surcharge applies on Vietnamese national holidays.

What to Bring

  • Warm clothing (Sapa is cold from September to March)

  • Scarf, hat, cap (foggy from December to March)

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Vietnam Dong cash (ATMs may not always function; USD/EUR/AUD accepted)

  • Personal medicine (pharmacies available but limited)

124 USD / person (3★)

140 USD / person (4★)

184 USD / person (5★)
tours.titleZh: 河内—沙坝—猫猫村—老柴—达旺—针线山口—银瀑布
tours.summaryZh: 本行程专为想花更多时间探索沙坝精华景点的旅行者设计，包括Trạm Tôn山口、银瀑布和最美的少数民族村寨。入住舒适酒店，服务贴心，费用远低于夜班火车。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
本行程专为想花更多时间探索沙坝精华景点的旅行者设计，包括Trạm Tôn山口、银瀑布和最美的少数民族村寨。入住舒适酒店，服务贴心，费用远低于夜班火车，Vietlook Travel确保您拥有难忘的沙坝体验。

目的地包括：沙坝镇、猫猫村（Cát Cát）、Y Linh Hồ、老寨（Lao Chải）、Tả Van村、Trạm Tôn山口（天门关）、银瀑布、三文鱼养殖场。

行程安排

第1天：河内 – 沙坝 – 猫猫村

含餐：午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30

在巴士站集合，登上卧铺巴士，前往沙坝。

07:30 – 11:45

沿高速公路前往老街市，途中稍作休息。

11:45 – 13:00

沿山路驶往沙坝镇，沿途欣赏山谷和梯田美景。

13:00

抵达沙坝镇，遇见身着色彩斑斓传统服饰的少数民族。

  • 欢迎饮品

  • 行程介绍

  • 享用越南菜午餐

  • 办理酒店入住

14:30

步行前往猫猫村（Cát Cát），这里是黑苗族的家园。参观传统民居，观察村民的日常活动，并徒步前往法国人修建的水力发电站和猫猫瀑布。然后徒步上坡返回沙坝，欣赏傍晚的美丽景色。
徒步距离：2.5公里——约2小时

16:30

返回沙坝。18:00晚餐，酒店过夜。

第2天：Y Linh Hồ – 老寨 – Tả Van村

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

07:00 – 07:45

酒店早餐。准备好徒步用的轻便背包。

08:00

短途驱车前往Y Linh Hồ。开始徒步，穿过梯田，沿Mường Hoa河前往黑苗族的老寨村（Lao Chải）。继续前往Tả Van村，这里是佳依族（Giáy）少数民族的家园。

徒步距离：9公里——约4小时

11:30

在Tả Van桥接上团队，并送回沙坝。

12:00 – 晚上

午餐，并自由活动，独自探索沙坝镇。

晚餐及酒店过夜。

第3天：Trạm Tôn山口 – 银瀑布 – 河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

06:00 – 08:00

酒店早餐，与导游会合。

08:00

开始12公里的车程前往Trạm Tôn山口（天门关），它被誉为越南最高的山口，也是越南北部最壮丽的山景观景点。

继续前往银瀑布（Thác Bạc）并参观当地三文鱼养殖场。

12:00 – 13:00

返回沙坝。在酒店冲个澡，享用午餐，并自由休息。

13:30

与团队在酒店集合。

14:00

登上返回河内的巴士，途中休息两次。

20:30 – 21:00

抵达河内巴士站，行程结束。

  • 河内 – 沙坝 – 河内卧铺巴士（巴士上不配导游）

  • 沙坝英语当地导游

  • 餐食：3顿午餐、2顿晚餐、2顿早餐

tours.title: SAIGON WALKING FOODIE AND HISTORY TOUR
tours.summary: The Saigon Walking Foodie and History Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is a cultural walking experience designed for international travelers who want to understand Ho Chi Minh City through its history, daily life, and
tours.contentHtml:
The Saigon Walking Foodie and History Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is a cultural walking experience designed for international travelers who want to understand Ho Chi Minh City through its history, daily life, and local cuisine. This tour combines historical landmarks with authentic street food and traditional markets, offering a deeper look into the city beyond the main tourist attractions.

Walking through local neighborhoods, you will learn about important historical events, explore hidden wartime sites, and experience the everyday rhythm of Saigonese life. Along the way, you will enjoy iconic Vietnamese food and drinks that reflect the city’s diverse culinary culture. This tour is ideal for travelers who enjoy learning, walking, and tasting their way through a city.

TOUR SCHEDULE

08:00 AM – 12:00 PM

01:00 PM – 05:00 PM

06:00 PM – 10:00 PM

Partner Price: 44 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Thich Quang Duc Monument

Visit the Thich Quang Duc Monument and learn about the historical background of a significant event in 1963 related to the Buddhist movement in Vietnam. Your guide will explain the social and historical context of this moment and its impact on Vietnamese history.

Secret Weapon Bunker during the Vietnam War

Explore the hidden remains of a secret weapon bunker used during the Vietnam War. This discreet site once played an important role in wartime logistics and offers insight into the underground strategies used during that period.

Grilled Banana Wrapped in Sticky Rice with Coconut Milk

Taste a popular local dessert known as grilled banana wrapped in sticky rice and served with fresh coconut milk. This traditional sweet treat is widely loved by local people and represents classic southern Vietnamese flavors.

Original Vietnamese Coffee

Stop at a local coffee shop to enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee. Learn about the traditional brewing method and savor the rich, bold flavor that has made Vietnamese coffee famous around the world.

Banh Mi, the World’s Best Sandwich

Enjoy the famous banh mi, a Vietnamese sandwich known globally for its crispy French style baguette filled with a balanced combination of meats, vegetables, herbs, and sauces.

Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment, Built in 1968

Visit the Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment, one of the oldest apartment complexes in Saigon, built in 1968. This location offers a glimpse into local residential life and the architectural style of the post war period.

Biggest Flower Market in District Ten

Walk through the largest flower market in District Ten. Experience the lively atmosphere and learn about the role of flowers in Vietnamese daily life, traditions, and celebrations.

Do It Yourself Lotus Pod Experience

Create your own lotus pod using the lotus flower, which is a national symbol of Vietnam. Learn about its cultural meaning, representing purity, calmness, and resilience.

Fresh Sugarcane Juice

Refresh yourself with a glass of freshly pressed sugarcane juice, a popular local drink enjoyed for its natural sweetness and cooling effect.
tours.titleZh: 西贡步行美食与历史游
tours.summaryZh: 由Vietlook Travel运营的西贡美食与历史漫步之旅，是一项文化徒步体验，让国际旅客通过历史、日常生活和地道美食了解胡志明市，将历史地标与正宗街头美食和传统市场相结合。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
由Vietlook Travel运营的西贡美食与历史漫步之旅是一项文化徒步体验，专为希望通过历史、日常生活和地道美食了解胡志明市的国际旅客设计。本行程将历史地标与正宗街头美食和传统市场相结合，带您跳出主流景点，更深入地认识这座城市。

漫步在当地街区，您将了解重要的历史事件，探访隐秘的战时遗址，感受西贡人日常生活的节奏。沿途还能品尝代表这座城市多元饮食文化的经典越南美食和饮品。本行程非常适合喜欢边学习、边行走、边品尝来认识一座城市的旅行者。

行程时间

08:00 AM – 12:00 PM

01:00 PM – 05:00 PM

06:00 PM – 10:00 PM

合作伙伴价格：每人44 USD

行程亮点与安排

释广德纪念碑

参观释广德纪念碑，了解1963年与越南佛教运动相关的重大事件的历史背景。导游将讲解这一时刻的社会与历史背景及其对越南历史的影响。

越战时期秘密武器地堡

探访越战时期使用的秘密武器地堡遗迹。这处隐蔽的场所曾在战时后勤中发挥重要作用，让您了解当时的地下作战策略。

椰奶糯米烤香蕉

品尝一种广受欢迎的当地甜品——糯米包裹的烤香蕉，配上新鲜椰奶。这道传统甜点深受当地人喜爱，代表着经典的越南南部风味。

正宗越南咖啡

在当地咖啡馆小憩，品尝正宗越南咖啡。了解传统的冲泡方法，细细品味让越南咖啡闻名世界的浓郁醇厚风味。

越南法棍（Bánh Mì），世界上最棒的三明治

享用著名的越南法棍（bánh mì），这款越南三明治以酥脆的法式长棍面包闻名全球，夹着搭配均衡的肉类、蔬菜、香草和酱料。

建于1968年的Nguyen Thien Thuat公寓

参观Nguyen Thien Thuat公寓，这是西贡最古老的公寓楼之一，建于1968年。这里让您得以一窥当地居民的生活和战后时期的建筑风格。

第十郡最大的花市

漫步第十郡最大的花市，感受热闹的氛围，了解鲜花在越南日常生活、传统习俗和庆典中的地位。

亲手制作莲蓬体验

用莲花亲手制作属于自己的莲蓬，莲花是越南的国家象征。了解它的文化含义：代表纯洁、宁静和坚韧。

鲜榨甘蔗汁

来一杯鲜榨甘蔗汁提神解渴，这是一种广受欢迎的当地饮品，以天然的甜味和清凉解暑的功效深受喜爱。

tours.title: SUNSET COCKTAIL AND DINNER CRUISE
tours.summary: Experience a magical tropical evening aboard Emperor Cruises as the sun sets over Nha Trang Bay. Enjoy a delicious 5-course seafood dinner while being serenaded by live musicians, with the stars, moon, and city lights as
tours.contentHtml:
Experience a magical tropical evening aboard Emperor Cruises as the sun sets over Nha Trang Bay. Enjoy a delicious 5-course seafood dinner while being serenaded by live musicians, with the stars, moon, and city lights as your backdrop. The attentive staff ensure an unforgettable romantic cruise experience.

DETAILED ITINERARY

15:35 – 16:00
Pick-up from your hotel and transfer to Vinh Truong Island Waterway Port to board Emperor Cruises.

16:20 – 16:30
Guests are transferred by tender from the port to the main Emperor Cruises boat.

16:30 – 18:00
Upon arrival on board, you are welcomed by the Experiences Manager with a welcome drink. Receive an introduction to Nha Trang Bay, local culture, cuisine, history, the emperor’s legacy, and safety precautions. Begin cruising through the stunning landscape of Nha Trang Bay as the sun sets.

18:00 – 19:30
Enjoy cocktails and wines on the sundeck while live musicians (violin and guitar) play against the breathtaking backdrop of stars, the moon, and city lights.

Indulge in a 5 course seafood dinner, with main course options including lobster, Australian beef, or salmon, served by the attentive Emperor Cruises team.

20:00
Conclude your romantic evening with drinks or cocktails on the lounge or sundeck before returning to the port. Shuttle transfers will take you back to your hotel.

PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 72

BENEFITS INCLUDED

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off in central Nha Trang

  • Cocktail party and canapés on the sundeck

  • Experiences Manager on board (English, Russian, Korean, Vietnamese)

  • Seafood 5-course dinner on board with main course options: Lobster / Australian Beef / Salmon

  • Unlimited drinks: house wine, cocktails, liquor, local beer, soft drinks, fruit juice, tea, coffee, mineral water

  • Live music (violin + guitar)

  • Free Wi-Fi

NOTE

  • Timetable may vary by ±30 minutes depending on weather and sea conditions.

  • Final pick-up time will be confirmed one day prior to the cruise.

ONBOARD SERVICES

  • 24-hour reception and security

  • Mini bar

  • Restaurant

  • Newspapers, magazines, and chess

  • Languages spoken: English, Russian, Korean, Vietnamese
tours.titleZh: 日落鸡尾酒晚餐游轮
tours.summaryZh: 登上帝王游轮，在夕阳洒落芽庄湾之际，感受一个魔幻的热带夜晚。品尝丰盛的五道菜海鲜晚宴，现场乐手奏响悠扬乐曲，繁星、明月与城市灯火是您身后的绝美背景……
tours.contentHtmlZh:
登上帝王游轮（Emperor Cruises），在夕阳洒落芽庄湾之际，感受一个魔幻的热带夜晚。品尝丰盛的五道菜海鲜晚宴，现场乐手奏响悠扬乐曲，繁星、明月与城市灯火是您身后的绝美背景。贴心周到的船员将为您带来一次难忘的浪漫游轮体验。

详细行程

15:35 – 16:00
酒店接客，前往Vinh Truong岛水路码头登上帝王游轮。

16:20 – 16:30
客人乘接驳小艇从码头前往帝王游轮主船。

16:30 – 18:00
登船后，体验经理将以欢迎饮品迎接您，并为您介绍芽庄湾、当地文化、美食、历史、帝王传奇以及安全注意事项。随着夕阳西下，游轮缓缓驶过芽庄湾的迷人风光。

18:00 – 19:30
在日光甲板上品尝鸡尾酒和葡萄酒，现场乐手（小提琴和吉他）在繁星、明月与城市灯火的绝美背景下现场演奏。

尽享五道菜海鲜晚宴，主菜可选龙虾、澳洲牛肉或三文鱼，由贴心周到的帝王游轮团队为您服务。

20:00
在休息厅或日光甲板上品饮美酒或鸡尾酒，为浪漫的夜晚画上句号，随后返回码头。接驳车将送您回酒店。

价格

每人价格：72美元

包含项目

  • 芽庄市中心酒店接送

  • 日光甲板鸡尾酒会及开胃小点

  • 船上体验经理（英语、俄语、韩语、越南语）

  • 船上五道菜海鲜晚宴，主菜可选：龙虾 / 澳洲牛肉 / 三文鱼

  • 无限畅饮：餐酒、鸡尾酒、烈酒、当地啤酒、软饮、果汁、茶、咖啡、矿泉水

  • 现场音乐（小提琴 + 吉他）

  • 免费Wi-Fi

注意事项

  • 时间表可能因天气和海况而有±30分钟的变动。

  • 最终接客时间将在游轮出发前一天确认。

船上服务

  • 24小时前台接待与安保

  • 迷你吧

  • 餐厅

  • 报纸、杂志和国际象棋

  • 服务语言：英语、俄语、韩语、越南语

tours.title: HO CHI MINH CITY – MUI NE – VUNG TAU TOUR
tours.summary: This five day, four night tour ( HCM – Mui Ne – Vung Tau Tour) offers a well balanced journey through southern Vietnam, combining vibrant city life, coastal landscapes, sand dunes, beaches, and cultural landmarks. Travel
tours.contentHtml:
This five day, four night tour ( HCM – Mui Ne – Vung Tau Tour) offers a well balanced journey through southern Vietnam, combining vibrant city life, coastal landscapes, sand dunes, beaches, and cultural landmarks. Travelers will experience the highlights of Ho Chi Minh City, the natural beauty of Mui Ne, and the seaside charm of Vung Tau, with comfortable transportation, guided sightseeing, and authentic local cuisine.

Price: 338 USD per person

Based on a group of two people

DETAILED ITINERARY

DAY 1: HO CHI MINH CITY TOUR

Lunch included

Morning

Your tour guide will pick you up at the airport and transfer you to the city center of Ho Chi Minh City.

Noon

Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant with Vietnamese beef noodle soup, known as pho.

Afternoon

Visit the Ho Chi Minh City People’s Committee building and walk along Nguyen Hue Walking Street. Stop at the Coffee Apartment to enjoy traditional Vietnamese coffee.

Continue to visit the Pink Church, one of the most famous architectural landmarks in the city, built in the mid nineteenth century in a European architectural style with its distinctive pink exterior.

Visit the Saigon Central Post Office, an outstanding example of European neoclassical architecture combined with Asian decorative elements.

View Notre Dame Cathedral, built in classical French architectural style and recognized for its cultural, historical, and religious significance.

Evening

Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market near the hotel.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 2: HO CHI MINH CITY – MUI NE SUNSET TOUR

Breakfast, lunch, and dinner included

Overnight in Mui Ne

Morning

Pick up at the hotel and depart for Mui Ne. The journey takes approximately four hours.

Noon

Have lunch at a local restaurant. Check in to the hotel and relax.

Afternoon

At 03:15 PM, depart from the hotel for sightseeing.

Visit Suoi Tien, a popular photo location known for its colorful sand formations in red, white, orange, and pink.

Visit the fishing village to observe the daily life of local fishermen, including boats returning from the sea and families sorting the catch.

Visit the Red Sand Dunes, where the gentle slopes and vibrant red sand create excellent photo opportunities, especially near sunset.

Evening

At 06:00 PM, enjoy a fresh barbecue seafood dinner at a local restaurant.

Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 3: MUI NE SUNRISE TOUR – HO CHI MINH CITY

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Early Morning

At 05:30 AM, the tour guide and driver will pick you up for the sunrise tour.

Visit the White Sand Dunes to watch the sunrise. Optional activities such as quad bike riding, ostrich riding, and sand sliding are available at personal expense.

Return to the hotel for breakfast and free time to swim or relax at the resort.

Midday

At 12:00 PM, check out and have lunch before departing for Ho Chi Minh City.

Late Afternoon

At 05:00 PM, check in at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City. Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market.

DAY 4: VUNG TAU FULL DAY TOUR

Breakfast and lunch included

Morning

At 07:30 AM, depart from the hotel for Vung Tau City.

At 10:00 AM, arrive in Vung Tau and enjoy free time at Thuy Van Beach, also known as Back Beach, one of the most beautiful beaches in Vietnam with a coastline of nearly ten kilometers.

Noon

Have an authentic Vietnamese lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon

Visit the Jesus Christ Statue by walking up eight hundred and forty seven steps to reach the thirty two meter tall statue.

Adventurous visitors may climb inside the statue’s arms to enjoy panoramic views of Vung Tau City.

Visit Thang Tam Temple, also known as the Whale Temple, which reflects the coastal belief in the whale as a protector deity.

Continue to Bach Dinh, a colonial era mansion built in the early twentieth century as a retreat for the French Governor of Indochina.

Visit Cape Nghinh Phong, a scenic cliff area offering wide views of the city and the East Sea.

Evening

At 05:00 PM, return to Ho Chi Minh City.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 5: HO CHI MINH CITY DEPARTURE

Breakfast included

After breakfast, pick up at the hotel and transfer to the airport.

TOUR INCLUSIONS

  • Private car pickup and drop off
  • English speaking tour guide
  • Three local lunches and one dinner
  • Entrance tickets to attractions
  • Four nights accommodation in three star hotels

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

  • Jeep service at sand dunes
  • Value added tax
  • Personal expenses
  • Visa fees
tours.titleZh: 胡志明市—美奈—头顿游
tours.summaryZh: 这趟五天四晚之旅（胡志明市 – 美奈 – 头顿）带您平衡地游览越南南部，融合了繁华的都市生活、海岸风光、沙丘、海滩和文化地标……
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟五天四晚之旅（胡志明市 – 美奈 – 头顿之旅） 带您平衡地游览越南南部，融合了繁华的都市生活、海岸风光、沙丘、海滩和文化地标。旅行者将体验胡志明市的精华景点、美奈的自然之美以及头顿的海滨魅力，享有舒适的交通、导游讲解观光和地道的当地美食。

价格：每人338美元

以2人成团为基准

详细行程

第1天：胡志明市市区游

含午餐

上午

导游到机场接您，并送您前往胡志明市市中心。

中午

在当地餐厅享用午餐，品尝越南牛肉汤粉（Phở）。

下午

参观胡志明市人民委员会大楼，漫步阮惠步行街。在咖啡公寓（Coffee Apartment）停留，品尝传统越南咖啡。

继续参观粉红教堂，这是市内最著名的建筑地标之一，建于19世纪中叶，采用欧式建筑风格，以独特的粉红色外墙闻名。

参观西贡中央邮局，这是欧洲新古典主义建筑与亚洲装饰元素相结合的杰出典范。

观赏红教堂（圣母大教堂），它采用古典法式建筑风格，因其文化、历史和宗教意义而闻名。

晚上

自由活动，探索酒店附近的滨城夜市。

夜宿胡志明市。

第2天：胡志明市 – 美奈日落之旅

含早餐、午餐和晚餐

夜宿美奈

上午

酒店接客，出发前往美奈。车程约四小时。

中午

在当地餐厅享用午餐。入住酒店并休息。

下午

下午03:15从酒店出发观光。

参观仙泉（Suối Tiên），这是一处热门的拍照地点，以红、白、橙、粉等五彩斑斓的沙地景观而闻名。

参观渔村，观察当地渔民的日常生活，包括渔船出海归来和家人们分拣渔获。

参观红沙丘，这里平缓的沙坡与鲜艳的红沙营造出绝佳的拍照机会，尤其是在日落时分。

晚上

下午06:00在当地餐厅享用新鲜的海鲜烧烤晚餐。

晚上自由活动。

夜宿美奈。

第3天：美奈日出之旅 – 胡志明市

含早餐和午餐

夜宿胡志明市

清晨

上午05:30，导游和司机接您前往观赏日出。

前往白沙丘观赏日出。可自费参加四轮沙滩车、骑鸵鸟和滑沙等自选活动。

返回酒店享用早餐，然后自由活动，可在度假村游泳或放松。

正午

中午12:00退房并享用午餐，随后出发前往胡志明市。

傍晚

下午05:00，入住胡志明市酒店。自由活动，探索滨城夜市。

第4天：头顿全日游

含早餐和午餐

上午

上午07:30从酒店出发前往头顿市。

上午10:00抵达头顿，在水云海滩（Thùy Vân，又称后滩）自由活动，这里是越南最美的海滩之一，海岸线长近十公里。

中午

在当地餐厅享用地道的越南午餐。

下午

参观耶稣基督像，需步行登上八百四十七级台阶，抵达这座高三十二米的雕像。

爱冒险的游客可以爬进雕像的手臂内部，欣赏头顿市的全景。

参观胜三庙（Thắng Tam），又称鲸鱼庙，体现了沿海居民将鲸鱼视为守护神的信仰。

继续前往白殿（Bạch Dinh），这是一座建于20世纪初的殖民时期宅邸，曾是法属印度支那总督的度假别墅。

参观迎风角（Nghinh Phong），这是一处风景秀丽的悬崖区域，可远眺城市和东海的辽阔景色。

晚上

下午05:00返回胡志明市。

夜宿胡志明市。

第5天：胡志明市送机

含早餐

早餐后，酒店接客并送往机场。

团费包含

  • 私人车辆接送
  • 英语导游
  • 三顿当地午餐和一顿晚餐
  • 景点门票
  • 四晚三星级酒店住宿

团费不包含

  • 沙丘吉普车服务
  • 增值税
  • 个人开销
  • 签证费用

tours.title: DISCOVER NHA TRANG BEACH MUN ISLAND – FISHING VILLAGE – MINI BEACH
tours.summary: Explore the beauty of Nha Trang Bay with Vietlook Travel on this exciting island-hopping tour. Swim in crystal-clear waters, snorkel among colorful coral reefs, experience local life at a floating fishing village, and re
tours.contentHtml:
Explore the beauty of Nha Trang Bay with Vietlook Travel on this exciting island-hopping tour. Swim in crystal-clear waters, snorkel among colorful coral reefs, experience local life at a floating fishing village, and relax at Mini Beach. Perfect for travelers seeking both adventure and relaxation.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Car and professional English-speaking tour guide pick you up at the meeting point.

Board a speed canoe to begin the island tour.

MUN ISLAND

09:15
Arrive at Mun Island.

Free time to swim, snorkel, and admire colorful coral reefs.

Swimming goggles and snorkels are provided.

Optional water activities are available at your own expense, such as jet ski, parasailing, scuba diving, sea walking, banana boat, and more.

FISHING VILLAGE

11:30
Visit the floating fishing village.

Enjoy lunch at a raft restaurant (lunch included in the tour).

The floating wooden raft restaurant features live tanks and nets filled with fish, lobster, crabs, and mussels (additional seafood may incur extra charges).

After lunch, free time to rest and relax.

MINI BEACH

12:30
Arrive at Mini Beach.

Free time to swim, relax, and enjoy the sea.

Optional water activities are available at your own expense, such as parasailing, jet ski, banana boat, and more.

15:30 – 16:00
Return to the mainland by canoe. End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 32

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Hotel pick-up by car

  • Speed canoe transportation

  • Lunch at the island

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Bottled water

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional activities outside the program

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children under 1 meter: Free of charge

  • From 1m to 1.29m: 70% of adult price

  • From 1.29m and above: Adult price applies
tours.titleZh: 芽庄海滩探索：木岛—渔村—迷你海滩
tours.summaryZh: 跟随Vietlook Travel踏上精彩的跳岛之旅，探索芽庄湾之美。在清澈的海水中畅游，在珊瑚礁间浮潜，体验水上渔村的当地生活，并在Mini Beach放松身心。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
跟随Vietlook Travel踏上这趟精彩的跳岛之旅，探索芽庄湾之美。在清澈见底的海水中畅游，在色彩斑斓的珊瑚礁间浮潜，体验水上渔村的当地生活，并在Mini Beach放松身心。非常适合既想冒险又想休闲的旅行者。

行程安排

08:00 – 08:30
车辆和专业英语导游在集合点接您。

登上快艇，开启海岛之旅。

Mun岛（黑岛）

09:15
抵达Mun岛。

自由活动时间，可游泳、浮潜，欣赏色彩缤纷的珊瑚礁。

提供泳镜和浮潜呼吸管。

tours.title: HO CHI MINH CITY TO MUI NE ONE DAY TOUR
tours.summary: Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne One Day Tour offers travelers a chance to explore some of the most beautiful natural landscapes in southern Vietnam within a single day. This tour is ideal for visitors who enjoy nature, photog
tours.contentHtml:
Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne One Day Tour offers travelers a chance to explore some of the most beautiful natural landscapes in southern Vietnam within a single day. This tour is ideal for visitors who enjoy nature, photography, and light adventure activities.

During the journey, you will discover white and red sand dunes, a peaceful lake in the middle of the desert, a unique stream flowing through colorful sand formations, and the authentic daily life of local fishermen. The tour combines scenic views, cultural experiences, and leisure time, making it a memorable getaway from the city.

ITINERARY

07:00 – 07:30

Pick up at the airport or hotel in Ho Chi Minh City by private car.

11:00 – 13:30

Arrive in Mui Ne and visit Bau Trang.

Bau Trang, A Mystical Lake among White Sand Dunes

Bau Trang is one of the most beautiful natural attractions in Mui Ne. The lake is famous for its clear turquoise water surrounded by vast white sand dunes, creating a peaceful and impressive landscape.

Visitors can enjoy the fresh air, admire panoramic views, and take memorable photographs. Optional activities such as boat rides on the lake are available. The contrast between the blue water and white sand makes Bau Trang an ideal destination for photography lovers.

13:00

Have lunch at a local restaurant.

14:30

Visit Suoi Tien.

Suoi Tien, A Turquoise Stream in the Sand Dunes

Suoi Tien is a unique natural site where a shallow stream flows through red sand dunes. The bright turquoise water contrasts beautifully with the warm red sand, creating a rare and striking landscape.

Walking along the stream allows visitors to enjoy the natural scenery and observe fascinating rock formations shaped by wind and water. The area offers a calm and visually impressive experience.

16:00

Visit Mui Ne Fishing Village

Stop at the fishing village to take photos and observe the daily life of local fishermen. This area provides insight into the traditional coastal lifestyle of Mui Ne.

16:30

Visit the Red Sand Dunes and watch the sunset.

Red Sand Dunes, A Land of Vibrant Colors

The Red Sand Dunes are one of the most famous attractions in Mui Ne. The dunes are known for their warm red and orange tones, which become especially beautiful during sunset.

Visitors can walk on the dunes, enjoy the scenery, and take photos. Optional sand sliding activities are available at personal expense.

17:00

Depart Mui Ne and return to Ho Chi Minh City.

20:00 – 20:30

Arrive back at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City.

TOUR INCLUSIONS

Private car pickup and drop off

English speaking tour guide

Local lunch

Entrance tickets to attractions

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

Jeep service at sand dunes

Value added tax

Personal expenses
tours.titleZh: 胡志明市至美奈一日游
tours.summaryZh: 胡志明市至美奈一日游让旅行者有机会在一天之内探索越南南部一些最美丽的自然风光。这个行程非常适合喜爱大自然、摄影和轻度探险活动的游客。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
胡志明市至 美奈一日游 让旅行者有机会在一天之内探索越南南部一些最美丽的自然风光。这个行程非常适合喜爱大自然、摄影和轻度探险活动的游客。

旅途中，您将发现白沙丘和红沙丘、沙漠中央宁静的湖泊、流经彩色沙层的独特溪流，以及当地渔民的地道日常生活。行程融合了风景观赏、文化体验和休闲时光，是一次难忘的都市出逃之旅。

行程安排

07:00 – 07:30

乘坐专车在胡志明市机场或酒店接客。

11:00 – 13:30

抵达美奈，参观白湖（Bau Trang）。

白湖，白沙丘间的神秘湖泊

白湖是美奈最美丽的自然景点之一。湖水清澈碧绿，四周被广阔的白沙丘环绕，构成宁静而令人印象深刻的景观。

游客可以呼吸新鲜空气，欣赏全景，拍下难忘的照片。可选择在湖上划船等活动。蓝色湖水与白色沙丘形成的对比，使白湖成为摄影爱好者的理想目的地。

13:00

在当地餐厅享用午餐。

14:30

参观仙女溪（Suoi Tien）。

仙女溪，沙丘中的碧绿溪流

仙女溪是一处独特的自然景点，浅浅的溪水流经红沙丘。明亮的碧绿溪水与温暖的红沙形成美丽的对比，构成罕见而醒目的景观。

沿着小溪漫步，游客可以欣赏自然风光，观察由风和水塑造的迷人岩层。这一区域带来平静而视觉震撼的体验。

16:00

参观美奈渔村

在渔村停留，拍照并观察当地渔民的日常生活。这里让您深入了解美奈传统的沿海生活方式。

16:30

参观红沙丘并观赏日落。

红沙丘，色彩绚丽的土地

红沙丘是美奈最著名的景点之一。沙丘以温暖的红色和橙色调著称，在日落时分尤为美丽。

游客可以在沙丘上漫步，欣赏风景并拍照。可选的滑沙活动需自费。

17:00

离开美奈，返回胡志明市。

20:00 – 20:30

返回胡志明市酒店。

行程包含

专车接送

英语导游

当地午餐

景点门票

行程不含

沙丘吉普车服务

增值税

个人开销

tours.title: VUNG TAU 1 DAY TRIP
tours.summary: Explore Vung Tau with Vietlook Travel, relax at beautiful beaches, visit spiritual landmarks, and enjoy panoramic views of the city on this full day tour. TOUR OVERVIEW Duration: 1 day | Departure: 7:00 – 7:30 to 18:00 |
tours.contentHtml:
Explore Vung Tau with Vietlook Travel, relax at beautiful beaches, visit spiritual landmarks, and enjoy panoramic views of the city on this full day tour.

TOUR OVERVIEW

Duration: 1 day | Departure: 7:00 – 7:30 to 18:00 | Transportation: Bus

Morning (07:20 AM): Pick up from your hotel and depart for Vung Tau (approximately 3 hours driving).

THUY VAN BEACH (BAI SAU): On arrival, enjoy leisure time at Thuy Van Beach (Back Beach) – one of the most beautiful beaches in Vietnam, stretching almost 10 km with fine sand and gentle waves. Take a swim or simply relax and enjoy the sea breeze.

Noon: Enjoy authentic Vietnamese lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon:

  • JESUS CHRIST STATUE: Visit this miniature version of Brazil’s Cristo Redentor. Climb inside and admire the entire Bai Sau beach area and part of Vung Tau city from the statue’s arms.

  • DINH THANG TAM (WHALE TEMPLE): Discover the spiritual and cultural significance of Whale Temple, a sacred place for local fishermen. Visitors come here to pray for safety, peace, and prosperity.

  • BACH DINH (White Palace): Explore this ancient French-style villa, magnificently built on the mountainside of Vung Tau.

  • NGHINH PHONG CAPE: Visit one of the top must-see spots in Vung Tau, known for its “front sea, back mountain” scenery. A popular place for photos and sightseeing.

Please note: Drop-off time may vary due to traffic or weather conditions, so the tour may end later than expected.

Price/pax: 40$

TOUR INCLUDES:

  • Transportation: Air-conditioned tourist bus with soft seats

  • Meals: 1 main meal (lunch)

  • Guide: Vietnamese-English speaking tour guide

  • Sightseeing: Entrance fees to attractions listed in the program

  • Service: 1 bottle of mineral water per person

TOUR EXCLUDES:

  • Personal expenses outside the program

  • VAT 10% (upon request)

CHILDREN POLICY:

  • Under 5 years old: Free, parents take care of the child themselves (two adults accompany 1 child; the 2nd child pays 75% of tour price)

  • 5–9 years old: 75% of ticket price (includes meal, entrance fees, private seat)

  • 10 years and above: Charged as adult ticket price

Note: 1 adult + 1 child booking counts as 2 adults for the tour.

tours.contentHtmlZh:
与Vietlook Travel一起探索头顿，在美丽的海滩放松身心，参观灵性地标，并在这趟全日游中欣赏城市全景。

上午（07:20）：酒店接您出发，前往头顿（车程约3小时）。

翠云海滩（后滩，BÃI SAU）：抵达后，在翠云海滩（后滩）享受悠闲时光——这是越南最美的海滩之一，绵延近10公里，沙质细腻，海浪轻柔。您可以下海游泳，或只是静享海风。

tours.title: CU CHI TUNNELS – MY THO – BEN TRE – UNICORN ISLAND
tours.summary: This full day tour Vietlook Travel is perfect for travelers interested in Vietnam’s history and culture, as well as those who want to explore the Mekong Delta on a day trip from Ho Chi Minh City. The tour visits two main
tours.contentHtml:
This full day tour Vietlook Travel is perfect for travelers interested in Vietnam’s history and culture, as well as those who want to explore the Mekong Delta on a day trip from Ho Chi Minh City. The tour visits two main destinations: the Cu Chi Tunnels, an extraordinary historical site, and the Mekong Delta, known for its scenic rivers, islands, and traditional villages.

MORNING – CU CHI TUNNELS

7:15 AM: The bus and English speaking tour guide will pick you up at the meeting point and depart for the Cu Chi Tunnels, located 70 kilometers west of Ho Chi Minh City.

The Cu Chi Tunnel system was built by the National Front for the Liberation of South Vietnam during the Indochina War and the Vietnam War. The network includes an infirmary, living quarters, kitchens, storage rooms, working areas, and over 200 kilometers of underground tunnels with bush-covered ventilation systems. During the 1968 Tet Offensive, the tunnels were strategically used for guerrilla attacks on Saigon.

During the visit, you will:

  • Learn how Vietnamese guerrillas built, lived, and fought in these tunnels.

  • Watch documentary footage showcasing the Vietnamese resistance during the war.

  • See primitive homemade weapons, bamboo traps, and other guerrilla tools.

  • Optionally crawl through safe tunnel sections to experience tunnel life.

  • Observe local people making rice paper and rice wine.

  • Optionally try shooting at the on-site AK-47 shooting range (extra fee).

NOON – MEKONG DELTA REGION

11:30 AM: Depart Cu Chi Tunnels and travel toward the Mekong Delta.

  • Arrive at My Tho Cruise Port and board a boat on the Tien River. Cruise along the river, passing the floating fish farms and Rach Mieu Bridge, and enjoy views of four islands: Long, Lan, Qui, and Phung.

  • Stop at Thoi Son Island (Lan Island) to explore village roads, visit local homes and fruit gardens, take souvenir photos, and see the honey bee farm and taste honey tea. Visit the coconut candy factory.

  • Enjoy Don Ca Tai Tu traditional music while sampling fresh fruit.

  • Use small rowing boats to explore narrow canals, admire rows of coconut trees and the peaceful riverine landscape.

  • Lunch at a local Vietnamese restaurant around 2:00 PM.

AFTERNOON – RETURN TO HO CHI MINH CITY

5:00 PM: Return to My Tho by boat and depart for Ho Chi Minh City.

7:00 PM: Arrive in Ho Chi Minh City. Drop off at Pham Ngu Lao Street or Ben Thanh Market. Tour ends with farewell from your guide.

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Pick-up and drop-off at selected hotels in Central District One only

  • Air-conditioned bus transportation

  • Motor boat trip on the Mekong River

  • Small rowing boat exploration

  • Mineral water served on the bus

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Vietnamese cuisine lunch

  • All entrance fees

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • AK-47 shooting fee

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips (optional)

Price per person: 34$

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children from 1 meter to under 1.4 meters: 75% of the adult ticket price, with seats provided.

  • Children under 1 meter: free of charge, sit on parents’ lap (two adults may accompany one free child). From the second child onward, 75% of ticket price applies.

  • Children 1.4 meters and above: full adult ticket required.
tours.titleZh: 古芝地道—美托—槟椥—麒麟岛
tours.summaryZh: 这趟Vietlook Travel全天行程非常适合对越南历史和文化感兴趣的旅行者，也适合想从胡志明市出发一日游探索湄公河三角洲的游客。行程游览两大目的地
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟Vietlook Travel全天行程非常适合对越南历史和文化感兴趣的旅行者，也适合想从胡志明市出发一日游探索湄公河三角洲的游客。行程游览两大目的地：古芝地道——一处非凡的历史遗址，以及湄公河三角洲——以风景如画的河流、岛屿和传统村落闻名。

上午 – 古芝地道

上午7:15：巴士和英语导游在集合地点接您，出发前往位于胡志明市以西70公里的古芝地道。

古芝地道系统由南越民族解放阵线在印度支那战争和越南战争期间修建。该地道网络包括医务室、生活区、厨房、储藏室、工作区，以及200多公里长、带有灌木覆盖通风系统的地下隧道。在1968年春节攻势期间，这些地道被战略性地用于对西贡发动游击袭击。

参观期间，您将：

  • 了解越南游击队如何在这些地道中修建、生活和战斗。

  • 观看展示战争期间越南抵抗运动的纪录片。

  • 参观原始的自制武器、竹制陷阱和其他游击工具。

  • 可自选爬行穿过安全的地道路段，体验地道生活。

  • 观察当地人制作米纸和米酒。

  • 可自选体验现场的AK-47射击场（需另付费）。

中午 – 湄公河三角洲地区

上午11:30：离开古芝地道，前往湄公河三角洲。

  • 抵达美拖游船码头，登上前江游船。沿河巡游，途经水上渔排和Rạch Miễu大桥，欣赏龙、麟、龟、凤四个岛屿的风光。

  • 在Thới Sơn岛（麟岛）停留，漫步村路，参观当地民居和果园，拍摄纪念照，参观养蜂场并品尝蜂蜜茶。参观椰子糖工厂。

  • 一边品尝新鲜水果，一边欣赏传统音乐Đờn ca tài tử。

  • 乘坐小划艇探索狭窄的水道，欣赏成排的椰树和宁静的水乡风光。

  • 下午2:00左右在当地越南餐厅享用午餐。

下午 – 返回胡志明市

下午5:00：乘船返回美拖，出发前往胡志明市。

晚上7:00：抵达胡志明市。在范五老街或滨城市场下车。行程结束，导游道别。

  • 湄公河机动船游览

  • 巴士上提供矿泉水

  • 专业英语导游

  • 越南风味午餐

  • 所有门票

费用不含

  • AK-47射击费用

  • 个人消费

  • 小费（自愿）
