tours.title: SAIGON SIGHTSEEING AND CRAFT BEER TOUR
tours.summary: Experience Saigon like a local with Vietlook Travel, combining sightseeing, street food, and craft beer in a fun and authentic way. Highlights / Itinerary Bún Bò Huế – Central Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup: Taste the famou
tours.contentHtml:
Experience Saigon like a local with Vietlook Travel, combining sightseeing, street food, and craft beer in a fun and authentic way.

Highlights / Itinerary

  • Bún Bò Huế – Central Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup: Taste the famous spicy beef noodle soup from Hue, made with tender beef, round rice vermicelli, special broth cooked for hours, and a variety of fresh herbs.

  • Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment: Step into one of the oldest apartments in Saigon (built in 1968) to experience the authentic daily life of locals.

  • District 10 Flower Market: Try your hand at making a lotus flower (Vietnam’s national flower) and learn about local traditions of buying and using flowers.

  • Cambodia Market – Famous Street Food Area: Walk through this lively food area, enjoy authentic street food, and see how locals hang out.

  • Bia Sệt – Frozen Beer: Try the local specialty beer in a unique frozen style.

tours.summary: The Elephant Cave and Ma Da Valley Jungle Trek is a perfect one day adventure for nature lovers seeking peace, discovery, and a touch of adventure. Trek deep into Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park, explore Elephant Cave,
tours.contentHtml:
The Elephant Cave and Ma Da Valley Jungle Trek is a perfect one day adventure for nature lovers seeking peace, discovery, and a touch of adventure.

Trek deep into Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park, explore Elephant Cave, swim in the crystal-clear waters of Ma Da Valley and Tra Ang Cave, and enjoy a nutritious jungle BBQ lunch.

This tour is suitable for everyone over 9 years old under adult supervision. It offers a moderate trekking challenge while allowing you to experience the jungle, rivers, caves, and local culture of Phong Nha.

For travelers seeking more adventure, consider the Pygmy Exploration 2 Days 1 Night. For easier options, there are tours like Paradise Cave & Phong Nha Cave or Dark Cave and Paradise Cave, all part of our Phong Nha Tours.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:30 – Briefing on environmental protection, safety rules, and trekking preparation.

08:45 – Depart for the trail to start the jungle trek.

10:00 – 11:00 – Trek to Elephant Cave. Explore the 60-meter-high, 300-meter-long cave and learn about its history from your guide.

12:00 – 12:45 – Trek to Ma Da Valley and Crystal Lake. Swim in the cool blue waters and enjoy a BBQ lunch with local dishes. Vegetarian options available upon request.

14:00 – 15:00 – Continue trekking to Tra Ang Cave.

15:45 – 16:30 – Swim 600 meters inside Tra Ang Cave, explore the cave’s interior, and enjoy the unique jungle experience.

17:00 – 17:30 – Trek back to the trailhead and enjoy a cold drink (beer or soda) before returning.

17:30 – Private car returns you to your hotel or homestay in Phong Nha.

tours.title: HO CHI MINH CITY HALF DAY TOUR MORNING
tours.summary: This half day morning tour is a perfect introduction to Ho Chi Minh City. In a short amount of time, you will visit the city’s most famous historical and cultural landmarks, gaining insight into Viet Nam’s past, architec
tours.contentHtml:
This half day morning tour is a perfect introduction to Ho Chi Minh City. In a short amount of time, you will visit the city’s most famous historical and cultural landmarks, gaining insight into Viet Nam’s past, architecture, and daily life. This tour is ideal for travelers with limited time who still want to experience the highlights of Saigon.

MORNING CITY TOUR

The bus and English-speaking tour guide will pick you up at the meeting point or selected hotels in Central District One. The tour then begins with visits to the most well-known landmarks of Saigon.

INDEPENDENCE PALACE

Visit the Independence Palace, an important architectural complex and historical site of Viet Nam. This landmark played a significant role in modern Vietnamese history and is closely associated with the end of the war in 1975.

NOTRE DAME CATHEDRAL (OUTSIDE VISIT ONLY)

Visit Notre Dame Cathedral, one of the most iconic symbols of Ho Chi Minh City. Construction began in 1877 and was completed in 1880. The cathedral represents Catholicism in Viet Nam and is a fine example of French colonial architecture.
Please note: The cathedral is currently under restoration, so guests can only visit and take photos from outside.

HO CHI MINH CITY POST OFFICE

Continue to the Ho Chi Minh City Post Office, built between 1886 and 1891 by French architect Gustave Eiffel. This historic building is well known for its classic architectural style, decorative details, and distinctive yellow color. It is a popular photo stop for visitors.

WAR REMNANTS MUSEUM

Next, visit the War Remnants Museum, which displays valuable historical artifacts from the Nguyen Dynasty to the two Indochina wars. The museum offers an informative and moving insight into Viet Nam’s wartime history.

END OF TOUR AND LUNCH

At noon, the bus will take you to a local restaurant for lunch (optional). After lunch, you will be transferred back to the meeting point, ending the tour.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Return time may vary depending on traffic conditions and weather.

  • Notre Dame Cathedral is under restoration; visits are outside only.

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Air-conditioned bus or van

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Mineral water

  • Entrance fees

  • Lunch (optional)

  • Pick-up from selected hotels in Central District One only

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Price per person: 18$

CHILDREN POLICY

Children from one meter to under one meter and forty centimeters in height are charged seventy-five percent of the adult price and will have their own seat.

Children under one meter in height are free of charge and must sit on their parents’ lap. Two adults may accompany one free child. From the second child onward, the charge is seventy-five percent of the ticket price.

Children from one meter and forty centimeters in height and above are charged the full adult price.

tours.summaryZh: 这趟上午半日游是认识胡志明市的绝佳入门之旅。在短短的时间里，您将参观这座城市最著名的历史文化地标，了解越南的过去、建筑与日常生活。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟上午半日游是认识胡志明市的绝佳入门之旅。在短短的时间里，您将参观这座城市最著名的历史文化地标，了解越南的过去、建筑与日常生活。这趟行程非常适合时间有限、却仍想领略西贡精华的旅行者。

上午市区游

巴士和英语导游将在集合点或第一郡市中心的指定酒店接您。随后行程将从参观西贡最著名的地标开始。

统一宫（独立宫）

参观统一宫，这是越南重要的建筑群和历史遗迹。这座地标在越南现代史上具有重要地位，与1975年战争的结束密切相关。

西贡圣母大教堂（仅限外观参观）

参观西贡圣母大教堂，这是胡志明市最具代表性的象征之一。教堂于1877年动工，1880年竣工，代表了天主教在越南的存在，也是法国殖民时期建筑的杰出范例。
请注意：教堂目前正在修缮中，因此游客只能在外面参观和拍照。

胡志明市中心邮局

继续前往胡志明市中心邮局，由法国建筑师古斯塔夫·埃菲尔设计，建于1886年至1891年之间。这座历史建筑以其经典的建筑风格、精美的装饰细节和独特的黄色外观而闻名，是游客喜爱的拍照点。

战争遗迹博物馆

接下来参观战争遗迹博物馆，馆内陈列着从阮朝到两次印度支那战争的珍贵历史文物。博物馆让您深入、动容地了解越南的战争历史。

行程结束与午餐

中午，巴士将送您到当地餐厅用午餐（可选）。午餐后送您返回集合点，行程结束。

tours.title: HO CHI MINH CITY TOUR AND CU CHI TUNNELS ONE DAY TOUR
tours.summary: This full day tour combines the highlights of Ho Chi Minh City with a meaningful visit to the Cu Chi Tunnels. In one day, you will explore important historical landmarks in the city and then travel to the famous undergro
tours.contentHtml:
This full day tour combines the highlights of Ho Chi Minh City with a meaningful visit to the Cu Chi Tunnels. In one day, you will explore important historical landmarks in the city and then travel to the famous underground tunnel system that played a vital role during the war. The tour is ideal for travelers who want a comprehensive introduction to Saigon and its history.

MORNING: HO CHI MINH CITY TOUR

Your guide and vehicle will pick you up at the meeting point in District One. The morning is dedicated to visiting some of the most famous landmarks in Ho Chi Minh City.

INDEPENDENCE PALACE

Visit the Independence Palace, a well-known architectural complex and a significant historical site of Viet Nam. This building played an important role during the country’s modern history and is a symbol of the end of the war in 1975.

NOTRE DAME CATHEDRAL (OUTSIDE VISIT ONLY)

Visit Notre Dame Cathedral, one of the most iconic landmarks of Ho Chi Minh City. Construction began in 1877 and was completed in 1880. The cathedral is a symbol of Catholicism in Viet Nam and a remarkable example of French colonial architecture.

Please note: The cathedral is currently under restoration, so guests can only visit and take photos from outside.

HO CHI MINH CITY POST OFFICE

Next, visit the Ho Chi Minh City Post Office, built between 1886 and 1891 by French architect Gustave Eiffel. This historic building is famous for its classic architecture, decorative details, and distinctive yellow color. It is one of the most popular check-in spots in the city.

WAR REMNANTS MUSEUM

Continue to the War Remnants Museum, where you will see valuable historical artifacts related to the Nguyen Dynasty and the two Indochina wars. The museum offers a deeper understanding of the impact of war on Viet Nam and its people.

NOON: LUNCH BREAK

The bus will take you to a local restaurant for lunch. After lunch, you will have a short break before continuing the afternoon program.

AFTERNOON: CU CHI TUNNELS EXPERIENCE

After lunch, the tour continues with a journey to the Cu Chi Tunnels, located approximately one and a half hours northwest of Ho Chi Minh City. This vast underground network was built during the 1940s and 1960s to resist French and American forces.

LAM PHAT LACQUERWARE WORKSHOP

On the way, stop at Lam Phat, a lacquerware workshop that employs people with disabilities, many of whom were affected by the long-term consequences of war such as Agent Orange. This visit offers a meaningful opportunity to learn about traditional craftsmanship and support local artisans.

BEN DINH SECTION – CU CHI TUNNELS

Upon arrival, explore the Ben Dinh section of the Cu Chi Tunnels. This area was part of the two-hundred-and-fifty-kilometer tunnel system used during the Resistance War Against America (1955–1975) and served as an important base for guerrilla operations in the Saigon region.

HIGHLIGHTS AT CU CHI TUNNELS

DOCUMENTARY AND EXHIBITS

Watch a short documentary about the history and role of the Cu Chi Tunnels during the war. You will also see displays of handmade weapons, bamboo traps, and tools used by the Viet Cong.

TUNNEL LIFE

Learn how guerrilla fighters dug the tunnels and lived underground, including daily life, medical care, and command operations under constant bombardment.

STRENGTH OF WILL

Discover how determination, creativity, and ingenuity helped the Viet Cong resist advanced American weaponry through hidden trapdoors, camouflage techniques, and booby traps.

TUNNEL CRAWLING (OPTIONAL)

Guests may crawl through a safe and widened section of the tunnels to experience the narrow and confined conditions faced by the fighters. This activity is optional.

SHOOTING RANGE (OPTIONAL, EXTRA FEE)

Try firing an AK-47 rifle at the on-site shooting range. The cost is approximately 26$, bullets are not included and this activity is not part of the tour price.

TASTE HISTORY

Sample steamed cassava, a simple staple food eaten by guerrilla fighters during the war, usually served with salt and peanuts.

END OF TOUR

At around 17:30, depart from Cu Chi and return to District One.
The tour ends upon arrival.

tours.titleZh: 胡志明市区与古芝地道一日游
tours.summaryZh: 这条全天游将胡志明市的精华与富有意义的古芝地道之旅结合在一起。一天之内，您将探访城市中重要的历史地标，然后前往在战争中发挥关键作用的著名地下隧道系统。本行程非常适合想全面了解西贡及其历史的旅行者。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这条全天游将 胡志明市 的精华与富有意义的古芝地道之旅结合在一起。一天之内，您将探访城市中重要的历史地标，然后前往在战争中发挥关键作用的著名地下隧道系统。本行程非常适合想全面了解西贡及其历史的旅行者。

上午：胡志明市市区游览

导游和车辆将在第一郡的集合地点接您。上午将参观胡志明市一些最著名的地标。

统一宫（独立宫）

参观统一宫，这是一处著名的建筑群，也是越南重要的历史遗址。这座建筑在国家近代史上扮演了重要角色，是1975年战争结束的象征。

西贡圣母大教堂（仅限外部参观）

参观圣母大教堂，这是胡志明市最具标志性的地标之一。教堂于1877年开工，1880年竣工。它是越南天主教的象征，也是法国殖民建筑的杰出典范。

请注意：教堂目前正在修缮，游客只能在外部参观和拍照。

胡志明市中心邮局

接着参观胡志明市中心邮局，由法国建筑师古斯塔夫·埃菲尔于1886年至1891年间建造。这座历史建筑以经典的建筑风格、装饰细节和独特的黄色外观而闻名，是城市中最受欢迎的打卡点之一。

战争遗迹博物馆

继续前往战争遗迹博物馆，您将看到与阮朝及两次印度支那战争相关的珍贵历史文物。博物馆让您更深入了解战争对越南及其人民的影响。

中午：午餐休息

巴士将带您前往当地餐厅用午餐。午餐后稍作休息，然后继续下午的行程。

下午：古芝地道体验

午餐后，行程继续前往古芝地道，位于胡志明市西北方向约一个半小时车程处。这一庞大的地下网络建于20世纪40年代至60年代，用于抵抗法国和美国军队。

林发(Lam Phát)漆器作坊

途中停靠林发漆器作坊，这里雇用残障人士，其中许多人受到橙剂等战争长期后果的影响。这次参观让您有机会了解传统手工艺并支持当地工匠，意义非凡。

边定(Bến Đình)段——古芝地道

抵达后，探索古芝地道的边定段。该区域是抗美救国战争（1955–1975）期间使用的全长二百五十公里隧道系统的一部分，是西贡地区游击作战的重要基地。

古芝地道亮点

纪录片与展品

观看一部关于古芝地道历史及其在战争中作用的短片。您还将看到手工制造的武器、竹制陷阱以及越共使用的工具展示。

地道生活

了解游击队员如何挖掘隧道并在地下生活，包括在持续轰炸下的日常生活、医疗救护和指挥行动。

意志的力量

探索决心、创造力和智慧如何帮助越共通过隐蔽的活板门、伪装技术和陷阱抵御先进的美国武器。

爬地道（自选）

游客可以爬过一段安全、经过拓宽的隧道，体验战士们所面临的狭窄、封闭环境。此项活动为自选。

射击场（自选，需额外付费）

在现场射击场体验射击AK-47步枪。费用约26美元，不含子弹，此活动不包含在团费内。

品尝历史

品尝蒸木薯，这是战争期间游击队员食用的一种简单主食，通常配盐和花生。

行程结束

大约17:30，从古芝出发返回第一郡。
抵达后行程结束。

请注意：送达时间可能因交通状况、天气或其他因素而有所不同。

  • 英语导游

  • 矿泉水

  • 门票

  • 仅限第一郡市中心部分酒店接客

行程不含

  • 个人消费

身高一米至一米四十厘米以下的儿童，收取成人票价的百分之七十五，并拥有独立座位。

身高一米以下的儿童免费，须坐在父母腿上。两位成人可携带一名免费儿童。从第二名儿童起，收取票价的百分之七十五。

身高一米四十厘米及以上的儿童，按成人全价收费。

tours.title: DISCOVER HOI AN CRAFT VILLAGES – PRESERVING TRADITIONAL CULTURE
tours.summary: This tour offers a unique opportunity to explore Hoi An’s traditional craft villages, where centuries-old skills are preserved and passed down through generations. Immerse yourself in creativity, culture, and local life,
tours.contentHtml:
This tour offers a unique opportunity to explore Hoi An’s traditional craft villages, where centuries-old skills are preserved and passed down through generations. Immerse yourself in creativity, culture, and local life, and bring home handmade souvenirs crafted with your own hands.

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Thanh Ha Pottery Village – Over 500 years of history; visit the workshops, try making your own pottery, and take home a unique souvenir

  • Kim Bong Carpentry Village – Witness talented artisans create exquisite wood carvings and feel the vitality in every handmade piece

  • Tra Que Vegetable Village – Experience life as a local farmer, plowing the soil, growing fresh vegetables, and enjoying dishes made from garden-fresh ingredients

  • Hoi An Lantern Village – Learn the art of lantern making, a symbolic craft of Hoi An, and create a meaningful keepsake

ITINERARY

  • Morning: Hotel pick-up by Vietlook Travel guide. Travel to Thanh Ha Pottery Village and Kim Bong Carpentry Village.

  • Late morning: Visit Tra Que Vegetable Village. Experience farming life and taste fresh local dishes.

  • Afternoon: Explore Hoi An Lantern Village and participate in a lantern-making workshop.

  • End of tour: Return to your hotel.

Take the time to visit these traditional craft villages to experience the intersection of past and present, and gain a deeper understanding of Hoi An’s cultural heritage.

TOUR PRICE: USD 32 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Air-conditioned coach for hotel pick-up and drop-off

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Entrance fees to all craft villages

  • Hands-on activities: pottery and lantern-making

  • Services not mentioned above

tours.title: CU CHI TUNNELS HALF DAY TOUR
tours.summary: Vietlook Travel is a local tour operator in Viet Nam, specializing in well organized tours for international travelers. We focus on reliable services, experienced tour guides, and friendly customer support to ensure a co
tours.contentHtml:
Vietlook Travel is a local tour operator in Viet Nam, specializing in well organized tours for international travelers. We focus on reliable services, experienced tour guides, and friendly customer support to ensure a comfortable and meaningful travel experience.

Cu Chi Tunnels Half Day Tour is carefully designed to help visitors gain a deeper understanding of Viet Nam’s history, resilience, and wartime ingenuity, while enjoying a smooth and informative journey.

A CAPTIVATING JOURNEY INTO A HIDDEN HISTORICAL MARVEL

Located approximately seventy kilometers northwest of Ho Chi Minh City, the Cu Chi Tunnels are among the most important historical sites in southern Viet Nam. This underground network stretches over two hundred and fifty kilometers and was constructed during the wars against French and American forces.

More than a military structure, the tunnels formed a complete underground living system that included hospitals, meeting rooms, kitchens, storage areas, and secret escape routes. Today, the Cu Chi Tunnels stand as a powerful symbol of determination, survival, and creativity.

TOUR ITINERARY

Your Vietlook Travel guide and vehicle will pick you up from selected hotels in District One. After pick-up, the journey to the Cu Chi Tunnels begins and takes approximately one and a half hours.

LAM PHAT LACQUERWARE WORKSHOP

Along the way, the tour stops at Lam Phat, a local lacquerware workshop that provides employment opportunities for people with disabilities, many of whom were affected by the long-term consequences of war, including Agent Orange. Guests can observe the traditional lacquerware production process and support meaningful local handicrafts.

BEN DINH SECTION – CU CHI TUNNELS

Upon arrival, you will explore the Ben Dinh section of the Cu Chi tunnel system. This area played an important role during the Resistance War Against America from 1955 to 1975 and served as a key base for guerrilla forces operating around the Saigon region.

HIGHLIGHTS AND EXPERIENCES

DOCUMENTARY AND EXHIBITS

Begin with a short documentary film introducing the history and strategic importance of the Cu Chi Tunnels. You will also see displays of homemade weapons, bamboo traps, and tools used during the war.

TUNNEL LIFE

Learn how soldiers lived, worked, and fought underground, including how the tunnels were dug, expanded, and maintained under extremely challenging conditions.

STRENGTH OF WILL

Discover how determination, creativity, and clever tactics helped Vietnamese fighters resist modern military technology.

TUNNEL CRAWLING (OPTIONAL)

Guests may crawl through a safe and widened section of the tunnels to experience the narrow and confined living space once endured by the fighters.

SHOOTING RANGE (OPTIONAL, EXTRA FEE)

Visitors can try firing an AK-47 rifle at the on-site shooting range at an additional cost. This activity is not included in the tour price.

TASTE HISTORY

Enjoy steamed cassava served with salt and peanuts, a simple but essential daily food for guerrilla fighters during the war.

END OF TOUR

After the visit, the bus will return to Ho Chi Minh City and drop guests off at the original pick-up point in District One.

Please note that return times may vary depending on traffic conditions and public holidays.

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Air-conditioned bus or van

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Mineral water

  • Entrance fees

  • Steamed cassava

  • Pick-up and drop-off at selected hotels in District One

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Shooting range fee

  • Personal expenses

CHILDREN POLICY

Children from one meter to under one meter and forty centimeters in height are charged seventy-five percent of the adult price and will have their own seat.

Children under one meter in height are free of charge and must sit on their parents’ lap. Two adults may accompany one free child. From the second child onward, the charge is seventy-five percent of the adult price.

Children from one meter and forty centimeters in height and above are charged the full adult price.

一次探索隐秘历史奇迹的迷人之旅

古芝地道位于胡志明市西北约七十公里处，是越南南部最重要的历史遗址之一。这一地下网络绵延超过两百五十公里，修建于抗法和抗美战争期间。

这些地道不仅仅是军事设施，更是一个完整的地下生活系统，包括医院、会议室、厨房、储藏区和秘密逃生通道。如今，古芝地道已成为决心、生存与创造力的有力象征。

了解战士们如何在地下生活、工作和战斗，包括在极其艰苦的条件下如何挖掘、扩建和维护地道。

了解决心、创造力和机智战术如何帮助越南战士抵抗现代军事技术。

tours.summary: This full day tour takes you to two of Central Vietnam’s most iconic UNESCO World Heritage sites. Explore the mystical My Son Holy Land, the ancient religious sanctuary of the Champa Kingdom, and then stroll through the
tours.contentHtml:
This full day tour takes you to two of Central Vietnam’s most iconic UNESCO World Heritage sites. Explore the mystical My Son Holy Land, the ancient religious sanctuary of the Champa Kingdom, and then stroll through the charming streets of Hoi An Ancient Town, famous for its well preserved architecture, cultural heritage, and peaceful atmosphere.

This tour is perfect for travelers who love history, culture, and authentic local experiences.

ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Driver and English-speaking tour guide from Vietlook Travel pick you up at your hotel. Depart for My Son Holy Land.

09:30
Arrive at My Son Holy Land – a unique sanctuary of the ancient Cham civilization.

Discover the sacred complex of moss-covered brick towers dating back to the 4th – 13th centuries, once the spiritual and political center of the Champa Kingdom.

Enjoy a traditional Cham music and dance performance, and visit the Tra Kieu Marian Pilgrimage Center, the site of the former capital of the Hindu Champa Kingdom.

11:30
Lunch at a local restaurant.

13:30
Continue to Hoi An Ancient Town. Enjoy a guided walking tour through this charming heritage town, visiting:

  • Ancient merchant houses

  • Fukien Chinese Assembly Hall

  • The 400-year-old Japanese Covered Bridge

  • Sa Huynh Museum

  • Local handicraft workshops

Free time for shopping and exploring the old town at your own pace.

16:00
Drop-off at your hotel.

End of tour services. Thank you for traveling with Vietlook Travel

tours.summary: Da Nang City Full Day Tour is an excellent introduction to the most modern and vibrant coastal city in Central Vietnam. This tour combines iconic landmarks, cultural sites, spiritual attractions, and local cuisine, offer
tours.contentHtml:
Da Nang City Full Day Tour is an excellent introduction to the most modern and vibrant coastal city in Central Vietnam. This tour combines iconic landmarks, cultural sites, spiritual attractions, and local cuisine, offering travelers a comprehensive view of Da Nang in just one day.

09:00
Begin the city sightseeing tour:

  • Love Bridge – a romantic symbol of Da Nang

  • Photo stops at Da Nang’s famous bridges, known as “the four most beautiful bridges of the city”:

    • Dragon Bridge

    • Han River Swing Bridge

    • Tran Thi Ly Bridge

    • Thuan Phuoc Bridge

Continue to Linh Ung Pagoda (Son Tra Peninsula) – the largest and most impressive spiritual site in Da Nang. Admire the 67-meter high Lady Buddha statue and enjoy a panoramic view of the city, coastline, and mountains. You may also see the friendly brown monkeys living in the area.

11:00
Visit Da Nang World Wonders Park, featuring miniature models of famous landmarks such as the Statue of Liberty, Eiffel Tower, and other world icons — a popular photo spot, especially for young travelers.

11:30
Stop at APEC Park, famous for its kite-shaped architectural design, one of the newest landmarks in Da Nang. Visit the exhibition gallery inside the park.

12:00
Lunch at a local restaurant. Enjoy Da Nang specialties such as rice paper rolls with pork, Quang noodles, and other local dishes.

13:30
Visit the Cham Sculpture Museum, home to the world’s largest collection of Cham artifacts and sculptures.

14:30
Visit Linh Ung Pagoda (Ngu Hanh Son / Marble Mountains area) – one of Da Nang’s largest pagodas, offering peaceful scenery and spiritual atmosphere.

16:00
Return to your hotel.

参观岘港世界奇迹公园，园内有自由女神像、埃菲尔铁塔等世界著名地标的微缩模型——是热门拍照地，尤其受年轻游客欢迎。

11:30
停靠亚太经合组织(APEC)公园，以风筝造型的建筑设计闻名，是岘港最新的地标之一。参观公园内的展览馆。

12:00
在当地餐厅享用午餐。品尝岘港特色美食，如猪肉米纸卷、广南面(Mì Quảng)及其他当地菜肴。

13:30
参观占婆雕塑博物馆，馆内收藏着全球最大规模的占婆文物和雕塑。

14:30
参观灵应寺（五行山/大理石山区域）——岘港最大的寺庙之一，景色宁静，充满宗教氛围。

16:00
返回酒店。

tours.title: THAN TAI HOT SPRING PARK DA NANG
tours.summary: Operated by Vietlook Travel, the Than Tai Hot Spring Park Full Day Tour is a perfect choice for travelers looking to relax, rejuvenate, and enjoy nature just outside Da Nang City. Nestled in a lush mountain area, Than Ta
tours.contentHtml:
Operated by Vietlook Travel, the Than Tai Hot Spring Park Full Day Tour is a perfect choice for travelers looking to relax, rejuvenate, and enjoy nature just outside Da Nang City. Nestled in a lush mountain area, Than Tai Hot Spring Park offers natural hot mineral springs, a modern water park, and unique wellness experiences inspired by Japanese onsen culture.

This tour combines comfort, relaxation, and fun, making it suitable for couples, families, and travelers of all ages.

ITINERARY

07:45 – 08:30
Driver and English-speaking tour guide from Vietlook Travel pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang. Depart for Than Tai Hot Spring Park.

08:45
Arrive at the park entrance and check in. Take an electric car to the main swimming pool area.
Enjoy various relaxing activities such as:

  • Jacuzzi pools

  • Luoi River inside Long Tien Cave

  • Mini water park

  • Artificial giant mushroom waterfalls

  • Hydro massage and water jets

Continue relaxing in the natural hot mineral spring lake and experience boiling eggs in natural hot water (at your own expense).

You may also choose optional premium services (not included) such as:

  • Private onsen bath

  • Herbal or mineral baths

  • Local beverages

  • Traditional tea ceremony

12:00
Lunch at a restaurant inside the park.

13:00
Free time to enjoy the water park with many exciting games and activities.

15:30
Drop-off at your hotel.
End of tour services. Thank you for traveling with Vietlook Travel!

TOUR PRICE: USD 40 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Air-conditioned coach for transfers

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

tours.titleZh: 岘港神财温泉公园

tours.contentHtmlZh:

tours.title: CHAM ISLAND FULL DAY TOUR
tours.summary: Operated by Vietlook Travel, the Cham Island Full Day Tour is an ideal getaway for travelers who love nature, the sea, and outdoor activities. Located just off the coast of Hoi An, Cham Island is a UNESCO-recognized Bios
tours.contentHtml:
Operated by Vietlook Travel, the Cham Island Full Day Tour is an ideal getaway for travelers who love nature, the sea, and outdoor activities. Located just off the coast of Hoi An, Cham Island is a UNESCO-recognized Biosphere Reserve, famous for its crystal-clear water, coral reefs, and peaceful island life.

This tour offers a perfect combination of sightseeing, swimming, snorkeling, and relaxation, with convenient transportation, professional service, and a delicious seafood lunch on the island.

ITINERARY

07:30 – 08:30
Driver and English-speaking tour guide from Vietlook Travel pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang. Depart for Cua Dai Beach via the “five-star street” connecting Da Nang and Hoi An, passing many luxury resorts. Distance is approximately 30 km from Da Nang city center.

09:15
Board a speed motorboat and begin an exciting journey to Cham Island. The island is located about 8 nautical miles east of Cua Dai Beach. Enjoy the thrilling experience as the boat rides across the waves.

09:40
Arrive at Bai Lang Pier on Cham Island. Start exploring the island with visits to:

  • Sa Huynh Museum

  • Cham Island Marine Protected Area

  • Hai Tang Pagoda

  • Tan Hiep Seafood Market (shopping time)

10:30
Free time for relaxing, swimming, and taking photos.

12:00
Enjoy lunch at Bai Ong Beach.

14:00
Return to the boat, depart from Bai Lang to Hon Dai, then head back to Hoi An pier (Hoai River).

15:00 – 15:30
Drop-off at your hotel.
End of tour services. Thank you for traveling with Vietlook Travel!

TOUR PRICE: USD 20 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Air-conditioned coach for hotel transfers

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Round-trip motorboat: Hoi An Pier – Cham Island

  • Lunch on Cham Island

  • Mineral water

  • Snorkeling service on Cham Island

  • All entrance fees as per itinerary

tours.titleZh: 占婆岛全天游
tours.summaryZh: 由 Vietlook Travel 运营的占婆岛一日游，是热爱自然、大海和户外活动的旅行者的理想出游之选。占婆岛位于会安近海，是联合国教科文组织认定的生物圈保护区
tours.contentHtmlZh:
由 Vietlook Travel 运营的占婆岛一日游，是热爱自然、大海和户外活动的旅行者的理想出游之选。占婆岛位于会安近海，是联合国教科文组织认定的生物圈保护区，以清澈见底的海水、珊瑚礁和宁静的海岛生活而闻名。

这趟行程完美融合了观光、游泳、浮潜和休闲放松，交通便利、服务专业，还有岛上美味的海鲜午餐。

Vietlook Travel 的司机和英语导游到您位于岘港的酒店接您。经由连接岘港和会安的“五星级大道”前往古岱海滩（Cửa Đại），沿途经过众多豪华度假村。距离岘港市中心约30公里。

09:15
登上快艇，开启前往占婆岛的刺激旅程。该岛位于古岱海滩以东约8海里。快艇乘风破浪，尽享惊险刺激的体验。

09:40
抵达占婆岛的Bãi Làng码头。开始探索全岛，参观：

  • 沙莹博物馆

  • 新协（Tân Hiệp）海鲜市场（购物时间）

tours.title: KHAI DINH TOMB – IMPERIAL CITADEL – THIEN MU PAGODA
tours.summary: Operated by Vietlook Travel, this full day Hue City Tour is specially designed for international travelers who wish to explore the cultural, historical, and spiritual highlights of Vietnam’s former imperial capital in ju
tours.contentHtml:
Operated by Vietlook Travel, this full day Hue City Tour is specially designed for international travelers who wish to explore the cultural, historical, and spiritual highlights of Vietnam’s former imperial capital in just one day.

Travel comfortably from Da Nang to Hue through the scenic Hai Van Tunnel, visit iconic royal tombs, ancient pagodas, and the UNESCO-listed Imperial Citadel, while gaining deep insight into the Nguyen Dynasty and Hue’s rich heritage. With professional service, experienced English-speaking guides, and carefully selected attractions, Vietlook Travel ensures a memorable and authentic journey.

ITINERARY

07:30 – 08:30
Our driver and English-speaking tour guide will pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang. Depart for Hue City via Hai Van Tunnel – the longest and most modern road tunnel in Southeast Asia.

09:15 – 09:45
Stop at Lap An Lagoon:

  • Enjoy a coffee break

  • Take photos of the peaceful natural scenery

  • Visit one of the largest pearl farms in Vietnam

11:00
Arrive in Hue and visit Khai Dinh Tomb – the most impressive and artistic royal tomb of the Nguyen Dynasty, featuring a unique blend of Asian and European architecture.

11:45 – 12:00
Lunch at a local restaurant and short rest.

12:45 – 13:00
Continue visiting:

  • Thien Mu Pagoda – the oldest and most beautiful pagoda in Hue, regarded as the spiritual symbol of the city.

  • Hue Imperial Citadel – a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site (since 1993). Here, you will learn about the 13 Nguyen Dynasty emperors who ruled Vietnam for over 140 years. Despite historical changes, the Citadel still preserves its remarkable historical value.

15:15 – 15:30
From the Citadel parking area, stop at a rest point for a short break before returning to Da Nang (approximately 2-hour drive).

18:00 – 18:30
Drop-off at your hotel.
End of tour services. Thank you and see you again!

TOUR PRICE: USD 35 / person

INCLUSION

  • Air-conditioned tourist coach

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Mineral water on the coach

  • All entrance fees as per itinerary

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Please provide personal information: Full name, year of birth, gender, nationality, and contact details.

    • 1–4 years old: Free of charge (sharing lunch with parents)

    • 5–9 years old: 50% of adult price (half portion lunch)

    • Above 9 years old: Full adult price
tours.titleZh: 启定陵—顺化皇城—天姥寺
tours.summaryZh: 这趟顺化全日游由Vietlook Travel运营，专为希望在一天之内领略越南昔日帝都文化、历史与精神精华的国际游客而设计……
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟顺化全日游由Vietlook Travel运营，专为希望在一天之内领略越南昔日帝都文化、历史与精神精华的国际游客而设计。

从岘港出发，舒适地穿越风景秀丽的海云隧道前往顺化，参观标志性的皇家陵寝、古老的寺庙以及被联合国教科文组织列入名录的皇城，深入了解阮朝和顺化丰富的文化遗产。凭借专业的服务、经验丰富的英语导游和精心挑选的景点，Vietlook Travel为您保证一段难忘而地道的旅程。

行程安排

07:30 – 08:30
我们的司机和英语导游将在岘港的酒店接您。经海云隧道前往顺化——这是东南亚最长、最现代化的公路隧道。

09:15 – 09:45
停靠Lập An泻湖：

  • 享受咖啡休息时间

  • 拍摄宁静的自然风光

  • 参观越南最大的珍珠养殖场之一

11:00
抵达顺化，参观启定陵——阮朝最具震撼力、最富艺术气息的皇家陵寝，融合了亚洲与欧洲建筑的独特风格。

11:45 – 12:00
在当地餐厅享用午餐并短暂休息。

12:45 – 13:00
继续参观：

  • 天姥寺——顺化最古老、最美丽的寺庙，被视为这座城市的精神象征。

  • 顺化皇城——联合国教科文组织世界文化遗产（自1993年起）。在这里，您将了解统治越南140多年的13位阮朝皇帝。尽管历经历史变迁，皇城依然保存着非凡的历史价值。

15:15 – 15:30
从皇城停车场出发，在休息站短暂停留，然后返回岘港（车程约2小时）。

18:00 – 18:30
送您回酒店。
行程服务结束。感谢您的参与，期待再次相见！

tours.title: BA NA HILLS – DISCOVER THE GOLDEN BRIDGE
tours.summary: Enjoy a full-day escape to the cool climate of Ba Na Hills ( Da Nang City ), ride one of the world’s most impressive cable car systems, walk on the legendary Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands, and have fun at one o
tours.contentHtml:
Enjoy a full-day escape to the cool climate of Ba Na Hills ( Da Nang City ), ride one of the world’s most impressive cable car systems, walk on the legendary Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands, and have fun at one of Asia’s top indoor theme parks.

ITINERARY

07:30–08:30 – Hotel Pick-up

Our English-speaking guide and driver pick you up from your hotel in Da Nang.

Depart for Ba Na Hills along one of the most beautiful seaside roads in Central Vietnam.

09:00 – Arrive at Ba Na Hills – First Cable Car Ride

Reach Ba Na Hills and board the UNESCO record-holding cable car system, famous for its height and length.

On the way up, enjoy spectacular views of:

  • Mo Stream

  • Toc Tien Waterfall with its dazzling white spray

  • Lush forests and misty mountains

Golden Bridge And French Village Area

Visit the iconic sights on Ba Na Hills:

  • Golden Bridge – “Hands of the Gods” holding a curved golden bridge in the sky, one of the most famous landmarks in Vietnam.

  • L’Jardin d’Amour Zone with French-inspired architecture, including:

    • Tinh Tam Garden

    • The old French stable

    • Hundred-year-old pomelo tree

    • Ancient villas

  • Linh Ung Pagoda – with a 27m-high Buddha statue and peaceful gardens

  • Loc Uyen Garden – a beautiful landscaped garden perfect for photos

11:30 – Second Cable Car to Nui Chua Peak & Lunch

From Debay Station, take the second cable car line to Nui Chua Peak – the rooftop of Da Nang City.

Enjoy a buffet lunch at Ba Na Hills.

Afternoon – Fantasy Park And Summit Attractions

Continue your exploration with:

  • Fantasy Park – one of Asia’s most modern indoor game centers. Enjoy a wide range of games and rides for all ages (most included).

  • Linh Chua Linh Tu Temple – Visit this spiritual site and enjoy a panoramic view of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay, often seen through a romantic layer of mist from Ba Na’s peak.

15:00–15:15 – Cable Car Down & Return to Da Nang

Take the cable car back down the mountain and board the coach to return to Da Nang city center.

17:00–17:30 – Hotel Drop-off

Arrive back at your hotel.

End of services. Goodbye & see you again! 

TOUR PRICE

54 USD / pax

INCLUDED

  • Transfer by air-conditioned coach in good condition.

  • Professional English-speaking guide.

  • Buffet lunch in Ba Na Hills.

  • Round-trip cable car tickets.

  • Entrance fees for all sightseeing as per itinerary.

  • Mineral water.

NOTES & CHILDREN POLICY

Notes:

Please provide the following personal information when booking:

  • Full name
  • Year of birth
  • Gender
  • Nationality
  • Contact details

Children Policy:

  • Under 1m: Free of charge (share lunch with parents).

  • From 1m to under 1.4m: 80% of adult price.

  • From 1.4m and above: Charged as adult.
tours.titleZh: 巴拿山 – 探访金桥
tours.summaryZh: 在巴拿山（岘港市）清凉的气候中度过一整天，乘坐世界上最令人印象深刻的缆车系统之一，漫步于由巨大石手托起的传奇金桥，并畅玩亚洲顶级室内主题乐园之一。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
在巴拿山（ 岘港市 ）清凉的气候中度过一整天，乘坐世界上最令人印象深刻的缆车系统之一，漫步于由巨大石手托起的传奇金桥，并畅玩亚洲顶级室内主题乐园之一。

行程安排

07:30–08:30 – 酒店接客

我们的英语导游和司机将在岘港您的酒店接您。

沿着越南中部最美丽的海滨公路之一，前往巴拿山。

09:00 – 抵达巴拿山 – 首段缆车

抵达巴拿山，登上创下吉尼斯世界纪录的缆车系统，该系统以其高度和长度闻名。

在上山途中，您将欣赏到壮丽的景色：

  • Mo溪

  • 飞溅着耀眼白色水花的Toc Tien瀑布

  • 茂密的森林与云雾缭绕的群山

金桥与法式村区域

参观巴拿山的标志性景点：

  • 金桥——“神之手”托起一座弯曲的金色桥梁悬于空中，是越南最著名的地标之一。

  • L’Jardin d’Amour爱情花园区，拥有法式风格建筑，包括：

    • 静心园

    • 古老的法式马厩

    • 百年柚子树

    • 古老别墅

  • 灵应寺——拥有27米高的佛像和宁静的花园

  • Loc Uyen花园——景色优美的园林，非常适合拍照

11:30 – 第二段缆车前往Nui Chua峰及午餐

从Debay站乘坐第二条缆车线路前往Nui Chua峰——岘港市的屋顶。

在巴拿山享用自助午餐。

下午 – 梦幻乐园与山顶景点

继续探索：

  • 梦幻乐园——亚洲最现代化的室内游乐中心之一。 享受适合各年龄段的众多游戏和游乐设施（大部分已包含）。

  • 灵洲灵祠——参观这处灵修场所，从巴拿山顶欣赏岘港市和岘港湾的全景，常笼罩在浪漫的薄雾之中。

15:00–15:15 – 乘缆车下山并返回岘港

乘缆车下山，登上大巴返回岘港市中心。

17:00–17:30 – 酒店送客

返回您的酒店。

服务结束。 再见，期待与您再次相会！ 

行程价格

54美元/人

费用包含

  • 乘坐车况良好的空调大巴接送。

  • 专业英语导游。

  • 巴拿山自助午餐。

  • 往返缆车票。

  • 按行程安排的所有景点门票。

  • 矿泉水。

注意事项与儿童政策

注意事项：

预订时请提供以下个人信息：

  • 全名
  • 出生年份
  • 性别
  • 国籍
  • 联系方式

儿童政策：

  • 1米以下：免费（与父母共享午餐）。

  • 1米至1.4米以下：成人价格的80%。

  • 1.4米及以上：按成人收费。

tours.title: LINH UNG PAGODA – MARBLE MOUNTAIN – HOI AN ANCIENT TOWN
tours.summary: This afternoon tour brings you from Da Nang’s most sacred pagoda to the mystical Marble Mountains and the magical lantern town of Hoi An. It’s a perfect mix of culture, spirituality, and night-time charm. ITINERARY 13:45
tours.contentHtml:
This afternoon tour brings you from Da Nang’s most sacred pagoda to the mystical Marble Mountains and the magical lantern town of Hoi An. It’s a perfect mix of culture, spirituality, and night-time charm.

ITINERARY

13:45–14:30 – Hotel Pick-up

Driver and English-speaking guide pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang.

Linh Ung Pagoda (Son Tra Peninsula)

Visit Linh Ung Pagoda, the most important pagoda in Da Nang for Buddhist locals.

  • Admire the towering Lady Buddha statue watching over the sea.

  • Enjoy peaceful temple grounds, bonsai gardens, and panoramic views of Da Nang City and the coastline.
    This is a meaningful spiritual stop where many people come to pray for peace and good fortune.

Marble Mountain (Ngu Hanh Son)

Continue to Marble Mountain, a famous spiritual and natural complex:

  • The mountain cluster consists of Kim (Metal), Mộc (Wood), Thủy (Water), Hỏa (Fire), Thổ (Earth), symbolizing the five elements of the universe in Asian culture.

  • Explore mysterious caves filled with Buddhist shrines and a sacred atmosphere.

  • Visit Tam Thai Pagoda and Linh Ung Pagoda (at Marble Mountain).

  • Stop by Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village at the foot of the mountain to admire exquisite stone sculptures made by skillful local artisans.

18:00 – Depart to Hoi An Ancient Town

On arrival in Hoi An:

Dinner in Hoi An

Enjoy a special local dinner with unique dishes such as:

  • Cao Lau

  • Hoanh Thanh (wontons)

  • Banh Bao

  • Banh Vac (white rose dumplings)
    …and more.

Hoi An Ancient Town by Night

After dinner, explore the charming UNESCO World Heritage old town:

  • Visit the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge, the last remaining symbol of Japanese culture in Hoi An and now a symbol of the town.

  • Take a leisurely walk along the Hoai River, enjoy the romantic and lively night atmosphere.

  • Admire countless colorful lanterns hanging across streets, shop fronts, and small alleys, creating a peaceful and dreamy scene that makes you want the walk to last forever.

21:00–21:30 – Drop-off at Your Hotel

Return to your hotel in Da Nang.

End of services. Goodbye & see you again!

TOUR PRICE

25 USD / pax

INCLUDED

  • Transfer by air-conditioned coach in good condition.

  • Dinner with special local dishes in Hoi An.

  • English-speaking guide.

  • Entrance fees for all sightseeing as per itinerary.

  • Mineral water on the coach.

NOTES AND CHILDREN POLICY

Notes:

Please provide personal information when booking:

  • Full name
  • Year of birth
  • Gender
  • Nationality
  • Contact details

Children Policy:

  • 1–4 years old: Free of charge (share dinner with parents).

  • 5–9 years old: 50% of adult price (half portion dinner).

  • From 10 years old and above: Charged as an adult.
tours.titleZh: 灵应寺—五行山—会安古镇
tours.summaryZh: 这趟下午行程将带您从岘港最神圣的寺庙，前往神秘的五行山，再到灯笼璀璨的魔幻小镇会安。文化、灵性与夜晚的魅力在此完美融合。 行程安排 13:45
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟下午行程将带您从岘港最神圣的寺庙，前往神秘的五行山，再到灯笼璀璨的魔幻小镇会安。文化、灵性与夜晚的魅力在此完美融合。

行程安排

13:45–14:30 – 酒店接客

司机和英语导游到您位于岘港的酒店接您。

灵应寺（山茶半岛）

参观灵应寺，这是岘港当地佛教徒心中最重要的寺庙。

  • 欣赏高耸的观音佛像，她守望着大海。

  • 徜徉于宁静的寺院庭园和盆景花园，欣赏岘港市区和海岸线的全景。
    这是一处意义非凡的心灵驿站，许多人来此祈求平安和好运。

五行山（Ngũ Hành Sơn）

继续前往五行山，这是著名的灵修与自然景区：

  • 山群由金（Kim）、木（Mộc）、水（Thủy）、火（Hỏa）、土（Thổ）五座山峰组成，象征着亚洲文化中宇宙的五行。

  • 探索神秘的洞窟，洞内供奉着佛龛，氛围神圣庄严。

  • 参观三台寺和灵应寺（位于五行山）。

  • 在山脚下的非严（Non Nước）石雕村稍作停留，欣赏当地能工巧匠制作的精美石雕。

18:00 – 前往会安古镇

抵达会安后：

会安晚餐

享用一顿特色本地晚餐，品尝独特的美食，例如：

  • 高楼面（Cao Lầu）

  • 馄饨（Hoành Thánh）

  • 包子（Bánh Bao）

  • 白玫瑰饺子（Bánh Vạc）
    ……等等。

夜游会安古镇

晚餐后，漫步探索这座迷人的联合国教科文组织世界遗产古镇：

  • 参观标志性的日本来远桥，它是会安仅存的日本文化象征，如今已成为这座古镇的标志。

  • 沿着怀江悠闲漫步，享受浪漫而热闹的夜晚氛围。

  • 欣赏高悬在街道、店铺门前和小巷间数不清的彩色灯笼，营造出宁静如梦的画面，让您希望这段漫步永不结束。

21:00–21:30 – 送回酒店

返回您位于岘港的酒店。

服务结束。再见，期待与您再次相见！

团费

25 美元/人

费用包含

  • 乘坐车况良好的空调巴士接送。

  • 会安特色本地菜肴晚餐。

  • 英语导游。

  • 行程所列全部景点门票。

  • 巴士上的矿泉水。

注意事项与儿童政策

注意事项：

预订时请提供个人信息：

  • 全名
  • 出生年份
  • 性别
  • 国籍
  • 联系方式

儿童政策：

  • 1–4岁：免费（与父母共享晚餐）。

  • 5–9岁：成人价格的50%（半份晚餐）。

  • 10岁及以上：按成人收费。

tours.title: HA GIANG – CAO BANG – BAN GIOC WATERFALL – BA BE LAKE
tours.summary: Ha Giang – Cao Bang – Ban Gioc – Ba Be Lake Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers who want to go deeper into Vietnam’s wild and mountainous Northeast. You’ll ride through the legendary Ha Giang Loop, conquer Mã Pí Lèn
tours.contentHtml:
Ha Giang – Cao Bang – Ban Gioc – Ba Be Lake Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers who want to go deeper into Vietnam’s wild and mountainous Northeast. You’ll ride through the legendary Ha Giang Loop, conquer Mã Pí Lèng Pass and Mẻ Pia Slope, visit Ban Gioc – Vietnam’s most beautiful waterfall, explore Nguom Ngao Cave, and finish with a peaceful boat trip on Ba Be Lake.

Travel by motorbike with professional Easy Riders, stay in local homestays, and experience real ethnic minority culture along the way.

TOUR OVERVIEW

  • Type: SIC Easy Rider motorbike tour

  • Duration: 6 days / 5 nights (plus transfer night from Hanoi)

  • Route: Hanoi → Ha Giang → Dong Van → Meo Vac → Bao Lac → Cao Bang → Ban Gioc → Ba Be → Hanoi

  • Highlights:

    • Hà Giang Loop & Đồng Văn Karst Plateau Geopark

    • Mã Pí Lèng Pass & Nho Quế River viewpoint

    • Mẻ Pia Slope (Mã Pia) with iconic zig-zag road

    • Nguom Ngao Cave & Ban Gioc Waterfall

    • Ba Be National Park & Ba Be Lake boat trip

    • Authentic homestays with Tay and other ethnic families

DETAILED ITINERARY

Hanoi → Ha Giang (Sleeper Bus)

  • 19:30–20:00: Pick-up around Hanoi Old Quarter.

  • Board a luxury private-cabin sleeper bus to Ha Giang.

  • Late evening arrival in Ha Giang City.

  • Check in to shared-room homestay (traditional house) and rest.

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Slope – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast at the homestay, your Easy Rider team will brief you on safety and the route, then the adventure begins.

  • Ride out of Ha Giang into the mountains – the scenery changes quickly from town to towering limestone peaks.

  • Stop at Bac Sum Slope for panoramic views and a short drink break.

  • Continue through Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark – a UNESCO-recognized area full of rice terraces, rock formations and hidden valleys.

  • Visit Quan Ba Heaven Gate and the famous Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills) – a classic Ha Giang viewpoint.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant in Yen Minh Town.

  • In the afternoon, continue to Tham Ma Slope, a winding mountain road with impressive views.

  • Visit the historic H’Mong King Palace (Vuong family residence), an important cultural and architectural site.

  • Arrive in Dong Van Town, check into homestay, have dinner and free time to explore the Old Quarter (if time allows).
    Overnight in Dong Van.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Bao Lac

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

One of the most spectacular days of the trip.

  • After breakfast, ride from Dong Van towards Mã Pí Lèng Pass on the Happiness Road between Dong Van and Meo Vac.

  • Stop at the Volunteer Youth Monument and multiple viewpoints along the pass.

  • Ride the Sky Path to admire the full view of deep canyons and the turquoise Nho Quế River below. This is one of the most iconic sceneries in all of Vietnam.

  • Take time for photo stops and to soak in the mountainous landscape.

  • Continue through Meo Vac Town, then ride further into Cao Bang province along remote mountain trails.

  • Reach Bao Lac Town, home to many ethnic groups (including Tay, Nung, H’Mong, etc.).

  • Check in to a Tay family homestay, enjoy a home-cooked dinner and “happy water” (local rice wine).
    Overnight in Bao Lac.

Day 3: Bao Lac – Me Pia Slope – Phia Thap Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

Today you ride approximately 130 km through some of the best scenery in Northeast Vietnam.

  • Depart Bao Lac towards Phia Thap Village.

  • Ride through vast forests, limestone mountains, valleys and small local villages.

  • Stop at Mẻ Pia Slope (Ma Pia) – a spectacular zig-zag mountain pass with dramatic views perfect for photos.

  • Enjoy the cool, fresh air of Cao Bang province, with scenic stops along the way.

  • Lunch en route at a local restaurant.

  • Afternoon ride to Phia Thap Village, known for its charming geo-cultural landscape and traditional life.

  • Check in at a local homestay, relax, and enjoy dinner with the host family.
    Overnight in Phia Thap.

Day 4: Phia Thap – Nguom Ngao Cave – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Cao Bang City

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

Nature day with cave and waterfall highlights.

  • Leave Phia Thap and head to Nguom Ngao Cave – one of Northern Vietnam’s most beautiful caves, featuring impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

  • Stop at viewpoints along the way to appreciate Northeast Vietnam’s hidden charm.

  • Continue riding to Ban Gioc Waterfall on the Vietnam–China border – the largest and one of the most stunning waterfalls in Vietnam.

  • Enjoy the sight of emerald water cascading over terraced rock formations surrounded by forested cliffs.

  • Optional: short bamboo raft ride to get closer to the falls (if available, at extra cost).

  • In the afternoon, ride back towards Cao Bang City.

  • Check in to accommodation in Cao Bang, dinner and free time.
    Overnight in Cao Bang.

Day 5: Cao Bang – Ba Be Lake – Pac Ngoi Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

  • After breakfast, depart Cao Bang for Ba Be National Park – famous for its combination of mountains, rivers, caves and one of Vietnam’s largest natural freshwater lakes.

  • Ride through mountain passes and rural villages on the way to Ba Be.

  • Arrive in Ba Be Lake area, set among high limestone ranges. The lake never runs dry, even in the dry season.

  • If time permits, you may take a short boat trip on Ba Be Lake or walk around the village.

  • Continue to Pac Ngoi Village, a peaceful Tay ethnic village beside the lake.

  • Check in at a traditional stilt house homestay, dinner and relax in the quiet countryside.
    Overnight in Ba Be.

Day 6: Ba Be – Boat Trip on Ba Be Lake – Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

  • After breakfast, enjoy trekking in Ba Be National Park – visit hidden villages, traditional Tay houses and explore the surrounding nature.

  • Later, take a boat trip on Ba Be Lake (if not done the previous day) to experience the calm water, limestone cliffs and lush forest.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant in Ba Be.

  • Tour ends in the early afternoon.

13:00 – Departure to Hanoi

  • Board a limousine bus from Ba Be at around 13:00.

  • Evening arrival back in Hanoi.
    End of tour.

PRICE PER PERSON (USD)

  • 520 USD / person – SIC Tour

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang ↔ Ba Be ↔ Hanoi:

    • Sleeper bus luxury private cabin (pick-up in Hanoi Old Quarter 19:30–20:00)

    • Limousine bus (pick-up around Hanoi Old Quarter 15:00–15:30 for some routes / return from Ba Be at 13:00)

  • Free shared homestay night in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private room in homestays during the loop (except first shared night in Ha Giang)

  • All meals during the tour: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide(s)

  • Experienced Easy Rider motorbike drivers

  • Motorbikes & fuel

  • All entry fees to indicated sites (caves, waterfalls, viewpoints…)

  • Protective gear: helmet, raincoat, basic protective equipment

  • Drinking water during the riding days (1 bottle/day)

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Border entry permit for restricted areas (if required)

  • Tips for guide and riders

  • Personal drinks (coffee, beer, soft drinks, etc.)

  • Personal expenses and anything not clearly mentioned in “Tour Includes”
tours.titleZh: 河江—高平—板约瀑布—巴贝湖
tours.summaryZh: 河江 – 高平 – 板约 – 巴碧湖 Easy Rider 摩托之旅，专为想深入探索越南东北部荒野山区的旅行者打造。您将骑行传说中的河江环线，征服马皮岭（Mã Pí Lèng）山口与Mẻ Pia坡道
tours.contentHtmlZh:
河江 – 高平 – 板约 – 巴碧湖 Easy Rider 摩托之旅，专为想 深入 探索越南东北部荒野山区的旅行者打造。您将骑行传说中的河江环线，征服马皮岭（Mã Pí Lèng）山口与Mẻ Pia坡道，造访越南最美的瀑布——板约瀑布，探访Nguom Ngao洞穴，并在巴碧湖上享受一次宁静的泛舟之旅。

乘坐摩托车，由专业的 Easy Rider 车手带队，入住当地民宿，沿途体验真实的少数民族文化。

行程概览

  • 类型： SIC 拼团 Easy Rider 摩托之旅

  • 行程天数： 6天5晚 （另加从河内出发的夜间交通）

  • 路线：河内 → 河江 → 同文 → 妙瓦 → 保乐 → 高平 → 板约 → 巴碧 → 河内

  • 行程亮点：

    • 河江环线与同文喀斯特高原地质公园

    • 马皮岭山口与Nho Quế河观景台

    • Mẻ Pia坡道（Mã Pia）标志性的之字形公路

    • Nguom Ngao洞穴与板约瀑布

    • 巴碧国家公园与巴碧湖泛舟

    • 入住岱族及其他少数民族家庭的地道民宿

详细行程

河内 → 河江（卧铺巴士）

  • 19:30–20:00：在河内老城区附近接客。

  • 乘坐 豪华单人包厢卧铺巴士 前往河江。

  • 深夜抵达河江市。

  • 入住 合住房民宿 （传统民居）并休息。

第1天：河江市 – Bac Sum坡 – 广坝天堂之门 – 双峰山（仙女乳峰） – 延明 – Tham Ma坡 – 苗王府 – 同文

用餐：午餐、晚餐

在民宿用完早餐后，Easy Rider 团队将为您讲解安全事项和路线，随后冒险正式开始。

  • 骑行驶出河江，进入群山——风景迅速由城镇变为巍峨的石灰岩山峰。

  • 在 Bac Sum坡 停留，欣赏全景并稍作饮水休息。

  • 继续穿越 同文喀斯特高原地质公园 ——这片被联合国教科文组织认可的区域遍布梯田、奇岩怪石和隐秘山谷。

  • 参观 广坝天堂之门 和著名的 双峰山（仙女乳峰） ——河江经典的观景点。

  • 在 延明镇的当地餐厅享用午餐。

  • 下午，继续前往 Tham Ma坡，这是一条蜿蜒的山路，景色令人印象深刻。

  • 参观历史悠久的 苗王府 （王氏家族宅邸），这是一处重要的文化与建筑遗址。

  • 抵达 同文镇，入住民宿，享用晚餐，并自由活动游览老街区（视时间而定）。
    夜宿同文。

第2天：同文 – 志愿青年纪念碑 – 马皮岭山口 – Nho Quế河观景台 – 妙瓦 – 保乐

用餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

这是整个旅程中最壮观的一天。

  • 早餐后，从同文出发，骑行前往 马皮岭山口 ，沿着连接同文与妙瓦的“幸福之路”前行。

  • 在 志愿青年纪念碑 及山口沿途的多个观景台停留。

  • 骑行 天空之路 ，饱览深邃峡谷和下方碧绿的 Nho Quế河 全景。这是整个越南最具代表性的景观之一。

  • 留出时间拍照，沉浸在壮丽的山地风光中。

  • 继续穿过 妙瓦镇，然后沿偏远的山间小路深入高平省。

  • 抵达 保乐镇，这里居住着许多民族（包括岱族、侬族、苗族等）。

  • 入住 岱族家庭民宿，享用家常晚餐，并品尝“快乐水”（当地米酒）。
    夜宿保乐。

第3天：保乐 – Me Pia坡 – Phia Thap村

用餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

今天您将骑行约 130公里 ，穿越越南东北部一些最美的风景。

  • 从保乐出发前往 Phia Thap村。

  • 穿越广袤的森林、石灰岩山脉、山谷和小小的当地村落。

  • 在 Mẻ Pia坡（Ma Pia） 停留——这是一条壮观的之字形山路，景色震撼，非常适合拍照。

  • 享受高平省清凉新鲜的空气，沿途设有多处观景停靠点。

  • 途中在当地餐厅享用午餐。

  • 下午骑行前往 Phia Thap村，这里以迷人的地质文化景观和传统生活而闻名。

  • 入住当地民宿，放松休息，与房东一家共进晚餐。
    夜宿Phia Thap。

第4天：Phia Thap – Nguom Ngao洞 – 板约瀑布 – 高平市

用餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

以洞穴和瀑布为亮点的自然之旅。

  • 离开Phia Thap，前往 Nguom Ngao洞 ——越南北部最美丽的溶洞之一，拥有令人惊叹的钟乳石和石笋。

  • 沿途在观景台停留，欣赏越南东北部隐藏的魅力。

  • 继续骑行前往 板约瀑布 ，位于越中边境，是越南最大、也是最令人惊艳的瀑布之一。

  • 欣赏翠绿的河水倾泻过层层叠叠的岩石，四周被森林覆盖的悬崖环绕。

  • 可选项目：乘坐竹筏近距离接近瀑布（视情况而定，需另付费用）。

  • 下午，骑车返回 高平市。

  • 入住高平的住宿，享用晚餐并自由活动。
    夜宿高平。

第5天：高平 – 巴碧湖 – Pac Ngoi村

用餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

  • 早餐后，从高平出发前往 巴碧国家公园 ——这里集山脉、河流、洞穴和越南最大的天然淡水湖之一于一体，久负盛名。

  • 沿途穿越山口和乡村，前往巴碧。

  • 抵达 巴碧湖 地区，湖泊坐落于高耸的石灰岩山脉之间。即使在旱季，湖水也从不干涸。

  • 如果时间允许，您可以在巴碧湖上进行一次 短途泛舟 ，或在村中漫步。

  • 继续前往 Pac Ngoi村，这是湖畔一个宁静的岱族村落。

  • 入住传统高脚屋民宿，享用晚餐，在宁静的乡村中放松身心。
    夜宿巴碧。

第6天：巴碧 – 巴碧湖泛舟 – 河内

用餐：早餐、午餐

  • 早餐后，享受 巴碧国家公园徒步 ——探访隐秘的村庄和传统的岱族民居，探索周围的自然风光。

  • 随后，乘坐 巴碧湖游船 （如前一天尚未游览），体验平静的湖水、石灰岩峭壁和茂密的森林。

  • 在巴碧的当地餐厅享用午餐。

  • 行程于下午早些时候结束。

13:00 – 出发返回河内

  • 约13:00从巴碧乘坐 商务车（Limousine） 出发 。

  • 傍晚返回河内。
    行程结束。

每人价格（美元）

  • 520 美元 / 人 – SIC 拼团

费用包含

  • 河内 ↔ 河江 ↔ 巴碧 ↔ 河内的交通：

    • 豪华单人包厢卧铺巴士 （河内老城区接客时间 19:30–20:00）

    • 商务车（Limousine） （部分线路河内老城区接客时间 15:00–15:30 / 返程巴碧出发时间 13:00）

  • 免费合住民宿 一晚，位于河江市（传统民居）

  • 住宿： 独立房间 ，环线期间入住民宿（河江第一晚合住除外）

  • 行程全程用餐： 早餐 – 午餐 – 晚餐

  • 专业的 英语导游

  • 经验丰富的 Easy Rider 摩托车车手

  • 摩托车及燃油

  • 行程所列景点的全部门票（洞穴、瀑布、观景台等）

  • 防护装备： 头盔、雨衣，以及基础防护用具

  • 骑行日提供饮用水（每天1瓶）

费用不含

tours.title: HANG EN CAVE ADVENTURE CAMP – 2 DAYS / 1 NIGHT
tours.summary: The Hang En Cave Adventure is one of Vietnam’s most spectacular cave experiences. Hang En is considered the world’s third-largest cave and is a must-see natural wonder. Its massive size, 300-million-year-old fossils, pri
tours.contentHtml:
The Hang En Cave Adventure is one of Vietnam’s most spectacular cave experiences. Hang En is considered the world’s third-largest cave and is a must-see natural wonder. Its massive size, 300-million-year-old fossils, pristine jungle, and river crossings make it an unforgettable adventure.

This 2-day, 1-night tour includes camping inside Hang En Cave beside a lazy river, visits to Ban Doong Village, and exploration of Hang Lanh (“Cold Cave”). Featured in National Geographic, The New York Times, Lonely Planet, Daily Mail UK, Good Morning America, and the Hollywood film Pan (2015), Hang En is a natural and cultural highlight of Phong Nha.

The tour combines trekking, river crossings, jungle exploration, cave adventure, and overnight camping for physically active guests seeking a moderate but thrilling challenge.

TOUR ITINERARY

Day 1: Phong Nha – Ban Doong Village – Hang En

07:30 – 08:00 – Pick up from your hotel in Phong Nha and transfer to Oxalis Headquarters. Gear up, receive a safety briefing, and sign the release form.

10:00 – Start trekking into the jungle via a steep hill and rivers. Hike through primary forest to reach Ban Doong Village, an ethnic minority village, for tea and cultural experience.

12:30 – 13:00 – Picnic lunch near the river.

Continue trekking through rivers and jungle valleys toward Hang En Cave.

15:00 – Arrive at Hang En. Camp is set up on the cave’s beach by the porter team. Explore the cave, walk to the viewpoint above camp to see 300-million-year-old fossils, relax or swim in the natural pool, and enjoy a grilled dinner with rice wine under the sounds of swifts overhead.

Day 2: Hang En – Hang Lanh – Phong Nha

08:00 – Breakfast and pack belongings.

09:00 – Depart Hang En and trek 1 km along the riverside to Hang Lanh (“Cold Cave”).

10:00 – 12:00 – Explore Hang Lanh, a 4 km-long wet cave with cold rivers, magnificent formations, and rare fossils.

12:00 – 13:00 – Lunch with the group.

13:00 – 14:00 – Trek through the river valley and jungle paths back toward the trailhead.

14:00 – 16:00 – Final uphill trek to the pickup point.

16:30 – 17:30 – Return to your hotel in Phong Nha.

TOUR INFORMATION

  • Operating Period: 24th Dec – August (closed September – late December)

  • Duration: 2 days / 1 night

  • Adventure Level: Moderate, 25 km for physically active guests

  • Group Size: 10 – 16 pax (minimum 2 pax)

  • Minimum Age: 16 years old

  • Start Time: 08:00 – 08:30 from local hotel in Phong Nha

  • End Time: 17:00 – 17:30 at local hotel in Phong Nha

  • Price: 405 USD per person

INCLUSIONS

  • Private car transfers

  • Camping and trekking equipment

  • Breakfast, lunch, and dinner

  • English-speaking local tour guide

  • Bottled water

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips

CHILD POLICY

  • Only guests aged 16 years and above can join this tour
tours.titleZh: 韩洞探险露营 – 两天一晚
tours.summaryZh: Hang En洞探险是越南最壮观的洞穴体验之一。Hang En被誉为世界第三大洞穴，是不容错过的自然奇观。其巨大的规模、3亿年前的化石、原始丛林
tours.contentHtmlZh:
Hang En（燕洞）探险之旅是越南最壮观的洞穴体验之一。Hang En被誉为世界第三大洞穴，是不容错过的自然奇观。其巨大的规模、3亿年前的化石、原始丛林和涉水过河，让这趟探险令人难忘。

这趟2天1晚的行程包括在Hang En洞内悠缓河流旁露营、参观Ban Doong村，以及探索Hang Lạnh（“冷洞”）。Hang En曾被《国家地理》、《纽约时报》、《孤独星球》、英国《每日邮报》、《早安美国》以及2015年好莱坞电影《潘》报道或取景，是峰牙的自然与文化亮点。

行程融合徒步、涉水过河、丛林探索、洞穴探险和野外露营，适合希望挑战适中但充满刺激体验的体能良好的游客。

行程安排

第1天：峰牙 – Ban Doong村 – Hang En

07:30 – 08:00 – 从峰牙的酒店接客，前往Oxalis总部。整理装备、听取安全须知并签署免责书。

10:00 – 开始徒步进入丛林，翻越陡坡、涉过溪流。穿越原始森林，抵达少数民族村落Ban Doong村，品茶并体验当地文化。

12:30 – 13:00 – 河边野餐午餐。

继续徒步，穿过河流和丛林山谷，前往Hang En洞。

15:00 – 抵达Hang En。挑夫团队在洞内沙滩上搭好营地。探索洞穴，步行至营地上方的观景点欣赏3亿年前的化石，放松身心或在天然水池中游泳，在头顶雨燕鸣叫声中享用烧烤晚餐并品尝米酒。

第2天：Hang En – Hang Lạnh – 峰牙

08:00 – 早餐并收拾行李。

09:00 – 离开Hang En，沿河岸徒步1公里前往Hang Lạnh（“冷洞”）。

10:00 – 12:00 – 探索Hang Lạnh，这是一个长4公里的水洞，有冰凉的河流、壮丽的钟乳石地貌和珍稀化石。

12:00 – 13:00 – 与团队一起享用午餐。

13:00 – 14:00 – 穿越河谷和丛林小径，返回登山口方向。

14:00 – 16:00 – 最后一段上坡徒步，前往接送点。

16:30 – 17:30 – 返回峰牙的酒店。

行程信息

  • 运营时间：12月24日 – 8月（9月 – 12月下旬关闭）

  • 时长：2天 / 1晚

  • 探险难度：中等，25公里，适合体能良好的游客

  • 团队规模：10 – 16人（最少2人成团）

  • 最低年龄：16岁

  • 出发时间：08:00 – 08:30，从峰牙当地酒店出发

  • 结束时间：17:00 – 17:30，在峰牙当地酒店结束

  • 价格：每人 405 USD

费用包含

  • 私人专车接送

  • 露营和徒步装备

  • 早餐、午餐和晚餐

  • 英语当地导游

  • 瓶装水

费用不含

  • 个人消费

  • 小费

儿童政策

  • 仅限16岁及以上游客参加本行程

tours.title: MARBLE MOUNTAIN – COCONUT FOREST – HOI AN ANCIENT TOWN
tours.summary: This afternoon evening tour is perfect for travelers who want to combine nature, culture, and fun in one go: explore the sacred Marble Mountains, enjoy a basket-boat experience in the Coconut Forest, and fall in love wit
tours.contentHtml:
This afternoon evening tour is perfect for travelers who want to combine nature, culture, and fun in one go: explore the sacred Marble Mountains, enjoy a basket-boat experience in the Coconut Forest, and fall in love with the lantern lit beauty of Hoi An Ancient Town by night.

ITINERARY

14:00 – Pick-up from your hotel

Driver and English-speaking guide pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang and depart for Marble Mountain.

Marble Mountain (Ngu Hanh Son)

  • Visit the famous cluster of five limestone mountains representing the five elements:

    • Kim (Metal), Mộc (Wood), Thủy (Water), Hỏa (Fire), Thổ (Earth)

  • Explore mysterious caves with a sacred Buddhist atmosphere.

  • Visit Tam Thai Pagoda and Linh Ung Pagoda on the mountain.

  • Stop at Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village at the foot of the mountain to admire exquisite stone sculptures crafted by local artisans.

16:00 – Coconut Forest (Bay Mau Coconut Forest)

Head to the famous Coconut Forest and explore the waterways on a traditional basket boat.

You will:

  • Take a basket-boat ride through the peaceful coconut forest.

  • Learn how to cast a fishing net, catch crabs, and join fun basket-boat races.

  • Watch locals perform impressive basket-boat skills and enjoy a mini show of Quang folk melodies.

  • Try making small accessories from coconut leaves with local guidance.

17:30 – Depart to Hoi An Ancient Town

18:00 – Dinner & Hoi An Night Stroll

  • Enjoy a special dinner with local Hoi An dishes such as:

    • Cao Lau, Hoanh Thanh, Banh Bao, Banh Vac and more.

  • Visit Hoi An Ancient Town, a charming UNESCO World Heritage site.

  • Stop at the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge – the most famous symbol of Hoi An.

  • Take a leisurely walk along the Hoai River, enjoy the romantic atmosphere of the old town at night.

  • Admire colorful lanterns hanging along streets, alleys, and houses – a magical and peaceful scene you’ll never forget.

21:00–21:30 – Drop-off at your hotel

End of services. Goodbye and see you again!

TOUR PRICE

30 USD / pax

INCLUDED

  • Transfer by air-conditioned coach in good condition.

  • Dinner with special local dishes in Hoi An.

  • English-speaking guide.

  • Entrance fees for all sightseeing as per itinerary.

  • Mineral water on the coach.

NOTES AND CHILDREN POLICY

Notes:

Please provide personal information when booking:

  • Full name
  • Year of birth
  • Gender
  • Nationality
  • Contact details

Children Policy:

  • 1–4 years old: Free of charge (share dinner with parents).

  • 5–9 years old: 50% of adult price (half portion dinner).

  • From 10 years old and above: Charged as an adult.
tours.titleZh: 五行山—椰林—会安古镇
tours.summaryZh: 这条下午至晚间的行程非常适合想一次体验自然、文化与乐趣的旅行者：探索神圣的五行山，在椰林中体验竹筏船，并爱上夜晚灯笼璀璨的会安古镇之美。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这条下午至晚间的行程非常适合想一次体验自然、文化与乐趣的旅行者：探索神圣的五行山，在椰林中体验竹筏船，并爱上夜晚灯笼璀璨的会安古镇之美。

行程安排

14:00 – 酒店接客

司机和英语导游在您位于岘港 的酒店接您，前往五行山。

五行山（Ngũ Hành Sơn）

  • 参观著名的五座石灰岩山群，分别代表五行：

    • 金（Kim）、木（Mộc）、水（Thủy）、火（Hỏa）、土（Thổ）

  • 探索充满神秘感、佛教氛围浓厚的洞穴。

  • 参观山上的三台寺（Tam Thai）和灵应寺（Linh Ứng）。

  • 在山脚下的非山石雕村（Non Nước）停留，欣赏当地工匠精心雕琢的精美石雕。

16:00 – 椰林（Bảy Mẫu椰林）

前往著名的椰林，乘坐传统竹筏船探索水道。

您将：

  • 乘坐竹筏船穿行于宁静的椰林之间。

  • 学习撒网捕鱼、抓螃蟹，并参加有趣的竹筏船比赛。

  • 观看当地人表演精彩的竹筏船技艺，并欣赏广南民歌迷你表演。

  • 在当地人的指导下，尝试用椰叶制作小饰品。

17:30 – 前往会安古镇

18:00 – 晚餐与会安夜游

  • 享用特色晚餐，品尝会安当地美食，例如：

    • 高楼面（Cao Lầu）、馄饨（Hoành Thánh）、白玫瑰（Bánh Bao Bánh Vạc）等。

  • 游览会安古镇，这是一处迷人的联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

  • 在标志性的日本桥（来远桥）停留——这是会安最著名的象征。

  • 沿着秋盆河（Hoài）悠闲漫步，感受夜晚古镇的浪漫氛围。

  • 欣赏悬挂在街巷和房屋间的五彩灯笼——如梦如幻、宁静祥和的景象，令人终生难忘。

21:00–21:30 – 送回酒店

服务结束。再见，期待与您再次相遇！

行程价格

30 USD / 人

费用包含

  • 乘坐车况良好的空调巴士接送。

  • 晚餐，品尝会安特色当地美食。

  • 英语导游。

  • 行程中所有景点的门票。

  • 巴士上提供矿泉水。

注意事项与儿童政策

注意事项：

预订时请提供以下个人信息：

  • 全名
  • 出生年份
  • 性别
  • 国籍
  • 联系方式

儿童政策：

  • 1–4岁：免费（与父母共享晚餐）。

  • 5–9岁：成人价格的50%（半份晚餐）。

  • 10岁及以上：按成人收费。

tours.title: DISCOVER PHONG NHA – CYCLING ON THE HO CHI MINH TRAIL
tours.summary: The Phong Nha Ho Chi Minh Trail Cycling Tour offers an adventurous and immersive way to explore the stunning landscapes and historic trails of Phong Nha. Cycle through rice paddies, peanut fields, rivers, and jungle path
tours.contentHtml:
The Phong Nha Ho Chi Minh Trail Cycling Tour offers an adventurous and immersive way to explore the stunning landscapes and historic trails of Phong Nha.

Cycle through rice paddies, peanut fields, rivers, and jungle paths while discovering Vietnam’s history along the legendary Ho Chi Minh trails.

This tour is ideal for travelers who love physical challenges, outdoor adventure, and learning about local culture and wartime history, all while enjoying breathtaking mountain views and pristine nature.

WHAT TO BRING

  • Sunglasses

  • Sun cream

  • Cycling shoes

  • Swimming gear

We provide:

  • Bottles of water, soft drinks, seasonal fruits, and snacks

  • International standard mountain bikes (Trek/Giant or similar) and helmets

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30 – Pick up from your hotel or homestay in Phong Nha. Receive a briefing on cycling traffic rules and safety before starting the tour.

08:45 – Cycle from Phong Nha town toward Phong Nha National Park. Pass through corn and rice fields along the Son River to Na Village, a floating fishing farm. Learn about local culture, rice farming, and fish feeding from your guide.

Visit Ho Khanh’s house, the jungle man who discovered Son Doong Cave, the world’s largest cave. Opportunity for photos if available.

Cycle through peanut fields and explore the original Ho Chi Minh trails, historically used to transport soldiers and supplies during the Vietnam War. Cross muddy paths and peanut fields along the Chay River to reach HCM HW (West Wing).

Enjoy lunch at Chay Lap Homestay or Nuoc Mooc Spring, with an option to swim in the pristine jungle spring.

Cycle across Chay River via a wooden bridge to explore the Wine Cave, where rice wine was historically made during wartime. Learn about its significance and peace symbol.

Return to Phong Nha town by 16:30, with an optional ice-cream break.

INCLUSIONS

  • Entrance fees

  • First-aid service

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Boat on Son River and local ferry fees

  • Cold drinks (Revive, coke) and water (unlimited)

  • Mountain bike with helmet (Trek/Giant or similar) with mechanic support

  • English-speaking cycling guide (escorted guide for groups of 9 or more)

  • Pick up and drop off at your hotel in Phong Nha

EXCLUSIONS

  • Tourist insurance

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips for guide/driver

  • Services not mentioned above

CHILD POLICY

  • Children from 9 to 11 years old: half price
tours.titleZh: 峰牙探索：骑行胡志明小道
tours.summaryZh: 峰牙胡志明小道骑行之旅以充满冒险与沉浸感的方式，带您探索峰牙壮丽的自然风光和历史古道。骑行穿过稻田、花生地、河流和丛林小径
tours.contentHtmlZh:
峰牙胡志明小道骑行之旅以充满冒险与沉浸感的方式，带您探索峰牙壮丽的自然风光和历史古道。

骑行穿过稻田、花生地、河流和丛林小径，沿着传奇的胡志明小道探寻越南的历史。

本行程非常适合热爱体能挑战、户外探险，并希望了解当地文化和战争历史的旅行者，同时还能欣赏令人惊叹的山景和原始自然风光。

建议携带

  • 太阳镜

  • 防晒霜

  • 骑行鞋

  • 游泳装备

我们提供：

  • 瓶装水、软饮料、时令水果和小吃

  • 国际标准山地自行车（Trek/Giant或同级别）及头盔

行程安排

08:00 – 08:30 – 从峰牙的酒店或民宿接客。出发前听取骑行交通规则和安全须知。

08:45 – 从峰牙镇骑行前往峰牙国家公园。沿着Son河穿过玉米地和稻田，抵达水上养鱼场Na村。由导游为您讲解当地文化、水稻种植和喂鱼知识。

参观Hồ Khanh之家，他是发现世界最大洞穴韩松洞（Son Doong）的丛林向导。如条件允许，可拍照留念。

骑行穿过花生地，探索原始的胡志明小道，这些小道在越南战争期间曾用于运送士兵和物资。沿着Chày河穿越泥泞小路和花生地，抵达胡志明公路（西线）。

在Chày Lập民宿或Nước Mọoc泉享用午餐，可选择在原始丛林清泉中游泳。

经木桥骑行跨过Chày河，探访酒洞，战争期间这里曾用来酿制米酒。了解它的意义及和平象征。

16:30前返回峰牙镇，可选择休息吃冰淇淋。

费用包含

  • 门票

  • 急救服务

  • 当地餐厅午餐

  • Son河游船及当地渡轮费用

  • 冷饮（Revive、可乐）和饮用水（不限量）

  • 山地自行车及头盔（Trek/Giant或同级别），配有维修人员支持

  • 英语骑行向导（9人及以上团队配备全程陪同导游）

  • 峰牙酒店接送

费用不含

  • 旅游保险

  • 个人消费

  • 导游/司机小费

  • 上述未提及的服务

tours.title: Cao Bang 3 Days 2 Nights
tours.summary: This 3 day, 2 night journey takes you deep into the majestic landscapes and historical sites of Cao Bang in the Northeast of Vietnam. Visit sacred revolutionary sites in Pac Bo, admire the breathtaking Ban Gioc Waterfall
tours.contentHtml:
This 3 day, 2 night journey takes you deep into the majestic landscapes and historical sites of Cao Bang in the Northeast of Vietnam. Visit sacred revolutionary sites in Pac Bo, admire the breathtaking Ban Gioc Waterfall on the Vietnam – China border, walk through the stunning Nguom Ngao Cave, check in at the unique God’s Eye Mountain (Nui Mat Than), and unwind amidst the tranquil beauty of Ba Be Lake.

With comfortable accommodation, local cuisine, and a knowledgeable tour guide, this program is perfect for travelers who want to experience both nature and culture in a short but meaningful trip.

ITINERARY

Day 1: Hanoi – Cao Bang – Pac Bo

  • Morning pick-up in Hanoi and drive to Cao Bang.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant.

  • Afternoon visit to Pac Bo Historical Site – including Lenin Stream and Karl Marx Mountain, where President Ho Chi Minh lived and worked in the early days of the revolution.

  • Return to Cao Bang City for dinner.

  • Overnight at hotel in Cao Bang.

Day 2: Cao Bang – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Nguom Ngao Cave – Nui Mat Than – Cao Bang

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Depart for Ban Gioc Waterfall, one of the most spectacular waterfalls in Vietnam. Free time for sightseeing and photos. (Optional bamboo boat ride to get closer to the falls – at your own expense.)

  • Visit Nguom Ngao Cave, famous for its impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

  • Stop at Nui Mat Than (God’s Eye Mountain / Nui Thung) for photo opportunities of this unique mountain with a natural “eye” in the rock. (Motorbike taxi to the viewpoint available at your own expense.)

  • Return to Cao Bang City for dinner and overnight at hotel.

Day 3: Cao Bang – Ba Be Lake – Hanoi

  • Breakfast at hotel, then depart for Ba Be National Park.

  • Enjoy a boat trip on Ba Be Lake, surrounded by limestone mountains, forests, and peaceful villages.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant or homestay area (depending on timing).

  • Afternoon drive back to Hanoi.

  • Evening arrival in Hanoi. End of tour.

PRICE

From 250 USD / pax – SIC Tour (seat-in-coach)

TOUR INCLUSIONS

  • Transportation by tourist coach (7–45 seats) according to group size and itinerary.

  • Accommodation:

    • 2 nights at 2–3* hotels in Cao Bang (twin/double sharing).

  • Meals:

    • 5 main meals (set menu), valued at $5 / meal / person.

  • Breakfast:

    • 2 breakfasts at local restaurants or hotel.

  • English/Vietnamese-speaking tour guide throughout the itinerary.

  • Drinking water in the bus: 1 bottle per person per day.

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

  • VAT (10%) if an official tax invoice is required.

  • Foreign guest surcharge at Ban Gioc Waterfall: $2 / person.

  • Single room supplement (for solo travelers or guests requesting a single room).

  • Drinks during meals, minibar, and other personal expenses.

  • Optional bamboo boat ride at Ban Gioc Waterfall.

  • Motorbike taxi to access/viewpoint at Nui Mat Than (if used).

  • Any other services and expenses not clearly mentioned in the “Tour Inclusions” section.
tours.titleZh: 高平三天两晚
tours.summaryZh: 这趟3天2晚的旅程将带您深入越南东北部高平雄伟的山水风光和历史遗迹。参观Pac Bo神圣的革命遗址，欣赏越中边境上令人叹为观止的板约瀑布
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这趟3天2晚的旅程将带您深入越南东北部高平雄伟的山水风光和历史遗迹。参观Pac Bo（柏波）神圣的革命遗址，欣赏越中边境上令人叹为观止的板约瀑布，漫步于壮观的Nguom Ngao（鸭洞）洞穴，在独特的“神之眼”山（Nui Mat Than）打卡拍照，并在巴贝湖宁静的美景中放松身心。

配有舒适的住宿、当地美食和知识渊博的导游，本行程非常适合希望在短暂而有意义的旅程中同时体验自然与文化的旅行者。

行程安排

第1天：河内 – 高平 – Pac Bo

  • 上午在河内接客，驱车前往高平。

  • 在当地餐厅享用午餐。

  • 下午参观Pac Bo历史遗址——包括列宁溪和马克思山，胡志明主席在革命初期曾在此生活和工作。

  • 返回高平市享用晚餐。

  • 入住高平酒店。

第2天：高平 – 板约瀑布 – Nguom Ngao洞 – Nui Mat Than – 高平

  • 酒店享用早餐。

  • 出发前往板约瀑布，越南最壮观的瀑布之一。自由观光和拍照时间。（可自费乘竹筏靠近瀑布。）

  • 参观Nguom Ngao洞，以壮观的钟乳石和石笋闻名。

  • 在Nui Mat Than（神之眼山 / Nui Thung）停留拍照，这座独特的山岩上有一个天然的“眼睛”。（可自费乘摩托车前往观景点。）

  • 返回高平市享用晚餐，并入住酒店。

第3天：高平 – 巴贝湖 – 河内

  • 酒店早餐后，出发前往巴贝国家公园。

  • 乘船游览巴贝湖，四周环绕着石灰岩山峦、森林和宁静的村庄。

  • 在当地餐厅或民宿区享用午餐（视时间而定）。

  • 下午驱车返回河内。

  • 傍晚抵达河内，行程结束。

价格

每人 250 USD起 – SIC拼团（Seat-in-Coach）

行程包含

  • 根据团队规模和行程安排，乘坐旅游大巴（7–45座）。

  • 住宿：

    • 高平2–3星级酒店2晚（双床/大床合住）。

  • 餐食：

    • 5顿正餐（套餐），价值$5 / 餐 / 人。

  • 早餐：

    • 当地餐厅或酒店早餐2顿。

  • 全程英语/越南语导游。

  • 车上饮用水：每人每天1瓶。

行程不含

  • 如需开具正式税务发票，需加收增值税（10%）。

  • 板约瀑布外国游客附加费：$2 / 人。

  • 单人房差（适用于单独出行的旅客或要求住单人房的客人）。

  • 用餐时的饮品、迷你吧及其他个人消费。

  • 板约瀑布自选竹筏体验。

  • 前往Nui Mat Than入口/观景点的摩托车费用（如使用）。

  • “行程包含”部分中未明确提及的任何其他服务和费用。

tours.title: HANOI – HA LONG – NINH BINH – SAPA
tours.summary: This tour 6 day, 5-night Hanoi – Ha Long – Ninh Binh – Sapa package is designed for travelers who want to experience the very best of Northern Vietnam in a comfortable, time-efficient way. From the cultural heart of Hano
tours.contentHtml:
This tour 6 day, 5-night Hanoi – Ha Long – Ninh Binh – Sapa package is designed for travelers who want to experience the very best of Northern Vietnam in a comfortable, time-efficient way. From the cultural heart of Hanoi to the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay, the majestic limestone landscapes of Ninh Binh, and the misty mountain terraces of Sapa, this journey seamlessly combines nature, culture, and local life.

You’ll explore ancient temples and historic streets in Hanoi, cruise through thousands of limestone karsts in Ha Long Bay, row between towering cliffs and hidden caves in Trang An, and trek charming ethnic villages in Sapa, including Ta Van and Cat Cat.

Tour Itinerary

Day 1: Welcome to Hanoi – Half Day City Tour

Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, our representative will welcome you and transfer you to the hotel for check-in and relaxation.

In the afternoon, your guide will pick you up for a 4 hour Hanoi city tour, including:

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside)
    The mausoleum is clad in grey granite, supported by rows of square columns, with the words “CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH” prominently displayed. The surrounding grounds are planted with trees and flowers from across Vietnam, making this one of the capital’s most meaningful historical and cultural symbols.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda
    Located on a small island on West Lake’s southeastern shore, this 1,500-year-old pagoda is considered the oldest in Thang Long – Hanoi and was once the Buddhist center during the Ly and Tran dynasties. Its architecture harmoniously blends solemnity, antiquity, and natural lakeside beauty.

  • Train Street
    A unique 200-meter-long street tightly flanked by residential houses. When the train passes, you will experience the thrilling feeling of being just about one meter away, making it one of Hanoi’s most iconic photo and experience spots.

  • Water Puppet Show
    A traditional Vietnamese art form performed entirely on water. Each show lasts 45–60 minutes, with wooden puppets as the “actors”, accompanied by live music, sound effects, and lighting, creating a lively and captivating performance.

After the tour, you will enjoy a complimentary Vietnamese hair washing experience or body massage package.

Day 2: Hanoi – Ninh Binh – Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave

07:00 – Pick-up from your hotel in the Old Quarter or the Hanoi Opera House and depart for Ninh Binh.

10:00 – Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Visit the former capital of Vietnam in the 11th century. The ancient ruins, partly reclaimed by nature, create a mystical atmosphere. Explore the temples of Kings Dinh and Le, restored in the 17th century but believed to be on the original foundations of the royal palaces from the 11th–12th centuries.

After local lunch (around 13:30) – Depart for Trang An, a UNESCO-recognized eco-tourism complex:

  • Explore a 250-million-year-old limestone system with flooded forests, towering karst peaks, and cultural relics.

  • Enjoy a peaceful boat trip through caves and along emerald rivers, passing spectacular limestone cliffs and lush landscapes.

15:30 – Mua Cave

Climb nearly 500 stone steps to the summit. At the top, a tower in traditional Vietnamese style crowns the mountain. From here, take in the panoramic view of rice fields, winding rivers, and karst mountains – one of the most beautiful viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

Return to Hanoi.

Day 3: Ha Long Bay Day Cruise

08:00–08:45 – Hotel Pick-up

Your English-speaking guide will collect you from various hotels around Hanoi Old Quarter (timing approximate due to traffic).

11:45–12:00 – Boarding the Cruise

Arrive at Tuan Chau Marina, board the cruise from our private pier where the crew will warmly welcome you.

12:00–13:30 – Lunch on Board

Cruise out into the heart of Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Sail past iconic limestone islands such as Dog Rock, Duck Rock, and Thumb Rock, a tall islet shaped like a giant thumb.

Enjoy a buffet lunch with a variety of seafood and Vietnamese dishes.

13:30–14:30 – Explore Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave

Stop at Bo Hon Island and walk up around 200 steps under the forest canopy to the entrance of Sung Sot Cave, the largest and most beautiful cave in Ha Long Bay. Spend about 45 minutes exploring its impressive chambers.

(Guests who prefer not to walk can stay on board and relax on the sundeck or in the jacuzzi.)

14:30–15:30 – Kayaking / Rowboat

Head to Luon Cave. Here you can:

  • Go kayaking for about 30 minutes, or

  • Sit on a rowboat paddled by locals to admire the limestone cliffs and peaceful water.

15:30–16:30 – Titop Island

Stop at Titop Island, where you can climb halfway up for a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay. This viewpoint offers one of the most stunning vistas of the bay.

17:00 – Sunset Party

Enjoy complimentary wine, Vietnamese tea, fresh fruit, and small cakes while cruising back. Watch the sky change colors as the sun sets over the bay.

18:00 – Disembark and return to Hanoi by limousine bus.

You will be dropped off in the Old Quarter to have dinner or explore by yourself.

Around 21:00, a sleeper bus will pick you up to depart for Sapa.

Overnight on the sleeping bus.

Day 4: Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Ta Van Village

05:30 – Arrive in Sapa, early check-in at your pre-booked hotel and rest.

10:00–10:30 – Your guide will pick you up to visit Fansipan:

  • Transfer to the Cable Car Station and take a 20-minute cable car ride, enjoying breathtaking views of the Hoang Lien Son mountain range.

  • Reach an altitude of about 2,800 meters, where you can:

    • Explore the pagoda complex and spiritual sites.

    • Climb around 600 steps to the summit of Fansipan – “The Roof of Indochina”.

    • Spend about 1.5 hours for photos and sightseeing.

After that, visit Ta Van Village, about 12 km from Sapa town:

  • This is home to the Black H’Mong and Red Dao ethnic minorities, each with distinct languages, houses, and customs.

  • The village lies in Muong Hoa Valley, the largest valley in Sapa along the Hoang Lien Son range.

  • While Sapa town is lively and busy, Ta Van offers a peaceful, rural atmosphere with:

    • Vast terraced rice fields covering hillsides

    • The sound of flowing streams and singing birds

Day 5: Cat Cat Village – Hanoi

Morning: Breakfast at the hotel, then your guide will take you to Cat Cat Village:

  • Take a short walk to Cat Cat, a village of the Black H’Mong people located in a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

  • Observe daily life, traditional handicrafts, and local culture.

  • Trek down to the waterfall and old French Hydraulic Power Station, stop for photos at the bridge and waterfall.

  • Trek back uphill to Sapa with beautiful scenery along the way (trekking distance approx. 2.5 km, about 2 hours).

After the tour, you will return to Hanoi by sleeper bus.

Upon arrival in Hanoi, check in to the hotel and enjoy free time.

Day 6: Departure from Hanoi

After breakfast, free at leisure until your private car picks you up and transfers you to the airport for your onward flight.

tours.titleZh: 河内—下龙—宁平—沙坝
tours.summaryZh: 这个6天5晚的河内 – 下龙湾 – 宁平 – 沙坝套餐专为希望以舒适、高效的方式体验越南北部精华的旅行者设计。从河内的文化中心，到下龙湾的
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这个6天5晚的河内 – 下龙湾 – 宁平 – 沙坝套餐专为希望以舒适、高效的方式体验越南北部精华的旅行者设计。从河内的文化中心，到下龙湾的翡翠碧水、宁平雄伟的石灰岩地貌，再到沙坝云雾缭绕的山间梯田，这趟旅程将自然、文化与当地生活完美融合。

您将探访河内的古老寺庙和历史街巷，在下龙湾乘船穿梭于成千上万座石灰岩岛屿之间，在长安划船穿行于高耸的悬崖和隐秘的洞穴之间，并徒步游览沙坝迷人的少数民族村寨，包括打凡村（Ta Van）和Cát Cát村。

行程安排

第1天：欢迎来到河内 – 半日市区游

抵达内排机场后，我们的代表将迎接您，并送您前往酒店办理入住和休息。

下午，导游将接您参加4小时河内市区游，包括：

  • 胡志明陵（外观参观）
    陵墓外覆灰色花岗岩，由一排排方形立柱支撑，醒目地刻有“CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH”字样。周围园区种植着来自越南各地的树木和花卉，使其成为首都最具意义的历史文化象征之一。

  • 镇国寺
    位于西湖东南岸的一座小岛上，这座有1,500年历史的古寺被认为是升龙 – 河内最古老的寺庙，曾是李朝和陈朝时期的佛教中心。其建筑将庄严、古朴与湖畔自然之美和谐交融。

  • 火车街
    一条长约200米的独特街道，两侧紧邻民居。火车驶过时，您将体验到距离火车仅约一米的惊险刺激感，使其成为河内最具标志性的拍照和体验地点之一。

  • 水上木偶戏
    一种完全在水上表演的越南传统艺术形式。每场演出持续45–60分钟，以木偶为“演员”，配以现场音乐、音效和灯光，表演生动迷人。

游览结束后，您将免费享受越南洗头体验或全身按摩套餐。

第2天：河内 – 宁平 – 华闾 – 长安 – 木洞

07:00 – 从老城区或河内歌剧院附近的酒店接客，出发前往宁平。

10:00 – 华闾古都

参观11世纪越南的古都。部分被大自然重新占据的古老遗迹营造出神秘的氛围。探访丁先皇庙和黎大行庙，两座庙宇于17世纪修复，据信建在11–12世纪皇宫的原址之上。

当地午餐后（约13:30） – 出发前往长安，联合国教科文组织认定的生态旅游景区：

  • 探索拥有2.5亿年历史的石灰岩系统，有水淹森林、高耸的喀斯特山峰和文化古迹。

  • 乘船悠然穿越洞穴、沿翡翠般的河流前行，沿途经过壮观的石灰岩峭壁和郁郁葱葱的风光。

15:30 – 木洞

攀登近500级石阶登顶。山顶矗立着一座越南传统风格的塔楼。在这里可以欣赏稻田、蜿蜒河流和喀斯特山峦的全景——宁平最美的观景点之一。

返回河内。

第3天：下龙湾一日游轮

08:00–08:45 – 酒店接客

英语导游将从河内老城区各酒店接您（因交通状况，时间为大致时间）。

11:45–12:00 – 登上游轮

抵达Tuan Chau码头，从我们的专用码头登上游轮，船员将热情欢迎您。

12:00–13:30 – 船上午餐

驶入联合国教科文组织世界遗产下龙湾的核心海域。途经标志性的石灰岩岛屿，如狗石、鸭石和拇指石——一座形似巨大拇指的高耸小岛。

享用包含多种海鲜和越南菜肴的自助午餐。

13:30–14:30 – 探索惊讶洞（Sung Sot）

停靠Bo Hon岛，在林荫下步行约200级台阶，来到惊讶洞洞口，这是下龙湾最大、最美的洞穴。花约45分钟探索其壮观的洞室。

（不愿步行的客人可留在船上，在日光甲板或按摩浴缸中放松。）

14:30–15:30 – 皮划艇 / 划艇

前往Luon洞。在这里您可以：

  • 乘坐皮划艇约30分钟，或

  • 坐上由当地人划的小船，欣赏石灰岩峭壁和宁静的水面。

15:30–16:30 – 天堆岛（Titop）

停靠天堆岛，您可以爬至半山腰俯瞰下龙湾全景。这处观景点可欣赏海湾最令人惊叹的景色之一。

17:00 – 日落派对

返程途中免费享用葡萄酒、越南茶、新鲜水果和小蛋糕。欣赏夕阳西下时天空变幻的色彩。

18:00 – 下船，乘豪华Limousine巴士返回河内。

您将在老城区下车，可自行用晚餐或游览。

约21:00，卧铺巴士将接您前往沙坝。

夜宿卧铺巴士。

第4天：沙坝 – 番西邦峰 – 打凡村

05:30 – 抵达沙坝，在预订的酒店提前入住并休息。

10:00–10:30 – 导游将接您参观番西邦峰：

  • 前往缆车站，乘坐20分钟缆车，欣赏黄连山脉的壮丽景色。

  • 到达海拔约2,800米处，您可以：

    • 探索寺庙建筑群和精神圣地。

    • 攀登约600级台阶登上番西邦峰之巅——“印度支那屋脊”。

    • 花约1.5小时拍照和观光。

随后，参观距沙坝镇约12公里的打凡村：

  • 这里是黑苗族和红瑶族少数民族的家园，各自拥有独特的语言、房屋和习俗。

  • 村庄位于木花山谷（Muong Hoa），这是沙坝沿黄连山脉最大的山谷。

  • 沙坝镇热闹繁忙，而打凡村则拥有宁静的田园氛围：

    • 覆盖山坡的广袤梯田

    • 潺潺流水声和鸟儿歌唱声

第5天：Cát Cát村 – 河内

上午：酒店享用早餐，随后导游将带您前往Cát Cát村：

  • 短途步行前往Cát Cát，这是黑苗族村寨，位于番西邦峰脚下的深谷之中。

  • 观察日常生活、传统手工艺和当地文化。

  • 徒步下至瀑布和法国人修建的旧水力发电站，在桥上和瀑布处停留拍照。

  • 徒步上坡返回沙坝，沿途风景优美（徒步距离约2.5公里，约2小时）。

游览结束后，您将乘卧铺巴士返回河内。

抵达河内后，入住酒店并自由活动。

第6天：河内送机

早餐后自由活动，直至专车接您并送往机场，搭乘后续航班。
