tours.title: Hanoi – Sapa – Lao Chai – Ta Van – Giang Ta Chai
tours.summary: Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to experience an authentic stay at a basic hill-tribe homestay, trek through the most beautiful ethnic villages in Sapa, and enjoy a lower cost than night-train packages while
tours.contentHtml:
Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to experience an authentic stay at a basic hill-tribe homestay, trek through the most beautiful ethnic villages in Sapa, and enjoy a lower cost than night-train packages while still receiving friendly and attentive services.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa – Y Linh Ho – Lao Chai – Ta Van

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30

Meet at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45

Travel along the highway toward Lao Cai City with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue along the mountain road to Sapa Town while enjoying views of deep valleys and terraced rice fields.

13:00

Arrive in Sapa Town where H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay ethnic groups wear their colorful traditional costumes.

  • Welcome drink and itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:15

Take a short drive to Y Linh Ho, then begin trekking through rice terraces and along Muong Hoa Stream toward the Black H’Mong village of Lao Chai. Enjoy breathtaking scenery of the Hoang Lien Son Mountain range before continuing to Ta Van Village, home of the Zay ethnic people.

Trekking distance: 9 km (approx. 3.5 hours)

17:45

Check in at Ta Van homestay and meet the Dzay host family. Enjoy a peaceful sunset over the mountains. You may join the family in cooking traditional dishes before dinner.

In the evening, you can visit a local bar for music and meet other travelers. Overnight at the homestay.

Day 2: Ta Van – Giang Ta Chai – Sapa – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

08:00

Enjoy breakfast prepared by the host family before starting another scenic trek.

08:45

Walk through rice fields for great photo opportunities, then continue through a bamboo forest to reach the panoramic viewpoint of Giang Ta Chai Village, home of the Red Dzao ethnic people.

Trekking distance: 4 km (approx. 2 hours)

11:00

Cross Giang Ta Chai Bridge to reach the main road, where the bus will pick you up and take you back to Sapa.

12:00 – 13:00

Return to the hotel for a shower, lunch, and free time.

13:30

Meet the group at the hotel and prepare for departure.

14:00

Board the bus back to Hanoi with two comfort breaks on the way.

20:30 – 21:00

Arrive at Hanoi bus station. The trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Sleeper bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (tour guide not available on the bus)

  • English-speaking tour guide during the tour in Sapa

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 dinner, 1 breakfast

  • All entrance tickets to indicated sites

  • Single basic bed with mosquito net at Ta Van homestay

  • Insurance during bus transport

Trip Excludes

  • Beverages, travel insurance, VAT, personal expenses

  • Services not mentioned

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD/person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD/person (round trip)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat: 25 USD/person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble: 16 USD/person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Under 5 years old (or under 1m): Free of charge (2 adults + 1 child sharing bed/berth/bus)

  • 5 – 8 years old: 75% of adult price, sharing bed with adult

  • 9 years old and above: Charged as adult

Notes

  • Seniors should not join the 9 km long trek due to its difficulty, especially in rainy weather.

  • Children under 6 years old and people with mobility impairment should not join this tour.

  • Homestay accommodations are basic and different from hotels in facilities and comfort.

Surcharge Policy

  • Additional charges apply during national holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothes, scarf, hat, cap (Sapa is cold from September to March)

  • Fog is common from December to March

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong (ATMs in Sapa may not work reliably; USD, EUR, AUD accepted)

  • Personal medicine (although pharmacies exist in Sapa)

Tour Price per Person 

72 USD per person
tours.titleZh: 河内—沙坝—老柴—达旺—江达寨
tours.summaryZh: 沙坝之旅专为希望体验山地少数民族简朴民宿、徒步穿越沙坝最美的少数民族村寨，并且希望费用低于夜火车套餐、同时仍能享受友好周到服务的旅行者而设计……
tours.contentHtmlZh:
沙坝之旅专为希望体验山地少数民族简朴民宿、徒步穿越沙坝最美的少数民族村寨，并且希望费用低于夜火车套餐、同时仍能享受友好周到服务的旅行者而设计。

行程安排

第1天：河内 – 沙坝 – Y Linh Ho – Lao Chải – Tả Van

包含餐食：午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30

在汽车站集合，登上卧铺巴士，出发前往沙坝。

07:30 – 11:45

沿高速公路驶向老街市，途中安排休息。

11:45 – 13:00

沿山路继续前往沙坝镇，一路欣赏深谷和层层梯田的风景。

13:00

抵达沙坝镇，苗族、瑶族和岱族等少数民族身着色彩斑斓的传统服饰。

  • 欢迎饮品及行程介绍

  • 当地越南特色午餐

  • 酒店入住

14:15

短途驱车前往Y Linh Ho，然后开始徒步，穿过梯田，沿着Mường Hoa溪前往黑苗族村寨Lao Chải。欣赏壮丽的黄连山山脉风光，然后继续前往Tả Van村，这里是Zay族人的家园。

徒步距离：9公里（约3.5小时）

17:45

入住Tả Van民宿，与Dzay族房东一家见面。欣赏群山之上宁静的日落。晚餐前，您可以和房东一家一起烹制传统菜肴。

晚上，您可以前往当地酒吧欣赏音乐，结识其他旅行者。夜宿民宿。

第2天：Tả Van – Giàng Tả Chải – 沙坝 – 河内

包含餐食：早餐、午餐

08:00

享用房东一家准备的早餐，然后开始又一段风景优美的徒步。

08:45

穿过稻田，沿途有绝佳的拍照机会，然后穿过竹林，抵达Giàng Tả Chải村的全景观景台，这里是红瑶族人的家园。

徒步距离：4公里（约2小时）

11:00

越过Giàng Tả Chải桥抵达公路，巴士将在此接您并送您返回沙坝。

12:00 – 13:00

返回酒店冲澡、用午餐并自由活动。

13:30

在酒店与团队会合，准备出发。

14:00

登上返回河内的巴士，途中安排两次休息。

20:30 – 21:00

抵达河内汽车站，行程结束。

行程包含

  • 河内 – 沙坝 – 河内卧铺巴士（巴士上无导游随行）

  • 沙坝行程期间的英语导游

  • 餐食：2顿午餐、1顿晚餐、1顿早餐

  • 所列景点的全部门票

  • Tả Van民宿的简朴单人床，配蚊帐

  • 乘坐巴士期间的保险

行程不包含

  • 饮品、旅游保险、增值税、个人开销

  • 未提及的服务

  • 卧铺巴士包厢附加费：

    • 单人包厢：12美元/人（往返）

    • 双人共享包厢：8美元/人（往返）

  • Dcar Limousine VIP座位：25美元/人（往返）

  • 豪华商务巴士28座Nouble：16美元/人（往返）

儿童政策

  • 5岁以下（或身高1米以下）：免费（2名成人 + 1名儿童共用床/铺/座位）

  • 5 – 8岁：收取成人票价的75%，与成人同床

  • 9岁及以上：按成人收费

注意事项

  • 老年人因9公里长途徒步难度较大，尤其是在雨天，不建议参加。

  • 6岁以下儿童和行动不便者不建议参加本行程。

  • 民宿住宿条件简朴，在设施和舒适度上与酒店不同。

附加费政策

  • 国家法定节假日期间需另付附加费

携带物品

  • 保暖衣物、围巾、帽子（沙坝9月至次年3月天气寒冷）

  • 12月至3月常有大雾

  • 徒步鞋、太阳镜、防晒霜、驱蚊剂

  • 越南盾现金（沙坝的ATM可能不稳定；可接受美元、欧元、澳元）

  • 个人药品（尽管沙坝有药店）

每人团费

每人72美元

tours.title: HANOI BIKING – EXPLORE RED RIVER DELTA COUNTRYSIDE (HALF DAY)
tours.summary: Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour 08:00 – Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, or homestay and transfer you to our bicycle office, where you can choose the most suitable bike and receive a safety briefin
tours.contentHtml:
Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour

08:00 – Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, or homestay and transfer you to our bicycle office, where you can choose the most suitable bike and receive a safety briefing. If your hotel is conveniently located, we can also bring the bicycles directly to your hotel.

After getting ready, we will start cycling from your hotel and head out for our countryside ride.

Crossing Long Bien Bridge

Our first highlight is crossing the Red River via Long Bien Bridge – the oldest bridge in Hanoi, built over 100 years ago during the French colonial period. From here, you can enjoy beautiful views of the Red River, watch boats passing underneath, and see the lush green vegetable farms on the river island.

Countryside and Local Life

We then cycle into the countryside, where local farmers live and work. Here, you will have the chance to visit a local family, learn more about daily life and traditions, and have meaningful conversations with them. Our guide will assist to make the interaction easy and insightful.

Co Loa Ancient Citadel

We continue cycling along dirt roads and through rural villages to reach Co Loa Ancient Citadel, originally built in 275 BC. Here, you will learn about Vietnam’s long tradition of establishing and defending the country, as well as the history of King Thuc Phan An Duong Vuong and his struggle against foreign invaders.

Fruit Garden – Lunch – Egg Coffee

After visiting Co Loa, we will stop at a fruit garden, where you can see how local fruits are grown. Then we cycle back to Hanoi for lunch at a local restaurant, where you will enjoy traditional Vietnamese dishes.

We finish the trip in the Old Quarter with a cup of egg coffee, a famous local specialty, before transferring you back to your hotel.

Tour Includes

  • Professional English–speaking guide

  • Quality mountain bike

  • All entry fees and free bottled water during the tour

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Pick up and drop off

  • Helmet
tours.titleZh: 河内骑行：探索红河三角洲乡村（半日）
tours.summaryZh: 行程详情 08:00 – 我们的导游将到您的酒店、Airbnb或民宿接您，并送您到我们的自行车办公室，您可以在那里选择最合适的自行车并接受安全讲解。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
行程详情

08:00 – 我们的导游将到您的酒店、Airbnb或民宿接您，并送您到我们的自行车办公室，您可以在那里选择最合适的自行车并接受安全讲解。如果您的酒店位置便利，我们也可以直接把自行车送到您的酒店。

准备就绪后，我们将从您的酒店开始骑行，出发前往乡村。

穿越龙编桥

我们的第一个亮点是经龙编桥穿越红河——这是河内最古老的桥梁，建于一百多年前的法国殖民时期。在这里，您可以欣赏红河的美景，观看船只从桥下驶过，并看到河中岛上郁郁葱葱的蔬菜农场。

乡村与当地生活

随后我们骑行进入乡村，当地农民在这里生活和劳作。在这里，您将有机会拜访一户当地家庭，更多地了解日常生活和传统，并与他们进行有意义的交流。我们的导游将协助您，让交流轻松而富有见地。

古螺古城

我们继续沿着土路穿过乡村，抵达古螺古城，该城最初建于公元前275年。在这里，您将了解越南悠久的建国和卫国传统，以及蜀泮安阳王的历史和他抵御外来侵略者的斗争。

果园 – 午餐 – 蛋咖啡

参观古螺后，我们将在一处果园停留，您可以看到当地水果是如何种植的。然后我们骑车返回河内，在当地餐厅享用午餐，品尝传统越南菜。

行程在老城区结束，您将品尝一杯著名的当地特产蛋咖啡，随后送您返回酒店。

行程包含

  • 专业英语导游

  • 优质山地自行车

  • 行程中的所有门票及免费瓶装水

  • 当地餐厅午餐

  • 接送服务

  • 头盔

tours.title: HANOI BY NIGHT FOOD TOUR
tours.summary: ITINERARY Hop on the back of the scooter as we take you to enjoy one of the most famous dishes in Hanoi—Bún Chả—at a local restaurant famously visited by President Obama. Our next stop is the French Quarter to see the Ha
tours.contentHtml:
ITINERARY

  • Hop on the back of the scooter as we take you to enjoy one of the most famous dishes in Hanoi—Bún Chả—at a local restaurant famously visited by President Obama.
  • Our next stop is the French Quarter to see the Hanoi Opera House, where you will have the opportunity to take beautiful photos and learn some history of the area.
  • We then ride to Long Bien Bridge, a magnificent structure built more than a hundred years ago. It spans the Red River, connecting Hoan Kiem and Long Bien districts, and provides shelter for locals living on boats underneath. Only motorbikes and bicycles can cross it—so off we go!
  • Back on the scooter, we continue along the beautiful Ceramic Road and Chuong Duong Bridge to reach our next food stop, where you will enjoy “Burned Garlic Siamese Duck” and “Liver Pâté Siamese Duck.”
  • The exciting ride through organized, chaotic Hanoi traffic brings you to another local restaurant for authentic dishes. Then we explore small alleys to try different versions of Pho, including Pho Chien Phong and Pho Cuon, along with many other famous Vietnamese dishes.
  • A ride around West Lake offers a romantic view of Hanoi that most travelers rarely get the chance to see—an experience filled with “wow” moments. Continuing the tour, we ride around the city and pass by Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum for a night-time photo stop.
  • A short ride later brings us to a traditional Egg Coffee shop, where you will enjoy Hanoi’s famous specialty.
  • We then ride you back to your hotel. Say goodbye

INCLUDED

  • Scooter, fuel, helmet
  • Experienced professional riders
  • English-speaking guides
  • Dinner at local restaurants
  • All entrance fees & cold water throughout the tour
  • Free pick-up and drop-off
  • Raincoat (if needed)
tours.titleZh: 河内夜间美食之旅
tours.summaryZh: 跳上摩托车后座，带您品尝河内最著名的烤肉米线、参观歌剧院、龙边桥与陶瓷之路，穿梭小巷尝遍各式河粉，环西湖骑行，最后在传统蛋咖啡店结束这趟难忘的夜游。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
行程安排

  • 跳上摩托车后座，我们带您前往一家奥巴马总统曾光顾而闻名的当地餐厅，品尝河内最著名的美食之一——烤肉米线（Bún Chả）。
  • 下一站是法国区，参观河内歌剧院，您可以在这里拍摄美照，并了解这片区域的历史。
  • 随后我们骑行前往龙边桥，这座宏伟的建筑建于一百多年前，横跨红河，连接还剑郡和龙边郡，桥下还庇护着在船上生活的当地居民。桥上只允许摩托车和自行车通行——出发吧！
  • 回到摩托车上，我们沿着美丽的陶瓷之路和长阳桥继续前行，抵达下一个美食站，您将品尝“焦蒜暹罗鸭”和“肝酱暹罗鸭”。
  • 穿梭在有序又混乱的河内车流中，令人兴奋的骑行将带您来到另一家当地餐厅享用地道美食。接着我们钻进小巷，品尝不同风味的河粉，包括炒河粉（Phở Chiên Phồng）和河粉卷（Phở Cuốn），以及许多其他著名的越南美食。
  • 环西湖骑行，为您呈现大多数游客很少有机会看到的浪漫河内——一段充满“哇”时刻的体验。继续行程，我们骑行穿过市区，经过胡志明陵，在此停留拍摄夜景照片。
  • 再骑一小段路，我们来到一家传统蛋咖啡店，您将品尝河内著名的特色饮品。
  • 然后我们送您回酒店。挥手道别

费用包含

  • 摩托车、燃油、头盔
  • 经验丰富的专业骑手
  • 英语导游
  • 当地餐厅晚餐
  • 全程所有门票及冰水
  • 免费接送
  • 雨衣（如需要）

tours.title: EXPLORING THE NORTH OF THE RED RIVER
tours.summary: ITINERARY Vietlook Travel will drive you across the spectacular Long Bien Bridge that spans the Red River. We then ride our scooters along the riverbank toward the countryside, where you will see vast green rice paddies
tours.contentHtml:
ITINERARY

  • Vietlook Travel will drive you across the spectacular Long Bien Bridge that spans the Red River. We then ride our scooters along the riverbank toward the countryside, where you will see vast green rice paddies and rural villages hidden alongside the fields.
  • We continue riding through small alley roads in the middle of the rice paddies, enjoying an exciting off-road adventure. We will make some stops for you to learn how rice is grown and understand more about wet rice cultivation.
  • Back on the scooter, our authentic riders will take you to visit a 900 year old village that still preserves its ancient architecture. Here, you will learn about traditional culture and village life.
  • We then head to a local market to see how people buy and sell their daily essentials. You will also have the chance to try tropical fruits.
  • Next, we ride to visit the temple worshipping King An Duong Vuong. This ancient site dates back to 257 BC and was once the capital of Vietnam, known as Co Loa Citadel. It is the perfect place to learn about the history of Hanoi and Vietnam.
  • After visiting Co Loa Citadel, we take you to a local coffee shop to enjoy Vietnamese coffee and you can also try Hanoi’s famous Egg Coffee.
  • We then hop back on the scooter and head to a local restaurant for you to enjoy authentic Vietnamese cuisine. After lunch, our rider team will take you back to your hotel or drop you off anywhere you prefer. Just let us know. Goodbye.

INCLUDED

  • Scooter, fuel, helmet

  • Experienced professional riders

  • English-speaking guides

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • All entrance fees & cold water throughout the tour

  • Free pick-up and drop-off

  • Raincoat (if needed)
tours.titleZh: 探索红河北岸
tours.summaryZh: Vietlook Travel带您驱车驶过龙边桥，骑踏板摩托沿红河岸前往乡村，穿越稻田，参观900年历史古村、当地市集和古螺城，品尝蛋咖啡和地道越南午餐。含摩托、燃油、头盔、专业车手、英语导游、午餐及免费接送。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
行程安排

  • Vietlook Travel将带您驱车驶过横跨红河的壮观龙边桥。随后我们骑上踏板摩托，沿河岸驶向乡村，您将看到一望无际的绿色稻田和藏于田野间的乡村。
  • 我们继续穿行于稻田中的乡间小路，享受刺激的越野探险。途中会停留数处，让您了解水稻的种植方式，深入认识水稻耕作。
  • 重新骑上摩托后，我们地道的车手将带您参观一座有900年历史、仍保存着古老建筑的村庄。在这里，您将了解传统文化和村民生活。
  • 随后前往当地市集，看看人们如何买卖日常必需品。您还有机会品尝热带水果。
  • 接着，我们骑行前往参观供奉安阳王的庙宇。这处古迹可追溯至公元前257年，曾是越南的首都，即古螺城。这里是了解河内和越南历史的绝佳之地。
  • 参观古螺城后，我们带您前往当地咖啡馆，品尝越南咖啡，还可以尝试河内著名的蛋咖啡。
  • 随后我们再次骑上摩托，前往当地餐厅享用地道的越南美食。午餐后，车手团队会送您回酒店，或送您到任何您想去的地方，告诉我们即可。再见！

费用包含

  • 踏板摩托、燃油、头盔

  • 经验丰富的专业车手

  • 英语导游

  • 当地餐厅午餐

  • 全程所有门票及冰水

  • 免费接送

  • 雨衣（如需要）

tours.summary: Course Information Departure time: 12:30 – 13:00 Meeting point: After your reservation is confirmed, please provide your hotel address. Duration: 5 – 8 hours Drop-off location: Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) or your
tours.contentHtml:
Course Information 

  • Departure time: 12:30 – 13:00

  • Meeting point: After your reservation is confirmed, please provide your hotel address.

  • Duration: 5 – 8 hours

  • Drop-off location: Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) or your hotel

  • Places to visit: Hanoi Old House, Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi Church and Hanoi Train Track

Lunch Options

You may choose one of the following popular dishes for lunch:

  • Phở Lý Quốc Sư (Noodle soup – Ly Quoc Su Street)

  • Bún Chả – 01 Hàng Mành (Grilled pork with rice noodles – Hang Manh Street)

  • Bánh Cuốn – 12 Hàng Gà (Rolled steamed cake – Hang Ga Street)

Spa And Dinner

Spa Options

  • Labase Beauty Spa

  • Dalhye Beauty Spa

Dinner

Asian Fusion Set Menu at Koto Restaurant

– Starter –

  • Grilled Fish Crystal Rolls

  • US Beef Kumquat Salad

– Main Course –

  • Wok-fried Basil Chicken Thighs

  • BBQ Pork Spare Ribs

  • Stir-fried Seasonal Vegetables

  • Fragrant Steamed Rice

  • Soy Sauce Eggplant and Tofu

– Dessert –

  • Seasonal Fruit Platter

ONE DAY TRIP

Meal: Lunch, Dinner

12:30 The car and tour guide will pick you up at your hotel and take you for lunch with delicious Hanoi dishes such as Bún Chả, Phở, Bánh Cuốn, or Bánh Mì.

These are long-standing traditional specialties of Hanoi. Not only do local people love them, but international tourists and even world leaders visiting

Vietnam also look forward to having the chance to enjoy these dishes. They are not luxurious or expensive, but incredibly tasty and filled with the rich flavors of Vietnamese culinary culture.

13:30 Visit the Old Quarter with its ancient houses, hotels, restaurants, souvenir shops, and traditional market alleys. This is the busiest area of the city, where you will have the opportunity to learn about the daily life of Hanoi’s locals.

The next stop is the Ancient House at 87 Ma May Street. Built in the 19th century, this house represents Hanoi’s traditional architecture with an area of 157.6 m², along with many ancient artifacts still preserved inside, making it even more special.

14:30 Continue by car to visit the famous Train Track Coffee area. Enjoy a cup of coffee while admiring the railway line running between rows of ancient houses and crowds of visitors.

If you are lucky, you may see a train passing by—an unforgettable experience and a perfect chance to capture the typical cultural essence of Hanoi.

On the way to Hanoi Church, you will pass by many charming historical streets.

16:30 Arrive at the spa, where you will enjoy a 75-minute full-body massage at Labase Beauty Spa. This relaxing experience will leave you refreshed and energized for your night flight.

For customers who do not book the spa package, you will go directly to the restaurant for dinner.

18:00 Dinner will be served as a set menu at Koto Restaurant.

19:30 Depart for the airport.

20:15 Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport for your departure flight.

tours.summaryZh: 行程信息 出发时间：12:30 – 13:00 集合地点：预订确认后，请提供您的酒店地址。 时长：5 – 8小时 送达地点：内排国际机场(HAN)或您的酒店
tours.contentHtmlZh:

  • 出发时间： 12:30 – 13:00

  • 集合地点： 预订确认后，请提供您的酒店地址。

  • 时长： 5 – 8小时

午餐选择

您可以从以下热门菜肴中任选一道作为午餐：

  • Phở Lý Quốc Sư （河粉——李国师街）

  • Bún Chả – 01 Hàng Mành （烤肉米线——行蔓街）

水疗与晚餐

水疗选择

  • Dalhye Beauty Spa

晚餐

Koto餐厅亚洲融合套餐

– 前菜 –

  • 烤鱼水晶卷

  • 美国牛肉金桔沙拉

– 主菜 –

  • 香米饭

  • 酱油茄子豆腐

– 甜点 –

  • 时令水果拼盘

一日游

餐食：午餐、晚餐

12:30 车辆和导游将到酒店接您，带您享用美味的河内菜肴，例如 Bún Chả（烤肉米线）、 Phở（河粉）、 Bánh Cuốn（蒸卷粉）或 Bánh Mì（越式法棍）。

这些都是河内历史悠久的传统特色美食。不仅当地人喜爱，国际游客甚至到访

越南的世界领导人也期待有机会品尝这些美食。它们并不奢华或昂贵，却美味无比，饱含越南饮食文化的浓郁风味。

13:30 参观老城区，那里有古老的房屋、旅馆、餐厅、纪念品商店和传统市场小巷。这是城市最繁华的区域，您将有机会了解河内当地人的日常生活。

下一站是位于 马眉街(Mã Mây)87号的古宅。这座房屋建于19世纪，代表了河内的传统建筑，面积为 157.6平方米，内部还保存着许多古老文物，更显独特。

14:30 乘车继续前往著名的火车轨道咖啡区。品一杯咖啡，同时欣赏铁路线穿行于一排排古屋和熙攘人群之间的景象。

如果幸运，您可能会看到火车驶过——这是一次难忘的体验，也是捕捉河内典型文化精髓的绝佳机会。

前往河内大教堂途中，您将经过许多迷人的历史街道。

16:30 抵达水疗中心，您将在 Labase Beauty Spa 享受 75分钟全身按摩 。这次放松体验将让您焕发活力，从容迎接夜间航班。

20:15 抵达内排国际机场，搭乘您的离境航班。

tours.title: HANOI – HA LONG SONATA 5 STAR DAY CRUISE – NINH BINH
tours.summary: Ha Long – Ninh Binh 2 day, 1 night tour is an ideal journey for travelers seeking to explore the magnificent natural landscapes and rich cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Begin your adventure in Ha Long Bay, a UNESC
tours.contentHtml:
Ha Long – Ninh Binh 2 day, 1 night tour is an ideal journey for travelers seeking to explore the magnificent natural landscapes and rich cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Begin your adventure in Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its emerald waters, limestone karsts, and enchanting caves.

Continue to Ninh Binh, known for its breathtaking scenery, sacred pagodas, historic temples, and peaceful river valleys. With a well-organized itinerary and attentive service, this tour promises an unforgettable experience.

ITINERARY

Day 1: Hanoi – Ha Long Sonata 5 Star Day Cruise – Ninh Binh

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

08:00 – 08:45 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

The bus and tour guide will pick you up at your hotel and depart for Ha Long Bay via the modern expressway.

11:45 – Arrival at Tuan Chau Island

Enter the private waiting lounge and board the Halong Sonata 5-Star Day Cruise. Begin your captivating 6-hour journey following the iconic overnight cruise route, offering stunning views of uninhabited islets and magnificent limestone formations.

Buffet Lunch Onboard

Enjoy a buffet lunch while the cruise glides through the scenic bay.

Ha Long Bay Highlights

14:00 – 16:30 – Explore Bo Hon Archipelago

  • Visit Surprising Cave (Sung Sot Cave) with extraordinary stalactites and stalagmites

  • Explore Luon Cave by kayak or bamboo boat

  • Stop at Titov Island to swim or climb to the panoramic viewpoint

16:30 – Sunset Party

Return to the cruise for a Sunset Party with live traditional music as the boat heads back to Tuan Chau Harbor.

18:00 – Transfer to Ninh Binh
Have dinner en route and continue to Ninh Binh.

21:00 – Check-in at Homestay or Bungalow
Relax and enjoy the night at your accommodation.

Day 2: Bai Dinh or Hoa Lu – Trang An or Tam Coc – Mua Cave – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:00 – 09:00 – Breakfast at the Bungalow

09:30 – Pick-up for Day 2 Activities

Morning Options

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda

Visit the grand Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex with highlights such as:

  • 500 Arhat statues

  • Two giant bronze bells

  • Thousand-armed Quan Yin statue

  • Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Explore Vietnam’s former capital and visit Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple.

Lunch

12:00 – Lunch at Local Restaurant

Afternoon Options

Option 1: Trang An Boat Trip

Sampan ride through a network of caves and temples including Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, Thanh Truot Cave, and more.

Option 2: Tam Coc Boat Trip

1.5-hour sampan journey through “Three Caves,” surrounded by limestone mountains, rice paddies, and peaceful streams.

Mua Cave And Ngoa Long Mountain

16:00 – Visit Mua Cave

Hike to the viewpoint for a spectacular panoramic view of the rice valley.

17:00 – Return to Hanoi

19:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at the original meeting point. The tour concludes.

INCLUSION

  • Modern bus or limousine bus

  • Halong Sonata 5-Star Cruise with buffet lunch, live traditional music, jacuzzi

  • English-speaking guide

  • 2 lunches, 1 breakfast, 1 dinner

  • All entrance fees

  • Accommodation at homestay or bungalow

  • Cycling and swimming at the bungalow

EXCLUSION

  • Beverages and travel insurance

  • Kayaking or bamboo boat (5 USD)

  • Electric car at Bai Dinh Pagoda

  • Guide overnight at bungalow

  • Tips and personal expenses

  • Children policies and single supplement as stated
tours.titleZh: 河内—下龙Sonata五星一日游轮—宁平
tours.summaryZh: 下龙湾—宁平2天1晚之旅，是探索越南北部壮丽自然风光和丰富文化遗产的理想旅程。从联合国教科文组织世界遗产下龙湾出发，随后前往以绝美风景、神圣寺庙和宁静河谷著称的宁平。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
下龙湾—宁平2天1晚之旅，是为渴望探索越南北部壮丽自然风光和丰富文化遗产的旅行者量身打造的理想旅程。冒险从下龙湾开始，这处联合国教科文组织世界遗产以翡翠般的海水、石灰岩山峰和迷人的洞穴而闻名。

随后前往宁平，这里以令人叹为观止的风景、神圣的寺庙、历史悠久的古庙和宁静的河谷著称。行程安排周密、服务周到，保证带给您难忘的体验。

行程安排

第1天：河内 – 下龙湾Sonata 5星日间游轮 – 宁平

含餐：午餐、晚餐

08:00 – 08:45 – 酒店接客

巴士和导游在您的酒店接您，经现代化高速公路前往下龙湾。

11:45 – 抵达屯洲岛（Tuần Châu）

进入专属候船厅，登上下龙湾Sonata 5星日间游轮。沿着经典的过夜游轮航线开启6小时的迷人旅程，欣赏无人小岛和雄伟石灰岩地貌的绝美景色。

船上自助午餐

游轮在风景如画的海湾中滑行，您可享用自助午餐。

下龙湾亮点

14:00 – 16:30 – 探索Bồ Hòn群岛

  • 参观惊讶洞（Sửng Sốt洞），洞内钟乳石和石笋形态奇特

  • 乘皮划艇或竹筏探索Luồn洞

  • 在提托夫岛（Titov）停留，可游泳或登上全景观景台

16:30 – 日落派对

返回游轮参加日落派对，伴有传统音乐现场演奏，游轮驶回屯洲港。

18:00 – 前往宁平
途中用晚餐，继续前往宁平。

21:00 – 入住民宿或平房
在住处放松身心，享受夜晚。

第2天：白丁寺或华闾 – 长安或三谷 – 木洞 – 河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

07:00 – 09:00 – 在平房享用早餐

09:30 – 接客开始第2天活动

上午可选项目

方案1：白丁寺（Bái Đính）

参观宏伟的白丁寺建筑群，亮点包括：

  • 500尊罗汉像

  • 两口巨型铜钟

  • 千手观音像

  • 释迦牟尼佛像

方案2：华闾古都

探索越南昔日的都城，参观丁先皇庙和黎大行皇庙。

午餐

12:00 – 当地餐厅午餐

下午可选项目

方案1：长安（Tràng An）游船

乘坐小舢板穿行于由洞穴和庙宇组成的水道网络，途经Lâm洞、Vàng洞、Đại洞、Thánh Trượt洞等。

方案2：三谷（Tam Cốc）游船

乘坐小舢板开始1.5小时的“三洞”之旅，四周环绕着石灰岩山峰、稻田和宁静的溪流。

木洞与卧龙山

16:00 – 参观木洞（Hang Múa）

徒步登上观景台，欣赏稻谷山谷的壮丽全景。

17:00 – 返回河内

19:00 – 抵达河内

送回最初的集合地点，行程结束。

费用包含

  • 现代化巴士或豪华小巴

  • 下龙湾Sonata 5星游轮，含自助午餐、传统音乐现场演奏、按摩浴缸

  • 英语导游

  • 2顿午餐、1顿早餐、1顿晚餐

  • 所有门票

  • 民宿或平房住宿

  • 在平房骑行和游泳

费用不包含

  • 饮品和旅行保险

  • 皮划艇或竹筏（5 USD）

  • 白丁寺电瓶车

  • 导游在平房过夜

  • 小费和个人消费

  • 儿童政策及单人房差按所述规定执行

tours.title: Hanoi – Sapa – CatCat – Lao Chai – Ta Van – Hanoi
tours.summary: Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 2 days and 1 night in Sapa while saving time and visiting the most popular attractions. Enjoy a comfortable hotel stay, lower costs compared to the night train, and f
tours.contentHtml:
Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 2 days and 1 night in Sapa while saving time and visiting the most popular attractions. Enjoy a comfortable hotel stay, lower costs compared to the night train, and friendly services throughout the trip.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa by Bus – Short Trek to Cat Cat Village

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30

Welcome at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45

Travel along the highway to Lao Cai City with a comfort break on the way.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue on the mountain road to Sapa Town, enjoying beautiful views of valleys and terraced rice fields.

13:00

Arrive in Sapa Town, where you will meet ethnic groups such as the H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay in colorful traditional costumes.

  • Welcome drink and itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Take a short walk to Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people and located at the bottom of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

Your local guide will show you daily life in the village. Trek down to the valley to visit the waterfall and the French Hydroelectric

Power Station. After taking photos at the bridge and waterfall, trek uphill toward Sapa.

Trekking distance: 2.5 km (approx. 2 hours)

Driver picks you up and returns you to Sapa Town.

17:00

Return to Sapa Town. Enjoy dinner and stay overnight at the hotel. Free time for evening activities.

Day 2: Sapa – Y Linh Ho – Lao Chai – Ta Van – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:00 – 07:45

Have breakfast at the hotel and prepare a light pack for the day’s trek.

08:00

A short drive to Y Linh Ho Village, then begin trekking through rice terraces and along Muong Hoa Stream to the Black H’Mong village of Lao Chai. Continue to Ta Van Village, home of the Dzay ethnic people, while enjoying the spectacular landscape of the Hoang Lien Son Mountain Range.

Trekking distance: 9 km (approx. 3.5 hours)

11:30

Bus picks you up at Ta Van Bridge and transfers you back to Sapa.

12:00 – 13:00

Have a shower at the hotel, check out, enjoy lunch, and spend some free time in Sapa.

13:00 – 13:30

Meet the group at the hotel and prepare for departure.

14:00

Board the bus back to Hanoi with two comfort breaks.

20:30 – 21:00

Arrive at the bus station in Hanoi. The trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Sleeper bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (tour guide not available on the bus)

  • English-speaking tour guide during the trip in Sapa

  • Accommodation in Sapa (double/twin/triple sharing room)

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 dinner, 1 breakfast

  • All entrance tickets to indicated sites

Trip Excludes

  • Return ticket for Cable Car Sapa – Fansipan – Sapa: 32 USD (weekday) / 34 USD (Saturday)

  • Government tax, beverages

  • Tips for tour guides and drivers, travel insurance

  • Other services not clearly mentioned

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD per person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD per person (round trip)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat: 20 USD per person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble: 26 USD per person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Children under 5 years (or under 1 meter): Free of charge (based on 2 adults + 1 child sharing bed/berth/bus seat)

  • Children 5 – 8 years old: 75% of adult price, sharing bed with adult

  • Children 9 years old and above: Charged as adult

Surcharge Policy

  • Surcharges apply during national holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothes, scarf, hat, cap (cold weather from September to March)

  • Note: Sapa may be foggy in December, January, February, and March

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong (bank services may be unstable; USD, EUR, AUD accepted)

Tour Price per Person

  • 90 USD per person – 3-star hotel

  • 98 USD per person – 4-star hotel

  • 125 USD per person – 5-star hotel
tours.titleZh: 河内—沙坝—猫猫村—老柴—达旺—河内
tours.summaryZh: 沙坝之旅专为想在沙坝度过2天1晚、节省时间并游览最热门景点的旅行者设计。享受舒适的酒店住宿、比夜间火车更低的费用，以及全程友好的服务。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
沙坝之旅专为想在沙坝度过2天1晚、节省时间并游览最热门景点的旅行者设计。您将享受舒适的酒店住宿、比夜间火车更低的费用，以及全程友好的服务。

行程安排

第1天：河内–乘巴士前往沙坝–短途徒步猫猫村

含餐：午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30

在巴士站迎接，登上卧铺巴士，启程前往沙坝。

07:30 – 11:45

沿高速公路前往老街市，途中休息一次。

11:45 – 13:00

继续沿山路前往沙坝镇，欣赏山谷和梯田的美景。

13:00

抵达沙坝镇，您将遇到身着五彩传统服饰的苗族、瑶族和岱族等少数民族。

  • 欢迎饮品和行程介绍

  • 享用越南地方菜肴午餐

  • 酒店入住

14:30

短途步行前往猫猫村，这里是黑苗族人的家园，位于番西邦峰山脚下的深谷谷底。

当地导游将带您了解村里的日常生活。徒步下到山谷，参观瀑布和法国水电站

。在桥上和瀑布前拍照后，上坡徒步返回沙坝。

徒步距离：2.5公里（约2小时）

司机接您并送回沙坝镇。

17:00

返回沙坝镇。享用晚餐并在酒店过夜。晚间自由活动。

第2天：沙坝–Y Linh Hồ–老寨–踏文–河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

07:00 – 07:45

在酒店用早餐，并准备当天徒步的轻便背包。

08:00

短途驱车前往Y Linh Hồ村，然后开始徒步，穿越梯田，沿Mường Hoa溪前往黑苗族村落老寨（Lao Chải）。继续前往踏文村（Tả Van），这里是佐依族（Dzáy）人的家园，同时欣赏黄连山脉的壮丽风光。

徒步距离：9公里（约3.5小时）

11:30

巴士在踏文桥接您，送回沙坝。

12:00 – 13:00

在酒店冲澡、退房、用午餐，并在沙坝享受一些自由时间。

13:00 – 13:30

在酒店与团队会合，准备出发。

14:00

乘上返回河内的巴士，途中休息两次。

20:30 – 21:00

抵达河内巴士站。行程结束。

行程包含

  • 卧铺巴士河内–沙坝–河内（巴士上无导游）

  • 沙坝行程期间的英语导游

  • 沙坝住宿（双人/双床/三人合住房）

  • 餐食：2顿午餐、1顿晚餐、1顿早餐

  • 所示景点的所有门票

行程不包含

  • 沙坝–番西邦–沙坝缆车往返票：32 USD（平日）/ 34 USD（周六）

  • 政府税费、饮品

  • 导游和司机小费、旅游保险

  • 其他未明确提及的服务

  • 卧铺巴士铺位附加费：

    • 单人铺位：每人12 USD（往返）

    • 共享铺位：每人8 USD（往返）

  • Dcar豪华商务车VIP座位：每人20 USD（往返）

  • 豪华商务车28座Nouble：每人26 USD（往返）

儿童政策

  • 5岁以下儿童（或身高1米以下）：免费（按2名成人+1名儿童共用床/铺位/巴士座位计算）

  • 5 – 8岁儿童：成人价格的75%，与成人同床

  • 9岁及以上儿童：按成人收费

附加费政策

  • 国定假日期间需收取附加费

随身携带物品

  • 保暖衣物、围巾、帽子、鸭舌帽（9月至3月天气寒冷）

  • 注：沙坝在12月、1月、2月和3月可能有雾

  • 徒步鞋、太阳镜、防晒霜、驱虫剂

  • 越南盾现金（银行服务可能不稳定；接受美元、欧元、澳元）

每人行程价格

  • 每人90 USD – 3星级酒店

  • 每人98 USD – 4星级酒店

  • 每人125 USD – 5星级酒店

tours.title: Hanoi – Sapa – Fansipan – CatCat – Moana View Or Ham Rong
tours.summary: Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 2 days and 2 nights in Sapa, saving time while still visiting the most popular destinations. Stay in a comfortable hotel, explore Fansipan Peak and enjoy friendly and
tours.contentHtml:
Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 2 days and 2 nights in Sapa, saving time while still visiting the most popular destinations. Stay in a comfortable hotel, explore Fansipan Peak and enjoy friendly and attentive service throughout the trip.

Itinerary

Night 1: Hanoi – Sapa by Sleeper Bus

Meals Included: None

21:30 – 21:45

Welcome at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and depart for Sapa. Overnight on the bus.

Day 1: Sapa – Fansipan – Short Trek to Cat Cat Village

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30

Arrive at Sapa Bus Station and transfer to the hotel for breakfast.

08:00

The driver and tour guide will take you to the Cable Car Station. Enjoy a 20-minute cable car ride with spectacular views.

09:00

Arrive at 2,800 meters, take photos, enjoy panoramic mountain views, visit the pagoda complex, and hike 600 steps to reach the summit of Fansipan – the highest peak in Indochina. (Approx. 1.5 hours of hiking and photography)

11:30

Return to the Cable Car Station and head back to Sapa Town.

12:00

Enjoy lunch with local Vietnamese dishes, followed by hotel check-in.

14:30

Start a short walk to Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong ethnic people and located at the bottom of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

Your local guide will introduce the daily life and traditional practices of the villagers. Trek down to the valley to see the waterfall and the Hydroelectric Power Station built by the French. After some time for photos at the bridge and waterfall, trek uphill to return to Sapa. The driver will pick you up from the main road.

17:00

Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel. Free evening to explore Sapa.

Day 2: Sapa – Moana View or Ham Rong Mountain – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:00

Breakfast at the hotel.

Option 1: Moana View Check-in Point

08:00

Take a short walk to Moana View, located 700 meters from Sapa Church. This is a trendy check-in location created especially for young travelers who love unique photo spots.

You will take photographs at:

  • Bali Gate

  • Infinity Lake

  • Moana Girl Statue

  • Golden Hand

  • Thrilling Swing

  • Lonely Tree

  • Panoramic Café overlooking Fansipan Peak and Muong Hoa Valley

Prepare beautiful clothes and accessories for your best photos.

Option 2: Ham Rong Mountain

08:30

Begin trekking up Ham Rong Mountain (Dragon’s Jaw).

Visit:

  • Ham Rong Botanical Garden

  • Landscaped orchid gardens

  • Stone pathways and panoramic viewpoints

The trek is uphill and can be strenuous, but the panoramic views of Sapa Town and surrounding valleys are worth the effort.
Note: Stone steps may be slippery on rainy or foggy days.

11:00

Return to the hotel, check out, and have lunch. Free time to enjoy Sapa.

13:00 – 14:00

Board the bus back to Hanoi with comfort breaks.

20:00 – 20:30

Arrive at the bus station in Hanoi. The trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Sleeper bus ticket Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (tour guide not available on the bus)

  • English-speaking tour guide during the trip in Sapa

  • Hotel accommodation in double/twin sharing room

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 dinner, 2 breakfasts

  • All entrance tickets as mentioned in the itinerary

Trip Excludes

  • Return cable car ticket Sapa – Fansipan – Sapa:

    • 32 USD (weekday)

    • 34 USD (Saturday)

  • Government tax, beverages

  • Tips for tour guides and drivers, travel insurance

  • Services not clearly mentioned

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD per person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD per person (round trip)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat surcharge: 20 USD per person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble surcharge: 26 USD per person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Children under 5 years old (or under 1 meter): Free of charge (based on 2 adults + 1 child sharing bed/berth/bus seat)

  • Children 5 – 8 years old: 75% of adult price (sharing bed with adult)

  • Children 9 years old and above: Charged as adult

Surcharge Policy

  • Additional surcharges apply on National Holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothes, scarf, hat, cap (Sapa is usually cold from September to March)

  • Note: Sapa often has fog in December, January, February, and March

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong (local banking can be unreliable; USD, EUR, and AUD are accepted in Sapa)

Tour Price per Person 

  • 92 USD per person – 3-star hotel

  • 102 USD per person – 4-star hotel

  • 124 USD per person – 5-star hotel
tours.titleZh: 河内—沙坝—番西邦—猫猫村—Moana观景台或咸龙山
tours.summaryZh: 沙坝2天2晚行程，专为希望节省时间又想游览最热门景点的旅行者设计。入住舒适酒店，登上番西邦峰，全程享受热情周到的服务。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
沙坝之旅 专为希望在沙坝度过2天2晚的旅行者设计，节省时间的同时游览最受欢迎的景点。入住舒适的酒店，探索番西邦峰，全程享受热情周到的服务。

行程

第1夜：河内 – 沙坝（卧铺巴士）

含餐：无

21:30 – 21:45

在巴士站迎接，登上卧铺巴士，前往沙坝。夜宿巴士上。

第1天：沙坝 – 番西邦峰 – 徒步前往猫猫村

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30

抵达沙坝巴士站，转乘前往酒店享用早餐。

08:00

司机和导游将带您前往缆车站。乘坐20分钟的缆车，沿途景色壮观。

09:00

抵达海拔2,800米处，拍照留念，欣赏群山全景，参观寺庙群，并攀登600级台阶登顶番西邦峰——中南半岛最高峰。（徒步和拍照约1.5小时）

11:30

返回缆车站，回到沙坝镇。

12:00

享用当地越南菜午餐，随后办理酒店入住。

14:30

开始徒步前往猫猫村（Cat Cat），这里是黑苗族人的家园，位于番西邦峰脚下深谷的底部。

当地向导将为您介绍村民的日常生活和传统习俗。徒步下到山谷，观赏瀑布和法国人修建的水力发电站。在桥边和瀑布旁拍照后，徒步上坡返回沙坝。司机将在大路旁接您。

17:00

返回沙坝镇。享用晚餐并留宿酒店。晚上自由活动，漫步沙坝。

第2天：沙坝 – Moana景区或龙颔山 – 河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

07:00

酒店早餐。

选择1：Moana景区打卡点

08:00

步行前往 Moana景区，距离沙坝教堂700米。这是专为热爱独特拍照地点的年轻旅行者打造的潮流打卡胜地。

您将在以下地点拍照：

  • 巴厘岛之门

  • 无边际湖

  • Moana女孩雕像

  • 黄金之手

  • 刺激秋千

  • 孤独树

  • 可俯瞰番西邦峰和芒花山谷的全景咖啡厅

请准备好漂亮的服装和配饰，拍出最美的照片。

选择2：龙颔山

08:30

开始徒步登上 龙颔山（龙之颚）。

参观：

  • 龙颔山植物园

  • 精心布置的兰花园

  • 石径和全景观景台

徒步为上坡路，可能较为吃力，但沙坝镇和周围山谷的全景值得您付出努力。
注意：雨天或有雾的日子，石阶可能湿滑。

11:00

返回酒店，退房并享用午餐。自由时间，随意游览沙坝。

13:00 – 14:00

乘坐巴士返回河内，途中设有休息站。

20:00 – 20:30

抵达河内巴士站。行程结束。

行程包含

tours.title: Sapa – CatCat – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall
tours.summary: Sapa sits at an altitude of 1,600 meters above sea level and enjoys a temperate climate with average temperatures ranging from 15°C to 18°C. Cool throughout the year and occasionally snowy in winter, Sapa was discovered
tours.contentHtml:
Sapa sits at an altitude of 1,600 meters above sea level and enjoys a temperate climate with average temperatures ranging from 15°C to 18°C. Cool throughout the year and occasionally snowy in winter, Sapa was discovered by the French in the early 20th century for its scenic beauty, fresh climate, and natural water sources.

Visitors can admire remnants of French architecture, ethnic minority villages and iconic attractions such as Silver Waterfall, Heaven’s Gate, Cloud Bridge, Wind Cave, and Ham Rong Mountain. This tour is perfect for nature lovers and travelers interested in local cultures and traditions.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa – Cat Cat Village – Sapa

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30

Meet at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and depart for Sapa via the Noi Bai – Lao Cai Expressway.

07:30 – 11:45

Travel along the expressway toward Lao Cai City with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue on the mountain road toward Sapa Town, passing stunning valley and terraced-field scenery.

13:00

Arrive in Sapa Town, where ethnic groups such as the H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay appear in colorful traditional clothes.

  • Welcome drink and itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Drive to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people, located at the bottom of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

Your guide will introduce the culture, daily activities, and traditional crafts of the villagers.

Trek down to the waterfall and visit the French-built Hydroelectric Power Station. Take photos at the bridge and waterfall before trekking uphill back to Sapa.

Trekking distance: 2.5 km (approx. 2 hours)

16:30

Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel. Free time for evening activities.

Day 2: Sapa – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:00

Wake up to a beautiful sunrise over the Sapa mountains. Enjoy breakfast at the hotel.

08:00

Begin your exploration of Dragon Cloud, the Glass Bridge, Lonely Tree, and Silver Waterfall.

Along the way, stop at the summit of O Quy Ho Pass, one of Vietnam’s Four Great Passes, located at 2,333 meters above sea level. This is a famous spot for cloud hunting and panoramic photography.

At the Dragon Cloud Glass Bridge, you will:

  • Check in at the colorful staircase

  • Take the elevator to the Hao Han Qiao Glass Bridge (three transparent sides)

  • Walk along the 768-meter structure perched 1,000 meters above the mountainside

  • Have free time to explore and take photos
    Optional activities inside the tourist area are available for purchase.

11:30

Return to the hotel for check-out.

12:00

Have lunch at the hotel.

13:30

Board the bus back to Hanoi with a comfort stop and a short shopping break.

20:00

Arrive at the Hanoi bus station. The tour ends.

Included Services

  • Sleeper bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (no tour guide on the bus)

  • Sightseeing bus in Sapa as per itinerary

  • Local English-speaking guide in Sapa

  • 1 breakfast and 3 main meals

  • Entrance tickets: Cat Cat Village, Glass Bridge, Lonely Tree, Silver Waterfall

  • 3–4–5 star hotel accommodation (2 guests per room; 3 guests for odd-number groups)

  • Insurance in accordance with bus company policy

Excluded Services

  • Drinks during meals

  • Personal expenses outside the itinerary

  • Single room surcharge

  • VAT

  • Tour guide on bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD per person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: $8 per person (one way)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat surcharge: 20 USD per person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble surcharge: 16 USD per person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Under 5 years old (or under 1 meter): Free of charge (2 adults + 1 child sharing bed/berth/bus seat)

  • 5 – 8 years old: 75% of adult price, sharing bed with adult

  • 9 years old and above: Charged as adult

Surcharge Policy

  • Surcharges apply during National Holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothes, scarf, hat, cap (Sapa is cold from September to March)

  • Note: Fog is common in December, January, February, and March

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Cash in VND (banking services in Sapa may be unstable; USD, EUR, AUD accepted)

Tour Price Per Person 

  • 124 USD per person – 3-star hotel

  • 130 USD per person – 4-star hotel

  • 150 USD per person – 5-star hotel
tours.titleZh: 沙坝—猫猫村—玻璃桥—孤树—银瀑布
tours.summaryZh: 沙坝海拔1,600米，气候温和，全年凉爽。本行程探访猫猫寨、龙云玻璃桥、孤树、银瀑布和欧贵湖山口，适合热爱大自然和对当地文化感兴趣的旅行者。3星级每人124美元起。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
沙坝 位于海拔1,600米处，气候温和，平均气温在15°C至18°C之间。沙坝全年凉爽，冬季偶有降雪，20世纪初被法国人发现，因其秀美的风光、清新的气候和天然的水源而闻名。

游客可以欣赏法式建筑遗迹、少数民族村寨，以及银瀑布、天门、云桥、风洞和龙颔山（Hàm Rồng）等标志性景点。本行程非常适合热爱大自然以及对当地文化和传统感兴趣的旅行者。

行程安排

第1天：河内 – 沙坝 – 猫猫寨 – 沙坝

含餐食：午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30

在汽车站集合，登上卧铺大巴，经内排–老街高速前往沙坝。

07:30 – 11:45

沿高速公路前往老街市，途中安排休息。

11:45 – 13:00

继续沿山路前往沙坝镇，沿途穿过令人惊叹的山谷和梯田风光。

13:00

抵达沙坝镇，苗族、瑶族和岱族等少数民族身着色彩斑斓的传统服饰。

  • 欢迎饮品及行程说明

  • 品尝越南当地菜肴的午餐

  • 酒店入住

14:30

驱车前往 猫猫寨寨门，这里是黑苗族的家园，坐落于番西邦峰脚下深谷的谷底。

导游将介绍村民的文化、日常活动和传统手工艺。

徒步下到瀑布，参观法国人修建的水电站。在桥上和瀑布前拍照后，徒步上山返回沙坝。

徒步距离：2.5公里（约2小时）

16:30

返回沙坝镇。享用晚餐并在酒店过夜。晚间自由活动。

第2天：沙坝 – 玻璃桥 – 孤树 – 银瀑布 – 河内

含餐食：早餐、午餐

07:00

迎着沙坝群山上美丽的日出醒来。在酒店享用早餐。

08:00

开始探索龙云、玻璃桥、孤树和银瀑布。

途中，在 欧贵湖山口山顶停留，这里是越南 四大名关之一，海拔2,333米，是著名的追云和全景拍摄地点。

在 龙云玻璃桥，您将：

  • 在色彩缤纷的阶梯打卡

  • 乘坐电梯前往 好汉桥玻璃桥 （三面透明）

  • 漫步于这座长768米、悬于山腰上方1,000米处的建筑

  • 自由探索并拍照留念
    景区内的自选活动可另行购买。

11:30

返回酒店办理退房。

12:00

在酒店享用午餐。

13:30

乘车返回河内，途中安排休息和短暂购物时间。

20:00

抵达河内汽车站，行程结束。

服务包含

  • 河内 – 沙坝 – 河内卧铺大巴（车上无导游）

  • 沙坝按行程安排的观光巴士

  • 沙坝当地英语导游

  • 1顿早餐和3顿正餐

  • 门票：猫猫寨、玻璃桥、孤树、银瀑布

  • 3–4–5星级酒店住宿（2位客人一间；奇数人数团队安排3人一间）

  • 按巴士公司规定的保险

服务不含

  • 用餐期间的饮品

  • 行程以外的个人消费

  • 单人房差

  • 增值税

  • 河内 – 沙坝 – 河内巴士上的导游

  • 卧铺大巴包厢附加费：

    • 单人包厢：每人12美元（往返）

    • 拼用包厢：每人$8（单程）

  • Dcar豪华商务车VIP座位附加费：每人20美元（往返）

  • 豪华28座Limousine Nouble附加费：每人16美元（往返）

儿童政策

  • 5岁以下（或身高1米以下）：免费（2位成人+1名儿童共用床位/铺位/座位）

  • 5–8岁：成人价的75%，与成人共用床位

  • 9岁及以上：按成人收费

附加费政策

  • 国定假日期间另收附加费

建议携带物品

  • 保暖衣物、围巾、帽子（沙坝9月至次年3月天气寒冷）

  • 注意：12月、1月、2月和3月多雾

  • 徒步鞋、太阳镜、防晒霜、驱虫剂

  • 携带越南盾现金（沙坝的银行服务可能不稳定；也接受美元、欧元、澳元）

团费 每人 

  • 每人124美元——3星级酒店

  • 每人130美元——4星级酒店

  • 每人150美元——5星级酒店

tours.contentHtml:
This tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 2 days and 1 night in Sapa while saving time, visiting the most popular destinations, and enjoying comfortable hotel accommodation. The trip costs less than taking the night train and includes friendly services throughout.

Itinerary

Travel along the highway to Lao Cai City with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

14:30

Take a short walk to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people and situated at the bottom of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

Trek down to visit the waterfall and the Hydroelectric Power Station built by the French. Take photos at the bridge and waterfall, then trek uphill to return to Sapa.

The driver will pick you up and transfer you back to town.

17:00

Have breakfast at the hotel and prepare your camera for the check-in session.

08:00

Begin a short walk to Moana View, located only 700 meters from Sapa Church.

This popular check-in complex is designed especially for young travelers who enjoy unique and creative photo spots.

You will take photos at:

  • Bali Gate

  • Infinity Lake

  • Moana Girl Statue

  • Golden Hand

  • Thrilling Swing

  • Lonely Tree

  • Panoramic Café overlooking Fansipan Peak and Muong Hoa Valley

Prepare stylish outfits and accessories for your best photos.

12:00 – 13:30

Return to the hotel for check-out, have lunch, and enjoy some free time in Sapa.

13:30 – 14:00

Board the bus back to Hanoi with a comfort break on the way.

20:00 – 20:30

Arrive at the bus station in Hanoi. The trip ends.

Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 3 days and 2 nights in Sapa while saving time and visiting the most popular destinations. You will stay in a comfortable hotel and conquer Fansipan Peak – “The Roof of Indochina.” The tour also includes friendly and attentive service throughout your journey.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa by Bus – Short Trek to Cat Cat Village

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30

Meet at the bus station and board the sleeper bus to Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45

Travel along the highway to Lao Cai City with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue on the mountain road to Sapa Town, enjoying beautiful views of valleys and terraced fields.

13:00 – 13:30

Arrive in Sapa Town, where you will see ethnic minorities such as the H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay in traditional colorful clothing.

  • Welcome drink and itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Begin a short walk to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong ethnic people, located at the foot of Fansipan Peak.
Your local guide will show you the daily life of the villagers. Trek down to the valley to visit the waterfall and the Hydroelectric Power Station built by the French. Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel. Free time for evening activities.

Day 2: Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Moana View

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

08:00

After breakfast, the driver and tour guide will take you to the Cable Car Station. Enjoy a 20-minute cable car ride with spectacular mountain scenery.

09:00

Arrive at 2,800 meters above sea level. Take photos, enjoy the mountain views, visit the pagoda area, and trek 600 steps to reach the summit of Fansipan – “The Roof of Indochina.”
You will spend about 1.5 hours hiking and taking photos.

11:30

Return to the Cable Car Station and head back to Sapa Town.

12:00

Lunch at a local restaurant or at the hotel.

Afternoon – Visit Moana View

Take an easy walk to Moana View, located 700 meters from Sapa Church. This is the latest check-in point specially designed for young travelers who enjoy creative, impressive photo spots.

At Moana View, you can take photos at:

  • Bali Gate

  • Infinity Lake

  • Moana Girl Statue

  • Golden Hand

  • Thrilling Swing

  • Lonely Tree

  • Panoramic Café with views of Fansipan Peak and Muong Hoa Valley

Prepare beautiful outfits and accessories to capture your best photos.

17:00

Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel.

Day 3: Sapa – Hanoi by Bus

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

Morning

Have breakfast at the hotel, then enjoy free time to explore Sapa on your own.

12:00

Check out of your hotel, have lunch, and enjoy your remaining time in Sapa.

13:00 – 14:00

Board the bus back to Hanoi, with comfort breaks on the way.

20:00 – 20:30

Arrive at the bus station in Hanoi. The trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Sleeper bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi with modern facilities (tour guide not available on the bus)

  • English-speaking tour guide during the trip in Sapa

  • Hotel accommodation in double/twin room (twin sharing basis)

  • Meals: 3 lunches, 2 dinners, 2 breakfasts

  • All entrance tickets as mentioned in the itinerary

Trip Excludes

  • Return Cable Car Ticket Sapa – Fansipan – Sapa:

    • 32 USD (weekday)

    • 34 USD (Saturday)

  • Government tax, beverages

  • Tips for tour guides and drivers, travel insurance

  • Services not clearly mentioned above

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharges:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD per person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD per person (round trip)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat surcharge: 20 USD per person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble surcharge: 26 USD per person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Children under 5 years old (or under 1 meter tall): Free of charge (based on 2 adults + 1 child sharing bed/berth/bus seat)

  • Children 5 – 8 years old: 75% of adult price (sharing bed with adults)

  • Children 9 years old and above: Charged as adults

Surcharge Policy

  • Additional charges apply on National Holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothes, scarf, hat, cap (Sapa is cold from September to March)

  • Note: Sapa is often foggy in December, January, February, and March

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong (local banking may be unstable; USD, EUR, AUD are accepted)

Tour Price per Person

  • 124 USD per person – 4-star hotel

  • 172 USD per person – 5-star hotel
tours.titleZh: 河内—沙坝—猫猫村—番西邦—Moana沙坝
tours.summaryZh: 沙坝之旅专为希望在沙坝度过3天2夜、既节省时间又游览最热门目的地的旅行者设计。您将入住舒适的酒店，并征服番西邦峰——“印度支那屋脊”。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
沙坝之旅专为希望在沙坝度过3天2夜、既节省时间又游览最热门目的地的旅行者设计。您将入住舒适的酒店，并征服番西邦峰——“印度支那屋脊”。行程全程还配有友好周到的服务。

行程安排

第1天：河内 – 乘巴士前往沙坝 – 短途徒步猫猫村（Cát Cát）

含餐：午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30

在车站集合，登上前往沙坝的卧铺巴士。

07:30 – 11:45

沿高速公路前往老街市，途中安排休息。

11:45 – 13:00

继续沿山路前往沙坝镇，欣赏山谷和梯田的美丽风光。

13:00 – 13:30

抵达沙坝镇，您将看到身着色彩斑斓传统服饰的苗族、瑶族和岱族等少数民族。

  • 欢迎饮品及行程说明

  • 越南当地风味午餐

  • 酒店入住

14:30

开始短途步行前往猫猫村（Cát Cát）入口，这里是黑苗族少数民族的家园，位于番西邦峰脚下。
当地导游将带您了解村民的日常生活。徒步下到山谷，参观瀑布和法国人修建的水力发电站。在瀑布和桥上花些时间拍照，然后徒步上坡返回主路。司机将接您送回沙坝。

徒步距离：约2.5公里（约2小时）

17:00

返回沙坝镇。享用晚餐并在酒店住宿。晚间自由活动。

第2天：沙坝 – 番西邦峰 – Moana View

含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

08:00

早餐后，司机和导游将带您前往缆车站。乘坐20分钟的缆车，饱览壮观的山景。

09:00

抵达海拔2,800米处。拍照、欣赏山景、参观寺庙区，并攀登600级台阶登上番西邦峰顶——“印度支那屋脊”。
您将花约1.5小时徒步和拍照。

11:30

返回缆车站，回到沙坝镇。

12:00

在当地餐厅或酒店用午餐。

下午 – 参观Moana View

轻松步行前往距沙坝教堂700米的Moana View。这是专为喜爱创意、震撼拍照点的年轻旅行者设计的最新打卡地。

在Moana View，您可以在以下地点拍照：

  • 巴厘岛之门

  • 无边际湖

  • Moana女孩雕像

  • 黄金之手

  • 惊险秋千

  • 孤独之树

  • 全景咖啡馆，可眺望番西邦峰和木花山谷（Mường Hoa）

请准备好漂亮的服装和配饰，拍出您最美的照片。

17:00

返回沙坝镇。享用晚餐并在酒店住宿。

第3天：沙坝 – 乘巴士返回河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

上午

在酒店享用早餐，然后自由活动，自行探索沙坝。

12:00

酒店退房，享用午餐，并享受在沙坝的剩余时光。

13:00 – 14:00

登上返回河内的巴士，途中安排休息。

20:00 – 20:30

抵达河内汽车站，行程结束。

行程包含

  • 设施现代化的卧铺巴士 河内 – 沙坝 – 河内（巴士上无导游随行）

  • 沙坝行程期间的英语导游

  • 酒店住宿，双人间/双床间（双人合住）

  • 餐食：3顿午餐、2顿晚餐、2顿早餐

  • 行程所列的全部门票

行程不含

tours.title: Hanoi – Sapa – CatCat – Fansipan – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall – Moana View
tours.summary: Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 3 days and 2 nights in Sapa, visiting the most popular attractions while staying in a comfortable hotel. You will also visit Fansipan Peak, known as “The Roof of Indo
tours.contentHtml:
Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 3 days and 2 nights in Sapa, visiting the most popular attractions while staying in a comfortable hotel. You will also visit Fansipan Peak, known as “The Roof of Indochina,” and enjoy warm, friendly service throughout the tour.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa by Bus – Short Trek to Cat Cat Village

Meals included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30 – Welcome at the bus station, board the sleeper bus and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45 – Travel along the highway to Lao Cai City with a comfort break on the way.

11:45 – 13:00 – Continue on the mountain road approaching Sapa Town, passing scenic valleys and terraced fields.

13:00 – 13:30 – Arrive in Sapa Town, where you will see colorful traditional costumes of the H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay ethnic people.

  • Welcome drink and itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30 – Take a short walk to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong ethnic group at the bottom of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

Your local guide will show you the daily lifestyle of the villagers. Trek down to the valley to visit the waterfall and the French-built Hydroelectric Power Station. Enjoy some time for photos at the bridge and waterfall, then trek uphill back towards Sapa with beautiful late-afternoon scenery. The driver will pick you up and transfer you back to Sapa Town.

17:00 – Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel, with free time to enjoy night activities.

Day 2: Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Moana View

Meals included: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

08:00 – After breakfast at the hotel, the driver and tour guide will take you to the Cable Car Station. Spend about 20 minutes on the cable car, taking in the spectacular views.

09:00 – At an altitude of 2,800 meters, enjoy time to sightsee and take photos. Visit the pagoda and spiritual sites, then trek approximately 600 steps to reach the peak of Fansipan – “The Roof of Indochina.”
You will spend about 1.5 hours hiking and taking photos.

11:30 – Return to the Cable Car Station and travel back to Sapa Town.

12:00 – Lunch at a local restaurant or at the hotel.

Afternoon – Visit Moana View

Start a short, easy walk to Moana View, located about 700 meters from Sapa Church. This is one of the latest check-in spots designed for travelers who enjoy creative photography and new experiences.

You can take photos at:

  • Bali Gate

  • Infinity Lake

  • Moana Girl Statue

  • Golden Hand

  • Thrilling Swing

  • Lonely Tree

  • Panoramic Café overlooking Fansipan Peak and Muong Hoa Valley

You are encouraged to prepare attractive outfits, hats, and accessories for your best photos.

17:00 – Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel.

Day 3: Sapa – Hanoi by Bus

Meals included: Breakfast, Lunch

In the morning, have breakfast at the hotel, then enjoy free time to explore Sapa on your own.

12:00 – Check out of the hotel, have lunch, and relax until departure time.

13:00 – 14:00 – Board the bus back to Hanoi with comfort breaks on the way.

20:00 – 20:30 – Arrive at the bus station in Hanoi. The trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Sleeper bus ticket Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi with modern facilities (tour guide not available on the bus)

  • English-speaking tour guide during the trip in Sapa

  • Hotel accommodation in double/twin room based on twin sharing

  • Meals: 3 lunches, 2 dinners, 2 breakfasts

  • All entrance tickets as mentioned in the itinerary

Trip Excludes

  • Return cable car ticket Sapa – Fansipan – Sapa: 32 USD and 34 USD on Saturday

  • Government tax and beverages

  • Tips for tour guides and drivers, travel insurance

  • Other services not clearly mentioned above

  • Surcharge for sleeper bus with cabin:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD per person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD per person (round trip)

  • Surcharge for Dcar Limousine VIP seat: 20 USD per person (round trip)

  • Surcharge for Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble: 26 USD per person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Children under 5 years old (or under 1 meter tall): Free of charge, based on 2 adults and 1 child sharing bed/berth/bus seat with adults

  • Children from 5 to 8 years old: 75% of adult price, sharing bed with adults

  • Children from 9 years old and above: Charged as adults

Surcharge Policy

  • A surcharge will be applied for travel on national holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothes, scarf, hat, and cap (Sapa is usually cold from September to March)

  • Note: Due to Sapa’s altitude, it can be foggy in December, January, February, and March

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sun cream, insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong (banking systems in Sapa may not always function well; US Dollars, Euros, and Australian Dollars are accepted)

Tour Price per Person

  • 108 USD per person – 3-star hotel

  • 124 USD per person – 4-star hotel

  • 172 USD per person – 5-star hotel

行程

  • 欢迎饮品及行程介绍

  • 当地越南菜午餐

  • 办理酒店入住

当地向导将带您了解村民的日常生活方式。徒步下到山谷，参观瀑布和法国人修建的水力发电站。在桥边和瀑布旁拍照后，沿着傍晚迷人的景色徒步上坡返回沙坝。司机将接您返回沙坝镇。

17:00 – 返回沙坝镇。享用晚餐并留宿酒店，可自由参加夜间活动。

第2天：沙坝 – 番西邦峰 – Moana景区

09:00 – 抵达海拔2,800米处，自由观光拍照。参观寺庙和灵修场所，然后攀登约600级台阶登顶番西邦峰——“中南半岛屋脊”。
您将花约1.5小时徒步和拍照。

11:30 – 返回缆车站，回到沙坝镇。

12:00 – 在当地餐厅或酒店享用午餐。

下午 – 参观Moana景区

开始一段轻松的短途步行，前往距沙坝教堂约700米的Moana景区。这是专为喜爱创意摄影和新奇体验的旅行者打造的最新打卡景点之一。

您可以在以下地点拍照：

  • 无边际湖

  • Moana女孩雕像

  • 黄金之手

  • 刺激秋千

  • 孤独树

建议您准备好吸睛的服装、帽子和配饰，拍出最美的照片。

17:00 – 返回沙坝镇。享用晚餐并留宿酒店。

第3天：沙坝 – 乘巴士返回河内

上午在酒店享用早餐，随后自由活动，自行探索沙坝。

12:00 – 酒店退房，享用午餐，休息至出发时间。

13:00 – 14:00 – 乘坐巴士返回河内，途中设有休息站。

20:00 – 20:30 – 抵达河内巴士站。行程结束。

  • 餐食：3顿午餐、2顿晚餐、2顿早餐

tours.title: Ninh Binh And Ha Long – 2 Days 1 Night
tours.summary: Ninh Binh – Ha Long 2 day, 1 night tour is the perfect journey for travelers who want to uncover the breathtaking natural beauty and rich cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Begin your adventure in Ninh Binh, home to
tours.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh – Ha Long 2 day, 1 night tour is the perfect journey for travelers who want to uncover the breathtaking natural beauty and rich cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Begin your adventure in Ninh Binh, home to spectacular limestone landscapes, historic temples, and peaceful river valleys. Continue to Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where towering islets, shimmering waters, and fascinating caves create one of the world’s most iconic seascapes.

ITINERARY

Day 1: Bai Dinh or Hoa Lu – Trang An or Tam Coc – Mua Cave

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

07:00 – 07:40 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide meets you at your hotel or homestay. Begin the 110–kilometer modern bus journey through the verdant countryside. A short break will be made en route.

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda

10:00 – Visit Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

Arrive at Bai Dinh, the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Situated at the foot of Dinh Mountain, it offers breathtaking views of river valleys and limestone karsts.

Highlights include:

  • 500 Arhat stone statues

  • Two giant bronze bells (27 tons and 36 tons)

  • The thousand–armed, thousand–eyed Quan Yin statue

  • The majestic Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

10:00 – Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Explore the historic capital of Vietnam, where you will visit Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple, both dating back to the seventeenth century.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese meal featuring regional specialties.

Afternoon Choices

Option 1: Trang An Boat Trip

13:30 – Trang An Landscape Complex

Depart for the Trang An Grottoes, a UNESCO–recognized site renowned for majestic limestone mountains rising dramatically from rice fields.

Board a traditional sampan boat and glide through interconnected caves such as Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, and Thanh Truot Cave, along with stops at Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

Option 2: Tam Coc Boat Trip

13:30 – Sampan Trip through Tam Coc

Enjoy a 1.5–hour boat excursion through Tam Coc, meaning “Three Caves.” Sail past limestone cliffs, caves, peaceful streams, rice paddies, and serene countryside views. Tam Coc is often called “Ha Long Bay on Land” and offers excellent opportunities for photography.

Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

15:30 – Visit Mua Cave

Begin the climb to the top of Ngoa Long Mountain and enjoy a panoramic view of the vast rice valley and dramatic limestone landscapes.

16:30 – Check-in at Homestay/Bungalow

Relax, swim, or unwind before dinner at 19:00. After dinner, enjoy the peaceful nighttime atmosphere at the poolside bar.

Note: The tour guide will not be present again until the following afternoon.

Day 2: Ninh Binh – Ha Long Sonata 5 Star Day Cruise – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

Morning

Breakfast is served at the bungalow before check-out.

07:30 – Transfer to Ha Long Bay

Depart for Ha Long Bay.

11:45 – Arrival at Tuan Chau Island

Enter the private waiting lounge before boarding the Halong Sonata 5–Star Day Cruise. Begin your 6–hour journey on the iconic two–day sleeper boat route, famous for its uninhabited islets and spectacular limestone formations.

Buffet Lunch on Board

Enjoy a buffet lunch as the cruise glides through the stunning seascape.

Explore the Highlights of Ha Long Bay

14:00 – 16:30 – Bo Hon Archipelago

Visit the Surprising Cave (Sung Sot Cave), known for its impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

Continue to Luon Cave, where you may choose between kayaking or a bamboo boat ride through the tranquil lagoon.

Finally, visit Titov Island, where you may relax on the sandy beach or climb to the peak for a breathtaking panoramic view of Ha Long Bay.

Sunset Party on Board

16:30 – Sunset Party on the Cruise

Return to the ship and enjoy live traditional music, a jacuzzi, and time on the sun deck as the cruise returns to Tuan Chau Harbor.

Return to Hanoi

18:00 – Disembark & Transfer Back

Leave the cruise and board the bus for your return journey to Hanoi.

20:30 – 21:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

Your guide will drop you off at your hotel. The tour ends.

INCLUSION

  • Modern bus as per itinerary (complimentary bottled water on board)

  • Halong Sonata 5–Star Day Cruise with buffet lunch, live traditional music, jacuzzi

  • English–speaking guide as per itinerary

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 breakfast, 1 dinner

  • All entrance fees included in the itinerary

  • Accommodation in homestay or bungalow (twin or double sharing)

  • Cycling and swimming at the bungalow

EXCLUSION

  • Beverages, travel insurance

  • Kayaking or bamboo boat (5 United States Dollars per person, depending on floating house pricing)

  • Electric car in Bai Dinh Pagoda (5 United States Dollars per person)

  • Tour guide overnight at the bungalow

  • Tips and personal expenses

  • Children 5–8 years old: 75 percent of adult price

  • Children 9 years old and above: full adult price

  • Children under 5 years old: free of charge (excluding entrance fees, meals, and bus seat)

  • Single supplement

Note: Itinerary may change due to weather conditions.
tours.titleZh: 宁平与下龙 – 两天一晚
tours.summaryZh: 宁平 – 下龙湾2天1夜之旅，是想探索越南北部迷人自然风光和丰富文化遗产的旅行者的完美之选。您的冒险从宁平开始，这里拥有壮观的石灰岩地貌、历史悠久的寺庙和宁静的河谷。随后继续前往
tours.contentHtmlZh:
宁平 – 下龙湾2天1夜之旅，是想探索越南北部迷人自然风光和丰富文化遗产的旅行者的完美之选。您的冒险从宁平开始，这里拥有壮观的石灰岩地貌、历史悠久的寺庙和宁静的河谷。随后继续前往 下龙湾，这座联合国教科文组织世界遗产地以高耸的岛屿、波光粼粼的海水和迷人的洞穴，构成了世界上最具标志性的海景之一。

行程安排

第1天：白亭寺或华闾 – 长安或三谷 – 舞洞

含餐：午餐、晚餐

07:00 – 07:40 – 酒店接客

导游在您的酒店或民宿与您会合。乘坐现代化巴士，开始110公里的车程，穿越葱郁的乡村。途中将短暂休息。

选择1：白亭寺

10:00 – 参观白亭寺建筑群

抵达白亭寺，这是越南乃至东南亚最大的寺庙建筑群。寺庙坐落于Dinh山脚下，可饱览河谷与石灰岩山峰的壮丽景色。

亮点包括：

  • 500尊罗汉石像

  • 两口巨型铜钟（27吨和36吨）

  • 千手千眼观音像

  • 庄严的释迦牟尼佛像

选择2：华闾古都

10:00 – 参观华闾古都

探访越南的历史古都，参观丁王庙和黎王庙，两座庙宇均可追溯至十七世纪。

12:00 – 当地餐厅午餐

享用美味的越南餐，品尝地方特色菜肴。

下午选择

选择1：长安泛舟

13:30 – 长安名胜区

前往长安溶洞群，这是联合国教科文组织认可的遗址，以从稻田中拔地而起的雄伟石灰岩山峰而闻名。

乘坐传统小舢板，穿梭于相互连通的洞穴，如Lam洞、Vang洞、Dai洞和Thanh Truot洞，并在高山寺、Suoi Tien寺和Vu Lam寺停留参观。

选择2：三谷泛舟

13:30 – 乘舢板游览三谷

享受1.5小时的三谷泛舟之旅，“三谷”意为“三个洞”。您将经过石灰岩峭壁、洞穴、宁静的溪流、稻田和恬静的乡村景色。三谷常被称为“陆地上的下龙湾”，是绝佳的摄影之地。

舞洞与卧龙山

15:30 – 参观舞洞

开始攀登卧龙山山顶，欣赏广阔稻谷山谷和壮观石灰岩地貌的全景。

16:30 – 入住民宿/小木屋

放松、游泳或休息，19:00享用晚餐。晚餐后，在泳池酒吧享受宁静的夜晚氛围。

注意： 导游将在次日下午才会再次出现。

第2天：宁平 – 下龙湾Sonata五星日间游船 – 河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

上午

退房前在小木屋享用早餐。

07:30 – 前往下龙湾

出发前往下龙湾。

11:45 – 抵达Tuan Chau岛

进入专属候船厅，登上Halong Sonata五星日间游船。开启6小时的旅程，行驶于标志性的两日夜宿游船航线，这条航线以无人居住的小岛和壮观的石灰岩地貌而闻名。

船上自助午餐

游船在壮丽的海景中缓缓前行，您可享用自助午餐。

探索下龙湾亮点

14:00 – 16:30 – Bo Hon群岛

参观惊讶洞（Sung Sot洞），以其壮观的钟乳石和石笋而闻名。

继续前往Luon洞，您可以选择划皮划艇或乘竹筏，穿行于宁静的潟湖之中。

最后参观Titov岛，您可以在沙滩上放松，也可以攀登至山顶，欣赏下龙湾的壮丽全景。

船上日落派对

16:30 – 游船日落派对

返回游船，欣赏现场传统音乐，享受按摩浴缸和日光甲板时光，游船返回Tuan Chau港。

返回河内

18:00 – 下船并乘车返回

离开游船，登上巴士返回河内。

20:30 – 21:00 – 抵达河内

导游会将您送到酒店。行程结束。

费用包含

  • 按行程安排的现代化巴士（车上提供免费瓶装水）

  • Halong Sonata五星日间游船，含自助午餐、现场传统音乐、按摩浴缸

  • 按行程安排的英语导游

  • 餐食：2顿午餐、1顿早餐、1顿晚餐

  • 行程中所列的全部门票

  • 民宿或小木屋住宿（双床或大床，两人合住）

  • 小木屋内骑行和游泳

费用不含

  • 饮品、旅行保险

  • 皮划艇或竹筏（每人5美元，视水上浮屋定价而定）

  • 白亭寺电瓶车（每人5美元）

  • 导游在小木屋的过夜费用

  • 小费和个人开销

  • 5–8岁儿童：成人价格的75%

  • 9岁及以上儿童：按成人全价收费

  • 5岁以下儿童：免费（不含门票、餐食和巴士座位）

  • 单人房差

注意：行程可能因天气情况而变更。

tours.title: Hanoi – Sapa – CatCat – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall
tours.summary: This sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 3 days – 2 night in Sapa aiming at: Saving the time, visit the most popular travel sites in Sapa, stay overnight in a good hotel to be comfortable and visit Fans
tours.contentHtml:
This sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 3 days – 2 night in Sapa aiming at: Saving the time, visit the most popular travel sites in Sapa, stay overnight in a good hotel to be comfortable and visit Fansipan peak – “The roof of Indochina”, especially you can enjoy friendly services provided.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa – Cat Cat Village – Sapa

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30 – Departure from Hanoi

Arrive at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and begin the journey to Sapa via the Noi Bai – Lao Cai Expressway, the longest highway in Vietnam.

07:30 – 11:45 – Highway Journey

Travel to Lao Cai City with a comfort break along the way.

11:45 – 13:00 – Mountain Road to Sapa

Enjoy picturesque views of terraced valleys and highland landscapes as you approach Sapa.

13:00 – Arrival in Sapa Town

See ethnic minority groups in their colorful traditional costumes.

  • Welcome drink and tour briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30 – Visit Cat Cat Village

Take a short drive to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people.

Your local guide will introduce village life, customs, and the daily activities of the locals. Trek down to the valley to visit the waterfall and the French-built Hydroelectric Power Station. Take photos at the waterfall and bridge before trekking uphill back toward Sapa.

Trekking distance: 2.5 km (approx. 2 hours)

The driver will pick you up and return to Sapa Town.

16:30 – Return to Sapa

Have dinner and spend the night at the hotel. Free time to explore Sapa’s nightlife.

Day 2: Sapa – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:00 – Sunrise & Breakfast

Enjoy the refreshing morning views over Sapa’s mountains, then have breakfast at the hotel.

08:00 – Visit Dragon Cloud, Glass Bridge & O Quy Ho Pass

A sightseeing bus will take you to the Dragon Cloud tourist area, Lonely Tree, and Silver Waterfall.

Your trip includes a stop at the summit of O Quy Ho Pass (2,333 meters above sea level), one of Vietnam’s Four Great Passes, perfect for cloud hunting and panoramic photography.

At the Dragon Cloud Glass Bridge, you will:

  • Take photos at the vibrant outdoor staircase

  • Enjoy the thrilling elevator ride to the Hao Han Qiao Glass Bridge

  • Walk across the three-sided transparent glass bridge (768 meters long, 1,000 meters above the mountain slope)

You may also join optional activities available within the tourist zone.

11:30 – Return to the Hotel

Check out of the hotel.

12:00 – Lunch

Enjoy lunch at the hotel.

13:30 – Depart for Hanoi

Board the bus and return to Hanoi. Stop along the way to rest and shop for local specialties.

20:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

Arrive at the bus station. The tour ends.

Vietlook Travel looks forward to welcoming you again!

Included Services

  • Sleeper bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (no guide on the bus)

  • Sightseeing bus in Sapa according to itinerary

  • Local English-speaking guide in Sapa

  • 1 breakfast and 3 main meals

  • Entrance tickets: Cat Cat Village, Glass Bridge, Lonely Tree, Silver Waterfall

  • 3–4–5 star hotels (2 guests per room, or 3 guests if group has odd number)

  • Insurance under bus company policy

Excluded Services

  • Drinks during meals

  • Personal expenses outside itinerary

  • Single room surcharge

  • VAT

  • Guide on the Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi bus

  • Sleeper cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD per person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: $8 per person (one way)

  • VIP Dcar Limousine surcharge: 20 USD per person (round trip)

  • Luxury 28-seat Limousine Nouble: 16 USD per person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Under 5 years old (or under 1 meter): Free of charge (sharing bed/bus with parents; applies for 2 adults + 1 child)

  • 5–8 years old: 75% of adult price, sharing bed with adult

  • 9 years old and above: Charged as adult

Surcharge Policy

  • Additional surcharges apply during national holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothing, scarf, hat (Sapa can be very cold between September–March)

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sun cream, insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong (banking services in Sapa are sometimes unstable; USD, EUR, AUD are accepted)
tours.titleZh: 河内—沙坝—猫猫村—玻璃桥—孤树—银瀑布
tours.summaryZh: 这条沙坝3天2夜行程旨在节省时间，游览沙坝最热门的景点，入住舒适酒店，并登上“中南半岛屋脊”番西邦峰，享受周到友好的服务。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
这条 沙坝之旅 专为想在沙坝度过3天2夜的旅行者设计，旨在：节省时间，游览沙坝最热门的景点，入住舒适的好酒店，并登上番西邦峰–“中南半岛屋脊”，尤其能享受我们周到友好的服务。

行程安排

第1天：河内 – 沙坝 – 猫猫寨 – 沙坝

含餐食：午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30 – 从河内出发

抵达汽车站，登上卧铺大巴，经越南最长的高速公路内排–老街高速前往沙坝。

07:30 – 11:45 – 高速公路行程

前往老街市，途中安排休息。

11:45 – 13:00 – 山路前往沙坝

接近沙坝时，欣赏梯田山谷和高原风光的如画美景。

13:00 – 抵达沙坝镇

看到身着色彩斑斓传统服饰的少数民族。

  • 欢迎饮品及行程说明

  • 品尝越南当地菜肴的午餐

  • 酒店入住

14:30 – 参观猫猫寨

短途驱车前往猫猫寨寨门，这里是黑苗族的家园。

当地导游将介绍村寨生活、风俗和村民的日常活动。徒步下到山谷，参观瀑布和法国人修建的水电站。在瀑布和桥上拍照后，徒步上山返回沙坝方向。

徒步距离：2.5公里（约2小时）

司机接上您，返回沙坝镇。

16:30 – 返回沙坝

享用晚餐并在酒店过夜。自由时间，可探索沙坝夜生活。

第2天：沙坝 – 玻璃桥 – 孤树 – 银瀑布 – 河内

含餐食：早餐、午餐

07:00 – 日出与早餐

欣赏沙坝群山清新的晨景，然后在酒店享用早餐。

08:00 – 参观龙云、玻璃桥与欧贵湖山口

观光巴士将带您前往龙云旅游区、孤树和银瀑布。

行程包括在欧贵湖山口（海拔2,333米）山顶停留，这里是越南四大名关之一，非常适合追云和拍摄全景。

在龙云玻璃桥，您将：

  • 在色彩缤纷的户外阶梯拍照

  • 乘坐惊险刺激的电梯前往好汉桥玻璃桥

  • 走过三面透明的玻璃桥（长768米，距山坡1,000米高）

您还可以参加景区内的自选活动。

11:30 – 返回酒店

办理退房。

12:00 – 午餐

在酒店享用午餐。

13:30 – 出发返回河内

登车返回河内。途中停留休息并选购当地特产。

20:00 – 抵达河内

抵达汽车站，行程结束。

Vietlook Travel期待再次迎接您！

服务包含

  • 河内 – 沙坝 – 河内卧铺大巴（车上无导游）

  • 沙坝按行程安排的观光巴士

  • 沙坝当地英语导游

  • 1顿早餐和3顿正餐

  • 门票：猫猫寨、玻璃桥、孤树、银瀑布

  • 3–4–5星级酒店（2位客人一间，如团队人数为奇数则安排3人一间）

  • 按巴士公司规定的保险

服务不含

  • 用餐期间的饮品

  • 行程以外的个人消费

  • 单人房差

  • 增值税

  • 河内 – 沙坝 – 河内巴士上的导游

  • 卧铺包厢附加费：

    • 单人包厢：每人12美元（往返）

    • 拼用包厢：每人$8（单程）

  • VIP Dcar豪华商务车附加费：每人20美元（往返）

  • 豪华28座Limousine Nouble：每人16美元（往返）

儿童政策

  • 5岁以下（或身高1米以下）：免费（与父母共用床位/座位；适用于2位成人+1名儿童）

  • 5–8岁：成人价的75%，与成人共用床位

  • 9岁及以上：按成人收费

附加费政策

  • 国定假日期间另收附加费

建议携带物品

  • 保暖衣物、围巾、帽子（9月至次年3月沙坝可能非常寒冷）

  • 徒步鞋、太阳镜、防晒霜、驱虫剂

  • 携带越南盾现金（沙坝的银行服务有时不稳定；也接受美元、欧元、澳元）

tours.title: Hanoi – Hoa Lu Or Bai Dinh – Cycling To Bich Dong And Thung Nham Bird Valley
tours.summary: Enjoy a full day exploring the cultural, historical, and natural highlights of Ninh Binh. This tour combines visits to ancient temples or a grand pagoda complex with countryside cycling, cave exploration, and the famous
tours.contentHtml:
Enjoy a full day exploring the cultural, historical, and natural highlights of Ninh Binh. This tour combines visits to ancient temples or a grand pagoda complex with countryside cycling, cave exploration, and the famous Thung Nham Bird Valley.

Itinerary

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your guide meets you at your hotel or accommodation in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Start the 110–kilometer journey through the peaceful countryside. A short break will be made along the way.

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

10:30 – Bai Dinh Pagoda

Arrive at Bai Dinh, the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Located at the foot of Dinh Mountain, the pagoda features breathtaking views of river valleys and limestone formations.

Highlights include:

  • 500 stone statues of Arhats

  • Two giant bronze bells weighing 27 tons and 36 tons

  • The thousand-eyed, thousand-armed Quan Yin statue

  • The majestic Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

10:30 – Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Visit the historic ancient capital of Vietnam and explore the Dinh King Temple, dating back to the seventeenth century. Learn about the early dynasties and admire traditional Vietnamese architecture.

Lunch

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious buffet lunch featuring local specialties, served with a panoramic view of the Tam Coc region.

Cycling and Thung Nham Bird Valley

13:00 – Countryside Cycling to Bich Dong and Thung Nham

Begin an adventurous cycling journey through peaceful villages, green rice fields, and mountain landscapes. Continue to Thung Nham Bird Valley, one of Ninh Binh’s most beautiful natural areas.

Start with a relaxing boat trip to Fairy Water Cave. Then move to the opposite side of the island for another boat trip to observe the diverse bird species such as storks, pelicans, and herons. This is a wonderful opportunity for nature lovers and photographers.

Return to Hanoi

16:30 – Depart for Hanoi

Board the bus and head back to Hanoi.

18:30 – 19:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

You will be dropped off at your hotel. The trip ends.

Inclusion

  • Pick-up from hotel or accommodation in Hanoi Old Quarter by Bus or Limousine Bus

  • Fully escorted tour with a professional English-speaking guide

  • Two bottles of water per person

  • Buffet lunch at a local restaurant with a panoramic view of Tam Coc

  • All entrance fees included in the itinerary

  • Cycling tour

Exclusion

  • Beverages, travel insurance, personal expenses, and tips for the guide

  • Electric car at Bai Dinh Pagoda (5 United States Dollars per person)

  • Limousine bus upgrade (19 seats): additional 5 United States Dollars per person

  • Children from 5 to 8 years old: 75 percent of adult price

  • Children from 9 years old and above: full adult price

  • Children under 5 years old: free of charge (excluding entrance tickets, meals, and bus seat)

 

THE PRICE PER PERSON IN USD: 38 $/ PAX
tours.titleZh: 河内—华闾或拜亭—骑行至碧洞与通岩鸟谷
tours.summaryZh: 用一整天时间探索宁平的文化、历史与自然亮点。本行程将参观古老庙宇或宏伟的寺庙群，并结合乡间骑行、洞穴探索和著名的Thung Nham鸟谷。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
用一整天时间探索宁平的文化、历史与自然亮点。本行程将参观古老庙宇或宏伟的寺庙群，并结合乡间骑行、洞穴探索和著名的Thung Nham鸟谷。

行程安排

07:00 – 07:45 – 酒店接您出发

导游将在河内老城区的酒店或住处与您会合。开启110公里的旅程，穿越宁静的乡村。途中会短暂休息。

选项一：百顶寺（Bái Đính）寺庙群

10:30 – 百顶寺

抵达百顶寺，这是越南和东南亚最大的寺庙群。寺庙坐落于顶山脚下，可欣赏河谷与石灰岩地貌的壮丽景色。

亮点包括：

  • 500尊罗汉石像

  • 两口巨型铜钟，分别重27吨和36吨

  • 千眼千手观音像

  • 庄严的释迦牟尼佛像

选项二：华闾古都

10:30 – 华闾古都

参观越南历史悠久的古都，游览可追溯至17世纪的丁先皇庙。了解早期王朝的历史，欣赏越南传统建筑。

午餐

12:00 – 当地餐厅午餐

享用美味的自助午餐，有地方特色菜肴，并可欣赏三谷（Tam Cốc）地区的全景。

骑行与Thung Nham鸟谷

13:00 – 乡间骑行前往碧洞与Thung Nham

开启一段充满冒险的骑行之旅，穿越宁静的村庄、青翠的稻田和山地风光。继续前往Thung Nham鸟谷，这是宁平最美的自然区域之一。

首先乘船悠闲游览仙水洞（Fairy Water Cave）。然后前往岛的另一侧，再次乘船观赏白鹳、鹈鹕和苍鹭等多种鸟类。对自然爱好者和摄影师来说，这是绝佳的机会。

返回河内

16:30 – 启程返回河内

乘上巴士返回河内。

18:30 – 19:00 – 抵达河内

我们将送您到酒店。行程结束。

  • 在当地餐厅享用自助午餐，可欣赏三谷全景

  • 骑行游览

tours.title: Hanoi – CatCat – Moana View
tours.summary: This tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 2 days and 1 night in Sapa while saving time, visiting the most popular attractions, enjoying comfortable hotel accommodation, and paying a much lower cost compared t
tours.contentHtml:
This tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 2 days and 1 night in Sapa while saving time, visiting the most popular attractions, enjoying comfortable hotel accommodation, and paying a much lower cost compared to taking the night train. Guests can also expect friendly and attentive service throughout the trip.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa by Bus with a Short Trek to Cat Cat Village

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30 – Departure from Hanoi

Arrive at the bus station, board the sleeping bus, and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45 – Expressway Journey

Travel along the expressway to Lao Cai City with a comfort break en route.

11:45 – 13:00 – Mountain Road to Sapa

Continue along the mountain road to Sapa Town, enjoying stunning views of valleys and terraced rice fields.

13:00 – 13:30 – Arrival in Sapa Town

Meet ethnic minorities in traditional costumes such as the H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay people.

  • Welcome drink and tour briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30 – Short Trek to Cat Cat Village

Walk to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home to the Black H’Mong ethnic group, located at the base of a deep valley near Fansipan Peak.

Your local guide will introduce the daily life of the villagers. Trek down to the valley and visit the waterfall and the hydroelectric station built by the French. After taking photos, trek uphill to return to the main road where your driver will pick you up back to Sapa.

17:00 – Return to Sapa Town

Enjoy dinner and spend the night at the hotel. Free time to explore Sapa’s nightlife.

Day 2: Sapa – Moana View Check in Point – Hanoi by Bus

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:00 – 07:45 – Breakfast at the Hotel

Prepare your camera for the morning check-in session.

08:00 – Moana View Check-in Point

Start the day with a short walk to Moana View, located just 700 meters from Sapa Church.

This trending check-in complex offers various photo spots including:

  • Bali Gate

  • Infinity Lake

  • Moana Girl Statue

  • Golden Hand

  • Thrilling Swing

  • Lonely Tree

  • Panoramic Café overlooking Fansipan Peak and Muong Hoa Valley

Guests are encouraged to bring nice outfits, hats, and accessories for perfect photos.

12:00 – 13:30 – Lunch & Free Time

Return to the hotel for check-out, lunch, and personal leisure.

13:30 – 14:00 – Return to Hanoi

Board the bus back to Hanoi with a comfort break.

20:00 – 20:30 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at the bus station. The trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Sleeping bus from Hanoi to Sapa and return (tour guide not available on the bus)

  • English-speaking tour guide during the trip in Sapa

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 dinner, 1 breakfast with local menu

  • All entrance fees according to itinerary

  • Accommodation in Sapa (double/twin/triple sharing room)

Trip Excludes

  • Beverages, travel insurance, tax, personal expenses

  • Services not clearly mentioned

  • Sleeper cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD per person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: $8 per person (one-way)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat surcharge: 20 USD per person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble: 16 USD per person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Under 5 years old (or under 1 meter tall): Free of charge (share bed/bus seat with adults; maximum 2 adults + 1 child)

  • 5–8 years old: 75% of adult price, sharing bed with adults

  • 9 years old and above: Charged as an adult

Surcharge Policy

A surcharge applies during national holidays.

What to Bring

  • Warm clothing, scarf, hat, and cap (weather is unpredictable and often cold from September to March)

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, and insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong (bank services in Sapa may be unstable; USD, EUR, AUD are also accepted)

Tour Price per Person

  • 80 USD per person – 3-star hotel

  • 90 USD per person – 4-star hotel

  • 120 USD per person – 5-star hotel
tours.titleZh: 河内—猫猫村—Moana观景台
tours.summaryZh: 本行程专为想在沙坝度过2天1晚的旅行者设计：节省时间，游览最热门的景点，入住舒适的酒店，费用比乘坐夜间火车低得多。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
本行程专为想在沙坝 度过2天1晚的旅行者设计：节省时间，游览最热门的景点，入住舒适的酒店，费用比乘坐夜间火车低得多。全程还将享受友好、周到的服务。

行程安排

第1天：河内 – 沙坝（乘巴士），并短途徒步至Cat Cat村

含餐：午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30 – 从河内出发

抵达巴士站，登上卧铺巴士，出发前往沙坝。

07:30 – 11:45 – 高速公路行程

沿高速公路前往老街市，途中安排休息。

11:45 – 13:00 – 山路前往沙坝

沿山路继续前往沙坝镇，欣赏山谷和梯田的壮丽景色。

13:00 – 13:30 – 抵达沙坝镇

会见身着传统服饰的少数民族，如苗族、瑶族和岱族。

  • 欢迎饮品及行程介绍

  • 享用越南当地风味午餐

  • 酒店入住

14:30 – 短途徒步至Cat Cat村

步行至Cat Cat村村口，这里是黑苗族的家园，位于番西邦峰附近深谷的谷底。

当地导游将为您介绍村民的日常生活。徒步下到山谷，参观瀑布和法国人修建的水电站。拍照后，徒步上坡返回主路，司机将接您返回沙坝。

17:00 – 返回沙坝镇

享用晚餐并入住酒店。自由活动时间，可探索沙坝的夜生活。

第2天：沙坝 – Moana View打卡点 – 乘巴士返回河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

07:00 – 07:45 – 酒店早餐

准备好相机，迎接清晨的打卡时光。

08:00 – Moana View打卡点

从短途步行开始新的一天，前往距沙坝教堂仅700米的Moana View。

这个热门打卡景区拥有多个拍照点，包括：

  • 巴厘岛之门

  • 无边际湖

  • Moana女孩雕像

  • 黄金之手

  • 刺激秋千

  • 孤独之树

  • 俯瞰番西邦峰和木花（Muong Hoa）山谷的全景咖啡馆

建议游客携带漂亮的服装、帽子和配饰，拍出完美的照片。

12:00 – 13:30 – 午餐及自由活动

返回酒店退房、午餐及个人休闲。

13:30 – 14:00 – 返回河内

登上巴士返回河内，途中安排休息。

20:00 – 20:30 – 抵达河内

在巴士站下车，行程结束。

行程包含

  • 河内至沙坝往返卧铺巴士（巴士上不配备导游）

  • 沙坝行程期间配备英语导游

  • 餐食：2顿午餐、1顿晚餐、1顿早餐，当地特色菜单

  • 按行程包含所有景点门票

  • 沙坝住宿（双人/双床/三人合住房）

行程不含

  • 饮品、旅游保险、税费、个人消费

  • 未明确提及的服务

  • 卧铺包厢附加费：

    • 单人包厢：每人12 USD（往返）

    • 合住包厢：每人$8（单程）

  • Dcar Limousine VIP座位附加费：每人20 USD（往返）

  • 豪华Limousine 28座 Nouble：每人16 USD（往返）

儿童政策

  • 5岁以下（或身高不足1米）：免费（与成人同床/同座；最多2位成人 + 1名儿童）

  • 5–8岁：按成人价格的75%收费，与成人同床

  • 9岁及以上：按成人收费

附加费政策

国家法定节假日期间需加收附加费。

建议携带

  • 保暖衣物、围巾、帽子和鸭舌帽（天气多变，9月至次年3月通常较冷）

  • 徒步鞋、太阳镜、防晒霜和驱虫剂

  • 越南盾现金（沙坝的银行服务可能不稳定；也接受美元、欧元、澳元）

Lunch Options

Choose one of the following popular Hanoi dishes:

ONE DAY TRIP
