12:30 The car and tour guide will pick you up at your hotel for lunch with delicious Hanoi specialties such as Bún Chả, Phở, Bánh Cuốn, or Bánh Mì.

These are long-standing traditional dishes of Hanoi. Not only loved by locals, but also by international tourists and even world leaders visiting Vietnam.

They are not luxurious or expensive, but they are incredibly delicious and represent the full richness of Vietnamese culinary culture.

tours.contentHtmlZh:
行程信息 

  • 出发时间： 12:30 – 13:00

  • 集合地点： 确认预订后，请提供您的酒店地址

  • 行程时长： 5 – 8小时

  • 送达地点： 内排国际机场（HAN）或您的酒店

  • 游览景点： 河内古宅、还剑湖、河内教堂及河内火车轨道街

午餐选择

从以下河内特色美食中任选其一：

  • Phở Lý Quốc Sư（牛肉粉） （汤粉 – 李国师街）

  • Bún Chả – 01 Hàng Mành（烤肉米线） （烤猪肉配米线 – 行芒街）

水疗晚餐

水疗选择

  • 美国牛肉金桔沙拉

– 主菜 –

  • 烤猪肋排

  • 清炒时蔬

  • 香米饭

  • 酱油茄子豆腐

– 甜点 –

一日游

用餐：午餐、晚餐

这些都是河内历史悠久的传统美食，不仅深受当地人喜爱，也受到国际游客甚至到访越南的世界领导人的青睐。

它们既不奢华也不昂贵，却美味无比，展现了越南饮食文化的丰富多彩。

13:30 前往 Quang Phu Cau香村 参观并拍照——这是一个拥有百年以上历史的传统制香村。

14:30 抵达后，您将有机会了解传统制香的各个步骤。

五颜六色的香束被摆成各种美丽的造型，是拍摄难忘纪念照片的绝佳场景。

16:30 前往水疗中心。您将在Labase Beauty Spa享受 75分钟全身按摩 ，让您在夜间航班前焕发活力、精神焕然一新。

tours.title: Ancient Village And Spiritual Journey
tours.summary: Discover the timeless beauty of Đường Lâm Ancient Village and explore northern Vietnam’s spiritual heritage on this full-day cultural journey with Vietlook Travel. This experience takes you through ancient villages, hist
tours.contentHtml:
Discover the timeless beauty of Đường Lâm Ancient Village and explore northern Vietnam’s spiritual heritage on this full-day cultural journey with Vietlook Travel. This experience takes you through ancient villages, historic pagodas, and the only laterite stone citadel in Vietnam, offering a deep connection to history, culture, and spirituality.

Morning

Pick-up from Hotels in Hanoi’s Old Quarter or Opera House Area

Your private car and English-speaking guide will meet you at your accommodation to begin the day.

Khai Nguyen Pagoda

Visit one of the region’s most peaceful Buddhist sanctuaries. Dating back to the eleventh century, Khai Nguyen Pagoda combines traditional architecture with contemporary elements, creating a serene atmosphere for reflection.

Son Tay Ancient Citadel

Explore the only laterite stone citadel in Vietnam. Built in 1822 during the Minh Mang era, this historic fortress was constructed to protect the northwest approach to Hanoi and remains an important symbol of regional history.

Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a traditional Vietnamese meal featuring fresh, local ingredients.

Afternoon

Đường Lâm Ancient Village

Discover one of the best-preserved traditional villages in Northern Vietnam. Walk through quiet alleyways, admire centuries-old houses, and experience the authentic rhythm of rural life. Key landmarks include:

  • Mong Phu Communal House — A cultural and architectural symbol of the village.

  • Ba Chua Mia Temple — Dedicated to a revered historical figure and known for its spiritual significance.

  • Giang Van Minh’s Tomb — Honoring a prominent Vietnamese diplomat who made notable contributions to national history.

Taste local specialties such as traditional rice wine and “che lam,” a famous countryside snack.

Mia Pagoda

Visit one of Vietnam’s oldest pagodas, home to hundreds of historically valuable Buddhist statues. Mia Pagoda is surrounded by tranquil countryside scenery, making it a meaningful spiritual stop.

Evening

Return to Hanoi and arrive at your hotel or designated drop-off point in the evening.

Tour Highlights

  • Walk through Đường Lâm Ancient Village and explore centuries old traditional houses.

  • Discover Vietnam’s only laterite stone citadel in Son Tay.

  • Visit sacred pagodas and historical landmarks with deep cultural significance.

  • Enjoy a countryside meal and experience authentic local traditions.

Who This Tour Is For

  • Travelers with an interest in history and traditional Vietnamese culture.

  • Visitors seeking a spiritual and cultural experience outside the busy city.

  • Individuals with limited time who want to explore an authentic Vietnamese village in one day.

Tour Includes

  • Private car with driver

  • English-speaking local guide

  • Lunch at Đường Lâm Ancient Village

  • All entrance fees

Tour Price

68 Dollars per person

Vietlook Travel is dedicated to offering immersive, meaningful, and authentic cultural journeys throughout Vietnam.
tours.titleZh: 古村落与心灵之旅
tours.summaryZh: 跟随Vietlook Travel开启全天文化之旅，探索唐林古村的历久魅力，感受越南北部的精神遗产。行程途经古老村落、历史悠久的寺庙，以及越南唯一的红土石古城堡。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
跟随Vietlook Travel开启一场全天文化之旅，探索唐林古村（Đường Lâm）历久弥新的魅力，感受越南北部的精神遗产。行程将带您走过古老村落、历史悠久的寺庙，以及越南唯一的红土石古城堡，让您与历史、文化和灵性深度相连。

上午

从河内老城区或歌剧院一带的酒店接客

您的私家车和英语导游将在住处与您会合，开启一天的行程。

开元寺（Khai Nguyên）

参观该地区最宁静的佛教圣地之一。开元寺始建于十一世纪，传统建筑与现代元素相融合，营造出适合静思的宁静氛围。

山西古城

探索越南唯一的红土石古城。这座历史要塞建于1822年明命年间，用以守护河内的西北门户，至今仍是地区历史的重要象征。

当地餐厅午餐

享用以新鲜本地食材烹制的传统越南餐。

下午

唐林古村（Đường Lâm）

探索越南北部保存最完好的传统村落之一。漫步宁静的小巷，欣赏数百年历史的老屋，体验地道的乡村生活节奏。主要景点包括：

  • Mông Phụ公社亭——村庄的文化与建筑象征。

  • Bà Chúa Mía祠——供奉一位备受尊崇的历史人物，以其灵性意义而闻名。

  • Giang Văn Minh墓——纪念一位为国家历史作出杰出贡献的越南著名外交官。

品尝当地特产，如传统米酒和著名的乡村小吃“糖水（chè lam）”。

Mía寺

参观越南最古老的寺庙之一，寺内供奉着数百尊具有历史价值的佛像。Mía寺四周是宁静的田园风光，是一处意义非凡的灵修之地。

傍晚

返回河内，傍晚抵达您的酒店或指定下车地点。

行程亮点

  • 漫步唐林古村，探索数百年历史的传统老屋。

  • 发现位于山西的越南唯一红土石古城。

  • 参观具有深厚文化意义的神圣寺庙和历史地标。

  • 享用乡村美食，体验地道的当地传统。

适合人群

  • 对历史和越南传统文化感兴趣的旅行者。

  • 希望远离喧嚣城市、寻求灵性与文化体验的游客。

  • 时间有限、希望一天之内探索地道越南村落的人。

费用包含

  • 私家车及司机

  • 英语当地导游

  • 唐林古村午餐

  • 所有门票

行程价格

每人68美元

Vietlook Travel致力于在越南各地提供沉浸式、有意义且地道的文化之旅。

tours.title: Hanoi – Hoa Lu or Bai Dinh – Trang An – Mua Cave – Cuc Phuong National Park
tours.summary: Discover the highlights of Ninh Binh with a perfect combination of spiritual sites, natural wonders, river grottoes, panoramic mountains, and Vietnam’s oldest national park. This two-day, one-night experience provides a
tours.contentHtml:
Discover the highlights of Ninh Binh with a perfect combination of spiritual sites, natural wonders, river grottoes, panoramic mountains, and Vietnam’s oldest national park. This two-day, one-night experience provides a memorable journey through culture, history, and untouched nature.

Itinerary

Day 1: Bai Dinh or Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up in Hanoi

Your tour guide meets you at your hotel in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer drive through peaceful countryside landscapes. A short break will be made along the way.

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

10:00 – Bai Dinh Pagoda

Visit the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Located at the foot of Dinh Mountain, Bai Dinh offers breathtaking views of river valleys and limestone formations.

Highlights include:

  • 500 stone statues of Arhats

  • Two massive bronze bells weighing 27 and 36 tons

  • The thousand-eyed, thousand-armed Quan Yin statue

  • The majestic Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

10:00 – Visit Hoa Lu
Explore the former capital of Vietnam and visit the Dinh King Temple, a historic site dating back to the seventeenth century.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese meal featuring regional specialties.

Trang An Grottoes

13:00 – Sampan Boat Trip

Travel to the Trang An Landscape Complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its dramatic limestone mountains, tranquil valleys, freshwater ponds, and lush jungle.

Ride a traditional sampan boat through caves such as:

  • Lam Cave

  • Vang Cave

  • Dai Cave

  • Thanh Truot Cave

Along the route, you will also see Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

15:30 – Climb to the Peak

Explore Mua Cave and begin the trek to the top of Ngoa Long Mountain. The summit offers breathtaking panoramic views of rice fields, mountains, and the surrounding nature.

17:00 – Check-In at Homestay or Bungalow

Relax, enjoy the swimming pool, read, or simply unwind before dinner at 19:00.

Note: The tour guide is not available again until the next afternoon.

Day 2: Cuc Phuong National Park – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

Morning

Breakfast is served at the bungalow. After checking out, your guide will take you to Cuc Phuong National Park.

Endangered Primate Rescue Center

Visit the Endangered Primate Rescue Center, home to langurs, monkeys, and gibbons. Here, professional conservation staff work to protect rare species and preserve their natural habitat. This meaningful visit provides insights into Vietnam’s wildlife protection efforts.

Lunch and Jungle Trek

After visiting the center, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant recommended by your guide.

In the afternoon, take a trekking trip deep into the forest to see:

  • The One-Thousand-Year-Old Tree

  • The Prehistoric Man’s Cave (if time permits)

Experience the cool jungle atmosphere and learn about the biodiversity of Vietnam’s oldest national park.

Return to Hanoi

16:30 – Depart for Hanoi

Leave Cuc Phuong and return to Hanoi.

18:30 – 19:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at your hotel. The tour ends.

Inclusion

  • Pick-up from hotel or accommodation in Hanoi Old Quarter

  • Round-trip transfers with two complimentary bottles of water per person

  • English-speaking guide as per itinerary

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 breakfast, 1 dinner

  • All entrance fees and boat trip as mentioned

  • Accommodation at homestay or bungalow (twin or double sharing)

  • Transportation to Cuc Phuong National Park and entrance ticket

Exclusion

  • Beverages, travel insurance, and personal expenses

  • Electric car at Bai Dinh Pagoda (5 United States Dollars per person)

  • Tour guide overnight service at bungalow

  • Tips for tour guide

  • Children from 5 to 8 years old: 75 percent of adult price

  • Children from 9 years old and above: full adult price

  • Children under 5 years old: free of charge (excluding entrance tickets, meals, and bus seat)

  • Single supplement
tours.titleZh: 河内—华闾或拜亭—长安—舞洞—菊芳国家公园
tours.summaryZh: 探索宁平的精华，完美融合宗教圣地、自然奇观、河上溶洞、全景山峰以及越南最古老的国家公园。这段两天一夜的体验，将带您踏上一段穿越文化、历史与原始自然的难忘旅程。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
探索宁平的精华，完美融合宗教圣地、自然奇观、河上溶洞、全景山峰以及越南最古老的国家公园。这段两天一夜的体验，将带您踏上一段穿越文化、历史与原始自然的难忘旅程。

行程安排

第1天：白定寺或华闾 – 长安 – 舞洞

含餐：午餐、晚餐

07:00 – 07:45 – 河内接客

导游在河内老城区的酒店与您会合。开始110公里的车程，穿越宁静的乡村风光。途中会短暂休息。

方案一：白定寺建筑群

10:00 – 白定寺

参观越南和东南亚规模最大的寺庙建筑群。白定寺坐落在丁山脚下，可饱览河谷和石灰岩地貌的壮丽景色。

亮点包括：

  • 500尊罗汉石像

  • 两口重达27吨和36吨的巨型铜钟

  • 千手千眼观音像

  • 庄严的释迦牟尼佛像

方案二：华闾古都

10:00 – 参观华闾
探索越南昔日的都城，参观丁先皇庙，这是一处可追溯至十七世纪的历史遗迹。

12:00 – 当地餐厅午餐

享用美味的越南餐，品尝地方特色菜肴。

长安洞窟

13:00 – 乘小舟游览

前往长安名胜群，这是联合国教科文组织世界遗产，以雄奇的石灰岩山峰、宁静的山谷、淡水池塘和茂密的丛林而闻名。

乘坐传统小舟穿越溶洞，例如：

  • 蓝洞（Lâm）

  • 黄洞（Vàng）

  • 大洞（Đại）

  • 清滑洞（Thánh Trượt）

沿途您还将看到高山寺、泉仙寺和武林寺。

舞洞和卧龙山

15:30 – 登顶

探索舞洞，并开始攀登卧龙山。山顶可俯瞰稻田、群山和周边自然风光的壮丽全景。

17:00 – 入住民宿或小木屋

放松身心，享受泳池、阅读，或在19:00晚餐前单纯地休息。

注：导游在次日下午之前不再随行。

第2天：菊芳国家公园 – 河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

上午

在小木屋享用早餐。退房后，导游将带您前往菊芳国家公园。

濒危灵长类动物救护中心

参观濒危灵长类动物救护中心，这里是叶猴、猴子和长臂猿的家园。专业的保护工作人员在此致力于保护珍稀物种及其自然栖息地。这次意义非凡的参观将让您了解越南的野生动物保护工作。

午餐与丛林徒步

参观中心后，在导游推荐的当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午，深入森林徒步，参观：

  • 千年古树

  • 史前人类洞穴（时间允许的话）

感受清凉的丛林氛围，了解越南最古老国家公园的生物多样性。

返回河内

16:30 – 启程返回河内

离开菊芳，返回河内。

18:30 – 19:00 – 抵达河内

送您到酒店，行程结束。

费用包含

  • 河内老城区酒店或住宿地点接送

  • 往返接送，每人提供两瓶免费饮用水

  • 按行程安排提供英语导游

  • 餐食：2顿午餐、1顿早餐、1顿晚餐

  • 所述的全部门票及游船

  • 民宿或小木屋住宿（双床或双人合住）

  • 前往菊芳国家公园的交通及门票

费用不含

  • 饮品、旅游保险及个人消费

  • 白定寺电瓶车（每人5美元）

  • 导游在小木屋的过夜服务

  • 导游小费

  • 5至8岁儿童：成人价格的75%

  • 9岁及以上儿童：按成人全价

  • 5岁以下儿童：免费（不含门票、餐食及巴士座位）

  • 单人房差

tours.title: Hanoi – Hoa Lu or Bai Dinh – Trang An – Mua Cave – Tam Coc – Cycling
tours.summary: Explore the very best of Ninh Binh with this 2 day, 1 night journey. From spiritual pagodas to ancient temples, majestic limestone landscapes, river grottoes, and peaceful countryside villages, this tour offers an unforg
tours.contentHtml:
Explore the very best of Ninh Binh with this 2 day, 1 night journey. From spiritual pagodas to ancient temples, majestic limestone landscapes, river grottoes, and peaceful countryside villages, this tour offers an unforgettable combination of culture and nature.

Itinerary

Day 1: Bai Dinh or Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up in Hanoi

Your tour guide meets you at your hotel in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer journey through the peaceful countryside. A short break will be made on the way.

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

10:00 – Visit Bai Dinh Pagoda

Arrive at Bai Dinh, the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Set at the foot of Dinh Mountain, the site offers breathtaking scenery overlooking river valleys and limestone karsts.
Highlights include:

  • 500 stone statues of Arhats

  • Two enormous bronze bells (27 tons and 36 tons)

  • The thousand-armed, thousand-eyed Quan Yin statue

  • The impressive Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel → Trang An

10:00 – Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Visit the historic capital of Vietnam and explore Dinh King Temple, dating back to the seventeenth century. Learn about the early dynasties that shaped Vietnamese history.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese meal featuring authentic local cuisine.

13:00 – Trang An Grottoes

Transfer to the Trang An Landscape Complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site of towering limestone mountains, peaceful valleys, freshwater ponds, and jungle.

Board a traditional sampan and journey through a series of caves including Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, Thanh Truot Cave, and visit spiritual sites such as Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

15:30 – Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

Climb to the summit of Ngoa Long Mountain for one of the most spectacular panoramic views in northern Vietnam. Enjoy sweeping views of rice fields, limestone peaks, and the surrounding countryside.

17:00 – Check-in at Homestay or Bungalow

Relax, swim, read, or enjoy the peaceful atmosphere before dinner at 19:00.

Note: Tour guide is not available until the next afternoon.

Day 2: Tam Coc Boating – Cycling – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

Morning

Breakfast is served at your bungalow. Free time to swim, relax, or explore the surrounding area.

11:30 – Check out and have lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon – Tam Coc Boat Trip

Your guide takes you on a sampan journey along the Ngo Dong River through the famous three caves:

  • Hang Ca

  • Hang Hai

  • Hang Ba

Tam Coc offers breathtaking scenery of river landscapes surrounded by limestone karsts, lush rice fields, and rich flora and fauna.

16:00 – Countryside Cycling Tour

Cycle through peaceful villages and rice fields, admiring the dramatic limestone ridges and charming hamlets. This is a refreshing and relaxing highlight of the tour, offering wonderful photography opportunities.

17:00 – Return to Hanoi

Board the bus and depart for Hanoi.

18:30 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at your hotel. The trip ends.

Inclusion

  • Pick-up from hotel or accommodation in Hanoi Old Quarter by Bus or Limousine Bus

  • Round-trip transfers with two complimentary bottles of water per person

  • English-speaking guide as indicated in the itinerary

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 breakfast, 1 dinner

  • All entrance fees included in the itinerary

  • Accommodation in Homestay or Bungalow (twin or double room sharing)

  • Cycling and swimming at the bungalow

Exclusion

  • Beverages, travel insurance, personal expenses, and tips

  • Electric car fee at Bai Dinh Pagoda (5 United States Dollars)

  • Overnight guide service at the bungalow and next morning

  • Children from 5–8 years old: 75 percent of adult price

  • Children from 9 years old and above: full adult price

  • Children under 5 years old: free of charge (excluding entrance tickets, meals, and bus seat)

  • Single supplement for solo travelers
tours.titleZh: 河内—华闾或拜亭—长安—舞洞—三谷—骑行
tours.summaryZh: 用2天1晚的行程探索宁平的精华。从灵性的寺庙到古老的庙宇，从雄伟的石灰岩风光、河道溶洞到宁静的乡村，本行程将文化与自然完美结合，带来难忘的体验。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
用2天1晚的行程探索宁平的精华。从灵性的寺庙到古老的庙宇，从雄伟的石灰岩风光、河道溶洞到宁静的乡村，本行程将文化与自然完美结合，带来难忘的体验。

行程安排

第1天：百顶寺或华闾–长安–木洞

含餐：午餐、晚餐

07:00 – 07:45 – 河内接送

导游将在河内老城区的酒店与您会合。开启110公里的旅程，穿越宁静的乡村。途中会短暂休息。

选项一：百顶寺寺庙群

10:00 – 参观百顶寺

抵达百顶寺，这是越南和东南亚最大的寺庙群。寺庙坐落于顶山脚下，可俯瞰河谷与石灰岩山峰，景色令人屏息。
亮点包括：

  • 500尊罗汉石像

  • 两口巨型铜钟（27吨和36吨）

  • 千手千眼观音像

  • 令人印象深刻的释迦牟尼佛像

选项二：华闾古都 → 长安

10:00 – 华闾古都

参观越南的历史古都，游览可追溯至17世纪的丁先皇庙。了解塑造越南历史的早期王朝。

12:00 – 当地餐厅午餐

享用美味的越南餐，品尝地道的当地美食。

13:00 – 长安溶洞

前往长安景观区，这是联合国教科文组织世界遗产，拥有高耸的石灰岩山峰、宁静的山谷、淡水池塘和丛林。

乘坐传统小舢板，穿越一系列洞穴，包括Lấm洞、Vàng洞、Đại洞、Thánh Trượt洞，并参观高山庙、仙泉庙和武林庙等灵性场所。

15:30 – 木洞与卧龙山

攀登至卧龙山山顶，欣赏越南北部最壮观的全景之一。尽览稻田、石灰岩山峰和周边乡村的辽阔景色。

17:00 – 入住民宿或小木屋

放松身心、游泳、读书，或在19:00晚餐前享受宁静的氛围。

注：导游至次日下午才提供服务。

第2天：三谷乘船–骑行–河内

含餐：早餐、午餐

上午

早餐在您的小木屋供应。自由时间可游泳、放松或探索周边。

11:30 – 退房，并在当地餐厅用午餐。

下午——三谷乘船游

导游带您乘小舢板沿吴同河（Ngô Đồng）航行，穿越著名的三个洞穴：

  • 头洞（Hang Cả）

  • 二洞（Hang Hai）

  • 三洞（Hang Ba）

三谷拥有令人屏息的河景，四周环绕着石灰岩山峰、青翠的稻田，以及丰富的动植物。

16:00 – 乡间骑行游

骑行穿越宁静的村庄和稻田，欣赏壮丽的石灰岩山脊和迷人的小村落。这是行程中令人精神焕发、放松身心的亮点，提供绝佳的摄影机会。

17:00 – 返回河内

乘上巴士前往河内。

18:30 – 抵达河内

送至您的酒店。行程结束。

费用包含

  • 乘坐巴士或豪华巴士从河内老城区酒店或住处接送

  • 往返接送，每人赠送两瓶水

  • 行程所示的英语导游

  • 餐食：2顿午餐、1顿早餐、1顿晚餐

  • 行程包含的全部门票

  • 入住民宿或小木屋（双床或大床房，两人同住）

  • 骑行及小木屋游泳

费用不包含

  • 饮品、旅游保险、个人开销及小费

  • 百顶寺电瓶车费用（5美元）

  • 小木屋过夜及次日上午的导游服务

  • 5–8岁儿童：成人价格的75%

  • 9岁及以上儿童：按成人全价

  • 5岁以下儿童：免费（不含门票、餐食和巴士座位）

  • 单人游客的单人房差

tours.title: Hanoi – Hoa Lu – Cycling – Tam Coc – Mua Cave
tours.summary: Experience the best of Ninh Binh in one full day, combining ancient history, peaceful countryside cycling, a scenic sampan boat trip, and a spectacular viewpoint overlooking rice fields and limestone mountains. Itinerary
tours.contentHtml:
Experience the best of Ninh Binh in one full day, combining ancient history, peaceful countryside cycling, a scenic sampan boat trip, and a spectacular viewpoint overlooking rice fields and limestone mountains.

Itinerary

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide will meet you at your accommodation in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer bus journey through the beautiful countryside. A short break will be made along the way.

10:30 – Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Explore Vietnam’s former capital city and visit the Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple, both dating back to the seventeenth century. Discover the stories of Vietnam’s early dynasties and admire traditional architecture.

11:30 – Countryside Cycling

Enjoy a leisurely cycling trip along rural paths, passing canal networks, rice fields, and small villages with impressive limestone mountains in the background. This is a wonderful way to experience the peaceful countryside.

12:00 – Buffet Lunch

Enjoy a buffet lunch at a local restaurant, featuring delicious Vietnamese dishes.

13:30 – Tam Coc Sampan Boat Trip

Board a small traditional sampan and begin a 1.5-hour journey through Tam Coc, meaning “Three Caves.”
Admire majestic limestone cliffs, mysterious caves, calm rivers, rice paddies, and peaceful landscapes. This area is often compared to “Ha Long Bay on Land” and is ideal for photography lovers.

15:30 – Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

Arrive at Mua Cave and begin an exciting trek up Ngoa Long Mountain. The summit offers breathtaking views of rice fields, rivers, and dramatic limestone formations.

16:30 – Return to Hanoi

Board the bus and begin the return journey.

18:30 – Arrival in Hanoi

You will be dropped off at your hotel. The trip ends.

Inclusion

  • Pick-up from hotel or accommodation in Hanoi Old Quarter

  • Fully escorted tour with a professional English-speaking guide

  • Two bottles of water per person

  • A Vietnamese set-menu lunch

  • Entrance fees for Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

  • Shared sampan boat trip in Tam Coc

  • Biking activity

Exclusion

  • Beverages, travel insurance, personal expenses, and tips for the guide

  • Limousine bus upgrade (19 seats): additional 5 United States Dollars per person

  • Children from 5 to 8 years old: 75 percent of adult price

  • Children from 9 years old and above: 100 percent adult price

tours.summaryZh: 用一整天时间体验宁平的精华，融合古老历史、宁静乡村骑行、风景如画的舢板游船，以及俯瞰稻田与石灰岩山峦的壮观观景点。行程安排
tours.contentHtmlZh:
用一整天时间体验宁平的精华，融合古老历史、宁静乡村骑行、风景如画的舢板游船，以及俯瞰稻田与石灰岩山峦的壮观观景点。

行程安排

07:00 – 07:45 – 酒店接客

导游将在河内老城区的住宿处与您会合。开始110公里的巴士旅程，穿越美丽的乡村风光。途中将短暂休息。

10:30 – 参观华闾古都

探索越南昔日的都城，参观丁先皇庙和黎大行庙，两座庙宇均可追溯至17世纪。了解越南早期王朝的故事，欣赏传统建筑。

11:30 – 乡村骑行

沿着乡间小路悠闲骑行，经过纵横交错的河渠、稻田和小村庄，背景是气势恢宏的石灰岩山峦。这是感受宁静乡村风光的绝佳方式。

12:00 – 自助午餐

在当地餐厅享用自助午餐，品尝美味的越南菜肴。

13:30 – 三谷舢板游船

登上传统小舢板，开始1.5小时的三谷（Tam Coc，意为“三个洞”）之旅。
欣赏雄伟的石灰岩峭壁、神秘的洞穴、平静的河流、稻田和宁静的风景。这里常被誉为“陆地上的下龙湾”，非常适合摄影爱好者。

15:30 – 木洞与卧龙山

抵达木洞（Mua Cave），开始激动人心的卧龙山（Ngoa Long Mountain）徒步登山。山顶可欣赏到稻田、河流和壮丽石灰岩地貌的绝美景色。

16:30 – 返回河内

登上巴士，开始返程。

18:30 – 抵达河内

将您送回酒店，行程结束。

tours.contentHtml:

Who This Tour Is Perfect For

tours.title: Hoa Lu – Cycling – Trang An – Mua Cave – Tam Coc
tours.summary: Experience the beauty of Ninh Binh with an exciting combination of history, cycling, river exploration, and breathtaking mountain views. This full-day tour offers an ideal blend of adventure and cultural discovery. Itine
tours.contentHtml:
Experience the beauty of Ninh Binh with an exciting combination of history, cycling, river exploration, and breathtaking mountain views. This full-day tour offers an ideal blend of adventure and cultural discovery.

Itinerary

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide will meet you at your hotel or accommodation in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer journey through lush countryside in a modern, comfortable bus. A short break will be made along the way.

10:30 – Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Explore Vietnam’s ancient capital and visit the Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple, both dating back to the seventeenth century. Learn about the history of the Dinh and Le dynasties while admiring traditional architecture.

11:30 – Cycling Experience

Enjoy a leisurely cycling trip along rural roads, passing alongside rivers, canals, rice fields, and small villages surrounded by spectacular limestone mountains. This is an excellent way to immerse yourself in local life and the natural landscape.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Savor a buffet lunch at The Long Restaurant, offering a panoramic view of Tam Coc. The meal features delicious regional Vietnamese cuisine.

13:30 – Explore Trang An Grottoes

Continue to the Trang An Landscape Complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its stunning limestone formations.
Board a traditional sampan boat and glide along the river through an enchanting system of caves such as Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, and Thanh Truot Cave. You will also pass Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

15:30 – Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

Arrive at Mua Cave and begin the trek up Ngoa Long Mountain. From the summit, enjoy one of the most impressive viewpoints in northern Vietnam, overlooking vast rice fields and dramatic limestone scenery.

16:30 – Return to Hanoi

Board the bus for your journey back to Hanoi.

18:30 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at your hotel or accommodation. The tour concludes.

  • Pick-up from hotel or accommodation in Hanoi Old Quarter by Bus or Limousine Bus

  • Fully escorted tour with a professional English-speaking guide

  • Two bottles of water per person

  • Buffet lunch at The Long Restaurant with a panoramic view of Tam Coc

  • All entrance fees listed in the itinerary

Exclusion

  • Beverages, travel insurance, personal expenses, and tips for the guide

  • Limousine bus upgrade (19-seat vehicle) additional 5 United States Dollars per person

tours.title: Perfume Pagoda One Day Trip
tours.summary: Embark on a full-day spiritual journey to the Perfume Pagoda, a vast and sacred complex of Buddhist temples and shrines nestled within the limestone mountains of Huong Tich. This tour combines scenic waterways, mountain
tours.contentHtml:
Embark on a full-day spiritual journey to the Perfume Pagoda, a vast and sacred complex of Buddhist temples and shrines nestled within the limestone mountains of Huong Tich. This tour combines scenic waterways, mountain pathways, and a deep insight into Vietnam’s centuries old Buddhist culture.

Itinerary

08:00 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your guide and driver will meet you at your accommodation in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. After pick-up, enjoy a peaceful two-hour drive through the countryside toward the Perfume Pagoda.

Boat Trip on the Yen Stream

Upon arrival, board a traditional boat for a one-hour journey along the Yen Stream. The ride offers beautiful views of rice fields, limestone cliffs, and tranquil waterways as you make your way to Thien Tru Harbor.

Visit to Thien Tru Pagoda and Trek to Huong Tich Cave

Once you reach Thien Tru Pagoda, begin your trek toward the Perfume Pagoda complex. Continue your ascent to Huong Tich Cave, located at the top of the mountain. This sacred cave is known for its ancient legends and spiritual relics, including the symbolic “Golden Tree” and “Silver Tree.”

Travelers may choose to trek for approximately one hour or take the optional cable car (fee not included).

Lunch at a Local Restaurant

After your descent, enjoy a traditional Vietnamese lunch at a local restaurant at the base of the mountain.

Heaven Kitchen Pagoda (Thien Tru Pagoda Complex)

Following lunch, visit the Heaven Kitchen Pagoda, an important historical site displaying Buddhist architecture from the Le Dynasty. Learn about its cultural significance before returning to your boat.

Return to Hanoi

Re-board the boat for the return trip, followed by a comfortable two-hour drive back to Hanoi.

The tour concludes with drop-off at your hotel at approximately 18:00.

What Is Included

  • Full transfers by air-conditioned private car

  • Boat trip on the Yen Stream

  • Entrance fees

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • English-speaking guide

Tour Price

68 USD per person

Vietlook Travel is committed to offering meaningful cultural experiences, combining comfort, authenticity, and expert guidance throughout your journey.
tours.titleZh: 香寺一日游
tours.summaryZh: 开启一段香寺全天心灵之旅：燕溪泛舟、参观天厨寺、徒步至香迹洞，并在当地餐厅享用午餐。每人68美元，含空调私家车接送、泛舟、门票、午餐及英语导游。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
开启一段香寺全天心灵之旅。香寺是坐落于香迹石灰岩山中的庞大而神圣的佛寺与神龛建筑群。本行程融合了风景如画的水道、山间小径，并让您深入了解越南绵延数百年的佛教文化。

行程安排

08:00 – 酒店接客

导游和司机将在河内老城区您下榻的酒店与您会合。接上客人后，您将在宁静的乡间公路上行驶约两小时，驶向香寺。

燕溪（Yen Stream）泛舟

抵达后，乘坐传统小船沿燕溪航行约一小时。沿途可欣赏稻田、石灰岩峭壁和宁静水道的美景，前往天厨码头。

参观天厨寺并徒步前往香迹洞

抵达天厨寺后，开始徒步前往香寺建筑群，继续攀登至山顶的香迹洞。这座圣洞以古老的传说和灵性圣物闻名，其中包括具有象征意义的“金树”和“银树”。

游客可选择徒步约一小时，或自选乘坐缆车（费用不含）。

当地餐厅午餐

下山后，在山脚下的当地餐厅享用传统越南午餐。

天厨寺（天厨寺建筑群）

午餐后参观天厨寺，这是一处重要的历史古迹，展现了黎朝时期的佛教建筑。了解其文化意义后，返回乘船处。

返回河内

重新登船返程，随后乘车舒适地行驶约两小时返回河内。

行程于约18:00送您回酒店后结束。

费用包含

  • 全程空调私家车接送

  • 燕溪泛舟

  • 门票

  • 当地餐厅午餐

  • 英语导游

团费

每人68美元

tours.title: Ninh Binh Discovery: Hoa Lu – Bai Dinh Pagoda – Mua Cave
tours.summary: Explore the natural beauty and cultural heritage of Ninh Binh on this full-day tour. From ancient temples to towering limestone mountains and serene river landscapes, this experience offers an unforgettable glimpse of no
tours.contentHtml:
Explore the natural beauty and cultural heritage of Ninh Binh on this full-day tour. From ancient temples to towering limestone mountains and serene river landscapes, this experience offers an unforgettable glimpse of northern Vietnam.

Itinerary

07:00 – 07:40 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide will meet you at your hotel in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer journey through the peaceful countryside in a modern, comfortable bus. A short break will be made en route.

10:00 – Visit Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

Arrive at Bai Dinh, the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Located at the base of Dinh Mountain, the complex offers breathtaking views of valleys, rivers, and limestone formations.

Explore several remarkable highlights of this impressive Buddhist complex:

  • 500 stone statues of “La Han” (Arhats)

  • Two giant bronze bells weighing 27 and 36 tons

  • The thousand-eyed, thousand-armed Quan Yin statue

  • The massive Gautama Buddha statue

This area is so large it requires a full day to explore in depth. During this tour, you will visit the most significant and culturally important landmarks.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a buffet-style meal featuring delicious regional Vietnamese cuisine.

13:30 – Explore Trang An Grottoes

Continue to the stunning Trang An Landscape Complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This area features a majestic limestone mountain system covering 20 square kilometers. Hidden among the cliffs are serene valleys, freshwater ponds, and lush forests.
Board a traditional sampan boat and gently float along the river as you pass through impressive caves such as Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, and Thanh Truot Cave. You will also see Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

15:30 – Visit Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

Start your trek up Ngoa Long Mountain, where the viewpoint offers one of the most spectacular views in northern Vietnam. From the summit, admire panoramic scenery of rice fields, rivers, and limestone peaks.

16:30 – Return to Hanoi

Board the bus for the return journey.

18:30 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at your hotel in the Old Quarter. The tour concludes.

Inclusion

  • Pick-up from hotels in Hanoi Old Quarter by Bus or Limousine Bus

  • Fully escorted tour with professional English-speaking guide

  • Two bottles of water per person

  • Buffet lunch at a local restaurant

  • All entrance fees listed in the itinerary

Exclusion

  • Beverages, travel insurance, personal expenses, and tips for the guide

  • Electric car at Bai Dinh Pagoda (5 United States Dollars per person)

  • Limousine bus upgrade (19-seat vehicle) additional 5 United States Dollars per person

  • Children from 5 to 8 years old: 75 percent of adult price

  • Children from 9 years old and above: charged as adults

  • Children under 5 years old: free of charge (excluding entrance tickets, meals, and bus seat)

Tour Price

30 United States Dollars per person
tours.titleZh: 宁平探索：华闾—拜亭寺—舞洞
tours.summaryZh: 在这趟一日游中探索宁平的自然之美与文化遗产。从古老的寺庙到高耸的石灰岩山峰，再到宁静的河流风光，这段旅程让您难忘地一窥越南北部的魅力。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
在这趟一日游中探索宁平的自然之美与文化遗产。从古老的寺庙到高耸的石灰岩山峰，再到宁静的河流风光，这段旅程让您难忘地一窥越南北部的魅力。

行程安排

07:00 – 07:40 – 酒店接客

导游将在河内老城区的酒店与您会合。乘坐现代舒适的巴士，开始110公里的旅程，穿越宁静的乡村。途中会短暂休息。

10:00 – 参观白定寺建筑群

抵达白定寺，这是越南和东南亚规模最大的寺庙建筑群。寺院坐落在丁山脚下，可饱览山谷、河流和石灰岩地貌的壮丽景色。

探索这座宏伟佛教建筑群的几处非凡亮点：

  • 500尊“罗汉”石像

  • 两口重达27吨和36吨的巨型铜钟

  • 千手千眼观音像

  • 巨大的释迦牟尼佛像

这片区域规模宏大，需要一整天才能深入游览。本次行程中，您将参观最重要、最具文化意义的景点。

12:00 – 当地餐厅午餐

享用自助式午餐，品尝美味的越南地方风味菜肴。

13:30 – 探索长安洞窟

继续前往风景绝美的长安名胜群，这里是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。这片区域拥有雄伟的石灰岩山脉，面积达20平方公里。悬崖之间隐藏着宁静的山谷、淡水池塘和葱郁的森林。
乘坐传统小舟，沿河轻轻漂流，穿过蓝洞（Lâm）、黄洞（Vàng）、大洞（Đại）和清滑洞（Thánh Trượt）等壮观的溶洞。您还将看到高山寺、泉仙寺和武林寺。

15:30 – 参观舞洞和卧龙山

开始攀登卧龙山，山顶观景台能欣赏到越南北部最壮观的景色之一。站在山顶，可俯瞰稻田、河流和石灰岩山峰的全景。

16:30 – 返回河内

登上巴士踏上返程。

18:30 – 抵达河内

送您到老城区的酒店，行程结束。

费用包含

  • 乘坐巴士或豪华商务巴士，从河内老城区酒店接送

  • 5岁以下儿童：免费（不含门票、餐食及巴士座位）

    • Warm clothes, scarf, hat, cap because the weather in Sapa is pretty unpredictable. It is normally cold in September, October, November, December, January, February and March

  • 参观胡志明市地标：战争遗迹博物馆、圣母大教堂和统一宫。探秘古芝地道。

tours.title: Vietnam Tour 18 Days 17 Nights From Hanoi
tours.summary: Sightseeing Highlights Walk through the little alley streets of Hanoi Old Quarter, Enjoy the local food discovery tour. Take the overnight cruise trip, Admire Halong Bay’s majestic beauty. Explore Hue’s Forbidden Purple
tours.contentHtml:
Sightseeing Highlights

  • Walk through the little alley streets of Hanoi Old Quarter, Enjoy the local food discovery tour.
  • Take the overnight cruise trip, Admire Halong Bay’s majestic beauty.

  • Explore Hue’s Forbidden Purple City, Enjoy a vegetarian meal at a Buddhist temple.

  • Climb the Marble Mountain in Da Nang, stroll through the streets of Hoi An Ancient town and taste the delicious local food.

  • Visit Tra Que village, Take part in a fun farming lesson.

  • Discover the spectacular maze of Cu Chi tunnels below ground, See the Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Reunification Palace in Ho Chi Minh City

  • Take a day trip to the Mekong Delta to discover the hidden waterways.

Dining Experience

  • 11 hotel buffet breakfasts.
  • 5 dinners and 6 lunches at well-selected restaurants
  • 2 street food tours

What’s Included?

  • Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C train, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.

What’s Not Included?

  • Your international flights from and to Vietnam, the entry visa to Vietnam, personal expenses, tips to guide and driver.
tours.titleZh: 河内出发越南十八天十七晚游
tours.summaryZh: 观光亮点：漫步河内老城区的小巷街道，享受当地美食探索之旅。乘坐过夜游轮，欣赏下龙湾的雄伟壮丽。探索顺化紫禁城……
tours.contentHtmlZh:
观光亮点

  • 漫步河内老城区的小巷街道，享受当地美食探索之旅。
  • 乘坐过夜游轮，欣赏下龙湾的雄伟壮丽。

  • 探索顺化紫禁城，在佛寺中享用一顿素斋。

  • 攀登岘港五行山，漫步会安古镇街巷，品尝地道美食。

  • 参观茶桂（Trà Quế）蔬菜村，参与有趣的农耕体验课。

  • 探秘地下纵横交错、蔚为壮观的古芝地道，游览胡志明市的红教堂（圣母大教堂）和统一宫

  • 一日游湄公河三角洲，探寻隐秘的水道风光。

美食体验

  • 11顿酒店自助早餐。
  • 5顿晚餐和6顿午餐，均安排在精选餐厅
  • 2次街头美食之旅

费用包含

  • 私人英语导游、住宿、私人游览及接送、国内航班、空调火车、部分主要餐食、所有门票、税费及服务费。

费用不包含

  • 往返越南的国际航班、越南入境签证、个人开销、导游和司机小费。

tours.title: Vietnam Heritage Discovery Tour 16 Days 15 Nights
tours.summary: Sightseeing Highlights Discover Hanoi’s best-known landmarks, enjoy authentic local food. Spend a night for quality time on board an overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay Unveil the spectacular network of caves, archways, and
tours.contentHtml:
Sightseeing Highlights

  • Discover Hanoi’s best-known landmarks, enjoy authentic local food.

  • Spend a night for quality time on board an overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay
  • Unveil the spectacular network of caves, archways, and grottoes in Ninh Binh

  • Explore the glamorous Phong Nha Cave (the world’s largest cave), enjoy a day ride train through the DMZ.

  • Visit Imperial Citadel and Emperor Mausoleums in Hue

  • Climb the Marble Mountain, Walk through the charming town of Hoi An
  • Have fun with beach time, cooking class, or get some cloth made in Hoi An

  • Visit Ho Chi Minh City landmarks: War Remnant Museum, Notre Dame Cathedral, and Reunification Palace. Crawl through the legendary Cu Chi Tunnels

  • Enjoy a discovery day in lush green Ben Tre town – Home of coconut in the Mekong Delta.

Dining Experience

  • 15 hotel buffet breakfasts
  • 3 dinners and 7 lunches at well-selected restaurants.

What’s Included?

  • Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C vehicles, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.

What’s Not Included?

  • Your international flights from and to Vietnam, entry visa to Vietnam, personal expenses, tips to guide and driver.
tours.titleZh: 越南遗产探索之旅十六天十五晚
tours.summaryZh: 观光亮点 探索河内最著名的地标，品尝地道当地美食。在下龙湾邮轮上过夜，享受悠闲美好的时光 揭开宁平错综壮观的洞穴、拱门与石窟的神秘面纱
tours.contentHtmlZh:
观光亮点

  • 探索河内最著名的地标，品尝地道当地美食。

  • 在下龙湾邮轮上过夜，享受悠闲美好的时光
  • 揭开宁平错综壮观的洞穴、拱门与石窟的神秘面纱

  • 探索迷人的峰牙洞（世界最大洞穴），并乘坐一日火车穿越非军事区（DMZ）。

  • 参观顺化皇城和帝王陵寝

  • 攀登五行山，漫步迷人的会安古镇
  • 尽情享受海滩时光、烹饪课程，或在会安定制衣服

  • 参观胡志明市地标：战争遗迹博物馆、圣母大教堂和统一宫。穿越传奇的古芝地道

tours.summaryZh: 景点亮点：河内著名地标、板约瀑布、巴蓄湖、河江山区、沙坝山地部落、番西邦缆车以及蓝霞湾游轮过夜。含12顿酒店早餐、5顿晚餐和10顿午餐、私人英语导游等。
tours.contentHtmlZh:

  • 探访河内最著名的地标景点，品尝地道本地美食

参观板约瀑布，风景秀丽之地的壮观景象

  • 探索越南最大的天然湖泊巴蓄湖（Ba Be），湖畔石灰岩峭壁环绕，原始森林覆盖。
  • 探索令人惊叹的山城河江，尽览全景式壮丽风光。

  • 乘坐缆车——世界最长、最高的缆车之一，直达海拔3,143米的番西邦峰（Fansipan），被誉为“中南半岛屋脊”

tours.summary: Sightseeing Highlights Explore Ho Chi Minh City like a local, rising early for a cyclo ride through peaceful parks, sipping French-pressed Vietnamese coffee, perusing flowers at a local market. Discovery Mekong Delta and
tours.contentHtml:
Sightseeing Highlights

  • Explore Ho Chi Minh City like a local, rising early for a cyclo ride through peaceful parks, sipping French-pressed Vietnamese coffee, perusing flowers at a local market.

  • Discovery Mekong Delta and enjoy a unique experience stay at Co Co Riverside Lodge

  • Discover the forests surrounded villages and deep in local life and culture of the native ethnic groups in the Central Highlands of Vietnam

  • Visit Buon Ma Thuot, the coffee capital of Vietnam which has played a key role in Vietnam’s success as the world’s top Robusta.

  • Explore two of the most impressive waterfalls in the Central Highlands of Vietnam: Dray Sap and Dray Nu

  • Join a full day elephant experience in Yok Don National Park with the stories of training and working with elephants.
  • Discovery the fascinating ancient town of Hoi An and take a cookery course.

  • Experience Hanoi off the beaten path by Russian Minsk motorcycle

  • Dip into traditional Vietnamese culture by trekking through lush hill tribe villages in Da Bac
  • Row through a huge network of waterways out into lakes dwarfed by limestone mountains in Ninh Binh
  • Take the overnight cruise trip, Admire Lan Ha Bay’s majestic beauty.

  • Free time to wander through the bustling narrow streets of the Old Quarter lined with shop-houses.

Dining Experience

  • 21 buffet breakfasts.
  • 8 dinners and 14 lunches at well-selected restaurants

What’s Not Included?

  • Your international flights from and to Vietnam, the entry visa to Vietnam, personal expense, tips to guide and driver.
tours.titleZh: 越南二十二天二十一晚游
tours.summaryZh: 观光亮点：像当地人一样探索胡志明市、探索湄公河三角洲、深入中部高原少数民族村寨、造访咖啡之都邦美蜀、Yok Don国家公园大象体验、会安古镇、河内摩托车之旅、宁平水道与下龙湾过夜游轮。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
观光亮点

  • 像当地人一样探索胡志明市：清晨早起乘坐三轮车穿过宁静的公园，品尝法式滴滤越南咖啡，逛一逛当地花市。

  • 探索湄公河三角洲，并在Co Co Riverside Lodge体验独特的住宿

  • 探访森林环绕的村落，深入了解越南中部高原当地少数民族的生活与文化

  • 造访邦美蜀（Buôn Ma Thuột），这座越南咖啡之都，在越南成为全球罗布斯塔咖啡第一大产国的过程中扮演了关键角色。

  • 探索越南中部高原最壮观的两座瀑布：Dray Sap瀑布和Dray Nu瀑布

  • 在Yok Don国家公园参加全天大象体验，聆听训练和驯养大象的故事。
  • 探索迷人的会安古镇，并参加烹饪课程。

  • 乘坐俄罗斯Minsk摩托车，体验河内的非主流路线

  • 徒步穿越郁郁葱葱的Da Bac山地部落村寨，沉浸于越南传统文化
  • 在宁平划船穿行于纵横交错的水道，驶入被石灰岩山峰衬得渺小的湖泊
  • 乘坐过夜游轮，欣赏Lan Ha湾的壮丽美景。

  • 自由活动时间，漫步在两旁林立着店屋的熙攘狭窄的老城区街巷。

餐饮体验

  • 21顿自助早餐。

tours.title: Tour Ho Chi Minh – Mekong – Hoi An – Hue – Hanoi – Ninh Binh – Ha Long – 12 days 11 nights
tours.summary: Vietnam, an S-shaped country, often likened to a dragon, is located in the west of the East Sea. The perfect combination of elegance and rustic charm always captivates travelers with rich experiences, beautiful landscape
tours.contentHtml:
Vietnam, an S-shaped country, often likened to a dragon, is located in the west of the East Sea. The perfect combination of elegance and rustic charm always captivates travelers with rich experiences, beautiful landscapes and hospitable people who seem to want to hold travelers’ footsteps.

Sightseeing Highlights

  • Visit Ho Chi Minh City landmarks such as: War Remnants Museum, Notre Dame Cathedral, Reunification Palace and the former US Embassy….

  • Explore the legendary Cu Chi tunnels.

  • Explore Cai Rang Floating Market and visit handicraft villages in the Mekong Delta.

  • Take a walking of Hoi An Ancient town, get some cloth made at the local tailor shops.

  • Discover the Imperial Citadel and the Emperor Mausoleums in Hue.

  • Take a cyclo (rickshaw) through the French Quarter, Stroll around Hanoi’s Old Quarter and Hoan Kiem Lake.Row a boat through the lakes and admire the limestone mountains of Ninh Binh.

  • Spend a night onboard an overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay.

Dining Experience

  • 10 hotel buffet breakfasts.
  • 2 dinners and 7 lunches at well-selected restaurants.
  • 1 Cooking demonstration on Halong Bay boat

What’s Included?

  • Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C vehicles, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.

What’s Not Included?

  • Your international flights from and to Vietnam, entry visa to Vietnam, personal expense, tips to guide and driver.

tours.summaryZh: 越南是一个呈S形的国度，常被比作一条巨龙。本行程串联胡志明市、古芝地道、湄公河三角洲、会安古镇、顺化皇城、河内、宁平和下龙湾游轮，含酒店早餐、精选餐厅用餐、私人英语导游及国内机票。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
越南是一个呈S形的国度，常被比作一条巨龙，位于东海之西。典雅与质朴的完美融合，丰富的体验、秀美的风光和热情好客的人们，总让旅行者流连忘返，不忍离去。

景点亮点

  • 探访Cái Răng水上市场，参观湄公河三角洲的手工艺村。

  • 探访顺化皇城和历代帝王陵寝。

  • 乘坐三轮车穿行法国区，漫步河内老城区和还剑湖。在宁平划船穿越湖泊，欣赏石灰岩山峰。

  • 在下龙湾的游轮上过夜。

用餐体验

  • 10顿酒店自助早餐。
  • 2顿晚餐和7顿午餐，均在精选餐厅享用。

tours.contentHtml:

Children (please read carefully to understand the standards for children):

  • Children aged 1-4 free of charge (parents cover all costs for the child; no seat on the coach). Two adults may bring only one free child; from the second child, 75% of the tour price applies (with the same standard as a paying child).
  • If one adult travels with one child aged 1-4 the child must pay 50% of the adult tour price (and receives the same services as a child aged 5-9).
  • Children aged 5-9 pay 75% of the tour price (own meal portion and own seat on the coach, but sharing a bed with parents). Two paying children also do not receive a separate bed.
  • Children aged 10 and over are charged as adults.

  • Take the overnight cruise trip, Admire Bai Tu Long Bay’s majestic beauty.

  • Explore the weaving laneways of historic Hoi An ancient town on the banks of the Thu Bon River by bicycle ride. Join exciting basket boat activity in Cam Thanh village.

  • Enjoy a day of snorkeling in the waters around Cham Island and discover its amazing sea life

  • Experience and relax in a spectacular setting in a dramatic bay that gives the feeling of being on an exclusive private island resort in the East Vietnam Sea, “hidden” Ninh Van Bay  

  • Visit Ho Chi Minh City landmarks: War Remnant Museum, Notre Dame Cathedral, Reunification Palace, and Ben Thanh Market…etc.

  • Take a day trip to the Mekong Delta to discover the hidden waterways.

Dining Experience

  • 13 hotel buffet breakfasts
  • 5 dinners and 6 lunches at well-selected restaurants and local homes

What’s Included?

  • Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C vehicles, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.

What’s Not Included?

  • Your international flights from and to Vietnam, entry visa to Vietnam, personal expenses, tips to guide and driver.
tours.titleZh: 越南蜜月之旅十四天十三晚
tours.summaryZh: 景点亮点：河内地标、唐林古村、白龙尾湾过夜游轮、会安古镇、占婆岛浮潜、宁云湾、胡志明市和湄公河三角洲。含13顿酒店早餐、5顿晚餐和6顿午餐。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
景点亮点

  • 探访河内最著名的地标景点，享用当地家庭款待的晚餐

  • 参观Ky Son和唐林古村，体验越南乡村的传统生活和地道文化

  • 乘坐过夜游轮，欣赏白龙尾湾（Bai Tu Long）的雄伟之美。

  • 骑自行车穿行于秋盆河畔历史悠久的会安古镇蜿蜒的小巷。在锦清村（Cam Thanh）体验刺激的竹篮船活动。

  • 在占婆岛周边海域享受一天的浮潜，探索奇妙的海洋生物

  • 在壮丽的海湾中体验和放松，仿佛置身东海上的私人专属岛屿度假村——“隐秘”的宁云湾（Ninh Van）  

  • 参观胡志明市地标：战争遗迹博物馆、圣母大教堂、统一宫和滨城市场等。

  • 前往湄公河三角洲一日游，探寻隐秘的水道。

用餐体验

  • 13顿酒店自助早餐
  • 5顿晚餐和6顿午餐，在精选餐厅和当地家庭享用

费用包含

  • 英语私人导游、住宿、私人游览及接送、国内机票、空调车辆、部分正餐、所有景点门票、税费及服务费。

费用不含

  • 往返越南的国际机票、越南入境签证、个人消费、导游和司机小费。

More than 21 days before arrival: No charge
    • 14-21 days before arrival: 20% of total tour price
    • 7-14 days before arrival: 45% of total tour price
    • 3-7 days before arrival: 75% of total tour price

tours.contentHtml:
If you are staying in Da Nang and looking for a comfortable and flexible way to visit My Son Sanctuary, Vietlook Travel offers a round-trip private car service from Da Nang to My Son with an experienced local driver.

My Son Sanctuary is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most important cultural and historical destinations in central Vietnam. Traveling by private car allows you to enjoy the journey at your own pace while avoiding the limitations of group tours.

Da Nang to My Son Distance and Travel Time

The distance from Da Nang city center to My Son Sanctuary is approximately forty kilometers one way. The transfer by private car takes about one hour to one hour and fifteen minutes, depending on traffic conditions.

With a private car, you can choose your preferred departure time and enjoy a direct, door-to-door service without waiting for other passengers.

Flexible Private Car Service

By booking a Da Nang to My Son private car with Vietlook Travel, you will enjoy:

  • Full flexibility in departure time

  • Door-to-door pick-up and drop-off at your hotel

  • Privacy and comfort during the journey

  • Freedom to stop for photos, rest breaks, or refreshments

Our experienced drivers are familiar with the route and will ensure a safe and smooth transfer.

About My Son Sanctuary

My Son Sanctuary was the religious and political center of the ancient Champa Kingdom from the fourth to the thirteenth century. The complex includes a group of Hindu temples and towers set in a lush valley surrounded by mountains.

Visitors can explore:

  • Ancient Cham temple ruins

  • Historical architecture and carvings

  • Peaceful natural surroundings

You may spend as much time as you wish at the site, depending on your schedule.

tours.title: Nha Trang To Dalat Private Car Transfer
tours.summary: Nha Trang to Dalat private car transfer is a high-quality door-to-door service for travelers from the beach city to the “city of love” Dalat. By booking transport with A/C private cars and English-speaking drivers, vacat
tours.contentHtml:
Nha Trang to Dalat private car transfer is a high-quality door-to-door service for travelers from the beach city to the “city of love” Dalat. By booking transport with A/C private cars and English-speaking drivers, vacationers will have easy, hassle-free trips to Dalat from Nha Trang.

Nha Trang To Dalat Distance

Dalat and Nha Trang are two popular destinations among holidaymakers coming to Vietnam. While Nha Trang is famous for its exquisite beaches, Dalat appeals to visitors thanks to dreamy views of hills and valleys.

The distance from Nha Trang to Da Lat is ~212 km (132 miles). It is expected to take approximately 4,5 hours by car, following the CT01 route that connects to QL27, which is currently the fastest route. However, bad weather and heavy traffic can prolong your trip by 1 to 2 hours longer than expected.

How To Get To Dalat From Nha Trang

So, how to go from Nha Trang to Dalat? Transfers by bus, taxi, private car, or motorcycle are several of the most commonly chosen ways. However, we believe private car transfers bring the most conveniences and comfort.

It’s door-to-door, private, customizable, and flexible. You can get pick-ups and drop-offs right at your hotels in the cities without worrying about tickets, scams, extra costs, finding stations, changing vehicles, etc.

NHA TRANG TO DALAT PRIVATE CAR TRANSFER

Travel Briefing

  • Distance: 212km (~132 miles)
  • Travel Time: 4,5 – 5 hours
  • Pick-up Point: Hotel/Resort/Homestay in Nha Trang
  • Drop-off Point: Hotel/Resort/Homestay in Dalat
  • Types of Private Car: Sedan/SUV/Minivan/Limousine

Travel From Nha Trang To Dalat By Private Car

First of all, you make a booking with us and inform us of your preferred pick-up place, time, drop-off hotel, and other requests that you have. After confirming everything, our travel experts will arrange a private car and an excellent driver for you.

Later, our driver will pick you up at your requested hotel/homestay in Nha Trang City. He will welcome you to the car, help you with the luggage, and leave for Dalat.

During the 3-hour trip, you can ask him to stop for snacks, a short break, or a toilet. Our driver will be happy to drop by a suitable spot, so don’t worry about the long hours in the car.

Lastly, our driver will drop you off at your hotel in Dalat City. He will look around the car seat spaces to ensure you don’t forget anything and say goodbye.

Moreover, if you would like to do a Nha Trang day trip before getting to Dalat, we can set up a sightseeing tour by car for you, as follows:

We pick you up at your hotel in Nha Trang. Then, the car will take you to your requested attractions, such as Nha Trang beaches, Po Nagar Cham Towers, Stone Church, Nha Trang Institute of Oceanography, Hon Mun Marine Protected Area, Long Son Pagoda, etc. Finally, we transfer you to Dalat.

Don’t hesitate to contact us if you have any requests. We will try our best to meet your travel needs. Vietlook Travel looks forward to seeing you on our Nha Trang to Dalat private car journey.

tours.summaryZh: 芽庄至大叻私家车接送是为从海滨城市前往“爱之城”大叻的旅客提供的高品质门到门服务。预订配空调私家车和英语司机的交通服务，度假游客可以轻松无忧地从芽庄前往大叻。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
芽庄至大叻私家车接送是为从海滨城市前往“爱之城”大叻的旅客提供的高品质门到门服务。预订配空调私家车和英语司机的交通服务，度假游客可以轻松无忧地从芽庄前往大叻。

芽庄至大叻的距离

大叻和芽庄是来越南度假的游客非常喜爱的两大目的地。芽庄以精致的海滩闻名，而大叻则以如梦如幻的山丘与山谷风光吸引游客。

芽庄到大叻的距离约212公里（132英里）。沿CT01路线连接QL27国道，预计乘车约4,5小时，这是目前最快的路线。不过，恶劣天气和交通拥堵可能使行程比预期多出1至2小时。

如何从芽庄前往大叻

那么，如何从芽庄前往大叻？乘坐巴士、出租车、私家车或摩托车是最常见的几种方式。不过，我们认为私家车接送最为便利舒适。

它门到门、私密、可定制且灵活。您可以在城市的酒店直接接送，无需担心车票、诈骗、额外费用、寻找车站、换乘车辆等问题。

芽庄至大叻私家车接送

行程简介

  • 距离：212公里（约132英里）
  • 行车时间：4,5 – 5小时
  • 上车地点：芽庄的酒店/度假村/民宿
  • 下车地点：大叻的酒店/度假村/民宿
  • 私家车类型：轿车/SUV/商务车/豪华商务车

乘私家车从芽庄前往大叻

首先，您向我们预订，并告知偏好的上车地点、时间、大叻的下车酒店及其他要求。确认所有事项后，我们的旅行专家将为您安排私家车和优秀的司机。

随后，司机将在芽庄市您指定的酒店/民宿接您。他会迎您上车，帮您搬运行李，然后启程前往大叻。

在3小时的行程中，您可以要求他停车买零食、短暂休息或上洗手间。司机会乐意在合适的地点停靠，因此不必担心长时间坐车。

最后，司机会把您送到大叻市的酒店。他会检查车内座位周围，确保您没有遗忘任何物品，然后与您道别。

此外，如果您想在前往大叻之前先游览芽庄一日，我们可以为您安排乘车观光行程，如下：

我们在芽庄的酒店接您。然后，车辆将带您前往您指定的景点，如芽庄海滩、婆那加占婆塔（Po Nagar）、石教堂、芽庄海洋研究所、黑岛海洋保护区、龙山寺等。最后，我们送您前往大叻。

如有任何需求，请随时联系我们。我们将尽力满足您的旅行需求。Vietlook Travel期待在芽庄至大叻私家车之旅中与您相见。

tours.contentHtml:
Nha Trang To Mui Ne Private Car is a professional shuttle service that takes you to Mui Ne after your Nha Trang vacation ends. When booking our private car service, you will be transferred by a private driver at the time you specify.

In addition, you will be able to relax in a clean and modern specialized car with comfortable seats and a cool air-conditioning system. Besides, you can use free bottled water prepared in the car.

Furthermore, our experienced driver will choose some beautiful stops suitable for you to sightsee, enjoy coffee, and use the restroom. If you want to sightsee a beautiful place along the way, don’t be afraid to let our driver know. He’ll be glad to comply with your requests.

NHA TRANG TO MUI NE BY PRIVATE CAR

How To Get From Nha Trang To Mui Ne

Mũi Né offers tourists a blend of experiences. You can explore vast white and red sand dunes and wade through the enchanting Fairy Stream with its colorful sand as well as unique formations. Plus, come to visit the bustling fishing village to witness local life and fresh seafood markets. Visitors can also enjoy water sports, cultural landmarks like Po Sah Inu Cham Towers, and stunning coastal sunsets. The vibrant atmosphere combines nature, culture, and adventure beautifully.

The Nha Trang to Mui Ne distance is about 200km, which means it will take around 4 hours to travel directly by private car. Nowadays, guests can travel by many vehicles, such as a coach, train, plane, shared car, or private car. However, a private car is the most popular choice among overseas tourists because of its flexibility and convenience.

Private Car Nha Trang To Mui Ne

First of all, our private car will pick you up at your hotel, homestay, or resort in Nha Trang City on time. After greeting you, our friendly driver will remind you to double-check your passport and take you to the car. Then, we will start the Nha Trang To Mui Ne Private Car.

Along the way, our experienced driver will choose some suitable stops for you to rest and sightsee. In addition, visitors can ask our driver to stop the car when they need to eat and use the restroom.

After all, our private car will take you to your accommodation in Mui Ne as you requested. Our driver will return your luggage and check the car again before saying goodbye. Finally, we ended the Nha Trang to Mui Ne private car trip. Vietlook Travel wishes you an enjoyable vacation in Mui Ne Binh Thuan.

芽庄至美奈私人包车

如何从芽庄前往美奈

美奈（Mũi Né） 为游客带来多元的体验。您可以探索广阔的白沙丘和红沙丘，涉水穿行迷人的仙女溪（Fairy Stream），欣赏其五彩沙地和独特地貌。此外，还可参观热闹的渔村，了解当地生活并逛逛新鲜海鲜市场。游客还可以体验水上运动、参观婆莎努（Po Sah Inu）占婆塔等文化地标，欣赏绝美的海岸日落。这里活力四射的氛围完美融合了自然、文化与探险。

芽庄至美奈的距离约200公里，乘私家车直达大约需要4小时。如今，游客可以选择多种交通方式，如长途大巴、火车、飞机、拼车或包车。不过，包车因其灵活便利，是海外游客最受欢迎的选择。

芽庄至美奈包车服务

tours.title: Nha Trang To Saigon Private Car Transfer
tours.summary: Nha Trang to Saigon private car transfer offers visitors high-standard transportation from Vietnam’s best coastal city to Ho Chi Minh City. Besides easy and safe transfers with experienced drivers, this door-to-door shut
tours.contentHtml:
Nha Trang to Saigon private car transfer offers visitors high-standard transportation from Vietnam’s best coastal city to Ho Chi Minh City. Besides easy and safe transfers with experienced drivers, this door-to-door shuttle service is also tailored to travellers’ requests, which ensures top convenience and flexibility.

NHA TRANG TO SAIGON PRIVATE CAR TRANSFER

Nha Trang To Saigon Distance

The distance from Nha Trang to Ho Chi Minh City is roughly 400 kilometres. It will take around 6 hours to pass by car. Trains, sleeper buses, airlines, and private cars are popular modes of transportation for visitors. Each one is suitable for a specific target traveller.

Those who prefer door-to-door shuttle services, flexibility, and the opportunity for sightseeing along the way should consider our private car transfer. Learn more about it as follows.

Travel From Nha Trang To Saigon By Car

If you want a Nha Trang to Ho Chi Minh City private car ride, first of all, you should give us the trip details (pickup time, locations, stops en route, etc.). Accordingly, we will inform you of all costs and confirm the trip if you agree to proceed with booking it.

Later, a driver and a private car will be sent to your requested hotel in Nha Trang to pick you up. Before kicking it off, our driver will help you carry the luggage and settle into the seats.

During the journey from Nha Trang to Saigon, please don’t hesitate to ask our driver to stop if you need a short break, use the toilet, or have lunch/dinner. Our experienced driver will find a suitable spot for you.

Upon arrival at your hotel in Ho Chi Minh City, our driver will drop you off, return your luggage, check the car seats in case you’ve forgotten anything, and then say goodbye. After all, your Nha Trang to Saigon private car trip finishes here.

Please contact Vietlook Travel immediately if you require any travel services. We wish you a wonderful time in Vietnam.

What Should You Visit Along The Way?

You will cross Khanh Hoa, Ninh Thuan, Binh Thuan, and Dong Nai before Saigon. If you’re fed up with a direct transfer from Nha Trang to Saigon, we can arrange a sightseeing trip with interesting tourist venues, such as:

Cam Ranh Bay (Khanh Hoa Province)

Apart from being a strategic spot, Cam Ranh Bay appeals to visitors as an untouched landscape. Unlike the modern appearance of Nha Trang beaches, the bay seems more rural, idyllic, and poetic.

You can drop by to admire the views and taste some signature seafood dishes made out of fresh squid, lobster, or crab.

Mui Ne (Binh Thuan Province)

If you’re interested in “beach heavens” in Vietnam, you must have heard of Mui Ne. It’s a national tourism area, boasting the best highlights, including dream-like beaches and impressive dunes.

If you’d like to take a look at Mui Ne Beach, our driver can make a brief stop at one of the most beautiful coastal viewpoints in the area.

Po Sah Inu Cham Towers

Known as the oldest temple in Binh Thuan, Po Sah Inu Towers will give visitors a sacred and mysterious atmosphere. It’s part of the Cham tower ruins collection, so it holds great significance in Vietnamese history and culture.

If you’re keen on ancient relics, historical constructions, and architecture, this site is worth your time.

Ho Chi Minh City

If you want to quickly see Saigon, we can do a no-guide city tour right away upon arrival. Our private car can take you around Ho Chi Minh City, show you to famous attractions, and introduce you to local eateries, before dropping you off at your hotel.

Notre Dame Cathedral, Independence Palace, and the Central Post Office are some must-see places. Besides, let’s try some street dishes, such as banh mi, com tam rice, pho Saigon, noodles, and coffee.

tours.titleZh: 芽庄至西贡包车接送
tours.summaryZh: 芽庄至西贡私人包车接送为游客提供高标准的交通服务。经验丰富的司机、门到门接送，还可定制沿途观光行程，兼具便利与灵活。
tours.contentHtmlZh:
芽庄至西贡 私人包车接送 为游客提供从越南最美海滨城市前往胡志明市的高标准交通服务。除了由经验丰富的司机提供轻松安全的接送外，这项门到门接送服务还可根据旅客的需求量身定制，确保极致的便利与灵活。

芽庄至西贡私人包车接送

芽庄至西贡的距离

芽庄到胡志明市的距离约400公里，乘车大约需要6小时。火车、卧铺大巴、飞机和包车都是游客常用的交通方式，各自适合不同类型的旅客。

喜欢门到门接送、灵活出行并希望沿途观光的旅客，不妨考虑我们的包车接送服务。详情如下。

乘车从芽庄前往西贡

如果您想预订芽庄至胡志明市的包车，首先请告知我们行程详情（接客时间、地点、途中停靠点等）。我们会据此告知您所有费用，若您同意预订，我们将确认行程。

随后，我们会派司机和专车前往您指定的芽庄酒店接您。出发前，司机会帮您搬运行李并安顿好座位。

在芽庄前往西贡的途中，如需短暂休息、上洗手间或用午餐/晚餐，请随时请司机停车。经验丰富的司机会为您找到合适的地点。

抵达您在胡志明市的酒店后，司机会让您下车、归还行李，并检查车内座位以防遗漏物品，然后道别。至此，您的芽庄至西贡包车之旅圆满结束。

如需任何旅游服务，请立即联系 Vietlook Travel 。祝您在越南度过美好时光。

沿途有哪些值得一游的地方？

抵达西贡之前，您将途经庆和、宁顺、平顺和同奈。如果您厌倦了从芽庄直达西贡，我们可以安排包含有趣景点的观光行程，例如：

金兰湾（庆和省）

金兰湾除了是战略要地，还以原始未经雕琢的风光吸引游客。与芽庄海滩的现代面貌不同，这里的海湾更显田园、宁静而富有诗意。

您可以顺道欣赏美景，品尝以新鲜鱿鱼、龙虾或螃蟹烹制的招牌海鲜。

美奈（平顺省）

如果您对越南的“海滩天堂”感兴趣，一定听说过美奈。这是一处国家级旅游区，拥有梦幻般的海滩和壮观的沙丘等最精彩的亮点。

如果您想看看美奈海滩，司机可以在该地区最美的海岸观景点之一短暂停留。

婆莎努占婆塔

婆莎努塔被誉为平顺最古老的寺庙，为游客带来神圣而神秘的氛围。它是占婆塔遗迹群的一部分，在越南历史和文化中具有重要意义。

如果您热衷于古迹、历史建筑和建筑艺术，这里值得一游。

tours.title: Mui Ne To Ho Chi Minh By Private Car
tours.summary: After an amazing vacation on the beautiful Mui Ne beach, you may want to travel to Ho Chi Minh City for another trip in this bustling city or to Ho Chi Minh Airport. But you still don’t know which vehicle to take on this
tours.contentHtml:
After an amazing vacation on the beautiful Mui Ne beach, you may want to travel to Ho Chi Minh City for another trip in this bustling city or to Ho Chi Minh Airport. But you still don’t know which vehicle to take on this route. Then choose our Mui Ne To Ho Chi Minh Private Car, the excellent transfer service from Vietlook Travel, to have a comfortable trip with flexible stops and itinerary.

Mui Ne To Ho Chi Minh Distance

Ho Chi Minh City is one of the two largest economic centers of Vietnam. Tourists coming here can visit famous tourist attractions such as Ben Thanh Market, Notre Dame Cathedral, Independence Palace, or Cu Chi Tunnels. In addition, some choose Saigon Airport (Tan Son Nhat Airport) to fly to other provinces for another visit or back to their country.

Tourists in Mui Ne going to Ho Chi Minh City have to travel a distance of about 205 km (~127 miles). This route is not too far, driving through CT01 Highway to Ho Chi Minh City will take you about 3.5-4 hours.

Or if you choose Saigon Airport as your destination, the distance is only 200 km (~124 miles). And it will take you about 3.5 hours by car. However, the road to the airport often has traffic jams, so the Mui Ne to Ho Chi Minh Airport travel time can be extended.

For this journey, tourists can choose to travel by taxi, bus, shared car, or private car. But for a convenient door-to-door trip with comfort and a flexible schedule, we highly recommend you choose our private car service. Then, you will no longer have to worry about the weather or traffic; just relax and enjoy the dedicated services from us.

MUI NE TO HO CHI MINH PRIVATE CAR SERVICE

Booking our private car service is very simple. You just need to fill out the form on our website. Or you can contact us via WhatsApp (+84) 98.339.3488. Then please provide us with some necessary information like the number of passengers, luggage and your other requirements for the trip. We will make a best-fit itinerary for you.

Traveling From Mui Ne To Saigon/ Saigon Airport By Car

Based on your booking, our driver will arrive at your hotel or resort in Mui Ne. He will arrive 10 minutes early so you don’t have to wait. When you meet him, the driver will greet you warmly and then take you to the car. He will help you carry your luggage and get you safely into the car. Once done, your trip from Mui Ne to Saigon by private car begins here.

On the way from Mui Ne, you will always feel relaxed while sitting in a spacious and clean car with many modern amenities. Also, being accompanied by an experienced driver makes you feel more secure. We always prioritize your safety throughout the trip to Ho Chi Minh City/ Airport.

Additionally, along the way, you can ask our driver to stop if you want to use the restroom, have a snack, drink coffee, or sightsee. He will always be happy and willing to stop at the location to suit your request which doesn’t affect your travel time much.

Moreover, traveling from Mui Ne to Ho Chi Minh, you can visit some famous attractions, such as Ta Cu Mountain, Van Thuy Tu Temple, or Po Sah Inư Tower. According to your request, our travel experts put your desired stops into your itinerary and make the visit match your schedule.

After all, you have arrived at Ho Chi Minh or Tan Son Nhat Airport after nearly 4 hours of travel. Upon arrival, our friendly driver will help you unload your luggage from the car. After he has made sure nothing is left in the car, your whole journey from Mui Ne to Ho Chi Minh by car officially ends.

tours.summary: Traveling from Saigon to Mui Ne by private car is a convenient and comfortable way to make the journey. Mui Ne is a popular coastal city in Vietnam known for its beautiful beaches and sand dunes. The distance between Ho
tours.contentHtml:
Traveling from Saigon to Mui Ne by private car is a convenient and comfortable way to make the journey. Mui Ne is a popular coastal city in Vietnam known for its beautiful beaches and sand dunes.

The distance between Ho Chi Minh City and Mui Ne is approximately 220 kilometers (137 miles), and the journey usually takes around 3 – 4 hours, depending on road conditions and stops along the way. Unlike other transport from Saigon to Mui Ne such as grab cars, traditional taxis, or buses, it is inconvenient and easy to get scams.

Traveling by private car offers flexibility and comfort, allowing you to enjoy the journey at your own pace. It’s a popular choice for those who prefer a more personalized and convenient mode of transportation from Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne.

SAIGON TO MUI NE BY PRIVATE CAR

If you land at Tan Son Nhat International Airport and would like to get a private car to travel to Mui Ne, Vietlook Travel will arrange a comfortable car and experienced driver to pick you up.

Please inform us of your flight number, landing time, the number of people as well as your hotel name/ address in Mui Ne. Our driver will wait for you at the Saigon Airport arrival gate with your full name on a welcome board so you can easily recognize him. Then he will transfer you safely to your hotel in Mui Ne.

If you request us to pick you up at a hotel in Saigon, you can choose the pickup time. Our experienced driver will be ready at your hotel lobby and remind you to collect all the passports.

Because this is your private car transfer, you can choose the direct transfer which takes 3 hours by private car. If you like, along the way from Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne, you can request our driver to stop at places for you to have lunch, drink some Vietnamese coffee, or take a short break.

Upon arrival at Mui Ne Hotel, he will help you get the luggage and check the car to make sure you forget nothing and say goodbye to you. We finished the Private Car Saigon to Mui Ne Transfer. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great stay in Mui Ne.

Why Should You Choose Us?

  • Mui Ne to Saigon is always available upon request.
  • Door-to-door private car with a basic English-speaking driver.
  • Our Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne private car price is clear, and reasonable without any hidden costs.
  • We offer a comfortable, flexible private car with strong A/C. Free of charge to stop for lunch, coffee, short break.
  • Our travel experts are always available and are willing to support you via Whatsapp at +84343662242.
  • We have all kinds of transportation from sedan cars, SUVs, or minivans even Luxury Dcar Limousines.

tours.summary: If you stay in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon) and would like to have a day trip to the Mekong Delta but do not know which is the best way. You should book a private car Ho Chi Minh to Mekong Delta transfer via Vietlook Travel
tours.contentHtml:
If you stay in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon) and would like to have a day trip to the Mekong Delta but do not know which is the best way. You should book a private car Ho Chi Minh to Mekong Delta transfer via Vietlook Travel.

By booking our Saigon to Mekong Delta by private car, you will have door-to-door service in a comfortable vehicle with an experienced driver. The distance from Saigon to the Mekong Delta depends on what route you take.

For a great experience in the Mekong Delta, Vietlook Travel highly recommends 2 popular routes including Saigon to My Tho (the Mekong Delta) 67km which takes an hour and 30 minutes transfer, or Ho Chi Minh to Ben Tre (Mekong Delta) 84km which takes an hour and 50 minutes.

HO CHI MINH TO MEKONG DELTA BY PRIVATE CAR

Please provide us with your hotel name/ address in Saigon for pickup, the number of people, and the travel date. Vietlook Travel owns many types of vehicles from Sedans to SUVs, and Minivans to meet all your group sizes and ensure you a comfortable day from Saigon to Mekong Delta.

The private transfer from Ho Chi Minh to Mekong Delta by car will take about 1.5 hours when we take the My Tho destination. Along the way from Saigon to My Tho, our friendly driver will be happy to stop at a convenient place for you to take a short break, drink some coffee, or use the toilet.

Upon arrival at My Tho, our experienced driver will drop you off at the My Tho Marina, Tien Giang province where he will help you to take a boat to explore the Mekong Delta.

Our professional driver will wait for you at My Tho Marina, Tien Giang province, and give you enough time to enjoy the Mekong Delta Tour and then transfer you back to the Ho Chi Minh City Hotel. We finish the Saigon to Mekong Delta private car transfer. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great day with us.

Travel Thoughts

  • An English-speaking tour guide is highly recommended.
  • Full charge your camera and phones for beautiful photos.
  • You should choose the departure time at 8 AM and will be back at the hotel around 7 PM.
  • When visiting rural villages, temples, or family-run workshops, be respectful of local customs.
  • Bring some cash with you because the local vendors in the floating markets or villages may only accept cash.
  • consider starting your tour early in the morning, especially if you want to see the vibrant floating markets at their liveliest.
  • The Mekong Delta can be hot and humid, so wear comfortable clothes, and don’t forget sunscreen, a hat, and insect repellent.

Why Travel With US?

  • Our drivers are the locals and good at travel routes and navigation.
  • We own a wide range of cars which will meet all your group sizes.
  • We always offer our customers the best price without any hidden fees.
  • We provide 24/7 customer care service via WhatsApp and email.
  • Our travel experts are willing to customize the itinerary following your request.
  • A door-to-door private car 2 ways from Ho Chi Minh to the Mekong Delta in a day.
  • Our private cars are all in good condition comfortable and spacious, ensuring you travel in comfort.

tours.title: Saigon To Cu Chi Tunnels Private Car
tours.summary: Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) to the Cu Chi Tunnels by private car is a convenient and flexible travel option. The tunnel network is extensive, with tunnels stretching for over 250 kilometers (155 miles) beneath the ground.
tours.contentHtml:
Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) to the Cu Chi Tunnels by private car is a convenient and flexible travel option. The tunnel network is extensive, with tunnels stretching for over 250 kilometers (155 miles) beneath the ground. These tunnels were constructed by hand, using simple tools, and were well-organized with multiple levels, trapdoors, and camouflaged entrances.

The Ho Chi Minh to Cu Chi Tunnels distance is 45km and it takes an hour and 30 minutes to transfer by car. Unlike other transports to travel to Cu Chi Tunnels such as taxis, and grab cars. By booking our Ho Chi Minh City to Cu Chi Tunnels private car, you will have a door-to-door transfer service with a basic English-speaking driver to explore the Cu Chi Tunnels.

SAIGON TO CU CHI TUNNELS PRIVATE CAR

Following your request, our Saigon private car and driver will pick you up at your desired pickup location in Saigon Center, such as your hotel, Tan Son Nhat International Airport, or any other convenient spot in the city.

If you request to be picked up at Saigon Airport, please tell us your flight number, landing time as well as the number of people so we can send a proper car such as a sedan, an SUV, or a minivan to pick you up.

Our driver will wait for you at the Tan Son Nhat airport arrival gate with your full name on a welcome board so you can recognize him. After greetings and loading the luggage, he will transfer you to visit Cu Chi Tunnels. After all, our driver will drop you off at your hotel in Saigon center.

If you stay at a hotel in Ho Chi Minh city, our driver will pick you up at your hotel and transfer you to Cu Chi Tunnels to visit. You can choose the pick up time and our driver will wait for you to explore Cu Chi Tunnels until you finish.

The tunnel network is extensive, with tunnels stretching for over 250 kilometers (155 miles) beneath the ground. These tunnels were constructed by hand, using simple tools, and were well-organized with multiple levels, trapdoors, and camouflaged entrances.

The tunnels served multiple purposes, including hiding from American and South Vietnamese troops, launching surprise attacks, storing food and supplies, and serving as a communication and transportation network.

You can explore a section of the tunnels, learn about their history, and gain insights into the life and tactics of the Viet Cong during the war. Travelling to Cu Chi Tunnels, you will learn more about the tunnels’ history, construction, and usage. You can also see various traps and booby traps used during the war.

There are museums and exhibits on-site that display weapons, equipment, and artifacts from the Vietnam War era. These exhibits offer a deeper understanding of the conflict. Plus, You will have the opportunity to try shooting firearms used during the war at an on-site shooting range for an additional fee.

After all, our driver will transfer you back to your hotel in Saigon and we finish the private car Saigon to Cu Chi Tunnels transfer. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great experience with us.

Travel Thoughts:

Respect the Site: The Cu Chi Tunnels are a historical and cultural site. Show respect for the history and the people involved in the Vietnam War while visiting. Avoid making inappropriate jokes or disrespectful comments.

Stay Hydrated: The tunnels can be hot and humid, so it’s essential to stay hydrated. Bring bottled water with you and drink regularly to avoid dehydration.

Use Sun Protection: The tropical sun can be intense. Apply sunscreen, wear a wide-brimmed hat, and use sunglasses to protect yourself from sunburn.

Crawling in the Tunnels: If you choose to crawl through the tunnels, be prepared for a tight and dark space. It’s not suitable for those with claustrophobia or physical limitations. Go at your own pace and take your time.

Photography: Ask your guide about the rules regarding photography. Some areas may not allow photography due to the sensitivity of the site. Respect these restrictions.

Leave No Trace: Do not litter or leave trash behind. Use designated trash bins for disposal.

Learn About the History: Before your visit, take some time to learn about the history of the Cu Chi Tunnels and the Vietnam War. This will enhance your understanding and appreciation of the site.

Why Should You choose Us?

  • This is a door to door private car with an experienced driver.
  • We provide nice, comfortable car with a strong A/C.
  • We accept the last minute bookings and pick up at Tan Son Nhat Airport.
  • Our Saigon to Cu Chi Tunnels price is compatitive and reasonable without hidden costs.
  • We are 24/7 online support via Whatsapp at (+84) 98.339.3588  and are willing to customize the itinerary.

tours.contentHtml:
If you are staying in Hanoi and looking for a private car transfer to Ninh Binh or a day trip to Ninh Binh from Hanoi, consider booking Hanoi to Ninh Binh Private Car now with an experienced driver through Vietlook Travel.

The distance from Hanoi to Ninh Binh is approximately 95 km, and it takes around 2 hours to transfer by car one way. Unlike other forms of transportation from Hanoi to Ninh Binh, such as buses, shared limousines, or taxis, they are not flexible or convenient. This is a door-to-door private transfer service, allowing you to choose your departure time and customize the itinerary.

HANOI TO NINH BINH BY PRIVATE CAR

To ensure you have a great experience in Ninh Binh, Vietlook Travel offers a range of travel options to cater to all your diverse needs.

Option 1: Hanoi Airport to Ninh Binh Transfer

Please provide us with your flight number/landing time, the number of people, and your hotel name/address in Ninh Binh. Our travel expert will send you a sedan car, SUV, or minivan to pick you up. He will be waiting at the Hanoi airport arrival gate with your full name displayed on a welcome board, so you can easily recognize him.

After exchanging greetings, our driver will introduce you to the car and assist you with loading your luggage. A direct transfer from Hanoi Airport to the Ninh Binh Hotel takes approximately 2 hours. If you have ample time, you can ask our travel experts to customize your itinerary. Depending on your schedule, you can visit Mua Cave, Hoa Lu, Tam Coc, Bai Dinh Pagoda, or the Trang An scenic landscape complex.

Upon arrival at your hotel in Ninh Binh, our friendly driver will assist you with your luggage and inspect the car to ensure that you don’t leave anything behind. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great stay in Ninh Binh city.

Option 2: Hanoi to Ninh Binh Day Trip

With this option, we highly recommend you start the trip early. At 8:00 am, our driver and Hanoi private car will pick you up at your hotel lobby, and we will start the Hanoi to Ninh Binh day trip. Along the way, you can ask our driver to stop at convenient places to use the toilets, have lunch, and enjoy a cup of coffee.

You can choose one of the travel routes below because of the time limit of the day.

  • Route 1: Hanoi Hotel to Hoa Lu Ancient Capital – Tam Coc – Mua Cave – Hanoi Hotel.
  • Route 2: Hanoi to Bai Dinh Pagoda, Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex, Mua Cave, and Hanoi Hotel.

After all, we will transfer you back to your hotel in Hanoi and finish the private car Hanoi to Ninh Binh day trip. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great day with us.

tours.title: Hanoi To Moc Chau Private Car Transfer
tours.summary: Hanoi to Moc Chau by private car is such a comfortable and flexible door-to-door transfer service to travel to Moc Chau with our experienced driver. The distance between Hanoi and Moc Chau is approximately 180 kilometers
tours.contentHtml:
Hanoi to Moc Chau by private car is such a comfortable and flexible door-to-door transfer service to travel to Moc Chau with our experienced driver.

The distance between Hanoi and Moc Chau is approximately 180 kilometers (112 miles), and the driving time can vary depending on road conditions and traffic, but it typically takes around 4-5 hours to reach Moc Chau by car.

Traveling from Hanoi to Moc Chau by private car is a convenient and comfortable way to explore this scenic region in Vietnam. Moc Chau is known for its beautiful landscapes, tea plantations, and flower gardens, making it a popular destination for nature lovers.

HANOI TO MOC CHAU BY PRIVATE CAR

To meet all the different requests from our valued customers, Vietlook Travel creates some travel options such as

Option 1: Hanoi Airport to Moc Chau Transfer

By booking the private car from Hanoi Airport to Moc Chau, please provide us with your flight number/ landing time and the number of people. Our Hanoi private car and driver will be ready at the Noi Bai Airport arrival gate with your full name on a welcome board so you can easily recognize him.

After greetings and helping you to set up the luggage, we start the Hanoi to Moc Chau private car transfer. The direct transfer from Hanoi to Moc Chau takes about 5 hours and if you have a lot of time, you can request our driver to stop at convenient places for you to capture photos, take a break, and drink some coffee.

Upon arrival at Moc Chau Hotel, our experienced driver will double-check the private car to make sure you don’t forget anything before saying goodbye to you.

Option 2: Hanoi Hotel to Moc Chau Private Car

With this travel option, you can choose your pickup time and our driver will be ready at your hotel lobby following your request. After greetings and reminding you not to forget the passports, we start the private car Hanoi to Moc Chau transfer.

Along the way, our friendly driver will stop at places for you to go to the toilets, have lunch, or take a short break. Upon arrival at your hotel in Moc Chau downtown, he will drop you off and make sure you forget nothing in the car.

We finish the Ha Noi to Moc Chau by private car and Vietlook Travel wishes you a wonderful transfer with us.

Mộc Châu is a refreshing mountain escape known for vast tea plantations, colorful flowers, and cool climate. Tourists can explore stunning waterfalls, hike Pha Luong Peak, and visit impressive caves. Rich ethnic cultures, traditional villages, and festivals add to the experience. The famous Bach Long Glass Bridge and eco-tourism spots offer unique adventures in nature.

Travel Thoughts:

  • Vehicle Options: Private car services offer various vehicle options to suit your needs and group size. You can typically choose from sedans, SUVs, vans, or even a minivan or VIP Limousine if you’re traveling with a group. The choice of vehicle will also affect the price.
  • Booking in Advance: It’s advisable to book your private car in advance, especially if you’re traveling during peak tourist seasons. This ensures that a vehicle and driver will be available on your preferred date and time.
  • Pickup and Drop-Off Locations: Specify your desired pickup location in Hanoi and your destination in Moc Chau when making the booking. Popular pickup points in Hanoi include the Old Quarter, Noi Bai International Airport, or your hotel.
  • Driver’s English: Our drivers can speak very basic English but our professional travel experts are always available via WhatsApp at (+84) 98.339.3488.
  • Cost: The cost of a private car from Ha Noi to Moc Chau can vary based on the type of vehicle you choose, the distance, and any additional services or stops you request. Our travel experts will tell you all the detailed information and prices before confirming your booking.
  • Comfort and Amenities: Our private car services often provide amenities such as air conditioning, comfortable seating, bottled water, tolls, parking fees, gasoline, and sometimes even Wi-Fi.

预订河内机场至木州的私家车时，请提供您的航班号/降落时间及人数。我们的河内私家车和司机将在内排(Nội Bài)机场到达口等候，手持写有您全名的欢迎牌，方便您辨认。

问候并协助您安放行李后，我们开始河内至木州的私家车接送。河内直达木州约需5小时；如果您时间充裕，可以要求司机在方便的地点停车，供您拍照、休息和喝咖啡。

抵达木州酒店后，经验丰富的司机会再次检查车辆，确保您没有遗漏物品，然后与您道别。

方案2：河内酒店至木州私家车

选择此方案，您可以自选接客时间，司机将按您的要求在酒店大堂等候。问候并提醒您别忘了护照后，我们开始河内至木州的私家车接送。

途中，友好的司机会在合适的地方停车，供您上洗手间、用午餐或短暂休息。抵达木州市区的酒店后，他会送您下车，并确保车内没有遗落任何物品。

河内至木州私家车服务到此结束，Vietlook Travel 祝您接送旅程愉快。

木州(Mộc Châu) 是一处清爽宜人的山地度假胜地，以广阔的茶园、五彩缤纷的花卉和凉爽的气候著称。游客可以探访壮观的瀑布，徒步法Luong峰，参观令人印象深刻的洞穴。丰富的民族文化、传统村落和节日为旅程增添色彩。著名的白龙玻璃桥和生态旅游景点带来独特的自然探险。
