凭借当地专业知识、灵活的行程和可靠的服务，Vietlook Travel 确保您在越南最美丽的地区之一拥有顺畅而丰富的旅程。

越南西北部是一个随季节变化而美丽蜕变的目的地。从盛开的鲜花到金色的梯田，一年中的每个时节都有特别之处。

根据这些季节亮点规划您的行程，您可以充分体验这个非凡地区的自然与文化之丰富。

posts.title: Northwest Vietnam Travel Guide
posts.excerpt: Northwest Vietnam is one of the most captivating regions in the country, known for its dramatic mountain landscapes, terraced rice fields, and rich ethnic cultures. Destinations such as Sapa, Ha Giang
posts.contentHtml:
Northwest Vietnam is one of the most captivating regions in the country, known for its dramatic mountain landscapes, terraced rice fields, and rich ethnic cultures. Destinations such as Sapa, Ha Giang, Mu Cang Chai, Dien Bien, and Son La offer travelers a unique blend of natural beauty and cultural depth.

To fully enjoy your journey, careful planning and practical knowledge are essential. Below is a comprehensive guide to help you explore Northwest Vietnam effectively and meaningfully.

Best Time to Visit Northwest Vietnam

The Northwest region has distinct seasonal beauty, and the ideal time depends on what you want to experience.

From September to October is considered the most beautiful period, when terraced rice fields turn golden during harvest season, especially in Mu Cang Chai and Sapa. This is also the peak time for photography and sightseeing.

From March to May, the weather is mild and pleasant, with blooming flowers such as plum and peach blossoms covering the mountains. This period is ideal for trekking and exploring local villages.

From November to February, the weather becomes colder, especially in high-altitude areas like Sapa and Ha Giang. While it may be foggy, this season offers a quieter and more peaceful travel experience.

How to Get There

Traveling to Northwest Vietnam requires a combination of transportation options depending on your starting point.

From Hanoi, travelers can take sleeper buses, limousine vans, or trains to destinations like Sapa (via Lao Cai). Travel time typically ranges from five to eight hours.

For Ha Giang and more remote areas, buses or private cars are the most common options. Motorbike travel is also popular among adventurous travelers, offering flexibility and scenic routes.

For a more comfortable experience, booking a private transfer or a guided tour with Vietlook Travel ensures a safer and more convenient journey, especially for first-time visitors.

Accommodation Options

Northwest Vietnam offers a wide range of accommodation, from budget homestays to boutique hotels and eco-lodges.

Homestays are highly recommended for those who want to experience local culture. Staying with ethnic families allows you to enjoy traditional meals and learn about daily life.

In popular destinations like Sapa, there are also many hotels and resorts with modern amenities and stunning mountain views.

It is advisable to book accommodation in advance during peak seasons such as harvest time or holidays.

What to Eat in Northwest Vietnam

The cuisine of the Northwest is simple but rich in flavor, often using local ingredients and traditional cooking methods.

Some must-try dishes include grilled pork, bamboo-cooked rice, smoked meat, wild vegetables, and freshwater fish. Thang co, a traditional dish of the Hmong people, is also a unique culinary experience.

Local markets are the best places to explore authentic food and interact with local communities.

Suggested Itineraries

A well-planned itinerary helps you make the most of your trip.

A three-day trip is suitable for destinations like Sapa, combining trekking, village visits, and local markets.

A four to five-day itinerary allows deeper exploration of Ha Giang, including the famous Ha Giang Loop, Dong Van Karst Plateau, and Ma Pi Leng Pass.

For a longer journey, you can combine multiple destinations such as Sapa, Mu Cang Chai, and Ha Giang to experience the full diversity of the region.

Cultural Awareness and Travel Etiquette

Northwest Vietnam is home to many ethnic minority groups, each with its own customs and traditions.

Travelers should dress modestly, especially when visiting villages. Always ask for permission before taking photos of local people.

Respect local lifestyles and avoid disrupting daily activities. Small gestures of respect go a long way in creating meaningful interactions.

Important Travel Tips

Bring warm clothing, especially if traveling during colder months or visiting high-altitude areas.

Prepare cash, as many remote areas do not accept card payments.

Wear comfortable shoes for trekking and walking on uneven terrain.

Check weather conditions before traveling, as mountain roads can be affected by rain or fog.

Consider traveling with a local guide to better understand the culture and ensure safety.

Travel with Vietlook Travel

Vietlook Travel offers professional tour packages to Northwest Vietnam, designed to provide both comfort and cultural depth. From transportation and accommodation to guided experiences, every detail is carefully arranged.

Whether you are looking for a short getaway or an extended exploration, Vietlook Travel helps you discover the Northwest in a seamless and enriching way.

Traveling to Northwest Vietnam is not just about visiting beautiful landscapes. It is an opportunity to connect with nature, explore diverse cultures, and experience a slower, more authentic way of life.

With proper preparation and the right guidance, your journey to this remarkable region will be both memorable and rewarding.

posts.contentHtmlZh:
越南西北部是这个国家最迷人的地区之一，以壮丽的山地景观、梯田和丰富的民族文化而闻名。沙坝、河江、木江杈(Mu Cang Chai)、奠边府和山罗等目的地，为旅行者呈现了自然之美与文化深度的独特结合。

要充分享受您的旅程，周密的规划和实用的知识必不可少。以下是一份全面的指南，帮助您高效且有意义地探索越南西北部。

游览越南西北部的最佳时间

西北地区四季景致分明，理想的出行时间取决于您想要体验什么。

9月至10月被认为是最美的时期，此时正值收获季节，梯田一片金黄，尤其是在木江杈和沙坝。这也是摄影和观光的高峰期。

3月至5月，天气温和宜人，李花、桃花等繁花盛开，漫山遍野。这段时间非常适合徒步和探访当地村寨。

11月至次年2月，天气变冷，尤其是在沙坝和河江等高海拔地区。虽然可能有雾，但这个季节能带来更安静、更宁和的旅行体验。

如何前往

前往越南西北部需要结合多种交通方式，具体取决于您的出发地。

从河内出发，旅行者可以乘坐卧铺巴士、专线小巴(Limousine)或火车前往沙坝(经老街)等目的地。行程时间通常在五到八小时之间。

前往河江和更偏远的地区，巴士或包车是最常见的选择。骑摩托车旅行在爱冒险的旅行者中也很受欢迎，灵活自由，沿途风景优美。

若想获得更舒适的体验，预订 Vietlook Travel 的专车接送或导览团，能确保旅程更安全、更便捷，尤其适合首次到访的游客。

住宿选择

越南西北部提供种类丰富的住宿，从经济实惠的民宿到精品酒店和生态小屋应有尽有。

强烈推荐想体验当地文化的游客入住民宿。与少数民族家庭同住，您可以品尝传统餐食，了解他们的日常生活。

在沙坝等热门目的地，还有许多设施现代、可欣赏壮丽山景的酒店和度假村。

在收获季或节假日等旺季，建议提前预订住宿。

越南西北部吃什么

西北部的美食朴实却风味浓郁，常使用当地食材和传统烹饪方法。

一些必尝的菜肴包括烤猪肉、竹筒饭、熏肉、野菜和淡水鱼。Thang co 是苗族的传统菜肴，也是一种独特的美食体验。

当地集市是探索地道美食、与当地社区交流的最佳场所。

推荐行程

精心规划的行程能让您充分利用这次旅行。

三天的行程适合沙坝等目的地，可结合徒步、探访村寨和当地集市。

四到五天的行程可以更深入地探索河江，包括著名的河江环线(Ha Giang Loop)、同文喀斯特高原和马痹岭关(Ma Pi Leng)。

若想要更长的旅程，可以将沙坝、木江杈和河江等多个目的地结合起来，全面体验这个地区的多样性。

文化意识与旅行礼仪

posts.title: Highland Weekly Markets – A Cultural Beauty Of Mountain Regions
posts.excerpt: Highland weekly markets are one of the most distinctive cultural features of Northern Vietnam. More than just places for trading goods, these markets reflect the daily life, traditions, and identity o
posts.contentHtml:
Highland weekly markets are one of the most distinctive cultural features of Northern Vietnam. More than just places for trading goods, these markets reflect the daily life, traditions, and identity of ethnic minority communities living in mountainous areas such as Ha Giang, Sapa, Bac Ha, and Mu Cang Chai.

For travelers seeking authentic cultural experiences, visiting a highland market offers a meaningful glimpse into a way of life that has been preserved for generations.

A Unique Cultural Space in the Mountains

Unlike urban markets, highland markets operate on specific days of the week and often rotate between different locations. People from nearby villages travel long distances to gather, bringing agricultural products, livestock, handmade goods, and local specialties.

Each market becomes a vibrant meeting point where different ethnic groups such as the Hmong, Dao, Tay, and Nung come together. Their presence creates a colorful and dynamic atmosphere, shaped by diversity in language, clothing, and customs.

Traditional Costumes and Cultural Identity

One of the most impressive aspects of highland markets is the traditional attire worn by local people. Each ethnic group has its own distinctive style, featuring handwoven fabrics, intricate embroidery, and symbolic patterns.

These garments are not only beautiful but also represent cultural identity and craftsmanship passed down through generations. For visitors, it is a rare opportunity to witness living heritage in its most authentic form.

A Culinary Journey of the Highlands

Highland markets are also a paradise for those interested in local cuisine. Food here is simple, fresh, and deeply rooted in local traditions.

Some must-try dishes include thắng cố (a traditional stew), grilled meats, sticky rice, corn cakes, and herbal soups. Local corn wine is often shared among friends, adding to the lively and communal atmosphere of the market.

Dining at a highland market is not just about taste, but also about experiencing the social life of the community.

Handmade Products and Local Crafts

Visitors can explore a wide variety of handmade products at these markets. From brocade textiles and embroidered clothing to silver jewelry and bamboo items, each product reflects the skill and creativity of local artisans.

These items are not mass-produced, making them meaningful souvenirs that carry cultural value. Supporting these products also contributes to preserving traditional crafts.

More Than a Market: A Social Gathering

For local communities, the market is more than a place to trade goods. It is an important social event where people meet, exchange news, and strengthen relationships.

In some regions, markets even serve as “love markets,” where young people gather to meet potential partners. This adds a unique emotional and cultural layer to the experience.

The Natural Beauty Surrounding the Markets

Set against a backdrop of mountains, valleys, and fresh air, highland markets offer a peaceful yet lively environment. Early mornings often begin with mist covering the hills, gradually revealing colorful scenes as the market comes to life.

This harmony between nature and human activity creates a unique charm that is difficult to find elsewhere.

Travel Tips for Visiting Highland Markets

To fully enjoy the experience, travelers should consider the following:

  • Visit early in the morning when the market is most active
  • Respect local customs and ask permission before taking photos
  • Bring cash for purchases
  • Wear comfortable clothing suitable for mountain weather
  • Engage with locals to better understand their culture

Explore Highland Markets with Vietlook Travel

Vietlook Travel offers curated tours to some of the most famous highland markets in Vietnam, including Bac Ha Market, Dong Van Market, and Sapa Market. With professional guidance and well-planned itineraries, travelers can experience these cultural highlights in a convenient and meaningful way.

Highland weekly markets are not only places of commerce but also living symbols of cultural heritage in Vietnam’s mountainous regions. They showcase the beauty of tradition, community, and everyday life in a way that is both authentic and inspiring.

For anyone interested in cultural travel, a visit to these markets is an unforgettable journey into the heart of Vietnam’s highlands.

posts.contentHtml:
Highland weekly markets are among the most authentic cultural experiences in northern Vietnam. Taking place in mountainous regions such as Ha Giang, Sapa, Bac Ha, and Dong Van, these markets are not only centers of trade but also vibrant social and cultural gatherings for ethnic communities.

For travelers seeking a deeper understanding of local life, visiting a highland market offers a rare opportunity to witness traditions that have remained unchanged for generations.

What Is a Highland Weekly Market?

Unlike daily markets in urban areas, highland markets usually take place on specific days of the week, often following a fixed rotational schedule. Each market serves as a meeting point for various ethnic groups such as the Hmong, Dao, Tay, and Nung.

People travel long distances, sometimes on foot or by motorbike, to attend the market. It is a place where goods are exchanged, relationships are built, and cultural identity is expressed.

A Unique Cultural Encounter

One of the most striking aspects of highland markets is the diversity of traditional costumes. Each ethnic group wears distinct clothing, often handmade with intricate embroidery and vibrant colors.

Visitors can observe daily life in its most authentic form, from farmers selling produce to artisans showcasing handcrafted goods. The market becomes a living cultural exhibition, offering insights into customs, traditions, and community life.

Traditional Food and Local Specialties

Food plays a central role in the market experience. Unlike modern street food scenes, dishes here are deeply connected to local ingredients and traditional cooking methods.

Popular specialties include thắng cố, grilled pork, sticky rice, corn cakes, and locally brewed corn wine. These dishes are simple yet rich in flavor, reflecting the lifestyle of highland communities.

Sharing food and drinks at the market is also a social activity, where locals gather, talk, and celebrate their culture.

Handmade Crafts and Authentic Souvenirs

Highland markets are ideal places to discover unique handmade products. Visitors can find brocade fabrics, embroidered clothing, silver jewelry, bamboo baskets, and herbal products.

Each item carries cultural meaning and is often made using techniques passed down through generations. Purchasing these products also supports local artisans and sustainable tourism.

A Social and Community Gathering

For local people, the market is not only about buying and selling. It is a social event where friends meet, families reconnect, and young people interact.

In some markets, there is even a traditional “love market” culture, where young men and women come to meet and form relationships. This adds a unique and human dimension to the overall experience.

The Atmosphere of the Highlands

Set amidst mountains, valleys, and fresh air, highland markets offer a completely different atmosphere compared to city markets.

Early mornings are often covered in mist, gradually giving way to lively scenes filled with colors, sounds, and movement. The natural setting enhances the authenticity and charm of the experience.

Tips for Visiting Highland Markets

To make the most of your visit, consider the following:

  • Arrive early in the morning to experience the market at its most vibrant
  • Respect local customs and always ask before taking photos
  • Bring cash, as most vendors do not accept digital payments
  • Dress comfortably and prepare for cooler temperatures in mountainous areas
  • Be open to trying local food and interacting with local people

Travel with Vietlook Travel

Whether you prefer a short visit or a multiday journey through northern Vietnam, Vietlook Travel ensures a professional and enriching travel experience.

Conclusion

Experiencing a highland weekly market is more than just a visit to a marketplace. It is a journey into the cultural heart of Vietnam’s mountainous regions.

From traditional clothing and local cuisine to community interaction and scenic landscapes, every moment at the market reflects the richness and diversity of ethnic life. For those looking to explore beyond typical tourist routes, this is an experience not to be missed.

posts.contentHtml:
Highland night markets in Vietnam offer a unique blend of cultural authenticity, local lifestyle, and vibrant social interaction. Unlike urban night markets that focus heavily on tourism and entertainment, night markets in mountainous regions such as Ha Giang, Sapa, Bac Ha, and Dong Van reflect the traditions and daily life of ethnic minority communities.

Below are the key highlights that make highland night markets a distinctive experience.

Authentic Ethnic Culture and Traditions

One of the most remarkable features of highland night markets is the strong presence of ethnic minority cultures. Groups such as the Hmong, Dao, Tay, and Nung gather not only to trade but also to socialize and preserve their traditions.

Visitors can observe traditional clothing with intricate patterns, handmade accessories, and cultural practices that have been maintained for generations. The markets are not just commercial spaces but also important cultural meeting points.

Unique Local Cuisine

Food is a central attraction at highland night markets. Unlike typical street food in cities, dishes here are deeply rooted in local traditions and ingredients.

Some notable specialties include thắng cố (a traditional Hmong stew), grilled meats, sticky rice, corn wine, and herbal dishes prepared with forest ingredients. The flavors are bold and distinctive, offering a true taste of the region.

Handcrafted Products and Local Goods

Highland night markets are ideal places to find authentic handmade products. Items such as brocade textiles, embroidered clothing, silver jewelry, bamboo crafts, and herbal remedies are commonly sold.

These products are often made by local artisans using traditional techniques, making them meaningful souvenirs that reflect the cultural identity of the region.

Social Gathering and Community Connection

For many locals, the market is more than a place to trade goods. It is a social event where people meet friends, exchange news, and build relationships.

Young people often come to the market to interact, while families gather to enjoy food and entertainment. This social aspect creates a warm and lively atmosphere that is very different from commercial markets in big cities.

Scenic Mountain Atmosphere

Set against the backdrop of mountains, valleys, and cool highland air, these markets offer a naturally beautiful environment.

The combination of dim lighting, traditional stalls, and misty surroundings creates a distinctive and memorable setting, especially in places like Dong Van Old Quarter or Sapa town.

Weekend and Seasonal Market Experience

Many highland night markets operate on weekends or specific days rather than daily schedules. This makes each visit feel more special and event-like.

Some markets are also tied to seasonal activities or festivals, adding an extra layer of cultural richness and uniqueness to the experience.

Cultural Performances and Folk Activities

In certain locations, night markets feature traditional music, dance performances, and folk games.

These activities allow visitors to experience local heritage in an interactive way, from listening to ethnic musical instruments to participating in community celebrations.

年轻人常常来到集市相互交流，家人们则聚在一起享受美食和娱乐。这种社交氛围温馨而热闹，与大城市的商业市场截然不同。

山间风光氛围

这些集市以群山、山谷和凉爽的高原空气为背景，拥有天然优美的环境。

昏暗的灯光、传统的摊位和云雾缭绕的四周交织在一起，营造出独特而难忘的场景，尤其是在同文古镇或沙坝镇等地。

周末与季节性集市体验

许多高原夜市只在周末或特定日子开放，而非每日营业。这让每一次到访都显得更加特别，更像参加一场活动。

一些集市还与季节性活动或节庆相结合，为这份体验增添了一层文化的丰富性与独特性。

文化表演与民俗活动

在某些地方，夜市上还有传统音乐、舞蹈表演和民间游戏。

这些活动让游客以互动的方式体验当地遗产，从聆听民族乐器到参与社区庆典。

posts.title: Traditional Markets In Vietnam
posts.excerpt: Traditional markets in Vietnam are more than just places for buying and selling goods. They reflect the rhythm of daily life, regional culture, and long-standing trading traditions. From floating mark
posts.contentHtml:
Traditional markets in Vietnam are more than just places for buying and selling goods. They reflect the rhythm of daily life, regional culture, and long-standing trading traditions. From floating markets in the Mekong Delta to highland ethnic markets in the north, each type of market offers a unique experience for both locals and travelers.

Below is a comprehensive overview of the most common types of traditional markets in Vietnam.

1. Wet Markets (Chợ dân sinh)

Wet markets are the most common type of traditional market found across Vietnam. They operate daily and primarily serve local communities.

These markets sell fresh produce such as vegetables, fruits, meat, fish, and household essentials. The atmosphere is lively, often starting early in the morning when the freshest goods arrive.

Wet markets are ideal for experiencing authentic local life and understanding Vietnamese food culture.

2. Floating Markets (Chợ nổi)

Floating markets are unique to the Mekong Delta region, including famous ones such as Cai Rang and Cai Be.

Vendors sell goods directly from boats, creating a dynamic marketplace on the water. Products range from fresh fruits and vegetables to cooked meals and drinks.

This type of market reflects the river-based lifestyle of southern Vietnam and is best visited early in the morning.

3. Highland Ethnic Markets (Chợ vùng cao)

These markets are typically held weekly in mountainous regions such as Ha Giang, Lao Cai, and Bac Ha.

They are gathering places for ethnic minority communities to trade goods, socialize, and maintain cultural traditions. Visitors can find handmade textiles, traditional clothing, livestock, and local specialties.

The vibrant colors and cultural diversity make these markets especially attractive for travelers interested in cultural experiences.

4. Night Markets (Chợ đêm)

Night markets are popular in tourist destinations such as Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, and Hoi An.

They usually open in the evening and offer street food, souvenirs, clothing, and handicrafts. The atmosphere is lively, with lights, music, and street performances.

Night markets are ideal for shopping and enjoying local cuisine in a relaxed setting.

5. Wholesale Markets (Chợ đầu mối)

Wholesale markets are large-scale trading hubs where goods are distributed in bulk to smaller vendors and retailers.

Examples include Binh Dien Market in Ho Chi Minh City and Long Bien Market in Hanoi. These markets operate mainly at night or very early in the morning.

They provide insight into the supply chain of food and goods in Vietnam and are fascinating for those interested in commerce and logistics.

6. Rural Markets (Chợ quê)

Rural markets are typically held in villages and small towns, often on specific days of the week.

They offer locally grown produce, handmade goods, and traditional foods. The pace is slower, and the environment is more intimate compared to urban markets.

These markets reflect the simplicity and authenticity of countryside life in Vietnam.

7. Craft Village Markets (Chợ làng nghề)

Located within or near traditional craft villages, these markets specialize in locally made products such as ceramics, silk, bamboo crafts, and lacquerware.

Examples include Bat Trang pottery market and Van Phuc silk village market.

Visitors can not only shop but also observe production processes and interact with artisans.

8. Festival Markets (Chợ hội)

Festival markets appear during traditional festivals and cultural events.

They combine trading activities with entertainment, food stalls, and cultural performances. These markets are often temporary but highly vibrant.

They offer a festive atmosphere and are a great way to experience local traditions.

Discover Local Culture with Vietlook Travel

Exploring traditional markets is an essential part of understanding Vietnam’s culture and lifestyle. Vietlook Travel offers curated tours that include visits to iconic markets across the country, from bustling urban centers to remote highland regions.

With expert local guides and well-planned itineraries, Vietlook Travel ensures a meaningful and convenient travel experience.

Traditional markets in Vietnam are diverse and deeply connected to the country’s cultural identity. Each type of market tells a different story, from the fast-paced trade of urban markets to the cultural richness of ethnic gatherings.

Whether you are a food lover, cultural explorer, or curious traveler, visiting these markets will give you a deeper appreciation of Vietnam’s everyday life and traditions.
posts.excerptZh: 越南的传统市场不仅仅是买卖商品的地方。它们反映了日常生活的节奏、地域文化和源远流长的贸易传统。从湄公河三角洲的水上市场到北部的高地少数民族集市，每一种市场都为当地人和旅行者提供独特的体验。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
越南的传统市场 不仅仅是买卖商品的地方。它们反映了日常生活的节奏、地域文化和源远流长的贸易传统。从湄公河三角洲的水上市场到北部的高地少数民族集市，每一种市场都为当地人和旅行者提供独特的体验。

以下是对越南最常见的传统市场类型的全面介绍。

1. 菜市场（Chợ dân sinh）

菜市场是遍布越南最常见的传统市场类型。它们每天营业，主要服务于当地社区。

这些市场出售蔬菜、水果、肉类、鱼类等新鲜农产品和生活必需品。氛围热闹，通常在清晨最新鲜的货物到达时就开始营业。

菜市场是体验原汁原味的当地生活、了解越南饮食文化的理想之地。

2. 水上市场（Chợ nổi）

水上市场是湄公河三角洲地区独有的，包括芹苴的Cai Rang和Cai Be等著名市场。

摊贩直接在船上售卖货物，形成了水面上充满活力的市集。商品从新鲜水果和蔬菜到熟食和饮品应有尽有。

这类市场反映了越南南部以河流为基础的生活方式，最好在清晨前往。

3. 高地民族集市（Chợ vùng cao）

这些集市通常每周在河江、老街和北河（Bac Ha）等山区举行。

它们是少数民族社区交易货物、社交并维系文化传统的聚集地。游客可以找到手工纺织品、传统服饰、牲畜和当地特产。

鲜艳的色彩和文化多样性使这些集市对有兴趣体验文化的旅行者特别有吸引力。

4. 夜市（Chợ đêm）

夜市在河内、胡志明市、岘港和会安等旅游目的地很受欢迎。

它们通常在傍晚开放，提供街头美食、纪念品、服装和手工艺品。氛围热闹，有灯光、音乐和街头表演。

夜市是购物并在轻松环境中享用当地美食的理想场所。

5. 批发市场（Chợ đầu mối）

批发市场是大规模的贸易枢纽，货物在此批量分销给较小的摊贩和零售商。

例如胡志明市的平田（Binh Dien）市场和河内的龙编（Long Bien）市场。这些市场主要在夜间或清晨很早的时候营业。

它们让人了解越南食品和货物的供应链，对于有兴趣了解商业和物流的人来说非常有趣。

6. 乡村集市（Chợ quê）

乡村集市通常在村庄和小镇举行，往往在每周的特定日子。

它们提供当地种植的农产品、手工制品和传统食品。与城市市场相比，节奏更慢，环境更亲切。

这些市场反映了越南乡村生活的质朴与真实。

7. 手工艺村市场（Chợ làng nghề）

这些市场位于传统手工艺村内或附近，专营当地制作的产品，如陶瓷、丝绸、竹制工艺品和漆器。

例如钵场（Bat Trang）陶瓷市场和万福（Van Phuc）丝绸村市场。

游客不仅可以购物，还可以观察生产过程并与工匠交流。

8. 庙会集市（Chợ hội）

庙会集市出现在传统节日和文化活动期间。

它们将贸易活动与娱乐、美食摊位和文化表演结合在一起。这些市场往往是临时的，但非常热闹。

它们提供节日氛围，是体验当地传统的绝佳方式。

与Vietlook Travel一起探索当地文化

探索传统市场是了解越南文化和生活方式的重要组成部分。 Vietlook Travel 提供精心策划的旅游行程，包括参观全国各地的标志性市场，从繁华的城市中心到偏远的高地地区。

在专业的当地导游和规划周详的行程陪伴下，Vietlook Travel确保您拥有有意义且便利的旅行体验。

越南的传统市场多种多样，与国家的文化认同紧密相连。每一种市场都讲述着不同的故事，从城市市场快节奏的贸易，到民族集会的文化丰富性。

无论您是美食爱好者、文化探索者还是好奇的旅行者，参观这些市场都将让您更深入地领会越南的日常生活和传统。

posts.title: Top 5 Major Festivals In Vietnam For Travel Experiences
posts.excerpt: Vietnam is a country rich in cultural heritage, where traditional festivals play an essential role in community life. These events are not only deeply rooted in spiritual beliefs and history but also
posts.contentHtml:
Vietnam is a country rich in cultural heritage, where traditional festivals play an essential role in community life. These events are not only deeply rooted in spiritual beliefs and history but also offer vibrant, immersive experiences for travelers. From grand celebrations to sacred rituals, festivals in Vietnam provide a unique opportunity to understand local traditions while enjoying colorful festivities.

Below are five of the most significant festivals in Vietnam that every traveler should consider experiencing.

Tet Nguyen Dan (Vietnamese Lunar New Year)

Tet is the most important and widely celebrated festival in Vietnam. It marks the beginning of the Lunar New Year and is a time for family reunions, honoring ancestors, and welcoming new beginnings.

During Tet, cities and villages are decorated with flowers, lanterns, and traditional symbols of prosperity. Visitors can experience festive markets, traditional food such as banh chung and banh tet, and cultural performances.

For travelers, Tet offers a deep cultural experience, although it is important to plan ahead as many businesses close during this period.

Huong Pagoda Festival

The Huong Pagoda Festival is one of the largest and longest spiritual festivals in Vietnam, attracting thousands of pilgrims each year.

Located near Hanoi, the festival involves a scenic journey by boat along a river surrounded by limestone mountains, followed by a hike or cable car ride to the pagoda complex.

This festival combines natural beauty with spiritual significance, making it a unique experience for both cultural exploration and sightseeing.

Hung Kings Temple Festival

Held annually in Phu Tho Province, this festival honors the Hung Kings, the legendary founders of Vietnam.

The event features traditional ceremonies, processions, and cultural performances that reflect national pride and historical identity.

Visitors can witness solemn rituals alongside lively folk activities, offering a meaningful insight into Vietnam’s origins and cultural values.

Hue Festival

The Hue Festival is a large-scale cultural event held in the former imperial capital of Hue. It showcases traditional arts, royal court performances, music, and international cultural exchanges.

The city becomes a vibrant stage with street performances, traditional costumes, and historical reenactments.

This festival is ideal for travelers who want to explore Vietnam’s imperial heritage in a lively and engaging atmosphere.

Mid-Autumn Festival (Tet Trung Thu)

The Mid-Autumn Festival is especially popular among children but is also widely enjoyed by adults.

Celebrated with lantern parades, lion dances, and mooncakes, the festival creates a joyful and colorful atmosphere across cities and towns.

Hoi An is one of the best places to experience this festival, as the ancient town is beautifully illuminated with lanterns, creating a magical setting for visitors.

Travel Tips for Festival Experiences

Plan your trip in advance, especially for major festivals like Tet, as accommodation and transportation can be in high demand.

Respect local customs and dress appropriately when attending spiritual or religious events.

Be prepared for large crowds, particularly at popular festival locations.

Combine festival visits with nearby attractions to make the most of your travel itinerary.

Discover Vietnam with Vietlook Travel

For a seamless and enriching festival experience, Vietlook Travel offers well-organized tour packages that combine cultural exploration with comfort and convenience.

With expert guidance, flexible itineraries, and reliable services, Vietlook Travel helps you fully enjoy Vietnam’s most iconic festivals while discovering the country’s diverse landscapes and traditions.

Vietnamese festivals are a reflection of the country’s rich cultural identity and community spirit. Whether you are drawn to spiritual journeys, historical celebrations, or vibrant street festivities, these events offer unforgettable travel experiences.

Exploring Vietnam through its festivals allows you to connect with local traditions in a meaningful way, making your journey truly unique and memorable.
posts.titleZh: 越南五大节庆旅游体验
posts.excerptZh: 越南是一个文化遗产丰富的国度，传统节日在社区生活中扮演着重要角色。这些活动不仅深深植根于精神信仰和历史，还为旅行者提供充满活力、沉浸式的体验。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
越南是一个文化遗产丰富的国度，传统节日在社区生活中扮演着重要角色。这些活动不仅深深植根于精神信仰和历史，还为旅行者提供充满活力、沉浸式的体验。从盛大的庆典到神圣的仪式， 越南节日 为您提供了解当地传统、享受缤纷庆典的独特机会。

以下是每位旅行者都应考虑体验的越南五大最重要的节日。

春节（Tet Nguyen Dan，越南农历新年）

春节是越南最重要、庆祝最广泛的节日。它标志着农历新年的开始，是家人团聚、祭祖和迎接新开始的时刻。

春节期间，城市和村庄都装饰着鲜花、灯笼和象征繁荣的传统符号。游客可以体验节日集市、粽子（banh chung和banh tet）等传统美食以及文化表演。

对旅行者来说，春节提供了深入的文化体验，不过需要提前规划，因为许多商家在此期间会关门。

香寺节

香寺节是越南规模最大、持续时间最长的精神节日之一，每年吸引数以千计的朝圣者。

该节日在河内附近举行，包括乘船沿着被石灰岩山脉环绕的河流进行风景如画的旅程，然后徒步或乘缆车前往寺庙群。

该节日将自然之美与精神意义相结合，是文化探索和观光的独特体验。

雄王祭典

每年在富寿省举行，这一节日纪念越南传说中的创立者雄王。

活动包括传统仪式、游行和文化表演，体现了民族自豪感和历史认同。

游客可以目睹庄严的仪式和热闹的民间活动，深入了解越南的起源和文化价值。

顺化节

顺化节是在昔日帝都顺化举行的大型文化活动。它展示传统艺术、宫廷表演、音乐和国际文化交流。

城市变成一个充满活力的舞台，有街头表演、传统服饰和历史再现。

对于想在热闹、引人入胜的氛围中探索越南皇家遗产的旅行者来说，这个节日是理想之选。

中秋节（Tet Trung Thu）

中秋节特别受孩子们欢迎，但成年人也广泛参与其中。

节日以提灯游行、舞狮和月饼来庆祝，在城市和城镇中营造出欢乐而多彩的氛围。

会安是体验这一节日的最佳地点之一，古镇被灯笼装点得美轮美奂，为游客营造出神奇的场景。

节日体验旅行贴士

提前规划行程，尤其是春节等大型节日，因为住宿和交通可能供不应求。

参加精神或宗教活动时，请尊重当地习俗并着装得体。

做好应对大量人群的准备，尤其是在热门的节日地点。

将节日参观与附近的景点相结合，充分利用您的旅行行程。

与Vietlook Travel一起探索越南

为了获得顺畅而充实的节日体验，Vietlook Travel提供组织良好的旅游套餐，将文化探索与舒适便利相结合。

借助专业的指导、灵活的行程和可靠的服务，Vietlook Travel帮助您充分享受越南最具代表性的节日，同时探索这个国家多样的风景和传统。

越南的节日反映了这个国家丰富的文化身份和社区精神。无论您被精神之旅、历史庆典还是热闹的街头庆祝活动所吸引，这些活动都能带来难忘的旅行体验。

通过节日探索越南，让您以有意义的方式与当地传统建立联系，使您的旅程真正独特而难忘。

posts.title: With Vietlook Travel Visiting Vietnamese Countryside
posts.excerpt: Vietnam’s countryside offers a completely different perspective compared to its dynamic cities. Beyond the bustling streets of Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City lies a peaceful world of rice fields, tradition
posts.contentHtml:
Vietnam’s countryside offers a completely different perspective compared to its dynamic cities. Beyond the bustling streets of Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City lies a peaceful world of rice fields, traditional villages, winding rivers, and authentic local life. For travelers seeking a deeper cultural connection, exploring the Vietnamese countryside is an essential part of the journey.

With Vietlook Travel, these experiences are thoughtfully designed to bring you closer to the true essence of Vietnam, combining comfort, local insight, and meaningful cultural interaction.

Explore the Vietnamese Countryside

The countryside in Vietnam is where traditions are preserved most clearly. Life here moves at a slower pace, shaped by agriculture, community values, and long-standing customs.

Traveling through rural areas allows you to witness daily activities such as rice farming, fishing, traditional cooking, and craft making. It also offers a chance to enjoy natural landscapes that remain untouched by rapid urban development.

From the terraced fields in the north to the fertile Mekong Delta in the south, each region presents its own unique charm.

Top Countryside Destinations in Vietnam

Sapa and Northern Highlands

Sapa is famous for its terraced rice fields and ethnic minority villages. Visitors can trek through scenic landscapes, stay in local homes, and learn about the cultures of groups such as the Hmong and Dao.

The region offers a balance between natural beauty and cultural exploration, making it one of the most popular countryside destinations.

Ninh Binh

Often referred to as “Ha Long Bay on land,” Ninh Binh features limestone mountains, rice paddies, and peaceful rivers.

Boat trips through Tam Coc or Trang An provide a relaxing way to explore the area, while cycling through rural villages offers a closer look at local life.

Hoi An Countryside

Beyond the ancient town of Hoi An lies a tranquil countryside filled with vegetable farms, fishing villages, and coconut forests.

Visitors can participate in farming activities, take basket boat rides, and enjoy traditional Vietnamese cooking experiences.

Mekong Delta

The Mekong Delta is known for its vast river network, floating markets, and lush orchards.

Travelers can explore the region by boat, visit local homes, taste fresh tropical fruits, and experience the rhythm of life along the waterways.

Authentic Experiences with Vietlook Travel

Local Interaction and Cultural Immersion

Vietlook Travel focuses on creating meaningful connections between travelers and local communities. You will have opportunities to engage with farmers, artisans, and families, gaining insight into their daily lives.

Carefully Designed Itineraries

Each itinerary is built to balance sightseeing and relaxation. Whether you prefer a short countryside escape or a multi-day cultural journey, Vietlook Travel ensures smooth logistics and well-paced travel.

Comfortable and Flexible Transportation

Depending on your preference, transportation options include private cars, guided tours, bicycles, and boats. This flexibility allows you to explore rural areas conveniently while still enjoying authentic experiences.

Culinary Experiences

Countryside tours often include traditional meals prepared with fresh, local ingredients. Cooking classes and farm-to-table experiences are also available, giving you a deeper appreciation of Vietnamese cuisine.

Suggested Countryside Itinerary

Day 1: Departure from a major city to a rural destination, sightseeing and local exploration
Day 2: Cultural activities such as farming, craft workshops, or village visits
Day 3: Relaxation, nature exploration, and return journey

Longer itineraries can combine multiple regions for a more comprehensive experience.

Travel Tips for Countryside Exploration

Wear comfortable clothing suitable for outdoor activities and changing weather conditions.

Bring sunscreen, insect repellent, and a hat for sun protection.

Respect local customs and traditions when visiting villages and interacting with residents.

Prepare cash for small purchases in rural areas.

Vietlook Travel provides professional travel services tailored to international and domestic travelers. With a strong understanding of local destinations and a commitment to quality, the company ensures a seamless and enriching countryside experience.

From transportation and accommodation to guided tours and cultural activities, every detail is carefully arranged to help you explore Vietnam with confidence.

Conclusion

Visiting the Vietnamese countryside is a journey into the heart of the country’s culture and natural beauty. It offers a refreshing escape from urban life and an opportunity to experience authentic traditions.

With Vietlook Travel, you can explore these destinations in a well-organized, comfortable, and meaningful way, turning your trip into a memorable and insightful adventure.

探索越南乡村

越南的乡村是传统保存得最清晰的地方。这里的生活节奏较慢，由农业、社区价值观和悠久的习俗塑造。

穿行乡村地区，您可以亲眼目睹插秧耕作、捕鱼、传统烹饪和手工制作等日常活动。您也有机会欣赏未受快速城市发展影响的自然风光。

从北部的梯田到南部肥沃的湄公河三角洲，每个地区都有其独特的魅力。

越南顶级乡村目的地

沙坝与北部高地

沙坝以梯田和少数民族村庄而闻名。游客可以徒步穿越风景优美的景观，入住当地人家，并了解苗族和瑶族等民族的文化。

该地区在自然之美与文化探索之间取得平衡，使其成为最受欢迎的乡村目的地之一。

宁平

宁平常被称为“陆上下龙湾”，拥有石灰岩山脉、稻田和宁静的河流。

乘船游览三谷（Tam Coc）或长安（Trang An）是探索该地区的轻松方式，而骑自行车穿越乡村则可以更近距离地了解当地生活。

会安乡村

在会安古镇之外，是一片宁静的乡村，遍布蔬菜农场、渔村和椰林。

游客可以参与农事活动，乘坐竹筐船，并体验传统越南烹饪。

湄公河三角洲

湄公河三角洲以广阔的河网、水上市场和葱郁的果园而闻名。

旅行者可以乘船探索该地区，参观当地人家，品尝新鲜的热带水果，并体验水道沿岸的生活节奏。

与Vietlook Travel一起获得原汁原味的体验

当地互动与文化沉浸

Vietlook Travel专注于在旅行者与当地社区之间建立有意义的联系。您将有机会与农民、工匠和家庭交流，深入了解他们的日常生活。

精心设计的行程

每个行程都旨在平衡观光与休闲。无论您偏好短途乡村度假还是多日文化之旅，Vietlook Travel都能确保顺畅的后勤保障和节奏适中的旅行。

舒适灵活的交通

根据您的偏好，交通方式包括私家车、导览团、自行车和船只。这种灵活性让您既能方便地探索乡村地区，又能享受原汁原味的体验。

美食体验

乡村之旅通常包括用新鲜当地食材制作的传统餐食。也提供烹饪课程和从农场到餐桌的体验，让您更深入地领会越南美食。

推荐的乡村行程

第1天：从大城市出发前往乡村目的地，观光并探索当地
第2天：文化活动，如农耕、手工艺工作坊或参观村庄
第3天：休闲放松、探索自然并返程

较长的行程可以结合多个地区，带来更全面的体验。

探索乡村的旅行贴士

请穿着适合户外活动和多变天气条件的舒适服装。

请携带防晒霜、驱虫剂和遮阳帽。

参观村庄和与居民交流时，请尊重当地习俗和传统。

请准备现金，用于乡村地区的小额购物。

Vietlook Travel为国际和国内旅行者提供量身定制的专业旅行服务。凭借对当地目的地的深入了解和对品质的承诺，公司确保提供无缝而丰富的乡村体验。

从交通、住宿到导览游和文化活动，每一个细节都经过精心安排，帮助您充满信心地探索越南。

结语

参观越南乡村是一次深入这个国家文化与自然之美核心的旅程。它让您从城市生活中获得清新的逃离，并有机会体验原汁原味的传统。

有了Vietlook Travel，您可以以组织周密、舒适且有意义的方式探索这些目的地，让您的旅行成为一次难忘而富有见地的冒险。

posts.title: Top 7 Tourist Destinations In The North
posts.excerpt: Vietlook Travel will accompany you to explore the top 7 tourist destinations in the North, bringing you the best experiences in Vietnam, experiencing diverse cultures, and heroic historical sites. Bes
posts.contentHtml:
Vietlook Travel will accompany you to explore the top 7 tourist destinations in the North, bringing you the best experiences in Vietnam, experiencing diverse cultures, and heroic historical sites. Besides, you can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes.

The Vietnam tour itinerary will take you to explore famous landmarks in the North, visit natural landscapes and traditional craft villages such as: Ba Trang Pottery, Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, Ha Thai Lacquer Painting… and let’s take a look at those interesting things right below.

Hanoi

A must-see destination when traveling to the North, the capital Hanoi is a destination that attracts tourists from all over the world with its rich history, unique architecture and distinctive cultural style.

Coming to Hanoi, you will explore the city’s landmarks, experience the local culture, visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, one of the most famous landmarks in Hanoi. Here, you can also see the simple house that he loved throughout his life.

Visiting the Temple of Literature, the first university in Vietnam, you will learn more about Vietnam’s ancient education system and admire the beautiful architectural buildings.

If you like shopping and enjoying local cuisine, you should go to Hanoi’s Old Quarter, one of the city’s most famous shopping and culinary centers. Many cafes, bars and local shops sell all kinds of food and drinks.

In addition, you can also enjoy typical dishes of Hanoi such as: Pho, bun cha, nem ran, egg coffee… and learn about the culture and history of Vietnam.

In addition, when coming to Hanoi, visitors can enjoy delicious dishes and experience the colorful life with the people here. Prepare for this memorable tour of the North!

Co To Island – Quang Ninh

A great choice for those who love the sea and islands, with pristine white sand beaches, clear blue sea and beautiful natural scenery, Co To Island is a stopover for all tourists in the summer.

From Hanoi to Co To Island, visitors go to Cam Pha – Cai Rong Port by ferry or speedboat to Co To Island. Travel time is about 1 hour, during which time, you can admire the beautiful sea view and relax on the boat.

Coming to Co To Island, you can enjoy the quiet atmosphere, relax on the pristine beaches and immerse yourself in the green nature of the Island or participate in activities such as diving, fishing and exploring the caves on the Island.

The most interesting destination on Co To Island is definitely Hong Van Beach, with fine white sand and clear blue water. You can swim, lie on the sand or admire the beautiful sunset on the beach. There are many interesting activities for your Northern Vietnam tour during the holiday.

In addition to the pristine nature, Co To Island also has many cultural and historical sites worth exploring. With destinations such as: Co To Temple, Co To Fishing Village and Chong Rock Beach…

Traveling to Co To Island is a great experience during your holiday, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Discover the most attractive cultural activities in the sea paradise of Co To Island today.

Sapa – Lao Cai

Traveling to Sapa is one of the great choices for those who love natural scenery, want to experience life with the highlanders, and like to conquer the height of the Roof of Indochina, not only that, Sapa also welcomes visitors with a relatively cool climate.

Sapa is famous for its hills, valleys, waterfalls, terraced fields, cool green tea hills and Ban Ang pine forests with the sound of chirping pine trees. Especially conquering Fansipan peak, the highest mountain in Vietnam, to see the whole view of Sapa from above.

If you do not want to climb the mountain, you can go to the observation deck in Ham Rong to admire the most beautiful view of the city. Besides, visitors can visit majestic waterfalls such as Silver Waterfall, Love Waterfall to cool off, take pictures and relax. Admire the terraced fields in Ta Phin Village and enjoy the dreamlike beauty.

Sapa town, with its old French architecture and local markets, is also a memorable destination. Visitors can walk around the old town to learn about the culture in the sound of the flute calling you….

In particular, when visiting Cat Cat village, visitors will encounter the ancient villages of the Black H’Mong people, located about 3 km from Sapa, and learn about the culture and lifestyle of the local people, visit the ancient houses and enjoy unique handicraft products.

Stone Plateau – Ha Giang

A destination not to be missed when visiting the Northwest mountains. With rugged, majestic hills and pristine nature, the Ha Giang stone plateau is a destination that attracts many international tourists to visit.

The most famous destination on the Ha Giang stone plateau is Ma Pi Leng pass, one of the most beautiful landscapes in Vietnam. From here, visitors can admire the panoramic view of the Ha Giang stone plateau with rugged mountain ranges and winding rivers in the valley.

In addition, visitors can also experience mountain climbing, hiking, camping and adventure tourism to explore the majestic wild beauty and learn about the culture and customs of the ethnic minorities here.

Note that when going on a tour of Ha Giang, visitors should also prepare equipment and supplies for mountain climbing, hiking and camping activities to ensure safety. There will be many challenges along the way, but it is these challenges that make the trip the most unforgettable.

Moc Chau – Son La

Moc Chau is a beautiful plateau in Son La province, located about 200km northwest of Hanoi. Moc Chau is a vast plateau with rugged mountainous terrain.

Moc Chau has a temperate climate, and is home to beautiful flower seasons, each season has its own flower species, notably canola flowers, apricot flowers, plum flowers, cherry blossoms spread across the mountainside. In addition, visitors can also experience picking plums, peaches, pears…

It can be said that Moc Chau is an ideal destination for those who are passionate about camping, mountain climbing and exploring nature to experience interesting activities such as hiking, mountain climbing, cycling, horse riding, camping and visiting highland villages.

Famous tourist attractions in Moc Chau include Dai Yem Waterfall, Dong Muoi Cave, Moc Chau mustard hills, tea hills and ethnic minority villages.

In addition, visitors can also enjoy specialties such as grilled meat, meat wrapped in betel leaves, sticky rice cakes, sugarcane juice… and many more interesting things waiting for you to discover.

Tam Dao – Vinh Phuc

A beautiful tourist destination when traveling to the North, where there are high mountains, cool climate all year round and beautiful natural scenery. Tam Dao has many attractive tourist attractions, beautiful check-in points.

The first destination when traveling to Tam Dao is Tam Dao market, where visitors can enjoy specialties and buy souvenirs. Then visit Thay Pagoda, an ancient pagoda with beautiful architecture and unique sculptures and paintings.

Visit Wonderland, an entertainment area with many interesting activities such as skiing, ice skating, horseback riding and fishing…

If you are a nature lover, visit Hang Mom, Doi Co, Suoi Mo, Thac Bac and Tam Dao Flagpole…

If you want to enjoy the peaceful space and seek relaxation, go to the resorts and luxury hotels in Tam Dao. You will enjoy spa treatments, massages, mineral baths, yoga … will bring you the most memorable vacation.

Means of transportation to Tam Dao, you can choose a car or motorbike or bus from Hanoi. Travel time from Hanoi to Tam Dao is about 2-3 hours, depending on the means of transportation and weather conditions.

If you do not like the hustle and bustle of the city, choose a tour to the North on weekdays to avoid crowds and the scenic spots will not have to wait in long lines.

Tam Coc – Ninh Binh

Tam Coc – Bich Dong is one of the famous tourist attractions, and is located about 100km south of Hanoi. It has beautiful natural scenery, limestone mountains, adjacent river systems and majestic, poetic caves. Coming to Tam Coc, visitors often experience boating on the Ngo Dong River and admire the poetic scenery.

It can be said that Tam Coc has beautiful natural scenery, peaceful rivers, ripe rice fields and overlapping rocky mountains. On the way to Tam Coc, visitors will pass through caves such as:

  • Hang Mot
  • Hang Hai
  • Hang Ba

All three caves have unique shapes and spectacular scenery. In addition, visitors can visit the ancient temple with a long history. The temple was built in the 17th century with unique and sophisticated architecture, including many towers and shrines.

When visiting Bich Dong, visitors can also visit caves such as Hang Chin, Hang Bon, Hang Ba…

In addition, visitors can also experience cycling to visit villages to enjoy the fresh air and relax in peaceful villages. You will enjoy local specialties such as grilled chicken, fried spring rolls, sweet dessert soup,…

Things to note when traveling to the North of Vietnam

When you first come to Vietnam, you should pay attention to choosing famous places in the places, if you do not want to go far, you should choose famous places in the North, if you have plenty of time, choose the Central, Southern, or Northwest tour. However, it all depends on your preferences, and you need to note the following:

Weather

  • Northern Vietnam has a relatively mild climate, but it can also change suddenly. Therefore, you should regularly update weather information and prepare your luggage suitable for bad weather conditions.
  • The climate in the North is divided into 4 distinct seasons, so you can choose a tourist destination according to each season. There are places that are not suitable for you to visit in winter because there are not as many activities as in summer, because your trip to the North will be perfect if you pay attention to the weather.

Transportation

  • Means of transportation to visit the North, you can take a bus, or rent a private car to drive yourself. If you want the most safety for yourself, you should rent a car with a driver who will take you to visit the attractions you want to visit.

Eat and drink

  • Northern Vietnam is famous for its attractive specialties. However, you should choose reputable, clean restaurants to avoid health-related problems.
  • You should consult with local restaurants before starting your journey. This can give you more advantages in finding your favorite local dishes. Your trip to the North will be safer.

Respect local culture and customs

  • To respect local culture and customs, you should wear appropriate clothing when visiting tourist attractions, especially religious and historical sites, spiritual tourist areas. If you need to wear ao dai, conical hat… please ask your tour guide or local people for advice.

So if you want to have a quality trip to the North, please contact Vietlook immediately for more detailed advice. Vietlook Travel will always be a friend to tourists when visiting new lands, that is our honor.
posts.titleZh: 越南北部七大热门景点
posts.excerptZh: Vietlook Travel 将陪伴您探索北部七大旅游目的地，为您带来越南最棒的体验，感受多元文化和英雄历史遗迹。此外，您还可以品尝美味诱人的菜肴。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
Vietlook Travel 将陪伴您探索北部七大旅游目的地，为您带来越南最棒的体验，感受多元文化和英雄历史遗迹。此外，您还可以品尝美味诱人的菜肴。

这条 越南旅游 行程将带您探索北部著名地标，参观自然景观和传统手工艺村，例如：钵场陶器（Bat Trang）、Quang Phu Cau 香村、Ha Thai 漆画……让我们一起来看看下面这些有趣的内容吧。

河内

是前往 北部旅行时必去的目的地，首都河内以其丰富的历史、独特的建筑和鲜明的文化风格吸引着来自世界各地的游客。

来到河内，您将探索这座城市的地标，体验当地文化，参观胡志明陵，这是河内最著名的地标之一。在这里，您还可以看到他一生都喜爱的朴素住所。

参观越南第一所大学文庙，您将进一步了解越南古代的教育体系，并欣赏美丽的建筑。

如果您喜欢购物和品尝当地美食，应该前往河内古街区，这是这座城市最著名的购物和美食中心之一。许多咖啡馆、酒吧和当地商店出售各种食品和饮料。

此外，您还可以品尝河内的特色菜肴，如：河粉、烤肉米线（bun cha）、炸春卷、蛋咖啡……并了解越南的文化和历史。

此外，来到河内，游客可以品尝美味佳肴，与这里的人们一起体验丰富多彩的生活。为这次难忘的北部之旅做好准备吧！

古拜岛（Co To）– 广宁

对于热爱大海和海岛的人来说是绝佳的选择，这里有原始的白沙滩、清澈的蓝色海水和优美的自然风光，古拜岛是夏季所有游客的休憩之地。

从河内前往古拜岛，游客先到锦普（Cam Pha）– Cai Rong 港，乘渡轮或快艇前往古拜岛。行程约1小时，期间您可以欣赏美丽的海景并在船上放松。

来到古拜岛，您可以享受宁静的氛围，在原始的海滩上放松，沉浸在岛上的绿色自然中，或参加潜水、钓鱼和探索岛上洞穴等活动。

古拜岛上最有趣的目的地无疑是 Hong Van 海滩，那里沙滩洁白细腻，海水清澈湛蓝。您可以游泳、躺在沙滩上，或欣赏海滩上美丽的日落。假期里有许多有趣的活动可供您参加， 越南北部之旅 期间尽享乐趣。

除了原始的自然风光，古拜岛还有许多值得探索的文化和历史遗迹。景点包括：古拜庙（Co To Temple）、古拜渔村和 Chong Rock 海滩……

前往古拜岛旅行是假期中一次绝佳的体验，远离城市的喧嚣。今天就来探索古拜岛这片海上天堂最迷人的文化活动吧。

沙坝 – 老街

前往沙坝旅行是热爱自然风光、想体验高原人生活、喜欢征服“印度支那屋脊”高度的人的绝佳选择之一，不仅如此，沙坝还以相对凉爽的气候迎接游客。

沙坝以山丘、山谷、瀑布、梯田、清凉的绿茶山和松涛阵阵的 Ban Ang 松林而闻名。尤其是征服越南最高峰番西邦峰，从高处俯瞰沙坝全景。

如果您不想爬山，可以前往龙颚（Ham Rong）观景台，欣赏城市最美的景色。此外，游客还可以参观银瀑布（Silver Waterfall）、情人瀑布（Love Waterfall）等雄伟的瀑布，消暑、拍照和放松。欣赏大品村（Ta Phin）的梯田，享受如梦如幻的美景。

沙坝镇拥有古老的法式建筑和当地市场，也是一个令人难忘的目的地。游客可以漫步古镇，在笛声的召唤中了解当地文化……

特别是参观猫猫村（Cat Cat）时，游客将邂逅黑苗族的古老村寨，该村位于距沙坝约3公里处，了解当地人民的文化和生活方式，参观古屋，并欣赏独特的手工艺品。

石高原 – 河江

参观西北山区时不容错过的目的地。河江石高原拥有崎岖雄伟的山丘和原始的自然风光，吸引了许多国际游客前来参观。

河江石高原上最著名的目的地是马皮岭山口（Ma Pi Leng），这里是越南最美的风景之一。从这里，游客可以欣赏河江石高原的全景，崎岖的山脉和山谷中蜿蜒的河流。

此外，游客还可以体验登山、徒步、露营和探险旅游，探索雄伟的荒野之美，了解这里少数民族的文化和习俗。

请注意，前往河江旅游时，游客还应准备好登山、徒步和露营活动的装备和用品，以确保安全。沿途会有许多挑战，但正是这些挑战使这次旅行最为难忘。

木州 – 山罗

木州是山罗省一个美丽的高原，位于河内西北约200公里处。木州是一片广阔的高原，地形崎岖多山。

木州属温带气候，拥有美丽的花季，每个季节都有各自的花卉品种，尤其是油菜花、杏花、梅花、樱花盛开在山坡上。此外，游客还可以体验采摘李子、桃子、梨……

可以说，木州是热衷于露营、登山和探索自然的人们的理想目的地，可以体验徒步、登山、骑行、骑马、露营和参观高原村寨等有趣活动。

木州著名的旅游景点包括 Dai Yem 瀑布、Dong Muoi 洞、木州芥菜花山丘、茶山和少数民族村寨。

此外，游客还可以品尝烤肉、包在蒌叶里的肉、糯米糕、甘蔗汁等特产……还有更多有趣的事物等待您去发现。

三岛 – 永福

这是前往北部旅行时一个美丽的旅游目的地，这里有高山、终年凉爽的气候和优美的自然风光。三岛拥有许多迷人的旅游景点和漂亮的打卡地点。

前往三岛旅行的第一站是三岛市场，游客可以在这里品尝特产并购买纪念品。然后参观师寺（Thay Pagoda），这是一座古老的寺庙，建筑优美，雕塑和绘画独特。

参观 Wonderland，这是一个娱乐区，有滑雪、滑冰、骑马和钓鱼等许多有趣的活动……

如果您是自然爱好者，可以参观 Hang Mom、Doi Co、Suoi Mo、Thac Bac 和三岛旗杆……

如果您想享受宁静的空间并寻求放松，可前往三岛的度假村和豪华酒店。您将享受水疗、按摩、矿泉浴、瑜伽……将为您带来最难忘的假期。

前往三岛的交通方式，您可以从河内选择乘汽车、摩托车或巴士。从河内到三岛的行程约2-3小时，取决于交通工具和天气状况。

如果您不喜欢城市的喧嚣，请选择在工作日前往北部旅游，以避开人群，景点也不必排长队。

三谷 – 宁平

三谷 – 碧洞（Tam Coc – Bich Dong）是著名的旅游景点之一，位于河内以南约100公里处。这里自然风光优美，有石灰岩山脉、相邻的河流系统和雄伟而诗意的洞穴。来到三谷，游客通常会体验在吴洞河（Ngo Dong）上泛舟，欣赏诗情画意的风景。

可以说，三谷拥有优美的自然风光、宁静的河流、成熟的稻田和层层叠叠的岩石山脉。前往三谷的路上，游客将经过以下洞穴：

  • 第一洞（Hang Mot）
  • 第二洞（Hang Hai）
  • 第三洞（Hang Ba）

这三个洞穴都形状独特、景色壮观。此外，游客还可以参观历史悠久的古寺。该寺建于17世纪，建筑独特精致，包括许多塔和神殿。

参观碧洞时，游客还可以参观第九洞（Hang Chin）、第四洞（Hang Bon）、第三洞（Hang Ba）等洞穴……

此外，游客还可以体验骑自行车参观村庄，享受清新的空气，在宁静的村庄中放松。您将品尝到当地特产，如烤鸡、炸春卷、甜汤……

前往越南北部旅行的注意事项

初次来到越南时，您应注意选择当地的著名景点，如果不想走太远，应选择北部的著名景点，如果时间充裕，可选择中部、南部或西北之旅。不过，这一切取决于您的喜好，您需要注意以下几点：

天气

  • 越南北部气候相对温和，但也可能突然变化。因此，您应经常关注天气信息，并准备适合恶劣天气的行李。
  • 北部气候分为四个分明的季节，因此您可以根据每个季节选择旅游目的地。有些地方不适合冬季前往，因为活动不如夏季多，只要注意天气，您的北部之旅就会很完美。

交通

  • 前往北部的交通方式，您可以乘坐巴士，或租一辆私家车自驾。如果您想获得最大的安全保障，应租用带司机的车辆，由司机带您前往想参观的景点。

饮食

  • 越南北部以迷人的特产而闻名。不过，您应选择信誉良好、干净的餐厅，以避免出现健康方面的问题。
  • 出发之前，您应向当地餐厅咨询。这可以让您在寻找喜爱的当地菜肴时更具优势。您的北部之旅将更加安全。

尊重当地文化和习俗

  • 为了尊重当地文化和习俗，参观旅游景点，尤其是宗教和历史遗迹、精神旅游区时，应穿着得体。如果您需要穿奥黛、戴斗笠……请向导游或当地人咨询。

posts.title: Visiting Traditional Craft Villages In Vietnam
posts.excerpt: Vietnam is not only known for its breathtaking landscapes and vibrant cities, but also for its rich network of traditional craft villages that have been preserved for generations. These villages are m
posts.contentHtml:
Vietnam is not only known for its breathtaking landscapes and vibrant cities, but also for its rich network of traditional craft villages that have been preserved for generations. These villages are more than production sites; they are living cultural spaces where history, craftsmanship, and local identity come together.

For travelers seeking authentic cultural experiences, visiting traditional craft villages in Vietnam offers a deeper understanding of the country’s heritage and a chance to witness skilled artisans at work.

The Cultural Significance of Craft Villages

Traditional craft villages in Vietnam have existed for hundreds, sometimes thousands, of years. Each village specializes in a particular craft, often passed down within families from one generation to the next.

These crafts are closely tied to local culture and daily life. From pottery and silk weaving to bamboo weaving and lacquer art, every product reflects not only technical skill but also artistic expression and regional identity.

Visiting these villages allows travelers to explore a side of Vietnam that goes beyond tourism, offering insight into the values, traditions, and creativity of local communities.

Famous Craft Villages Across Vietnam

Bat Trang Pottery Village, Hanoi

Located just outside Hanoi, Bat Trang is one of the most famous pottery villages in Vietnam. With a history spanning several centuries, the village produces a wide range of ceramic products, from household items to artistic pieces.

Visitors can explore pottery workshops, learn about the production process, and even try making their own ceramic items.

Van Phuc Silk Village, Hanoi

Van Phuc is known for its high-quality silk, once used for royal garments. Today, the village continues to produce elegant silk fabrics with traditional patterns and modern designs.

Travelers can walk through the village streets lined with silk shops, observe weaving techniques, and purchase authentic Vietnamese silk products.

Kim Bong Carpentry Village, Hoi An

Located near Hoi An, Kim Bong village specializes in traditional woodworking. Artisans here have contributed to the construction and restoration of many historic buildings in central Vietnam.

Visitors can see intricate wood carving techniques and learn about the role of carpentry in Vietnamese architecture.

Thanh Ha Pottery Village, Hoi An

Thanh Ha is another well-known pottery village, famous for its simple yet elegant ceramic products.

The village offers interactive experiences where visitors can shape clay and understand the traditional firing process.

Phu Vinh Bamboo and Rattan Village, Hanoi

Phu Vinh village is renowned for its bamboo and rattan handicrafts. Products range from everyday items to sophisticated decorative pieces.

The craftsmanship here demonstrates creativity and sustainability, using natural materials to create durable and beautiful goods.

Unique Experiences for Travelers

Hands-on Craft Activities

Many villages offer workshops where visitors can participate in making pottery, weaving silk, or crafting bamboo products. These activities provide a memorable and engaging experience.

Cultural Interaction

Interacting with local artisans gives insight into their daily lives, techniques, and the stories behind each craft. This personal connection adds depth to your journey.

Shopping for Authentic Souvenirs

Craft villages are ideal places to buy handmade products directly from artisans. These items are often unique and carry cultural significance, making them meaningful souvenirs.

Travel Tips for Visiting Craft Villages

Plan your visit in the morning or early afternoon when workshops are most active.

Respect local customs and ask for permission before taking photographs of artisans.

Bring cash, as many small workshops do not accept card payments.

Combine your visit with nearby attractions to make the most of your itinerary.

Travel with Vietlook Travel

Exploring traditional craft villages can be more convenient and insightful with professional guidance. Vietlook Travel offers curated cultural tours that include visits to renowned craft villages across Vietnam.

With experienced guides, well-planned itineraries, and reliable transportation, Vietlook Travel helps you experience the authenticity of Vietnam in a structured and comfortable way.

Visiting traditional craft villages in Vietnam is a meaningful journey into the country’s cultural roots. It is an opportunity to witness the dedication of artisans, understand centuries-old traditions, and bring home pieces of Vietnam’s heritage.

Whether you are interested in art, history, or simply authentic travel experiences, these villages offer something truly special that goes beyond ordinary tourism.
posts.titleZh: 探访越南传统手工艺村
posts.excerptZh: 越南不仅以令人惊叹的风景和充满活力的城市闻名，还以世代传承的丰富传统手工艺村网络而著称。这些村庄不仅是生产场所，更是历史、工艺和地方特色汇聚的活的文化空间。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
越南不仅以令人惊叹的风景和充满活力的城市闻名，还以世代传承的丰富传统手工艺村网络而著称。这些村庄不仅是生产场所，更是历史、工艺和地方特色汇聚的活的文化空间。

对于寻求地道文化体验的旅行者来说， 参观越南传统手工艺村 能让您更深入地了解这个国家的遗产，并有机会见证技艺娴熟的工匠工作。

手工艺村的文化意义

越南的传统手工艺村已存在数百年，有时甚至数千年。每个村庄专精于一门特定的手艺，通常在家族内代代相传。

这些手艺与当地文化和日常生活紧密相连。从陶器、丝绸织造到竹编和漆艺，每件产品不仅体现技术，也体现艺术表达和地域特色。

参观这些村庄让旅行者探索越南超越旅游的一面，深入了解当地社区的价值观、传统和创造力。

越南各地的著名手工艺村

钵场陶器村，河内

钵场（Bat Trang）位于河内郊外，是越南最著名的陶器村之一。村庄历史跨越数个世纪，生产从家居用品到艺术品的各种陶瓷产品。

游客可以参观陶器作坊，了解生产过程，甚至尝试亲手制作自己的陶瓷制品。

万福丝绸村，河内

万福（Van Phuc）以高品质丝绸闻名，曾用于制作皇家服饰。如今，该村继续生产带有传统图案和现代设计的优雅丝织品。

旅行者可以漫步在两旁都是丝绸店的村中街道，观察织造技术，并购买地道的越南丝绸产品。

金榜木雕村，会安

金榜村（Kim Bong）位于会安附近，专精于传统木工。这里的工匠曾参与越南中部许多历史建筑的建造和修复。

游客可以看到精细的木雕技艺，并了解木工在越南建筑中的作用。

青河陶器村，会安

青河（Thanh Ha）是另一个知名的陶器村，以简约而优雅的陶瓷产品闻名。

村庄提供互动体验，游客可以塑造陶泥，并了解传统的烧制过程。

Phu Vinh竹藤村，河内

Phu Vinh村以竹藤手工艺品而闻名。产品从日常用品到精致的装饰品应有尽有。

这里的工艺展示了创造力和可持续性，利用天然材料制作耐用而美观的商品。

为旅行者带来的独特体验

亲手体验的手工活动

许多村庄提供工作坊，游客可以参与制作陶器、织丝绸或制作竹制品。这些活动提供难忘而引人入胜的体验。

文化交流

与当地工匠交流，能让您了解他们的日常生活、技艺以及每门手艺背后的故事。这种个人联系为您的旅程增添深度。

选购地道的纪念品

手工艺村是直接向工匠购买手工制品的理想场所。这些物品通常独一无二，具有文化意义，是有意义的纪念品。

参观手工艺村的旅行小贴士

请在上午或午后早些时候安排参观，此时作坊最为活跃。

尊重当地习俗，拍摄工匠照片前请先征得许可。

请携带现金，因为许多小作坊不接受刷卡支付。

将参观与附近的景点结合起来，以充分利用您的行程。

与 Vietlook Travel 一起旅行

在专业向导的带领下探索传统手工艺村会更便捷、更有见地。Vietlook Travel 提供精心策划的文化之旅，包括参观越南各地的知名手工艺村。

凭借经验丰富的导游、规划周密的行程和可靠的交通，Vietlook Travel 帮助您以有条不紊且舒适的方式体验地道的越南。

参观越南传统手工艺村是一次深入了解这个国家文化根源的有意义之旅。这是见证工匠的奉献精神、了解数百年传统并带回越南遗产片段的机会。

无论您对艺术、历史感兴趣，还是只是想要地道的旅行体验，这些村庄都能提供超越普通旅游的真正特别之处。

posts.title: Top 7 Mountains In Vietnam

posts.contentHtml:
Coming to Vietnam, you will encounter high mountain ranges, with mountain passes covered in clouds all year round, clear streams that look like a picturesque landscape painting from afar. If you are a nature lover and want to find a trip to explore and conquer high mountain ranges, then come to Vietnam and conquer the top 7 mountains worth conquering.

If you still don’t know which mountain to visit on your upcoming trip to Vietnam, today Vietlook Travel will suggest you the top 7 beautiful mountains to conquer on this trip.

Fansipan Mountain

If you are a travel enthusiast and want to explore famous mountains in Vietnam, Fansipan is the first stop on your trip. This is the highest mountain in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.

Fansipan belongs to Hoang Lien Son range with an altitude of 3,143 meters, the climate here is relatively cool in summer, quite cold in winter, if you travel to Sapa on cold days when conquering Fansipan peak you will be immersed in white snow.

You can reach the top of Fansipan by a 6.2km cable car. This is the longest cable car system in the world and is the highlight of the mountain climbing trip.

When you reach the top of the mountain, you can see the whole view of Hoang Lien Son mountain range and admire the beauty of nature.

In addition to mountain climbing, visitors can also experience interesting activities such as mountain climbing, camping or soaking in natural hot water that will bring visitors a feeling of relaxation.
When conquering the mountain top, from the top of the mountain you can admire the scenery of Sapa, a beautiful natural scene with a peaceful rustic picture, especially when the sun has just risen with the first rays of sunlight shining on the canopy when the dew drops still on the leaves will sway in the wind creating a beautiful picture.

To have a great Fansipan trip, you should prepare all the necessary equipment, including climbing shoes, warm and thick clothes, masks and enough drinking water, and plan a trip with good health to conquer the height, while walking and admiring the natural scenery.

Pu Ta Leng Mountain

If you are a lover of wild nature and want to conquer high mountains, visit Pu Ta Leng Mountain, one of the highest peaks in the Hoang Lien Son range in Northwest Vietnam.

If you are a lover of wild nature and want to conquer high mountains, visit Pu Ta Leng Mountain, one of the highest peaks in the Hoang Lien Son range in Northwest Vietnam.

To reach Pu Ta Leng Mountain, you have to cross streams, forests and high hills to reach the top of the mountain. From above, you can see the majestic mountain ranges, villages, corn fields and terraced fields hidden in the misty fog.

What’s special is that Pu Ta Leng is still a fairly new and unexploited destination, so when you come here, you will experience the wildness and peace.

At an altitude of 2,900m above sea level, visitors will admire the rhododendron forests with flowers of various colors such as pink, red, white… Rhododendrons bloom most beautifully in March and April every year. Because if you want to see beautiful rhododendron flowers, you should travel to Sapa from March to April.

If you conquer Pu Ta Leng peak at the end of the year in November, visitors will admire the beauty of the yellow and red leaf forest, you will feel like you are in some western land, not at Pu Ta Leng Mountain.

However, you must also prepare carefully before climbing Pu Ta Leng, including equipment such as climbing shoes, warm clothes, masks, and enough drinking water. You also need to prepare mentally to face the challenges on the way to the top.

Pu Si Lung Mountain

If you spend 2 weeks conquering the mountains, and conquering the beauty of Vietnam, then Pu Si Lung Lai Chau is a destination you must visit, located at an altitude of over 3,000 meters above sea level.

To reach the top of the mountain, you will cross difficult and arduous paths, such as dense forests, hills, rivers and streams, and conquer steep slopes. When you reach the top, you will see the clouds drifting slowly, especially when the sunlight shines in, creating a beautiful scene for you to enjoy from above.

The vegetation is stratified, from low shrubs to tall shrubs. Moreover, the forest has many beautiful flowers, including orchids, rhododendrons and especially lilies that look very unique and rare.

From the top of Pu Si Lung, you can admire the majestic landscape of Hoang Lien Son mountain range, along with the tranquility and peace of wild nature. In particular, you also have the opportunity to explore many rare and attractive species of flora and fauna on the mountain top.

If you are a mountain climbing enthusiast, Pu Si Lung is a destination not to be missed when traveling to Vietnam. This is one of the challenges for you to conquer the height and challenge yourself and have the best tour.

Ba Den Mountain

Ba Den Mountain in Tay Ninh, located at an altitude of about 986m, is one of the destinations with many diverse temples and pagodas such as: Hoa Thanh Temple and Cao Dai Temple to Thuong Temple, Trung Temple, Ha Temple. This is one of the important pilgrimage sites for people in the Southwest region.

Coming here, besides the sacred temples and spiritual activities, visitors can also participate in many interesting outdoor activities at Ba Den Mountain such as: mountain climbing, kayaking on the Dauntings River, mountain biking… this will bring you interesting and challenging experiences when conquering the mountain top.

When reaching the top of Ba Den mountain, you can admire the panoramic view of the surrounding hills and enjoy the scenery of Thien Hau statue, one of the famous architectural works of Ba Den mountain, and learn about the unique culture of the Southern region.

As a famous pilgrimage and tourist destination, Ba Den Mountain has many accommodation facilities, restaurants, and cafes to serve tourists. In addition, you can also buy unique souvenirs to give to friends, relatives, or as souvenirs during your conquest of Ba Den Mountain.

With interesting and diverse landscapes, Ba Den Mountain is one of the tourist destinations that you cannot miss when exploring the famous landscapes in Vietnam. You should visit Ba Den Mountain to feel the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.

Bach Ma Mountain

Bach Ma Mountain is located 60 km south of Hue. In Vietnam, it is considered a natural boundary, and is located in Bach Ma National Park and is 1,450m high.

This is a resort chosen by many tourists when coming to Vietnam. From the top of the mountain, you can see waterfalls and peaceful streams. It is one of the beautiful destinations with wild, magnificent scenery and many exciting activities.

Below are the activities when you visit Bach Ma Mountain

  • Conquering Bach Ma mountain at an altitude of over 1,400m requires you to have good health and endurance to climb to the top of the mountain. However, when you reach the top, you will feel excited and have unforgettable moments.
  • Bach Ma National Park is located in the middle of a primeval forest and is one of the largest national parks in Vietnam. Coming here, visitors can learn about the diverse ecosystem and rich fauna.
  • Visiting the Forest Church is one of the unique architectural works on Bach Ma Mountain, built in the middle of a lush green forest. This is a place of prayer for those who seek peace and tranquility.
  • Hiking and conquering Bach Ma mountain, visitors go through challenging trails for climbing and hiking enthusiasts passing through lush forests, clear streams and beautiful waterfalls.

When you reach Bach Ma Mountain, you will have to go through winding roads. However, the higher you go, the more the beauty of Bach Ma appears before your eyes and you will be satisfied to admire the beauty of Lang Co Bay.

You can also admire the purple color of sim flowers and enjoy the beautiful lakes at Bach Ma National Park. It will definitely bring you beautiful memories during your trip.

In addition, you will also encounter diverse flora and fauna, colorful landscape paintings will bring you the most enjoyable feelings.

Ba Vi Mountain

Ba Vi Mountain is located about 50 km west of Hanoi city center. With an altitude of over 1,200m, Ba Vi Mountain is covered by a rich primeval forest and is home to many rare species of flora and fauna.

The mountain is considered one of the most beautiful mountains, and is best visited in the fall, from September to November. At this time, the weather is cool and pleasant, not too hot or too cold, along with beautiful and captivating natural scenery.

In addition to mountain climbing experiences, visiting national parks and enjoying local cuisine, visitors can also participate in many interesting activities in Ba Vi.

  • Join the tour and experience cycling and mountain climbing to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Ba Vi mountain and explore the winding passes.
  • Taking part in sports activities like hiking, climbing and ziplining will give you a sense of excitement and help you explore new paths.
  • Admire the beautiful scenery from the top of Ba Vi mountain, you can see the whole town, or the rice fields, lakes and pristine forests.
  • Bathing in the streams and waterfalls at Ba Vi mountain, which are clear, cool and unique, is an ideal stop for tourists to relax and cool off on hot summer days.

In addition to Thuong Temple, visitors can visit other famous landmarks such as Thay Pagoda, Duong Lam ancient village, West Lake, Muong Hoa Heaven Gate,…

To get to Ba Vi Mountain, you can choose to travel by motorbike or car. However, if you are trekking, walking is the best way to experience the mountain.

If you want to stay overnight at Ba Vi Mountain, you can choose a resort or camp or stay at a homestay, there are many options for you.

Ngu Hanh Son Mountains

If you are planning to travel to Vietnam for 2 weeks, you cannot miss a stop like Ngu Hanh Son, and explore the beauty of marble mountains.

The mountain was formed about 5 to 10 million years ago and has 5 limestone peaks, each named Kim Son, Moc Son, Thuy Son, Hoa Son, and Tho Son.

In addition to visiting tourist attractions, visitors can also participate in activities such as mountain climbing, trekking, camping, and taking photos next to beautiful landscapes. Ngu Hanh Son is an ideal destination for those who love natural scenery and want to find peace in nature.

The best time to travel to Ngu Hanh Son is from February to August every year. At this time, the weather is warm and cool, not too hot or too cold, very convenient for tourists to visit and sightsee, especially walking to admire the scenery or conquering the mountain top to admire the scenery from above.

To get to Ngu Hanh Son, you have to climb many steps, so you should wear cool clothes, and you should avoid the rainy season from August to November, because storms will affect your tour or conquer the mountain peaks.

In addition to the suggested destinations above, it will help you choose your favorite destinations, especially conquering high mountains from the North, Central, South… and experiencing the culture of each region and enjoying the cuisine of each locality.

Note When Going To Experience Climbing

Mountain climbing in Vietnam is an exciting and challenging activity. You must refer to some tips below to ensure your trip is safe.

Research the mountain climbing destination before going

The first important thing when preparing for a mountain climbing trip is to research the destination you will go to. This helps you know in advance about the location’s height, slope, climate, and weather conditions.

If you are climbing in winter or rainy season, you need to bring the right equipment to ensure safety. At the same time, if you are climbing in a group, make sure that all members know the location well and are fully prepared before conquering.

Consult and choose a reputable travel agency to choose a rewarding trip for yourself. If you are still hesitant, let Vietlook accompany you.

Prepare necessary equipment

The next important thing is to prepare the necessary equipment when climbing. Spikes help you grip the rocky slopes. In addition, a backpack full of food, water and emergency items is also necessary when climbing.

Waterproof jackets, sunglasses, masks and safety equipment such as belts and helmets are also essential items to bring. During the climbing process, essential accessories.

However, if you are afraid of long distances and want to avoid carrying heavy equipment, you can rent from local people or agents.

Good Health

Mountain climbing is an activity that requires you to be in good health. Before starting the trip, check your health and make sure you can complete the journey safely.

Local regulations 

Localities may have their own regulations regarding climbing, so it is important to research and follow the rules before you go. If you are traveling with a guide, ask them about the rules and make sure you understand and follow them.

Safety first 

Always follow the rules when climbing in Vietnam, do not go alone and always keep in touch with your companions or the authorities to ensure the safety of yourself and others. If you encounter an emergency, seek support from a guide or rescue agency.

Monitor the weather 

It is important to check the weather before you go hiking to ensure your safety. If the weather is bad, you should cancel your trip and wait for better weather. If you are hiking and the weather suddenly changes, make sure you have the right equipment to deal with different weather conditions.

Respect local culture

When hiking in Vietnam, please protect the local nature and culture. Do not litter and keep the public clean. Respect and learn from the local culture, avoid causing trouble for the local people, it will not be good for your trip.

It can be said that Vietnam is a beautiful destination for mountaineers who want to explore pristine natural landscapes. From Fansipan, Pu Ta Leng, Pu Si Lung, Bach Ma, Ba Vi to Ngon Hanh Son Mountain – Da Nang, each location brings unique and interesting experiences for you. Let’s join Vietlook to explore the beauty of Vietnam today.
