posts.title: Famous Attractions On Phu Quy Island During A Binh Thuan Trip
posts.excerpt: With crystal-clear beaches where you can see straight to the ocean floor, untouched landscapes, and a peaceful island atmosphere, Phu Quy Island has become a dream destination for many travelers. Join
posts.contentHtml:
With crystal-clear beaches where you can see straight to the ocean floor, untouched landscapes, and a peaceful island atmosphere, Phu Quy Island has become a dream destination for many travelers. Join us as we explore the most popular attractions on Phu Quy Island – a hidden gem of Binh Thuan Province.

Phu Quy is gradually making its mark on the Binh Thuan tourism map. Blessed with pristine beaches, turquoise waters, and unspoiled natural scenery, the island offers a rare sense of tranquility that captivates visitors from the very first moment.

Princess Ban Tranh Temple

According to legend, Princess Ban Tranh was exiled to a deserted island after disobeying her father, the king. Accompanied by only a few servants and a small boat, she reclaimed the land, fished, cultivated crops, and established the first settlements on the island. She taught the local people how to farm and grow crops, laying the foundation for life on Phu Quy Island.

In gratitude for her great contributions, local residents built a temple in her honor. Every year on the 3rd day of the Lunar New Year, the Princess Ban Tranh Temple Festival takes place, attracting many visitors traveling to Binh Thuan during the holiday season. The temple is a national historical relic, reflecting the cultural fusion between Cham and Vietnamese traditions and the spiritual life of the island’s people.

Phu Quy Lighthouse

Located on Mount Cam at an elevation of 108 meters above sea level, Phu Quy Lighthouse is one of the largest lighthouses in Vietnam. At night, its powerful light guides fishing boats safely home. To reach the lighthouse, visitors must climb more than 120 stone steps, passing uniquely shaped rocks formed by years of exposure to wind and sea.

From the top, travelers can enjoy panoramic views of Phu Quy Island’s poetic landscape: calm blue seas, fishing boats drifting in the distance, Mount Cam reflected in the water, and surrounding islets such as Hon Tranh, Hon Trung, and Hon Dao acting as natural shields against ocean storms.

Trieu Duong Bay

Trieu Duong Bay is considered the most beautiful beach on Phu Quy Island, featuring a long stretch of fine white sand and crystal-clear water. Coconut palms, whispering casuarina trees, and nearby islets like Hon Tranh and Hoa Son create a breathtaking natural painting.

The best time to swim here is in the late afternoon, when the sun softens and the sea becomes especially inviting. Trieu Duong Bay is also famous for its romantic sunsets, when the sky and sea glow in warm hues. Visitors can even experience local island life by joining fishermen in casting nets, pulling in the catch, and enjoying freshly caught seafood.

During festivals and holidays, Trieu Duong Bay becomes a lively gathering place for locals, yet it still retains its peaceful charm thanks to the island’s mild climate and sustainable tourism development.

Linh Son Pagoda – Cao Cat Mountain

Linh Son Pagoda is not only a spiritual destination but also one of the best viewpoints on Phu Quy Island. Situated atop Cao Cat Mountain, the pagoda offers a 360-degree view of the entire island. To the east lies the mysterious tomb of Master Sai Nai, believed to bring wisdom to those who visit. To the west, visitors can spot Mount Cam Lighthouse and Princess Ban Tranh Temple.

The sound of waves blending with the pagoda bells, along with the gentle scent of incense, creates a deeply peaceful and sacred atmosphere. Many travelers stop here to pray for good fortune and family well-being.

Wind Power Hill

Constructed in 2010 in the northern part of the island, Phu Quy Wind Power Hill is Vietnam’s first hybrid wind–diesel power project. It supplies electricity 24/7 for local residents and has become a unique check-in spot for visitors.

Unlike other wind farms, Phu Quy’s turbines stand against a backdrop of blue sea and green grasslands, where herds of cows graze peacefully. The simple white turbines contrast beautifully with the deep blue sky, creating a calm and nostalgic scene perfect for photography or even a relaxed outdoor picnic.

Infinity Lake

Often called the “Little Bali of Vietnam,” Phu Quy Island is home to the stunning Infinity Lake, located near Bai Nho – Ganh Hang. This natural rock pool connects directly to the open sea, creating the illusion of endless water stretching into the horizon.

The lake’s beauty changes throughout the day—from serene sunrise moments to vibrant midday colors and romantic sunsets. Its untouched charm has quickly made it one of the most sought-after photo spots on the island.

Hon Tranh Islet

Just 600 meters from Phu Quy Port, Hon Tranh is the largest of the ten surrounding islets. With no permanent residents except for a naval observation station, the islet remains largely untouched. Calm, crystal-clear waters make it an ideal destination for snorkeling and coral viewing at Vung Phat Marine Conservation Area.

Hon Tranh’s volcanic rock formations, colorful coral reefs, and peaceful environment offer an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and underwater explorers.

Bai Nho – Ganh Hang

Located about 10 kilometers from the island center, Bai Nho – Ganh Hang features a crescent-shaped beach framed by rocky cliffs. Despite its small size, the beach is airy, quiet, and blessed with clear turquoise water.

Visitors can swim, snorkel, relax on the grass-covered cliffs, or simply sit on the rocks and admire the endless sky. Afterward, enjoying fresh and affordable seafood such as herring salad, grilled sea urchin, braised squid, or cobia sour soup is a must.

Hon Tranh Beach

Hon Tranh Beach is famous for its calm waters, exceptional visibility, and vibrant coral reefs. Surrounded by volcanic rocks and protected by high cliffs, the sea remains tranquil year-round. The blend of blue sea, clear sky, and rugged black rocks creates a dramatic natural masterpiece.

Swimming, snorkeling, and watching the sunset here offer a deeply immersive experience, making Hon Tranh Beach one of the most memorable stops on any Phu Quy Island journey.

With its majestic scenery, pristine beaches, and rich cultural heritage, Phu Quy Island promises unforgettable discoveries for travelers visiting Binh Thuan. If you are planning a weekend getaway or a longer island escape, these remarkable attractions should not be missed.
posts.titleZh: 平顺之旅：富贵岛著名景点
posts.excerptZh: 海滩清澈见底，可以直接看到海底，加上未经破坏的风景和宁静的海岛氛围，富贵岛（Phu Quy）已成为许多旅行者梦想中的目的地。让我们一起探索
posts.contentHtmlZh:
海滩清澈见底，可以直接看到海底，加上未经破坏的风景和宁静的海岛氛围，富贵岛（Phu Quy）已成为许多旅行者梦想中的目的地。让我们一起探索富贵岛最受欢迎的景点——平顺省的一颗隐秘明珠。

富贵岛正逐渐在 平顺 的旅游地图上占有一席之地。这里拥有原始的海滩、碧蓝的海水和未经破坏的自然风光，带来难得的宁静，从第一刻起就吸引着游客。

Ban Tranh 公主庙

据传说，Ban Tranh 公主因违抗父王而被流放到一座荒岛。她只带着几个仆人和一艘小船，开垦土地、捕鱼、耕种，并在岛上建立了最早的聚居点。她教当地人如何耕作和种植农作物，为富贵岛的生活奠定了基础。

为感谢她的巨大贡献，当地居民建庙祭祀她。每年正月初三，Ban Tranh 公主庙会举行，吸引许多在节假日期间前往平顺旅游的游客。该庙是国家级历史遗迹，反映了占族与越族传统之间的文化交融以及岛上居民的精神生活。

富贵灯塔

富贵灯塔位于海拔108米的 Cam 山上，是越南最大的灯塔之一。夜晚，它强大的灯光引导渔船安全回家。要到达灯塔，游客必须攀爬120多级石阶，沿途经过因多年风吹海蚀而形成的形状独特的岩石。

从山顶，旅行者可以欣赏富贵岛如诗的全景：平静的蓝色大海、远处漂浮的渔船、倒映在水中的 Cam 山，以及周围的 Hon Tranh、Hon Trung 和 Hon Dao 等小岛，它们像天然屏障一样抵御海上风暴。

Trieu Duong 湾

Trieu Duong 湾被认为是富贵岛最美的海滩，拥有绵长的细白沙滩和清澈见底的海水。椰子树、沙沙作响的木麻黄树，以及附近 Hon Tranh 和 Hoa Son 等小岛，构成一幅令人叹为观止的自然画卷。

在这里游泳的最佳时间是傍晚，此时阳光变得柔和，大海格外迷人。Trieu Duong 湾还以浪漫的日落而闻名，天空和大海都散发着温暖的色调。游客甚至可以加入渔民撒网、拉网并享用刚捕捞的海鲜，体验当地的海岛生活。

在节日和假期期间，Trieu Duong 湾成为当地人热闹的聚会场所，但得益于岛上温和的气候和可持续的旅游发展，它仍保留着宁静的魅力。

灵山寺——Cao Cat 山

灵山寺不仅是一个精神目的地，也是富贵岛最佳的观景点之一。寺庙坐落在 Cao Cat 山顶，可360度俯瞰整座岛屿。东面是神秘的 Sai Nai 大师之墓，据信能给到访者带来智慧。西面，游客可以看到 Cam 山灯塔和 Ban Tranh 公主庙。

海浪声与寺庙钟声交融，加上淡淡的香火气息，营造出深深的宁静与神圣氛围。许多旅行者在这里驻足，祈求好运和家人安康。

风电山丘

富贵风电山丘建于2010年，位于岛的北部，是越南第一个风力–柴油混合发电项目。它全天候为当地居民供电，并已成为游客独特的打卡地。

与其他风电场不同，富贵岛的风力涡轮机矗立在蓝色大海和绿色草地的背景之中，牛群在此悠闲吃草。简洁的白色涡轮机与深蓝的天空形成美丽的对比，构成一幅宁静而怀旧的画面，非常适合摄影，甚至可以悠闲地野餐。

无边湖

富贵岛常被称为“越南的小巴厘岛”，这里有令人惊叹的无边湖，位于 Bai Nho – Ganh Hang 附近。这个天然岩石水池直接连通外海，营造出水面无尽延伸至地平线的错觉。

湖的美景在一天中不断变化——从宁静的日出时刻，到正午的鲜艳色彩，再到浪漫的日落。它原始的魅力很快使其成为岛上最受追捧的拍照地点之一。

Hon Tranh 小岛

Hon Tranh 距富贵港仅600米，是周围十座小岛中最大的一座。除了一个海军观察站外没有常住居民，小岛基本保持原始状态。平静、清澈的海水使其成为 Vung Phat 海洋保护区浮潜和观赏珊瑚的理想目的地。

Hon Tranh 的火山岩构造、五彩缤纷的珊瑚礁和宁静的环境，为自然爱好者和水下探索者提供难忘的体验。

Bai Nho – Ganh Hang

Bai Nho – Ganh Hang 距岛中心约10公里，拥有一片被岩石峭壁环绕的新月形海滩。虽然面积不大，但海滩开阔、安静，拥有清澈的碧蓝海水。

游客可以游泳、浮潜、在长满青草的峭壁上放松，或者只是坐在岩石上欣赏无边的天空。之后，品尝新鲜实惠的海鲜是必不可少的，如鲱鱼沙拉、烤海胆、红烧鱿鱼或军曹鱼酸汤。

Hon Tranh 海滩

Hon Tranh 海滩以平静的海水、极佳的能见度和绚丽的珊瑚礁而闻名。海滩被火山岩环绕，并受高耸峭壁的保护，海面全年平静。蓝色的大海、晴朗的天空和粗犷的黑色岩石相融合，构成一幅壮观的自然杰作。

在这里游泳、浮潜和观赏日落，能带来深度沉浸的体验，使 Hon Tranh 海滩成为任何富贵岛之旅中最难忘的一站。

凭借雄伟的风景、原始的海滩和丰富的文化遗产，富贵岛承诺为前往平顺的旅行者带来难忘的发现。无论您是计划周末度假还是更长时间的海岛之旅，这些非凡的景点都不容错过。

posts.title: Why Is Phu Quy Island So Appealing To Travelers Worldwide?
posts.excerpt: Phu Quy Island, a hidden gem in the blue waters of Binh Thuan Province, is an ideal destination for travelers who are drawn to untouched nature and authentic island life. This article provides a compr
posts.contentHtml:
Phu Quy Island, a hidden gem in the blue waters of Binh Thuan Province, is an ideal destination for travelers who are drawn to untouched nature and authentic island life. This article provides a comprehensive guide to the best time to visit, must-see attractions, local cuisine, and practical travel tips to help you enjoy a complete and memorable journey to this beautiful island.

Located off the coast of southern Vietnam, Phu Quy Island has long captivated nature lovers with its pristine landscapes and tranquil atmosphere. Despite the passage of time and historical changes, the island has preserved its original charm, featuring vibrant coral reefs, powdery white sand beaches, and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Beyond its natural beauty, Phu Quy is also home to significant historical and spiritual landmarks that tell stories of resilience and cultural heritage. If you are planning to explore this remarkable destination and are unsure where to begin, let us guide you through the highlights of Phu Quy Island.

Best Time To Visit Phu Quy Island

Phu Quy Island has a tropical climate with two distinct seasons: the dry season and the rainy season. Each season brings its own charm, but the most ideal time to visit is from June to December. During this period, the weather is generally pleasant, with clear skies, gentle sunshine, and minimal rainfall, making it perfect for outdoor activities such as swimming, snorkeling, and beach relaxation.

The sea is relatively calm during these months, which helps reduce seasickness for travelers taking boats to the island. This is also the peak season for marine activities, allowing visitors to fully enjoy the island’s clear waters and fresh ocean air.

Travelers are advised to check weather forecasts before departure and book ferry tickets and accommodation in advance, especially during peak seasons. Ferries typically depart from Phan Thiet Port, with travel times ranging from 2.5 to 3.5 hours depending on the vessel. One-way ticket prices usually range from 350,000 to 450,000 VND. Renting a motorbike upon arrival is a convenient and popular way to explore the island.

Must-Visit Attractions On Phu Quy Island

Bai Nho – Ganh Hang: Untouched Coastal Beauty

Bai Nho – Ganh Hang is one of the most iconic destinations on Phu Quy Island, located about 10 kilometers from the island center. This crescent-shaped beach is embraced by dramatic rocky cliffs and features soft white sand and calm, jade-colored waters. With minimal boat traffic, the beach retains a peaceful and pristine atmosphere.

Visitors can swim, relax by the shore, or snorkel to explore the colorful coral reefs that remain largely untouched. Early morning and late afternoon are the best times for photography, when the light is soft and the scenery becomes especially poetic.

After enjoying the sea, travelers should not miss the opportunity to savor fresh local seafood such as herring salad, spotted babylon snail mango salad, braised squid in fish sauce, grilled sea urchin with scallion oil, and hot sour fish soup.

Phu Quy Lighthouse: A Symbol Of Strength And Sovereignty

Standing proudly atop Mount Cam at 108 meters above sea level, Phu Quy Lighthouse is both an important maritime structure and a powerful symbol of Vietnam’s island sovereignty. With over 25 years of operation, the lighthouse continues to guide fishing boats and commercial vessels safely through the surrounding waters.

To reach the top, visitors climb more than 120 stone steps along the mountainside. The reward is a breathtaking panoramic view of the island, lush greenery, and the vast sea dotted with fishing boats. The site also offers insight into the life and dedication of lighthouse keepers who quietly safeguard the coastline.

Linh Son Pagoda And Cao Cat Mountain: Spiritual Serenity And Geological Wonders

Linh Son Pagoda sits atop Cao Cat Mountain, considered a sacred peak by local residents. This spiritual site offers sweeping 360-degree views of Phu Quy Island and the surrounding sea. The pagoda’s architecture harmonizes beautifully with nature, creating a peaceful and contemplative atmosphere.

Visitors can admire the majestic statue of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva and explore the mountain’s unique basalt rock formations shaped by ancient volcanic activity. Cao Cat Mountain is also a favorite spot for sunrise and sunset viewing, when the landscape is bathed in dramatic natural light.

Trieu Duong Bay: A Romantic Seaside Sunset

Trieu Duong Bay is widely regarded as the most beautiful beach on Phu Quy Island. With its long stretch of white sand, clear blue water, and rows of swaying casuarina trees, the bay offers a tranquil and romantic setting. Across the water lie Hon Tranh and Hon Den islets, enhancing the bay’s scenic charm.

Afternoons are ideal for swimming, while evenings offer spectacular sunset views as the sky and sea glow in shades of gold and crimson. Visitors may also join local fishermen in traditional activities such as net casting and squid fishing, followed by a fresh seaside meal.

Wind Power Hill: Green Energy And Iconic Photo Spot

Phu Quy Wind Power Hill, developed in 2010, is Vietnam’s first hybrid wind-diesel power project. Beyond its practical importance in providing 24/7 electricity for the island, it has become a popular photo destination.

The white wind turbines stand out against the deep blue sky and green grasslands, creating a peaceful rural scene often accompanied by grazing cattle. Visitors can enjoy picnics here while watching the turbines rotate gracefully in the sea breeze.

Infinity Lake: The “Mini Bali” Of Phu Quy

Infinity Lake, located near Bai Nho – Ganh Hang, is a naturally formed tidal pool that seamlessly blends with the ocean horizon. Surrounded by rugged rocks and filled with clear seawater, it creates the illusion of an endless pool merging with the sea.

The lake’s beauty changes throughout the day, from mystical dawn light to vibrant midday colors and romantic sunset hues. It has quickly become a favorite spot for photography and relaxation.

Hon Tranh Island: A Paradise For Snorkeling

Hon Tranh is the largest of the small islands surrounding Phu Quy. Sheltered by high cliffs, its waters are exceptionally calm and clear year-round, making it an ideal destination for snorkeling and coral exploration.

The underwater ecosystem here is rich and colorful, offering visitors a chance to immerse themselves in a pristine marine environment. Boat trips to Hon Tranh often include swimming, picnicking, and sunset viewing.

Local Experiences And Cuisine

Exploring Phu Quy by motorbike allows travelers to freely navigate scenic coastal roads and discover hidden beaches. The island is also renowned for its fresh and affordable seafood.

Must-try specialties include moon crab, emperor crab, grouper, grilled squid, sea cucumber, and Phu Quy hot beef dishes made from locally raised cattle. Another unique delicacy is seaweed jelly dessert, known for its refreshing taste and health benefits.

Accommodation And Transportation

Phu Quy offers a range of accommodation options, from budget guesthouses to cozy homestays and small hotels. Prices typically range from 200,000 to 500,000 VND per night. Booking in advance is recommended during peak travel periods.

Motorbikes are the most convenient means of transportation, with rental prices averaging 100,000 to 150,000 VND per day. Taxis and motorbike taxis are also available at higher costs.

Culture And Local Life

The people of Phu Quy are known for their friendliness, simplicity, and hospitality. Most residents make a living from fishing and agriculture. Visitors are warmly welcomed and encouraged to learn about local customs and daily life.

Traditional festivals such as the Whale Worshiping Festival and other sea-related ceremonies reflect the island’s deep spiritual connection to the ocean and offer meaningful cultural experiences for travelers.

Suggested 3 Day  2 Night Itinerary

Day 1: Arrival, check-in, visit Phu Quy Lighthouse and Linh Son Pagoda, sunset at Trieu Duong Bay.

Day 2: Snorkeling at Bai Nho or Hon Tranh, visit Infinity Lake and Wind Power Hill, enjoy local cuisine.

Day 3: Shopping for local specialties, visit Phu Quy Market, return to Phan Thiet.

Important Travel Tips

  • Book ferry tickets and accommodation early, especially during peak seasons.
  • Bring sunscreen, swimwear, sunglasses, and personal medication.
  • Respect local culture and religious sites.
  • Protect the environment by avoiding littering.
  • Drive carefully, as island roads can be narrow and steep.

Phu Quy Island is more than just a travel destination; it is a serene paradise where untouched nature, rich culture, and authentic island life come together. If you are seeking a peaceful yet enriching experience in Vietnam, Phu Quy Island is a destination not to be missed.
posts.titleZh: 富贵岛为何吸引全球游客？
posts.excerptZh: 富贵岛是平顺省碧蓝海域中的一颗隐秘宝石，是向往原始自然和地道海岛生活的旅行者的理想目的地。本文提供全面指南，介绍最佳游览时间、必游景点、当地美食和实用旅行贴士，帮助您享受一次完整而难忘的美丽海岛之旅。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
富贵岛(Phu Quy)是平顺省碧蓝海域中的一颗隐秘宝石，是向往原始自然和地道海岛生活的旅行者的理想目的地。本文提供全面指南，介绍最佳游览时间、必游景点、当地美食和实用旅行贴士，帮助您享受一次完整而难忘的美丽海岛之旅。

富贵岛位于越南南部海岸外，长久以来以其原始的风光和宁静的氛围吸引着自然爱好者。尽管时光流逝、历史变迁，这座岛屿依然保留着最初的魅力，拥有绚丽的珊瑚礁、细腻如粉的白色沙滩和清澈见底的青绿海水。除了自然之美，富贵岛还拥有重要的历史和精神地标，讲述着坚韧与文化遗产的故事。如果您正计划探索这个非凡的目的地却不知从何开始，就让我们带您领略富贵岛的亮点。

游览富贵岛的最佳时间

富贵岛属热带气候，有明显的两个季节：旱季和雨季。每个季节各有魅力，但最理想的游览时间是6月至12月。在此期间，天气总体宜人，天空晴朗，阳光柔和，降雨极少，非常适合游泳、浮潜和海滩休闲等户外活动。

这几个月海面相对平静，有助于减轻乘船上岛旅客的晕船反应。这也是海上活动的旺季，让游客能充分享受岛上清澈的海水和清新的海洋空气。

建议旅行者出发前查看天气预报，并提前预订渡轮票和住宿，尤其是在旺季。渡轮通常从潘切港(Phan Thiet)出发，航程2.5至3.5小时，视船只而定。单程票价通常在350,000至450,000越南盾之间。抵达后租一辆摩托车，是探索全岛便利而受欢迎的方式。

富贵岛必游景点

Bai Nho – Ganh Hang：原始的海岸之美

Bai Nho – Ganh Hang 是富贵岛最具标志性的目的地之一，距岛中心约10公里。这片新月形的海滩被险峻的岩壁环抱，沙滩洁白柔软，海水平静，呈翡翠色。这里船只往来极少，海滩保持着宁静而原始的氛围。

游客可以游泳、在海边放松，或浮潜探索基本保持原始状态的缤纷珊瑚礁。清晨和傍晚是拍摄的最佳时间，此时光线柔和，景色格外富有诗意。

享受完大海之后，旅行者千万不要错过品尝当地新鲜海鲜的机会，例如鲱鱼沙拉、芒果拌斑点法螺、鱼露焖鱿鱼、葱油烤海胆和酸辣鱼汤。

富贵灯塔：力量与主权的象征

富贵灯塔矗立在海拔108米的 Cam 山顶，既是重要的航海建筑，也是越南海岛主权的有力象征。灯塔已运行超过25年，持续引导渔船和商船安全通过周边海域。

要登上塔顶，游客需沿山势攀登120多级石阶。回报是令人屏息的全岛全景、葱郁的绿意，以及点缀着渔船的辽阔大海。这里还能让人了解默默守护海岸线的灯塔守护者们的生活与奉献。

灵山寺与 Cao Cat 山：精神的宁静与地质奇观

灵山寺(Linh Son)坐落在 Cao Cat 山顶，被当地居民视为圣山。这处精神圣地可360度俯瞰富贵岛和周围的大海。寺庙的建筑与自然和谐相融，营造出宁静而沉思的氛围。

游客可以欣赏庄严的观世音菩萨像，并探索由远古火山活动塑造的山体独特玄武岩地貌。Cao Cat 山也是观赏日出和日落的热门地点，此时山河沐浴在壮丽的自然光线之中。

Trieu Duong 湾：浪漫的海滨日落

Trieu Duong 湾被普遍认为是富贵岛上最美的海滩。绵长的白色沙滩、碧蓝清澈的海水和成排摇曳的木麻黄树，营造出宁静浪漫的环境。海对面是 Hon Tranh 和 Hon Den 小岛，为海湾的风光增色。

下午适合游泳，傍晚则可欣赏壮观的日落，天空和大海被染成金色与绯红。游客还可以与当地渔民一同参与撒网、钓鱿鱼等传统活动，随后享用一顿新鲜的海边餐食。

风力发电山：绿色能源与标志性拍照点

富贵风力发电山建于2010年，是越南首个风力-柴油混合发电项目。除了为全岛提供全天候电力的实际意义外，这里也已成为热门的拍照地。

白色的风力涡轮机在深蓝的天空和绿色的草地映衬下格外醒目，构成一幅宁静的田园景象，常有牛群在其间吃草。游客可以在这里野餐，观看涡轮机在海风中优雅旋转。

无边湖(Infinity Lake)：富贵岛的“迷你巴厘岛”

无边湖位于 Bai Nho – Ganh Hang 附近，是一处天然形成的潮池，与海洋地平线无缝相融。四周是嶙峋的岩石，池中盛满清澈的海水，营造出一池无尽之水与大海交汇的错觉。

湖的景色一天之中不断变化，从神秘的黎明光线，到正午的明艳色彩，再到浪漫的日落色调。这里很快成为摄影和放松的热门地点。

Hon Tranh 岛：浮潜天堂

Hon Tranh 是环绕富贵岛的小岛中最大的一座。有高高的悬崖遮蔽，这里的水域全年都格外平静清澈，是浮潜和探索珊瑚的理想目的地。

这里的水下生态系统丰富多彩，让游客有机会沉浸于原始的海洋环境。前往 Hon Tranh 的乘船游览通常包含游泳、野餐和观赏日落。

当地体验与美食

骑摩托车探索富贵岛，让旅行者可以自由穿行于风景优美的海岸公路，发现隐秘的海滩。这座岛屿还以新鲜且价格实惠的海鲜而闻名。

必尝的特色美食包括月亮蟹、帝王蟹、石斑鱼、烤鱿鱼、海参，以及用当地饲养的牛制成的富贵热牛肉菜肴。另一道独特的美味是海藻果冻甜品，以其清爽的口感和健康功效而闻名。

住宿与交通

富贵岛提供多种住宿选择，从经济型招待所到温馨的民宿和小型酒店。价格通常为每晚200,000至500,000越南盾。旅游旺季建议提前预订。

摩托车是最便利的交通工具，租金平均每天100,000至150,000越南盾。也有出租车和摩托车载客服务，但费用较高。

文化与当地生活

富贵岛的人们以友善、淳朴和热情好客而闻名。大多数居民以捕鱼和农业为生。游客会受到热情欢迎，并被鼓励了解当地习俗和日常生活。

鲸鱼祭祀节(Whale Worshiping Festival)等传统节庆以及其他与海洋相关的仪式，反映了岛民与海洋之间深厚的精神联系，为旅行者提供了有意义的文化体验。

推荐3天2夜行程

第1天：抵达、入住，参观富贵灯塔和灵山寺，在 Trieu Duong 湾看日落。

第2天：在 Bai Nho 或 Hon Tranh 浮潜，参观无边湖和风力发电山，品尝当地美食。

第3天：选购当地特产，参观富贵市场，返回潘切。

重要旅行贴士

  • 尽早预订渡轮票和住宿，尤其是在旺季。
  • 请携带防晒霜、泳衣、太阳镜和个人药品。
  • 尊重当地文化和宗教场所。
  • 不乱扔垃圾，保护环境。
  • 小心驾驶，因为岛上的道路可能狭窄陡峭。

富贵岛不仅仅是一个旅游目的地，更是一处宁静的天堂，原始的自然、丰富的文化和地道的海岛生活在这里交汇。如果您在越南寻求宁静而充实的体验，富贵岛是一个不容错过的目的地。

posts.title: Top 5 Best Value Hotels For Travelers In Hoi An
posts.excerpt: Hotels located near Hoi An Ancient Town are always among the top choices for travelers, as staying close to the old quarter helps save travel time and makes sightseeing much more convenient. Understan
posts.contentHtml:
Hotels located near Hoi An Ancient Town are always among the top choices for travelers, as staying close to the old quarter helps save travel time and makes sightseeing much more convenient. Understanding this, Vietlook Travel is pleased to introduce five high-quality, great-value hotels that are truly worth experiencing during your trip to Hoi An. Let’s take a closer look.

In Depth Review Of The Top 5 Best Value Hotels In Hoi An

A memorable trip starts with finding the right place to stay comfortable, well-located, and suitable for your budget. Below are five highly rated hotels that many travelers recommend for an autumn getaway in Hoi An.

1. Anantara Hoi An Resort

Located along the poetic Thu Bon River, Anantara Hoi An Resort is one of the most prestigious five-star hotels near Hoi An Ancient Town. Like other properties in the Anantara collection, the resort beautifully incorporates local charm into its design. Anantara Hoi An is a harmonious blend of French colonial architecture with influences from Dutch, Chinese, and Japanese cultures.

Guests can enjoy complimentary services such as morning yoga classes, a children’s play area, and cooking classes. In addition, visitors can book river cruises along the Thu Bon River or join guided tours to explore Hoi An’s most famous attractions.

Address: 1 Pham Hong Thai Street, Cam Chau Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 3,500,000 VND per room per night

2. Koi Resort & Spa Hoi An

Often described as a green oasis by the peaceful De Vong River, Koi Resort & Spa Hoi An offers a luxurious yet tranquil retreat that perfectly captures the spirit of Hoi An. The rooms are designed in an elegant Asian style, featuring warm brown and golden tones, with views overlooking the river, lush gardens, or the vibrant town.

The resort’s signature koi fish pond is a standout feature, along with unique experiences such as fishing and kayaking on the river, making it an ideal choice for travelers seeking relaxation combined with meaningful activities.

Address: Au Co Street, Cua Dai Beach, Cua Dai Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 18,400,000 VND per room per night

3. Laluna Hoi An Riverside Hotel

Laluna Hoi An Riverside Hotel is widely praised for its stunning riverside location along the Hoai River, complete with a scenic walking path that embraces the waterway. Guests can admire the magical beauty of Hoi An at sunrise or sunset from spacious balconies overlooking the river.

One of Laluna’s greatest advantages is its location only a five-minute walk from the heart of the Ancient Town making it perfect for travelers who want easy access to major attractions while still enjoying a peaceful stay.

Address: 12 Nguyen Du Street, Cam Pho Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 16,500,000 VND per room per night

4. Heron House Hoi An

Heron House Hoi An is a charming accommodation that transports guests back to the peaceful atmosphere of old Hoi An. Featuring traditional architecture with red-tiled roofs, wooden furniture, patterned tiles, bamboo blinds, and rustic details, the property offers a nostalgic and serene experience.

The hotel is surrounded by vast rice fields, creating a refreshing countryside ambiance. Guests can wake up to golden sunlight over the fields and explore nearby rural areas by bicycle, gaining an authentic glimpse into local life.

Address: An My, Cam Chau Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 1,200,000 VND per room per night

5. An Bang Garden Homestay

An Bang Garden Homestay is an excellent option for families or groups of friends. This cozy accommodation boasts a prime location, with one side facing the sea and the other opening into a quiet residential area.

After enjoying breakfast and coffee, guests can borrow bicycles to explore nearby attractions such as Phuc Kien Assembly Hall, Cua Dai Beach, and An Bang Beach. Its relaxed atmosphere and affordable price make it a favorite among budget-conscious travelers.

Address: Nguyen Phan Vinh Street, An Bang Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 730,000 VND per room per night

Final Thoughts

Whether you prefer staying near the Ancient Town or close to the beach, choosing a budget-friendly stay or indulging in luxury, we hope this curated list helps you find the perfect accommodation for your Hoi An journey. These hotels offer excellent value for money, allowing you to fully enjoy the beauty, culture, and charm of Hoi An without exceeding your budget.
posts.titleZh: 会安五家高性价比酒店
posts.excerptZh: 靠近会安古镇的酒店一直是旅行者的首选，因为住在古城区附近既能节省出行时间，也让观光更加方便。Vietlook Travel 为您推荐五家品质优良、性价比极高、真正值得在会安之行中体验的酒店。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
靠近会安古镇的酒店一直是旅行者的首选，因为住在古城区附近既能节省出行时间，也让观光更加方便。了解这一点后，Vietlook Travel 很高兴为您推荐五家品质优良、性价比极高、真正值得在会安之行中体验的酒店。让我们一起来详细了解。

会安五大高性价比酒店深度点评

一次难忘的旅行，始于找到一个舒适、位置优越且适合预算的住处。以下是五家广受好评的酒店，许多旅行者都推荐在会安的秋季度假时入住。

1. Anantara Hoi An Resort

Anantara Hoi An Resort 坐落在如诗如画的秋盆河(Thu Bon)畔，是会安古镇附近最负盛名的五星级酒店之一。与 Anantara 旗下的其他酒店一样，度假村将当地魅力完美融入设计之中。Anantara Hoi An 是法式殖民地建筑与荷兰、中国和日本文化影响的和谐融合。

住客可享受晨间瑜伽课、儿童游乐区和烹饪课等免费服务。此外，游客还可以预订秋盆河游船，或参加导览团游览会安最著名的景点。

地址：会安锦周坊(Cam Chau)范鸿泰街(Pham Hong Thai)1号
参考价格：每间每晚 3,500,000 VND 起

2. Koi Resort & Spa Hoi An

Koi Resort & Spa Hoi An 常被形容为宁静的德旺河(De Vong)畔的一片绿洲，提供奢华而静谧的度假体验，完美捕捉了会安的精神。客房采用雅致的亚洲风格设计，以温暖的棕色和金色为主调，可俯瞰河景、繁茂的花园或热闹的小镇。

度假村标志性的锦鲤池是一大亮点，此外还有河上垂钓和皮划艇等独特体验，非常适合想要在放松的同时进行有意义活动的旅行者。

地址：会安古大坊(Cua Dai)古大海滩(Cua Dai Beach)，Au Co 街
参考价格：每间每晚 18,400,000 VND 起

3. Laluna Hoi An Riverside Hotel

Laluna Hoi An Riverside Hotel 因其位于怀河(Hoai)畔的绝佳河景位置而广受赞誉，还有一条环绕水道的风景步道。住客可以在可俯瞰河面的宽敞阳台上，欣赏会安日出或日落时分的神奇美景。

Laluna 最大的优势之一是位置，距古镇中心仅步行五分钟，非常适合既想方便前往主要景点、又想享受宁静住宿的旅行者。

地址：会安锦浦坊(Cam Pho)阮攸街(Nguyen Du)12号
参考价格：每间每晚 16,500,000 VND 起

4. Heron House Hoi An

Heron House Hoi An 是一家迷人的住宿，让住客仿佛回到旧时会安的宁静氛围。酒店采用传统建筑风格，红瓦屋顶、木质家具、花砖、竹帘和质朴的细节，带来怀旧而静谧的体验。

酒店四周是广阔的稻田，营造出清新的乡村氛围。住客可以在稻田上金色的阳光中醒来，并骑自行车探索附近的乡村地区，真切感受当地生活。

地址：会安锦周坊(Cam Chau)安美(An My)
参考价格：每间每晚 1,200,000 VND 起

5. An Bang Garden Homestay

An Bang Garden Homestay 是家庭或朋友结伴出行的绝佳选择。这家温馨的住宿位置得天独厚，一侧面朝大海，另一侧通向安静的居民区。

享用早餐和咖啡之后，住客可以借用自行车前往附近的景点，如福建会馆(Phuc Kien)、古大海滩和安邦海滩(An Bang)。轻松的氛围和实惠的价格，使其深受预算有限的旅行者喜爱。

地址：会安安邦坊(An Bang)阮潘永街(Nguyen Phan Vinh)
参考价格：每间每晚 730,000 VND 起

写在最后

无论您更喜欢住在古镇附近还是靠近海滩，是选择经济实惠的住宿还是尽享奢华，我们都希望这份精选名单能帮助您为会安之行找到完美的住处。这些酒店物超所值，让您在不超出预算的前提下，充分享受会安的美景、文化与魅力。

posts.title: Discover 20 Must Visit Attractions In Binh Thuan
posts.excerpt: Save this list of 20 famous tourist attractions in Binh Thuan and start planning your journey to explore this stunning coastal destination. These places promise unforgettable experiences and are perfe
posts.contentHtml:
Save this list of 20 famous tourist attractions in Binh Thuan and start planning your journey to explore this stunning coastal destination. These places promise unforgettable experiences and are perfect for travelers who love nature, culture, and adventure.

Located in Vietnam’s South Central Coast region, Binh Thuan is a true paradise for travel enthusiasts. The province captivates visitors with its turquoise seas, white sand beaches, golden sunshine, and unique cultural landmarks. So, what makes a Binh Thuan tour so special? Let’s explore the top attractions below with Vietlook Travel.

Top 20 Stunning Tourist Attractions In Binh Thuan

Binh Thuan is not only famous for its breathtaking landscapes but also for producing Vietnam’s iconic fish sauce. The following 20 destinations will surely enrich your upcoming journey with memorable experiences.

1. Phu Quy Island

Recently rising as a travel hotspot, Phu Quy Island attracts visitors with its untouched beauty. Located in the middle of the East Sea, the island features dramatic coastal scenery and resembles a dragon resting on the waves when viewed from afar. It is an ideal destination for travelers seeking tranquility, romance, and a deep connection with nature.

Location: Approximately 56 nautical miles from Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

2. Cu Lao Cau Island

Cu Lao Cau is a remote and relatively undiscovered island, about 1.5 hours by boat from the mainland. Due to limited tourism development, the island retains its pristine and unspoiled charm. Crystal-clear waters and peaceful surroundings make it one of the most beautiful hidden gems in Binh Thuan.

Location: Phuoc The Commune, Tuy Phong District, Binh Thuan Province

3. Ta Cu Mountain

One of Binh Thuan’s most famous attractions, Ta Cu Mountain boasts majestic natural scenery. From the summit, visitors can enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding landscape and breathe in fresh mountain air. A clear stream flowing across the mountain keeps the climate cool year-round, making it a great destination at any time.

Location: Thuan Nam Town, Ham Thuan Nam District, Binh Thuan Province

4. Co Thach Beach

Co Thach Beach is well known for its emerald waters, gentle waves, and colorful rock formations. In March, the rocks are covered with green moss, creating a spectacular natural scene that attracts photographers and nature lovers alike.

Location: Binh Thanh Commune, Tuy Phong District, Binh Thuan Province

5. Ke Ga Cape

Also known as Khe Ga Cape, this coastal landmark extends into the East Sea and lies about 500 meters from the mainland. During low tide, a sandy path appears, connecting the shore to the cape—an impressive natural phenomenon.

Location: Tan Thanh Commune, Ham Thuan Nam District, Binh Thuan Province

6. Red Sand Dunes

Located about 25 kilometers from Phan Thiet City, the Red Sand Dunes are famous for their golden-red hue and constantly shifting shapes. This ever-changing landscape makes it one of the most photographed attractions in Binh Thuan.

Location: Hon Rom Area, Mui Ne, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

7. Bien Lac Lake

Bien Lac Lake is an ideal picnic and eco-tourism destination surrounded by primeval forests and rubber plantations. Visitors can enjoy boating, fishing, and grilling fresh catches while immersing themselves in the area’s rich biodiversity.

Location: Tanh Linh District and part of Duc Linh District, Binh Thuan Province

8. Ong Dia Rock Beach

Known for its clear water and large rock formations extending into the sea, Ong Dia Rock Beach holds both scenic and cultural significance for local residents. It is a popular stop for sightseeing and photography.

Location: Nguyen Dinh Chieu Street, Phu Hai Ward, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

9. Mui Ne Fishing Village

Mui Ne Fishing Village offers a vibrant glimpse into local life. Early mornings are especially lively, with fishermen trading fresh seafood such as crabs and squid. It is a great place to experience authentic coastal culture.

Location: 321 Huynh Thuc Khang Street, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

10. Po Sah Inu Cham Towers

Also known as Pho Hai Cham Towers, this ancient complex showcases the distinctive architecture of the Cham civilization. It is a culturally significant site and a popular attraction for history lovers.

Location: Phu Hai Ward, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

11. Cam Binh Beach

Nestled beneath rows of casuarina trees, Cam Binh Beach offers a breezy, relaxing atmosphere ideal for outdoor activities and seaside relaxation.

Location: Cam Binh Hamlet, Tan Phuoc Commune, La Gi Town, Binh Thuan Province

12. Rang Beach

Rang Beach is renowned for its picturesque coastline, fishing boats, and peaceful ambiance. Walking along the shore while listening to gentle waves is a uniquely soothing experience.

Location: 15 Huynh Thuc Khang Street, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

13. Sand Sculpture Park

This large-scale Sand Sculpture Park features impressive artworks and is a favorite destination for both families and young travelers.

Location: Nguyen Thong Street, Phu Hai Ward, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

14. Hang Pagoda (Co Thach Pagoda)

With over 100 years of history, Hang Pagoda is an important spiritual and cultural site, often described as a living museum of Binh Thuan’s heritage.

Location: Binh Thanh Commune, Tuy Phong District, Binh Thuan Province

15. Ham Thuan Lake

A large hydropower reservoir, Ham Thuan Lake charms visitors with its peaceful, untouched scenery. Boating and photography are popular activities here.

Location: Da Mi Commune, Ham Thuan Bac District, Binh Thuan Province

16. Hon Rom

Though not an island, Hon Rom is a small mountain extending into the sea, known for its tranquil beauty and water sports such as swimming, paragliding, and water slides.

Location: Long Son Hamlet, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

17. Fairy Stream (Suoi Tien)

Fairy Stream is a shallow stream flowing behind red sand dunes for about one kilometer before reaching the sea. Its cool water and poetic scenery make it a must-visit attraction.

Location: Ham Tien Ward, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

18. Hon Ba Island

Covering approximately 2.8 hectares, Hon Ba Island resembles a giant turtle emerging from the sea. Its unique shape and surrounding sandbanks create a striking natural scene.

Location: Ham Tan District, Binh Thuan Province

19. Thay Thim Temple

Thay Thim Temple is a spiritual destination known for its distinctive architecture and cultural importance. Many visitors come here to worship and admire its tranquil surroundings.

Location: Tan Tien Commune, La Gi Town, Binh Thuan Province

20. Ke Ga Lighthouse

The Ke Ga Lighthouse is the tallest and oldest lighthouse in Vietnam. Featuring spiral staircases and historic architecture, it is one of Binh Thuan’s most iconic landmarks.

Location: Ke Ga Cape, Ham Thuan Nam District, Binh Thuan Province

Final Thoughts

Above is a complete guide to 20 must-visit attractions in Binh Thuan that no traveler should miss. Whether you love beaches, islands, mountains, or cultural landmarks, Binh Thuan offers something truly special for every journey.
posts.excerptZh: 收藏这份平顺20个著名旅游景点清单，开始规划您探索这个迷人海滨目的地的旅程吧。这些地方承诺带来难忘的体验，非常适合热爱自然、文化和冒险的旅行者。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
收藏这份 平顺 20个著名旅游景点清单，开始规划您探索这个迷人海滨目的地的旅程吧。这些地方承诺带来难忘的体验，非常适合热爱自然、文化和冒险的旅行者。

平顺位于越南中南部沿海地区，是旅游爱好者真正的天堂。该省以碧蓝的大海、白色的沙滩、金色的阳光和独特的文化地标吸引着游客。那么，平顺之旅特别在哪里？让我们跟随 Vietlook Travel 一起探索以下顶级景点。

平顺20大迷人旅游景点

平顺不仅以令人惊叹的风景而闻名，还出产越南标志性的鱼露。以下20个目的地必将为您即将到来的旅程增添难忘的体验。

1. 富贵岛（Phu Quy）

富贵岛近来成为旅游热点，以其原始的美景吸引着游客。该岛位于东海中央，拥有壮观的海岸风光，从远处看就像一条卧在波浪上的巨龙。对于追求宁静、浪漫以及与自然深度联结的旅行者来说，这里是理想的目的地。

位置：距平顺省潘切市（Phan Thiet）约56海里

2. Cu Lao Cau 岛

Cu Lao Cau 是一座偏远且相对鲜为人知的岛屿，距大陆乘船约1.5小时。由于旅游开发有限，该岛保持着原始纯净的魅力。清澈见底的海水和宁静的环境，使其成为平顺最美丽的隐藏瑰宝之一。

位置：平顺省绥丰县（Tuy Phong）Phuoc The 乡

3. Ta Cu 山

作为平顺最著名的景点之一，Ta Cu 山拥有雄伟的自然风光。从山顶，游客可以欣赏周围景色的全景，呼吸清新的山间空气。一条清澈的溪流穿过山间，使这里全年气候凉爽，任何时候都是绝佳的目的地。

位置：平顺省咸顺南县（Ham Thuan Nam）Thuan Nam 镇

4. Co Thach 海滩

Co Thach 海滩以其翠绿的海水、轻柔的海浪和色彩斑斓的岩石而闻名。3月时，岩石上覆盖着绿色的苔藓，形成壮观的自然景象，吸引着摄影师和自然爱好者。

位置：平顺省绥丰县 Binh Thanh 乡

5. Ke Ga 岬角

又称 Khe Ga 岬角，这处海岸地标延伸入东海，距大陆约500米。退潮时，会出现一条沙路连接海岸与岬角——这是一种令人印象深刻的自然现象。

位置：平顺省咸顺南县 Tan Thanh 乡

6. 红沙丘

红沙丘距潘切市约25公里，以金红色的色调和不断变化的形状而闻名。这种瞬息万变的景观使其成为平顺被拍摄次数最多的景点之一。

位置：平顺省潘切市美奈（Mui Ne）Hon Rom 区

7. Bien Lac 湖

Bien Lac 湖是理想的野餐和生态旅游目的地，周围环绕着原始森林和橡胶园。游客可以划船、钓鱼、烧烤新鲜捕获的鱼，同时沉浸在该地区丰富的生物多样性之中。

位置：平顺省 Tanh Linh 县及部分 Duc Linh 县

8. Ong Dia 岩石海滩

Ong Dia 岩石海滩以清澈的海水和延伸入海的大块岩石而闻名，对当地居民而言兼具风景与文化意义。它是观光和摄影的热门一站。

位置：平顺省潘切市 Phu Hai 坊 Nguyen Dinh Chieu 街

9. 美奈渔村

美奈渔村让您得以领略当地生活的活力。清晨尤为热闹，渔民们在此交易螃蟹、鱿鱼等新鲜海产。这里是体验地道海滨文化的好地方。

位置：平顺省潘切市 Huynh Thuc Khang 街321号

10. Po Sah Inu 占婆塔

又称 Pho Hai 占婆塔，这座古建筑群展示了占婆文明独特的建筑风格。它是具有重要文化意义的遗址，也是历史爱好者的热门景点。

位置：平顺省潘切市 Phu Hai 坊

11. Cam Binh 海滩

Cam Binh 海滩坐落在一排排木麻黄树下，海风习习，氛围轻松，非常适合户外活动和海边放松。

位置：平顺省 La Gi 镇 Tan Phuoc 乡 Cam Binh 村

12. Rang 海滩

Rang 海滩以风景如画的海岸线、渔船和宁静的氛围而闻名。沿着海岸漫步，聆听轻柔的海浪声，是一种独特而舒缓的体验。

位置：平顺省潘切市 Huynh Thuc Khang 街15号

13. 沙雕公园

这座大型沙雕公园拥有令人印象深刻的艺术作品，是家庭和年轻旅行者都喜爱的目的地。

位置：平顺省潘切市 Phu Hai 坊 Nguyen Thong 街

14. 洞寺（Co Thach 寺）

洞寺（Hang Pagoda）已有100多年历史，是重要的精神与文化场所，常被形容为平顺遗产的活博物馆。

位置：平顺省绥丰县 Binh Thanh 乡

15. 咸顺湖（Ham Thuan）

咸顺湖是一座大型水电水库，以其宁静、未经雕琢的风景令游客着迷。划船和摄影是这里的热门活动。

位置：平顺省咸顺北县 Da Mi 乡

16. Hon Rom

虽然不是岛屿，Hon Rom 是一座延伸入海的小山，以宁静的美景和游泳、滑翔伞、滑水道等水上运动而闻名。

位置：平顺省潘切市 Long Son 村

17. 仙女溪（Suoi Tien）

仙女溪是一条浅溪，在红沙丘后方流淌约一公里后入海。清凉的溪水和诗意的风景使其成为必游景点。

位置：平顺省潘切市 Ham Tien 坊

18. Hon Ba 岛

Hon Ba 岛面积约2.8公顷，形似一只从海中浮出的巨龟。其独特的形状和周围的沙洲构成了引人注目的自然景象。

位置：平顺省咸新县（Ham Tan）

19. Thay Thim 庙

Thay Thim 庙是一处精神朝圣地，以独特的建筑和文化重要性而闻名。许多游客来此参拜并欣赏其宁静的环境。

位置：平顺省 La Gi 镇 Tan Tien 乡

20. Ke Ga 灯塔

Ke Ga 灯塔是越南最高、最古老的灯塔。它拥有螺旋楼梯和历史建筑，是平顺最具标志性的地标之一。

位置：平顺省咸顺南县 Ke Ga 岬角

结语

以上是平顺20个任何旅行者都不容错过的必游景点完整指南。无论您喜爱海滩、海岛、山脉还是文化地标，平顺都能为每一次旅程带来真正特别的体验。

posts.contentHtml:
Hoi An, the ancient town nestled along the poetic Hoai River, is an ideal destination for a self-guided trip in 2026. This comprehensive guide covers the best time to visit, transportation options, local cuisine, and essential travel tips to help you enjoy a complete and memorable journey through this charming heritage town.

Hoi An is a historic town in central Vietnam that captivates millions of visitors every year. Famous for its lantern-lit streets, well-preserved architecture, and rich cultural heritage, Hoi An offers far more than just beautiful scenery. Hidden behind its ancient facades are centuries of history, vibrant traditions, and a unique lifestyle shaped by its past as a bustling trading port.

If you are planning a self-guided trip to Hoi An, this detailed guide will help you explore every corner of the town from its timeless old streets and nearby beaches to lively entertainment areas ensuring a truly unforgettable experience.

The Best Time To Visit Hoi An In 2026

Choosing the right time to visit plays a crucial role in making your Hoi An trip enjoyable. The town has two distinct seasons, each offering its own unique charm.

Rainy Season (September To January)

During this period, Hoi An experiences frequent rainfall, sometimes heavy and prolonged. From October to December, flooding may occur, transforming the ancient town into a rare and fascinating sight where locals travel by boat through submerged streets.

Although less convenient, this season offers a quiet, romantic atmosphere. With fewer tourists, you can enjoy a more peaceful Hoi An, savor hot local dishes in cooler weather, and capture dreamy photos of lantern-lit streets reflected in rain-soaked roads. The rain adds a mysterious and poetic beauty that many travelers find unforgettable.

Dry Season (February To August)

This is considered the best time to visit Hoi An. From February to April, the weather is mild, sunny, and pleasant perfect for walking tours, sightseeing, and photography. Temperatures are comfortable, making outdoor activities more enjoyable.

From May to August, the weather becomes hotter, especially during the day, but the evenings are ideal for strolling through the old town. This period is also perfect for visiting nearby beaches such as An Bang Beach and Cua Dai Beach, where you can enjoy clear water and golden sunshine.

Lantern Festival Experience

One of the most magical experiences in Hoi An takes place on the 14th day of the lunar month. On these nights, electric lights are turned off throughout the Old Town, replaced by thousands of colorful lanterns. Visitors can release lanterns on the Hoai River, join traditional performances, and immerse themselves in a truly enchanting atmosphere. Booking accommodation and flights early is highly recommended during these peak times.

Transportation Options In Hoi An

Hoi An offers a variety of transportation choices to suit different travel styles and budgets.

Motorbike

Motorbikes are the most popular and flexible option. You can rent one in Hoi An or Da Nang for approximately 100,000–150,000 VND per day. This allows easy access to attractions outside the Old Town such as Tra Que Vegetable Village, Thanh Ha Pottery Village, and Cua Dai Beach.

Bicycle And Cyclo

Cycling is one of the best ways to experience the charm of Hoi An. Bicycle rental costs around 30,000–50,000 VND per day, allowing you to leisurely explore narrow streets and quiet corners.

Cyclo rides offer a more traditional experience, often accompanied by local drivers who share stories about the town. Prices typically range from 150,000–200,000 VND per hour.

Taxi And Private Car

For families or groups, taxis and private cars provide comfort and convenience. Major taxi companies operate in Hoi An, and private car rentals are ideal for trips between Hoi An and Da Nang or further destinations.

Boat Ride On The Hoai River

An evening boat ride along the Hoai River is a signature Hoi An experience. Prices range from 100,000–200,000 VND for a 20–30 minute ride, offering a romantic view of lantern reflections on the water.

Traveling To Cham Islands

To reach Cham Islands, travel to Cua Dai Pier and take either a speedboat or wooden boat. Speedboats take 15–20 minutes, while wooden boats are slower but more economical. Many travelers choose organized tours for convenience.

Essential Tips For A Perfect Self-Guided Trip

Best Time Of Day To Explore

Hoi An is most beautiful early in the morning and from late afternoon to evening. Morning light creates a peaceful atmosphere, while evenings bring lantern-lit magic. Avoid midday heat, especially in summer.

Experience The Full Moon Festival

If possible, plan your visit around the lunar full moon to enjoy cultural performances, lantern ceremonies, and a fairy-tale ambiance.

Try Traditional Activities

Do not miss traditional games, lantern-making workshops, cooking classes, and especially Bai Choi, a UNESCO-recognized folk art performance.

Discover Local Cuisine

Hoi An is a culinary paradise. Must-try dishes include Cao Lau, Mi Quang, Hoi An banh mi, white rose dumplings, and fried wontons. Street food and night markets offer authentic flavors at affordable prices.

Dress Appropriately

Wear respectful clothing when visiting temples and historical sites. Comfortable shoes are essential for walking tours, and sun protection is recommended during dry months.

Learn About Local History

Understanding Hoi An’s history as a former trading port enriches your experience. Visit small museums and heritage houses to gain deeper insight into the town’s cultural significance.

Shopping And Souvenirs

Hoi An is famous for lanterns, silk products, and handcrafted items perfect souvenirs for friends and family.

Explore Traditional Villages

Visit Tra Que Vegetable Village, Thanh Ha Pottery Village, and Kim Bong Carpentry Village to experience local craftsmanship and rural life.

Budget Planning

Hoi An is budget-friendly. Accommodation ranges from affordable homestays to luxury resorts. A 3-day, 2-night trip typically costs 2,000,000–4,000,000 VND (excluding flights), depending on travel style.

Safety And Health

Carry personal medications, insect repellent, and stay hydrated. Always follow traffic rules when riding motorbikes.

Respect Local Culture

Hoi An is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Respect local customs, dress modestly, and behave responsibly at cultural sites.

Final Thoughts

With this detailed self-guided travel guide to Hoi An, we hope you are well-prepared for an unforgettable journey through one of Vietnam’s most charming heritage destinations. Start planning today and immerse yourself in the timeless beauty, rich culture, and warm hospitality of Hoi An.

For travelers seeking a broader experience, combining Da Nang and Hoi An into one itinerary is an excellent choice, offering both vibrant city life and historic charm.

posts.contentHtmlZh:
会安是坐落在诗意的怀河（Hoai）畔的古镇，是2026年自助旅行的理想目的地。这份全面的指南涵盖最佳游览时间、交通方式、当地美食和必备旅行贴士，帮助您在这座迷人的遗产小镇享受一次完整而难忘的旅程。

会安 是越南中部的一座历史古镇，每年吸引数百万游客。以灯笼点亮的街道、保存完好的建筑和丰富的文化遗产而闻名，会安所能提供的远不止美丽的风景。在古老的立面背后，隐藏着数百年的历史、充满活力的传统，以及由其作为繁忙贸易港口的过往所塑造的独特生活方式。

如果您正在计划会安自助游，这份详细的指南将帮助您探索小镇的每一个角落，从永恒的老街、附近的海滩到热闹的娱乐区，确保一次真正难忘的体验。

2026年游览会安的最佳时间

选择合适的游览时间对于让您的会安之旅愉快至关重要。小镇有两个截然不同的季节，各自拥有独特的魅力。

雨季（9月至1月）

在此期间，会安经常下雨，有时雨势很大且持续时间长。10月至12月可能发生洪水，使古镇变成罕见而迷人的景象，当地人乘船穿行于被淹没的街道。

虽然不太方便，但这个季节带来宁静浪漫的氛围。游客较少，您可以享受更宁静的会安，在较凉爽的天气里品尝热腾腾的当地菜肴，并拍下灯笼点亮的街道倒映在雨后湿路上的梦幻照片。雨水增添了神秘而诗意的美，许多旅行者都觉得难以忘怀。

旱季（2月至8月）

这被认为是游览会安的最佳时间。2月至4月，天气温和、晴朗而宜人，非常适合徒步游览、观光和摄影。气温舒适，使户外活动更加愉快。

5月至8月，天气变得更热，尤其是白天，但傍晚是漫步古镇的理想时间。这段时期也非常适合前往附近的海滩，如安邦海滩（An Bang）和古代海滩（Cua Dai），在那里您可以享受清澈的海水和金色的阳光。

灯笼节体验

会安最神奇的体验之一发生在农历每月十四日。在这些夜晚，整个古城的电灯都会熄灭，取而代之的是成千上万盏五彩缤纷的灯笼。游客可以在怀河上放灯，参加传统表演，并沉浸在真正迷人的氛围中。在这些高峰时段，强烈建议提前预订住宿和机票。

会安的交通方式

会安提供多种交通选择，以适应不同的旅行风格和预算。

摩托车

摩托车是最受欢迎且最灵活的选择。您可以在会安或岘港租一辆，每天约100,000–150,000 VND。这让您可以轻松前往古城之外的景点，如茶桂蔬菜村（Tra Que）、青河陶器村（Thanh Ha）和古代海滩（Cua Dai）。

自行车和三轮车

骑自行车是体验会安魅力的最佳方式之一。自行车租金约每天30,000–50,000 VND，让您可以悠闲地探索狭窄的街巷和宁静的角落。

三轮车（Cyclo）提供更传统的体验，通常有当地车夫陪同，讲述小镇的故事。价格通常为每小时150,000–200,000 VND。

出租车和私家车

对于家庭或团体，出租车和私家车提供舒适和便利。会安有主要的出租车公司运营，租用私家车非常适合会安与岘港之间或更远目的地之间的行程。

怀河乘船游览

傍晚沿怀河乘船游览是会安的标志性体验。20–30分钟的行程价格为100,000–200,000 VND，可欣赏灯笼倒映在水面上的浪漫景色。

前往占婆岛（Cham）

前往占婆岛，需前往古代码头（Cua Dai），乘坐快艇或木船。快艇需15–20分钟，而木船较慢但更经济。许多旅行者为了方便选择有组织的旅游团。

完美自助游的必备贴士

最佳探索时间

会安在清晨以及傍晚到夜晚最美。晨光营造宁静的氛围，而夜晚则带来灯笼点亮的魔力。请避开正午的炎热，尤其是在夏季。

体验满月节

如果可能，请围绕农历满月安排您的行程，以欣赏文化表演、灯笼仪式和童话般的氛围。

尝试传统活动

不要错过传统游戏、制作灯笼工作坊、烹饪课，尤其是联合国教科文组织认可的民间艺术表演——牌戏（Bai Choi）。

探索当地美食

会安是美食天堂。必尝菜肴包括高楼面（Cao Lau）、广南面（Mi Quang）、会安法棍（banh mi）、白玫瑰饺子和炸馄饨。街头美食和夜市以实惠的价格提供原汁原味的风味。

着装得体

参观寺庙和历史遗迹时请穿着得体的服装。徒步游览必须穿舒适的鞋子，旱季建议做好防晒。

了解当地历史

了解会安作为昔日贸易港口的历史将丰富您的体验。参观小型博物馆和古宅，以更深入地了解小镇的文化意义。

购物和纪念品

会安以灯笼、丝绸产品和手工制品而闻名，是送给亲友的绝佳纪念品。

探索传统村庄

参观茶桂蔬菜村、青河陶器村和金榜（Kim Bong）木雕村，体验当地的手工技艺和乡村生活。

预算规划

会安对预算友好。住宿从经济实惠的民宿到豪华度假村不等。3天2夜的行程通常花费2,000,000–4,000,000 VND（不含机票），视旅行风格而定。

安全与健康

请携带个人药品、驱虫剂，并注意补水。骑摩托车时请始终遵守交通规则。

尊重当地文化

会安是联合国教科文组织世界遗产地。请尊重当地习俗，着装端庄，并在文化场所举止负责。

结语

有了这份详细的会安自助旅行指南，我们希望您为一次穿越越南最迷人遗产目的地之一的难忘旅程做好了充分准备。今天就开始规划，沉浸在会安永恒的美、丰富的文化和热情的款待之中。

对于寻求更广泛体验的旅行者，将岘港和会安合并为一个行程是绝佳的选择，既能体验活力四射的城市生活，又能感受历史的魅力。

posts.contentHtml:
Bay Mau Coconut Forest, a green gem nestled in the heart of Hoi An, is a must-visit destination renowned for its unspoiled natural beauty and unique river-based cultural experiences. This article provides detailed and up-to-date information on basket boat ticket prices for 2026, highlights exciting activities, and shares essential travel tips to help you enjoy a truly memorable visit.

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is a lush green oasis hidden within the tranquil countryside of Hoi An. With endless rows of water coconut palms stretching along winding waterways, this destination offers visitors a peaceful escape and an authentic glimpse into traditional rural life in Central Vietnam. Drifting gently along narrow canals in a traditional basket boat while immersing yourself in the cool, green surroundings is an experience not to be missed. So, how much does a basket boat ride cost in 2026, and what should you know to make the most of your trip? Let us explore Bay Mau Coconut Forest in detail.

Where Is Bay Mau Coconut Forest And How To Get There?

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is located in Cam Thanh Commune, Hoi An City, Quang Nam Province, approximately 3–5 kilometers southeast of Hoi An Ancient Town. Its convenient location makes it easy to combine a visit to the historic town with an eco-cultural experience in nature.

The name “Bay Mau,” meaning “Seven Acres,” originates from the forest’s original size of around 70,000 square meters. Over time, thanks to alluvial deposits, the forest has expanded significantly and is now one of the largest and most beautiful water coconut forests in Central Vietnam.

Popular Transportation Options

Visitors can reach Bay Mau Coconut Forest from Hoi An by several means, each offering a different experience:

  • Motorbike: A popular and budget-friendly option, especially among younger travelers. The journey takes about 10–15 minutes and passes scenic rice fields and peaceful villages.

  • Bicycle: Ideal for those who enjoy slow travel and fresh air. The flat and safe route allows you to fully appreciate the rural landscape.

  • Taxi or Grab: Convenient and comfortable for families or groups, with fares ranging from approximately 70,000 to 100,000 VND depending on distance.

  • Tour Bus or Package Tour: Many travel agencies offer half-day or full-day tours that include transportation, entrance fees, and guided activities, allowing for a stress-free experience.

No matter which option you choose, the journey itself is part of the charm, offering a peaceful introduction to the countryside of Hoi An.

Updated Entrance Fees And Basket Boat Ticket Prices 2026

Understanding ticket prices in advance helps you plan your budget more effectively. Below is the latest information on entrance fees and basket boat rental prices for 2026:

Entrance Fee

  • 30,000 VND per person

  • This fee covers entry to the tourist area only and does not include basket boat rides or additional activities.

Basket Boat Ride Price

  • 150,000 VND per basket boat

  • Each basket boat typically accommodates up to two adults

  • The price includes a local boat operator and life jackets

  • Ride duration is approximately 45–60 minutes

Additional Services And Tour Packages

  • Group tours often include entrance tickets, basket boat rides, local meals, and cultural activities at a more competitive price.

  • Larger basket boats for groups of four are available for around 300,000 VND per boat.

  • Prices may vary slightly during peak seasons, holidays, or depending on service providers. Always confirm prices before using services.

Unmissable Experiences At Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Bay Mau Coconut Forest offers much more than scenic views. It is a place where visitors can actively engage in local culture and river-based traditions.

1. Basket Boat Ride Through The Coconut Forest

Glide through winding canals beneath dense coconut palm canopies while local boatmen skillfully navigate the waterways. The cool air, gentle water sounds, and vibrant greenery create a relaxing and immersive experience. You may also spot fish, crabs, and other aquatic life beneath the palms.

2. Watch Traditional Basket Boat Spinning Performances

One of the most exciting highlights is the basket boat spinning show. Local performers demonstrate impressive techniques, spinning and balancing the boats with remarkable skill, creating splashes and cheers from the crowd.

3. Learn Traditional Fishing Techniques

Visitors can try casting fishing nets or catching crabs by hand under the guidance of experienced fishermen. These hands-on activities offer insight into the daily livelihoods of the local community.

4. Make Handicrafts From Coconut Leaves

Participate in a creative workshop where you can learn to make souvenirs such as rings, hats, toys, or small animals from fresh coconut leaves a meaningful keepsake from your visit.

5. Enjoy Local Cuisine

After exploring, enjoy regional specialties such as grilled seafood, banh xeo (Vietnamese savory pancakes), nem lui (lemongrass skewers), and fresh coconut-based desserts at riverside restaurants.

6. Capture Stunning Photos

With its emerald-green scenery, colorful basket boats, and golden sunlight, Bay Mau Coconut Forest is a paradise for photography lovers. Early morning and late afternoon offer the best lighting.

Best Time To Visit Bay Mau Coconut Forest

  • Dry Season (February to August): Ideal weather with minimal rain and clear skies. March to May offers particularly pleasant temperatures.

  • Flood Season (September to November): The forest becomes lush and vibrant, and higher water levels allow deeper exploration, though weather conditions should be monitored.

  • Best Time Of Day: Early morning or late afternoon to avoid strong sunlight and enjoy cooler temperatures.

What To Prepare Before Visiting

  • Sunscreen, hat, sunglasses

  • Light, breathable clothing

  • Comfortable footwear or sandals

  • Camera or smartphone (waterproof bag recommended)

  • Cash for small expenses

  • Personal medications if needed

  • Drinking water and light snacks

Cultural And Historical Significance

Beyond its natural beauty, Bay Mau Coconut Forest holds deep historical value. During the Vietnam War, it served as an important revolutionary base thanks to its dense vegetation and complex waterways. Today, it stands as a symbol of resilience and harmony between people and nature.

Friendly local boat operators are often happy to share stories about the forest’s history and traditions, enriching your visit with meaningful cultural insights.

Important Notes For Visitors

  • Protect the environment and avoid littering

  • Always wear a life jacket during boat rides

  • Politely negotiate prices when traveling independently

  • Respect local customs and traditions

  • Book services in advance during peak seasons

  • Use waterproof bags to protect valuables

Conclusion

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is more than just a tourist attraction it is a unique eco-cultural experience where visitors can reconnect with nature and discover the charm of river life in Central Vietnam. With updated information on basket boat ticket prices for 2026 and practical travel tips, we hope this guide helps you plan a smooth and unforgettable journey to this remarkable destination.

posts.contentHtmlZh:
七亩椰林（Bay Mau）是隐匿在会安中心地带的一颗绿色宝石，以其未被破坏的自然美景和独特的河上文化体验而闻名，是必游之地。本文提供2026年最新详细的竹篮船票价信息，介绍精彩活动，并分享实用旅行贴士，帮助您享受一次难忘的游览。

七亩椰林是隐藏在会安宁静乡村中的一片郁郁葱葱的绿洲。一排排无尽的水椰沿着蜿蜒的水道延伸，为游客提供一处宁静的避世之所，让人领略越南中部传统乡村生活的真实一面。乘坐传统竹篮船在狭窄的水道中轻轻漂流，沉浸在清凉的绿色环境中，是不容错过的体验。那么，2026年乘坐竹篮船要花多少钱？要充分享受这趟旅程，您还应该了解什么？让我们来详细探索七亩椰林。

七亩椰林在哪里？如何前往？

七亩椰林位于广南省会安市Cam Thanh社，距会安古镇东南方向约3–5公里。便利的位置让您可以轻松地将参观古镇与融入自然的生态文化体验结合起来。

“Bay Mau”意为“七亩”，名称源自椰林最初约70,000平方米的面积。随着时间推移，由于冲积物的沉积，椰林大幅扩展，如今已成为越南中部最大、最美的水椰林之一。

常见交通方式

游客可以通过多种方式从会安前往七亩椰林，每种方式都有不同的体验：

  • 摩托车：热门且经济实惠的选择，尤其受年轻旅行者欢迎。行程约需10–15分钟，沿途经过风景如画的稻田和宁静的村庄。

  • 自行车：适合喜欢慢旅行和呼吸新鲜空气的人。平坦安全的路线让您可以充分欣赏乡村风光。

  • 出租车或Grab：对家庭或团体来说方便舒适，费用约为70,000至100,000越南盾，视距离而定。

  • 旅游巴士或套餐游：许多旅行社提供半日游或全日游，包含交通、门票和导览活动，让您轻松无忧。

无论您选择哪种方式，旅途本身就是魅力的一部分，为您带来会安乡村的宁静开篇。

2026年最新门票和竹篮船票价

提前了解票价有助于您更有效地规划预算。以下是2026年门票和竹篮船租赁价格的最新信息：

门票

  • 每人30,000越南盾

  • 此费用仅包含进入景区，不包括竹篮船游览或其他额外活动。

竹篮船游览价格

  • 每条竹篮船150,000越南盾

  • 每条竹篮船通常最多可乘坐两名成人

  • 价格包含当地船夫和救生衣

  • 游览时长约45–60分钟

附加服务和套餐游

  • 团体游通常包含门票、竹篮船游览、当地餐食和文化活动，价格更具竞争力。

  • 四人团体可选用较大的竹篮船，每条船约300,000越南盾。

  • 旺季、节假日期间或视服务提供商不同，价格可能略有浮动。使用服务前请务必确认价格。

七亩椰林不容错过的体验

七亩椰林提供的远不止优美的风景。在这里，游客可以积极参与当地文化和河上传统。

1. 乘竹篮船穿越椰林

在茂密的椰树树冠下，沿着蜿蜒的水道滑行，当地船夫熟练地驾驭着水路。清凉的空气、轻柔的水声和生机勃勃的绿意带来放松而沉浸的体验。您还可能在椰树下看到鱼、螃蟹和其他水生动物。

2. 观看传统竹篮船旋转表演

最激动人心的亮点之一是竹篮船旋转表演。当地表演者展示令人惊叹的技巧，凭借高超的技艺旋转并保持船的平衡，溅起水花，引来人群欢呼。

3. 学习传统捕鱼技巧

在经验丰富的渔民指导下，游客可以尝试撒网捕鱼或徒手抓螃蟹。这些亲身参与的活动让人深入了解当地社区的日常生计。

4. 用椰叶制作手工艺品

参加创意工坊，学习用新鲜椰叶制作戒指、帽子、玩具或小动物等纪念品，这是此行一份有意义的纪念。

5. 品尝当地美食

游览之后，在河畔餐厅享用地方特色，如烤海鲜、越南煎饼（banh xeo）、香茅烤肉串（nem lui）和新鲜椰子甜点。

6. 拍摄绝美照片

凭借翠绿的景色、色彩缤纷的竹篮船和金色的阳光，七亩椰林是摄影爱好者的天堂。清晨和傍晚的光线最佳。

七亩椰林最佳游览时间

  • 旱季（2月至8月）：天气理想，降雨极少，天空晴朗。3月至5月的气温尤其宜人。

  • 洪水季（9月至11月）：椰林郁郁葱葱、生机盎然，水位较高，可以更深入地探索，不过应留意天气状况。

  • 最佳时段：清晨或傍晚，避开强烈阳光，享受凉爽的气温。

游览前需要准备什么

  • 防晒霜、帽子、太阳镜

  • 轻便透气的衣物

  • 舒适的鞋子或凉鞋

  • 相机或智能手机（建议配防水袋）

  • 少量现金用于小额开销

  • 如有需要，携带个人药品

  • 饮用水和轻食

文化与历史意义

除了自然之美，七亩椰林还具有深厚的历史价值。越南战争期间，凭借茂密的植被和复杂的水道，这里曾是重要的革命根据地。如今，它是坚韧不拔以及人与自然和谐共处的象征。

友善的当地船夫通常乐于分享椰林的历史和传统故事，用有意义的文化见解丰富您的游览。

游客须知

  • 保护环境，不要乱扔垃圾

  • 乘船时请务必穿好救生衣

  • 自助出行时请礼貌地议价

  • 尊重当地习俗和传统

  • 旺季请提前预订服务

  • 使用防水袋保护贵重物品

结语

七亩椰林不仅仅是一处旅游景点，更是一种独特的生态文化体验，让游客与自然重新连接，发现越南中部河上生活的魅力。凭借2026年最新的竹篮船票价信息和实用的旅行贴士，我们希望这份指南能帮助您规划一次顺利而难忘的旅程，前往这一非凡的目的地。

posts.title: Bay Mau Coconut Forest, Hoi An – A Complete Travel Review
posts.excerpt: Bay Mau Coconut Forest, located just a few kilometers from Hoi An Ancient Town, is one of the most distinctive eco-tourism destinations in Central Vietnam. Famous for its lush water coconut palms, pea
posts.contentHtml:
Bay Mau Coconut Forest, located just a few kilometers from Hoi An Ancient Town, is one of the most distinctive eco-tourism destinations in Central Vietnam. Famous for its lush water coconut palms, peaceful waterways, and vibrant local culture, this area offers visitors a chance to experience the authentic river-life lifestyle of rural Vietnam.

From riding traditional basket boats and watching exciting boat-spinning performances to learning coconut-leaf handicrafts and enjoying local cuisine, Bay Mau Coconut Forest promises memorable experiences for travelers visiting Hoi An in 2026.

Where Is Bay Mau Coconut Forest And Its Historical Background

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is located in Cam Thanh Commune, Hoi An City, Quang Nam Province, approximately 3 kilometers from Hoi An Ancient Town. Thanks to its convenient location, visitors can easily reach the forest by motorbike, bicycle, or taxi in about 7–10 minutes.

The name “Bay Mau” (meaning “Seven Acres”) originates from the forest’s original size of around seven acres. Over time, sediment accumulation expanded the forest into a large mangrove ecosystem rich in biodiversity.

Beyond its natural beauty, Bay Mau Coconut Forest also holds historical significance. During the Vietnam War, this dense coconut forest served as a revolutionary base, providing shelter and transportation routes for local resistance forces. Today, stories shared by local boatmen help visitors understand the forest’s important role in history, adding depth to the travel experience.

Best Time To Visit Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is open year-round, but certain periods offer more favorable conditions:

February To April

This is the best time to visit, with mild temperatures, minimal rain, and comfortable weather for outdoor activities such as basket boat rides, cycling, and photography.

May To July

Although summer can be hot, this period coincides with lively festivals in Hoi An. Travelers often combine a forest visit with beach trips to An Bang or Cua Dai for relaxation.

September To October (Lunar August)

Considered by locals as the most beautiful season, higher water levels allow basket boats to travel deeper into small canals. Light rain enhances the scenery, creating a peaceful and romantic atmosphere.

October To December

This is the rainy and stormy season. While the scenery can be dramatic, travel conditions may be less convenient.

Unmissable Experiences At Bay Mau Coconut Forest

1. Basket Boat Ride Through Coconut Waterways

The highlight of any visit is riding a traditional round basket boat, guided by friendly and experienced local boatmen. Gliding through narrow canals under dense coconut palms offers a refreshing and relaxing escape from busy city life.

2. Basket Boat Spinning Shows And Races

Visitors can enjoy thrilling basket boat spinning performances, showcasing impressive balance and rowing skills. Guests may also participate in fun boat races, creating laughter and unforgettable memories.

3. Coconut Leaf Handicraft Workshop

Learn how to make simple souvenirs such as rings, grasshoppers, fans, or bracelets from fresh coconut leaves. This hands-on activity offers insight into local craftsmanship and daily life.

4. Enjoy Local Cuisine

After exploring the forest, travelers can dine at riverside restaurants serving fresh seafood and regional specialties. Popular dishes include grilled fish, shrimp, Vietnamese pancakes, and coconut-based desserts, accompanied by refreshing fresh coconut water.

5. Cycling Through Cam Thanh Village

Cycling around Cam Thanh village allows visitors to observe rural life, rice fields, traditional houses, and friendly locals. It is an excellent way to experience the peaceful countryside surrounding Hoi An.

6. Fishing With Local Fishermen

For a deeper cultural experience, travelers can join local fishermen to learn traditional fishing techniques such as net casting and crab trapping, followed by enjoying freshly prepared seafood.

7. Visit Nearby Traditional Craft Villages

Nearby villages such as Thanh Ha Pottery Village and Kim Bong Carpentry Village provide additional cultural exploration, where visitors can witness traditional craftsmanship passed down through generations.

Practical Travel Tips

  • Entrance Fee: Approximately 30,000 VND per person

  • Basket Boat Rental: Around 150,000–200,000 VND per boat (2–4 people)

  • What To Wear: Light, comfortable clothing; hat, sunscreen, and sunglasses

  • Safety: Always wear a life jacket during boat rides

  • Environmental Awareness: Help protect the ecosystem by avoiding littering

Accommodation And Nearby Attractions

Visitors can choose from homestays in Cam Thanh for an authentic local experience or hotels and resorts in Hoi An Ancient Town for greater comfort. Bay Mau Coconut Forest is easily combined with visits to Hoi An Old Town, An Bang Beach, Cua Dai Beach, and other cultural landmarks.

Culture And Local Life

What makes Bay Mau Coconut Forest truly special is not only its landscape but also its people. The residents of Cam Thanh are known for their warmth and hospitality. Their knowledge of the forest, traditional basket boats, and sustainable living practices reflect a deep connection with nature.

A visit here offers a refreshing pause from urban life, allowing travelers to reconnect with nature, history, and local traditions in a meaningful way.

Final Thoughts

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is more than just a tourist attraction it is a symbol of resilience, cultural heritage, and sustainable eco-tourism in Hoi An. Whether you are seeking relaxation, cultural discovery, or hands-on experiences, this destination offers something unique and memorable for every traveler.

虽然夏季可能炎热，但这段时间恰逢会安热闹的节庆。旅行者常把游览椰林与前往安邦或古岱海滩的放松之旅结合起来。

九月至十月（农历八月）

被当地人认为是最美的季节，水位较高，竹筐船可以深入更小的水道。细雨增添了景色，营造出宁静而浪漫的氛围。

十月至十二月

这是雨季和风暴季。虽然景色可能壮观，但出行条件可能不太方便。

七亩椰林不容错过的体验

1. 乘竹筐船穿越椰林水道

每次游览的亮点是乘坐传统的圆形竹筐船，由友善而经验丰富的当地船夫掌舵。在茂密的椰树下滑过狭窄的水道，让您从繁忙的城市生活中获得清爽而放松的逃离。

2. 竹筐船旋转表演与比赛

游客可以欣赏惊险的竹筐船旋转表演，展示出色的平衡和划船技巧。客人还可以参加有趣的划船比赛，带来欢笑和难忘的回忆。

3. 椰叶手工艺工作坊

学习用新鲜椰叶制作戒指、蚱蜢、扇子或手链等简单的纪念品。这项亲手体验的活动让您了解当地的手工技艺和日常生活。

4. 品尝当地美食

游览完椰林后，旅行者可以在河畔餐厅用餐，餐厅供应新鲜海鲜和地方特色菜肴。受欢迎的菜品包括烤鱼、虾、越南煎饼和椰子甜品，搭配清爽的新鲜椰汁。

5. 骑行穿越锦清村

骑自行车游览锦清村，游客可以观察乡村生活、稻田、传统房屋和友善的当地人。这是体验会安周边宁静乡村的绝佳方式。

6. 与当地渔民一起捕鱼

为了更深入的文化体验，旅行者可以加入当地渔民，学习撒网和捕蟹笼等传统捕鱼技术，随后享用现做的新鲜海鲜。

7. 参观附近的传统手工艺村

附近的村庄，如青河陶器村和金榜木工村，提供更多文化探索，游客可以见证代代相传的传统手工技艺。

实用旅行提示

  • 门票：约每人30,000 VND

  • 竹筐船租金：约每艘150,000–200,000 VND（2–4人）

  • 着装建议：轻便舒适的衣物；帽子、防晒霜和太阳镜

  • 安全：乘船时务必穿救生衣

  • 环保意识：请不要乱扔垃圾，帮助保护生态系统

住宿与周边景点

游客可以选择锦清的民宿以获得地道的当地体验，或选择会安古镇的酒店和度假村以获得更多舒适。七亩椰林可以轻松与会安老城、安邦海滩、古岱海滩及其他文化地标的游览结合。

文化与当地生活

七亩椰林真正特别之处不仅在于景观，还在于当地人。锦清的居民以热情好客而闻名。他们对森林、传统竹筐船和可持续生活方式的了解，体现了与自然的深厚联系。

到访这里让您从都市生活中得到清新的停歇，让旅行者以有意义的方式重新与自然、历史和当地传统联结。

结语

七亩椰林不仅仅是一个旅游景点，它还是会安坚韧、文化遗产和可持续生态旅游的象征。无论您是寻求放松、文化探索还是亲身体验，这个目的地都能为每位旅行者带来独特而难忘的东西。

posts.title: What To Visit When Traveling Independently In Hoi An?
posts.excerpt: Autumn 2026 is an ideal season to explore the ancient and romantic charm of Hoi An. With mild weather, gentle sunshine, and fewer crowds, travelers can leisurely wander lantern-lit streets, visit hist
posts.contentHtml:
Autumn 2026 is an ideal season to explore the ancient and romantic charm of Hoi An. With mild weather, gentle sunshine, and fewer crowds, travelers can leisurely wander lantern-lit streets, visit historic landmarks, and enjoy the city’s rich culinary heritage.

Recognized as a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage Site, Hoi An captivates visitors with its well-preserved ancient town, glowing lanterns, traditional craft villages, and distinctive cuisine. Unlike the vibrant energy of summer or the quiet calm of winter, autumn brings a soft, poetic beauty that allows travelers to experience Hoi An at a slower, more meaningful pace.

Autumn in Hoi An typically lasts from September to November, with average temperatures ranging from 25–30°C. The pleasant climate is perfect for outdoor exploration. On full-moon nights, electric lights are turned off throughout the Old Town and replaced by thousands of lanterns, creating a magical and dreamlike atmosphere that leaves a lasting impression on every visitor.

Must Visit Attractions And Experiences In Hoi An During Autumn 2026

1. Hoi An Lantern Streets – A Magical Nighttime Experience

Lanterns are the soul of Hoi An. As night falls, colorful lanterns illuminate streets, alleys, and ancient houses, creating a romantic and unforgettable scene. Autumn’s cool air enhances the charm, making evening walks especially enjoyable.

Visitors can take a small wooden boat along the Hoai River, release floating lanterns, and admire the glowing Old Town from the water. Lantern-making workshops are also popular, allowing travelers to create their own handmade souvenir inspired by local culture.

2. Ba Mu Temple Gate (Tam Quan Ba Mu) – Ancient Architecture In The Heart Of The Old Town

The Tam Quan Ba Mu Gate is a striking historical structure known for its elegant design and peaceful surroundings. Restored with care, it features a tranquil pond, green lawns, and impressive architectural details that reflect Hoi An’s cultural depth. Autumn brings a calm and serene atmosphere, ideal for photography and quiet reflection.

3. Japanese Covered Bridge – A Cultural Icon Of Hoi An

Also known as Chua Cau, this iconic bridge symbolizes the cultural exchange between Vietnam and Japan during Hoi An’s trading-port era. Its curved roof, intricate carvings, and spiritual significance make it one of the most photographed landmarks in the city. Soft autumn sunlight highlights its timeless beauty.

4. Abandoned Brick Kiln – A Unique Photo Spot

Located about 5 kilometers from the Old Town, an abandoned brick kiln surrounded by rice fields has become a favorite destination for photography enthusiasts. Its raw, rustic appearance contrasts beautifully with the blue autumn sky, offering dramatic and artistic photo opportunities. Sunrise and sunset are the best times to visit.

5. Hoai River – Poetic And Peaceful

Flowing gently through the Old Town, the Hoai River adds a poetic touch to Hoi An’s scenery. In the evening, lantern reflections shimmer on the water as boats glide quietly along. Riverside cafés provide perfect spots to relax, enjoy Vietnamese coffee, and watch life unfold at a slow pace.

6. Thanh Ha Pottery Village – Preserving Traditional Craftsmanship

Situated along the Thu Bon River, Thanh Ha Pottery Village offers insight into centuries-old ceramic traditions. Visitors can watch skilled artisans at work or try shaping pottery themselves. The village’s rustic charm and cultural authenticity make it a meaningful stop for travelers interested in local heritage.

7. Bay Mau Coconut Forest – A “Mini Mekong” Experience

This lush water coconut forest offers a completely different perspective of Hoi An. Guests ride basket boats through narrow waterways, watch traditional fishing demonstrations, and enjoy lively local performances. Autumn’s cooler temperatures make this eco-experience especially comfortable.

8. An Bang And Cua Dai Beaches – Tranquility By The Sea

For those seeking relaxation, An Bang and Cua Dai beaches offer quiet escapes from the Old Town. In autumn, the beaches are peaceful, ideal for seaside walks, watching sunrise or sunset, and enjoying fresh seafood in beachfront restaurants.

9. Fujian Assembly Hall – Chinese Architectural Heritage

This grand assembly hall showcases traditional Chinese architecture with ornate gates, courtyards, and altars dedicated to sea deities. It reflects the historical presence of the Chinese community in Hoi An and is an excellent place to learn about the city’s multicultural past.

10. Tan Ky Ancient House – Living History

Over 200 years old, Tan Ky Ancient House beautifully blends Vietnamese, Japanese, and Chinese architectural elements. Visiting this well-preserved home offers insight into the lifestyle and trading history of Hoi An’s merchant families.

11. Traditional Craft Workshops – Art And Heritage

Hoi An is home to numerous craft workshops producing lanterns, silk, leather goods, and woodwork. Visitors can observe artisans at work, purchase handmade souvenirs, or join short workshops to create personalized keepsakes.

12. Cu Lao Cham Islands – A Natural Paradise

About 15 kilometers offshore, the Cu Lao Cham Islands feature pristine beaches, coral reefs, and traditional fishing villages. Autumn seas are calm, making it a great time for snorkeling, swimming, and enjoying fresh seafood. The islands are recognized as a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.

13. Hoi An Night Market – Local Flavors And Shopping

As night falls, the night market along the Hoai River becomes lively with lantern stalls, street food vendors, and souvenir shops. It is the perfect place to sample local snacks, shop for handmade items, and experience the vibrant nightlife of Hoi An.

Hoi An Autumn Cuisine – Flavors You Should Not Miss

No trip to Hoi An is complete without tasting its iconic dishes, including:

  • Cao Lau – Thick noodles with roasted pork and fresh herbs

  • Mi Quang – Turmeric noodles with rich but light broth

  • Hoi An Chicken Rice – Fragrant rice with shredded chicken

  • Banh Mi Phuong – Famous Vietnamese baguette

  • White Rose Dumplings – Delicate shrimp-filled dumplings

  • Herbal “Mot” Drink – Refreshing traditional beverage

Travel Tips For Visiting Hoi An In Autumn 2026

  • Book accommodation early, as autumn is a popular travel season

  • Explore the Old Town on foot or by bicycle

  • Bring light layers for cooler evenings

  • Carry some cash for local markets

  • Respect local culture and protect the environment

Final Thoughts

Hoi An in autumn 2026 offers a perfect blend of history, culture, cuisine, and tranquil beauty. From lantern-lit streets and ancient architecture to peaceful rivers and traditional villages, every moment feels poetic and unforgettable. Whether you are a culture lover, a food enthusiast, or a photography fan, Hoi An promises a deeply rewarding journey.
