posts.contentHtmlZh:
芽庄是越南中部海岸一颗闪耀的明珠，不仅以原始的白沙滩和清澈碧绿的海水闻名，还以充满活力、风味十足的街头美食文化著称。2025年11月，随着城市从雨季过渡到旱季，天气变得更加凉爽宜人，非常适合漫步街头，享用当地美味。

本文邀请您深入了解 芽庄街头美食的世界，介绍深受当地人喜爱的地道小店和必尝美食。这些美食体验必将为您在这座美丽海滨城市的旅程增添难忘的风味。

芽庄街头美食概览

芽庄的 美食以新鲜海鲜和浓郁的海滨风味而著称。菜肴往往以简单而精致的方式烹制，让食材的天然甜味得以彰显。越南和占婆文化遗产的影响也塑造了丰富多样的美食景观。

在旱季游览芽庄，旅行者可以在晴朗的天空和轻柔的海风下，以轻松的露天氛围享用这些特色美食，是绝佳的机会。

芽庄必尝街头美食

鱼饼米线汤（Bun Cha Ca）

传统的早餐最爱，Bun Cha Ca汤底清淡而风味十足，由鱼骨熬制，搭配有弹性的鱼饼和新鲜香草。它被认为是芽庄的招牌菜。当地人常推荐位于Ngo Gia Tu街123号的Nguyen Loan鱼汤米线。

芽庄烤肉卷（Nem Nuong Nha Trang）

香气四溢的烤肉卷搭配酥脆的米纸、新鲜香草和独特的蘸酱。这道菜在街边小吃店随处可见，味道令人难忘。位于Lan Ong街16A号的Dang Van Quyen烤肉卷是当地知名的最爱。

新鲜海鲜

作为一座海滨城市，芽庄是海鲜的天堂。虾、蟹、鱿鱼、蛤蜊、海螺和龙虾可以采用清蒸、烧烤或罗望子炒等多种方式烹制。Bo Ke街和Thap Ba街沿线的海鲜餐厅在夜晚尤其热闹。

越南小煎饼（Banh Can）

在陶土模具中烹制的小块咸味米粉煎饼，馅料有虾、鱿鱼或鹌鹑蛋，配以酸甜的鱼露食用。Thap Ba 15号的Banh Can是非常值得推荐的地方。

鱿鱼煎饼（Banh Xeo Muc）

一种酥脆的越南煎饼，内馅为新鲜鱿鱼，搭配香草和蘸酱食用。位于Hoang Van Thu街87号的Banh Xeo Chao深受当地人欢迎。

燕窝（Yen Sao）

庆和省富有营养的特产。游客可以品尝燕窝甜汤，或购买作为高档的当地礼品。

像当地人一样体验街头美食

要真正沉浸于芽庄的美食文化，请考虑以下体验：

探索Dam市场

Dam市场是芽庄最大的传统市场，提供新鲜海鲜、当地特产和各种街头小吃。这里是体验城市日常节奏和地道风味的绝佳之处。

漫步美食街

夜晚非常适合探索美食云集的街道，如Ngo Gia Tu、Thap Ba以及陈富海滩附近的区域。街边小推车和小吃店供应从鱼汤米线、烤肉到海鲜和海螺的各式美食。

享受路边咖啡

路边咖啡是越南文化的重要组成部分。坐在低矮的塑料凳上，啜饮冰牛奶咖啡，看着日常生活徐徐展开，是一种轻松而地道的当地体验。

当地贴士

不要犹豫向当地人询问推荐。他们往往知道隐藏的宝藏小店，以合理的价格提供最地道的风味。保持开放的心态尝试陌生的菜肴——这是发现芽庄美食灵魂的最佳方式。

规划您的街头美食之旅

探索街头美食的最佳时间是旱季，尤其是3月至8月。不过，2025年11月仍是极佳的选择，阳光温和，降雨极少。在市内出行很方便，可乘坐出租车、网约车软件或租用摩托车，让您自由探索美食地点。

没有街头美食的冒险，芽庄之行就不完整。借助当地居民的见解和对美食的好奇心，您的旅程将充满难忘的味道和有意义的文化体验。

与Vietlook Travel一起探索芽庄

探索芽庄街头美食不仅仅是品尝当地菜肴，更是深入越南海滨文化核心的旅程。从滋滋作响的街头烧烤到热闹的当地市场，每一种风味都讲述着一个由大海、历史和日常生活塑造的故事。

在Vietlook Travel，l 我们专注于为希望超越表面的国际旅行者打造地道、以体验为导向的旅程。我们精心策划的芽庄体验将街头美食探索、当地见解和顺畅的旅行服务相结合，确保您像真正的内行一样享受这座城市——舒适、安全且意义非凡。

posts.title: The Most Popular Tourist Attractions In Nha Trang
posts.excerpt: Nha Trang, often referred to as the jewel of Vietnam’s coastline, has long been one of the country’s most attractive travel destinations thanks to its perfect blend of unspoiled natural beauty and mod
posts.contentHtml:
Nha Trang, often referred to as the jewel of Vietnam’s coastline, has long been one of the country’s most attractive travel destinations thanks to its perfect blend of unspoiled natural beauty and modern tourism services. With long stretches of white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and a pleasant climate all year round, this coastal city promises unforgettable experiences for every traveler.

In 2025, Nha Trang continues to strengthen its position as one of Southeast Asia’s leading beach destinations, with significant improvements in infrastructure and tourism services. From spectacular islands and world-class entertainment complexes to ancient Cham cultural relics and vibrant street food scenes, Nha Trang truly has something for everyone.

To make your journey truly complete, careful planning and a thorough understanding of the destinations are essential. Beyond its landscapes, Nha Trang is also loved for the warm hospitality of its people and its colorful cultural festivals. Let us explore 10 must-visit attractions, along with useful travel tips, to help you enjoy an unforgettable trip to Nha Trang in 2025.

1. VinWonders Nha Trang (Formerly Vinpearl Land)

Located on Hon Tre Island, VinWonders Nha Trang is a world-class entertainment and resort complex often described as a “tropical paradise.” In addition to pristine beaches, the complex features five-star hotels, infinity pools overlooking the sea, and a massive amusement park offering hundreds of thrilling rides.

What makes VinWonders truly special is the diversity of its attractions, including an expansive water park with high-speed slides, a large aquarium showcasing thousands of colorful marine species, and King’s Garden, a semi-wild zoo where visitors can interact with rare animals. Spectacular performances such as the Tata Show are also a major highlight.

Visitors reach VinWonders via one of the world’s longest overwater cable cars, offering breathtaking panoramic views of Nha Trang Bay. Entrance tickets range from approximately VND 800,000 to VND 1,200,000, depending on the season and package. To fully enjoy the experience, it is recommended to spend an entire day here and book tickets online in advance.

2. Hon Mun Island

Recognized by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) as one of Vietnam’s most biodiverse marine areas, Hon Mun Island is a paradise for ocean lovers. The island is famous for its pristine coral reefs and vibrant underwater ecosystem.

Hon Mun is ideal for snorkeling and scuba diving, suitable for both beginners and experienced divers. Visitors can swim among tropical fish, admire colorful coral formations, or enjoy glass-bottom boat tours for coral viewing without entering the water. Sea-walking with special diving helmets is also a popular activity.

The best time to visit Hon Mun is from April to September, when the sea is calm and visibility is excellent. As a protected marine reserve, environmental conservation is strictly enforced. Boat transfers from Cau Da Port typically cost VND 250,000–350,000, excluding diving fees.

3. Hon Tam Island

Located about seven kilometers southeast of Nha Trang city center, Hon Tam Island spans over 110 hectares and is known for its untouched beauty combined with premium tourism services. From the island, visitors can admire panoramic views of Nha Trang City to the north and the majestic Cam Ranh Peninsula to the south.

In addition to white sandy beaches and clear waters, Hon Tam offers a wide range of marine activities such as snorkeling, sea walking, parasailing, and jet skiing. A major highlight is the MerPerle Hon Tam Mud Bath, where visitors can relax in natural hot mineral mud baths while enjoying stunning ocean views.

The island also features luxury resorts, professional spa services, and diverse dining options. Entrance and service packages typically range from VND 300,000 to VND 800,000, including speedboat transfers.

4. Ninh Van Bay

Located approximately 60 kilometers north of Nha Trang, Ninh Van Bay is a hidden gem for travelers seeking tranquility and seclusion. Far from the bustling city, the bay offers a peaceful atmosphere, crystal-clear waters, and deserted beaches framed by lush coconut palms.

The area is home to world-renowned luxury resorts such as Six Senses Ninh Van Bay, offering private villas with personal pools, refined cuisine, and holistic spa experiences. Activities focus on reconnecting with nature, including kayaking, snorkeling near the shore, and simply relaxing on the beach.

Although accommodation costs are relatively high, the experience offers unparalleled privacy and exclusivity, making it ideal for couples, honeymooners, and wellness retreats.

5. National Oceanographic Museum Of Nha Trang

Founded in 1923, the National Oceanographic Museum of Nha Trang is one of Vietnam’s oldest and largest marine research institutions. Located near Cau Da Port, the museum houses over 20,000 specimens representing more than 4,000 marine and freshwater species.

Its most impressive exhibit is a fully restored whale skeleton measuring nearly 26 meters in length. The museum also features live marine displays, rare species conservation areas, and exhibits on the history of oceanographic research.

With affordable entrance fees, this destination is particularly suitable for families and travelers interested in marine science and environmental conservation.

6. Po Nagar Cham Towers

Situated just two kilometers north of the city center, the Po Nagar Cham Towers are one of the most important Cham architectural complexes in Central Vietnam. The site is dedicated to Goddess Po Nagar, revered as the Mother of the Land.

Visitors can admire intricate brickwork, ancient carvings, and learn about Cham beliefs and traditions. The annual Po Nagar Festival, held in the third lunar month, attracts thousands of pilgrims and tourists.

7. Hon Chong – Hon Vo Rocks

Hon Chong – Hon Vo is a unique coastal rock formation known for its massive boulders stacked naturally in dramatic shapes. Associated with romantic local legends, this site offers spectacular views of Nha Trang Bay, especially at sunrise and sunset.

The nearby cultural center often hosts traditional music and dance performances, enriching the cultural experience.

8. Van Phong Bay

Located about 40 kilometers north of Nha Trang, Van Phong Bay is often described as one of Vietnam’s most untouched coastal areas. With pristine beaches, scattered islands, and clear waters, it is ideal for eco-tourism and nature exploration.

Visitors can snorkel, kayak, fish with local fishermen, or visit traditional fishing villages. Mui Doi, Vietnam’s easternmost mainland point, is also located here, offering a unique sunrise experience.

9. Dai Lanh Beach

Approximately 80 kilometers north of Nha Trang, Dai Lanh Beach is famous for its powdery white sand, turquoise waters, and peaceful atmosphere. The beach is perfect for relaxation, seafood tasting, and visiting nearby fishing villages.

Fresh seafood, affordable prices, and scenic surroundings make Dai Lanh an excellent escape from the city’s crowds.

10. Dam Market

Located in the heart of Nha Trang, Dam Market is both a commercial hub and a cultural landmark. With its distinctive circular architecture, the market offers a lively glimpse into local life.

Visitors can shop for fresh seafood, dried specialties, local delicacies, and handcrafted souvenirs. The market is also a street food paradise, featuring dishes such as jellyfish noodle soup, grilled pork rolls, and traditional sweet desserts.

Useful Tips For Visiting Nha Trang In 2025

The best time to visit Nha Trang is from January to September, when the weather is sunny and ideal for sea activities. Motorbikes are the most convenient way to explore the city, while taxis and buses are suitable for longer distances or group travel.

Booking accommodation and tours in advance during peak seasons is highly recommended. Visitors should also pack sunscreen, swimwear, and cash for local markets. Exploring cafés with ocean views and participating in local festivals will further enrich your experience.

Final Thoughts

With its diverse attractions from stunning beaches and untouched islands to ancient heritage sites and vibrant markets Nha Trang offers something for every traveler. Whether you seek adventure, relaxation, cultural discovery, or culinary exploration, this coastal city will not disappoint.

Nha Trang is not only an ideal holiday destination but also a gateway to understanding Cham civilization and enjoying Vietnam’s rich coastal cuisine. Plan your journey today and prepare for unforgettable memories in one of Vietnam’s most captivating seaside cities.
posts.excerptZh: 芽庄常被誉为越南海岸线上的明珠，凭借原生态自然美景与现代旅游服务的完美结合，长期以来一直是越南最具吸引力的旅游目的地之一。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
芽庄常被誉为越南海岸线上的明珠，凭借原生态自然美景与现代旅游服务的完美结合，长期以来一直是越南最具吸引力的旅游目的地之一。绵延的白色沙滩、清澈碧蓝的海水以及全年宜人的气候，让这座海滨城市为每位旅行者承诺难忘的体验。

2025年， 芽庄 继续巩固其作为东南亚顶级海滩目的地的地位，基础设施和旅游服务都有显著提升。从壮丽的海岛、世界级的娱乐综合体，到古老的占婆文化遗迹和热闹的街头美食，芽庄真正做到了人人皆宜。

要让您的旅程真正圆满，周密的规划和对目的地的透彻了解必不可少。除了自然风光，芽庄还因当地人的热情好客和丰富多彩的文化节庆而深受喜爱。让我们一起探索10个必游景点以及实用旅行贴士，帮助您享受2025年的芽庄难忘之旅。

1. 芽庄 VinWonders（原珍珠岛乐园 Vinpearl Land）

芽庄 VinWonders 位于竹岛（Hon Tre），是一座世界级的娱乐度假综合体，常被形容为“热带天堂”。除了原始的海滩，园区还有五星级酒店、俯瞰大海的无边泳池，以及提供数百种刺激游乐设施的大型游乐园。

VinWonders 的特别之处在于景点丰富多样，包括拥有高速滑道的大型水上乐园、展示数千种色彩斑斓海洋生物的大型水族馆，以及可与珍稀动物互动的半野生动物园“国王花园”。Tata Show 等精彩演出同样是一大亮点。

游客乘坐世界上最长的跨海缆车之一前往 VinWonders，可以欣赏芽庄湾令人叹为观止的全景。门票价格约为 800,000 越南盾至 1,200,000 越南盾，视季节和套餐而定。为了充分享受体验，建议在此待上一整天，并提前在线订票。

2. 蚝岛（Hon Mun）

蚝岛（Hon Mun）被世界自然基金会（WWF）认定为越南生物多样性最丰富的海洋区域之一，是海洋爱好者的天堂。该岛以原始的珊瑚礁和生机勃勃的海底生态系统而闻名。

Hon Mun 非常适合浮潜和水肺潜水，初学者和经验丰富的潜水者都能尽兴。游客可以与热带鱼一起畅游，欣赏五彩斑斓的珊瑚，也可以乘坐玻璃底船观赏珊瑚而无需下水。头戴特制潜水头盔的海底漫步也是一项热门活动。

参观 Hon Mun 的最佳时间是4月至9月，此时海面平静，能见度极佳。作为受保护的海洋保护区，这里严格执行环境保护。从 Cau Da 码头出发的船费通常为 250,000–350,000 越南盾，不含潜水费用。

3. 竹岛（Hon Tam）

Hon Tam 岛位于芽庄市中心东南约七公里处，面积超过110公顷，以未经雕琢的自然之美结合高端旅游服务而闻名。在岛上，游客可以眺望北面的芽庄市全景和南面雄伟的金兰半岛。

除了白色沙滩和清澈海水，Hon Tam 还提供浮潜、海底漫步、拖曳伞和水上摩托等丰富的海上活动。一大亮点是 MerPerle Hon Tam 泥浆浴，游客可以在天然温热矿物泥浆浴中放松身心，同时欣赏壮丽的海景。

岛上还有豪华度假村、专业水疗服务和多样的餐饮选择。门票和服务套餐通常为 300,000 至 800,000 越南盾，含快艇接送。

4. 宁云湾（Ninh Van Bay）

宁云湾位于芽庄以北约60公里处，是追求宁静与隐逸的旅行者的隐藏瑰宝。远离喧嚣的城市，海湾氛围平和，海水清澈见底，无人的海滩被茂密的椰树环绕。

这里坐落着六善宁云湾（Six Senses Ninh Van Bay）等世界知名的奢华度假村，提供带私人泳池的独栋别墅、精致美食和全方位的水疗体验。活动以重新亲近自然为主，包括皮划艇、近岸浮潜，或者只是在海滩上放松。

尽管住宿费用相对较高，但这里的体验提供无与伦比的私密性和专属感，非常适合情侣、蜜月旅行者和养生度假。

5. 芽庄国家海洋博物馆

芽庄国家海洋博物馆创建于1923年，是越南历史最悠久、规模最大的海洋研究机构之一。博物馆靠近 Cau Da 码头，收藏有超过20,000件标本，涵盖4,000多种海洋和淡水物种。

其最令人印象深刻的展品是一具长近26米、经过完整修复的鲸鱼骨架。博物馆还设有海洋生物活体展示、珍稀物种保护区，以及海洋学研究历史展览。

门票价格实惠，这里特别适合家庭以及对海洋科学和环境保护感兴趣的旅行者。

6. 婆那加占婆塔（Po Nagar）

婆那加占婆塔位于市中心以北仅两公里处，是越南中部最重要的占婆建筑群之一。该遗址供奉婆那加女神（Po Nagar），她被尊为大地之母。

游客可以欣赏精美的砖砌工艺和古老的雕刻，并了解占婆人的信仰和传统。每年农历三月举行的婆那加节吸引了成千上万的朝圣者和游客。

7. 钟夫石（Hon Chong – Hon Vo）

钟夫石（Hon Chong – Hon Vo）是一处独特的海岸岩石景观，以天然堆叠成戏剧性形态的巨大岩石而闻名。这里与浪漫的当地传说相关联，可以欣赏芽庄湾的壮丽景色，尤其是日出和日落时分。

附近的文化中心经常举办传统音乐和舞蹈表演，让文化体验更加丰富。

8. 云风湾（Van Phong）

云风湾位于芽庄以北约40公里处，常被形容为越南最未被开发的海岸地区之一。这里有原始的海滩、星罗棋布的岛屿和清澈的海水，非常适合生态旅游和自然探索。

游客可以浮潜、划皮划艇、与当地渔民一起捕鱼，或参观传统渔村。越南大陆最东端的 Mui Doi（东角）也位于此处，可带来独特的日出体验。

9. Dai Lanh 海滩

Dai Lanh 海滩位于芽庄以北约80公里处，以细腻的白沙、碧蓝的海水和宁静的氛围而闻名。这里非常适合放松、品尝海鲜以及参观附近的渔村。

新鲜的海鲜、实惠的价格和风景优美的环境，让 Dai Lanh 成为远离城市喧嚣的绝佳去处。

10. 占市场（Dam Market）

占市场位于芽庄市中心，既是商业中心，也是文化地标。市场拥有独特的圆形建筑，让人得以一窥当地生活的热闹景象。

游客可以选购新鲜海鲜、干货特产、当地美味和手工纪念品。市场同时也是街头美食的天堂，有海蜇米线汤、烤猪肉卷和传统甜品等美食。

2025年芽庄旅游实用贴士

游览芽庄的最佳时间是1月至9月，此时天气晴朗，非常适合海上活动。摩托车是探索城市最便捷的方式，而出租车和公交车则适合长距离或团体出行。

在旺季强烈建议提前预订住宿和旅游项目。游客还应携带防晒霜、泳衣以及逛当地市场用的现金。探访可欣赏海景的咖啡馆并参加当地节庆，将进一步丰富您的体验。

结语

从迷人的海滩和未经开发的海岛，到古老的遗产遗址和热闹的市场，芽庄的多样景点能满足每位旅行者的需求。无论您追求冒险、放松、文化探索还是美食之旅，这座海滨城市都不会让您失望。

芽庄不仅是理想的度假胜地，也是了解占婆文明、品尝越南丰富沿海美食的门户。今天就开始规划您的旅程，为在越南最迷人的海滨城市之一留下难忘回忆做好准备。

posts.title: Should You Choose Binh Ba Island Tour Or Binh Hung Island Tour?
posts.excerpt: For first time travelers to Nha Trang, choosing between Binh Ba Island tour and Binh Hung Island tour is one of the most common questions. Both islands are stunning, peaceful, and rich in natural beau
posts.contentHtml:
For first time travelers to Nha Trang, choosing between Binh Ba Island tour and Binh Hung Island tour is one of the most common questions. Both islands are stunning, peaceful, and rich in natural beauty, yet each offers a very different travel experience.

In this article, Vietlook Travel provides a comprehensive comparison of Binh Ba and Binh Hung Islands to help you choose the destination that best suits your travel style when visiting Nha Trang.

Overview Of Binh Ba Island And Binh Hung Island – Two Hidden Gems Of Khanh Hoa

Both Binh Ba Island and Binh Hung Island are small islands located in Cam Ranh City, Khanh Hoa Province, Vietnam. Although they are geographically close, separated only by a narrow strait, each island has its own distinct charm.

As both islands lie within a military-controlled area, tourism development has been limited. This has helped preserve their pristine landscapes, clear waters, and authentic local life, offering visitors a more genuine and less commercialized island experience.

Binh Ba Island – The Lobster Island

Often referred to as “Lobster Island,” Binh Ba covers an area of just over three square kilometers and is nestled along the scenic coastal road of Binh Tien, near Vinh Hy Bay.

The island is famous for:

  • White sandy beaches

  • Crystal-clear turquoise water

  • A peaceful and relaxing atmosphere

  • Fresh seafood, especially lobster at reasonable prices

Binh Ba is ideal for travelers who enjoy a balance between relaxation, beach activities, and vibrant local food culture.

Binh Hung Island – A Quiet And Untouched Paradise

Smaller in size, Binh Hung Island spans approximately two square kilometers and is located near Hon Chut Lighthouse. Often described as a “raw gem,” Binh Hung remains largely untouched by mass tourism.

The island is known for:

  • Egg-shaped stone beaches

  • Small, hidden coves

  • Traditional fishing village life

  • A calm, rustic atmosphere

Binh Hung is perfect for travelers seeking tranquility, nature exploration, and a slower pace of life.

Highlights Of Binh Ba Island – Beaches, Seafood, And Local Life

Bai Nom Beach – Swimming And Seafood Paradise

Bai Nom is the most popular beach on Binh Ba Island, featuring soft sand, calm waters, and rocky formations. Visitors can relax on hammocks, swim, and enjoy freshly caught seafood such as lobster, squid, sea urchin, and snails.

In the evening, the area becomes a lively seafood hub, offering grilled lobster, steamed seafood, and other local specialties.

Sa Huynh Beach – Mysterious Ancient Rock Formations

Located in a restricted military zone, Sa Huynh Beach is accessible only by boat. The beach is famous for its colorful ancient rock formations shaped over millions of years.

Early morning or late afternoon is the best time to visit for photography, when sunlight creates dramatic reflections on the rocks.

Bai Chuong Beach – Sunrise And Marine Ecosystem

Bai Chuong is known as the best spot to watch sunrise on Binh Ba Island. The beach features rich marine life near the shore, making it ideal for shell collecting, light snorkeling, and photography.

Hon Rua – The Iconic Turtle-Shaped Rock

Hon Rua is one of the most iconic landmarks on the island. From above, the rock resembles a turtle emerging from the sea. It is a favorite spot for photography and panoramic views of Cam Ranh Bay.

Binh Ba Floating Village – Local Culture And Fresh Seafood

The floating village offers a glimpse into the daily life of lobster farmers. Visitors can choose live seafood directly from the cages and have it prepared on the spot, enjoying the freshest flavors of the sea.

Hon Co Beach – Where History Meets Nature

Hon Co Beach holds historical significance, having witnessed conflicts during past wars. Today, it combines natural beauty with historical stories, adding depth to the island experience.

What Makes A Binh Hung Island Tour Special?

Egg Stone Beach – A Geological Wonder

Egg Stone Beach features large, smooth, egg-shaped rocks formed by natural erosion. It is a popular photography spot, though not suitable for swimming.

Cay Me Beach – A Natural Swimming Pool

Accessible only by boat, Cay Me Beach is famous for its crystal-clear water and vibrant coral reefs, making it perfect for snorkeling and underwater photography.

Hon Chut Lighthouse – A Century-Old Viewpoint

Built over one hundred years ago, Hon Chut Lighthouse offers panoramic views of Binh Hung Island and Cam Ranh Bay, making it one of the most scenic viewpoints in the region.

Binh Tien Beach – Luxury Amid Nature

Now developed into a resort area, Binh Tien Beach combines modern comfort with untouched natural beauty, offering white sand, clear water, and peaceful surroundings.

Sweet Water Beach – Where Fresh And Salt Water Meet

Sweet Water Beach is unique for its freshwater pool hidden inside a rocky cave, right next to the sea. Visitors can enjoy both saltwater swimming and freshwater relaxation in one location.

Accommodation Options On Binh Ba And Binh Hung Islands

Both islands offer budget-friendly accommodations such as guesthouses, homestays, and floating houses. Prices are affordable, and staying with local families provides an authentic cultural experience.

Camping on the beach and staying on floating seafood farms are also popular options, especially on Binh Hung Island.

Must-Try Local Dishes On Both Islands

Seafood lovers will be delighted with specialties such as:

  • Grilled lobster

  • Sea urchin with scallion oil

  • Grilled grouper with chili salt

  • Snails, squid, and fresh fish

  • Seafood banh canh and fish noodle soup

Best Time To Visit

The ideal time to visit Binh Ba and Binh Hung Islands is from March to September, when the weather is sunny, the sea is calm, and outdoor activities are most enjoyable.

How To Get There

Travelers first reach Ba Ngoi Port in Cam Ranh, then take a boat or speedboat to the islands. On the islands, motorbike rental is the most convenient way to explore.

Travel Tips For A Perfect Trip

  • Book accommodation in advance during peak season

  • Bring cash, as card payments are limited

  • Respect military area regulations

  • Protect the environment and avoid littering

  • Foreign travelers need special permission to visit Binh Ba Island

Final Verdict: Binh Ba Or Binh Hung?

Both islands offer unique experiences:

  • Binh Ba Island is livelier, famous for lobster and developed services, ideal for travelers who enjoy vibrant island life.

  • Binh Hung Island is quieter and more untouched, perfect for nature lovers seeking peace and authenticity.

Your choice depends on your travel preferences. Either way, a Binh Ba – Binh Hung tour curated by Vietlook Travel promises an unforgettable island experience in Nha Trang.

posts.contentHtmlZh:
对于首次前往芽庄的旅行者来说，在Binh Ba岛之旅和Binh Hung岛之旅之间做选择是最常见的问题之一。两座岛屿都美丽、宁静、自然风光丰富，但各自带来截然不同的旅行体验。

在本文中，Vietlook Travel对Binh Ba岛和Binh Hung岛进行了全面比较，帮助您在 游览芽庄.

Binh Ba岛和Binh Hung岛概览——庆和省的两颗隐藏瑰宝

Binh Ba岛和Binh Hung岛都是位于越南庆和省金兰市的小岛。虽然两岛在地理上相距很近，仅隔一条狭窄的海峡，但各自都有独特的魅力。

由于两座岛屿都位于军事管控区内，旅游开发受到限制。这有助于保护其原始的风景、清澈的海水和地道的当地生活，为游客提供更真实、商业化程度更低的海岛体验。

Binh Ba岛——龙虾岛

Binh Ba岛常被称为“龙虾岛”，面积仅三平方公里多一点，坐落在风景优美的Binh Tien沿海公路沿线，靠近Vinh Hy湾。

该岛以以下特色闻名：

  • 白色沙滩

  • 清澈的碧绿海水

  • 宁静放松的氛围

  • 新鲜海鲜，尤其是价格合理的龙虾

Binh Ba非常适合喜欢在放松、沙滩活动和热闹的当地美食文化之间取得平衡的旅行者。

Binh Hung岛——宁静而未被破坏的天堂

Binh Hung岛面积较小，约两平方公里，位于Hon Chut灯塔附近。它常被形容为“璞玉”，基本未受大众旅游影响。

该岛以以下特色闻名：

  • 蛋形石滩

  • 小巧隐秘的海湾

  • 传统渔村生活

  • 平静质朴的氛围

Binh Hung非常适合追求宁静、探索自然和更慢生活节奏的旅行者。

Binh Ba岛亮点——海滩、海鲜与当地生活

Bai Nom海滩——游泳与海鲜天堂

Bai Nom是Binh Ba岛上最受欢迎的海滩，拥有柔软的沙滩、平静的海水和岩石景观。游客可以躺在吊床上放松、游泳，并品尝新捕捞的海鲜，如龙虾、鱿鱼、海胆和海螺。

傍晚，这里会变成热闹的海鲜聚集地，提供烤龙虾、清蒸海鲜和其他当地特色。

Sa Huynh海滩——神秘的古老岩石景观

Sa Huynh海滩位于军事禁区内，只能乘船抵达。这片海滩以历经数百万年形成的五彩缤纷的古老岩石景观而闻名。

清晨或傍晚是拍摄的最佳时间，此时阳光在岩石上投下壮观的倒影。

Bai Chuong海滩——日出与海洋生态系统

Bai Chuong被誉为Binh Ba岛上观看日出的最佳地点。海滩近岸海洋生物丰富，非常适合捡贝壳、轻度浮潜和摄影。

Hon Rua——标志性的龟形岩石

Hon Rua是岛上最具标志性的地标之一。从上方俯瞰，这块岩石就像一只从海中浮出的乌龟。这里是拍照和眺望金兰湾全景的热门地点。

Binh Ba水上渔村——当地文化与新鲜海鲜

水上渔村让人一窥龙虾养殖户的日常生活。游客可以直接从网箱中挑选活海鲜，现场烹制，品尝最新鲜的海洋风味。

Hon Co海滩——历史与自然交汇之处

Hon Co海滩具有历史意义，曾见证过往战争中的冲突。如今，它将自然之美与历史故事结合在一起，为海岛体验增添深度。

Binh Hung岛之旅有何特别之处？

蛋石海滩——地质奇观

蛋石海滩有因自然侵蚀形成的巨大、光滑的蛋形岩石。这里是热门的拍照地点，但不适合游泳。

Cay Me海滩——天然泳池

Cay Me海滩只能乘船抵达，以清澈的海水和充满活力的珊瑚礁而闻名，非常适合浮潜和水下摄影。

Hon Chut灯塔——百年观景点

Hon Chut灯塔建于一百多年前，可俯瞰Binh Hung岛和金兰湾全景，是该地区风景最优美的观景点之一。

Binh Tien海滩——自然中的奢华

Binh Tien海滩如今已开发为度假区，将现代舒适与未被破坏的自然美景相结合，拥有白沙、清澈海水和宁静的环境。

甜水海滩——淡水与咸水交汇之处

甜水海滩的独特之处在于隐藏在岩洞内、紧邻大海的淡水池。游客可以在同一地点既享受海水游泳，又享受淡水放松。

Binh Ba岛和Binh Hung岛的住宿选择

两座岛屿都提供经济实惠的住宿，如旅馆、民宿和水上屋。价格实惠，与当地家庭同住能带来地道的文化体验。

海滩露营和住在水上海产养殖场也是热门选择，尤其是在Binh Hung岛。

两座岛屿必尝的当地美食

海鲜爱好者一定会爱上以下特色菜：

  • 烤龙虾

  • 葱油海胆

  • 椒盐烤石斑鱼

  • 海螺、鱿鱼和鲜鱼

  • 海鲜粗米粉汤和鱼汤米线

最佳旅行时间

参观Binh Ba岛和Binh Hung岛的理想时间是3月至9月，此时天气晴朗，海面平静，最适合户外活动。

如何前往

旅行者首先前往金兰的Ba Ngoi港，然后乘船或快艇前往岛屿。在岛上，租摩托车是最方便的探索方式。

完美旅行的贴士

  • 旺季请提前预订住宿

  • 请携带现金，因为刷卡付款受限

  • 遵守军事区规定

  • 保护环境，不要乱扔垃圾

  • 外国旅行者需要特别许可才能参观Binh Ba岛

最终结论：Binh Ba还是Binh Hung？

两座岛屿都提供独特的体验：

  • Binh Ba岛更热闹，以龙虾和完善的服务闻名，适合喜欢活力海岛生活的旅行者。

  • Binh Hung岛更安静、更原始，非常适合追求平静与真实的自然爱好者。

您的选择取决于您的旅行偏好。无论如何，由 Vietlook Travel 精心策划的Binh Ba – Binh Hung之旅，必将带给您难忘的芽庄海岛体验。

Cooking class

Live music

Gym

For those who regularly exercise, when going on a Ha Long cruise tour, you will participate in exercising right on the cruise, which is not only good for your health but also an opportunity for tourists to regain their shape after a long vacation.

Spa

Take photos by flycam

Chosen by many tourists, especially those who love virtual life, from flycam tourists can save the most beautiful moments as souvenirs of their tour, right on the Ha Long cruise.

Early morning Tai Chi/Yoga/Vovinam practice

You can practice early in the morning in the cool weather on the sea and improve your health when participating in Tai Chi, Yoga or Vovinam…

Experience A Five Star Cruise Tour In Ha Long

It can be said that a trip on a 5-star Ha Long Bay cruise not only brings visitors exciting feelings when watching the scenery and when the boat glides through the famous landscapes, the undulating waves, but also experience the exciting games that will bring visitors the most unforgettable vacation. posts.excerptZh: 下龙湾游轮上的活动将为游客带来最难忘的体验，乘坐游轮出行时，游客不仅可以欣赏海湾的美景，还能参与各种娱乐活动。那么，就让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起来看看游轮上的活动吧。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
下龙湾游轮上的活动将为游客带来最难忘的体验，乘坐游轮出行时，游客不仅可以欣赏海湾的美景，还能参与各种娱乐活动。那么，就让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起来看看游轮上的活动吧。

Vietlook Travel 支持的下龙湾游轮活动

简要介绍：在下龙湾游轮之旅中，客人可以体验并享受的休闲娱乐活动。

下午茶会

下午在游轮上，您将在甲板上迎接日落，品一杯香茶，没有什么比这更有趣了，尤其是在5星级下龙湾游轮上。

这是为热爱欣赏自然风光的人准备的体验之一，还可以享用鸡尾酒或葡萄酒等饮品……一起聊聊看海看岛的故事。

烹饪课

这是许多游客选择的体验，尤其是来自国外、想学习如何制作越南菜的游客，在游轮上您可以学做亚洲和欧式菜肴。对于热爱美食、想进一步了解越南文化和美食的人来说，这是一次绝佳的体验。

现场音乐

参加下龙湾游轮时，您将在游轮上享受欢乐的现场音乐氛围，青春音乐、乡村音乐或爵士乐将帮助游客在假期中度过最轻松的时光。

钓鱿鱼

在下龙湾参与钓鱿鱼是许多游客选择的体验之一，钓鱿鱼时，游客可以欣赏海湾风光，您将与当地人一起钓鱿鱼，没有什么比亲手钓到新鲜的鱿鱼更有趣了，您可以把它带回去让厨师烹制，直接在游轮上享用，再没有比这更有意思的了。

卡拉OK

就在游轮上，将给游客带来兴奋的感受，尤其是大团或公司参加下龙湾旅游的游客，这是大家一起开心歌唱的好机会。

打扑克

这是下龙湾游轮上很受欢迎的娱乐游戏，将为游客在下龙湾游轮上带来一个充满挑战和刺激的夜晚。

品红酒和雪茄

这是高档的葡萄酒、威士忌、朗姆酒、干邑或诱人的雪茄之一。如果您想挑选酒的种类，可以向游轮工作人员咨询，选择更适合您口味的高级酒。

打高尔夫

在5星、6星级游轮上设有高尔夫服务，为热爱运动的游客提供现代化的专业高尔夫球场，游客可以一边打高尔夫，一边放松身心，欣赏有趣的海岛风光。

游泳池/按摩浴缸

目前，下龙湾的游轮都设有游泳池，供游客在清凉的水中放松、欣赏风景，这是最放松的体验之一，驱散繁华都市的沉闷，融入辽阔的大海和岛屿空间。

健身房

对于经常锻炼的人来说，参加下龙湾游轮之旅时，您可以直接在游轮上锻炼，这不仅有益健康，也是游客在漫长假期之后恢复身材的机会。

水疗(Spa)

游轮上提供水疗服务，有按摩、桑拿、草药浴、护肤、去角质等专业疗程……由专业人员操作，为客人带来最放松的时光。

用无人机拍照

许多游客选择这项活动，尤其是热爱拍照打卡的人，通过无人机，游客可以留下最美的瞬间，作为旅程的纪念，就在下龙湾游轮上。

清晨太极/瑜伽/越武道(Vovinam)练习

您可以在清晨凉爽的海上练习，参加太极、瑜伽或越武道……增强体质。

体验下龙湾五星级游轮之旅

可以说，乘坐5星级下龙湾游轮之旅，不仅能在欣赏风景、游船滑过著名景观与起伏波浪时给游客带来兴奋的感受，还能体验各种精彩的游戏，为游客带来最难忘的假期。配套服务和随行旅游由 vietlook travel 提供。

posts.title: Seven lotus flowers on the Han River
posts.excerpt: Seven lotus flowers on the Han River during the Buddha’s birthday week symbolize the seven footsteps of Buddha, placed in the middle of the Han River. When night falls, the lotus flowers are lit up th
posts.contentHtml:
Seven lotus flowers on the Han River during the Buddha’s birthday week symbolize the seven footsteps of Buddha, placed in the middle of the Han River. When night falls, the lotus flowers are lit up throughout the Buddha’s birthday, creating a sparkling scene in the heart of the city.

Seven lotus flowers are placed on the Han River

Seven lotus flowers are placed on the Han River right between the Dragon Bridge and the Han River Bridge, each lotus flower is about 20m apart, nearly 4m high, placed right in the middle of the Han River, anchored with floating activities to attract tourists to visit and take pictures.

This is one of the opening events for the Buddha’s birthday week in Da Nang city, and also for the upcoming anniversary of the birth of Buddha Shakyamuni…

The pink lotus flowers create a highlight for people and tourists, decorating seven pink lotus flowers on the Han River is a unique check-in point attracting people and tourists to visit Da Nang on the occasion of Buddha’s birthday.

The seven lotus flowers symbolize peace, praying for happiness and peace, lighting up seven lotus flowers on the Han River on the occasion of Vesak Buddha’s birthday not only has the meaning of Buddhist culture but also adds beauty to the Han River.

With the meaning of seven lotus flowers on the Han River, representing the seven pure steps of Buddha when he was born, many young people are very interested in watching the lotus flowers when traveling Da Nang and watching the beauty of the Han River when the whole city lights up.

The lotus flowers have a lighting system, when the night falls on the river, the lights create a solemn and sparkling scene in the heart of the coastal city.

Exciting festival events on the banks of the Han River in the summer

Festival events take place on both banks of the Han River, with 22 regular activities, 57 annual activities, the festival is arranged to suit the days of the week for the convenience of people and tourists to attend.

From February to September, every Saturday and Sunday in Da Nang, there will be many exciting activities such as singing Bai Choi on Friday evenings, on the 2nd and 4th weeks of every month, along with music concerts, the first Saturday of summer will have a Music Performance Cluster.

At the sidewalk area of ​​Nhu Nguyet Street, the landscape floor of the park on the east bank of Tran Thi Ly Bridge, Bach Dang walking street, there are film screening programs on the banks of the Han River, street music, the art program “music and life”, mobile libraries… all will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

In addition, when taking a summer tour Da Nang, visitors can also participate in street dances, street music, folk dances… or cultural reading festivals, film screenings… taking place alternately on both banks of the Han River, Bach Dang and Tran Hung Dao streets.

In addition, on the banks of the Han River, there are many big festival programs throughout the year, along with many interesting games that will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation, especially when night falls, visitors can take a walk to visit and watch the Dragon Bridge breathe fire and water on weekends.

So come to Da Nang once, not only to admire the beauty, or join in the festival atmosphere taking place on the banks of the Han River, but also visit the famous sights, or experience the cable car on Ba Na mountain, or dive to see coral at Son Tra peninsula, take a canoe to Cu Lao Cham island… and many other interesting programs are waiting for visitors to discover.

posts.excerptZh: 佛诞周期间韩江上的七朵莲花象征佛陀的七步，置于韩江中央。夜幕降临，整个佛诞期间莲花都被点亮，在城市中心营造出璀璨的景象。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
韩江上的七朵莲花 在佛诞周期间象征佛陀的七步，置于韩江中央。夜幕降临，整个佛诞期间莲花都被点亮，在城市中心营造出璀璨的景象。

七朵莲花置于韩江之上

七朵莲花就置于龙桥与韩江桥之间的韩江上，每朵莲花相隔约20米，高近4米，置于韩江正中，以漂浮方式固定，吸引游客前来参观和拍照。

这是岘港市佛诞周的开幕活动之一，也是为即将到来的释迦牟尼佛诞辰纪念日而举办…

粉红色的莲花为民众和游客带来亮点，在韩江上装饰七朵粉色莲花是一个独特的打卡点，吸引民众和游客在佛诞之际前来岘港。

七朵莲花象征和平，祈求幸福与安宁，在卫塞节佛诞之际点亮韩江上的七朵莲花，不仅具有佛教文化的意义，也为韩江增添了美感。

韩江上七朵莲花的寓意，代表佛陀诞生时的七步清净莲，许多年轻人在 游览岘港 时非常有兴趣观赏莲花，并欣赏全城灯火通明时韩江的美景。

莲花配有灯光系统，当夜幕降临河面，灯光在这座海滨城市的中心营造出庄严而璀璨的景象。

夏季韩江两岸精彩的节庆活动

节庆活动在韩江两岸举行，共有22项常规活动、57项年度活动，节庆安排与一周中的日子相适应，方便民众和游客参加。

从2月到9月，每个周六和周日岘港都会有许多精彩的活动，例如每月第2周和第4周的周五晚上唱 Bai Choi（越南民间歌舞），以及音乐会，夏季第一个周六还有音乐表演集群。

在 Nhu Nguyet 街人行道区域、Tran Thi Ly 桥东岸公园的景观广场、Bach Dang 步行街，有韩江畔的电影放映节目、街头音乐、“音乐与生活”艺术节目、流动图书馆… 都将为游客带来最愉快的假期。

此外，在参加夏季 岘港之旅时，游客还可以参与街舞、街头音乐、民间舞蹈… 或文化阅读节、电影放映… 轮流在韩江两岸、Bach Dang 街和 Tran Hung Dao 街举行。

此外，韩江两岸全年有许多大型节庆活动，以及许多有趣的游戏，将为游客带来最愉快的假期，尤其是夜幕降临时，游客可以散步前往，周末观看龙桥喷火喷水。

所以来岘港一次吧，不仅欣赏美景、融入韩江两岸的节庆气氛，还可以参观著名景点，或体验巴拿山缆车，或在山茶半岛潜水观看珊瑚，乘独木舟前往占婆岛（Cu Lao Cham）… 还有许多其他有趣的项目等待游客去发现。

联系岘港旅游服务团队和越南中部旅游服务 Vietlook Travel 获取详细的日程支持，根据需求选择服务套餐。

posts.title: Hanoi Fireworks Festival
posts.excerpt: Hanoi Fireworks Festival takes place on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, this is an occasion to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Liberation of the South and the reunification of the country. The
posts.contentHtml:
Hanoi Fireworks Festival takes place on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, this is an occasion to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Liberation of the South and the reunification of the country. The fireworks festival has a low-altitude and pyrotechnic display at the F1 racing track, Phu Do ward, Nam Tu Liem district.

The live TV program “Vang mai khuc khai hoan” will display high-altitude and low-altitude fireworks at the multi-purpose stage, taking place at Thong Nhat park, expected time from 21:45 to 22:00 on April 27.

Hanoi Fireworks display locations on the occasion of April 30 – May 1

At public locations

The fireworks display location is a multi-purpose stage located close to the edge of Bay Mau Lake, about 300 m from the park gate on Le Duan street. The best place to watch the fireworks is in the park, a spacious, airy space and completely free for visitors to admire the fireworks on the occasion.

Visitors from Tran Nhan Tong and Nguyen Dinh Chieu streets will enjoy beautiful fireworks because they are very close to the shooting location. On weekends, the walking street in the Park will not have fences so that people and tourists can easily walk around and watch the fireworks.

In addition, people and tourists can also admire the fireworks display on Le Duan, Dai Co Viet, Dao Duy Anh, Xa Dan streets or around Thien Quang lake, or apartment buildings near the shooting location, especially at Prime Center (Quang Trung street), Ocean Park (Dao Duy Anh street), Hoa Phat Tower (Giai Phong street), Bach Khoa University… tourists will enjoy the full beauty of the fireworks.

Watching fireworks on April 30 at coffee shops

There are coffee shops near Thong Nhat Park and on high floors where visitors can sip coffee while watching beautiful fireworks displays such as Kitsune Coffee at 378 Le Duan (11th floor), Aries Rooftop Coffee at 8 O Cho Dua (9th floor) or Helios Skyview at 150 Ton Duc Thang (8th floor)…

The Sipping Bar Waterfront is a coffee shop overlooking the lake, with a beautiful view, so during the holidays, seats are arranged both indoors and outdoors. Especially on the occasion of fireworks, the shop often offers free parking for visitors, visitors can buy coffee and find the best spot to watch the fireworks.

On Nguyen Dinh Chieu Street, there are many coffee shops with beautiful views such as: Joah, An Kinh Bac, Hanoian, Industry, Shinee, 80 plus, Renée… however, the view from the shops here will not be as beautiful as the shops near Thong Nhat Park, because there are green branches blocking the view.

So if you are looking for a holiday during the 30/4 – 1/5 holiday, sign up for a Hanoi tour to admire the brilliant fireworks, and enjoy delicious dishes with the rich flavor of Hanoi right on the walking street, Hoan Kiem Lake, while enjoying the poetic scenery, or enjoy a cup of coffee while watching the brilliant fireworks during the holiday.

In addition, visitors should visit Hanoi during the blooming lily season, visitors will encounter cars full of flowers, weaving through every street corner, exuding a sweet fragrance in the wind.

That image not only gives you a picture of Hanoi’s approaching summer, and the most beautiful lily season is in April, wallflowers are grown in the suburbs of Hanoi such as Tay Tuu, Me Linh, Dan Phuong… after the flowers are harvested, people often bring them to Hanoi to sell or traders return and distribute them to the flower markets that fill Hanoi.

The flowers usually bloom for 3 weeks, but are most beautiful in mid-April, the lily flower exudes a sweet fragrance, suitable for all spaces, this flower is often used to decorate the living room, or as a gift in early summer.

Besides, in the center of Hanoi, along the streets full of tamarind leaves, along the tamarind tree roots are changing leaves spread out like a carpet, especially on the streets such as: Tran Hung Dao, Ly Thuong Kiet, Phan Dinh Phung, Dien Bien Phu…

It can be said that the beauty of the lily flower, and the season of tamarind leaves changing like a signal that summer has come, creating a beautiful summer picture, bringing you the most enjoyable vacation.
posts.excerptZh: 河内烟花节在4月30日至5月1日期间举行，这是庆祝南方解放、国家统一50周年的时刻。烟花节在南慈廉郡 Phu Do 坊的 F1 赛道举行低空和烟火表演。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
河内烟花节在4月30日 – 5月1日期间举行，这是庆祝南方解放、国家统一50周年的时刻。烟花节在南慈廉郡 Phu Do 坊的 F1 赛道举行低空和烟火表演。

电视直播节目“Vang mai khuc khai hoan”将在统一公园（Thong Nhat）的多功能舞台上燃放高空和低空烟花，预计时间为4月27日21:45至22:00。

4月30日 – 5月1日河内烟花燃放地点

公共场所

烟花燃放地点是靠近 Bay Mau 湖边的多功能舞台，距 Le Duan 街公园大门约300米。观看烟花的最佳地点是公园内，空间开阔通透，游客完全免费欣赏节日烟花。

从 Tran Nhan Tong 街和 Nguyen Dinh Chieu 街出发的游客将欣赏到美丽的烟花，因为这里离燃放地点非常近。周末时，公园步行街不设围栏，方便民众和游客随意走动观看烟花。

此外，民众和游客还可以在 Le Duan、Dai Co Viet、Dao Duy Anh、Xa Dan 街，或 Thien Quang 湖周围，或燃放地点附近的公寓楼观赏烟花，尤其是 Prime Center（Quang Trung 街）、Ocean Park（Dao Duy Anh 街）、Hoa Phat Tower（Giai Phong 街）、河内科技大学（Bach Khoa）等… 游客将欣赏到烟花的完整之美。

在咖啡馆观看4月30日的烟花

统一公园附近和高层楼上有一些咖啡馆，游客可以一边品咖啡一边观赏美丽的烟花表演，例如 Le Duan 378号（11楼）的 Kitsune Coffee、O Cho Dua 8号（9楼）的 Aries Rooftop Coffee 或 Ton Duc Thang 150号（8楼）的 Helios Skyview…

The Sipping Bar Waterfront 是一家俯瞰湖面的咖啡馆，景色优美，因此在节假日，室内外均设有座位。尤其在燃放烟花之际，店家通常为游客提供免费停车，游客可以购买咖啡并找到观看烟花的最佳位置。

在 Nguyen Dinh Chieu 街上，有许多景观优美的咖啡馆，例如：Joah、An Kinh Bac、Hanoian、Industry、Shinee、80 plus、Renée… 不过，这里咖啡馆的景色不如统一公园附近的店铺，因为有绿色的树枝遮挡视线。

所以如果您在寻找4月30日 – 5月1日假期的行程，请报名参加 河内旅游团 ，欣赏灿烂的烟花，并在步行街、还剑湖边品尝带有浓郁河内风味的美食，同时欣赏诗意的景色，或在节日期间一边喝咖啡一边观赏灿烂的烟花。

此外，游客应在百合花盛开的季节游览河内，您会看到满载鲜花的车辆穿梭于每个街角，在风中散发出甜美的芬芳。

这一景象不仅让您看到河内初夏的画面，最美的百合季节在4月，壁花种植在河内郊区，如 Tay Tuu、Me Linh、Dan Phuong… 花朵收割后，人们通常会带到河内出售，或商贩返回后分销到遍布河内的花市。

花期通常为3周，但4月中旬最美，百合花散发甜美的香气，适合各种空间，这种花常用来装饰客厅，或在初夏作为礼物。

此外，在河内市中心，沿着满是罗望子叶的街道，罗望子树根旁换叶的叶子像地毯一样铺开，尤其是在 Tran Hung Dao、Ly Thuong Kiet、Phan Dinh Phung、Dien Bien Phu 等街道…

可以说，百合花之美以及罗望子换叶的季节，仿佛夏天到来的信号，描绘出一幅美丽的夏日画卷，带给您最愉快的假期。

posts.title: Non La Festival Ninh Binh
posts.excerpt: The Non La Festival Ninh Binh takes place from April 30 to May 3, with many unique cultural activities to honor the image of traditional Vietnamese conical hats, to tourists and international friends.
posts.contentHtml:
The Non La Festival Ninh Binh takes place from April 30 to May 3, with many unique cultural activities to honor the image of traditional Vietnamese conical hats, to tourists and international friends.

Traveling Ninh Binh on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, visitors will be able to participate in many exciting cultural activities, parades and experience the art of making handmade hats. The Conical Hat Festival in Ninh Binh, Ha Nam takes place from April 30 to May 3, not only honoring the beauty of conical hats, but also being a cultural symbol to develop local tourism.

The conical hat looks simple, but it contains a profound culture, clearly showing the memories of Vietnamese people over the centuries. At the spiritual tourist destination of Hoa Lu ancient capital, the conical hat festival will open up a diverse cultural space of the ancient capital, attracting a large number of people and tourists to attend. This is also an opportunity for visitors to admire the beauty of Tam Coc – Bich Dong and admire the poetic natural scenery.

It can be said that participating in the conical hat festival, visitors not only admire the traditional beauty, but also live in the traditional flow that is both ancient and modern, bringing visitors memories of Vietnamese culture.

Visitors on a tour Ninh Binh from April 30 to May 3 will be able to participate in unique cultural and artistic events. Vietnam Conical Hat Festival is one of the most magnificent artistic activities ever in Ninh Binh.

The opening program is Hoa Lu Brocade from April 30 at Tam Coc Wharf, a large-scale ancient costume performance event, visitors will admire the splendid beauty in costumes of many dynasties of the South. This is not only a fashion show of Hoa Lu Brocade but also recreates the depth of history and the quintessence of Vietnamese culture, helping visitors have the opportunity to learn more about the culture between the modern and the past.

On May 1 and 2, the cultural and artistic space takes place at Tam Coc Wharf, the festival brings the live show Hoa Lu Vu Hoa, set in the beautiful natural landscape, recreated in the cultural space of traditional Vietnamese craft villages, through programs with dances, music, the stories of Hoa Lu Vu Hoa will bring visitors an impressive and profound musical feast, and is the pride of the people of the Ancient Capital.

In addition, the Ninh Binh conical hat festival also has many special activities that bring people and tourists an extremely romantic musical space, especially at night, the Nhuom Sac Luu Giang music scene at Tam Coc boat station.

When the sunset falls, the music stage is a place where deep and soulful melodies converge with the participation of artists such as Vu Cat Tuong, Bui Cong Nam, Phuong Phuong Thao… a special performance program between the music and the natural scenery, creating an unforgettable experience when traveling to Ninh Binh on the occasion of April 30 – May 1.

In addition to the conical hat activities, the Viet Nam Festival also brings visitors experiences of the Vietnamese countryside. On May 3, the scene of running through the village stretching from Tam Chuc (Ha Nam) to Tam Coc (Ninh Binh) is recreated. Participants will cross the fields and peaceful village roads, and visitors will be immersed in the intersection between the past and the present.

The Ninh Binh Conical Hat Festival takes place in a vibrant atmosphere, with many unique cultural events to honor the image of the conical hat and traditional Vietnamese craft villages that have been preserved and promoted to this day.
posts.excerptZh: 宁平斗笠节于4月30日至5月3日举行，有许多独特的文化活动，向游客和国际友人推介越南传统斗笠的形象。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
宁平斗笠节于4月30日至5月3日举行，有许多独特的文化活动，向游客和国际友人推介越南传统斗笠的形象。

游览宁平 ，恰逢4月30日——5月1日假期，游客将能参加许多精彩的文化活动、游行，并体验手工制作斗笠的艺术。河南宁平的斗笠节于4月30日至5月3日举行，不仅推崇斗笠之美，也是发展当地旅游的文化象征。

斗笠看似简单，却蕴含着深厚的文化，清晰地体现了越南人数百年来的记忆。在灵修旅游目的地华闾古都，斗笠节将开启古都多元的文化空间，吸引大量民众和游客参加。这也是游客欣赏三谷——碧洞之美、欣赏诗意自然风光的机会。

可以说，参加斗笠节，游客不仅欣赏传统之美，还生活在既古老又现代的传统潮流中，给游客带来越南文化的回忆。

参加 宁平之旅 的游客，在4月30日至5月3日将能参加独特的文化艺术活动。越南斗笠节是宁平有史以来最宏大的艺术活动之一。

开幕节目是4月30日在三谷码头举行的华闾锦缎（Hoa Lu Brocade），一场大型古装表演活动，游客将欣赏到南方多个朝代服饰的华丽之美。这不仅是华闾锦缎的时装秀，还再现了历史的深度和越南文化的精髓，让游客有机会进一步了解现代与过去之间的文化。

5月1日和2日，文化艺术空间在三谷码头举行，节日带来现场演出《华闾舞华》（Hoa Lu Vu Hoa），以美丽的自然景观为背景，再现于越南传统手工艺村的文化空间，通过舞蹈、音乐节目，华闾舞华的故事将给游客带来令人印象深刻而深刻的音乐盛宴，也是古都人民的骄傲。

此外，宁平斗笠节还有许多特别活动，为民众和游客带来极其浪漫的音乐空间，尤其是夜晚在三谷船站的“染色柳江”（Nhuom Sac Luu Giang）音乐场景。

日落时分，音乐舞台是深沉而有灵魂的旋律汇聚之处，有 Vu Cat Tuong、Bui Cong Nam、Phuong Phuong Thao 等艺术家参与，音乐与自然风光之间的特别演出节目，为4月30日——5月1日假期游览宁平创造难忘的体验。

除了斗笠活动，越南节还为游客带来越南乡村的体验。5月3日，再现了从三祝（Tam Chuc，河南）到三谷（宁平）绵延的穿村跑场景。参与者将穿过田野和宁静的乡村道路，游客将沉浸在过去与现在的交汇之中。

宁平斗笠节在热闹的氛围中举行，有许多独特的文化活动，推崇斗笠的形象和保存推广至今的越南传统手工艺村。

posts.title: Ha Long Carnival
posts.excerpt: Ha Long Carnival takes place on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, serving locals and tourists to come and enjoy, besides there are many programs and events taking place during the holiday, especially
posts.contentHtml:
Ha Long Carnival takes place on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, serving locals and tourists to come and enjoy, besides there are many programs and events taking place during the holiday, especially the vibrant fireworks festival.

Ha Long is a place recognized by UNESCO as a World Natural Heritage 3 times, in addition Ha Long is also the place where many traditional and modern festivals take place. Especially on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, Ha Long also holds the Carnival with the theme “Connecting heritage, pioneering to shine”.

This year’s Carnival takes place at Sun Carnaval Square and Vo Nguyen Giap Street, this is one of the annual festivals in Ha Long, on a large scale.

Besides the Carnival, there are fashion shows and street dances taking place throughout the 2 days of April 30 – May 1. So if you travel Ha Long on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, you will join in the atmosphere of the festival.

Before the Carnaval festival, there will be the festival of Duc Ong Tran Quoc Nghien Temple, and the Ha Long Beer and Squid Festival will open at 3:00 p.m. on April 29, and the Quang Ninh Summer OCOP Fair will take place in a vibrant atmosphere from April 29 to May 4 to serve the people and visitors.

Carnaval is not only an annual festival in Ha Long, but it is also a typical cultural event of new strategic significance, affirming the position of Ha Long on the Vietnam tourism map.

This year’s Carnaval has become a place where unique intangible cultural heritages of the three regions of the country converge, such as: Binh Lieu Then singing, Hue royal court music, Central Highlands gongs, Southern amateur music… all clearly expressed through unique artistic language.

This year’s Ha Long Carnaval Festival is divided into 4 parts, the opening of the Ha Long Carnaval grand ball, the electronic music party, and the fireworks display along with many other special programs to welcome the summer of Ha Long.

It is expected that in the coming time, Ha Long will re-organize traditional festivals such as: New Rice Celebration of the Tay people, Dai Phan Festival of the San Diu ethnic group, Loi Am Pagoda Festival, Cai Lan Temple Festival, Long Tien Pagoda Festival… and traditional village festivals such as: Bang Ca Village Festival, King Le Thai To Temple Festival…

On the occasion of April 30 – May 1, Ha Long will also hold a high-altitude fireworks display at 9:30 p.m. on May 1, during the Carnaval festival in the Ha Long coastal area, lasting 15 minutes, promising to bring a night of eye-catching festival for locals and tourists during the holiday.

 

The fireworks displays create a unique identity for Ha Long, creating a diverse cultural space, spreading the value of heritage, cultural integration and development.

So if you are planning to find yourself a vacation during the holidays, then do not hesitate to join Vietlook travel to Ha Long tour during the holidays to experience the most interesting things during your vacation.

It can be said that Ha Long is gradually changing, creating many unique tourism products, bringing visitors unique experiences when visiting Ha Long, no matter what season of the year visitors come to Ha Long, they will encounter beautiful landscapes.
posts.excerptZh: 下龙狂欢节在4月30日至5月1日假期期间举行，供当地居民和游客前来欣赏，此外假期期间还有许多活动和节目，尤其是热闹非凡的烟花节。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
下龙狂欢节在4月30日–5月1日假期期间举行，供当地居民和游客前来欣赏，此外假期期间还有许多活动和节目，尤其是热闹非凡的烟花节。

下龙被联合国教科文组织三次认定为世界自然遗产，此外下龙还是许多传统和现代节日举办的地方。尤其是在4月30日–5月1日假期期间，下龙还会举办以“连接遗产，先锋闪耀”为主题的狂欢节。

今年的狂欢节在太阳狂欢广场（Sun Carnaval Square）和武元甲街举行，这是下龙每年举办的大型节日之一。

除了狂欢节之外，在4月30日–5月1日的两天里还有时装秀和街舞表演。因此如果您 前往下龙旅行 恰逢4月30日–5月1日假期，您将融入节日的氛围。

在狂欢节之前，将举行德翁陈国献庙（Duc Ong Tran Quoc Nghien）庙会，下龙啤酒鱿鱼节将于4月29日下午3点开幕，广宁夏季OCOP展销会将于4月29日至5月4日在热闹的氛围中举行，为民众和游客服务。

狂欢节不仅是下龙每年举办的节日，也是具有新战略意义的典型文化活动，确立了下龙在越南旅游版图上的地位。

今年的狂欢节成为全国三个地区独特非物质文化遗产汇聚之地，如：平辽（Binh Lieu）的天歌（Then）、顺化宫廷音乐、西原锣鼓、南部才子音乐……都通过独特的艺术语言得到了清晰的展现。

今年的下龙狂欢节分为4个部分，包括下龙狂欢节盛大舞会开幕、电子音乐派对、烟花表演，以及许多其他特别节目，迎接下龙的夏天。

预计在未来一段时间，下龙将重新举办传统节日，如：岱族新米节、山由族大蟠节（Dai Phan）、Loi Am寺庙会、Cai Lan庙会、龙仙寺（Long Tien）庙会……以及传统村庆，如：Bang Ca村庆、黎太祖庙会……

在4月30日–5月1日假期期间，下龙还将于5月1日晚上9点30分在下龙海滨地区狂欢节期间举行高空烟花表演，时长15分钟，有望为当地居民和游客在假期带来一个引人注目的节日之夜。

 

烟花表演为下龙打造了独特的标识，创造出多元的文化空间，传播遗产价值、文化融合与发展。

因此，如果您正计划在假期期间为自己找一个度假的地方，请毫不犹豫地跟随Vietlook Travel参加 下龙之旅 ，在假期中体验最有趣的事物。

可以说，下龙正在逐步改变，打造出许多独特的旅游产品，为游客带来游览下龙的独特体验，无论游客在一年中的哪个季节来到下龙，都将遇到美丽的风景。

posts.title: Exciting activities in Da Nang on April 30
posts.excerpt: The Da Nang April 30 – May 1 holiday lasts for 5 days, so Da Nang is a destination chosen by many tourists during the holiday. This place not only has poetic beaches or famous landmarks, but when comi
posts.contentHtml:
The Da Nang April 30 – May 1 holiday lasts for 5 days, so Da Nang is a destination chosen by many tourists during the holiday. This place not only has poetic beaches or famous landmarks, but when coming to Da Nang on the occasion of April 30 and May 1, tourists can also participate in attractive art activities taking place throughout the city.

The April 30 and May 1 holidays are also the occasion for Da Nang to begin the opening of the beach tourism season. This year’s beach tourism season begins on April 26 with the theme “Blue Wave Dance” taking place on all the beaches of Da Nang.

The event includes activities on the sea such as: “Overcoming the Summer Waves”, “Son Tra Moments”, live painting, Danang Color Race and beach sports such as football, beach rugby…

Artistic kite flying on the beach of Da Nang

The event will take place from 9am to 6pm from April 26 to the holiday at Da Nang East Sea Park, bringing people and tourists to watch colorful art performances in the sky of Da Nang.

In the sky of Da Nang with many colorful kites flying, there are kites designed in the shape of funny animals, looking like a colorful painting, this will be a unique vacation in Da Nang, reminding visitors of their childhood memories.

Lion Dance Festival at Da Nang Downtown

The festival takes place from May 1 to 3 at Sun Wheel Square, with the participation of 27 lion dance teams from all over the country, with the themes “night dragon light”, “lion earth treasure”, “mai hoa thung” and traditional lighting and sound techniques.

The festival includes circus magic performances, bartenders, folk games and night market ku along with 50 craft beer food stalls, allowing visitors to enjoy and capture beautiful moments.

The festival takes place on Than Tai Mountain

During the April 30 – May 1 holiday, many exciting activities take place at Than Tai Mountain Hot Spring Park to celebrate the big holiday. If you have the opportunity to travel Da Nang during the April 30 – May 1 holiday, visitors should visit and relax at Than Tai Mountain to join in the exciting festival events.

At Nui Than Tai, in addition to areas such as mineral baths, mud baths, water parks… visitors can also visit the bird garden – mushroom garden, love forest, picnic area and enjoy an attractive outdoor BBQ party.

In addition, visitors can also watch monkey circus, python circus, interact with parrots and check in with three-headed dinosaurs… promising to bring visitors the most memorable vacation.

Japanese festival in Da Nang Mikazuki

On the 30/4 – 1/5 holiday, at the Da Nang Mikazuki scenic area, there will be a fire dance, water music and brilliant fireworks show. On the night of the 30th, visitors will enjoy a seafood buffet with Japanese flavors, and receive sake as a gift…

Gifts on the 30/4 holiday at Ba Na Hills

At Ba Na Hills on the occasion of the 30/4 holiday, there are many sunflowers blooming, visitors will be satisfied to see the flowers blooming and check in for themselves beautiful pictures next to the flowers blooming under the golden sunshine.

Especially when traveling to Ba Na during the 30/4 – 1/5 holiday this year, visitors should wear red flag shirts with yellow stars to visit the wax museum and will be given 500ml of fresh beer…

So above are the exciting activities in Da Nang on April 30, please join Vietlook Travel on the Da Nang April 30 tour right on this occasion to immerse yourself in the events and festivals that this place brings to visitors.
posts.excerptZh: 岘港4月30日至5月1日的假期长达5天，因此岘港是许多游客在假期选择的目的地。这里不仅有如诗如画的海滩和著名的地标，在4月30日和5月1日来到岘港，游客还可以参加遍布全市的精彩艺术活动。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
岘港4月30日 – 5月1日的假期长达5天，因此岘港是许多游客在假期选择的目的地。这里不仅有如诗如画的海滩和著名的地标，在4月30日和5月1日来到岘港，游客还可以参加遍布全市的精彩艺术活动。

4月30日和5月1日假期也是岘港开启海滩旅游季的时机。今年的海滩旅游季于4月26日拉开帷幕，主题为“蓝色之浪舞动”，在岘港所有海滩举行。

活动包括海上项目，例如：“乘风破浪迎夏”、“山茶时光”、现场绘画、Danang Color Race，以及足球、沙滩橄榄球等沙滩运动……

岘港海滩上的艺术风筝放飞

活动将于4月26日至假期期间每天上午9点至下午6点在岘港东海公园举行，让市民和游客观赏岘港天空中色彩缤纷的艺术表演。

岘港的天空中飘着许多五彩缤纷的风筝，其中有设计成有趣动物形状的风筝，宛如一幅色彩斑斓的画卷，这将是在岘港一次独特的假期，勾起游客的童年回忆。

岘港市中心舞狮节

该节日于5月1日至3日在太阳摩天轮广场（Sun Wheel）举行，来自全国各地的27支舞狮队参加，主题为“夜龙之光”、“狮地宝藏”、“梅花桩”，并运用传统的灯光和音响技术。

节日包括马戏魔术表演、调酒师表演、民间游戏和夜市，以及50个精酿啤酒美食摊位，让游客尽情享受并捕捉美好瞬间。

节庆活动在神财山举行

在4月30日 – 5月1日假期期间，神财山温泉公园举办许多精彩的活动来庆祝这个大假期。如果您有机会在4月30日 – 5月1日假期 前往岘港旅游 ，游客应该前往神财山参观并放松身心，参与精彩的节庆活动。

在神财山，除了矿泉浴、泥浴、水上乐园等区域外，游客还可以参观鸟园 – 蘑菇园、爱情森林、野餐区，并享受诱人的户外烧烤派对。

此外，游客还可以观看猴子马戏、蟒蛇马戏，与鹦鹉互动，并与三头恐龙合影打卡……有望带给游客最难忘的假期。

岘港日本节 Mikazuki

在4月30日 – 5月1日假期，岘港Mikazuki景区将举办火舞、水上音乐和绚丽的烟花表演。30日晚，游客将享用日式风味的海鲜自助餐，并获赠清酒……

巴拿山4月30日假期的礼物

在4月30日假期期间，巴拿山（Ba Na Hills）有许多向日葵盛开，游客将满足地欣赏盛开的鲜花，并在金色阳光下与盛开的花朵合影，留下美丽的照片。

特别是今年在4月30日 – 5月1日假期前往巴拿旅游时，游客应穿上金星红旗T恤参观蜡像馆，并将获赠500毫升鲜啤酒……

以上就是岘港4月30日的精彩活动，请在这个时机加入Vietlook Travel的 岘港4月30日旅游 ，亲身沉浸在这里为游客带来的活动和节庆之中。

posts.title: Specialty of Hanoi Com
posts.excerpt: Specialty of Hanoi Com, with a delicious and refreshing taste, and is a dish chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to visit Hanoi. This is not only a delicious dish but also has a pro
posts.contentHtml:
Specialty of Hanoi Com, with a delicious and refreshing taste, and is a dish chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to visit Hanoi. This is not only a delicious dish but also has a profound cultural value that reflects the unique culinary culture of Hanoi.

Com is made from young sticky rice, and must be the fragrant and fragrant yellow sticky rice variety to bring delicious and sticky golden rice grains. To get delicious com grains, the person making com must carefully select the rice flowers, then bring them back to separate the rice grains, dry the rice until ripe and peel off the husk to make the green and fragrant rice grains look very attractive.

Many tourists when traveling to Hanoi enjoy com and buy it as a gift, even buy it as a gift with the specialty of com lang vong Hanoi, a famous specialty that has existed for generations.

Com has a light green color, which is the color of young rice, and com is wrapped in fresh lotus leaves, creating a unique delicious flavor that blends the aroma of com, the aroma of lotus leaves with com and the green season of lotus leaves, bringing a very unique delicious flavor of Northern cuisine.

Com is divided into early season com, late season com, young com, old com, rustic com, and lake com… in which early season com is around February – April, at this time the young rice grains have the aroma of rice milk, late season com is usually in July – October, at this time the rice grains are more fatty, com is most enjoyable to enjoy when the weather is cold, watching the scenery and enjoying young com in the autumn weather of Hanoi, there is nothing more enjoyable.

Com is not only enjoyed directly but also processed into many different delicious dishes such as: Com sticky rice, Com cake, Com sweet soup, Com stir-fried… bringing a very unique delicious flavor of Hanoi cuisine.

It can be said that Hanoi, in addition to the French village spaces, sidewalk shops, also has many local specialties. If you have the opportunity to travel  Hanoi, enjoy the sidewalk dishes, and admire the scenery of Hanoi, especially on the old streets when the night falls, visitors will be immersed in the vibrant music…

In addition, to have the most beautiful trip to Hanoi, from August to November and spring from March to April. Many tourists often choose Hanoi in autumn to walk and admire the scenery under the fallen yellow leaves, next to the blue sky with the cool breeze, the scent of milk flowers and many other colorful flowers.

Hanoi attractions

Tran Quoc Pagoda

One of the ancient pagodas, located right on the east side of West Lake, the majestic pagoda is surrounded by a clear lake, a peaceful scene.

Temple of Literature – Quoc Tu Giam

As one of the first schools in Vietnam, visitors come here to visit the solemn campus or admire the lotus ponds, water lily ponds… inside the Temple of Literature – Quoc Tu Giam still preserves valuable artifacts and documents, especially the 82 doctoral steles recognized by UNESCO as “World Documentary Heritage”.

Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum

For any tourist when visiting Hanoi for sightseeing, they cannot miss the attraction such as Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, in the morning visitors will attend the flag raising or lowering ceremony at 9pm every day in a solemn atmosphere.

Museum

Visitors come here not only to visit but also to learn more about Vietnamese culture, so most of the Hanoi tour itinerary cannot miss the destination such as: the Museum of Ethnology where 15,000 artifacts, 42,000 documentary films, pictures and other documents are preserved and displayed.

So it can be said that when visiting Hanoi, you not only enjoy delicious and attractive dishes such as Com Lang Vong, but when coming to Hanoi, you also visit famous landmarks, historical sites, ancient temples, or traditional craft villages… will bring you the most enjoyable experiences.
posts.excerptZh: 河内特产——米（Com，青米片），味道鲜美清爽，是许多游客有机会游览河内时选择的菜肴。这不仅是一道美味佳肴，还具有深厚的文化价值，反映了河内独特的饮食文化。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
河内特产——米（Com，青米片），味道鲜美清爽，是许多游客有机会游览河内时选择的菜肴。这不仅是一道美味佳肴，还具有深厚的文化价值，反映了河内独特的饮食文化。

Com 由嫩糯米制成，必须是芳香的黄糯米品种，才能得到美味黏糯的金色米粒。为了得到美味的 com 米粒，制作 com 的人必须仔细挑选稻花，然后带回来分离米粒，将稻谷晒到成熟并剥去外壳，制成看起来非常诱人的青绿芳香的米粒。

许多游客游览河内时会品尝 com 并购买作为礼物，甚至将其与河内的特产榔望（Vong）村 com 一起作为礼物购买，这是一种世代传承的著名特产。

Com 呈淡绿色，是嫩稻的颜色，并用新鲜荷叶包裹，创造出独特美味的风味，融合了 com 的香气、荷叶的香气，以及荷叶的青绿季节，带来非常独特的北方美食美味。

Com 分为早季 com、晚季 com、嫩 com、老 com、乡野 com 和湖 com…其中早季 com 大约在2月–4月，此时嫩米粒带有米浆的香气；晚季 com 通常在7月–10月，此时米粒更丰腴；天气凉爽时享用 com 最为惬意，在河内的秋日天气里，一边观赏风景一边享用嫩 com，没有什么比这更惬意了。

Com 不仅可以直接食用，还可以加工成许多不同的美味佳肴，如：com 糯米饭、com 饼、com 甜汤、炒 com…带来非常独特的河内美食美味。

可以说，河内除了法式村落空间、街边小店外，还有许多地方特产。如果您有机会 游览河内，享用街边小吃，欣赏河内的风景，尤其是夜幕降临时的老街，游客将沉浸在热闹的音乐中…

此外，要拥有最美的河内之旅，应在8月至11月以及3月至4月的春季前往。许多游客常选择秋天的河内，在飘落的黄叶下漫步欣赏风景，旁边是蓝天、凉爽的微风、牛乳花（milk flower）的香气和许多其他五颜六色的花朵。

河内景点

镇国寺

最古老的寺庙之一，就位于西湖东侧，雄伟的寺庙被清澈的湖水环绕，景象宁静。

文庙——国子监

作为越南最早的学府之一，游客来到这里参观庄严的校园，或欣赏荷塘、睡莲池…文庙——国子监内仍保存着珍贵的文物和文献，尤其是被联合国教科文组织认定为“世界记忆遗产”的82块进士题名碑。

胡志明陵

对于任何前来河内观光的游客来说，不可错过胡志明陵这样的景点，每天早上游客将在庄严的气氛中参加升旗或降旗仪式，降旗仪式在晚上9点。

博物馆

游客来到这里不仅是参观，还要进一步了解越南文化，因此大多数河内旅游行程都不会错过这样的目的地：民族学博物馆，那里保存和展示着15,000件文物、42,000部纪录片、图片和其他文献。

因此可以说，游览河内时，您不仅享用榔望 com 这样美味诱人的菜肴，来到河内您还可以参观著名地标、历史遗迹、古寺或传统手工艺村…将带给您最愉快的体验。

posts.title: Nui Than Tai Hot Spring Park
posts.excerpt: Nui Than Tai Hot Spring Park, hidden in the nature reserve of Ba Na Nui Chua scenic area, where there is mountainous terrain with underground mineral springs and natural hot water sources. Nui Than Ta
posts.contentHtml:
Nui Than Tai Hot Spring Park, hidden in the nature reserve of Ba Na Nui Chua scenic area, where there is mountainous terrain with underground mineral springs and natural hot water sources.

Nui Than Tai is a tourist destination sought by many tourists, especially an attractive resort suitable for all ages, most tourists traveling to Da Nang visit Nui Than Tai Hot Spring Park.

After having enjoyed visiting the scenic spots of Da Nang, tourists often choose a peaceful resort, to have private time, and experience relaxation by soaking in natural mineral water, Nui Than Tai is a destination exclusively for tourists.

Coming to the Nui Than Tai scenic area, visitors will be able to participate in many interesting games, especially soaking in the mineral springs to dispel the hustle and bustle of everyday life. For children, participating in games at the water park with many games will make them excited.

Surrounding the Nui Than Tai scenic area are rows of cool green trees, with natural spring water, visitors can experience mud baths, soak in therapeutic methods, helping you have the most relaxing moments.

In addition, you can also bathe in onsen in Japanese style, which is currently one of the unique experiences in Vietnam. Experiencing the Nui Than Tai climbing tour at the end of the Da Nang tour is the best choice for you to relax before returning to the city.

If you are a person who loves to explore new things and participate in games, Nui Than Tai Park is the destination for you with games such as: wave pool on the mountainside, spiral slide, Long Tien Cave…

In addition, in the Nui Than Tai scenic area, there are also high-class restaurants, luxury resorts where you can stay overnight to relax and enjoy the interesting things that this place brings to visitors, especially watching free 9D to 12D movies.

Nui Than Tai scenic area is built in a cool green campus, giving visitors the most comfortable vacation, especially visitors on a one-day tour Ba Na, Nui Than Tai scenic area is an indispensable choice.

The resort is both luxurious, peaceful, and has a diverse entertainment area, airy space, especially the Than Tai hot spring park also has many interesting water games.

At the Than Tai Mountain Hot Spring Resort, there is also a spiritual tourist destination, the Than Tai Temple, where visitors often come to pray for luck, health and peace.

It can be said that Nui Than Hot Spring Park is the most ideal resort in Da Nang. When you have enjoyed exploring all the famous sights in Da Nang, Nui Than Hot Spring Park is the final resort in the journey of visitors, bringing them experiences and moments of relaxation before returning to their daily work.

Highlights when visiting Than Tai Mountain

  • Nhan Tai Hot Spring Resort is a destination for tourists who love to admire the beauty of nature and discover new things.
  • Soaking in the hot water from nature, and participating in those underwater activities will be one of the unique experiences at Than Tai Mountain scenic area.Bathing in natural mineral mud, bathing in Onsen Tower in Japanese style.
  • Watching 9D to 12D movies for free, and enjoying delicious cuisine at the restaurant, experiencing a luxurious resort… and many more interesting things are waiting for visitors to discover.
posts.excerptZh: 神台山温泉公园（Nui Than Tai Hot Spring Park）隐藏在巴拿—山母（Ba Na Nui Chua）风景区的自然保护区内，这里山地地形起伏，拥有地下矿泉和天然热水源。神台山……
posts.contentHtmlZh:
神台山温泉公园（Nui Than Tai Hot Spring Park）隐藏在巴拿—山母（Ba Na Nui Chua）风景区的自然保护区内，这里山地地形起伏，拥有地下矿泉和天然热水源。

神台山是众多游客寻访的旅游目的地，尤其是一处老少皆宜的迷人度假胜地，大多数来岘港旅行的游客都会游览神台山温泉公园。

在游览完岘港的名胜景点之后，游客往往会选择一处宁静的度假胜地，享受属于自己的私人时光，通过浸泡天然矿泉水来体验放松，神台山正是专为游客打造的目的地。

来到神台山风景区，游客可以参与许多有趣的游乐项目，尤其是浸泡矿泉，驱散日常生活的喧嚣。对孩子们来说，在设有众多游乐设施的水上乐园玩耍会让他们兴奋不已。

神台山风景区四周环绕着一排排清凉的绿树，拥有天然泉水，游客可以体验泥浆浴、疗养浸泡，度过最放松的时光。

此外，您还可以体验日式温泉（onsen）泡浴，这是目前越南独具特色的体验之一。在 岘港之旅 的最后体验神台山攀登之旅，是您返回市区前放松身心的最佳选择。

如果您是热爱探索新事物、喜欢参与游乐项目的人，神台山公园就是为您准备的目的地，这里有山腰造浪池、螺旋滑梯、龙仙洞（Long Tien Cave）等项目……

此外，神台山风景区内还有高档餐厅和豪华度假村，您可以在此过夜放松，享受这里带给游客的种种乐趣，尤其是免费观看9D至12D电影。

神台山风景区建在清凉的绿色园区中，为游客提供最舒适的假期，尤其是参加 巴拿一日游的游客，神台山风景区是必不可少的选择。

这座度假村既奢华又宁静，设有多样的娱乐区，空间通透开阔，尤其是神台温泉公园还有许多有趣的水上游戏。

在神台山温泉度假村内，还有一处精神旅游目的地——神台寺（Than Tai Temple），游客常来此祈求好运、健康与平安。

可以说，神台山温泉公园是岘港最理想的度假胜地。当您游览完岘港所有著名景点后，神台山温泉公园是旅程中的最后一站，在您重返日常工作之前，带给您放松的体验与时光。

游览神台山的亮点

  • 神台温泉度假村是热爱欣赏自然之美、发现新鲜事物的游客的目的地。
  • 浸泡来自大自然的热水，并参与各种水下活动，将成为神台山风景区独特的体验之一。体验天然矿泥浴，以及日式温泉塔（Onsen Tower）泡浴。
  • 免费观看9D至12D电影，在餐厅品尝美味佳肴，体验奢华度假村……还有更多有趣的事物等待游客去发现。

posts.title: Explore the beauty of Huong Quang Phu Cau village for half a day
posts.excerpt: Explore the beauty of Huong Quang Phu Cau village for half a day, will bring you the most enjoyable experiences, Huong Quang Phu Cau village is located right on the outskirts of Hanoi, is one of the t
posts.contentHtml:
Explore the beauty of Huong Quang Phu Cau village for half a day, will bring you the most enjoyable experiences, Huong Quang Phu Cau village is located right on the outskirts of Hanoi, is one of the traditional craft villages, the village is currently the hottest check-in spot.

Coming to Huong Quang Phu Cau village, you will be able to freely check in for yourself beautiful photos next to colorful bundles of incense, arranged in many different styles, which will bring you beautiful photos. From Hanoi, you travel to Huong Quang Phu Cau village, you only need half a day to fully explore the beauty of the traditional incense village.

In the morning, the car will pick you up at the meeting point in Hanoi capital, depart for Huong Quang Phu Cau village, if you travel on your own, you can go by motorbike or bus.

If you are a person who likes to sightsee, you should travel to Huong Quang Phu Cau village by motorbike while enjoying the scenery. When you get out of the inner city, you will be able to enjoy the peaceful and rustic countryside scenery that exudes its own beauty.

If you travel Huong Quang Phu Cau village by bus, from the center of Hanoi, you follow National Highway QL21B, Provincial Road 429, then take bus 91 from Yen Nghia bus station and depart through the villages. A scene appears right before your eyes like a rustic picture of the countryside.

When you arrive at Huong Quang Phu Cau village, you should walk around the village to visit and see how to make incense bundles. You can visit the production facilities and make incense sticks with the villagers.

You can see how people make things from the simple steps such as cutting bamboo, dyeing it with medicine, mixing incense powder and drying it in the sun. In addition, you can also chat with the incense makers, you can film the scene from the time of making until the finished incense bundles, which are one of the indispensable products in every family.

Nowadays, incense is not only sold domestically, but also exported abroad, not only developing the picture of Vietnamese countryside, but also bringing high income to the villagers, coming to Huong Quang Phu Cau village, you can walk around to admire the scenery and learn about the incense making process.

So if you want to explore the beauty of traditional Vietnamese craft villages, you don’t need to spend too much time, just half a day, you will be satisfied to explore the beauty of Huong Quang Phu Cau village and record the most beautiful moments with the villagers who are engrossed in making the most sophisticated products.
posts.titleZh: 半日探索广富球香村之美
posts.excerptZh: 用半天时间探索 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村之美，将为您带来最愉快的体验。Huong Quang Phu Cau 村位于河内郊区，是传统手工艺村之一，目前是
posts.contentHtmlZh:
用半天时间探索 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村之美，将为您带来最愉快的体验。Huong Quang Phu Cau 村位于河内郊区，是传统手工艺村之一，目前是最热门的打卡地。

来到 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村，您可以在五颜六色、以多种不同风格摆放的香束旁自由打卡，为自己拍下美丽的照片。从河内前往 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村，您只需半天时间就能充分领略传统香村之美。

早晨，车辆将在河内首都的集合点接您，出发前往 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村，如果您是自由行，可以骑摩托车或乘坐巴士前往。

如果您是喜欢观光的人，应该骑摩托车前往 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村，边骑边欣赏风景。走出市区后，您将欣赏到宁静质朴、散发着独特之美的乡村风光。

如果您乘坐巴士 前往 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村， 从河内市中心出发，沿着 QL21B 国道、429 省道，然后在 Yen Nghia 汽车站乘坐91路公交车，穿过各个村庄。一幅如同质朴乡村画卷般的景象就会出现在您眼前。

到达 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村后，您应该在村里走一走，参观并了解如何制作香束。您可以参观生产场所，并与村民一起制作香条。

您可以看到人们从砍竹子、用药水染色、混合香粉并在阳光下晾晒等简单步骤开始制作。此外，您还可以与制香人聊天，可以拍摄从制作到成品香束的全过程场景，香是每个家庭不可或缺的产品之一。

如今，香不仅在国内销售，还出口到国外，不仅发展了越南乡村的面貌，也为村民带来了高收入，来到 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村，您可以四处走走欣赏风景，并了解制香工艺。

因此，如果您想探索越南传统手工艺村之美，不需要花太多时间，只需半天，您就能满意地探索 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村之美，并与专注于制作最精巧产品的村民一起记录最美的瞬间。

posts.contentHtml:
If you are looking for an upcoming vacation, what is so attractive about the coastal city, so to see and admire the unique events and festivals, let’s travel with Vietlook to Da Nang tourism on the occasion of April 30 today.

Traveling Da Nang on the occasion of April 30 – May 1 knocks on the door to bring you the most enjoyable experiences, this is one of the brilliant destinations in the summer, you will immerse yourself in the jubilant atmosphere of the festival.

It can be said that Da Nang is the place where many brilliant festivals take place, especially on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, which wants to invite tourists to visit and enjoy, this is one of the wonderful experiences, where so many beautiful cultural exchanges and the rhythm of life of the coastal city.

posts.contentHtmlZh:

今年的海滩旅游季将在4月30日至5月1日期间举行，期间有许多艺术活动和许多游戏在海上开展，必将为游客带来一个欢乐的4月30日至5月1日假期。
