The experience of diving to see corals under the sea is a sport chosen by many tourists, to see the sparkling and fascinating coral reefs. So let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the top 5 coral diving spots you should know right below.

Speaking of the sparkling and fascinating coral spots, we must mention Hon Mun Nha Trang coral, Phu Quoc coral, Con Dao coral and the indispensable coral diving spot is Da Nang coral, with colorful coral reefs that are chosen by many tourists.

Coral diving has the following forms:
Snorkeling
This is one of the popular forms of diving, chosen by many tourists. Before diving, you will be instructed and equipped with necessary tools such as life jackets, diving goggles, and underwater snorkels. You will be amazed to see the beauty under the sea, with sparkling and fascinating coral reefs.

Scuba Diving

This is a diving tool for tourists who want to explore the beauty deep under the sea. Tourists dive with oxygen tanks, fins, life jackets, and diving goggles and listen to the instructions of professional guides will bring you the most interesting experience.

In addition, you can also experience walking on the seabed of Nha Trang (Sea Walking)

Walking on the seabed is one of the most unique and beautiful experiences in every summer when the weather is hot, visitors walk on the seabed, immerse themselves in the clear blue water, watch the colorful coral reefs and schools of fish swimming around, which will bring visitors the most exciting feeling.

The beautiful Hon Mun Nha Trang coral captivates many hearts, many tourists come and experience diving to see the sparkling and fascinating coral reefs and record beautiful pictures for themselves.

Phu Quoc coral

Phu Quoc is famous for its coral reefs, including both hard and soft corals, growing close together in beaches with many brilliant colors. In particular, in An Thoi archipelago, there are many coral diving spots such as: Hon Thom, Hon Roi, Hon Dam, Hon Dua… the best time to experience coral diving in Phu Quoc is from May to July, when the sea is calm and the water is very beautiful.

Con Dao coral

Con Dao sea is so clear that visitors can see all the way to the bottom. When it comes to coral in Con Dao, we must mention Hon Bay Canh, Hon Tai, Hon Tre, Hon Trung, Hon Trac, Hon Cau… with different colors that will bring a unique beauty, making visitors feel excited.

To experience coral diving in Con Dao, visitors should rent a boat to the island, and rent coral diving services. The best time to dive in Con Dao is from March to September every year.

Coral diving in Da Nang

Da Nang has many beautiful coral diving spots. If you have the opportunity to travel Da Nang in the summer, you should experience coral diving to feel the unique beauty of the seabed. The first coral diving spot in Da Nang is Son Tra coral with colorful coral reefs. It is a destination chosen by many tourists as a stopover during each summer vacation.

The most beautiful coral in Son Tra is Hon Sun, where the beautiful colors will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

Cua Lao Cham coral

A place where pristine beauty converges with magical sparkling coral reefs. The most beautiful time to travel to Cu Lao Cham is every summer when visitors can rent a canoe to go to the island and experience coral diving with magical sparkling coral reefs.

Cu Lao Cham Island has a spacious and airy conservation area with beautiful coral reefs of diverse colors. Visitors only need to dive about 3 meters or dive 6 meters below sea level to be amazed by the sparkling beauty.

Vinh Hy Bay Coral – Ninh Thuan

Vinh Hy Bay is a place that emerges like a pearl in the middle of the East Sea, with sparkling coral reefs. Visitors can both admire the beautiful natural scenery and experience scuba diving to see the sparkling coral.

Above are the beautiful coral viewing spots in the island paradise. If you are a lover of exploring the beauty of the ocean floor, come to this sea area once to see with your own eyes and admire the beauty of the sea floor with colorful sparkling coral reefs that will bring you the most exciting feeling.

In addition to the exciting experiences at sea, you can also enjoy fresh seafood such as lobster, king crab, and sea snails… bringing the delicious flavor unique to the island sea. To fully enjoy the beauty, visitors should come to the summer island paradise.
posts.titleZh: 你应该知道的五大珊瑚潜点
posts.excerptZh: 潜水观赏海底珊瑚是许多游客选择的运动，可以欣赏璀璨迷人的珊瑚礁。让我们跟随 Vietlook Travel 一起回顾下面这 5 大您应该知道的珊瑚潜水地点。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
潜水观赏海底珊瑚是许多游客选择的运动，可以欣赏璀璨迷人的珊瑚礁。让我们跟随 Vietlook Travel 一起回顾下面这 5 大您应该知道的珊瑚潜水地点。

说到璀璨迷人的珊瑚观赏地点，不得不提芽庄黑岛珊瑚、富国岛珊瑚、昆岛珊瑚，以及不可或缺的珊瑚潜水地点——岘港珊瑚，那里的五彩珊瑚礁深受众多游客青睐。

珊瑚潜水有以下几种形式：
浮潜
这是一种受欢迎的潜水形式，被许多游客选择。潜水前，您会得到指导，并配备救生衣、潜水镜和水下呼吸管等必要装备。您将惊叹于海底之美，看到璀璨迷人的珊瑚礁。

水肺潜水

这是一种供想要探索深海之美的游客使用的潜水方式。游客携带氧气瓶、脚蹼、救生衣和潜水镜下潜，并听从专业向导的指导，将带给您最有趣的体验。

此外，您还可以体验芽庄的海底漫步（Sea Walking）

海底漫步是每个炎热夏季最独特、最美妙的体验之一，游客在海底行走，沉浸在清澈的蓝色海水中，观看五彩斑斓的珊瑚礁和四处游动的鱼群，将带给游客最激动人心的感觉。

美丽的芽庄黑岛珊瑚俘获了许多人的心，许多游客前来体验潜水，观赏璀璨迷人的珊瑚礁，并为自己留下美丽的照片。

富国岛珊瑚

富国岛以其珊瑚礁而闻名，包括硬珊瑚和软珊瑚，紧密生长在色彩绚丽的海滩中。特别是在安泰群岛，有许多珊瑚潜水地点，例如：Hon Thom、Hon Roi、Hon Dam、Hon Dua…，体验富国岛珊瑚潜水的最佳时间是 5 月至 7 月，此时海面平静，海水非常美丽。

昆岛珊瑚

昆岛的海水清澈见底，游客可以一直看到海底。说到昆岛的珊瑚，不得不提 Hon Bay Canh、Hon Tai、Hon Tre、Hon Trung、Hon Trac、Hon Cau…，色彩各异，将带来独特的美，让游客兴奋不已。

要体验昆岛的珊瑚潜水，游客应租船前往海岛，并租用珊瑚潜水服务。昆岛每年潜水的最佳时间是 3 月至 9 月。

岘港珊瑚潜水

岘港有许多美丽的珊瑚潜水地点。如果您有机会在夏天游览岘港，应体验珊瑚潜水，感受海底的独特之美。岘港的第一个珊瑚潜水地点是山茶珊瑚，拥有五彩缤纷的珊瑚礁。它是许多游客在每个暑假中选择的中途停留目的地。

山茶最美的珊瑚在 Hon Sun，那里绚丽的色彩将带给游客最愉快的假期。

占婆岛珊瑚

这是一处原始之美与神奇璀璨珊瑚礁交汇的地方。前往占婆岛最美的时节是每年夏季，游客可以租一艘独木舟前往海岛，体验潜水观赏神奇璀璨的珊瑚礁。

占婆岛拥有宽敞开阔的保护区，里面有色彩多样的美丽珊瑚礁。游客只需下潜约 3 米或在海平面以下 6 米潜水，就会为这璀璨之美而惊叹。

永熙湾珊瑚 – 宁顺

永熙湾如同一颗明珠浮现在东海之中，拥有璀璨的珊瑚礁。游客既可以欣赏美丽的自然风光，也可以体验水肺潜水观赏璀璨的珊瑚。

以上就是海岛天堂中美丽的珊瑚观赏地点。如果您热爱探索海底之美，请来到这片海域亲眼看一看，欣赏海底五彩璀璨珊瑚礁之美，将带给您最激动人心的感觉。

除了海上的精彩体验之外，您还可以品尝龙虾、帝王蟹、海螺等新鲜海鲜…，带来海岛海域独有的美味风味。要充分享受这份美景，游客应在夏天来到海岛天堂。

posts.title: Top 9 traditional craft villages in Vietnam
posts.excerpt: Top 9 traditional craft villages in Vietnam updated by Vietlook Travel right in the article are brilliant highlights, the unique culture of traditional Vietnamese craft villages is always preserved an
posts.contentHtml:
Top 9 traditional craft villages in Vietnam updated by Vietlook Travel right in the article are brilliant highlights, the unique culture of traditional Vietnamese craft villages is always preserved and promoted, transmitting cultural identity to the next generation.

1. Phu Lang Pottery Village

As one of the famous craft villages that any tourist when having the opportunity to set foot in Bac Ninh will visit, with products meticulously made by artisans of the craft village, exuding the pristine beauty of the land.

2. Ha Thai Lacquer Village

Visiting the Ha Thai Lacquer Village, you will see the peaceful and rustic countryside scenery, exuding the unique beauty of a traditional craft village, with skilled craftsmen creating exquisite works, visitors will be able to personally paint the works with their own creativity and bring them back as gifts.
3. Quat Dong Embroidery Village
As a craft village that has been around for thousands of years, with products that are not only used domestically but also exported abroad, when visiting the village, visitors will encounter mothers and sisters who often embroider at home with exquisite works, if you are someone who wants to learn about traditional craft villages, so Vietnamese culture, this is the destination for you.

4. Dong Ho Painting Village

As a National Intangible Cultural Heritage, when coming here, you will admire unique works, the quality of paintings from clay printing paper and coloring materials have created traditional works bearing the mark of Vietnamese culture.

5. Van Phuc Silk Village

Ha Dong Silk Village or Van Phuc Silk Village The name is no longer strange to tourists from all over the world, the silk village has many old patterns, coming here visitors will encounter very eye-catching display stalls that visitors can buy as gifts, with very sophisticated and beautiful soft products.

6. Kim Son Sedge Village

Sedge mats have long been indispensable in every Vietnamese family, and have become a mark in the national cultural identity, not only bringing income to the people here but also an indispensable tourist destination in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary.

7. Tay Ho Conical Hat Village – Phu Vang

As one of the traditional craft villages that bring beloved conical hats, Tay Ho Conical Hat has long been famous for its elegant beauty, slimness and lightness, further enhancing the beauty of women. If you have the opportunity to travel to Hue, visit Tay Ho Conical Hat Village to feel its own beauty, a rustic scene of the countryside.

8. Tuong Binh Hiep Lacquer Painting Village

This place is not only famous for its lacquer paintings, but also a destination that attracts tourists to visit, with valuable and diverse lacquer works that exude the beauty of the homeland.

9. Trang Bang Rice Paper Craft Village

One of the famous craft villages in Tay Ninh, visitors coming here can not only visit but also enjoy delicious rice paper, a famous specialty that visitors can buy as gifts when they have the opportunity to visit Tay Ninh.

Above are the traditional craft villages in Vietnam updated in this article, which will be an interesting suggestion for tourists who love to explore Vietnamese culture, and learn about traditional craft villages of the nation. If you want to see the beauty of the panoramic picture of the craft village, join Vietlook Travel to Vietnam today to see the beauty with your own eyes.

If you are a lover of peaceful space and want to get away from the hustle and bustle, then visit the traditional craft villages once to feel the beauty of the countryside picture, experience cycling to see the scenery or leisurely stroll along the village roads to enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, away from the hustle and bustle, dust of the city will bring you the most enjoyable vacation, and experience the life of the people in the craft villages, listen to the artisans talk about stories about traditional Vietnamese craft villages.
posts.titleZh: 越南九大传统手工艺村
posts.excerptZh: Vietlook Travel在本文中更新的越南9大传统手工艺村是璀璨的亮点，越南传统手工艺村的独特文化始终被保存和弘扬，将文化认同传承给下一代。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
Vietlook Travel在本文中更新的越南9大传统手工艺村是璀璨的亮点，越南传统手工艺村的独特文化始终被保存和弘扬，将文化认同传承给下一代。

1. 富朗（Phu Lang）陶器村

作为任何游客有机会踏足北宁时都会参观的著名手工艺村之一，产品由手工艺村的工匠精心制作，散发着这片土地质朴的美。

2. 河泰（Ha Thai）漆器村

参观河泰漆器村，您将看到宁静质朴的乡村风光，散发着传统手工艺村独特的美，技艺娴熟的工匠创作出精美的作品，游客可以亲自发挥创意在作品上彩绘，并带回家作为礼物。
3. 缺东（Quat Dong）刺绣村
作为一个已有数千年历史的手工艺村，产品不仅在国内使用，也出口到国外，参观村庄时，游客会遇到常在家中刺绣的母亲和姐妹们，她们的作品十分精美，如果您想了解传统手工艺村，进而了解越南文化，这里就是适合您的目的地。

4. 东湖（Dong Ho）民间版画村

作为国家级非物质文化遗产，来到这里，您将欣赏到独特的作品，版画以土印纸和着色材料制成，创作出带有越南文化印记的传统作品。

5. 万福（Van Phuc）丝绸村

河东丝绸村或万福丝绸村，这个名字对来自世界各地的游客已不再陌生，丝绸村有许多古老的花纹，来到这里，游客会遇到非常醒目的展示摊位，可以购买作为礼物，产品柔软，十分精致美观。

6. 金山（Kim Son）莞草村

莞草席早已是每个越南家庭不可或缺的物品，并成为民族文化认同的印记，不仅为当地人带来收入，也是 宁平旅游 行程中不可错过的旅游目的地。

7. 西湖（Tay Ho）斗笠村 – 富荣（Phu Vang）

作为出产备受喜爱的斗笠的传统手工艺村之一，西湖斗笠长期以来以优雅的美、纤细和轻盈而闻名，更增添了女性的美。如果您有机会前往顺化旅游，参观西湖斗笠村，感受它独有的美，一幅质朴的乡村景象。

8. 祥平协（Tuong Binh Hiep）漆画村

这里不仅以漆画闻名，也是吸引游客参观的目的地，有价值而多样的漆器作品，散发着故乡之美。

9. 庄邦（Trang Bang）米纸手工艺村

作为西宁著名的手工艺村之一，来到这里的游客不仅可以参观，还可以品尝美味的米纸，这是一种著名的特产，游客有机会参观西宁时可以购买作为礼物。

以上是本文更新的越南传统手工艺村，对于热爱探索越南文化、了解民族传统手工艺村的游客来说，将是一个有趣的建议。如果您想看到手工艺村全景画面的美，请今天就加入Vietlook 前往越南旅游 ，亲眼目睹这份美。

如果您热爱宁静的空间，想远离喧嚣，那么不妨参观一次传统手工艺村，感受乡村画卷之美，体验骑自行车欣赏风景，或悠闲漫步在村路上享受宁静的氛围，远离城市的喧嚣与尘土，将带给您最愉悦的假期，并体验手工艺村里人们的生活，听工匠讲述越南传统手工艺村的故事。

posts.title: What’s beautiful about traveling to Ha Long in December
posts.excerpt: Are you wondering what’s beautiful about traveling to Ha Long in December, the climate and entertainment areas, or what’s fun about the scenic spots? So to meet that expectation, Vietlook Travel will
posts.contentHtml:
Are you wondering what’s beautiful about traveling to Ha Long in December, the climate and entertainment areas, or what’s fun about the scenic spots? So to meet that expectation, Vietlook Travel will share with you the experience of traveling to Ha Long in December, what’s beautiful right in this article.

Ha Long, which owns islands, towering mountains or long, poetic beaches with many beautiful landscapes, is a stopover chosen by many tourists during each of their vacations, especially here there are many caves such as: Trinh Nu Cave, Dau Go Cave, Sung Sot Cave… will bring tourists the most enjoyable vacation.

Ha Long climate in December

In December, Ha Long begins to enter winter, the temperature is around 20 degrees Celsius, the morning is chilly, the afternoon is sunny, the evening is chilly. If you travel Ha Long in December, you should not participate in water games.

When traveling to Ha Long in winter, you should sip a cup of coffee and admire the poetic scenery of the sea and islands. This is the time for those who do not like the hustle and bustle of the bustling city, and is very suitable for resort tours in Ha Long.

Places not to be missed when traveling to Ha Long in December

Tuan Chau Island Ha Long

A place with its own beauty, in December the island is peaceful, airy, the weather is very nice for visitors to admire the scenery, a peaceful scene, let’s chat with friends and have fun stories together.

In addition, when coming to Tuan Chau, you can also watch water puppetry, enjoy the music, combine with the colorful light space or participate in entertainment programs at Tuan Chau Park with many games suitable for all ages such as: Roller coaster, flying saucer, cable car…

Quang Ninh Museum

A place that preserves historical and cultural values, when coming here, visitors not only visit but also learn about historical and cultural values, and have a space to recreate the daily work of the people here.

Check in Ha Long Old Town

A place with unique architecture, a place where modern and traditional cultures intersect, is a unique check-in spot chosen by many tourists when traveling to Ha Long in December, the most beautiful is early in the morning when the sun has just risen, visitors can take beautiful pictures for themselves.

Ha Long Night Market

Ha Long Night Market, also known as Bai Chay Night Market, is located in the center, so it is very convenient for tourists to come here to visit, shop, and enjoy the delicious dishes of Ha Long.

Bai Chay Bridge – Ha Long

As one of the beautiful bridges connecting Hon Gai and Bai Chay, it is a virtual living spot that many tourists visit, especially when the night falls, the sparkling lights of the city add to the beauty of Ha Long.

Delicious and attractive dishes in Ha Long

White sticky rice with squid sausage is a dish that cannot be missed when going on a tour Ha Long in December, the ingredients are processed very elaborately, the aroma of sticky rice and the sweetness of squid will make visitors remember this delicious flavor forever.

Sea Sam

As a delicious and nutritious dish, sam can be processed into different dishes such as: stir-fried sam cartilage, stir-fried sam with sweet and sour… when enjoying, diners will feel the famous sweet and chewy taste of Ha Long.

Mantis shrimp vermicelli

With pure white vermicelli, mantis shrimp, raw vegetables and broth, in the cold winter weather of Ha Long, enjoying a bowl of hot vermicelli is nothing more interesting.

Ha Long pearl yogurt

Although it is a light dish, when enjoying it, diners will remember its own delicious flavor forever. When you have freely explored, enjoy Pearl yogurt while watching the scenery, visitors will feel more relaxed than ever.

Nodding cake

The name sounds attractive, it is one of the famous snacks in Ha Long, when coming here, visitors can enjoy nodding cake right at the roadside stalls, the cake is made from soft, chewy and pure white flour, bringing an irresistible delicious flavor.

The above are the experiences of traveling to Ha Long in December, hopefully through this article will help you on your trip, wish you the happiest vacation.
posts.titleZh: 十二月游下龙美在哪里
posts.excerptZh: 您是否在想12月去下龙湾旅游有什么美景，那里的气候和娱乐区，或者景点有什么好玩的？为了满足这一期待，Vietlook Travel将在本文中与您分享12月下龙湾旅游的经验和美景。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
您是否在想12月去下龙湾旅游有什么美景，那里的气候和娱乐区，或者景点有什么好玩的？为了满足这一期待，Vietlook Travel将在本文中与您分享12月下龙湾旅游的经验和美景。

下龙湾拥有岛屿、巍峨的山峰或绵长如诗的海滩，风景优美，是许多游客每次度假时选择的中途停靠地，尤其是这里有许多洞穴，如：贞女洞（Trinh Nu）、木头洞（Dau Go）、惊讶洞（Sung Sot）……将带给游客最愉悦的假期。

12月的下龙湾气候

12月，下龙湾开始进入冬季，气温约20摄氏度，早晨寒冷，下午有阳光，晚上寒冷。如果您在12月 游览下龙湾 ，不应参加水上游戏。

冬季前往下龙湾旅游时，您应该品尝一杯咖啡，欣赏如诗如画的海岛风光。这是不喜欢繁华都市喧嚣的人的时节，非常适合下龙湾的度假之旅。

12月去下龙湾旅游不可错过的地方

下龙湾头顿岛（Tuan Chau）

一个有着独特美的地方，12月的岛上宁静而通透，天气非常适合游客欣赏风景，一幅宁静的景象，与朋友聊天，一起分享有趣的故事。

此外，来到头顿岛，您还可以观看水上木偶戏，欣赏音乐，结合五彩缤纷的灯光空间，或参加头顿公园的娱乐节目，那里有许多适合各个年龄段的游戏，如：过山车、飞碟、缆车……

广宁博物馆

一个保存历史文化价值的地方，来到这里，游客不仅参观，还能了解历史文化价值，并有一个重现当地人日常劳作的空间。

下龙老街打卡

一个拥有独特建筑的地方，一个现代与传统文化交汇之处，是许多游客在12月前往下龙湾旅游时选择的独特打卡点，最美的时候是清晨太阳刚刚升起时，游客可以为自己拍下美丽的照片。

下龙夜市

下龙夜市，又称白茶（Bai Chay）夜市，位于市中心，因此游客非常方便前来参观、购物，并品尝下龙的美味佳肴。

下龙白茶大桥

作为连接鸿基和白茶的美丽桥梁之一，这是许多游客参观的拍照打卡点，尤其是夜幕降临时，城市璀璨的灯光为下龙增添了美感。

下龙美味诱人的菜肴

白糯米配鱿鱼卷（chả mực）是12月 游览下龙湾 时不可错过的一道菜，食材加工得非常精细，糯米的香气和鱿鱼的鲜甜会让游客永远记住这种美味。

海沙虫（Sam）

作为一道美味而营养的菜肴，沙虫可以加工成不同的菜品，如：炒沙虫软骨、糖醋炒沙虫……享用时，食客会感受到下龙著名的香甜与嚼劲。

虾蛄米粉

洁白的米粉、虾蛄、生菜和汤底，在下龙湾寒冷的冬季天气里，享用一碗热腾腾的米粉，没有比这更有趣的了。

下龙珍珠酸奶

虽然是一道清淡的菜品，但享用时，食客会永远记住它独特的美味。当您自由探索之后，一边欣赏风景一边享用珍珠酸奶，游客会感到前所未有的放松。

点头糕（Nodding cake）

名字听起来很吸引人，它是下龙著名的小吃之一，来到这里，游客可以在路边摊享用点头糕，糕点由柔软、有嚼劲且洁白的面粉制成，带来令人难以抗拒的美味。

以上就是12月前往下龙湾旅游的体验，希望本文能在您的旅途中帮助到您，祝您度过最幸福的假期。

posts.title: Da Nang Tourism and Weather in Each Month of the Year
posts.excerpt: Da Nang welcomes visitors with beautiful landscapes such as Ba Na, Cu Lao Cham, Ngu Hanh Son or My Khe beach or the top entertainment area at Fantasy Park, and is surrounded by 3 cultural heritages su
posts.contentHtml:
Da Nang welcomes visitors with beautiful landscapes such as Ba Na, Cu Lao Cham, Ngu Hanh Son or My Khe beach… or the top entertainment area at Fantasy Park, and is surrounded by 3 cultural heritages such as Hue, Hoi An, My Son. Not only that, Da Nang is also the place where many exciting festivals take place throughout the year, including special festivals such as fireworks festival, street festival, food festival taking place at Ba Na, summer festival taking place on the sea. So to have the most beautiful trip to Da Nang, please follow the weather of the months of the year right below.

The climate of Da Nang is divided into two distinct seasons: the rainy season from August to December, the dry season from January to July. To avoid storms affecting your trip, it is best to travel to Da Nang from February to July every year, because at this time the weather is clear and there is no rain, which is very convenient for tourists to visit, swim in the sea, and participate in sea sports.

Traveling Da Nang from January to April, the weather is sunny and mild, although it is the dry season, the temperature is not high, very suitable for tourists to choose camping tours or picnics with groups of friends, because the weather is cool so tourists can camp outdoors all day without fear of the sun.

Traveling to Da Nang in the low season of the rainy season, visitors should monitor the weather before going to avoid showers or storms that affect your tour. However, if you choose to travel to Da Nang on a budget, go in the rainy season, because this season the services are often softer than the high season, so it is very convenient for visitors to choose resort tours. In Da Nang, there are many luxurious resorts with beautiful views. From here, visitors can fully admire the scenery when the sunrise or sunset falls on clear days, revealing a poetic scene. Da Nang Weather and Months of the Year

Da Nang Climate in January

The temperature fluctuates around 18 degrees Celsius, not suitable for swimming, so tourists traveling to Da Nang in January should visit famous places such as Ngu Hanh Son, Linh Ung Pagoda or Cham Museum or admire the beauty of the city through bridges such as Han River Swing Bridge, Dragon Bridge, or Thuan Phuoc Bridge…

Da Nang Weather in February

Da Nang in February is in winter so it is quite cold, this is the Lunar New Year holiday and also in the weather gradually changing to spring, the temperature gradually increases at the end of the month, however, if traveling to Da Nang in February, it is not convenient for tourists to swim, only suitable for tourists to visit famous places.

However, February in Da Nang is also the time when many festivals take place such as Hoa My village festival or folk games such as singing opera or dramatic dances and art programs combining tradition and modernity will bring tourists the most enjoyable vacation.

Da Nang Weather in March

Da Nang in March the temperature gradually warms up, usually fluctuating around 28 degrees Celsius, this is the dry season of Da Nang and also the occasion of the Quan The Am festival on February 19 every year, this is a traditional festival and is becoming more and more abundant.

Da Nang Weather in April

This is the time when the weather in Da Nang is in and this is also the occasion of the holidays of January 30 and May 1, Da Nang holds many exciting programs, especially the Cau Ngu Festival with a strong traditional culture. In April, the weather in Da Nang is warm and sunny, very suitable for tourists to swim and participate in sports on the sea.

Da Nang Weather in May

At this time, there are showers, but the weather is still quite hot. The Central region’s summer weather is hot and sunny, with an average temperature ranging from 24.9 to 33.4 degrees Celsius, which is very suitable for tourists to swim and participate in beach games, or visit the Ba Na scenic area.

Da Nang Weather in June and July

June is the peak of summer, with temperatures ranging from 33 to 40 degrees Celsius. Many tourists choose to visit beaches such as Son Tra, My Khe, Cua Dai, Ghenh Bang beaches to swim and participate in summer festivals on the beach in Da Nang. This is also the peak season in Da Nang. If you are traveling to Da Nang on your own, you should proactively book tickets and leave early to avoid room shortages.

In addition, if you go on a full package tour to Da Nang, you just need to pack your backpack and go, because the services are included in the program and there is a tour guide with you, because June and July are the summer vacation time when many families often take their children out, so Da Nang is quite crowded at this time, many families with young children often choose vacation tours at luxury resorts right next to the sea to watch the fun scenery on the sea, or the vibrant fireworks festivals.

Da Nang weather in August and September

At this time, Da Nang enters autumn, the weather is clear and cool, but this is also the time when Da Nang enters the rainy season with the rains starting to appear, and there are storms, so visitors should check the weather before coming to Da Nang, you will still have a beautiful tour because this is the low season of Da Nang, so the services are often lower than the high season, so it still brings you a fun vacation on the island.

Da Nang Weather in October

At this time, Da Nang has quite nice weather with light sunshine, however, in the early morning and at night the weather starts to get cold, so it is not suitable for tourists to swim in the sea, tourists often choose resort tours in Da Nang and visit famous places.

Da Nang Weather in November

The weather in Da Nang in November gradually turns to winter, so it is not convenient for tourists to swim in the sea or participate in games on the sea, the temperature usually fluctuates between 28 – 30 degrees, and gradually decreases at night and early morning when the weather is cold. If you travel to Da Nang in November, choose resort tours, Da Nang has very luxurious resorts located right in the center, so it is very convenient for tourists to go sightseeing.

Da Nang Weather in December

At this time, Da Nang is entering the winter and is quite cold, the temperature is around 20 degrees Celsius, at this time outdoor entertainment activities have stopped, tourists will choose resort tours and walk to see the scenery of Da Nang starting to create a vibrant Tet atmosphere, the roads begin to attach symbols of the new year.

So above are the experiences of traveling to Da Nang that Vietlook wants to share with you, hopefully through this article there will be answers for those of you who are wondering which season is the best to travel to Da Nang, which month is the most beautiful and what the climate is like, thereby helping you have the most enjoyable vacation tour in the coastal city with friends and relatives.
posts.titleZh: 岘港全年各月旅游与天气
posts.excerptZh: 岘港以巴拿山、占婆岛、五行山、美溪海滩等美丽风光，以及顶级娱乐区 Fantasy Park 欢迎游客，并被顺化、会安、美山三处文化遗产环绕。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
岘港以巴拿山、占婆岛、五行山、美溪海滩…等美丽风光，以及顶级娱乐区 Fantasy Park 欢迎游客，并被顺化、会安、美山这三处文化遗产环绕。不仅如此，岘港全年还举办许多精彩的节庆活动，包括烟花节、街头节、在巴拿山举行的美食节，以及在海上举办的夏季节等特色节庆。因此，要拥有一次最美的岘港之旅，请参考下面一年中各个月份的天气情况。

岘港的气候分为两个明显的季节：8 月至 12 月为雨季，1 月至 7 月为旱季。为避免风暴影响您的行程，每年 2 月至 7 月前往岘港旅游最为合适，因为这段时间天气晴朗、没有降雨，非常方便游客参观、海边游泳和参加海上运动。

1 月至 4 月游览岘港，天气晴朗温和，虽然是旱季，但气温不高，非常适合游客选择露营旅游或与朋友结伴野餐，因为天气凉爽，游客可以整天在户外露营而不必担心日晒。

在雨季的淡季前往岘港旅游，游客出发前应关注天气，以免阵雨或风暴影响您的行程。不过，如果您选择经济实惠的岘港之旅，可以在雨季前往，因为这个季节的服务价格通常比旺季更为优惠，因此游客很方便选择度假村旅游。岘港有许多景观优美的豪华度假村。在这里，游客可以在晴天尽情欣赏日出或日落时分的风景，呈现出如诗如画的景象。岘港天气与一年中的各个月份

岘港 1 月的气候

气温在 18 摄氏度左右波动，不适合游泳，因此 1 月前往岘港的游客应参观五行山、灵应寺或占族博物馆等著名景点，或通过汉江旋转桥、龙桥、顺福桥…等桥梁欣赏城市之美。

岘港 2 月的天气

岘港 2 月处于冬季，因此相当寒冷，这是农历新年假期，天气也逐渐向春天转变，月底气温逐渐升高，不过 2 月前往岘港旅游，游客不便游泳，只适合参观著名景点。

不过，岘港的 2 月也是许多节庆举行的时节，例如和美村庙会，或唱戏等民间游戏、戏剧舞蹈以及融合传统与现代的艺术节目，将为游客带来最愉快的假期。

岘港 3 月的天气

岘港 3 月气温逐渐变暖，通常在 28 摄氏度左右波动，这是岘港的旱季，也恰逢每年农历二月十九日的观世音节，这是一个传统节日，规模越来越盛大。

岘港 4 月的天气

这是岘港天气宜人的时节，也恰逢 4 月 30 日和 5 月 1 日假期，岘港举办许多精彩的节目，尤其是传统文化氛围浓厚的祭鲸节（Cau Ngu）。4 月，岘港天气温暖晴朗，非常适合游客游泳和参加海上运动。

岘港 5 月的天气

这个时候会有阵雨，但天气仍然相当炎热。中部地区的夏季天气炎热晴朗，平均气温在 24.9 至 33.4 摄氏度之间，非常适合游客游泳、参加沙滩游戏，或参观巴拿景区。

岘港 6 月和 7 月的天气

6 月是夏季的高峰，气温在 33 至 40 摄氏度之间。许多游客选择前往山茶、美溪、Cua Dai、Ghenh Bang 等海滩游泳，并参加岘港海滩上的夏季节庆。这也是岘港的旺季。如果您自行前往岘港旅游，应主动订票并提早出发，以免客房紧缺。

此外，如果您参加全包式岘港旅游团，只需收拾背包出发即可，因为行程中已包含各项服务，并有导游陪同。6 月和 7 月是暑假时间，许多家庭经常带孩子出游，因此此时的岘港相当热闹，许多带着年幼孩子的家庭通常选择在海边的豪华度假村度假，欣赏海上的趣味风光，或观看热闹的烟花节。

岘港 8 月和 9 月的天气

这个时候，岘港进入秋季，天气晴朗凉爽，但也是岘港进入雨季的时候，开始出现降雨，并有风暴，因此游客来岘港之前应查看天气。您仍然会有一次美好的旅程，因为这是岘港的淡季，服务价格通常低于旺季，所以依然能带给您一个愉快的海岛假期。

岘港 10 月的天气

这个时候，岘港天气相当不错，阳光柔和，不过清晨和夜晚天气开始变冷，因此不适合游客在海里游泳，游客通常选择岘港的度假村旅游并参观著名景点。

岘港 11 月的天气

岘港 11 月的天气逐渐转入冬季，因此游客不便在海里游泳或参加海上游戏，气温通常在 28 – 30 度之间波动，夜晚和清晨天气寒冷时气温逐渐下降。如果您 11 月前往岘港旅游，请选择度假村旅游，岘港有非常豪华的度假村，就位于市中心，因此游客观光十分方便。

岘港 12 月的天气

这个时候，岘港正进入冬季，相当寒冷，气温在 20 摄氏度左右，此时户外娱乐活动已经停止，游客会选择度假村旅游，并漫步观赏岘港的风景——这座城市开始营造出热闹的春节氛围，道路上开始挂起新年的装饰。

以上就是 Vietlook 想与您分享的岘港旅游经验，希望通过这篇文章，能为那些想知道哪个季节最适合游览岘港、哪个月份最美以及气候如何的朋友提供答案，从而帮助您与亲朋好友在这座海滨城市拥有最愉快的度假之旅。

posts.title: Experience of traveling to Ba Na
posts.excerpt: Ba Na has long been an attractive destination, because of its beautiful landscapes and many unique festivals. However, if this is your first time visiting Ba Na, you will definitely wonder which seaso
posts.contentHtml:
Ba Na has long been an attractive destination, because of its beautiful landscapes and many unique festivals. However, if this is your first time visiting Ba Na, you will definitely wonder which season to travel to Ba Na to join the festival, or immerse yourself in the space of blooming tulips. Therefore, today Vietlook Travel will share with you the most complete and concise experience of traveling to Ba Na.

Coming to Ba Na, visitors will feel the climate of 4 seasons in 1 day, a beautiful check-in point, no matter what angle you stand from, you will capture beautiful pictures for yourself, not only that, Ba Na is also the place where many exciting festivals take place, many entertainment areas, shopping, or culinary areas with strong Asian-European flavors.

Ba Na is located in An Son village, Hoa Ninh commune, Hoa Vang district, Da Nang city and about 25km from the center of Da Nang city, where there is a poetic landscape with clouds surrounding the mountain top, will bring you the most perfect experiences during your vacation.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang, you should definitely visit Ba Na to feel the natural beauty, immerse yourself in the fresh air, and participate in many interesting games, and experience an adventure in the clouds, and experience the cable car to enjoy the moments floating on the clouds, watching the scenery of Da Thanh from above.

If you are a thrill-seeker, visit Fantasy Park, an indoor amusement park so you can play any season of the year, with many exciting games suitable for all ages. In addition, visit Le Jardin D’Amour flower garden, Debay wine cellar, Linh Ung pagoda, … and enjoy delicious food at the restaurants right on top of Ba Na.

When is the best time to travel to Ba Na?

Although Ba Na Hills is home to many famous landmarks and many festivals and events, the climate in Ba Na is relatively mild. Coming here, visitors can feel the climate of 4 seasons in 1 day, rainy mornings, sunny noons, and foggy afternoons, very convenient for visitors to go sightseeing.

To avoid being affected by fog, visitors should travel to Ba Na from April to September, at this time the weather is less rainy and sunny, very convenient for visitors to sightsee, if you want to immerse yourself in the beauty of the tulip festival, you should travel to Ba Na in the spring from January to March, if you want to immerse yourself in the space of Ba Na in winter, you should travel to Ba Na from October to December, this is also the time when Ba Na holds a vibrant Christmas Eve.

Means of transportation to the top of Ba Na

1. Go to Ba Na Hills by bus

From Da Nang city to the top of Ba Na, visitors choose public transportation by bus, the bus stop is right in the center, visitors will take the bus to Ba Na,if traveling on a tour Da Nang – Ba Na, rent a private car, or if traveling in a group, you should rent a private car for convenience.

2. Go to Ba Na by cable car

This is the most popular means of transport for tourists when traveling to Ba Na. The modern Ba Na cable car system will bring you the most wonderful feeling, from the cable car you can admire the poetic Ba Na scenery.

3. Ba Na Mountain Train

From Debay station, move to Debay ancient wine cellar, Le Jardin d’amour flower garden, Linh Ung pagoda, you can admire the scenery from the train, you can admire the majestic mountains, with a peaceful space that will bring you a feeling of excitement.

In addition, you can experience the view of Ba Na at night, at Beer Plaza restaurant, enjoy while admiring the scenery, with a European-style night party, and admire the sparkling performance, a romantic and magical space in the cold weather on the top of the mountain.
posts.excerptZh: 巴拿山一直是一个迷人的目的地，因为它美丽的风景和许多独特的节庆。然而，如果这是您第一次游览巴拿山，您一定会疑惑哪个季节前往。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
巴拿山一直是一个迷人的目的地，因为它美丽的风景和许多独特的节庆。然而，如果这是您第一次游览巴拿山，您一定会疑惑应该在哪个季节 前往巴拿山旅游 参加节庆，或沉浸在郁金香盛开的空间中。因此，今天 Vietlook Travel 将与您分享最完整、最简明的巴拿山旅游攻略。

来到巴拿山，游客会感受到一天之内四季的气候，这里是美丽的打卡点，无论您站在哪个角度，都能为自己拍下美照；不仅如此，巴拿山还是许多精彩节庆举办的地方，有许多娱乐区、购物区，或带有浓郁亚欧风味的美食区。

巴拿山位于岘港市和旺县（Hoa Vang）和宁社（Hoa Ninh）安山（An Son）村，距离岘港市中心约25公里，这里风景如诗，云雾环绕山顶，将给您的假期带来最完美的体验。

如果您有机会 游览岘港，一定要游览巴拿山，感受自然之美，沉浸在清新的空气中，参与许多有趣的游戏，体验云中探险，乘坐缆车享受漂浮在云端的时刻，从空中俯瞰岘港的风景。

如果您是追求刺激的人，请游览奇幻乐园，这是一座室内游乐园，所以一年中的任何季节都可以玩，有许多适合各年龄段的刺激游戏。此外，还可游览爱情花园（Le Jardin D’Amour）、Debay 酒窖、灵应寺…，并在巴拿山顶的餐厅享用美食。

什么时候前往巴拿山旅游最好？

虽然巴拿山拥有许多著名地标和许多节庆活动，但巴拿山的气候相对温和。来到这里，游客可以感受一天之内四季的气候，早晨有雨，中午晴朗，下午有雾，非常便于游客观光。

为避免受雾影响，游客应在4月至9月前往巴拿山，此时雨少晴朗，非常便于游客观光；如果想沉浸在郁金香节的美景中，应在1月至3月的春天前往巴拿山；如果想沉浸在冬天的巴拿山氛围中，应在10月至12月前往巴拿山，这也是巴拿山举办热闹平安夜活动的时候。

前往巴拿山顶的交通方式

1. 乘公共汽车前往巴拿山

从岘港市到巴拿山顶，游客选择乘公共汽车的公共交通，车站就在市中心，游客乘坐公共汽车前往巴拿山；如果参加 岘港之旅 ——巴拿山，可租私家车；或者如果结伴出行，为方便起见应租私家车。

2. 乘缆车前往巴拿山

这是游客 游览巴拿山时最受欢迎的交通方式。现代化的巴拿山缆车系统将带给您最美妙的感觉，从缆车上您可以欣赏诗意的巴拿山风景。

3. 巴拿山登山火车

从 Debay 站出发，前往 Debay 古酒窖、爱情花园（Le Jardin d’amour）、灵应寺，您可以在火车上欣赏风景，欣赏雄伟的群山，宁静的空间会给您带来兴奋的感觉。

此外，您还可以在 Beer Plaza 餐厅体验巴拿山的夜景，一边欣赏风景一边享用，参加欧式夜间派对，欣赏璀璨的表演，在山顶寒冷的天气里享受浪漫而神奇的空间。

posts.title: Which season is the most beautiful in Ha Long
posts.excerpt: Which season is the most beautiful in Ha Long is a concern for tourists who come to Ha Long for the first time, so you will ask the question of which season is the most beautiful in Ha Long and what i
posts.contentHtml:
Which season is the most beautiful in Ha Long is a concern for tourists who come to Ha Long for the first time, so you will ask the question of which season is the most beautiful in Ha Long and what is the interesting experience on the cruise, so let’s find out more about the Ha Long cruise experience below.

According to Vietlook’s Ha Long travel experience, the best time to go on a Ha Long cruise is in spring and autumn, that is, from April to October, at this time the weather in Ha Long is quite nice without rain, so it is very convenient for tourists to visit and experience on luxurious 5-star boats to admire the peaceful sea scenery.

Ha Long has a tropical climate, hot and humid summers and cold winters, and the temperature will fluctuate according to each season, and Ha Long is also a suitable place to participate in sea activities such as: Swimming, kayaking, snorkeling, playing volleyball…

Especially when experiencing Ha Long cruise, visitors will enjoy the cool breeze, while gliding on the clear blue sea. Although the best time for visitors to participate in Ha Long cruise tours is summer, Ha Long winter weather is quite low, and you should not go during the rainy and stormy seasons as it will affect your tour.

However, if you do not like the crowds like in the summer, you can experience Ha Long cruise in the winter, and you proactively book a schedule with the boat house in advance so that your trip is most convenient, if you want to register for a budget Ha Long tour, you should go in the winter, because at this time the services are often lower than in the summer, the peak season.

So no matter what season of the year you choose, Ha Long still brings you its own beauty and the best experiences.

So to have the most perfect trip, please refer to the weather in Ha Long in the year.

Ha Long in January

The sunny weather is very suitable for foreign tourists to come and see the scenery on the bay, at this time the temperature is relatively cool at around 18 degrees Celsius, the weather is less rainy but there is fog, visitors should bring a thin jacket.

If you travel to Ha Long in January, visitors can visit Bai Tho mountain, from above to see the bay’s famous sights from above, because Ha Long in January the weather is not suitable for visitors to participate in underwater activities.

February

The temperature is lower than January, around 17 degrees Celsius, this is the Lunar New Year holiday, and some attractions on the bay are closed because the weather is quite cold. If you come to Ha Long, you are only suitable for resort tours at luxury resorts to admire the scenery from above.

March

The temperature gradually warms up, the sky is clear, sometimes there is drizzle, the temperature is around 19 degrees Celsius, very suitable for those who like climbing mountains, conquering heights.

April

Ha Long in April is the summer season, the temperature gradually increases and fluctuates around 24 degrees Celsius, this is the best time for you to participate in rowing games, paragliding, mountain climbing, sightseeing… and it is also the occasion of the 30/4 holiday, so many tourists choose Ha Long tourism as a stopover during their vacation.

May

Ha Long in May is the summer season, the temperature increases, the hot weather is very suitable for tourists to experience the cruise, and you should bring a swimsuit for convenient swimming.

June

Ha Long weather in June is summer, and the rainy season begins, although there is not much rain, visitors need to monitor the weather before coming to Ha Long.

In July and August, Ha Long still has showers and storms, and the amount of rain is quite high, so visitors need to monitor the weather before coming to Ha Long.

In September and October, Ha Long enters autumn, however, sudden showers still appear, but gradually decrease, the autumn weather in Ha Long is quite beautiful, visitors can participate in games on the sea or choose interesting resort tours.

In November and December, Ha Long enters the dry season, this is also the peak season of Ha Long, the sky is clear and there is no rain, and at the end of December, the temperature gradually turns to winter, so there is gentle sunlight, visitors can sip a cup of coffee and admire the poetic sea and island scenery.
posts.excerptZh: 下龙湾哪个季节最美，是初次来下龙湾的游客关心的问题，因此您会问下龙湾哪个季节最美，以及游船上有什么有趣的体验，那么让我们一起来了解下面的
posts.contentHtmlZh:
下龙湾哪个季节最美，是初次来下龙湾的游客关心的问题，因此您会问下龙湾哪个季节最美，以及游船上有什么有趣的体验，那么让我们一起来了解下面的 下龙湾游船 体验吧。

根据Vietlook的 下龙湾旅游 经验，乘坐下龙湾游船的最佳时间是春季和秋季，即4月至10月，此时下龙湾的天气相当好，没有雨，因此游客非常方便游览，并乘坐豪华的5星级游船欣赏宁静的海景。

下龙湾属热带气候，夏季炎热潮湿，冬季寒冷，气温会随季节变化，下龙湾也是适合参加海上活动的地方，例如：游泳、皮划艇、浮潜、打排球……

特别是体验下龙湾游船时，游客将享受凉爽的海风，同时在清澈碧蓝的海面上滑行。虽然游客参加下龙湾游船之旅的最佳时间是夏季，但下龙湾冬季气温相当低，不建议在雨季和风暴季节前往，因为会影响您的行程。

不过，如果您不喜欢像夏季那样拥挤的人潮，可以在冬季体验下龙湾游船，并提前主动与船家预订日程，让您的行程最为方便，如果您想报名经济型的下龙湾旅游，应该在冬季前往，因为此时的服务价格往往比旺季的夏季低。

因此，无论您选择一年中的哪个季节，下龙湾都会带给您独特的美和最佳的体验。

所以，为了拥有最完美的旅程，请参考下龙湾全年的天气。

1月的下龙湾

晴朗的天气非常适合外国游客前来欣赏海湾风光，此时气温相对凉爽，约18摄氏度，雨天较少但有雾，游客应携带薄外套。

如果您在1月前往下龙湾旅游，游客可以登上白寿山（Bai Tho），从高处俯瞰海湾的著名景点，因为1月的下龙湾天气不适合游客参加水下活动。

2月

气温比1月低，约17摄氏度，这是农历新年假期，海湾上的一些景点因天气相当寒冷而关闭。如果您来下龙湾，只适合在豪华度假村进行度假之旅，从高处欣赏风景。

3月

气温逐渐回暖，天空晴朗，有时有毛毛雨，气温约19摄氏度，非常适合喜欢爬山、征服高峰的人。

4月

4月的下龙湾是夏季，气温逐渐升高，在24摄氏度左右波动，这是您参加划船游戏、滑翔伞、登山、观光……的最佳时间，也是4月30日假期，因此许多游客选择下龙湾旅游作为假期的中途停靠点。

5月

5月的下龙湾是夏季，气温升高，炎热的天气非常适合游客体验游船，您应携带泳衣以方便游泳。

6月

6月的下龙湾天气是夏季，雨季开始，虽然雨量不大，但游客在来下龙湾之前需要关注天气。

7月和8月，下龙湾仍有阵雨和风暴，雨量相当大，因此游客在来下龙湾之前需要关注天气。

9月和10月，下龙湾进入秋季，不过仍会出现突然的阵雨，但逐渐减少，下龙湾的秋季天气相当美丽，游客可以参加海上游戏或选择有趣的度假之旅。

11月和12月，下龙湾进入旱季，这也是下龙湾的旺季，天空晴朗无雨，12月底气温逐渐转入冬季，阳光温和，游客可以一边品尝一杯咖啡，一边欣赏如诗如画的海岛风光。

posts.title: Traveling to Hanoi and visiting traditional handicraft villages
posts.excerpt: Traveling to Hanoi and visiting traditional handicraft villages, visitors will feel the unique beauty, the unique culture that is preserved and increasingly developed, that is a unique beauty that Han
posts.contentHtml:
Traveling to Hanoi and visiting traditional handicraft villages, visitors will feel the unique beauty, the unique culture that is preserved and increasingly developed, that is a unique beauty that Hanoi brings to visitors from all over.

Traditional craft villages

1. Van Phuc silk village

As one of the famous craft villages, a place with its own beauty, a traditional craft village of the capital Hanoi, in the past Van Phuc silk village was also chosen to make costumes for the Royal Family, but until now this place still preserves and promotes the ancient beauty of the Northern countryside.

When visiting the silk village, tourists will encounter silk, la, gam, cham, to van, the, linh, bang, cinnamon, doan, sa, ky, cau, doi… all woven from natural silk materials. Currently, the silk village not only brings income to the people here but is also a tourist attraction for many tourists when traveling to Hanoi, visiting the silk village to visit and learn about the culture of the capital.

2. Bat Trang Pottery Village

The name is no longer strange to tourists from all over the world, thanks to the techniques and skillful hands of skilled craftsmen who have created sophisticated works, with beautiful green rice glaze from flower vases, flower pots, wind chimes, teapots, wall paintings… all exude elegance, looking very beautiful.

In addition, when visiting Bat Trang pottery village, visitors can also mold their own works according to their preferences, chat with the artisans of the pottery village, and indispensable is to buy products as gifts during the tour of the craft village in Hanoi.

3. Chang Son fan village

Located in Thach That, Hanoi, a place associated with many legends, Chang Son fan village is over 200 years old, because the famous fans are made by hand very delicately.

The fans look very simple but all require the skillful hands of skilled craftsmen, with types of silk fans, decorative wall fans, fans used as wedding invitations or high-class fans as souvenirs, visitors often buy fans as souvenirs of the trip, especially international visitors when coming here, they visit, take souvenir photos and buy souvenir fans.

4. Chuong Village Hats

A destination visited by many foreign tourists to visit and take pictures, especially young people. Here, there are hats such as: non quai thao, non doc pineapple, non no, non long, non toi, non dau for men, or conical bell hats for offerings…

5. Dao Thuc Water Puppet Village

As one of the traditional craft villages, located about 25km from Hanoi, it is a place that records the water puppetry profession from the Le Dynasty. Although it has gone through many historical ups and downs, the craft village is still preserved and promoted, chosen by many tourists as a stopover during their tour of Hanoi.

6. Phu Vinh Bamboo and Rattan Village

As one of the traditional bamboo weaving villages, with many different names such as Phu Hoa Trang village because of the skillful hands of the people here, with the traditional craft village, the children of Phu Vinh village grew up attached to bamboo and rattan trees and increasingly produced very sophisticated bamboo and rattan works, not only bringing income to the people but also being a tourist attraction for many tourists.

7. Thach Xa Bamboo Dragonfly Village

Speaking of Thach Xa, it is also the cradle of Lam tea and Banh Te. In addition, bamboo dragonflies are also known as popular products. When visiting here, visitors will see dragonflies made of bamboo very sophisticatedly, perched everywhere, looking very sophisticated.

8. Dong Ho Painting Village

With a variety of paintings, in the past, paintings were often produced and sold on the occasion of the Lunar New Year at rural markets, Dong Ho paintings are typical of the materials used to make and print paintings, and are combined with colors taken from nature.

Paper for making paintings is made from handmade tree bark, paintings are drawn according to artistic inspiration and are printed on boards, and have different distinct colors, many tourists when traveling to Hanoi often visit Dong Ho painting village, and learn how to make traditional paintings.

9. Quang Phu Cau Incense Stick Craft Village Hanoi

A place that preserves the traditional craft village of the Northern region, in the past, Hung village only supplied for domestic spiritual needs, but now it has been exported to other countries, and is a tourist attraction that many tourists come to, when there are bundles of incense arranged into flowers or the letter S spreading on social networking sites, from which Quang Phu Cau incense village attracts more and more tourists to visit.

It can be said that Quang Phu Cau Craft Village is famous for its high aesthetics. Coming here, visitors can visit and listen to artisans introduce how to make incense from the stages such as choosing bamboo, wrapping toothpicks, dyeing until creating sophisticated products.

10. Me Tri Com Village

Currently, there are many households making Com, and it has been included in the list of 17 national intangible cultural heritages. Com here is made through very elaborate stages, with types of Luong Phuong sticky rice, fragrant sticky rice, Tan sticky rice, Quyt sticky rice, Golden Flower sticky rice… will bring the famous delicious Com of Hanoi.

So, to see with your own eyes the beauty of traditional craft villages in Hanoi, visitors should follow Vietlook to explore the beauty of craft villages and countryside to learn more about Vietnamese culture.
posts.titleZh: 游河内探访传统手工艺村
posts.excerptZh: 游览河内并参观传统手工艺村，游客将感受到独特的美丽和被保存并日益发展的独特文化，这正是河内带给四面八方游客的独特魅力。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
游览河内并参观传统手工艺村，游客将感受到独特的美丽和被保存并日益发展的独特文化，这正是河内带给四面八方游客的独特魅力。

传统手工艺村

1. Van Phuc 丝绸村

作为著名的手工艺村之一，Van Phuc 丝绸村是首都河内一座别具美感的传统手工艺村，过去曾被选为皇室制作服饰，直到今天，这里依然保存并弘扬着北部乡村的古朴之美。

参观丝绸村时，游客会看到 la、gam、cham、to van、the、linh、bang、cinnamon、doan、sa、ky、cau、doi… 等各种丝绸，全部由天然蚕丝织成。如今，丝绸村不仅为当地人带来收入，也成为许多游客在 游览河内时参观丝绸村、了解首都文化的旅游景点。

2. Bat Trang 陶瓷村

这个名字对世界各地的游客来说已不陌生，得益于技艺精湛、双手灵巧的工匠，他们创作出精美的作品，带有美丽的青米釉，从花瓶、花盆、风铃、茶壶到壁画… 无不散发着优雅，非常美观。

此外，参观 Bat Trang 陶瓷村时，游客还可以按自己的喜好亲手塑形制作作品，与陶瓷村的工匠聊天，当然也少不了购买产品作为河内手工艺村之旅的礼物。

3. Chang Son 扇村

Chang Son 扇村位于河内石室县（Thach That），与许多传说相关联，已有200多年历史，因为这里著名的扇子全部由手工精心制作。

扇子看起来很简单，但都需要技艺精湛的工匠巧手制作，有丝绸扇、装饰壁扇、用作婚礼请柬的扇子或作为纪念品的高档扇子，游客常常购买扇子作为旅行纪念，尤其是国际游客来到这里时，会参观、拍照留念并购买纪念扇。

4. Chuong 村斗笠

这里是许多外国游客参观拍照的目的地，尤其受年轻人欢迎。这里有各种斗笠，例如：non quai thao、non doc pineapple、non no、non long、non toi、男士用的 non dau，或供奉用的圆锥形钟形斗笠…

5. Dao Thuc 水上木偶村

作为传统手工艺村之一，Dao Thuc 距河内约25公里，这里记录了自黎朝以来的水上木偶行业。尽管历经许多历史沧桑，这座手工艺村依然得以保存和弘扬，被许多游客选为河内游途中的一站。

6. Phu Vinh 竹藤村

作为传统竹编村之一，因当地人的巧手而有 Phu Hoa Trang 村等多个名称，凭借传统手工艺，Phu Vinh 村的孩子们从小与竹子和藤木相伴成长，制作出越来越精致的竹藤作品，不仅为当地人带来收入，也成为许多游客的旅游景点。

7. Thach Xa 竹蜻蜓村

说到 Thach Xa，它也是 Lam 茶和 Banh Te 的发源地。此外，竹蜻蜓也是知名的热门产品。来到这里，游客会看到用竹子精巧制成的蜻蜓栖息在各处，看起来非常精致。

8. Dong Ho 版画村

画作种类繁多，过去，画作通常在农历新年期间于乡村集市上制作和出售，Dong Ho 版画以其制作和印刷画作所用的材料而独具代表性，并结合了取自大自然的色彩。

制作画作的纸张由手工树皮制成，画作按照艺术灵感绘制并印在木板上，具有不同的鲜明色彩，许多游客在游览河内时常常参观 Dong Ho 版画村，并学习制作传统版画。

9. 河内 Quang Phu Cau 线香手工艺村

这里保存着北部地区的传统手工艺村，过去 Hung 村只供应国内的祭祀需求，如今已出口到其他国家，并成为许多游客前来的旅游景点，当成捆的线香被排列成花朵或字母S的形状在社交网站上传播时，Quang Phu Cau 线香村吸引了越来越多的游客前来参观。

可以说 Quang Phu Cau 手工艺村以其极高的美感而闻名。来到这里，游客可以参观并聆听工匠介绍制作线香的过程，从挑选竹子、包裹牙签、染色到制成精美产品等各个工序。

10. Me Tri 扁米（Com）村

目前有许多家庭制作扁米（Com），并已被列入17项国家级非物质文化遗产名录。这里的扁米经过非常精细的工序制成，有 Luong Phuong 糯米、香糯米、Tan 糯米、Quyt 糯米、Golden Flower 糯米… 将带来河内著名的美味扁米。

因此，要亲眼见证河内传统手工艺村之美，游客应跟随 Vietlook 一起探索手工艺村和乡村之美，进一步了解越南文化。

posts.title: Ha Long climate and months of the year
posts.excerpt: Ha Long has a climate of 4 seasons in the year: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter. Therefore, Ha Long is a destination for any season of the year. Today, let’s review the weather in Ha Long for 12 months
posts.contentHtml:
Ha Long has a climate of 4 seasons in the year: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter. Therefore, Ha Long is a destination for any season of the year. Today, let’s review the weather in Ha Long for 12 months below with Vietlook Travel. Ha Long climate and months of the year.

Ha Long weather in January

The weather is sunny, the temperature fluctuates around 18 degrees Celsius, there is fog in the early morning and little rain. If you travel to Ha Long in January, you should bring a thin shirt, for the convenience of sightseeing.

In addition, Ha Long in January is also the time when many special festivals and fun activities take place on the bay, very suitable for foreign tourists to Ha Long, and the cool weather is very suitable for conquering Ba Tho mountain, because at this time the temperature is low, so it is not convenient to participate in games under the sea.

February

Ha Long’s February temperature is lower than January, the temperature is around 17 degrees Celsius, and early mornings and late afternoons are still covered with fog, and this is also the occasion of Lunar New Year, a long holiday.

Ha Long weather in March.

The climate is very nice at this time, the sky is clear and sunny, the temperature is usually higher than January and February, Ha Long’s temperature in March is around 19 degrees Celsius, which is the time for those who like to experience mountain climbing.

April

The weather in summer begins to heat up, the temperature is around 24 degrees Celsius, this is the right time for tourists to experience Ha Long cruise tours, or participate in sea games, or paragliding from above.

May

At this time, many tourists go on a family tour Ha Long, but there are still sudden showers. At this time, Ha Long is in the hot summer, but when you come to the sea, you will feel cool, especially experiencing a luxurious 5 or 6-star cruise gliding on the water and stopping by scenic spots to enjoy delicious dishes right on the cruise, there is nothing more interesting.

Ha Long in June

At this time, Ha Long’s weather is at its peak in the summer, the temperature usually fluctuates around 30 degrees Celsius, very suitable for tourists to swim in the sea, or participate in games on the sea, and should not climb mountains, because the weather is quite hot at this time.

Ha Long climate in July and August

At this time, although Ha Long is sunny, there are still prolonged rains, even storms, so visibility is limited, not suitable for sightseeing experiences on the bay, however, this is the low season, so you can listen to the weather before traveling to Ha Long.

September

Ha Long at this time the rains have stopped and gradually entered the autumn weather, the temperature fluctuates around 18 degrees Celsius, however there are still sudden showers, so if you travel to Ha Long in September you should bring an umbrella to prevent the rain from affecting your tour.

October

The weather is quite cool, the temperature gradually decreases and this is also the beautiful weather for you to visit Ha Long, and you can visit the caves to explore the beauty, experience climbing Bai Tho mountain, and cycling to admire the scenery on the bay.

November

The weather enters the dry season, the temperature usually fluctuates around 24 degrees Celsius, and this is also the peak season of Ha Long, especially foreign tourists like to experience on yachts or rowing boats, or cycling to admire the beautiful scenery.

December

The weather is entering winter, the weather is clear and there are no more sudden showers, visitors can enjoy playing games on the sea, the weather is sunny and clear during the day, at night the weather starts to get cold, you should bring a jacket to go sightseeing and participate in night activities in the coastal city.

The above are experiences of traveling to Ha Long and Ha Long’s climate in the months of the year, hopefully it will help you in some way for your trip, if you have any questions, please contact Vietlook Travel immediately for more specific advice.
posts.excerptZh: 下龙湾一年有四季气候：春、夏、秋、冬。因此，下龙湾是一年四季皆宜的目的地。今天，让我们与 Vietlook Travel 一起回顾下龙湾十二个月
posts.contentHtmlZh:
下龙湾一年有四季气候：春、夏、秋、冬。因此，下龙湾是一年四季皆宜的目的地。今天，让我们与 Vietlook Travel 一起回顾下龙湾十二个月的天气。下龙湾气候与全年各月份。

一月的下龙湾天气

天气晴朗，气温在18摄氏度左右浮动，清晨有雾，雨水较少。如果您 前往下龙湾旅游 一月，应携带薄衬衫，便于观光。

此外，一月的下龙湾也是海湾上举行许多特色节庆和趣味活动的时期，非常适合来下龙湾的外国游客，而凉爽的天气非常适合征服 Ba Tho 山，因为此时气温较低，不便参加海上游戏。

二月

下龙湾二月的气温比一月低，约17摄氏度，清晨和傍晚仍有雾气笼罩，而且这也是农历新年的时期，有长假。

三月的下龙湾天气。

此时气候非常宜人，天空晴朗阳光明媚，气温通常比一月和二月高，下龙湾三月的气温约为19摄氏度，是喜欢体验登山的人的好时机。

四月

夏季的天气开始变热，气温约24摄氏度，这是游客体验 下龙湾游轮之旅、参加海上游戏或从空中体验滑翔伞的合适时间。

五月

此时许多游客参加家庭 下龙湾之旅，但仍有突发阵雨。此时下龙湾正值炎热的夏季，但来到海上您会感到凉爽，尤其是体验豪华的5星或6星游轮，在水面上滑行，并在景点停靠，在游轮上享用美味佳肴，没有什么比这更有趣了。

六月的下龙湾

此时下龙湾的天气处于夏季顶峰，气温通常在30摄氏度左右浮动，非常适合游客在海中游泳或参加海上游戏，不宜爬山，因为此时天气相当炎热。

七月和八月的下龙湾气候

此时虽然下龙湾阳光明媚，但仍有持续的降雨，甚至风暴，因此能见度有限，不适合在海湾上进行观光体验，不过，这是淡季，所以您可以在前往下龙湾之前留意天气预报。

九月

此时下龙湾雨水已停，逐渐进入秋季天气，气温在18摄氏度左右浮动，不过仍有突发阵雨，因此如果您九月前往下龙湾旅游，应带上雨伞，以防下雨影响您的行程。

十月

天气相当凉爽，气温逐渐下降，这也是游览下龙湾的美好天气，您可以参观洞穴探索其美景，体验攀登 Bai Tho 山，以及骑自行车欣赏海湾上的风景。

十一月

天气进入旱季，气温通常在24摄氏度左右浮动，这也是下龙湾的旺季，尤其是外国游客喜欢体验游艇或划艇，或骑自行车欣赏美丽的风景。

十二月

天气正在进入冬季，天气晴朗，不再有突发阵雨，游客可以享受海上游戏，白天天气晴朗明亮，夜晚天气开始变冷，您应带上外套去观光，并参加海滨城市的夜间活动。

以上是前往下龙湾旅游的经验以及下龙湾各月份的气候，希望能在某种程度上帮助到您的行程，如有任何疑问，请立即联系 Vietlook Travel 获取更具体的建议。

posts.title: What is beautiful about Ninh Binh tourism in November
posts.excerpt: Ninh Binh in November, the weather starts to turn into winter, a bit chilly, the sky is clear and there is no rain, and many tourists choose Ninh Binh as a destination for their vacation. However, if
posts.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh in November, the weather starts to turn into winter, a bit chilly, the sky is clear and there is no rain, and many tourists choose Ninh Binh as a destination for their vacation. However, if you are the first person to set foot in Ninh Binh, you will surely wonder what is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in November? So please read the article below.

Ninh Binh not only brings tourists scenic spots or sacred temples, but when coming here, tourists also encounter poetic scenes, unique cultures, especially immersing themselves in annual festivals will bring tourists a memorable vacation.

Places tourists should visit when traveling to Ninh Binh in November

Van Long Lagoon

Coming here, you will be immersed in the beautiful natural scenery, full of life, especially when you sit on the boats to admire the poetic scenery, looking like a charming landscape painting.

Thung Nham Bird Garden

Located about 4 km from Tam Coc scenic area, it is home to many species of birds such as: Storks, herons, teals, magpies… including many species listed in the Red Book of flamingos and phoenixes… the most beautiful is when in the evening flocks of birds fly back to their nests under the sunset, creating a beautiful scene for you to check in.

Trang An

Traveling to Trang An in November, you will be immersed in a unique festival, or sitting on boats to admire the poetic scenery, surrounded by high, overlapping rocky mountains, below is the clear blue water. Tourists sitting on boats gliding through the scenic spots will feel their souls truly comfortable, a poetic beauty that this place brings to visitors.

Bich Dong Pagoda

Located right at the foot of the mountain, with its back leaning against the mountain, facing the immense lake, surrounded by rows of cool green trees, and high rocky mountains creating a beautiful and peaceful scene.

What to eat when traveling to Ninh Binh in November?

Ninh Binh crispy rice

A famous dish, cooked from fried rice with a golden color through the skillful hands of the chef, has created delicious flavors unique to the cuisine of the North. Especially when going on a tour Ninh Binh in November in the cool weather, it is very suitable to enjoy crispy rice, a famous specialty.

Ninh Binh mountain goat

Goats here are raised by people on the mountains, so the meat is firm and delicious and through talented chefs are bringing diners an irresistible delicious flavor, goats can be processed into dishes such as: Raw goat with lemon, grilled goat with cast iron, Spicy goat stir-fry, Goat sauce ….

Ninh Binh mountain snails

Snails often live in caves and are most abundant during the rainy season, snails are fragrant and very crispy and are processed into many dishes such as: Grilled, stir-fried, boiled with lemongrass, steamed with ginger … all bring their own delicious flavors.

Gia Vien Shrimp Paste
Shrimp paste, also known as shrimp paste, sour sauce, is made from freshwater shrimp and Gia Vien water, so it has its own unique flavor and attractive aroma, often used to dip meat, vegetables or vermicelli.

Cai sauce

Made from fresh and delicious crabs, processed very elaborately, the crabs are caught and soaked in rice water, then crushed and put in a jar for 1 week… eaten with boiled vegetables, it looks simple but brings a unique delicious flavor, a famous specialty.

So with the experience of traveling to Ninh Binh in November that Vietlook Travel has shared with you, we hope you will choose for yourself the best tour, let’s come to Ninh Binh today.
posts.titleZh: 十一月宁平旅游美在哪里
posts.excerptZh: 十一月的宁平，天气开始转入冬季，略带凉意，天空晴朗无雨，许多游客选择宁平作为度假目的地。不过，如果您是
posts.contentHtmlZh:
十一月的宁平，天气开始转入冬季，略带凉意，天空晴朗无雨，许多游客选择宁平作为度假目的地。不过，如果您是第一次踏足宁平，一定会好奇十一月去宁平旅游有什么美景？那就请阅读下面的文章吧。

宁平不仅为游客带来风景名胜或神圣的寺庙，来到这里，游客还能遇到如诗的景色和独特的文化，尤其是融入每年的节庆活动，将为游客带来难忘的假期。

十一月 宁平旅游 时游客应该参观的地方

云龙湿地

来到这里，您将沉浸在美丽的自然风光中，充满生机，尤其是乘船欣赏如诗的景色，宛如一幅迷人的风景画。

Thung Nham 鸟园

距三谷景区约4公里，这里是许多鸟类的家园，如：鹳、鹭、水鸭、喜鹊……其中包括许多列入红皮书的物种，还有火烈鸟和凤凰……最美的是傍晚时分，成群的鸟儿在夕阳下飞回巢穴，构成一幅美丽的画面，供您打卡拍照。

长安

十一月游览长安，您将沉浸在独特的节庆之中，或乘船欣赏如诗的风景，四周是高耸、层叠的石山，下面是清澈的碧水。游客坐在船上滑过景区，会感到心灵无比舒畅，这是这里带给游客的如诗之美。

碧洞寺

寺庙正好位于山脚下，背靠大山，面朝广阔的湖泊，周围环绕着成排凉爽的绿树和高耸的石山，构成一幅美丽而宁静的画面。

十一月去宁平旅游吃什么？

宁平锅巴

一道著名的菜肴，由炸得金黄的米饭经过厨师的巧手烹制而成，创造出北方美食独有的美味。尤其是十一月在凉爽的天气里参加 宁平之旅 ，非常适合品尝锅巴这道著名的特色美食。

宁平山羊肉

这里的山羊由当地人在山上放养，所以肉质紧实鲜美，再经过巧手厨师的烹制，为食客带来令人无法抗拒的美味，山羊肉可以制作成：柠檬生羊肉、铁板烤羊肉、香辣炒羊肉、羊肉酱等……

宁平山螺

螺通常生活在洞穴中，雨季时数量最多，螺肉香气扑鼻、非常酥脆，可以加工成多种菜肴，如：烧烤、爆炒、香茅煮、姜蒸……都各有独特的美味。

嘉远虾酱
虾酱，又称虾膏、酸酱，由淡水虾和嘉远的水制成，因此有独特的风味和诱人的香气，常用来蘸肉、蔬菜或米线。

Cai 酱

用新鲜美味的螃蟹制成，加工非常精细，螃蟹捕获后浸泡在淘米水中，然后捣碎放入罐中1周……搭配水煮蔬菜食用，看似简单却带来独特的美味，是著名的特产。

以上就是 Vietlook Travel 与您分享的十一月宁平旅游经验，希望您为自己选择最好的旅程，今天就来宁平吧。

posts.title: Visit Dong Giang Heaven Gate
posts.excerpt: Visit Dong Giang Heaven Gate, you will conquer the height of 1500m above sea level from the gate of heaven, you will see the scenery from the rice fields, to the corn fields in the distance, the villa
posts.contentHtml:
Visit Dong Giang Heaven Gate, you will conquer the height of 1500m above sea level from the gate of heaven, you will see the scenery from the rice fields, to the corn fields in the distance, the villages hidden in the misty fog, exuding a unique beauty in the mountainous region.

Dong Giang Heaven Gate scenic area is located in Quang Nam and about 120km from the center of Da Nang city, Dong Giang Heaven Gate is a place with majestic mountain scenery, especially mountain climbing, trekking, swimming activities are chosen by many tourists for peaceful moments in the mountains and forests.

Coming to Dong Giang Heaven Gate, visitors will encounter natural streams, steep cliffs, unique caves inside with beautiful stalactites such as: Ngoc De Cave, Cong Troi Cave, Tien Cung Cave…

The most beautiful is Tien Cung Cave with 9 large and small caves, with waterfalls flowing all year round creating colorful natural stalactites, looking very eye-catching in a relatively cool climate. If you have the opportunity to go on a tour to Da Nang, visit Tien Cung Cave and admire the natural beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.

In addition, when traveling to Dong Giang Heaven Gate, you will also be immersed in the wild natural scenery in the middle of the mountains and forests, taking you from one surprise to another.

The most interesting thing that many young people come to Dong Giang Heaven Gate is the camping spot next to the peaceful stream, especially when traveling in large groups or groups of friends, tourists can participate in team building games, mountain climbing, SUP rowing, bathing in the stream… which will bring visitors the most enjoyable feeling in the Central region.

In addition, visitors can also visit the Dragon Egg Waterfall, the bonbon forest park, 7 bridges across the Ngan River, the fossil dinosaur area… promising to bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

It can be said that Dong Giang Heaven Gate is a place with a cool climate all year round, with mountain ranges, streams, and caves that are beautiful check-in spots. No matter what angle you stand at, visitors can capture beautiful photos for themselves.

Especially when traveling to Dong Giang Heaven Gate, visitors can also enjoy rustic dishes with the rich flavor of the mountains and forests and specialties of the Co Tu people and participate in unique cultural festivals.

Co Tu dishes in Da Nang

The delicious dishes of the Co Tu people include grilled fish, bamboo rice, buffalo croissant, dried beef jerky, grass-fed pork cooked with wild pepper, rock snails cooked with lemongrass…

The dishes of the Co Tu people are very elaborately prepared, from the available ingredients of the mountainous homeland, then processed, especially on the day of the festival, the food is presented very eye-catchingly.

All the dishes prepared by the Co Tu people are very attractive, including grilled fish, bamboo rice, buffalo croissant, dried beef jerky… and drinks such as Ta Vat wine, sticky rice wine… all the dishes look very simple but very attractive.

It can be said that this is not only a daily dish but also shows the culture, customs and practices of the Co Tu people, a culture that seems to have an exchange between all things and the natural landscape of the mountains and forests.

All dishes of the Co Tu people in Quang Nam will show traditional culture, dishes are often simply prepared such as grilled, boiled, smoked with spices such as wild pepper, roasted leaves will give off a strong aroma.

So let’s travel to Da Nang with Vietlook Travel today and visit Dong Giang Heaven Gate to visit the natural beauty, streams, caves, special festivals and unique cuisine that will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.
posts.excerptZh: 参观东江天门，您将从天门登上海拔1500米的高度，看到从稻田到远处玉米地的风景，以及隐藏在薄雾中的村庄，散发着山区独特的美。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
参观东江天门，您将从天门登上海拔1500米的高度，看到从稻田到远处玉米地的风景，以及隐藏在薄雾中的村庄，散发着山区独特的美。

东江天门（Dong Giang Heaven Gate）景区位于广南省，距岘港市中心约120公里，东江天门是拥有雄伟山区风光的地方，尤其是登山、徒步和游泳活动深受许多游客选择，在山林中度过宁静时光。

来到东江天门，游客将邂逅天然溪流、陡峭悬崖、内有美丽钟乳石的独特洞穴，例如：玉帝洞（Ngoc De）、天门洞（Cong Troi）、仙宫洞（Tien Cung）……

最美的是仙宫洞，共有9个大小洞穴，终年有瀑布流淌，形成色彩斑斓的天然钟乳石，在相对凉爽的气候中看起来非常引人注目。如果有机会参加 岘港之旅，请参观仙宫洞，欣赏大自然赋予这片土地的天然美景。

此外，前往东江天门旅行时，您还将沉浸在山林中的野性自然风光里，带给您一个又一个惊喜。

许多年轻人来到东江天门最感兴趣的是宁静溪流边的露营地，尤其是大团体或朋友结伴出游时，游客可以参加团队建设游戏、登山、SUP划桨、溪中沐浴……这将为游客带来中部地区最愉快的感受。

此外，游客还可以参观龙蛋瀑布、bonbon森林公园、横跨Ngan河的7座桥、化石恐龙区……承诺为游客带来最愉快的假期。

可以说，东江天门终年气候凉爽，拥有山脉、溪流和洞穴等美丽的打卡点。无论站在哪个角度，游客都能为自己拍下美丽的照片。

尤其是前往东江天门旅行时，游客还可以品尝带有浓郁山林风味的质朴菜肴和戈都族（Co Tu）的特产，并参加独特的文化节庆。

岘港的戈都族菜肴

戈都族的美味菜肴包括烤鱼、竹筒饭、水牛羊角面包、牛肉干、野胡椒煮草饲猪肉、香茅煮石螺……

戈都族的菜肴制作非常精细，使用山区家乡现成的食材，然后加工处理，尤其是在节庆之日，食物的摆盘非常引人注目。

戈都族准备的所有菜肴都非常诱人，包括烤鱼、竹筒饭、水牛羊角面包、牛肉干……以及Ta Vat酒、糯米酒等饮品……所有菜肴看起来都很简单，却非常诱人。

可以说，这不仅仅是日常菜肴，更展现了戈都族的文化、风俗和习惯，这种文化似乎与山林的万物和自然景观之间存在着交流。

广南省戈都族的所有菜肴都展现传统文化，菜肴通常烹制简单，如烤、煮、熏，搭配野胡椒等香料，烤叶会散发出浓郁的香气。

那么，让我们今天 前往岘港 与 Vietlook Travel 一起，参观东江天门，游览自然美景、溪流、洞穴、特色节庆和独特美食，将为游客带来最愉快的假期。

posts.title: Top 10 hottest check-in spots in Hanoi
posts.excerpt: Let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the Top 10 hottest check-in spots in Hanoi, which will help you have the most enjoyable tour when you have the opportunity to set foot in Hanoi. The best time to t
posts.contentHtml:
Let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the Top 10 hottest check-in spots in Hanoi, which will help you have the most enjoyable tour when you have the opportunity to set foot in Hanoi.

The best time to travel to Hanoi is December – March and July to September. The climate here has 4 distinct seasons. Visitors will admire the scenery of Hanoi and experience the cultural space of the North.

1. Long Bien Bridge

The bridge is the pride of the people of the capital. The bridge crosses the Red River. From the bridge, visitors can admire the scenery of the poetic river and in the distance is the scenery of the peaceful countryside. Visitors can capture beautiful pictures.

2. Train Street

As one of the ancient places of the capital, many young people come to take virtual photos, especially when the train is running, surrounded by ancient houses exuding a simple beauty in the old town.

3. Cathedral

The church has its own design, located at the intersection of 3 major streets, this place is most beautifully decorated on Christmas, visitors will be immersed in the atmosphere of the festival night.

4. Cat Linh Station

An extremely hot check-in spot chosen by many young people, if you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi, visitors should visit here and take pictures of themselves at Ha Dong station with very impressive background photos for you to save beautiful pictures.

5. Sunflower Field

The flower field is located near Nhat Tan Bridge, a virtual living spot for every tourist when they have the opportunity to set foot in Hanoi, the flower field located next to the peaceful river is a relaxing spot chosen by many tourists, especially on weekends or during their vacations.

6. Phung Hung Mural Street

A place with its own unique beauty, coming here, visitors seem to relive the ancient space that looks like fairy gardens, all recreated by Vietnamese – Korean artists, bringing a colorful space.

7. Van Phuc Village

A traditional silk village, visitors can visit the stalls to buy souvenirs or take beautiful pictures of the craft village scene, the peaceful countryside here still retains the traditional beauty of the Vietnamese countryside.

8. Ho Guom Walking Street

A peaceful space without dust, because this place is reserved for pedestrians, especially on weekends, visitors come here not only to visit, check in or admire the scenery but also to blend in with the vibrant atmosphere of melodious music…

9. Long Bien Flower Grassland

Located in the suburbs of Hanoi, where there are many colorful flowers, it is a check-in spot that many tourists come to, visit and admire the colorful flowers.

10. Vinpearl Aquarium

Located in the center of Hanoi, Vinpearl Aquarium is home to many rare marine species, appearing in the cool blue water, a beautiful scene, a virtual living spot that many young people are hunting for.

If you are a virtual life lover, follow Vietlook Travel to visit and admire the scenery at the famous landmarks of Hanoi Capital today. You do not need to spend too much time, just register for a 1-day Hanoi tour and you can be satisfied with the beauty of the capital.

In addition, when arriving in Hanoi, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes such as: Pho, Bun thang, Bun oc chuoi dau, Bun rieu, Bun moc, Bun dau mam tom, Chao ca, nem, beef salad… or snacks that you must try at least once in your life such as Trang Tien ice cream, Pho Co cafe, My van thang… bringing the delicious flavor of Northern cuisine.

Hanoi not only has a long-standing historical culture but also owns beautiful landscapes. Any visitor who first sets foot in Hanoi will be amazed by the natural beauty and many beautiful virtual living spots
posts.excerptZh: 让我们跟随Vietlook Travel一起回顾河内十大最热门打卡地，当您有机会踏上河内时，这将帮助您享受最愉快的旅程。前往河内旅行的最佳时间是12月至3月以及7月至9月。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
让我们跟随Vietlook Travel一起回顾河内十大最热门打卡地，当您有机会踏上河内时，这将帮助您享受最愉快的旅程。

前往河内旅行的最佳时间是12月–3月以及7月至9月。这里的气候四季分明。游客将欣赏河内的风光，体验北方的文化空间。

1. 龙编桥

这座桥是首都人民的骄傲。大桥横跨红河。从桥上，游客可以欣赏诗意的河景，远处是宁静乡村的景色。游客可以拍下美丽的照片。

2. 火车街

作为首都的古老地点之一，许多年轻人来这里拍照打卡，尤其是火车驶过时，周围古老的房屋散发着老城区质朴的美。

3. 大教堂

这座教堂设计独特，位于三条主要街道的交汇处，圣诞节时这里装饰得最为美丽，游客将沉浸在节日之夜的氛围中。

4. 吉灵站（Cat Linh）

一个深受许多年轻人青睐的超热门打卡地，如果您有机会前往河内旅行，应该来这里参观，并在河东站（Ha Dong）拍下自己的照片，背景非常出色，能为您留下美丽的照片。

5. 向日葵花田

这片花田位于日新桥（Nhat Tan）附近，是每位游客来到河内时的拍照打卡地，紧邻宁静河流的花田是许多游客选择的放松之处，尤其是在周末或假期。

6. 凤凰街（Phung Hung）壁画街

一个拥有独特之美的地方，来到这里，游客仿佛重温古老的空间，宛如童话花园，全部由越南和韩国艺术家重现，带来色彩缤纷的空间。

7. 万福村

一个传统的丝绸村，游客可以参观摊位购买纪念品，或拍摄手工艺村的美景，这里宁静的乡村依然保留着越南乡村的传统之美。

8. 还剑湖步行街

一个没有尘嚣的宁静空间，因为这里专为行人保留，尤其是在周末，游客来到这里不仅是为了参观、打卡或欣赏风景，也是为了融入悠扬音乐的热闹氛围……

9. 龙编花草地

位于河内郊区，这里有许多五颜六色的花朵，是许多游客前来参观和欣赏缤纷花海的打卡地。

10. 珍珠海洋馆（Vinpearl Aquarium）

位于河内市中心的珍珠海洋馆是许多珍稀海洋物种的家园，在清凉的蓝色海水中呈现出美丽的景象，是许多年轻人争相寻找的打卡地。

如果您是打卡爱好者，今天就跟随Vietlook Travel参观并欣赏河内首都著名地标的风景吧。您不需要花太多时间，只需报名 a 河内一日游 ，就能欣赏首都之美，心满意足。

此外，来到河内，游客还可以品尝美味诱人的菜肴，如：河粉、Bun thang、蕉芋螺蛳粉（Bun oc chuoi dau）、蟹汤米线（Bun rieu）、Bun moc、豆腐虾酱米线（Bun dau mam tom）、鱼粥、春卷、牛肉沙拉……或一生中至少要尝一次的小吃，如Trang Tien冰淇淋、Pho Co咖啡、Mi van thang……带来北方美食的美味。

河内不仅拥有悠久的历史文化，还拥有美丽的风景。任何初次踏上河内的游客都会为这里的自然美景和许多美丽的打卡地而惊叹

posts.title: Top 4 Hue specialty noodle dishes
posts.excerpt: Top 4 Hue specialty noodle dishes chosen by many diners when they have the opportunity to visit Hue, these are famous dishes that you don’t need to go to fancy restaurants, but right at sidewalk eater
posts.contentHtml:
Top 4 Hue specialty noodle dishes chosen by many diners when they have the opportunity to visit Hue, these are famous dishes that you don’t need to go to fancy restaurants, but right at sidewalk eateries you can enjoy bowls of noodles with Hue flavors.

Hue is a place with a rich and attractive culinary background, including the dishes that many tourists choose when they have the opportunity to set foot in Hue, we must mention the top 4 Hue specialty noodle dishes, let’s take a look.

1. Nam Pho noodle soup

As one of the quite familiar street foods in Hue, Nam Pho noodle soup is processed very elaborately, especially the broth that brings its own unique flavor, so the broth is often processed with fresh shrimp shells boiled with pork bones plus fish sauce to have a characteristic aroma.

Shrimp sprouts, soft and sticky noodle noodles of tapioca flour combined with the broth blend together to bring a delicious flavor, if you have the opportunity to travel Da Nang – Hue, visitors should enjoy Nam Pho noodle soup to feel the delicious flavor of Central cuisine.

2. Crab noodle soup

One of the traditional noodle soup dishes, and the main ingredients such as crab meat, crab cakes… the crabs here are carefully selected, the flavor must be fresh, the meat is firm. The broth is made from crab fat simmered with bones, bringing an irresistible delicious flavor.

The broth has a natural sweetness, made from crab fat, pork bones, enjoyed with noodles made from rice flour, cut into small strands, bringing toughness and elasticity. Especially when traveling to Hue in the fall, visitors should enjoy crab cakes to feel the delicious flavor.

3. Snakehead fish noodle soup

When processed, it is marinated with shrimp paste, mixed with spices to soak in for about 2 hours, then fried until golden brown, eaten with noodles made from chewy rice flour, snakehead fish bone broth, when enjoying, visitors will feel the rich flavor and sweetness.

Snakehead fish noodle soup with raw vegetables, in the autumn weather, there is nothing more interesting than enjoying a bowl of steaming snakehead fish noodle soup, if you have the opportunity to travel to Hue, visitors should enjoy this delicious and attractive dish.

3. Banh canh bot tron

Although the dish is simple, it has a rich flavor of the countryside, a typical dish of Hue, tapioca flour because of the mixture of pure white tapioca flour and black color, both eating and reducing the toughness of the cake.

The broth of tapioca flour noodles is very unique compared to other noodle dishes, because the broth is cooked from field crabs, cooked with pork bones to create the sweet flavor typical of Hue tapioca flour noodles.

If anyone has ever set foot in Hue, has enjoyed noodle dishes, then surely cannot ignore Hue tapioca flour noodles, this is one of the delicious and attractive dishes.

In addition, when coming to Hue, you can also enjoy vegetarian tapioca flour noodles, the ingredients include flowers, coriander, chopped clean milk, thinly sliced ​​fried tofu, and washed and drained straw mushrooms. Then stir-fry with spices until the onions start to turn yellow, add straw mushrooms, fried tofu, bean curd skin, black fungus…

Cook tapioca noodles with about 600ml, stir well, add noodles, cook for about 5 minutes, turn off the stove, scoop the noodles into a bowl, decorate with a few green onions, it looks very eye-catching, each noodle is soft, chewy and delicious, mushrooms are crispy with tofu and vegetables are delicious and attractive.
posts.excerptZh: 顺化四大特色面食，是许多食客有机会游览顺化时的首选，这些都是著名的美食，无需前往高档餐厅，在路边小摊就能品尝到带有顺化风味的面食。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
顺化四大特色面食，是许多食客有机会游览顺化时的首选。这些都是著名的美食，无需前往高档餐厅，在路边小摊就能品尝到带有顺化风味的一碗碗面食。

顺化拥有丰富而诱人的美食底蕴，其中许多游客踏足顺化时都会选择的美食，就不得不提顺化四大特色面食，让我们一起来看看。

1. 南浦粉汤（Nam Pho）

作为顺化相当常见的街头小吃之一，南浦粉汤制作十分精细，尤其是汤底别具一格：汤底通常用新鲜虾壳与猪骨一起熬煮，再加入鱼露，散发出独特的香气。

虾芽、软糯的木薯粉面条与汤底相互交融，带来鲜美的味道。如果您有机会 前往岘港 –顺化旅行，不妨品尝一下南浦粉汤，感受中部美食的美味。

2. 蟹汤面

这是传统汤面之一，主要食材有蟹肉、蟹饼等……这里的螃蟹经过精心挑选，味道必须新鲜，肉质紧实。汤底用蟹膏与骨头一起熬煮，味道令人难以抗拒。

汤底带有天然的鲜甜，由蟹膏和猪骨熬成，搭配切成细条的米粉面条，口感筋道有弹性。尤其是秋季到顺化旅行时，游客更应品尝蟹饼，感受其美味。

3. 黑鱼汤面

制作时，先用虾酱腌制，拌入香料浸泡约2小时，再炸至金黄，搭配筋道的米粉面条和黑鱼骨熬制的汤底食用，品尝时游客会感受到浓郁的味道和鲜甜。

黑鱼汤面配生菜，在秋天的天气里，没有什么比享用一碗热气腾腾的黑鱼汤面更有趣了。如果您有机会到顺化旅行，不妨品尝这道美味诱人的菜肴。

3. 木薯粉粗面（Banh canh bot tron）

这道菜虽然简单，却有着浓郁的乡土风味，是顺化的代表性美食。木薯粉面是由纯白的木薯粉与深色粉料混合制成，既好吃，又能减少面条的韧度。

木薯粉面的汤底与其他面食相比非常独特，因为汤底是用田蟹与猪骨一起熬煮而成，形成了顺化木薯粉面特有的鲜甜味道。

如果有人曾踏足顺化、品尝过面食，那么一定不能错过顺化木薯粉面，这是一道美味诱人的佳肴。

此外，来到顺化，您还可以品尝素食木薯粉面，食材包括花、香菜、切碎的洁净牛奶、切成薄片的炸豆腐，以及洗净沥干的草菇。然后加入调料翻炒，待洋葱开始变黄，加入草菇、炸豆腐、腐竹、黑木耳……

用大约600毫升水煮木薯粉面，搅拌均匀，放入面条煮约5分钟后关火，将面条盛入碗中，撒上少许葱花，看起来十分醒目。每根面条都软糯有嚼劲、美味可口，蘑菇脆嫩，豆腐和蔬菜鲜美诱人。
