posts.contentHtml:
Young Com, a specialty of Hanoi’s autumn, is one of the famous specialties. In the autumn weather, you can enjoy the scenery while enjoying lemon tea, egg coffee and young Com, there is nothing more interesting.

Although Com is a rustic dish, it has a strong traditional flavor of Vietnamese culture. Unlike Com from the Northwest, Ha Thanh Com is often processed into many dishes such as sticky rice with lotus seeds and green beans, Com sausage, fried Com…

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour of Hanoi, you should visit the street food stalls or coffee shops in the corners of Hanoi to enjoy young Com while admiring the scenery of Hanoi.

Especially in the autumn weather, visitors can enjoy Com with glasses of lemon tea, kumquat tea or egg coffee… which is one of the Hanoi cuisines that has a strong traditional culinary background but is also very new to young people.

Many restaurants in Hanoi have caught up with the trend of young people, with young rice on their menus, such as dishes made from green rice, such as green rice, sticky rice or stir-fried green rice, a typical culinary background of Hanoi’s autumn.

Not only that, after enjoying the meal, customers can also buy green rice cakes as gifts, or enjoy green rice coconut smoothies, matcha green rice… which further enriches the culinary background, and diners also feel more excited.

So if you have the opportunity to visit Hanoi in the fall, enjoy green rice, a famous specialty, and don’t forget to buy some as gifts for friends and relatives.
posts.titleZh: 嫩扁米——河内秋天的特产
posts.excerptZh: 嫩米片（Com），河内秋天的特产，是著名的特产之一。在秋天的天气里，您可以一边欣赏风景一边享用柠檬茶、蛋咖啡和嫩米片，没有什么比这更有趣了。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
嫩米片（Com），河内秋天的特产，是著名的特产之一。在秋天的天气里，您可以一边欣赏风景一边享用柠檬茶、蛋咖啡和嫩米片，没有什么比这更有趣了。

虽然 Com 是一道质朴的菜肴，却带有浓郁的越南文化传统风味。与西北的 Com 不同，河内（Ha Thanh）的 Com 常被加工成许多菜肴，如莲子绿豆糯米饭、Com 香肠、炒 Com…

如果您有机会参加 河内之旅，您应该去河内街角的街头小吃摊或咖啡店，一边欣赏河内的风景一边享用嫩米片。

尤其是在秋天的天气里，游客可以搭配柠檬茶、金桔茶或蛋咖啡等享用 Com…这是既具有浓厚传统美食底蕴、又对年轻人来说非常新颖的河内美食之一。

河内许多餐厅紧跟年轻人的潮流，菜单上有嫩米制品，例如以青米制成的菜肴，如青米饭、糯米饭或炒青米，是河内秋天典型的美食底蕴。

不仅如此，用餐后，顾客还可以购买青米糕作为礼物，或享用青米椰子冰沙、抹茶青米…这进一步丰富了美食底蕴，食客也感到更加兴奋。

因此，如果您有机会在秋天游览河内，请品尝青米这一著名特产，别忘了买一些作为礼物送给亲朋好友。

posts.title: What is beautiful about Sapa tourism in October
posts.excerpt: What is beautiful about Sapa tourism in October is a question for those who travel to Sapa for the first time, still wondering where to visit in October, so to see the scenery of Sapa in October, let’
posts.contentHtml:
What is beautiful about Sapa tourism in October is a question for those who travel to Sapa for the first time, still wondering where to visit in October, so to see the scenery of Sapa in October, let’s join Vietlook to Sapa today.

Sapa in October, the weather is in the fall, the cool breeze, along with the golden terraced fields, all the roads or villages are covered in brilliant yellow, especially villages such as: Lao Chai – Ta Van – Y Linh Ho are places that many tourists come to visit, especially young people who come here not only to visit but also to check in for themselves pictures next to the ripe rice season.

Sapa climate in October

October is the season of red leaves for many places, but Sapa is covered in a long yellow color, the temperature in Sapa at this time fluctuates from 18 to 25 degrees Celsius, the weather is clear during the day and cold at night.

In October, Sapa occasionally has showers, the morning is a bit cold and foggy, but when the sun just rises, the sky will be clear and visitors can record those moments as souvenirs, especially when on the top of Fansipan, visitors will record this beautiful scene, this is the most beautiful moment when going on a tour of Sapa in October.

What to wear when traveling to Sapa in October?

When coming to Sapa in October, you should bring autumn and winter clothes to wear in the early morning and late afternoon, because the temperature is cool during the day but cold in the early morning and late afternoon, but don’t forget to bring beautiful clothes to take pictures.

If you are a virtual person when visiting scenic spots, you can rent traditional costumes of the highlanders to capture beautiful photos, next to the autumn scenery of Sapa.

What is beautiful in October when traveling to Sapa?, and check-in points in Sapa

Fansipan Peak

When coming to Sapa, the first destination that visitors cannot miss is Fansipan Peak, located at an altitude of 3,143m. From here, visitors will immerse themselves in the sea of ​​clouds, from here they can see the whole view of Sapa from above.

Cat Cat Village

As one of the villages with many H’mong ethnic people living, when coming here, visitors can not only visit and enjoy the scenery, but also experience the life of the highlanders, especially the experience of weaving with brocades that visitors can buy as gifts.

Ham Rong Mountain

A check-in spot chosen by many tourists, especially young people who come here not only to visit but also to record beautiful pictures, it seems that this place has flowers blooming all year round, the weather is cool and the scenery is beautiful. Therefore, Ham Rong Mountain is a virtual living spot that cannot be missed when coming to Sapa.

Moana miniature landscape

A place with a beautiful view, there are many miniature landscapes for tourists to take virtual living, an indispensable destination when traveling to Sapa, no matter what angle visitors stand from, they can record beautiful pictures for themselves.

Ta Van Village, Lao Chai

Coming here in October, visitors will be immersed in the beauty of the golden season in the Northwest mountains, a beautiful scene for visitors to freely check in.

Sapa Dragon Cloud Glass Bridge

Located precariously on a rocky mountain, from the bridge visitors can admire the poetic beauty, below are villages milling terraced fields in golden autumn, visitors can capture beautiful moments in the Sapa weather in October.

Muong Hoa Valley

Coming here, visitors will be immersed in the colors of flowers, visitors experience the mountain train and admire the purple flowers, October Sapa has a little light sunshine with a faint scent, very suitable for visitors to visit and enjoy the scenery of Muong Hoa Valley in October.

Ban Y Linh Ho Sapa

A beautiful place to see the ripe rice season when traveling to Sapa in October, a place with rustic natural scenery, one of the peaceful villages, if you are a person who loves to admire the beautiful natural scenery, Ban Y Linh Ho Sapa is the destination for you.

Sapa O Long Tea Hill

October O Long Tea Hill has flower trees planted on the tea hill that have begun to bloom, especially coming here early in the morning, visitors will be satisfied with checking in next to the beautiful scenery, or when the dawn comes, the rays of sunlight shine in, creating a beautiful scene.

What to eat when traveling to Sapa in October?

The delicious dishes in Sapa include thang co, salmon and sturgeon hotpot, fish salad, grilled chicken, bamboo rice, grilled meat prepared with typical ingredients of the Northwest mountains, bringing a delicious flavor of its own. In addition, visitors can also order dishes on a tray of wild vegetables, stir-fried meat, grilled chicken, pork intestines, pork, cham cheo dipping sauce, fern salad… diners will remember this delicious flavor forever.

So above are the experiences of traveling to Sapa in October, Vietlook wants to share with you, to see that beauty with your own eyes, please register for the 3-day 2-night Sapa tour today.
posts.titleZh: 十月沙坝旅游美在哪里
posts.excerptZh: 10月沙坝旅游有什么美景，是第一次前往沙坝、还在犹豫10月去哪里游玩的人会问的问题，因此想欣赏10月沙坝的风光，今天就让我们与Vietlook一起前往沙坝吧。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
10月沙坝旅游有什么美景，是第一次前往沙坝、还在犹豫10月去哪里游玩的人会问的问题，因此想欣赏10月沙坝的风光，今天就让我们与Vietlook一起前往沙坝吧。

10月的沙坝，天气进入秋季，凉风习习，伴随着金黄色的梯田，所有的道路和村庄都被灿烂的金黄色覆盖，尤其是老寨 – 打坟 – 丫林号（Lao Chai – Ta Van – Y Linh Ho）等村庄，是许多游客前来参观的地方，特别是年轻人来到这里不仅是参观，还要在成熟稻谷季节旁拍照打卡。

10月的沙坝气候

10月对许多地方来说是红叶的季节，但沙坝却被一片长长的金黄色覆盖，此时沙坝的气温在18至25摄氏度之间波动，白天晴朗，夜晚寒冷。

10月的沙坝偶尔有阵雨，早晨有点冷且有雾，但当太阳刚刚升起时，天空会放晴，游客可以记录下这些时刻作为纪念，尤其是在番西邦峰顶时，游客将记录下这幅美丽的景象，这是10月游览沙坝时最美的时刻。

10月去沙坝穿什么？

10月来到沙坝，您应该携带秋冬衣物，在清晨和傍晚穿着，因为白天气温凉爽，但清晨和傍晚较冷，不过也别忘了带上好看的衣服拍照。

如果您是参观景点时喜欢拍照打卡的人，可以租用高地人的传统服饰，在沙坝秋景旁拍摄美照。

10月去沙坝有什么美景？沙坝打卡点

番西邦峰（Fansipan）

来到沙坝，游客不容错过的第一个目的地就是番西邦峰，海拔3,143米。从这里，游客将沉浸在云海之中，从这里可以俯瞰沙坝的全景。

猫猫村（Cat Cat）

作为苗族（H’mong）人聚居的村庄之一，来到这里，游客不仅可以参观并欣赏风景，还可以体验高地人的生活，尤其是织锦的体验，游客可以购买织锦作为礼物。

含龙山（Ham Rong）

这是许多游客选择的打卡点，尤其是年轻人来到这里不仅是参观，还要拍下美丽的照片，这里似乎终年都有鲜花盛开，天气凉爽，风景优美。因此，含龙山是来到沙坝不容错过的拍照打卡地。

Moana微缩景观

一个景色优美的地方，有许多微缩景观供游客拍照，是前往沙坝旅游时不可或缺的目的地，无论游客从哪个角度站立，都可以为自己留下美丽的照片。

打坟村（Ta Van）、老寨（Lao Chai）

10月来到这里，游客将沉浸在西北山区金色季节之美中，这是一幅供游客自由打卡的美丽景象。

沙坝龙云玻璃桥

桥身惊险地架在岩石山上，从桥上游客可以欣赏如诗如画的美景，下方是金色秋天里层层梯田的村庄，游客可以捕捉10月沙坝天气里的美好瞬间。

木花谷（Muong Hoa）

来到这里，游客将沉浸在花海的色彩之中，游客可以体验登山火车并欣赏紫色的花朵，10月的沙坝有淡淡的阳光和若有若无的香气，非常适合游客在10月参观并欣赏木花谷的风光。

沙坝丫林号村（Y Linh Ho）

这是10月前往沙坝时欣赏稻谷成熟季节的好地方，一个拥有质朴自然风光的地方，是宁静的村庄之一，如果您是热爱欣赏美丽自然风光的人，沙坝丫林号村就是适合您的目的地。

沙坝乌龙茶山（O Long）

10月的乌龙茶山，茶山上种植的花树已开始绽放，尤其是清晨来到这里，游客将在美丽的风景旁满意地打卡，或者当黎明来临时，阳光照射进来，营造出美丽的景象。

10月去沙坝吃什么？

沙坝的美味佳肴包括马肉锅（thang co）、三文鱼和鲟鱼火锅、鱼生沙拉、烤鸡、竹筒饭、用西北山区特色食材制作的烤肉，带来独特的美味。此外，游客还可以点上一盘野菜、炒肉、烤鸡、猪肠、猪肉、Cham Cheo蘸酱、蕨菜沙拉……食客将永远记住这种美味。

以上就是Vietlook想与您分享的10月沙坝旅游体验，想亲眼看到这份美，请今天就报名 沙坝3天2夜游 。

posts.title: Experience the Mekong Cruise
posts.excerpt: The Mekong Cruise will bring visitors exciting experiences, and admire the beauty of a river region, you will have an interesting vacation on a cruise on the floating water in the Mekong. When experie
posts.contentHtml:
The Mekong Cruise will bring visitors exciting experiences, and admire the beauty of a river region, you will have an interesting vacation on a cruise on the floating water in the Mekong.

When experiencing on the cruises in the floating season in the Mekong, it will bring you outstanding experiences that cannot be found anywhere else.

In addition to enjoying the attractive cuisine – famous specialties of the West, you can enjoy it right on the cruise, and freely admire the scenery on the deck, soak in the cool water at the infinity pool of the cruise, the bar or the mini golf course on the cruise and enjoy the best vacation.

If you are someone who loves to admire the scenery of the flood season on a cruise, take a Mekong tour with Vietlook Travel today to experience on the cruises, which will bring you the most enjoyable vacation.

Take a trip to the West once to see with your own eyes the idyllic beauty of the Mekong River region, and experience the unique culture, and have exciting experiences on a cruise during the flood season.

The cruise is luxuriously designed with a modern style, the interior is harmoniously decorated, has large windows and private balconies to help visitors enjoy the beauty and unique nuances of the peaceful space of the immense river region creating a beautiful picture.

On the cruise ships, you can experience free services right on the boat such as: swimming pool, jacuzzi, reading room, movie theater, spa, gym… and have a view of the immense river.

In addition, when traveling to the Mekong River, you can participate in the experience on small boats gliding through the blue canals, surrounded by rows of water coconut trees, or rows of cool green trees, visitors can admire the poetic scenery on the river, or visit the fruit-laden garden.

When getting on the small boats to visit the riverside spots in Can Tho, An Giang, Dong Thap… you can choose different sightseeing routes depending on your preferences.

When coming to Long Xuyen, visitors want to experience the simple life of the people here, you can visit the floating market and enjoy cups of coffee while watching the scenery of a river area, then visitors can visit the An Giang museum, Ong Ho island, visit the craft villages making bonsai pots, incense, ancient temples… of Long Xuyen.

When night falls, the boat will anchor in the middle of the river for tourists to spend the night on the cruise. Tourists traveling to the Mekong are most crowded during the flood season, and it is divided into 2 stages, the first stage is from January to March and October to December, however, the most crowded time is from June to August, when tourists from all over the world flock to the West to visit and enjoy the scenery.

Ho Chi Minh Mekong Cruise 3 Days 2 Nights Itinerary

Day 1: Saigon – Can Tho – Long Xuyen

  • You will arrive at the city center and move to Cai Cui Can Tho port at 15:00. Boarding the boat, visitors will listen to safety instructions and the tour itinerary, visitors will enjoy a refreshing cocktail watching the sunset on the Hau River and watch the performance of “Don ca tai tu”.
  • In the evening, visitors will learn to cook with the chef, then enjoy dinner on the cruise, then freely watch movies and stay overnight on the ship.

Day 2: Long Xuyen – Chau Doc (4 hours), Chau Doc – Long Xuyen (6 hours).

  • As the ship moves to the South, visitors will enjoy a meal on the cruise, participate in activities right on the cruise, and enjoy cocktails watching the poetic scenery.
  • At noon, visitors will learn to cook with the chef on the cruise and enjoy the dishes they have just prepared.
  • After enjoying lunch, you go to explore the Tra Su Melaleuca forest, you can take a small boat through the canals surrounded by rows of cool green trees, and flooded forests.
  • Then return to the boat to depart for Long Xuyen, you have lunch and dinner, then relax. Overnight in Long Xuyen.

Day 3: Long Xuyen – Tan Loc – Can Tho – Saigon.

  • In the morning, wake up early to join a relaxing Yoga class to enjoy the scenery from the morning boat. Have breakfast with delicious dishes with the rich flavors of the Mekong River region.
  • The boat will move towards Tan Loc Islet, you visit the traditional wine cellar making process to produce famous jars of wine, you taste the wine and hear about the wine brewing method, then you can buy it as a gift.
  • Visit Tan Loc Islet, visit the Sau Tia plum garden, one of the specialties of Sau Tia plum wine.

You return to the ship for lunch and dinner on the cruise before the boat moves back to Can Tho. The 3-day 2-night Mekong tour ends at 3:00 p.m.
posts.excerptZh: 湄公河游船将带给游客精彩的体验，并欣赏水乡之美，您将在湄公河上的水中游船上度过一个有趣的假期。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
湄公河游船将带给游客精彩的体验，并欣赏水乡之美，您将在湄公河上的水中游船上度过一个有趣的假期。

在湄公河水季体验游船，将带给您其他地方无法找到的卓越体验。

除了享用有吸引力的美食——西南部的著名特产，您可以直接在游船上享用，在甲板上自由欣赏风景，在游船的无边泳池中泡在清凉的水里，在酒吧或游船上的迷你高尔夫球场尽享最佳假期。

如果您喜欢乘游船欣赏洪水季节的风光，今天就与Vietlook Travel一起参加 湄公河之旅 ，体验游船，将带给您最愉悦的假期。

去一次西南部，亲眼看看湄公河地区田园诗般的美景，体验独特的文化，并在洪水季节获得游船上的精彩体验。

游船设计豪华，风格现代，内部装饰和谐，设有大窗户和私人阳台，帮助游客欣赏辽阔江河区域宁静空间的美丽和独特韵味，构成一幅美丽的画卷。

在游轮上，您可以直接在船上体验免费的服务，例如：游泳池、按摩浴池、阅览室、电影院、水疗、健身房……并欣赏辽阔江河的景色。

此外，前往湄公河旅游时，您可以参加乘坐小船滑过碧蓝运河的体验，两岸是成排的水椰树或成排清凉的绿树，游客可以欣赏河上如诗如画的风景，或参观果实累累的果园。

乘坐小船游览芹苴、安江、同塔等地的河边景点时，您可以根据自己的喜好选择不同的观光路线。

来到龙川，游客想体验当地人的简朴生活，可以参观水上市场，一边品尝咖啡一边欣赏水乡风光，然后游客可以参观安江博物馆、翁虎岛（Ong Ho），参观龙川制作盆景花盆、香、古庙等的手工艺村……

夜幕降临时，游船将在河中央抛锚，让游客在游船上过夜。前往湄公河旅游的游客在洪水季节最为拥挤，分为2个阶段，第一阶段是1月至3月和10月至12月，不过最拥挤的时间是6月至8月，此时世界各地的游客纷纷涌向西南部参观并欣赏风景。

胡志明市湄公河游船3天2夜行程

第1天：西贡 – 芹苴 – 龙川

  • 您将抵达市中心，并在15:00前往 芹苴Cai Cui港。登船后，游客将听取安全须知和旅游行程，游客将一边品尝清爽的鸡尾酒一边欣赏后江上的日落，并观看“才子弹唱”（Don ca tai tu）表演。
  • 晚上，游客将跟随厨师学习烹饪，然后在游船上享用晚餐，再自由观看电影并在船上过夜。

第2天：龙川 – 朱笃（4小时），朱笃 – 龙川（6小时）。

  • 随着游船向南行驶，游客将在游船上用餐，参加游船上的活动，并一边享用鸡尾酒一边欣赏如诗如画的风景。
  • 中午，游客将在游船上跟随厨师学习烹饪，并享用刚刚做好的菜肴。
  • 享用午餐后，您前往探索 茶苏白千层森林（Tra Su），您可以乘小船穿过两岸成排清凉绿树的运河，以及水淹森林。
  • 然后返回游船，出发前往 龙川，您享用午餐和晚餐，然后放松身心。龙川过夜。

第3天：龙川 – 新禄（Tan Loc）– 芹苴 – 西贡。

  • 早晨，早早起床参加轻松的 瑜伽课 ，在清晨的游船上欣赏风景。享用早餐，菜肴美味，带有湄公河地区的浓郁风味。
  • 船将驶向新禄 沙洲，您参观传统酿酒窖的酿造过程，生产著名的酒坛，您品尝美酒并听取酿酒方法，然后可以购买作为礼物。
  • 参观新禄沙洲，参观Sau Tia李子园，这是Sau Tia李子酒的特产之一。

您返回游船享用午餐和晚餐，然后游船驶回 芹苴。湄公河3天2夜之旅 于下午3:00结束。

posts.title: Paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang
posts.excerpt: Paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang will bring you the most exciting feelings, when you can fly in the sky of Da Nang to see the city from above, with bridges, statues of Bodhisattva Avalokitesva
posts.contentHtml:
Paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang will bring you the most exciting feelings, when you can fly in the sky of Da Nang to see the city from above, with bridges, statues of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara located majestically overlooking the East Sea, and poetic beaches.

If you are a sports lover, want to experience adventure sports, then paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula is one of the sports for you, you will be flying with a guide in the sky to admire the beauty of Da Nang from above.

The experience of paragliding in the sky will bring you different emotions, the paragliding experience starts at an altitude of 700m above sea level in an ideal position for you to both parachute and experience flying in the sky to enjoy the scenery from above.

What is paragliding?

Paragliding is an adventure sport not for the faint-hearted, when participating, visitors will be flying in the sky looking like seagulls spreading their wings.

When flying, visitors are seated in the cabin, with safety belts, so they can feel completely secure and look out the window to see the beautiful scenery. Most visitors, after experiencing it, do not feel as scared as at first.

How long does it take to paraglide on Son Tra Peninsula, Da Nang, Vietnam?

If you calculate the travel time from the foot of Son Tra Peninsula to the take-off point, and when landing on the ground, it takes about 10 minutes, and the check-in procedures take about 20 minutes, then visitors will go to the flight point, which is the top of the chessboard, 15 – 20 minutes, visitors will take souvenir photos for about 5 minutes.

Son Tra Peninsula in Da Nang is a great destination and a suitable place to participate in paragliding, on the top is a gently sloping land surrounded by primeval forests. To participate in paragliding, you will fly with a pilot, you will see the whole view of Son Tra, Linh Ung Pagoda, My Khe beach and the whole view of Da Nang from above.

This is one of the adventure sports, so when participating you need to follow the instructions of the guide, and must ensure your health, to ensure your safety.

Son Tra Paragliding Which Season Is The Best

To have the best Son Tra paragliding experience, you should go from March to September, at this time the climate in Da Nang is relatively beautiful, sunny and windy, the sky is clear, very suitable for tourists to experience paragliding adventures in the sky of Da Nang.

Experiences when you paragliding at Son Tra Peninsula

  • Before flying, you often feel nervous, and somewhat excited to blend in with nature.
  • From above, you can admire the scenery of Da Nang, and the majestic Linh Ung Pagoda with the majestic statue of Quan Am facing the East Sea.
  • You can save for yourself the most beautiful moments in the sky of Da Nang

Can you paragliding on Son Tra Peninsula, Da Nang?

If this is your first time participating, you will definitely be hesitant, but according to Vietlook’s experience of traveling to Da Nang, you can absolutely participate in the flight, because there are also professional guides flying with you, and before flying you will be instructed very carefully so you can be completely assured.

Before flying, you will sign a commitment according to your health regulations.

However, paragliding is not suitable for pregnant women, and those with cardiovascular diseases, asthma, epilepsy, hypocalcemia, etc.

It can be said that when experiencing Son Tra paragliding from above, visitors can admire the beauty of Da Nang city, the city of festivals and events, and see the scenery from a completely new angle, which will bring you the most enjoyable experiences.

So if you are a sports lover, go on a tour to Da Nang today and participate in paragliding at Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang will bring you exciting feelings.
posts.excerptZh: 在岘港山茶半岛体验滑翔伞将带给您最刺激的感受，您可以翱翔在岘港的天空，从高处俯瞰这座城市，看到桥梁、巍然俯瞰东海的观音像和诗意的海滩。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
在岘港山茶半岛体验滑翔伞将带给您最刺激的感受，您可以翱翔在岘港的天空，从高处俯瞰这座城市，看到桥梁、巍然俯瞰东海的观音像和诗意的海滩。

如果您是运动爱好者，想体验冒险运动，那么山茶半岛滑翔伞就是适合您的运动之一，您将与教练一起在空中飞行，从高处欣赏岘港之美。

在空中滑翔的体验将带给您不同的情感，滑翔伞体验从海拔700米的理想位置起飞，让您既能跳伞，又能体验在空中飞行，欣赏高处的风景。

什么是滑翔伞？

滑翔伞是一项不适合胆小者的冒险运动，参与时，游客将在空中飞翔，宛如展翅的海鸥。

飞行时，游客坐在座舱中，系着安全带，因此可以完全放心，并透过窗户欣赏美丽的风景。大多数游客体验之后，都不像最初那样害怕。

在越南岘港山茶半岛滑翔伞需要多长时间？

如果计算从山茶半岛山脚到起飞点的行程时间以及着陆时间，大约需要10分钟，办理登记手续约需20分钟，然后游客前往飞行点，即棋盘山顶，需15–20分钟，游客将拍摄纪念照约5分钟。

岘港的山茶半岛是一个绝佳的目的地，也是参加滑翔伞的合适场所，山顶是一片缓坡土地，四周被原始森林环绕。参加滑翔伞时，您将与飞行员一起飞行，从高处看到山茶半岛的全貌、灵应寺、美溪海滩以及岘港的全景。

这是冒险运动之一，因此参与时需要遵循教练的指导，并确保自身健康，以保证您的安全。

山茶滑翔伞哪个季节最好

要获得最佳的山茶滑翔伞体验，应在3月至9月前往，此时岘港的气候相对宜人，阳光明媚、风力适中，天空晴朗，非常适合游客体验岘港天空中的滑翔伞冒险。

在山茶半岛滑翔伞的体验

  • 飞行前，您通常会感到紧张，同时又有些兴奋，想要融入大自然。
  • 从高处，您可以欣赏岘港的风景，以及宏伟的灵应寺和面朝东海的庄严观音像。
  • 您可以为自己留下岘港天空中最美的时刻

可以在岘港山茶半岛滑翔伞吗？

如果这是您第一次参加，您肯定会犹豫，但根据Vietlook前往岘港旅行的经验，您完全可以参加飞行，因为有专业教练与您一同飞行，而且飞行前会有非常细致的指导，您完全可以放心。

飞行前，您将根据您的健康状况规定签署一份承诺书。

不过，滑翔伞不适合孕妇，以及患有心血管疾病、哮喘、癫痫、低钙血症等的人。

可以说，在高空体验山茶滑翔伞时，游客可以欣赏节庆与活动之城岘港的美景，并从全新的角度观赏风景，这将带给您最愉快的体验。

所以如果您是运动爱好者，今天就前往 岘港旅游 并参加岘港山茶半岛的滑翔伞，将带给您刺激的感受。

posts.title: What is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in October
posts.excerpt: What is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in October, is a question of interest to many tourists, especially those who are planning to travel to Ninh Binh and this is also the first time you set
posts.contentHtml:
What is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in October, is a question of interest to many tourists, especially those who are planning to travel to Ninh Binh and this is also the first time you set foot in Ninh Binh, so to know that, let’s refer to the Ninh Binh travel experience in October that Vietlook Trave will share with you right through this article.

Ninh Binh in October is entering the transitional season, the weather is gradually turning to winter and there are cool breezes, the clear blue sky is very convenient for tourists to visit and sightsee.

Should you travel to Ninh Binh in October?

Ninh Binh in October often brings its own beauty, a peaceful and quiet space, rich natural scenery as if to urge travelers to come to Ninh Binh, surrounded by majestic limestone ranges, and immense river scenery, creating a unique beauty.

Ninh Binh climate in October

Usually fluctuates from 22 – 26 degrees Celsius, and there is no rain, so it is very convenient for tourists to check in and take virtual photos in Ninh Binh. At the scenic spots, the weather is quite beautiful, very suitable for tourists to visit and sightsee. However, in October, Ninh Binh has a bit of a chilly weather, so you should bring a long-sleeved shirt to avoid getting cold.

Where to stay when traveling to Ninh Binh in October is a question for tourists traveling to Ninh Binh for the first time. However, according to Vietlook’s Ninh Binh travel experience, Ninh Binh has many places to stay from budget to high-end, but it all depends on your budget.

Places to visit in Binh Binh in October

Bai Dinh Pagoda

If you are looking for places to visit in Ninh Binh in October, Bai Dinh Pagoda is an indispensable destination in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary in October. The pagoda has a large campus and is a massive spiritual complex with its own architectural style. Every year in October, the pagoda becomes peaceful and solemn, attracting tourists from all over the world to come here to worship.

Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

A famous destination with 1000 years of history located in the 4 World Heritage complexes of Ninh Binh, Hoa Lu Ancient Capital has an ancient architectural style. Although it has gone through many years, Hoa Lu Ancient Capital still retains its own beauty.

Hang Mua

No matter what season you come to Ninh Binh, Hang Mua is an indispensable destination when you have the opportunity to visit here. When conquering the mountain top, visitors can see the full beauty of Ninh Binh from above, especially when conquering 500 stone steps, visitors can freely take beautiful pictures.

Trang An

A destination chosen by many tourists, when traveling to Trang An in October, you should experience rowing a boat on the lake to admire the poetic beauty, the lake is as calm as a sheet of paper, a peaceful scene enough for you to save beautiful pictures.

Am Tien Cave

This is one of the naturally formed caves surrounded by towering limestone mountains, with a clear blue lake in the middle. It is a relaxing spot chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to visit Ninh Binh, especially those who travel to Ninh Binh in October.

To reach Am Tien Cave, visitors should go through the tunnel through the mountain, and climb up the cave to burn incense and admire the magical stalactites.

Van Long Lagoon

To fully experience the beauty of the lagoon, take a boat on the lagoon. When the boat glides gently, you will also admire the poetic scenery. In addition, there are many rare animals here, including the white-cheeked langur, which is listed in the Red Book….

Thung Nham Bird Garden

In October, visitors come to the bird garden with many birds flying back to winter, visitors can record the most beautiful moments, especially at dusk when flocks fly away to find food, which is very beautiful and makes many visitors feel excited.

At this point, you must have your own answer such as what is beautiful when traveling to Ninh Binh in October, and where to visit, where to stay, so come to Ninh Binh once in October to feel all the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.
posts.excerptZh: 10月去宁平旅行有什么美景,是许多游客关心的问题,尤其是那些正计划前往宁平、并且是第一次踏足宁平的人。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
10月去宁平旅行有什么美景,是许多游客关心的问题,尤其是那些正计划前往宁平、并且是第一次踏足宁平的人,为了解答这个问题,让我们一起参考Vietlook Trave将在本文中与您分享的10月宁平旅行经验。

10月的宁平正进入换季时节,天气逐渐转向冬季,微风清凉,晴朗的蓝天非常便于游客参观游览。

10月应该去宁平旅行吗?

10月的宁平往往有着独特的美,宁静祥和的空间、丰富的自然风光仿佛在催促旅行者来到宁平,四周是雄伟的石灰岩山脉和广阔的河流风光,营造出独一无二的美景。

10月宁平的气候

气温通常在22 – 26摄氏度之间,且不下雨,因此游客在宁平打卡拍照非常方便。在各个景区,天气相当不错,非常适合游客参观游览。不过,10月的宁平天气略带凉意,所以您应该带一件长袖衣服,以免着凉。

10月前往宁平旅行时住在哪里,是首次来宁平的游客的疑问。不过,根据Vietlook的宁平旅行经验,宁平有从经济型到高端的众多住宿选择,一切取决于您的预算。

10月宁平的游览景点

百顶寺(Bai Dinh)

如果您在寻找10月宁平的游览景点,百顶寺是10月 宁平之旅行程中不可或缺的目的地。寺院占地广阔,是一座规模宏大、拥有独特建筑风格的灵修建筑群。每年10月,寺院变得宁静而庄严,吸引着世界各地的游客前来参拜。

华闾古都(Hoa Lu)

这是一处拥有千年历史的著名目的地,位于宁平的4处世界遗产建筑群之中,华闾古都拥有古老的建筑风格。尽管历经多年,华闾古都仍保留着自己独特的美。

木洞(Hang Mua)

无论您在哪个季节来到宁平,只要有机会到访,木洞都是不可或缺的目的地。登上山顶,游客可以从高处欣赏宁平的全貌,尤其是攀登500级石阶后,游客可以尽情拍摄美丽的照片。

长安(Trang An)

这是许多游客选择的目的地,10月前往长安时,您应该体验在湖上划船,欣赏诗情画意的美景,湖面平静如纸,宁静的景象足以让您留下美丽的照片。

阴仙洞(Am Tien)

这是天然形成的洞穴之一,四周被高耸的石灰岩山环绕,中间是一片清澈的蓝色湖水。当游客有机会到访宁平时,这是许多人选择的休闲之地,尤其是10月前往宁平的游客。

要到达阴仙洞,游客应穿过山中的隧道,并爬上洞穴上香,欣赏神奇的钟乳石。

云龙湿地(Van Long)

要充分体验湿地之美,请乘船游览湿地。当小船轻轻滑行时,您也将欣赏到诗意的风景。此外,这里还有许多珍稀动物,包括被列入红皮书的白颊长臂猿……

洞岩鸟园(Thung Nham)

10月,游客来到鸟园,许多鸟儿飞回此地过冬,游客可以记录最美的瞬间,尤其是黄昏时成群的鸟儿飞出觅食,景象十分美丽,让许多游客感到兴奋。

读到这里,您一定已经有了自己的答案,比如10月去宁平旅行有什么美景、去哪里游览、住在哪里,所以不妨在10月来一次宁平,去感受大自然赋予这片土地的所有美丽。

posts.title: When is the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang
posts.excerpt: When is the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang, the answer is at the end of October to the beginning of November, when the flowers are in full bloom, making many travelers come to Ha Giang and not wa
posts.contentHtml:
When is the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang, the answer is at the end of October to the beginning of November, when the flowers are in full bloom, making many travelers come to Ha Giang and not want to leave.

When is the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang? This is a question that many people who love Ha Giang are asking, who want to learn and explore the beauty of the majestic rocky plateau, want to find out how beautiful Ha Giang will be at that time, is it really as beautiful as the paintings that journalists often mention, no matter what the scenery is, you should come once to explore the beauty of Ha Giang, and see with your own eyes the beauty of this buckwheat flower season.

Coming to Ha Giang at the end of the year, you will be immersed in the beauty of the buckwheat flower season, the most beautiful is at the end of October, the beginning of November, this is the time when the buckwheat flowers bloom, and this is also the most beautiful time of the year in Ha Giang.

If you are a person who loves to admire and take pictures of buckwheat flowers, then take a tour to Ha Giang in late October and early November. At this time, you will not only immerse yourself in the beauty of the flowers but also join the exciting buckwheat flower festival.

Traveling to Ha Giang in the buckwheat flower season, right from the beginning of the village along the roads, you will see the flowers competing to show off their bright colors, or on the top of the high mountains to the valleys are covered in a color of flowers, at first the flowers are white, then gradually turn pink and gradually become a deep purple color, very eye-catching.

Every year in October, Ha Giang begins a flower season, this is also the occasion to signal that winter will come to the plateau. When the flower season ends, it is also the occasion for people here to harvest buckwheat flower cakes, cook porridge, and make wine, a famous specialty of the Northwest mountains.

Besides the majestic mountain scenery, the winding and dangerous mountain passes have created the feelings of many tourists coming to Ha Giang tourism. Especially international tourists coming to Ha Giang are fascinated by the elegant beauty of this flower.

Every late autumn and early winter, Ha Giang is covered with a season of buckwheat flowers, a beautiful check-in spot. No matter what angle you stand from, visitors will capture beautiful photos, below are the flowers surrounded by towering rocky mountains, Ha Giang looks like a majestic picture.

Traveling in the buckwheat flower season, you will encounter barefoot highland children, carrying baskets of flowers on their shoulders with the innocent faces of children, or babies sleeping on their mothers’ backs, exuding a simple, rustic village picture, further urging the footsteps of travelers to come to Ha Giang in the buckwheat flower season.

In the past, buckwheat flower season was also a source of hunger relief for the people here, but now that life has developed, buckwheat flowers have become a tourist attraction, and that has also contributed to making Ha Giang’s economy stronger and stronger, because buckwheat flowers are indispensable to the people here.

When traveling to Ha Giang in the buckwheat flower season, visitors can rent traditional costumes to take beautiful pictures, next to the long flower season scene, surrounded by mountains with misty clouds, or rustic villages located right at the foot of the mountain.

In late autumn and early winter, the buckwheat flower fields stretch out, the flowers are swaying in the wind like a painting, making visitors not want to leave, so when coming here, visitors must have their own answer like which month is the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang, and let’s follow Vietlook Travel to Ha Giang in this buckwheat flower season.
posts.titleZh: 河江荞麦花季是什么时候
posts.excerptZh: 河江的荞麦花季是什么时候？答案是10月底到11月初，此时花朵盛开，让许多旅行者来到河江后流连忘返。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
河江的荞麦花季是什么时候？答案是10月底到11月初，此时花朵盛开，让许多旅行者来到河江后流连忘返。

河江的荞麦花季是什么时候？这是许多热爱河江的人都在问的问题，他们想了解和探索雄伟石山高原之美，想知道那时的河江会有多美，是否真的像记者们常常提到的画一样美丽。无论风景如何，您都应该来一次，探索河江之美，亲眼看看这个荞麦花季的美景。

年末来到河江，您将沉浸在荞麦花季的美景中，最美的时间是10月底、11月初，这是荞麦花盛开的时候，也是河江一年中最美的时节。

如果您是喜欢欣赏和拍摄荞麦花的人，那就在10月底11月初参加河江之旅吧。此时，您不仅可以沉浸在花海之美中，还可以参加热闹的荞麦花节。

在荞麦花季前往河江旅行，从村口沿路开始，您就会看到花儿争相展现鲜艳的色彩，从高山之巅到山谷都被花色覆盖，起初花朵是白色的，然后逐渐变成粉色，最后变成深紫色，十分醒目。

每年10月，河江开始进入花季，这也是预示冬天即将来到高原的时节。花季结束时，也是这里的人们收获荞麦花糕、煮粥和酿酒的时候，这是西北山区著名的特产。

除了雄伟的山景，蜿蜒而险峻的山口也触动了许多来到河江旅游的游客的情感。尤其是来到河江的国际游客，对这种花的优雅之美着迷不已。

每年深秋初冬，河江被荞麦花季覆盖，是绝美的打卡地。无论您站在哪个角度，游客都能拍到美丽的照片，花海下方是高耸的石山环绕，河江宛如一幅雄伟的画卷。

在荞麦花季旅行，您会遇到光着脚的高原孩子，肩上扛着装满花朵的竹篮，脸上带着孩童的天真，或是婴儿在母亲背上熟睡，呈现出一幅质朴的乡村画面，更加催促着旅行者在荞麦花季来到河江的脚步。

过去，荞麦花季也是这里人们充饥的来源，而如今生活发展了，荞麦花成为旅游景点，也为河江的经济越来越强大做出了贡献，因为荞麦花对这里的人们来说不可或缺。

在荞麦花季前往河江旅行时，游客可以租借传统服饰拍出美丽的照片，背景是绵延的花季景象，周围群山云雾缭绕，或是坐落在山脚下的质朴村庄。

深秋初冬，荞麦花田绵延开去，花朵在风中摇曳，宛如一幅画，让游客不愿离开，因此来到这里，游客一定会心中有自己的答案：河江的荞麦花季是几月？让我们在这个荞麦花季跟随 Vietlook Travel 一起前往河江吧。

posts.title: Da Nang Travel Experience in October
posts.excerpt: Are you planning to travel to Da Nang in October, wondering about the climate in Da Nang in October, and what beautiful places to visit, especially what exciting festivals and events Da Nang has in Oc
posts.contentHtml:
Are you planning to travel to Da Nang in October, wondering about the climate in Da Nang in October, and what beautiful places to visit, especially what exciting festivals and events Da Nang has in October? So let’s follow Vietlook Travel and discover what’s beautiful in Da Nang in October right below.

Da Nang Weather in October

Da Nang in October enters the rainy season, at this time the weather is cool but there will be occasional sudden showers, however, if you check the weather in advance, you can still have the most perfect Da Nang October tours.

If you want to swim in Da Nang beach in October, you should wake up early to swim and watch the sunrise, if you go to Da Nang beach in the afternoon, there will be rains that are not favorable for you to enjoy the scenery, although the rain is not too long but it will still affect your fun on the beach.

Advantages and disadvantages of traveling to Da Nang in October

Advantages

Da Nang in October is the low season, so the accompanying services are usually not too expensive, and the scenic spots you do not have to wait in line, and are not as crowded as in the summer, hotels/motels you do not have to worry about being sold out like in the summer, if you want to have a budget trip to Da Nang, you should go in October.

Disadvantages of traveling to Da Nang in October

In the early morning, the weather is quite nice, but in the afternoon there are light rains, if you want to lie on the sand to enjoy the scenery, it will not be convenient, and in the afternoon, the sea in Da Nang in October is a bit cold. Therefore, it is not as convenient as traveling in the summer.

What to prepare when traveling to Da Nang in October

The weather in Da Nang in October is quite nice, so you can freely wear the clothes you like, because at this time the weather in Da Nang is between autumn and winter, so it is quite nice except for sudden showers. If you want to walk in the evening, bring a light jacket to walk and see the city.

Airfare to Da Nang in October is quite cheap, because this is the low season in Da Nang. If you plan to go on a tour to Da Nang in October, you should book tickets early to get the best price, which is also convenient for your trip, especially for those who travel to Da Nang on their own.

Accommodation services in Da Nang in October, this is not the peak season, so accommodation services are often cooler than in the summer. According to Da Nang travel experience from Vietlook Travel, you should choose hotels with a sea view or near the Han River, Dragon Bridge… to admire the scenery from where you stay.

Where to go in Da Nang in October?

Ba Na Hills: An indispensable destination in the Da Nang travel itinerary regardless of the season of the year, Ba Na is also a destination that brings visitors the most interesting experiences, where many exciting festivals and events take place, or interesting games.

Linh Ung Pagoda: A spiritual tourist destination with a majestic statue of Bodhisattva overlooking the sea, from the pagoda visitors can fully admire the beauty of the city from above.

Love Bridge: This bridge is sought after by many young people, coming here you can not only freely check in but also write down your prayers and hang them on love locks.

In addition, when coming to Da Nang regardless of the season of the year, you should visit the attractions such as: Han River swing bridge, My Khe beach, Than Tai mountain, .. and freely experience the things you like.

What to eat when traveling to Da Nang in October?

The weather in Da Nang in October is cool so you can enjoy all the delicious and attractive dishes, especially spicy dishes, seafood, hot pot, you should enjoy at Pham Van Dong beach, My Khe beach, there will be many restaurants with dishes for you to choose from.

Delicious dishes in Da Nang that tourists should enjoy are: Quang noodles, grilled beef, vermicelli with fish sauce, … you can follow the route such as Doan Thi Diem, Trung Nu Vuong, Hoang Dieu, Nguyen Van Linh, …

To enjoy snacks at Bac My An market, or markets where tourists can both visit and enjoy snacks in the evening will bring you exciting feelings.

Above is the complete guide to traveling to Da Nang in October, hopefully it will help your trip to be the most perfect during your vacation in the resort paradise.
posts.excerptZh: 您是否计划十月前往岘港旅行，想了解十月岘港的气候、有哪些美丽的地方可以游览，尤其是十月岘港有哪些精彩的节庆和活动？那就跟随 Vietlook Travel，一起来了解十月岘港的美景吧。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
您是否计划 前往岘港旅行 十月，想了解十月岘港的气候、有哪些美丽的地方可以游览，尤其是十月岘港有哪些精彩的节庆和活动？那就跟随 Vietlook Travel，一起来了解十月岘港的美景吧。

十月岘港的天气

十月的岘港进入雨季，此时天气凉爽，但偶尔会有突如其来的阵雨，不过，如果提前查看天气，您仍然可以拥有最完美的岘港十月之旅。

如果您想在十月于岘港海滩游泳，应早起游泳并观看日出；如果下午去岘港海滩，会有雨，不利于您欣赏风景，虽然雨下得不久，但仍会影响您在海滩上的乐趣。

十月前往岘港旅行的优缺点

优点

十月的岘港是淡季，因此相关服务通常不会太贵，景点不必排队，也不像夏季那样拥挤，酒店/旅馆也不用像夏季那样担心订满，如果您想进行一次预算有限的岘港之旅，应在十月前往。

十月前往岘港旅行的缺点

清晨天气相当不错，但下午会有小雨，如果想躺在沙滩上欣赏风景就不太方便，而且十月下午岘港的海水有点凉。因此，不如夏季旅行那样方便。

十月前往岘港旅行需要准备什么

十月的岘港天气相当不错，所以您可以随意穿着自己喜欢的衣服，因为此时岘港的天气介于秋冬之间，除了突然的阵雨之外相当宜人。如果您想在傍晚散步，请带一件薄外套，边走边欣赏这座城市。

十月前往岘港的机票相当便宜，因为这是岘港的淡季。如果您计划参加 岘港之旅 十月出行，应提前订票以获得最优惠的价格，这也方便您的旅行，尤其是对于自助前往岘港的人。

十月岘港的住宿服务，由于这不是旺季，住宿服务往往比夏季更便宜。根据 Vietlook Travel 的岘港旅行经验，您应该选择海景酒店或靠近汉江、龙桥……的酒店，在住处就能欣赏风景。

十月去岘港哪里玩？

巴拿山：无论一年中哪个季节，巴拿山都是岘港旅行行程中不可或缺的目的地，也是给游客带来最有趣体验的目的地，许多精彩的节庆和活动在此举行，还有有趣的游戏。

灵应寺：一处灵修旅游目的地，有一尊雄伟的菩萨像俯瞰大海，从寺庙里游客可以从高处尽情欣赏这座城市之美。

爱情桥：这座桥深受许多年轻人追捧，来到这里您不仅可以自由打卡，还可以写下祈愿，挂在爱情锁上。

此外，无论一年中的哪个季节来到岘港，您都应该参观汉江旋转桥、美溪海滩、Than Tai山等景点，自由体验您喜欢的事物。

十月前往岘港吃什么？

十月的岘港天气凉爽，因此您可以享用所有美味诱人的菜肴，尤其是辛辣菜肴、海鲜、火锅，建议您在Pham Van Dong海滩、美溪海滩享用，那里有许多餐厅，供您选择各种菜肴。

游客应品尝的岘港美味菜肴有：广南面、烤牛肉、鱼露米线……您可以沿着Doan Thi Diem、Trung Nu Vuong、Hoang Dieu、Nguyen Van Linh等街道……

在Bac My An市场享用小吃，或在傍晚既可参观又可品尝小吃的市场，会给您带来令人兴奋的感受。

以上是十月前往岘港旅行的完整指南，希望能帮助您在这个度假天堂的旅程中拥有最完美的假期。

A beautiful check-in spot that many tourists visit, this is one of the tallest buildings in Saigon and also a bustling shopping center. Coming here, you will be able to freely live virtually right on the campus or inside the building, you can capture beautiful pictures.

If you want to relax, you can enjoy a cup of coffee right outside the building, and admire the magnificent Saigon scenery, which will definitely bring you beautiful pictures.

2. Bach Dang Wharf

Coming here, visitors will encounter a poetic space, you can buy a waterbus ticket to explore the beauty of the peaceful Saigon River, or you can enjoy a cup of coffee watching the scenery at dusk, and record beautiful pictures of the magical sunset, an indispensable destination when traveling to Saigon.

3. Nguyen Hue Walking Street

This is a neighborhood that many tourists come to check in, and is where many exciting programs and interesting games take place, very suitable for young people. Not only that, around the neighborhood there are also many bustling shopping centers, very convenient for visitors to visit and sightsee during their vacation.

4. Khanh An Monastery

This is a place with a beautiful view that attracts young people to come here to take virtual photos, surrounded by a cool green campus, with rows of shady green trees. However, this is a monastery, so visitors should dress politely and elegantly when coming here.

5. Saigon Post Office

Located right in the city center, with classic French architecture, visitors can check in for themselves beautiful photos with that ancient look, no matter what angle they stand from, visitors can capture beautiful photos for themselves.

6. City Theater

Built in a classic style, imbued with magnificent European architecture, this place has a large and airy space, so many couples come here to take wedding photos on their big day.

7. Bui Vien Western Street

This is one of the bustling streets with rows of bars, pubs, eateries, restaurants or luxurious hotels, the space here is colorful, so if you check in at Bui Vien you will have beautiful photos.

8. Ho Chi Minh City Museum of Fine Arts

A beautiful place to take portrait photos, coming here visitors will encounter classic architecture but still exude its own beauty. Therefore, this place is chosen as a virtual living spot that many young people come to when they have the opportunity to go on a tour of Saigon and the Museum of Fine Arts is the perfect destination for every vacation.

9. Starlight Bridge

The bridge has the most beautiful scenery in Saigon, with LED lighting systems, you can walk at night to feel its own beauty, a romantic scene that many young people come to have fun and take virtual photos.

The pagoda is built in the architectural style of Thailand, looks very unique and has become a luxurious photo-taking view point that many tourists come to, especially young people or foreign tourists, come here to visit and check in on the temple grounds.

So above are the most beautiful virtual living spots in Saigon, hopefully it will help your trip. Especially for foreign tourists when going on a tour Vietnam but do not know which places to choose to record beautiful pictures during their tour in Saigon, this article will be suggestions for you.
posts.excerptZh: 您是打卡爱好者，想在西贡找到属于自己的拍照打卡地，但打卡地在哪里呢？让我们跟随Vietlook Travel一起回顾以下的打卡地。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
您是打卡爱好者，想在西贡找到属于自己的拍照打卡地，但打卡地在哪里呢？让我们跟随Vietlook Travel一起回顾以下的打卡地。

1. Landmark 81

一个许多游客前来的美丽打卡地，这是西贡最高的建筑之一，同时也是热闹的购物中心。来到这里，您可以在园区或大楼内尽情拍照打卡，拍下美丽的照片。

如果想放松，您可以在大楼外享用一杯咖啡，欣赏壮丽的西贡风光，这一定会为您带来美丽的照片。

2. 白藤码头（Bach Dang）

来到这里，游客将遇到充满诗意的空间，您可以购买水上巴士船票，探索宁静的西贡河之美，也可以喝一杯咖啡，欣赏黄昏的景色，记录下神奇日落的美丽照片，是到西贡旅行不可或缺的目的地。

3. 阮惠步行街

这是许多游客前来打卡的街区，也是许多精彩活动和有趣游戏举办的地方，非常适合年轻人。不仅如此，街区周围还有许多热闹的购物中心，非常方便游客在假期中参观游览。

4. 庆安寺（Khanh An）

这是一个景色优美的地方，吸引年轻人来此拍照打卡，四周是清凉的绿色园区，一排排绿树成荫。不过，这里是寺院，所以游客来此时应穿着得体、端庄。

5. 西贡中央邮局

位于市中心，拥有经典的法式建筑，游客可以在这里拍下带有古老风情的美丽照片，无论站在哪个角度，游客都能为自己拍出漂亮的照片。

6. 市政剧院

以经典风格建造，充满宏伟的欧式建筑风貌，这里空间宽敞开阔，所以许多情侣会在大喜之日来这里拍婚纱照。

7. 范五老西式街（Bui Vien）

这是热闹的街道之一，街上有成排的酒吧、酒馆、小吃店、餐厅和豪华酒店，这里的空间五彩缤纷，所以如果您在范五老打卡，一定能拍到漂亮的照片。

8. 胡志明市美术博物馆

一个拍摄人像照片的好地方，来到这里，游客将看到经典的建筑，依然散发着独特的美。因此，这里被选为许多年轻人有机会游览西贡时前来的打卡地，美术博物馆是每个假期的完美目的地。

9. 星光桥（Starlight Bridge）

这座桥拥有西贡最美的风景，配有LED照明系统，您可以在夜间漫步，感受它独特的美，是许多年轻人前来游玩和拍照打卡的浪漫景象。

10. 宝龙寺（Buu Long）

这座寺庙采用泰国建筑风格建造，看起来十分独特，已成为许多游客，尤其是年轻人或外国游客前来拍照的奢华观景点，来到这里参观并在寺院内打卡。

以上就是西贡最美的打卡地，希望能对您的旅行有所帮助。尤其是对于前往 越南旅游 的外国游客，如果不知道在西贡游览期间选择哪些地方记录美丽的照片，这篇文章将为您提供建议。

posts.title: Experience of visiting Quang Phu Cau incense village
posts.excerpt: The incense stick craft village was formed over a thousand years ago, with the love for the profession and the skillful hands of the artisans of the Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village, it has a
posts.contentHtml:
The incense stick craft village was formed over a thousand years ago, with the love for the profession and the skillful hands of the artisans of the Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village, it has always preserved and developed as a symbol of the cultural beauty of the Vietnamese people. Although located in the suburbs of Hanoi, the incense stick craft village exudes the quintessence of beauty and is a check-in point, a virtual living place or to learn about the incense stick making process of the people here.

A few words about Quang Phu Cau incense village

Through the process of formation and development, the incense stick craft village of Quang Phu Cau commune, Ung Hoa district is about 30 km from the center of the capital. The development of the craft village not only brings income to the people here but is also a famous tourist destination in the suburbs of Hanoi.

Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village not only attracts tourists to visit and sightsee but also attracts photographers to come here to take pictures, especially foreign tourists who come to visit and learn about traditional Vietnamese craft villages.

How to get to Quang Phu Cau incense village?

Located right on the outskirts of Hanoi, visitors can easily choose a means of transportation to get here. From the center of the capital, visitors can take bus routes 103a, 91,99,94 to reach the incense village. If visitors like to sightsee, they can ride a motorbike….

What’s beautiful about Quang Phu Cau Incense Stick Village

Currently, it is a quite famous check-in spot, especially recently when photos on the internet spread that Quang Phu Cau incense stick village looks very beautiful, with incense bundles spreading out like flowers or creative ideas to arrange incense bundles for visitors to take pictures, which looks very beautiful.

Traveling to Quang Phu Cau Incense Stick Village, visitors will encounter incense bundles with the top of the incense stick and the bottom spread out, looking like blooming flowers. There are incense bundles dyed yellow and red, which look very eye-catching, so the incense village is increasingly attracting domestic and foreign tourists.

Incense production process

The incense bundles are carefully selected by artisans, from the stage of choosing raw materials to completion, to produce fragrant products, these are indispensable products in every home, and incense is currently exported to other countries.

To have beautiful photos at Quang Phu Cau incense village, visitors can rent traditional costumes to take beautiful photos of themselves in the incense village, especially women often choose dresses, or bring long clothes to take photos next to the incense bundles, which look very eye-catching.
posts.titleZh: 探访广富球香村的经验
posts.excerptZh: 制香手工艺村形成于一千多年前，凭借对这门职业的热爱和Quang Phu Cau制香手工艺村工匠们的灵巧双手，它始终作为越南人民文化之美的象征而被保存和发展。虽然位于河内郊区，这个制香手工艺村散发着美的精髓，是一个打卡点、拍照地，也是了解这里人们制香过程的好地方。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
制香手工艺村形成于一千多年前，凭借对这门职业的热爱和Quang Phu Cau制香手工艺村工匠们的灵巧双手，它始终作为越南人民文化之美的象征而被保存和发展。虽然位于河内郊区，这个制香手工艺村散发着美的精髓，是一个打卡点、拍照地，也是了解这里人们制香过程的好地方。

关于Quang Phu Cau香村的几句话

经过形成和发展的过程，位于应和县（Ung Hoa）Quang Phu Cau乡的制香手工艺村距首都中心约30公里。手工艺村的发展不仅为这里的人们带来收入，也是河内郊区一个著名的旅游目的地。

Quang Phu Cau制香手工艺村不仅吸引游客参观观光，也吸引摄影师前来拍摄，尤其是前来参观并了解越南传统手工艺村的外国游客。

如何前往Quang Phu Cau香村？

香村就位于河内郊区，游客可以轻松选择交通工具前往。从首都市中心出发，游客可以乘坐103a、91、99、94路公交车前往香村。如果游客喜欢边走边看，可以骑摩托车……

Quang Phu Cau制香村的美丽之处

目前，这里是一个相当有名的打卡地点，尤其是最近网上的照片传开，说Quang Phu Cau制香村看起来非常美丽，香束像花朵一样散开，或是为游客拍照而创意摆放的香束，看起来非常漂亮。

前往Quang Phu Cau 制香村旅行时，游客会看到香束顶端和底部散开，看起来像盛开的花朵。有染成黄色和红色的香束，看起来非常醒目，因此香村越来越吸引国内外游客。

制香过程

香束由工匠精心挑选，从选择原材料的阶段到完成，制作出芳香的产品，这些是每个家庭不可或缺的产品，目前香也出口到其他国家。

要在Quang Phu Cau香村拍出漂亮的照片，游客可以租借传统服饰，在香村里为自己拍下美丽的照片，尤其是女性常常选择连衣裙，或带上长款衣服在香束旁拍照，看起来非常醒目。

posts.title: Delicious dishes in Da Nang
posts.excerpt: Let’s join Vietlook travel to review the delicious and attractive dishes in Da Nang such as: Grilled Bei Cau Mong, Nam O Fish Salad, Rice Paper Rolls with Pork, Cao Lau 1. Quang Noodles A dish that is
posts.contentHtml:
Let’s join Vietlook travel to review the delicious and attractive dishes in Da Nang such as: Grilled Bei Cau Mong, Nam O Fish Salad, Rice Paper Rolls with Pork, Cao Lau…

1. Quang Noodles

A dish that is no longer strange to the people of the Central region, Quang noodles with meat, raw vegetables, dried rice paper, and peanuts mixed together bring diners the delicious and famous flavor of the Central region’s cuisine.

2. Bun Mam Nem

A dish that you only try once but will remember forever, with the combination of young jackfruit, the aroma of raw vegetables, the fatty taste of roasted peanuts, it looks quite simple but when enjoyed, it will be quite delicious and attractive.

3. Cau Mong Grilled Veal

The veal is grilled on a charcoal stove until cooked, bringing a characteristic aroma, served with small chewy rice rolls, green banana, sour star fruit, bean sprouts, mixed with dipping sauce to bring a delicious flavor, an indispensable dish for any tourist when going on a Da Nang tour..

4. Nam O Fish Salad

There are usually 2 types of wet salad and dry salad, dry salad for first-time diners, wet salad for gourmets, a must-try dish when having the opportunity to set foot in Da Nang.

5. Pork Roll Rice Paper

A famous specialty in Da Nang, for any tourist when going on a Da Nang tour, this attractive dish cannot be missed, thinly sliced ​​pork, choose both lean and fatty meat, boiled and rolled with raw vegetables, fish sauce to create an unforgettable flavor of Central cuisine.

6. Cao Lau

The dish is very elaborately prepared, with chewy noodles that still retain their softness when eaten with firm pork, crispy skin, rich broth that brings a delicious flavor of its own, an indispensable dish on the journey to Da Nang Hoi An.

7. Banh Dap

A light dish chosen by many diners when traveling to Da Nang, the rice paper is crispy on the outside and wet on the inside, the cake is eaten with a separate dipping sauce, combining softness and toughness to bring a delicious duck flavor.

8. Nem Tre

A dish with a strong Central flavor, visitors can enjoy it on the spot or buy it as a gift. Nem Tre is made from lean pork, boiled pork belly, thinly sliced, mixed together to bring an irresistible delicious flavor.

With the top 8 delicious dishes in Da Nang that Vietlook has just shared above, we hope you will have the opportunity to fully enjoy the cuisine of Ha Thanh during your trip, and if you are choosing for yourself a fun trip to Da Nang, please join us today.
posts.excerptZh: 让我们跟随 Vietlook Travel 一起回顾岘港那些美味诱人的菜肴，例如：烤 Bei Cau Mong、Nam O 鱼生沙拉、猪肉米纸卷、Cao Lau 1. 广南面 这道菜……
posts.contentHtmlZh:
让我们跟随 Vietlook Travel 一起回顾岘港那些美味诱人的菜肴，例如：烤 Bei Cau Mong、Nam O 鱼生沙拉、猪肉米纸卷、Cao Lau 等……

1. 广南面（Quang Noodles）

这道菜对中部地区的人们来说早已不陌生，广南面配上肉、生菜、烤米饼和花生拌在一起，带给食客美味而著名的中部美食风味。

2. 鱼露酸菜米线（Bun Mam Nem）

这道菜只要尝过一次就会永远记住，嫩菠萝蜜、生菜的清香、烤花生的油润相结合，看起来相当简单，但品尝时却相当美味诱人。

3. Cau Mong 烤小牛肉

小牛肉用炭炉烤熟，散发出独特的香气，搭配小巧筋道的米卷、青香蕉、酸杨桃、豆芽，拌上蘸酱，味道鲜美，是每位游客参加 岘港之旅 时不可错过的一道菜。。

4. Nam O 鱼生沙拉

通常有湿拌和干拌两种，干拌适合初次品尝的食客，湿拌适合美食行家，是有机会踏足岘港时必尝的一道菜。

5. 猪肉卷米纸

这是岘港的著名特产，任何游客参加岘港之旅时都不能错过这道诱人的美味：猪肉切成薄片，精选瘦肉与肥肉搭配，煮熟后与生菜一起卷起，蘸上鱼露，形成令人难忘的中部美食风味。

6. Cao Lau（高楼面）

这道菜制作非常精细，面条筋道，与紧实的猪肉、酥脆的猪皮一起食用时仍保持软糯，汤底浓郁，自有一番美味，是前往岘港、会安旅途中必不可少的一道菜。

7. Banh Dap（拍饼）

这是许多食客在 前往岘港旅行时选择的清淡小吃，米饼外酥内湿润，搭配单独的蘸酱食用，软糯与筋道兼具，带来鲜美的风味。

8. Nem Tre（竹节发酵肉卷）

这是一道带有浓郁中部风味的菜肴，游客可以当场品尝，也可以买来作为礼物。Nem Tre 由瘦猪肉和煮熟切成薄片的五花肉混合制成，味道令人难以抗拒。

以上就是 Vietlook 刚刚分享的岘港八大美味佳肴，希望您在旅途中有机会尽情享用河城（岘港）的美食；如果您正在为自己挑选一次有趣的岘港之旅，欢迎今天就加入我们。

posts.title: Top 9 traditional craft villages in Hanoi
posts.excerpt: Let’s join Vietlok Travel to check out 8 traditional craft villages in ancient Hanoi. If you are a tourist who loves to learn about traditional culture, here are some suggestions for those who are loo
posts.contentHtml:
Let’s join Vietlok Travel to check out 8 traditional craft villages in ancient Hanoi. If you are a tourist who loves to learn about traditional culture, here are some suggestions for those who are looking for a place to learn about traditional craft villages and Vietnamese countryside scenery.

1. Bat Trang Pottery Village

Located in Gia Lam, Hanoi, famous for its ceramics, with sophisticated products that exude the unique beauty of a Hanoi ceramic village. If you are planning to travel to Hanoi, visit the pottery village and make pottery with artisans who create sophisticated products. You can buy ceramic items as gifts.

2. Chuong conical hat making village

A traditional craft village in Thanh Oai, with a thousand years of history, Chuong conical hats are still preserved and promoted, not only bringing income to the local people but also attracting tourists from all over the world to visit and sightsee, especially those who like virtual life can take beautiful photos.

Coming here, visitors can see the experienced conical hat artisans in person, and learn how to make hats from the rudimentary manual stages to the finished hats, especially the hats with eye-catching patterns, so Chuong conical hat village tourism is being chosen by many tourists when traveling to Hanoi.

3. Van Phuc silk village

A place famous for silk products imbued with the traditional culture of a Vietnamese village, when visiting, visitors will encounter shops selling products located close together, very sophisticated products that visitors can buy as gifts. Especially for foreign tourists when traveling to Vietnam, the destination that tourists cannot miss is Van Phuc Silk Village.

4. Vong Com Village

A famous place for making com and squid, although located right in the inner city of Hanoi, this place has a famous com village of Ha Thanh.

Green com grains, wrapped in lotus leaves, have the fragrant flavor of the countryside. In addition, when traveling to Vong village, visitors can also enjoy dishes such as: Fried com cake, sticky rice with com, contributing to enriching the autumn cuisine of Hanoi. Visitors can buy com as gifts.

5. Quat Dong Embroidery Village

Up to now, it still retains the traditional quintessence of a Vietnamese village, exuding a rustic peace but containing many interesting and sophisticated things with sophisticated embroidery works.

In the craft village, each house has a small workshop. When coming here, visitors can take a walk on the street and visit the mothers and sisters who are diligently embroidering eye-catching paintings.

6. Son Dong Sculpture Village

This is one of the traditional craft villages, the cradle of carving statues and worship objects on wood. Although it has gone through so much time, this place still retains traditional carving techniques, exuding a unique delicate beauty of a traditional craft village in Hanoi.

7. Nhi Khe Woodturning Village

At the beginning of the village, visitors can hear the bustling sound of spinning wheels, the meticulous chiseling and carving of craftsmen, the craftsmen create shapes from the blocks as if breathing life into each product that is both durable and beautiful.

The products here are very diverse, such as: bowls, plates, spoons, mortars and pestles, to sophisticated decorative items such as wooden statues, wooden paintings, and handicraft toys.

8. Chuon Ngo Mother-of-Pearl Inlay Village

A place that preserves the quintessence of Vietnamese culture, although it has gone through many years, this place still preserves and develops the mother-of-pearl inlay craft. Coming here, visitors will meet talented artisans who create exquisite works. Visitors not only visit but also chat and listen to the exquisite mother-of-pearl inlay of a traditional craft village in Hanoi.

9. Quang Phu Cau Incense Village Hanoi

Located about 35km from Hanoi, it is one of the traditional craft villages with the profession of producing aromatic incense. Coming here, visitors will meet incense artisans, visitors can make aromatic products by hand, and listen to stories about the formation of the incense village, from the way of making raw materials to the production of aromatic products, not only bringing income to the people here but also being a destination that attracts tourists to visit, especially young people who come to check in for themselves beautiful photos, or foreign tourists who come to visit and learn about traditional Vietnamese craft villages.

Currently, traditional craft villages are indispensable in the treasure trove of Vietnamese culture, where the humanistic values ​​of talented craftsmen are preserved and developed. Each craft village has its own nuances, creating diversity and richness for the Vietnamese national culture.
