posts.contentHtml:
When is the best time to go on a cruise in Ha Long, is the question that most of you are interested in, especially those who want to experience on luxury cruises to see the scenery, or soak in the cool water from the cruise, enjoy Asian and European dishes will bring you the most interesting vacation.

To have the most beautiful cruise in Ha Long, tourists should travel to Ha Long from April to October, when the weather is cool and clear, very favorable for tourists’ sightseeing or sightseeing.

Accompanying Vietlook to experience Ha Long cruise, tourists will have a wonderful adventure on the bay, when the boat glides past the famous sights, tourists can admire, or enjoy soaking in the swimming pool, enjoying delicious dishes right on the cruise will be a great experience when going on a cruise in Ha Long.

The weather in the bay has 4 distinct seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Traveling to Ha Long from April to September, the weather is hot and sunny, in August there are occasional sudden showers, but the short rains do not affect the tourists’ sightseeing journey.

The best time to go on a cruise in Ha Long is in the spring or fall, the weather in Ha Long from April to October is relatively favorable for tourists to have a trip on the sea.

Traveling to Ha Long Bay in the summer, tourists can also experience interesting sea games such as swimming, kayaking, snorkeling, volleyball, which will bring tourists the most perfect vacation.

In addition, when experiencing a cruise overnight, tourists can also admire the moonlight on the sea, a beautiful scene with clear blue water. However, if traveling to Ha Long in the rainy season, tourists should check the weather before coming here so as not to affect their sightseeing itinerary.

Therefore, you can go on a cruise in Ha Long all year round, although no matter what time you choose, Ha Long will bring you a wonderful experience, you should make a plan for your sightseeing tour to be the most perfect.

Experiencing on luxury cruises in Ha Long will bring you different emotions, and participating in games such as: many emotions and exciting experiences such as: kayaking, night squid fishing with coastal fishermen will bring you the most unforgettable moments.

Especially watching the sunset from a cruise with friends and relatives is nothing more interesting, so if you are planning to go on a cruise in Ha Long this summer, come with Vietlook Travel to Ha Long today to experience on 5-star cruises.

Experience on a cruise in Ha Long

Determine the time of departure, proactively book a room 1 or 2 weeks in advance. Especially during holidays, you should proactively book as soon as possible.

If you book a 5-star cruise, there will be full amenities such as an outdoor swimming pool, massage services and enjoy delicious dishes right on the cruise.

The Ha Long cruise will take you through the scenic spots of Sung Sot Cave, Titop Island, Luon Cave, Bai Tu Long Bay or attractions such as Vung Vieng Fishing Village, Soi Sim Island, Thien Canh Son Cave. In addition, you can choose Lan Ha Bay through the scenic spots of Sang Toi Cave, Ba Trai Dao Island, Quan Y Cave, Viet Hai Fishing Village…

In addition, when you have enjoyed the sightseeing, you should enjoy delicious dishes, or you can choose fresh seafood dishes such as: Shrimp, squid, crab, clams, mantis shrimp…

When choosing a menu with main dishes and desserts, each menu will bring diners the most perfect experience, with a combination of flavor and quality of food, the dishes are also decorated very eye-catching by talented chefs.

If you want to experience a romantic space on a cruise, you should choose a BBQ party on the sundeck in the morning on the top floor of the cruise, enjoy the fresh air on the sea, and listen to the music.

The BBQ party includes meats such as beef tenderloin, pork, chicken, and seafood such as shrimp, squid, fish, and vegetables mixed together to bring diners a delicious and famous flavor.

In the rooms on the yacht are decorated very eye-catching, you will have private space and enjoy delicious dishes by talented chefs that will bring you the most memorable vacation.
posts.excerptZh: 什么时候乘游轮游览下龙最好？这是大多数人关心的问题，尤其是想要体验豪华游轮、欣赏风景、在游轮上享受清凉海水、品尝亚洲和欧洲美食的游客，这将为您带来最有趣的假期。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
什么时候乘游轮游览下龙最好？这是大多数人关心的问题，尤其是想要体验豪华游轮、欣赏风景、在游轮上享受清凉海水、品尝亚洲和欧洲美食的游客，这将为您带来最有趣的假期。

要获得最美的下龙游轮体验，游客应在4月至10月前往下龙，此时天气凉爽晴朗，非常有利于游客观光游览。

跟随 Vietlook 一起体验 下龙游轮，游客将在海湾上开启一段美妙的探险，当游轮滑过著名景点时，游客可以尽情欣赏，也可以在泳池里浸泡，在游轮上品尝美味佳肴，这将是乘坐下龙游轮时的绝佳体验。

海湾的天气有四个分明的季节：春、夏、秋、冬。4月至9月前往下龙，天气炎热晴朗，8月偶有突如其来的阵雨，但短暂的降雨不会影响游客的观光行程。

乘游轮游览下龙的最佳时间是春季或秋季，4月至10月下龙的天气相对有利于游客海上出行。

夏季游览下龙湾，游客还可以体验游泳、皮划艇、浮潜、排球等有趣的海上游戏，将为游客带来最完美的假期。

此外，在体验过夜游轮时，游客还可以欣赏海上的月光，湛蓝清澈的海水构成一幅美景。不过，如果在雨季前往下龙，游客应在到达之前查看天气，以免影响观光行程。

因此，您全年都可以乘游轮游览下龙，尽管无论您选择什么时间，下龙都会带给您美妙的体验，但您仍应为观光之旅制定最完美的计划。

体验下龙的豪华游轮将带给您不同的情感，参与诸如皮划艇、与沿海渔民一起夜钓鱿鱼等许多令人兴奋的体验，将带给您最难忘的时刻。

尤其是与亲朋好友一起在游轮上观赏日落，再有趣不过了，所以如果您计划今年夏天乘游轮游览下龙，今天就跟随 Vietlook Travel 前往下龙，体验五星级游轮吧。

下龙游轮体验

确定出发时间，提前1至2周主动预订房间。尤其是在节假日，您应尽早预订。

如果您预订五星级游轮，将拥有完备的设施，如室外游泳池、按摩服务，并可在游轮上享用美味佳肴。

下龙游轮将带您游览 Sung Sot 洞（惊讶洞）、Titop 岛、Luon 洞，以及白龙尾湾（Bai Tu Long），或 Vung Vieng 渔村、Soi Sim 岛、Thien Canh Son 洞等景点。此外，您还可以选择蓝霞湾（Lan Ha），途经 Sang Toi 洞、Ba Trai Dao 岛、Quan Y 洞、Viet Hai 渔村…

此外，在观光之后，您应品尝美味佳肴，也可以选择新鲜海鲜菜肴，如：虾、鱿鱼、螃蟹、蛤蜊、螳螂虾…

选择包含主菜和甜点的菜单时，每份菜单都会为食客带来最完美的体验，风味与食物品质兼具，菜肴也由才华横溢的厨师装饰得非常夺目。

如果您想在游轮上体验浪漫的空间，应选择在游轮顶层的日光甲板上举办早晨的烧烤派对，享受海上的新鲜空气，聆听音乐。

烧烤派对包括牛里脊、猪肉、鸡肉等肉类，以及虾、鱿鱼、鱼等海鲜，搭配蔬菜，带给食客著名的美味。

游艇上的客房装饰得非常夺目，您将拥有私密空间，并享用才华横溢的厨师烹制的美味佳肴，带给您最难忘的假期。

posts.title: Where is Quang Phu Cau Incense Village
posts.excerpt: Currently, tourists are looking to learn and explore the beauty of Vietnamese craft villages, but do not know which craft village to visit, so follow Vietlook to explore the beauty of the Vietnamese c
posts.contentHtml:
Currently, tourists are looking to learn and explore the beauty of Vietnamese craft villages, but do not know which craft village to visit, so follow Vietlook to explore the beauty of the Vietnamese countryside. The most beautiful is Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, however, many of you will wonder where is Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, so let’s refer to this article.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, a virtual living spot on the outskirts of Hanoi, is being sought out by many tourists, especially those who like to live virtually or explore the peaceful and rustic Vietnamese countryside, away from the hustle and bustle.

Located about 35 km south of Hanoi city center, visitors will visit the beauty of a traditional craft village, Quang Phu Cau incense village. To get here, visitors can choose a bus from Yen Nghia bus station, visitors can take bus 91, or drive themselves along National Highway 21B or Provincial Road 429.

The incense village has been preserved by the people of Quang Phu for many generations, and has been passed down for many generations, from sister to sister, mother to children…

Currently, incense is an indispensable product in every family, and is an attractive destination for tourists to visit. The incense village develops not only as a tourist attraction but also as a source of income for the people here.

Quang Phu Cau incense village operates almost all year round, very bustling with the decoration that is constantly changed according to each season, and this is also a place for visitors to take beautiful pictures.

There are very eye-catching display areas, visitors can take beautiful photos and freely pose to take beautiful photos.

Traveling to Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village, almost every season, visitors can take beautiful photos, with incense bundles arranged very eye-catchingly, looking from afar like flowers or funny letters.

It can be said that Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village is not only famous for its aesthetics and uniqueness, but also for its craftsmanship of a traditional village.

In addition, when visiting the incense stick craft village, visitors can also visit the process of making incense bundles, from simple manual work to meticulous finished products.

The incense bundles are arranged with their heads together at the base like blooming flowers with a variety of colors such as red, yellow, pink, blue … looking very eye-catching. Currently, photographers and tourists come here to hunt for photos.

Throughout the village, visitors will also see incense yards drying bundles of green, red, yellow, purple, pink incense… that look like flowers. Visitors will want to take beautiful pictures of themselves, next to a traditional craft village.

Quang Phu Cau incense village is one of the traditional craft villages that has been promoted and preserved to this day, not only bringing income to the people but also being a tourist development point.

In addition, the development of Quang Phu Cau incense village also creates many jobs for workers, and attracts tourists to visit, check in and learn about Vietnamese village culture.

If you are planning to travel to Hanoi, and want to learn about craft villages but do not know which traditional craft villages to visit, and if you visit Quang Phu Cau incense village, where is the address to visit and take beautiful souvenir photos.

When visiting Quang Phu Cau incense village, take a walk around the village, to see with your own eyes the work of the people here through each stage of processing until bringing out aromatic products.

Until today, although Quang Phu Cau incense village has been mixed with modern features, the traditional culture has been mixed to exude the unique beauty of a village, a traditional craft village of Vietnam. If you want to fully explore the beauty, rent a bicycle and cycle around the ancient village in the suburbs of Hanoi to feel its unique beauty.
posts.excerptZh: 目前，游客正想了解和探索越南手工艺村之美，却不知该游览哪个手工艺村，那就跟随 Vietlook 一起探索越南乡村之美吧。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
目前，游客正想了解和探索越南手工艺村之美，却不知该游览哪个手工艺村，那就跟随 Vietlook 一起探索越南乡村之美吧。 最美的是广富旧（Quang Phu Cau）香村，不过，许多人会疑惑广富旧香村在哪里，那就请参考这篇文章吧。

广富旧香村是河内郊区的一处热门打卡点，受到许多游客的追捧，尤其是喜欢拍照打卡或探索宁静质朴、远离喧嚣的越南乡村的人。

广富旧香村位于河内市中心以南约35公里处，游客将参观传统手工艺村之美。前往这里，游客可以选择从 Yen Nghia 汽车站乘坐公共汽车，可乘91路公共汽车，或沿21B国道或429省道自驾前往。

香村由广富人民世代保存，代代相传，从姐妹到姐妹，从母亲到孩子…

如今，香是每个家庭不可或缺的产品，也是吸引游客参观的目的地。香村的发展不仅是一个旅游景点，也是这里人民的收入来源。

广富旧香村几乎全年运营，非常热闹，装饰会随着每个季节不断变化，这里也是游客拍摄美照的地方。

这里有非常引人注目的展示区，游客可以拍摄美照，自由摆姿势拍照。

游览广富旧制香手工艺村，几乎每个季节，游客都可以拍摄美照，成束的香被摆放得非常醒目，远看像花朵或有趣的字母。

可以说，广富旧制香手工艺村不仅以其美感和独特性而闻名，还以传统村落的精湛手艺而闻名。

此外，参观制香手工艺村时，游客还可以参观制作成束香的过程，从简单的手工到精细的成品。

成束的香头部在底部聚在一起，如盛开的花朵，有红、黄、粉、蓝等多种颜色…看起来非常醒目。目前，摄影师和游客都来到这里寻找拍摄素材。

整个村子里，游客还会看到晒香的院子，晒着绿、红、黄、紫、粉色的香束…看起来像花朵。游客会想在传统手工艺村旁为自己拍下美照。

广富旧香村是被推广并保存至今的传统手工艺村之一，不仅为人民带来收入，也是旅游发展点。

此外，广富旧香村的发展还为工人创造了许多就业机会，并吸引游客前来参观、打卡并了解越南乡村文化。

如果您计划前往河内旅游，想了解手工艺村，却不知该参观哪些传统手工艺村，那么游览广富旧香村吧，这里的参观地址在哪里、在哪里拍摄美丽的纪念照。

参观广富旧香村时，在村里走一走，亲眼看看这里的人们经过每个加工阶段，直至制成芬芳产品的劳作。

直到今天，尽管广富旧香村已掺入现代元素，传统文化交融在一起，散发出村落的独特之美，这是越南的传统手工艺村。如果想充分探索其美，租一辆自行车，骑行在河内郊区的古村中，感受它独特的美。

posts.title: What is beautiful about traveling to Ha Long in August
posts.excerpt: In August, the weather is gradually changing from summer to autumn, but this is also the time when Ha Long enters the cool weather, very suitable for tourists’ outdoor excursions, so if you are planni
posts.contentHtml:
In August, the weather is gradually changing from summer to autumn, but this is also the time when Ha Long enters the cool weather, very suitable for tourists’ outdoor excursions, so if you are planning to travel to Ha Long in August, let’s go through the points and experiences of traveling to Ha Long right below with Vietlook.

The weather in Ha Long in August is relatively cool, the temperature fluctuates between 29 degrees Celsius – 30 degrees Celsius, however, in August Ha Long has sudden showers so you should bring an umbrella so as not to affect the sightseeing journey of tourists, because the showers are usually short and not too long so they do not affect the tourists’ tour.

Ha Long tourist attractions in August

Bai Tho Mountain

Located at an altitude of 200m above sea level, and right next to Ha Long city, where nature has bestowed poetic beauty, from the top of the mountain visitors can enjoy the whole beauty of the bay, especially in the autumn weather.

Tuan Chau Sculpture Park

The park is called King Kong Park, famous for its interesting games, besides the exquisite sculptures, visitors can also admire the waterfalls, which are an interesting stop every summer or weekend, especially for families with young children.

Ha Long Bay

As one of the indispensable destinations in the Ha Long tour itinerary, no matter what season of the year, Ha Long Bay always brings visitors a unique beauty. When coming here, visitors should visit Thien Cung Cave, Titop Island, Cua Van Fishing Village, Hang Luon, Hon Trong Mai, ….

Especially when visiting Ha Long Bay by cruise, sitting on the cruise, visitors can enjoy the whole beauty of the bay, a magical and poetic scene appears right before the eyes of visitors.

Titop Island

Located in the middle of Ha Long Bay, the island emerges like a crescent moon. Coming to the island, tourists can not only visit but also experience swimming, participate in games on the sea or conquer the top of the island to watch the beautiful sunset.

Sung Sot Cave

One of the pristine caves in Ha Long, inside the cave there are natural stalactites, a cool space, an ideal stopover in Ha Long.

Luon Cave

One of the most visited by tourists, especially foreign tourists, when they experience kayaking or bamboo boats deep inside to admire the beauty of the cave, from inside the cave visitors can admire the beauty of the curved stone arch, when the sun shines down, creating a beautiful scene, a destination for tourists who love nature.

Cuu Van Fishing Village

Hidden next to the sea, a small fishing village lies under the cool green coconut trees, with boats anchored next to the casuarina trees, every evening the scene of the fishing village is bustling with boats coming to shore, with gentle smiles, when the dawn comes, those boats follow each other to go out to sea, looking like a poetic picture of the sea and islands.

In addition, when traveling to Ha Long in August, visitors should participate in interesting games on the sea such as: kayaking, sleeping overnight on a boat, experiencing Ha Long by seaplane … all will bring visitors the most interesting vacation when coming to Ha Long.

Delicious dishes you should try when traveling to Ha Long in August such as: Ngan Bien, Cha Muc, Sam Bien, Tien Yen Hill Chicken, Bun Be Man… and many more delicious and attractive dishes are waiting for tourists to discover.

With the experiences of traveling to Ha Long in August that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, you probably have your own answer, and will no longer wonder what is beautiful about traveling to Ha Long in August, wish you a happy trip.
posts.excerptZh: 8月，天气正逐渐由夏入秋，这也是下龙进入凉爽天气的时候，非常适合游客户外游览，因此如果您计划
posts.contentHtmlZh:
8月，天气正逐渐由夏入秋，这也是下龙进入凉爽天气的时候，非常适合游客户外游览，因此如果您计划 8月前往下龙旅游 ，让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起了解下面8月游览下龙的要点和体验。

8月的下龙天气相对凉爽，气温在29摄氏度至30摄氏度之间波动，不过8月下龙会有突发阵雨，所以您应该带一把伞，以免影响游客的观光行程，因为阵雨通常很短暂，不会太久，因此不会影响游客的游览。

8月的下龙旅游景点

白寿山（Bai Tho）

位于海拔200米，紧邻下龙市，大自然在这里赐予了诗意之美，从山顶游客可以欣赏海湾的全貌，尤其是在秋天的天气里。

巡洲雕塑公园

公园被称为金刚公园，以有趣的游乐项目闻名，除了精美的雕塑，游客还可以欣赏瀑布，是每年夏季或周末有趣的一站，尤其适合带幼儿的家庭。

下龙湾

作为 下龙之旅 行程中不可或缺的目的地之一，无论一年中的哪个季节，下龙湾总能给游客带来独特的美。来到这里，游客应游览天宫洞、斗鼓岛（Titop）、九万渔村（Cua Van）、Luon 洞、Trong Mai 岩…。

尤其是乘游轮游览下龙湾时，坐在游轮上，游客可以欣赏海湾的全貌，神奇而诗意的景象就出现在游客眼前。

斗鼓岛（Titop）

位于下龙湾中央，小岛如新月般浮现。来到岛上，游客不仅可以参观，还可以体验游泳、参加海上游戏，或征服岛顶观看美丽的日落。

惊讶洞（Sung Sot）

下龙原始洞穴之一，洞内有天然钟乳石，空间凉爽，是下龙理想的休憩之处。

Luon 洞

是游客，尤其是外国游客最常光顾的地方之一，他们可以体验皮划艇或乘竹筏深入洞内欣赏洞穴之美，从洞内游客可以欣赏弯曲的石拱之美，当阳光洒下时，形成美丽的景象，是热爱自然的游客的目的地。

九万（Cuu Van）渔村

隐藏在海边，一座小渔村坐落在清凉碧绿的椰子树下，船只停泊在木麻黄树旁，每天傍晚，渔村景象因船只靠岸而热闹，人们面带温和的微笑；黎明来临时，这些船只一艘接着一艘出海，如同一幅海与岛的诗意画卷。

此外，8月前往下龙旅游时，游客应参加有趣的海上活动，例如：皮划艇、在船上过夜、乘水上飞机体验下龙…都将给游客带来来到下龙时最有趣的假期。

8月前往下龙旅游时您应该品尝的美味佳肴，如：沙蚕（Ngan Bien）、鱿鱼饼（Cha Muc）、沙虫（Sam Bien）、Tien Yen 山鸡、Bun Be Man…还有许多美味诱人的菜肴等待游客去发现。

有了 Vietlook Travel 刚刚分享的8月前往下龙旅游的体验，您或许已经有了自己的答案，不会再疑惑8月前往下龙旅游有何美景，祝您旅途愉快。

posts.title: What is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in August
posts.excerpt: Traveling to Ninh Binh in August, visitors are amazed by the beauty of lotus flowers exuding a fragrant scent as the weather gradually turns to autumn, and visiting the scenic spots of Tam Coc, Bich D
posts.contentHtml:
Traveling to Ninh Binh in August, visitors are amazed by the beauty of lotus flowers exuding a fragrant scent as the weather gradually turns to autumn, and visiting the scenic spots of Tam Coc, Bich Dong, Thung Nham bird garden, Cuc Phuong national park, Bai Dinh pagoda… visitors can admire the scenery in the autumn weather, there is nothing more beautiful. So let’s take a look at What is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in August below.

Ninh Binh is a destination that is attracting domestic and international tourists. When traveling Ninh Binh in August, visitors will be amazed by the beauty of lotus season, lotus flowers exuding a passionate fragrance. Visitors can take pictures of the fragrant lotus season. To admire the beauty of this place in August, let’s take a look at the beautiful things about Ninh Binh in August below.

The weather in Ninh Binh in August is not as hot and sunny as in summer. In August, Ninh Binh enters the autumn season with a relatively cool climate, the sky is clear, sometimes there are clouds drifting, and occasionally there are sudden showers, so when traveling to Ninh Binh in August, you should bring an umbrella so as not to affect your sightseeing itinerary.

Visiting Trang An in August

Trang An has long been a popular tourist destination, where the green mountains and blue water blend together to create a poetic picture.

In particular, when traveling to Trang An, tourists also visit mysterious caves, rich fauna, shimmering and magical water valleys, and many historical relics including temples, shrines, and ancient pagodas from thousands of years ago that still remain today.

Thach Bich – Thung Nang

Coming to Thach Bich – Thung Nang in August, the weather is in autumn, with cool breezes, and the rice fields are starting to turn yellow, next to the blue rivers. When the sun just rises, the rays of sunlight shine through the leaves, or next to the rustic thatched houses located right on the river, creating a poetic picture, inside are caves surrounded by undulating mountains, a fascinating beauty.

Tam Coc – Bich Dong

Located in the Trang An scenic area, Tam Coc has 3 main caves: Hang Ca, Hang Hai, Hang Ba… to get here, visitors can sit on a dugout canoe along the river =, on both sides are long rice fields, Tam Coc has a truly poetic scene.

If you are a person who loves to admire the natural scenery of clouds and sky, you can rent a bicycle to go sightseeing, the destination that tourists cannot miss when traveling to Tam Coc is Bich Dong Pagoda, only 3km from Tam Coc, on both sides of the road to the pagoda are blooming lotus ponds giving off a cool fragrance, traveling to Tam Coc – Bich Dong in August, visitors will enjoy the charming beauty of the ancient capital.

Hang Mua

As one of the indispensable destinations in the Ninh Binh tour, when coming here, visitors will visit the ancient fortress, and conquer 500 stone steps, but in return, visitors will fully admire the beauty of Ninh Binh from above, and record beautiful pictures for themselves.

Thung Nham Bird Garden

August Thung Nham Bird Garden is very beautiful, in the cool weather, visitors can feast their eyes on the beauty, or take pictures of the lotus flowers spreading their fragrance in the wind, or enjoy a cup of lotus tea watching the peaceful scenery, enjoying the cool breeze, there is nothing more interesting. Besides, visitors also visit caves such as Hang But, inside there are beautiful stone slabs, which will bring visitors unforgettable memories when visiting Ninh Binh.

So it can be said that when traveling to Ninh, no matter what season of the year, visitors can feel its own beauty, a charming landscape of mountains and rivers, with vast rice fields, or the fragrant lotus season, or watching flocks of birds flying in the sky, especially going by boat to visit mysterious caves. Especially foreign tourists when traveling to Ninh Binh also experience cycling to see the scenery or enjoy fragrant lotus tea and delicious dishes that attract customers will bring tourists the most unforgettable vacation in Ninh Binh.
posts.excerptZh: 8 月前往宁平旅游，随着天气逐渐转入秋季，游客会被散发着芬芳的荷花之美所惊艳，并参观三谷、碧洞、Thung Nham 鸟园、菊芳国家公园、白亭寺等景点。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
8 月前往宁平旅游，随着天气逐渐转入秋季，游客会被散发着芬芳的荷花之美所惊艳，并参观三谷、碧洞、Thung Nham 鸟园、菊芳国家公园、白亭寺…游客可以在秋日的天气里欣赏风景，再没有比这更美的了。 那么，让我们来看看下面 8 月前往宁平旅游有哪些美景吧。

宁平是一个正吸引着国内外游客的目的地。8 月游览宁平，游客将被荷花季之美所惊艳，荷花散发着浓郁的芬芳。游客可以为芬芳的荷花季拍照。要欣赏这里 8 月的美景，让我们来看看下面 8 月宁平有哪些美丽之处。

宁平 8 月的天气不像夏天那样炎热多阳光。8 月，宁平进入秋季，气候相对凉爽，天空晴朗，有时有云朵飘过，偶尔会有突然的阵雨，因此 8 月前往宁平旅游时，您应该带一把伞，以免影响观光行程。

8 月游览长安

长安长期以来一直是受欢迎的旅游目的地，青山绿水交融在一起，构成一幅诗意的画卷。

特别是，前往长安旅游时，游客还可以参观神秘的洞穴、丰富的动物群、波光粼粼而神奇的水谷，以及许多历史遗迹，包括数千年前留存至今的庙宇、祠堂和古寺。

石壁 – Thung Nang

8 月来到石壁 – Thung Nang，天气正值秋季，微风清凉，稻田开始变黄，紧挨着蓝色的河流。 当太阳刚刚升起时，阳光透过树叶洒下，或是在紧邻河岸的质朴茅草屋旁，构成一幅诗意的画面，里面是被起伏山峦环绕的洞穴，令人着迷的美景。

三谷 – 碧洞

三谷位于长安景区内，有 3 个主要洞穴：Hang Ca、Hang Hai、Hang Ba…要前往那里，游客可以乘坐独木舟沿河而行，两岸是绵延的稻田，三谷呈现出真正诗意的景象。

如果您是喜爱欣赏云天自然风光的人，可以租一辆自行车去观光，游览三谷时游客不能错过的目的地是碧洞寺，距三谷仅 3 公里，通往寺庙的道路两旁是盛开的荷塘，散发着清凉的芬芳，8 月游览三谷 – 碧洞，游客将享受古都迷人的美景。

Hang Mua（舞洞）

作为宁平旅游中不可或缺的目的地之一，来到这里，游客将参观古城堡，并攀登 500 级石阶，但作为回报，游客可以从高处尽情欣赏宁平之美，并为自己留下美丽的照片。

Thung Nham 鸟园

8 月的 Thung Nham 鸟园非常美丽，在凉爽的天气里，游客可以大饱眼福，或为在风中散发芬芳的荷花拍照，或品一杯荷花茶，眺望宁静的风景，享受凉爽的微风，再没有比这更有趣的了。此外，游客还可以参观 Hang But 等洞穴，洞内有美丽的石板，将为游客留下游览宁平时难忘的回忆。

可以说，前往宁平旅游，无论一年中的哪个季节，游客都能感受到它独特的美：山水交融的迷人风景、辽阔的稻田，或是芬芳的荷花季，或是观赏成群的鸟儿在天空中飞翔，尤其是乘船参观神秘的洞穴。特别是外国游客前往宁平时，还会体验骑自行车观赏风景，或品尝芬芳的荷花茶和吸引顾客的美味佳肴，这将为游客带来最难忘的宁平假期。

posts.title: Da Nang – Hoi An Hot Air Balloon Festival
posts.excerpt: This year’s Da Nang – Hoi An Hot Air Balloon Festival will take place in a vibrant atmosphere. Coming here on this occasion, visitors will be able to participate in hot air balloon performances flying
posts.contentHtml:
This year’s Da Nang – Hoi An Hot Air Balloon Festival will take place in a vibrant atmosphere. Coming here on this occasion, visitors will be able to participate in hot air balloon performances flying in the sky and admire the beauty of the coastal city from above, which will bring a sense of excitement.

This is considered one of the exciting festivals that brings new experiences to the people and visitors, aiming to promote the image of Quang Nam tourism to international visitors and friends.

Traveling to Da Nang on the hot air balloon festival, visitors will be able to fly in the air as if inviting visitors to visit, bringing visitors an interesting vacation, admiring the beautiful landscapes of the Central region.

Taking a tour to Da Nang on the hot air balloon festival, visitors will be able to check in and take pictures next to colorful hot air balloons, spread out at the APEC Sculpture Garden Park on Bach Dang Street, visitors will be able to fly with a guide at a height of 15 m to 40 m to admire the scenery of Da Nang from above.

The hot air balloon performance from 7pm to 8pm with fire dragon performances, blowing up the bridge, building the bridge, including 12 mini hot air balloons, 3 level 7 hot air balloons and 2 inflatable hot air balloons serving visitors 24/7.

It can be said that this year’s hot air balloon festival will bring visitors unique experiences, especially for visitors to Da Nang during the festival. In Hoi An, the hot air balloon festival is also bustling, with many events that will bring people and visitors unique experiences.

During the festival, colorful hot air balloons will be displayed flying in the sky of Quang Nam, with 12 mini hot air balloons, 3 level 7 hot air balloons and 2 inflatable hot air balloons arranged to fly over the Hoai River, bringing visitors brilliant colors.

Especially at 7pm – 8pm on March 25, there will be a lantern night program with the blowing of fire into the balloon cages, at this time the balloons shine like sparkling lanterns, visitors can also participate in the game of shaking the basket on the Hoai River, creating a vibrant atmosphere.

It can be said that the Da Nang Hoi An hot air balloon festival promises to bring the most interesting experiences to the people and visitors, especially when flying in the air, admiring the scenery of Quang Nam from above.
posts.excerptZh: 今年的岘港–会安热气球节将在热闹的氛围中举行。在此期间来到这里，游客可以参与在天空中飞翔的热气球表演，从高处欣赏海滨城市之美，带来激动的感受。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
今年的岘港–会安热气球节将在热闹的氛围中举行。在此期间来到这里，游客可以参与在天空中飞翔的热气球表演，从高处欣赏海滨城市之美，带来激动的感受。

这被认为是为民众和游客带来全新体验的精彩节日之一，旨在向国际游客和朋友推广广南旅游形象。

前往岘港旅游 恰逢热气球节，游客将能够在空中飞翔，仿佛在邀请游客来参观，带来有趣的假期，欣赏中部地区美丽的风景。

参加 岘港之旅 恰逢热气球节，游客可以在白藤街（Bach Dang）APEC雕塑公园铺开的五彩热气球旁打卡拍照，游客还可以在导游陪同下升至15米至40米的高度，从高处欣赏岘港的风景。

热气球表演在晚上7点至8点举行，包括火龙表演、吹桥、搭桥，共有12个迷你热气球、3个7级热气球和2个充气热气球，全天候为游客服务。

可以说，今年的热气球节将为游客带来独特的体验，尤其是节日期间前往岘港的游客。在会安，热气球节同样热闹，有许多活动将为民众和游客带来独特的体验。

节日期间，五彩缤纷的热气球将在广南的天空中展示飞行，共安排12个迷你热气球、3个7级热气球和2个充气热气球飞越秋盆河，为游客带来绚丽的色彩。

特别是在3月25日晚上7点至8点，将举行灯笼之夜活动，向气球吊篮中喷火，此时气球如闪烁的灯笼般发光，游客还可以参与秋盆河上的摇篮游戏，营造出热闹的氛围。

可以说，岘港会安热气球节承诺为民众和游客带来最有趣的体验，尤其是在空中飞翔、从高处欣赏广南风光时。

posts.title: Traveling to Ha Giang in buckwheat flower season
posts.excerpt: Every year, in late autumn and early winter, in Ha Giang, in the valleys or on the mountain slopes and mountain passes, there is a season of fragrant buckwheat flowers, a typical flower of the Ha Gian
posts.contentHtml:
Every year, in late autumn and early winter, in Ha Giang, in the valleys or on the mountain slopes and mountain passes, there is a season of fragrant buckwheat flowers, a typical flower of the Ha Giang rocky plateau.

Ha Giang buckwheat flowers are usually beautiful in late October and early November, the flowers bloom in a purple color spread across the plateau, the majestic mountain and forest scenery, interspersed with beautiful pure buckwheat flowers that captivate people’s hearts.

Buckwheat flowers grow along the roads, at the foot of the mountains, on the hillsides, showing a strong vitality even on thorny cliffs. If you have the opportunity to travel to Ha Giang in October, visitors will be immersed in the beauty of beautiful buckwheat flowers.

Buckwheat flowers bloom, signaling the arrival of winter on the plateau, all over the valleys of Ha Giang, everywhere is covered with a season of brilliant flowers spreading a fragrant scent in the wind.

The petals clustered in the middle are buckwheat seeds, the color of the flower changes over time, at first the flower is pure white, then gradually turns to light pink, and a deep purple and a black color and then gradually fades.

Flowers cover the valleys of Ha Giang, this is the time when Ha Giang attracts the most tourists to visit and sightsee in the year, if you are planning to travel to Ha Giang, choose the buckwheat flower season.

Currently, the flower has become a highlight for every tourist when talking about Ha Giang, especially in November every year, Ha Giang also holds the buckwheat flower festival, with many exciting events that promise to bring people and tourists the most enjoyable experiences.

If you are someone who likes to live in the flower season, then join Vietlook to travel to Ha Giang during the buckwheat flower season, and this is also an opportunity for you to freely check in, no matter which angle you stand at, you can capture beautiful pictures for yourself.

It can be said that the flower on the rocky plateau is a typical symbol of Ha Giang. To fully admire the beauty of the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang, visitors should visit places such as: Ma Le, Pho Cao, Sung La, Lung Cu flagpole, …

To be proactive in the tourist itinerary when coming to Ha Giang, visitors should rent a motorbike to admire the beauty, and be proactive when traveling on the roads they love, they can stop to take pictures, or freely immerse themselves in the natural scenery and see with their own eyes the heart-stopping beauty of the rocky plateau.

In addition, when coming to Ha Giang, visitors can also conquer winding mountain passes with hairpin bends, admire the beauty of buckwheat flowers right on the mountainside, on high mountain passes with hairpin bends, all challenging the drivers, and feast their eyes on the beauty of the buckwheat flower season in the rocky plateau.
posts.excerptZh: 每年深秋初冬时节，在河江的山谷间、山坡上和山口，都迎来芬芳的荞麦花季，这是河江石高原的代表性花卉。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
每年深秋初冬时节，在河江的山谷间、山坡上和山口，都迎来芬芳的荞麦花季，这是河江石高原的代表性花卉。

河江的荞麦花通常在十月下旬和十一月上旬最美，花朵绽放出紫色，铺满整个高原，雄伟的山林风光中点缀着美丽纯净的荞麦花，令人心醉神迷。

荞麦花沿着道路、在山脚下、山坡上生长，即使在多刺的悬崖上也展现出顽强的生命力。如果您有机会在十月前往河江旅游，游客将沉浸在美丽荞麦花的美景之中。

荞麦花盛开，预示着高原冬季的到来，河江的山谷里到处都被绚丽的花季覆盖，在风中散发着芬芳的香气。

聚集在中间的花瓣是荞麦籽，花的颜色随时间变化，起初花朵是纯白色，然后逐渐变成浅粉色，再变成深紫色和黑色，然后逐渐凋谢。

鲜花覆盖河江的山谷，这是河江一年中吸引游客最多前来参观观光的时候，如果您正计划前往河江旅游，请选择荞麦花季。

目前，这种花已成为每位游客谈到河江时的亮点，尤其是每年十一月，河江还会举办荞麦花节，有许多精彩的活动，承诺为民众和游客带来最愉快的体验。

如果您是喜欢生活在花季中的人，那就加入 Vietlook， 在荞麦花季前往河江旅游，这也是您自由打卡的机会，无论站在哪个角度，都能为自己拍下美丽的照片。

可以说，石高原上的花是河江的典型象征。为了充分欣赏河江荞麦花季之美，游客应前往以下地方：Ma Le、Pho Cao、松拉、龙举旗台……

为了在来河江的旅游行程中占据主动，游客应租一辆摩托车来欣赏美景，并主动选择自己喜爱的道路行驶，可以随时停下来拍照，或自由沉浸在自然风光中，亲眼目睹石高原令人心跳的美景。

此外，来到河江，游客还可以征服蜿蜒曲折的发夹弯山口，在山腰上、在高高的发夹弯山口上欣赏荞麦花之美，这一切都考验着驾驶者，同时饱览石高原荞麦花季的美景。

posts.title: Top 4 delicious and attractive dishes
posts.excerpt: Let’s join Vietlook Travel to check out the delicious and attractive dishes that you must try once in your life, including dishes such as: Bun cha, broken rice with pork ribs, grilled spring rolls, br
posts.contentHtml:
Let’s join Vietlook Travel to check out the delicious and attractive dishes that you must try once in your life, including dishes such as: Bun cha, broken rice with pork ribs, grilled spring rolls, braised pork belly…

Nem lui

A famous delicious dish in Hue, made from ground pork with minced pork, onions, garlic and wrapped around lemongrass stalks, and seasoned to create eye-catching colors, the spices are often made from fish sauce, oyster sauce, annatto oil, ground pepper, sugar or honey and grilled on a charcoal stove to bring out the delicious flavor of Central Vietnam cuisine.

Nem lui is often served with raw vegetables wrapped in rice paper, with a sauce made from ground sticky rice, stir-fried minced meat, crushed peanuts, sweet fish sauce, satay… mixed together to bring an irresistible delicious flavor, if you have the opportunity to travel to Hue, you should enjoy nem lui to feel the delicious flavor that this place has brought to visitors.

Bun Cha

When talking about Bun Cha, people immediately think of Hanoi. This is a dish that many tourists choose when traveling to Hanoi, especially foreign tourists. Bun is eaten with minced meat and sweet crab broth, along with lettuce, cucumber, chili, pepper, lemon… bringing a delicious flavor.

Broken rice with pork ribs

This is one of the quite famous dishes – broken rice is cooked into rice and served with grilled pork ribs, grilled pork, fried eggs, egg rolls, shredded pork skin… with chopped onions, tomatoes, cucumbers and pickled vegetables.

Eat with garlic and chili sauce kept separately in a bowl, when eating, pour it on the rice according to the taste of each diner, it will bring a delicious flavor, although the dish is available in every region, the best is still Saigon broken rice.

So to enjoy the delicious flavors, let’s travel across Vietnam with Vietlook Travel, to feel and enjoy the delicious dishes with the bold flavors of the Vietnamese countryside.
posts.excerptZh: 让我们跟随Vietlook Travel一起看看一生中必尝一次的美味诱人菜肴，包括：烤肉米线（Bun cha）、碎米饭配猪排、烤春卷、红烧五花肉等菜肴。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
让我们跟随Vietlook Travel一起看看一生中必尝一次的美味诱人菜肴，包括：烤肉米线（Bun cha）、碎米饭配猪排、烤春卷、红烧五花肉……

香茅烤肉串（Nem lui）

顺化著名的美味菜肴，用猪肉末、洋葱、大蒜制成肉馅，包裹在香茅茎上，并调味出诱人的色泽，调料通常由鱼露、蚝油、胭脂树籽油、胡椒粉、糖或蜂蜜制成，在炭炉上烤制，以展现越南中部美食的美味风味。

香茅烤肉串通常搭配生菜用米纸卷起来食用，蘸酱由磨碎的糯米、炒肉末、碎花生、甜鱼露、沙爹……混合而成，带来令人难以抗拒的美味，如果您有机会前往顺化旅行，应该品尝香茅烤肉串，感受这里带给游客的美味。

烤肉米线（Bun Cha）

说到烤肉米线，人们立刻会想到河内。这是许多游客，尤其是外国游客 前往河内旅行时会选择的一道菜。米线搭配肉末和甜美的蟹汤，以及生菜、黄瓜、辣椒、胡椒、柠檬……带来美味的风味。

碎米饭配猪排

这是相当著名的菜肴之一——碎米煮成饭，搭配烤猪排、烤猪肉、煎蛋、蛋卷、猪皮丝……以及葱花、番茄、黄瓜和腌菜。

搭配单独盛在碗里的蒜蓉辣椒酱食用，吃的时候根据每位食客的口味淋在饭上，会带来美味的风味，虽然这道菜在各个地区都有，但最好吃的仍是西贡碎米饭。

所以要享受美味的风味，让我们跟随Vietlook Travel走遍越南，感受并享用带有越南乡村浓郁风味的美味菜肴。

posts.title: Discover the beauty of Ti Top peak
posts.excerpt: Discovering the beauty of Ti Top peak, visitors will catch an island from the high hill, from here they can see the whole beauty of the sea and islands, the vastness and majesty of Ha Long Bay opening
posts.contentHtml:
Discovering the beauty of Ti Top peak, visitors will catch an island from the high hill, from here they can see the whole beauty of the sea and islands, the vastness and majesty of Ha Long Bay opening right before their eyes.

Ha Long Bay has long been a famous tourist attraction that attracts visitors to visit and enjoy, especially in the summer when visitors from all over the world come here to visit and enjoy the scenery and participate in many interesting games on the sea.

When talking about Ha Long, visitors cannot help but mention beautiful stops such as: Dragon Eye Island, Tuan Chau Island, Hon Gai, Sung Sot Cave… in which Ti Top Island stands out with its own unique beauty.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ha Long, visitors should visit Ti Top Island to admire the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place, the island has a crescent-shaped sandy beach, the four seasons of high tides have washed it clean and white, visitors when coming to the island can walk barefoot on the sand.

Ti Top Island has left many memories, and Uncle Ho named the island Ti Top Island, so the island is a place that leaves many memories. If you set foot here, you will encounter an island with a steep bank. You should conquer Ti Top peak to admire the beauty of Ha Long Bay from above, a poetic landscape.

On the way to the top of the mountain, visitors will conquer a spacious stone embankment. Visitors will look down below to see the vegetation and ecosystem of Ha Long Bay. Currently, Titop Island is very suitable for visitors who like to participate in thrilling games such as parasailing, banana boating, etc.

On the top of the mountain is a beautiful stop, from here visitors can fully admire the beauty of Ha Long Bay from above. On the top of the mountain, there is a watchtower.

From the observation tower, visitors can admire the scenic Bai Tho Mountain and Bai Chay Bridge across Cua Luc Bay, the Queen Cable Car and the Sun Wheel like a giant wheel high in the sky or the towering Bo Hon Island, in the distance is the mountain range of Hon Soi Sim, Hon Dam Nam, Hon Dai Thanh…

So let’s join Vietlook Travel to Ha Long today to conquer the beauty of Ti Top Mountain, stop at the observation tower to admire the beauty of Ha Long from above, with clear blue sea water and boats connecting to the open sea, a truly beautiful scene, will bring visitors the most perfect vacation on the island.
posts.excerptZh: 探索提托峰（Ti Top）之美，游客将从高高的山丘上俯瞰一座海岛，从这里可以看到大海和群岛的全部美景，下龙湾的辽阔与雄伟就展现在眼前。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
探索提托峰（Ti Top）之美，游客将从高高的山丘上俯瞰一座海岛，从这里可以看到大海和群岛的全部美景，下龙湾的辽阔与雄伟就展现在眼前。

下龙湾长期以来一直是著名的旅游景点，吸引游客前来参观游玩，尤其是在夏季，来自世界各地的游客来到这里参观、欣赏风景，并参与许多有趣的海上游戏。

谈到下龙，游客不得不提到一些美丽的景点，例如：龙眼岛、Tuan Chau 岛、鸿基、惊讶洞（Sung Sot）…其中提托岛以其独特的美脱颖而出。

如果您有机会前往下龙旅游，游客应参观提托岛，欣赏大自然赐予这里的美景，岛上有一片月牙形的沙滩，四季涨潮的海水将它冲刷得洁白干净，游客来到岛上可以赤脚漫步在沙滩上。

提托岛留下了许多回忆，胡伯伯将这座岛命名为提托岛，因此这座岛是一个留下许多回忆的地方。如果您踏足这里，会看到一座岸边陡峭的岛屿。您应该登上提托峰，从高处欣赏下龙湾之美，如诗如画的风景。

在通往山顶的路上，游客将攀登宽敞的石砌堤岸。游客向下俯瞰，可以看到下龙湾的植被和生态系统。目前，提托岛非常适合喜欢参与滑翔伞、香蕉船等刺激游戏的游客。

山顶是一处美丽的停留点，从这里游客可以从高处尽情欣赏下龙湾之美。山顶上有一座瞭望塔。

从观景塔上，游客可以欣赏风景优美的 Bai Tho 山和横跨 Cua Luc 湾的白藤大桥（Bai Chay Bridge）、皇后缆车和如同高悬天际巨轮的太阳摩天轮，或者巍然耸立的 Bo Hon 岛，远处是 Hon Soi Sim、Hon Dam Nam、Hon Dai Thanh…等山脉。

让我们今天就跟随 Vietlook 前往下龙旅游，征服提托山之美，在观景塔驻足，从高处欣赏下龙之美，碧蓝清澈的海水和连接大海的船只，真是一幅美丽的景象，将为游客带来最完美的海岛假期。

posts.title: Immerse yourself in the sea of ​​clouds in Hanoi
posts.excerpt: When it comes to cloud hunting, many tourists immediately think of the Northwest mountains or Da Lat, but few people know that in Hanoi, tourists can also immerse themselves in the sea of ​​floating c
posts.contentHtml:
When it comes to cloud hunting, many tourists immediately think of the Northwest mountains or Da Lat, but few people know that in Hanoi, tourists can also immerse themselves in the sea of ​​floating clouds.

The cloud hunting spot that is being hunted by backpackers must immediately mention Ba Vi National Park, the green lung of the capital Hanoi, the most beautiful is when dawn comes, visitors can admire the scenery under the rising sun or after the rain, the weather covers the clouds like a beautiful picture.

Ba Vi National Park is different from other tourist attractions in the capital or other cities, from the evening of the previous day to about 9 o’clock the next day, the temperature here is relatively cool, sometimes chilly, the fresh air is very suitable for cloud hunting and sightseeing, especially resort tours at Ba Vi National Park.

Traveling to Ba Vi from April to October is a great place to escape the sun, because Ba Vi is a place with a beautiful landscape and cool weather, and this is also an opportunity for visitors to immerse themselves in the sea of ​​clouds and capture beautiful photos.

Many tourists who love to take virtual photos to have beautiful photos have traveled to Ba Vi from 3am to Ba Vi National Park to watch the sunrise, and this is the time many young people choose to take virtual photos when traveling to Hanoi

To get to Ba Vi National Park from the center of Hanoi, visitors can go in the direction of Thang Long Avenue or via National Highway 32, or if visitors take a bus from My Dinh, visitors take bus 74, 71 and at the end take bus 110 to Ba Vi National Park.
posts.titleZh: 沉浸在河内的云海之中
posts.excerptZh: 说到追云，许多游客立刻会想到西北山区或大叻，但很少有人知道，在河内，游客也可以沉浸在漂浮的云海之中。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
说到追云，许多游客立刻会想到西北山区或大叻，但很少有人知道，在河内，游客也可以沉浸在漂浮的云海之中。

背包客们正在追寻的追云地点，必须首先提到巴位国家公园，它是首都河内的绿肺，最美的是黎明到来时，游客可以欣赏朝阳下的风景，或是雨后云雾缭绕、如画般的景象。

巴位国家公园不同于首都或其他城市的旅游景点，从前一天傍晚到次日约9点，这里的气温相对凉爽，有时甚至带着寒意，清新的空气非常适合追云和观光，尤其是巴位国家公园的度假之旅。

四月至十月前往巴位是避暑的好去处，因为巴位风景优美、天气凉爽，这也是游客沉浸在云海中并拍下美照的机会。

许多喜欢拍照打卡以获得美照的游客，凌晨3点就前往巴位国家公园观看日出，这也是许多年轻人在 前往 河内旅游时选择拍照的时间。

从河内市中心前往巴位国家公园，游客可以沿升龙大道方向或经32号国道前往，或者如果游客乘坐公交车，从美亭出发乘坐74路、71路，最后换乘110路前往巴位国家公园。

posts.title: Discover the beauty of Van Trinh cave Ninh Binh
posts.excerpt: Discover the beauty of Van Trinh cave Ninh Binh, visitors feel like they are lost in the middle of a magical maze, the scenery of mountains and rivers is a charming and poetic scene. In addition, visi
posts.contentHtml:
Discover the beauty of Van Trinh cave Ninh Binh, visitors feel like they are lost in the middle of a magical maze, the scenery of mountains and rivers is a charming and poetic scene. In addition, visitors can also experience a cruise to admire the poetic scenery.

Van Cave is located halfway up the mountain with a charming and poetic landscape. From the cave entrance, visitors can gaze out at the wild beauty of the mountains and forests, peaceful rivers, or golden rice fields.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ninh Binh, visitors should visit Van Cave to feel its own beauty. The cave is likened to a maze with stalactites stacked on top of each other in strange animal shapes, very eye-catching.

Inside the cave, visitors will feel the cool climate, with beautiful stalactites, visitors can take souvenir photos, next to the magical shimmering stalagmites, with vivid stalactites shaped like bamboo shoots, or strange animals.

The stalactites look like a flea market from afar, or sitting gods, or chess boards with images of gods playing chess, or the shape of water drops…

Traveling to Van Trinh Cave in which season is the best

If this is your first time in Ninh Binh, visit Van Trinh Cave to feel the natural beauty that nature has bestowed upon Ninh Binh. Inside Van Trinh Cave, there are small caves such as Thien Ha Cave, Tien Ca Cave, Vai Gioi Cave… which are some of the most beautiful caves in Ninh Binh.

Visiting the most beautiful cave every summer, this is also the peak season of Ninh Binh, and this is also the lotus blooming season, visitors will be delighted to admire the beauty of the lotus flowers blooming, spreading their fragrant scent in the wind, and this is also the most beautiful moment for visitors to visit Ninh Binh.

In addition, if you are a person who likes sightseeing, you should travel to Ninh Binh in the spring, the season of many vibrant festivals and is very suitable for visitors to visit, because the spring weather is very cool and it is also the occasion for visitors to visit the temples in the early spring, praying for a healthy and peaceful new year.

However, to explore the beauty of the caves, you should travel to Ninh Binh in the summer, when the weather in the North is hot, but when you enter the cave, it will bring you cool air, and explore the natural beauty that nature has bestowed on Ninh Binh.

What to eat when traveling to Van Trinh cave, Ninh Binh?

Kim Son vermicelli with meatballs

White and chewy vermicelli, with crispy meatballs, often eaten with raw vegetables such as bean sprouts, sliced ​​banana leaves, basil, Vietnamese balm, etc., along with a famous aromatic broth, especially in the early morning in the cold weather, enjoy a hot bowl of vermicelli, there is nothing more interesting.

Ant egg sticky rice

This dish is sought after by many diners, the ant eggs here are taken by the locals from the limestone mountains so they are very fresh and delicious, combined with grilled sticky rice to create a famous specialty.

Fish stewed with a coconut shell

The name of fish stewed with a coconut shell is no longer strange to anyone, however, the dish of Fish stewed with a coconut shell is sought after by many tourists, the fish stewed with a coconut shell and enjoyed with hot rice is nothing more interesting.

Mountain goat meat

A specialty that is no longer strange to anyone, goat meat is processed into many different dishes such as: Raw goat with lemon leaves, stir-fried and grilled, or used for hot pot, all of which have their own delicious flavors.

Crispy rice

A specialty that is not only enjoyed when having the opportunity to set foot here, but visitors also buy it as a gift for friends and relatives.

So when coming to Ninh Binh tour, visitors not only visit Trang An eco-tourism area, Tam Coc – Bich Dong tourist area, Cuc Phuong national park, Van Long lagoon… but also visit unique caves, the most prominent of which is Van Trinh cave, a masterpiece that nature has bestowed upon this place.
posts.excerptZh: 探索宁平云景洞（Van Trinh）之美，游客仿佛迷失在神奇的迷宫之中，山水风光迷人而富有诗意。此外，游客还可以体验乘船欣赏如诗如画的风景。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
探索宁平云景洞（Van Trinh）之美，游客仿佛迷失在神奇的迷宫之中，山水风光迷人而富有诗意。此外，游客还可以体验乘船欣赏如诗如画的风景。

云洞（Van）位于半山腰，风景迷人而富有诗意。从洞口，游客可以眺望山林的原始之美、宁静的河流或金色的稻田。

如果您有机会 前往宁平旅游，游客应该参观云洞，感受它独有的美。这个洞穴被比作迷宫，钟乳石层层叠叠，形成奇特的动物形状，非常引人注目。

洞内，游客会感受到凉爽的气候，有美丽的钟乳石，游客可以拍照留念，旁边是神奇闪烁的石笋，还有形似竹笋或奇特动物的生动钟乳石。

远远望去，这些钟乳石好似一个跳蚤市场，或是端坐的神仙，或是神仙对弈的棋盘，又或是水滴的形状……

什么季节去云景洞旅游最好

如果这是您第一次来宁平，请参观云景洞，感受大自然赐予宁平的自然之美。云景洞内有小洞，如天下洞（Thien Ha）、仙瓜洞（Tien Ca）、天界洞（Vai Gioi）……这些是宁平最美的洞穴之一。

每年夏天参观这个最美的洞穴，这也是宁平的旺季，也是荷花盛开的季节，游客将欣赏盛开的荷花之美，荷香随风飘散，这也是游客参观宁平最美的时刻。

此外，如果您喜欢观光，应该在春季前往宁平旅游，这是许多热闹节庆的季节，非常适合游客参观，因为春天的天气非常凉爽，也是游客在早春参拜寺庙、祈求新的一年健康平安的时机。

不过，要探索洞穴之美，您应该在夏季前往宁平旅游，此时北部天气炎热，但进入洞内会带给您凉爽的空气，并探索大自然赐予宁平的自然之美。

前往宁平云景洞旅游吃什么？

金山（Kim Son）肉丸米粉

洁白而有嚼劲的米粉，配上酥脆的肉丸，通常搭配豆芽、香蕉叶丝、罗勒、越南香脂叶等生菜食用，再加上著名的香浓汤底，尤其是在清晨寒冷的天气里，享用一碗热气腾腾的米粉，没有比这更有趣的了。

蚂蚁蛋糯米饭

这道菜受到许多食客的追捧，这里的蚂蚁蛋是当地人从石灰岩山上采集的，因此非常新鲜美味，与烤糯米结合，成为著名的特产。

椰壳炖鱼

椰壳炖鱼之名对任何人来说都不再陌生，不过，椰壳炖鱼这道菜受到许多游客的追捧，椰壳炖鱼配热米饭享用，没有比这更有趣的了。

山羊肉

一种对任何人来说都不再陌生的特产，羊肉被加工成许多不同的菜肴，例如：柠檬叶生羊肉、爆炒和烧烤，或用于火锅，都各有其美味。

锅巴

这种特产不仅有机会踏足此地时可以享用，游客也会买来作为礼物送给亲友。

因此，来到 宁平旅游时，游客不仅参观长安（Trang An）生态旅游区、三谷 – 碧洞（Tam Coc – Bich Dong）旅游区、菊芳国家公园（Cuc Phuong）、云龙湿地（Van Long）……还可以参观独特的洞穴，其中最突出的是云景洞，这是大自然赐予这片土地的杰作。

posts.title: Visit the beauty of Da Chong Mountain
posts.excerpt: The peak of Da Chong Mountain has a unique shape, with stone slabs stacked on top of each other, especially the rocky outcrop jutting out over the edge of the cliff, which is a check-in spot that many
posts.contentHtml:
The peak of Da Chong Mountain has a unique shape, with stone slabs stacked on top of each other, especially the rocky outcrop jutting out over the edge of the cliff, which is a check-in spot that many tourists visit when they have the opportunity to come to Ha Long.

Currently, the peak of Da Chong Mountain is an attractive destination, especially for tourists who love to explore new things and conquer the majestic heights that nature has bestowed upon this place.

Located at an altitude of hundreds of meters above sea level, but the peak of Da Chong Mountain has its own beauty, and is a destination chosen by many tourists when traveling to Ha Long. Coming here, visitors will encounter a unique beauty because the stone slabs are stacked quite high, which is a virtual living spot chosen by many tourists.

The precariously stacked stone slabs create a unique feature, from above, visitors can see the entire beauty of Ha Long city from above, surrounded by mountain ranges or immense pine forests.

In addition, Da Chong mountain is also associated with fairy tales or places such as Khe Mung, Khe Lieu, Phuong Hoang mountain… is one of the sacred mountains of the Dao Thanh Y people, Bang Ca commune.

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour Ha Long, visitors should visit Da Chong mountain to visit, enjoy and listen to thrilling stories from the elders here.

To fully admire the beauty of Da Chong mountain, visitors should go to Bang Ca commune, then take a boat across the lake, go to Khe Mung and swim in the cool water. This is a destination for young people who love adventure travel and want to conquer heights, crossing the Su Tu rock mountains to the top of Chong mountain, visitors will be satisfied with the beauty of Ha Long from above.

After the rains, there will be beautiful clouds, as if wanting to embrace the scenery of the immense pine forest surrounding Yen Lap lake like a fairyland, a unique beauty that attracts backpackers.

Especially when conquering Da Chong mountain peak, visitors can also take beautiful pictures, in the middle of the fairyland, no matter what angle they stand from, visitors can still take beautiful pictures.

It is worth noting that to reach Da Chong mountain peak, visitors should prepare good health, when going down the boat, choose a boat that is qualified to move on the lake and wear a life jacket, and bring food and drinks because the route you conquer is a route without shops.
posts.excerptZh: Da Chong 山峰形状独特，石板层层叠叠，尤其是悬挑在悬崖边缘的岩石，是许多游客来到下龙湾时必去的打卡点。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
Da Chong 山峰形状独特，石板层层叠叠，尤其是悬挑在悬崖边缘的岩石，是许多游客来到下龙湾时必去的打卡点。

如今，Da Chong 山峰已成为一个极具吸引力的目的地，尤其适合热爱探索新事物、渴望征服大自然赋予这片土地的雄伟高峰的游客。

Da Chong 山峰海拔数百米，却自有其独特之美，是许多游客 前往下龙湾旅游时的选择。来到这里，游客会邂逅独特的景致，因为石板堆叠得相当高，是许多游客选择的“虚拟”拍照胜地。

摇摇欲坠般堆叠的石板形成了独特的景观，从高处俯瞰，游客可以将整个下龙市的美景尽收眼底，四周群山环绕，或是一望无际的松林。

此外，Da Chong 山还与神话传说以及 Khe Mung、Khe Lieu、Phuong Hoang 山等地相关联……是 Bang Ca 乡 Dao Thanh Y 族人的神山之一。

如果您有机会参加 下龙湾旅游团，建议游览 Da Chong 山，参观游览，并聆听这里长辈们讲述的惊险故事。

要全面欣赏 Da Chong 山的美景，游客应前往 Bang Ca 乡，然后乘船渡过湖面，前往 Khe Mung 在清凉的溪水中游泳。这里是热爱冒险旅行、渴望征服高峰的年轻人的目的地，穿越 Su Tu 岩石山脉登上 Chong 山山顶，游客将从高处饱览下龙湾之美，心满意足。

雨后会出现美丽的云海，仿佛想要拥抱环绕 Yen Lap 湖的无边松林美景，宛如仙境，这种独特的美吸引着背包客。

尤其是征服 Da Chong 山峰之后，游客还可以拍出美丽的照片，置身仙境之中，无论站在哪个角度，都能拍出好看的照片。

值得注意的是，要登上 Da Chong 山峰，游客应保持良好的身体状况；下船时，请选择具备湖上航行资质的船只并穿好救生衣，同时自带食物和饮水，因为您要征服的路线沿途没有商店。

posts.title: Da Nang International Fireworks Festival
posts.excerpt: The 2024 Da Nang International Fireworks Festival will take place in June and July, with the theme "Made in Unity – Global Connection – Radiant Five Continents", promising to bring visitors a special
posts.contentHtml:
The 2024 Da Nang International Fireworks Festival will take place in June and July, with the theme “Made in Unity – Global Connection – Radiant Five Continents”, promising to bring visitors a special event, with special performances in the sky, always captivating people.

This year’s Da Nang Fireworks Festival takes place in the summer, and this is also an event marking 12 years of organizing a vibrant fireworks program in the coastal city.

posts.title: Quang Phu Cau incense village half day tour
posts.excerpt: With Vietlook Travel, visit Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, located right on the outskirts of Hanoi, one of the hundreds of years old craft villages. Currently, Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is an attr
posts.contentHtml:
With Vietlook Travel, visit Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, located right on the outskirts of Hanoi, one of the hundreds of years old craft villages. Currently, Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is an attractive destination for tourists from all over the world to visit and check in, with colorful bundles of incense arranged in many different shapes, or colorful flowers.

From the capital Hanoi, visitors to Quang Phu Cau Incense Village only need to spend half a day to enjoy visiting and taking pictures, or experience the way of making incense with the locals here, which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Although half a day is not quite long, it is enough for visitors to visit and check in next to the scenery of Quang Phu Cau Incense Village.

Detailed schedule for a half-day tour of Quang Phu Cau Village

8:00: Pick up guests at the hotel or Hanoi Opera House, depart to visit Quang Phu Cau Incense Village.

9:15- 9:30: Arrive at Quang Phu Cau village, visitors walk around the incense village, watch local people make incense through the stages of cutting bamboo, dipping sticks in dye, creating incense powder and drying incense under the sun… visitors can interact with local people to learn about the history of incense making in the village. Visitors are free to walk around the village to take pictures of incense bundles, the incense making process, with incense bundles arranged in the shape of flowers, different images that look very eye-catching…

11:00: The car takes visitors back to Hanoi, arriving at the original pick-up point around 12:15. End of the 1/2 day Quang Phu Cau Incense Village tour, see you again in the next journey with Vietlook Travel.
posts.excerptZh: 与 Vietlook Travel 一起参观位于河内郊区的广富旧（Quang Phu Cau）香村，这是拥有数百年历史的手工艺村之一。目前，广富旧香村是吸引世界各地游客参观打卡的迷人目的地，成束的香排列成多种不同的形状，或五颜六色的花朵。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
与 Vietlook Travel 一起参观位于河内郊区的广富旧（Quang Phu Cau）香村，这是拥有数百年历史的手工艺村之一。目前，广富旧香村是吸引世界各地游客参观打卡的迷人目的地，成束的香排列成多种不同的形状，或五颜六色的花朵。

从首都河内出发，游览 广富旧香村 的游客只需花半天时间即可参观拍照，或与这里的当地人一起体验制香的方法，将给游客带来兴奋的感觉。

虽然半天时间不算太长，但足以让游客参观并在广富旧香村的风景旁打卡。

广富旧村半日游详细行程

8:00：在酒店或河内歌剧院接客人，出发前往参观广富旧香村。

9:15- 9:30： 抵达广富旧村，游客在香村里漫步，观看当地人经过砍竹、蘸染料、制作香粉和在阳光下晒香等工序制香…游客可以与当地人互动，了解村里制香的历史。游客可自由在村里走动，拍摄成束的香、制香过程，成束的香被摆放成花朵形状、不同图案，看起来非常醒目…

11:00：汽车载游客返回河内，约12:15抵达原接客点。广富旧香村半日游结束，期待在下一次旅程中与 Vietlook Travel 再会。

posts.title: Unique check-in point at Gieng Troi Da Nang
posts.excerpt: Located in Ba Na – Nui Chua conservation area, but the road to Gieng Troi is quite difficult and arduous, but in return, this place brings a wild beauty, with clear blue water in the middle of the for
posts.contentHtml:
Located in Ba Na – Nui Chua conservation area, but the road to Gieng Troi is quite difficult and arduous, but in return, this place brings a wild beauty, with clear blue water in the middle of the forest, a camping spot sought after by many backpackers.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang, visit Ba Na scenic area, visit Gieng Troi, a wild landscape, a destination for tourists who love nature, especially those who enjoy outdoor activities such as trekking, mountain climbing, camping or bathing in streams.

To reach Gieng Troi from Ba Na parking lot, visitors will conquer 7km of winding steep mountain passes, cross the stream through the forest, through the slopes, visitors will encounter a cool green stream pouring down from above, looking beautiful like a love story in the middle of the mountains and forests.

If you travel to Da Nang in the summer, you can not only immerse yourself in the clear blue water of the sea and islands, but also enjoy camping or sitting by the cool water of the Da Nang Sky Well, the most beautiful place to hide from the sun on weekends.

Sky Well is the meeting place of two streams from the western area of ​​Ba Na, forming an alley and creating a canyon from above, overlapping like a love song between the mountains and forests.

The waterfall from above pours down at night, creating white foam, visitors coming here can sit on a rock to check in for themselves a beautiful picture next to the cool blue water.

The water flows down to form a large stream, creating a beautiful picture that captivates travelers. When the hot summer weather comes to Sky Well, visitors will immerse themselves in the cool water, as if to dispel all the worries of life in the bustling city.

So it can be said that when coming to Gieng Troi, visitors will feel the pristine beauty, and record for themselves beautiful pictures with the beautiful natural scenery, especially when sitting on the rock with feet in the cool water, a beautiful scene.
posts.excerptZh: 位于巴拿-Nui Chua自然保护区，前往天井（Gieng Troi）的路相当艰难辛苦，但作为回报，这里带来野性之美，森林中央有清澈碧蓝的水，是许多背包客追捧的露营地。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
位于巴拿 – Nui Chua自然保护区，前往天井（Gieng Troi）的路相当艰难辛苦，但作为回报，这里带来野性之美，森林中央有清澈碧蓝的水，是许多背包客追捧的露营地。

如果有机会 前往岘港旅行，参观巴拿景区，游览天井这一野性的风景，是喜爱自然的游客的目的地，尤其是喜欢徒步、登山、露营或溪中沐浴等户外活动的人。

从巴拿停车场前往天井，游客将征服7公里蜿蜒陡峭的山路，穿过林中的溪流，翻过山坡，将遇到从上方倾泻而下的清凉绿色溪流，在山林中央看起来美得像一个爱情故事。

如果您在夏季前往岘港旅行，不仅可以沉浸在大海和岛屿的清澈碧水中，还可以在岘港天井清凉的水边露营或闲坐，这是周末避暑的最美之地。

天井是巴拿西部地区两条溪流的交汇处，形成一条小巷，并从上方形成峡谷，层层叠叠，宛如山林之间的一首情歌。

从上方倾泻而下的瀑布在夜晚形成白色的水沫，来到这里的游客可以坐在岩石上，在清凉的碧水旁为自己打卡留下一张美丽的照片。

水流而下形成一条大溪，创造出迷人的美景，令旅行者着迷。当炎热的夏季天气来到天井，游客将沉浸在清凉的水中，仿佛驱散了繁忙城市生活的所有烦恼。

因此可以说，来到天井，游客将感受到原始之美，并与美丽的自然风光一起为自己留下美丽的照片，尤其是坐在岩石上将双脚浸在清凉的水中，是一幅美丽的景象。

posts.title: Experience sleeping in a tent in the sea of ​​clouds of Ta Xua
posts.excerpt: In the early morning, visitors will be immersed in the sea of ​​clouds covering the mountain ranges or on the back of the dinosaur, visitors will blend in with the dawn on the plateau, a beautiful pic
posts.contentHtml:
In the early morning, visitors will be immersed in the sea of ​​clouds covering the mountain ranges or on the back of the dinosaur, visitors will blend in with the dawn on the plateau, a beautiful picture.

When traveling to Ta Xua, visitors should visit the scenic spot Dinosaur’s Back, many visitors choose to stay at a homestay, or set up a tent right on the back of the dinosaur to watch the sea of ​​clouds floating in the misty fog in the early morning.

The most beautiful thing is to welcome the sunrise on the back of the dinosaur with the sea of ​​clouds floating, many young people when traveling to Ta Xua often bring camping gear to sleep here overnight to watch the scenery of the sea of ​​clouds floating.

In the evening, if visitors camp overnight, remember to set up before 4:00 p.m., because the weather here often gets dark early, the climate of Ta Xua is quite cold at night, if you set up a tent, you should set it up firmly because the wind here is quite strong.

After a cool night, around 4-5am, visitors just open the tent door to enjoy the cool breeze and admire the beautiful scenery in the misty fog.

If you are planning to travel to Ha Giang, visit Ta Xua to admire the beautiful scenery, however, to enjoy hunting clouds in Ta Xua or admire the ripe rice color, visitors should go at the end of the year or the ripe rice color to be satisfied with the scenery of hunting clouds.

However, at the end of the year, when traveling to Ha Giang, visitors can also immerse themselves in the beauty of the purple buckwheat flower season, from the high altitude, visitors can see the beauty of the mountain ranges, winding mountain passes, corn fields or villages hidden in the misty fog.

Many visitors when camping in Ta Xua share that sleeping in a tent overnight is truly an unforgettable experience, on days when clouds cover the valleys, and can block the dawn, looking far away you will see the undulating mountain ranges.

Currently, the dinosaur spine is a cloud hunting spot sought after by many backpackers, a place to admire the magical sea. To be satisfied with the clouds, you should go from October to April of the following year, and the most beautiful is at the end of the year when the weather is hot, visitors will be afraid of showers or avoid floods in the highlands.

There are days when the clouds are thick from early morning to noon (10-11am), the clouds have not yet cleared, visitors will be satisfied with watching the clouds, if the day has less clouds, visitors can admire the scenery of the green mountains, the stilt houses nestled next to the mountains, the innocent children playing – A picture of the highlands.
posts.titleZh: 体验闲巴云海帐篷露营
posts.excerptZh: 清晨，游客将沉浸在笼罩山脉的云海之中，或置身于恐龙脊背之上，与高原上的黎明融为一体，宛如一幅美丽的画卷。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
清晨，游客将沉浸在笼罩山脉的云海之中，或置身于恐龙脊背之上，与高原上的黎明融为一体，宛如一幅美丽的画卷。

前往茶舍（Ta Xua）旅行时，游客应参观景点恐龙脊背（Dinosaur’s Back），许多游客选择住在民宿，或直接在恐龙脊背上搭帐篷，清晨观赏漂浮在薄雾中的云海。

最美的莫过于在飘浮着云海的恐龙脊背上迎接日出，许多年轻人前往茶舍旅行时常带着露营装备在此过夜，观赏云海飘浮的景色。

傍晚，如果游客在此露营过夜，记得在下午4点前搭好帐篷，因为这里的天色通常黑得早，茶舍夜间气候相当寒冷，搭帐篷时应搭牢固，因为这里的风相当大。

度过凉爽的一夜之后，凌晨4–5点左右，游客只需打开帐篷门，即可享受凉爽的微风，欣赏薄雾中的美丽风景。

如果您正计划 前往河江旅行，参观茶舍欣赏美景，不过，要在茶舍享受追云或欣赏稻谷成熟的色彩，游客应在年底或稻谷成熟的季节前往，才能满意地欣赏追云的风景。

不过，年底前往河江旅行时，游客还可以沉浸在紫色荞麦花季的美景中，从高处，游客可以看到连绵的山脉、蜿蜒的山口、玉米地或隐藏在薄雾中的村庄。

许多在茶舍露营的游客分享说，在帐篷里过夜确实是一次难忘的体验，在云雾笼罩山谷、甚至遮住黎明的日子里，向远处望去，您将看到起伏的山脉。

目前，恐龙脊背是许多背包客追捧的追云地点，是欣赏神奇云海的地方。要看够云海，应在10月至次年4月前往，最美的是在年底，此时天气炎热，游客会担心阵雨或避开高原的洪水。

有些日子，云层从清晨到中午（10-11点）都很厚，云雾尚未散去，游客可以尽情观赏云海；如果当天云少，游客可以欣赏青山的风景、依山而建的吊脚楼、天真的孩子们嬉戏的场景——一幅高原画卷。

posts.title: Top 10 festivals taking place in Da Nang
posts.excerpt: Top 10 festivals taking place in Da Nang will bring you the feeling of autumn during the holidays, in the coastal city of Central Vietnam. When talking about Da Nang festivals, you cannot help but men
posts.contentHtml:
Top 10 festivals taking place in Da Nang will bring you the feeling of autumn during the holidays, in the coastal city of Central Vietnam.

When talking about Da Nang festivals, you cannot help but mention the fireworks festival, street festival, village festival, boat racing festival… so let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the special festivals taking place in Da Nang during the year right below.

Da Nang International Fireworks Festival

This is one of the big festivals, often taking place during holidays or major events of the year, with many exciting programs taking place on the banks of the Han River.

In addition, there are many big activities such as: Art exhibitions, culinary festivals, or big music nights, visitors will be melodious with the music, if you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang at this time, visitors will immerse themselves in the exciting festival in the coastal city.

Quan The Am Festival

The festival usually takes place in early spring, that is, in the second lunar month every year. This is also an occasion to attract people and tourists from all over to attend at the Ngu Hanh Son scenic area. The festival is also an occasion for everyone to show their respect and pray for a new year of peace, happiness, favorable weather, and bountiful harvests.

In addition to the festival, visitors can also participate in many interesting games such as: sports-cultural activities, folk games such as throwing con, singing tuong, sculpture, releasing flower lanterns, etc.

Cau Ngu Festival

The festival usually takes place on January 14 every year, demonstrating the culture of fishermen in coastal areas. The festival includes traditional rituals and folk games, cultural arts, and sports…

An Hai Village Festival

The festival usually takes place in An Hai Tay Ward, Son Tra District, the festival lasts for 1 week. The festival includes the parasol procession, flag procession… and the four sacred animals boat race, visitors will join the locals in cheering.

Shepherd Procession Festival

As one of the festivals that many tourists visit, the festival usually takes place in the third lunar month every year, visitors coming here can not only worship the village’s mascot but also admire the innocent boys and girls playing in the fields.

Tuy Loan Village Festival

The festival takes place at Tuy Loan village communal house, the festival takes place in January, the festival includes the procession of royal decrees, offering incense to the communal house to commemorate the ancestors who founded Tuy Loan village. Coming to Da Nang tour during the festival, visitors can also participate in folk cultural games such as: Banh Tet wrapping competition, tug of war, bamboo pole dancing, …

Hoa My Village Festival

The festival usually takes place on January 12 every year, including rituals and traditional culture of the village, the festival also has folk games such as: Hoa My Village Festival, flower arrangement competition, health exercises for the elderly …

Boat racing festival

Usually takes place in January every year, with participating teams from all neighboring provinces of the Central region, on dragon boats decorated very eye-catching, in the cheers of the people and tourists will bring tourists the most interesting vacation in Da Nang.

Festivals in Ba Na Hills

Ba Na is the place where many exciting festival events take place such as: Flower Festival, Carnival, Winter Festival… and many more attractive festivals are waiting for visitors to discover.

Street Festival

Usually taking place in the summer, coming here on this occasion, visitors can also join in the atmosphere of the festival, dress up as famous characters and enjoy the melodious music, which will bring visitors an interesting vacation in Da Nang city.
posts.excerptZh: 岘港举办的十大节庆将在假期里为您带来秋日的感觉，来到越南中部这座海滨城市。谈到岘港的节庆，不能不提烟花节、街头节、乡村庆典、赛舟节等。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
岘港举办的十大节庆将在假期里为您带来秋日的感觉，来到越南中部这座海滨城市。

谈到岘港的节庆，不能不提烟花节、街头节、乡村庆典、赛舟节… 那么就让我们跟随 Vietlook Travel，一起回顾下面岘港全年举办的特色节庆吧。

岘港国际烟花节

这是规模最大的节庆之一，通常在节假日或全年重大活动期间举行，在韩江两岸举办许多精彩的节目。

此外还有许多大型活动，如：艺术展览、美食节或大型音乐之夜，游客将沉醉于悠扬的音乐中，如果您有机会在这个时候 游览岘港 ，游客将沉浸在这座海滨城市热闹的节庆之中。

观世音节（Quan The Am）

该节庆通常在早春举行，即每年农历二月。这也是吸引各地民众和游客前往五行山（Ngu Hanh Son）景区参加的时机。该节庆也是大家表达敬意、祈求新的一年平安幸福、风调雨顺、五谷丰登的时机。

除了节庆仪式，游客还可以参加许多有趣的游戏，如：体育文化活动、扔 con（抛绣球）、唱 tuong（越南传统戏曲）、雕塑、放花灯等民间游戏。

祭鱼节（Cau Ngu）

该节庆通常在每年1月14日举行，展现了沿海地区渔民的文化。节庆包括传统仪式和民间游戏、文化艺术及体育活动…

An Hai 村庆典

该庆典通常在山茶郡 An Hai Tay 坊举行，持续1周。庆典包括伞队巡游、旗帜巡游… 以及四灵兽赛船，游客将与当地人一起欢呼助威。

牧童巡游节（Shepherd Procession）

作为许多游客前往参观的节庆之一，该节庆通常在每年农历三月举行，来到这里的游客不仅可以参拜村里的吉祥物，还可以欣赏天真无邪的男孩女孩在田野里玩耍。

Tuy Loan 村庆典

该庆典在 Tuy Loan 村亭举行，时间在1月，包括迎接皇家敕令巡游、向村亭上香，以纪念开创 Tuy Loan 村的先祖。 来到 岘港之旅 节庆期间，游客还可以参加民间文化游戏，如：包粽子（Banh Tet）比赛、拔河、竹竿舞…

Hoa My 村庆典

该庆典通常在每年1月12日举行，包括村里的仪式和传统文化，庆典还有民间游戏，如：Hoa My 村庆典、插花比赛、老年人健身操…

赛舟节

通常在每年1月举行，来自中部地区各邻近省份的队伍参加，乘坐装饰得非常夺目的龙舟，在民众和游客的欢呼声中，将为游客带来岘港最有趣的假期。

巴拿山（Ba Na Hills）的节庆

巴拿山是许多精彩节庆活动举办的地方，如：花卉节、嘉年华、冬季节… 还有更多吸引人的节庆等待游客去探索。

街头节

通常在夏季举行，借此时机来到这里，游客还可以融入节庆的气氛，装扮成著名角色，享受悠扬的音乐，将为游客带来岘港市有趣的假期。

posts.title: What is beautiful about Ha Long tourism in September
posts.excerpt: Ha Long will bring visitors interesting experiences, if you are wondering what is beautiful about Ha Long tourism in September, then let’s refer to the full set of Ha Long tourism experiences in Septe
posts.contentHtml:
Ha Long will bring visitors interesting experiences, if you are wondering what is beautiful about Ha Long tourism in September, then let’s refer to the full set of Ha Long tourism experiences in September below with Vietlook.

Reasons why you like to travel to Ha Long in September

In September, Ha Long weather begins to enter autumn, the cool and clear weather is very convenient for tourists’ picnic trips, or interesting Ha Long cruise tours, when gliding through famous landscapes and mysterious caves.

Ha Long tourist attractions in September

Sun World Park

As the leading entertainment area in Ha Long, meeting all the needs of tourists, suitable for all ages, coming here visitors will experience interesting services such as cable cars, or participating in water games that will bring visitors exciting experiences.

Quang Ninh Museum

Coming here, visitors will learn about the historical culture of Quang Ninh. Currently, the museum is a place to display artifacts and images of cultural and historical documents through each period.

Titop Island

With a clear blue beach and white sand, it is very suitable for swimming or participating in games on the sea, it is an indispensable destination when traveling to Ha Long in the summer.

Luon Cave

As one of the small caves, to get here, visitors should experience kayaking through the rocky gorges to climb to visit the beauty of Luon Cave.

Things to note when traveling to Ha Long in September

  • You should bring a wide-brimmed hat and sunglasses when going to the beach
  • You should bring light, airy clothes and things to swim
  • Shoes are also very important for visitors’ beach trips.
  • You should also bring digestive enzymes to prevent when you eat seafood…

So now you probably have your own answer for what is beautiful about a trip to Ha Long in September. Hopefully, with the experiences of traveling to Ha Long in September that Vietlook has just shared above, it will help make your trip perfect.
posts.titleZh: 九月下龙旅游美在哪里
posts.excerptZh: 下龙将为游客带来有趣的体验，如果您想知道 9 月下龙旅游有哪些美景，那就让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起参考下面 9 月下龙旅游的全套经验吧。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
下龙将为游客带来有趣的体验，如果您想知道 9 月下龙旅游有哪些美景，那就让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起参考下面 9 月下龙旅游的全套经验吧。

您喜欢 9 月前往下龙旅游的理由

9 月，下龙的天气开始进入秋季，凉爽晴朗的天气非常方便游客野餐出游，或体验有趣的下龙游轮之旅，在著名的风景和神秘的洞穴之间滑行。

9 月的下龙旅游景点

太阳世界公园（Sun World Park）

作为下龙首屈一指的娱乐区，满足游客的所有需求，适合所有年龄段，来到这里，游客将体验到缆车等有趣的服务，或参与水上游戏，为游客带来刺激的体验。

广宁博物馆

来到这里，游客将了解广宁的历史文化。目前，博物馆是展示各时期文物和文化历史文献图片的场所。

提托岛（Titop Island）

拥有清澈湛蓝的海水和白色的沙滩，非常适合游泳或参与海上游戏，是夏季前往下龙旅游时不可或缺的目的地。

Luon 洞

作为小型洞穴之一，要到达这里，游客应体验划皮划艇穿过岩石峡谷，再攀登参观 Luon 洞之美。

9 月前往下龙旅游的注意事项

  • 前往海滩时，您应携带宽檐帽和太阳镜
  • 您应携带轻薄透气的衣服和游泳用品
  • 鞋子对游客的海滩之旅也非常重要。
  • 您还应携带助消化药物，以预防吃海鲜时…

那么现在，您或许已经有了自己关于 9 月下龙之行有哪些美景的答案。希望通过 Vietlook 上面分享的 9 月前往下龙旅游的经验，能帮助您的旅程更加完美。

posts.title: Top 10 tourist attractions in the suburbs of Hanoi
posts.excerpt: If you are a lover of peaceful spaces, away from the hustle and bustle, then the tourist attractions in the suburbs are the destination for you, let’s check out the attractions below with Vietlook. Du
posts.contentHtml:
If you are a lover of peaceful spaces, away from the hustle and bustle, then the tourist attractions in the suburbs are the destination for you, let’s check out the attractions below with Vietlook.

Duong Lam Ancient Village, Hanoi suburbs

Located about 44km from Hanoi capital, Duong Lam Ancient Village is a destination for tourists who love to explore the beauty of the countryside, with its unique culture, enjoy the peaceful space, and return to ancient culture.

Bat Trang Pottery Village

Although located in the suburbs of Hanoi, this place brings its own beauty, when coming here, visitors will experience how to make pottery, create sophisticated products by hand, guided by artisans, which will bring visitors exciting feelings. In addition, visitors can visit the pottery market, the pottery museum and enjoy the attractive dishes of the local people.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village

Currently a famous virtual living spot that many tourists come to check in, and how to make incense bundles, not only that, the people here also decorate the incense bundles with beautiful images, visitors can take beautiful pictures from any angle, visitors can take beautiful pictures next to the scenery of Quang Phu Cau incense village.

Co Loa Citadel

Located in Dong Anh, Hanoi, about 20km, Co Loa Citadel is a destination with important historical value that attracts tourists to visit, learn about the culture, listen to thrilling stories. There is An Duong Vuong temple, Ngoc Well relic, Ba Chua Am relic, Cao Lo temple, … which preserves precious cultural and historical values ​​and is an indispensable sightseeing spot in the Hanoi tour itinerary.

Gióng Temple

A spiritual tourist destination that many tourists visit when they have the opportunity to set foot in Hanoi, especially in early spring, visitors come here to visit and worship to pray for a healthy and peaceful new year. Coming to Gióng Temple, visitors visit Trinh Temple, Mau Temple, Dai Bi Pagoda, Thuong Temple, Saint Gióng Monument…

Hung Temple

An indispensable destination in the journey to Hanoi, especially on the anniversary of the death of the ancestors, visitors can offer incense to express their respect, and admire the scenery here.

In addition, visitors also visit the resorts on the outskirts of Hanoi, the resorts are designed to be very close to nature, with airy space, especially when traveling to Thien Son Suoi Nga in October, visitors can also immerse themselves in the beauty of wild sunflowers in bloom.

Ba Vi National Park

A destination for tourists who love peace and wild scenery, especially tourists traveling to Ba Vi in groups can experience overnight camping, and participate in interesting family activities that will bring visitors the most perfect vacation.

Huong Tram Ecological Area

Coming here, visitors will not only immerse themselves in nature, admire the magical shimmering scenery, and participate in interesting entertainment programs such as fishing, outdoor BBQ, visitors will have the most enjoyable vacation.

Lynn Times Thanh Thuy

A popular resort for many tourists, coming here visitors will be able to visit and immerse themselves in the natural hot mineral springs, with enthusiastic and professional service that will bring visitors the most perfect vacation.
posts.excerptZh: 如果您热爱远离喧嚣的宁静空间，那么郊区的旅游景点就是为您准备的目的地，让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起看看下面的景点。唐林古村……
posts.contentHtmlZh:
如果您热爱远离喧嚣的宁静空间，那么郊区的旅游景点就是为您准备的目的地，让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起看看下面的景点。

河内郊区的唐林古村（Duong Lam）

唐林古村距河内首都约44公里，是热爱探索乡村之美、感受独特文化、享受宁静空间并回归古老文化的游客的目的地。

钵场陶瓷村（Bat Trang）

虽然位于河内郊区，这里却自有一番美景，来到这里，游客将在工匠的指导下体验制作陶器，亲手制作精致的产品，带给游客愉快的感受。此外，游客还可以参观陶瓷市场、陶瓷博物馆，品尝当地人的美味小吃。

Quang Phu Cau 香村

目前是许多游客前来打卡的著名“虚拟”拍照胜地，这里有制作线香束的工艺，不仅如此，这里的人们还用美丽的图案装饰线香束，游客从任何角度都能拍出好看的照片，可以在 Quang Phu Cau 香村的风景旁拍出美照。

古螺城（Co Loa Citadel）

古螺城位于河内东英（Dong Anh），距离约20公里，是具有重要历史价值的目的地，吸引游客前来参观、了解文化、聆听惊心动魄的故事。这里有安阳王庙（An Duong Vuong）、玉井（Ngoc Well）遗迹、Ba Chua Am 遗迹、Cao Lo 庙等……保存着珍贵的文化和历史价值，是河内旅游行程中不可或缺的观光点。

扶董祠（Gióng Temple）

这是许多游客有机会踏足河内时参观的精神旅游目的地，尤其是早春时节，游客来到这里参观祭拜，祈求新的一年健康平安。来到扶董祠，游客可以参观 Trinh 祠、Mau 祠、大悲寺（Dai Bi）、Thuong 祠、扶董天王纪念碑等……

雄王庙（Hung Temple）

这是河内之旅中不可或缺的目的地，尤其是在祖先忌日，游客可以上香表达敬意，并欣赏这里的风景。

此外，游客还可以参观河内郊外的度假村，度假村设计得非常贴近自然，空间通透，尤其是10月前往 Thien Son Suoi Nga 旅行时，游客还可以沉浸在野生向日葵盛开的美景中。

巴维国家公园（Ba Vi National Park）

这是热爱宁静和野趣风光的游客的目的地，尤其是结伴前往巴维的游客，可以体验夜间露营，并参与有趣的亲子活动，为游客带来最完美的假期。

Huong Tram 生态区

来到这里，游客不仅可以沉浸在大自然中，欣赏梦幻闪烁的景色，还可以参加钓鱼、户外烧烤等有趣的娱乐活动，让游客度过最愉快的假期。

Lynn Times Thanh Thuy

这是许多游客喜爱的度假胜地，来到这里，游客可以参观并沉浸在天然矿物温泉中，热情专业的服务将为游客带来最完美的假期。

posts.title: Hoa Lu Festival
posts.excerpt: Hoa Lu Festival takes place from the 8th to the 10th of the third lunar month every year. This is a national holiday and also an occasion to commemorate the kings and national heroes Dinh Tien Hoang a
posts.contentHtml:
Hoa Lu Festival takes place from the 8th to the 10th of the third lunar month every year. This is a national holiday and also an occasion to commemorate the kings and national heroes Dinh Tien Hoang and Le Dai Hanh, the festival takes place in the vibrant atmosphere of the ancient capital Hoa Lu

Hoa Lu Festival has been ranked as a national cultural heritage, and is one of the festivals with a long history, about the life, background and career of King Dinh Tien Hoang.

Hoa Lu Ancient Capital Festival began as soon as the Ly Dynasty moved the capital to Thang Long – And on the foundation of Hoa Lu Palace, two temples worshiping King Dinh and King Le were built.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ninh Binh during the festival, you will be immersed in the atmosphere of the festival, with many exciting events such as: Water procession, Incense offering ceremony, Fire procession, Reed flag exercise, Female officer worship, Pulling letters, dragon and unicorn dance, cooking rice and many other performances.

In particular, the festival also has competitions with traditional folk festivals, which will bring visitors exciting experiences during their vacation in Ninh Binh.

The festival takes place with parts such as: Temple opening ceremony, Water procession ceremony, Incense offering ceremony, Fire procession ceremony, Bathing ceremony, Offering ceremony, Palanquin procession, Lantern festival.

The festival includes unique folk games, such as flag reed drill, boat racing, stick dancing, human chess, word arrangement, throwing, Cheo singing competition, wrestling, writing Chinese characters…

Coming here during the festival, visitors will be able to participate in the opening ceremony, flag reed drill ceremony, Thai Binh word arrangement… Attending the festival, there are many young men and women participating, visitors will be immersed in the atmosphere of the festival.

It can be said that Hoa Lu festival is an opportunity to promote Ninh Binh tourism to a large number of domestic and international tourists. During the festival, there is an art exhibition “Non nuoc Ninh Binh”, displaying images and artifacts of Hoa Lu capital, and displaying craft village products, famous specialties of Ninh Binh.

So let’s go on a Ninh Binh tour with Vietlook today to experience the most interesting things, and immerse yourself in the unique festival taking place in Ninh Binh.
posts.excerptZh: 华闾节每年农历三月初八至初十举行。这是一个全国性的节日，也是纪念丁先皇和黎大行等帝王与民族英雄的时刻，节庆在古都华闾热闹的氛围中举行。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
华闾节每年农历三月初八至初十举行。这是一个全国性的节日，也是纪念丁先皇和黎大行等帝王与民族英雄的时刻，节庆在古都华闾热闹的氛围中举行。

华闾节已被列为国家文化遗产，是历史悠久的节庆之一，讲述丁先皇的生平、背景和事业。

华闾古都节庆始于李朝迁都升龙之时——并在华闾宫殿的基础上，建起了祭祀丁王和黎王的两座庙宇。

如果您有机会在节庆期间 前往宁平旅游 ，您将沉浸在节日的氛围中，有许多精彩的活动，如：水祭、上香仪式、火炬游行、旗帜操演、女官祭、拔字、舞龙舞麒麟、煮饭赛等众多表演。

特别是，节庆中还有传统民间节日的比赛，将为游客在宁平度假期间带来精彩的体验。

节庆包括以下部分：开庙仪式、水祭仪式、上香仪式、火炬游行仪式、沐浴仪式、供奉仪式、抬轿游行、灯节。

节庆包含独特的民间游戏，如旗帜操演、赛船、舞棍、人棋、摆字、投掷、嘲剧歌唱比赛、摔跤、书写汉字……

节庆期间来到这里，游客可以参加开幕式、旗帜操演仪式、太平摆字……参加节庆的有许多青年男女，游客将融入节日的氛围。

可以说，华闾节是向大量国内外游客推广宁平旅游的契机。节庆期间还有“宁平山水”艺术展，展示华闾古都的图像和文物，并展示手工艺村产品和宁平著名特产。

所以今天就让我们与 Vietlook 一起参加 宁平之旅 ，体验最有趣的活动，并融入宁平举行的独特节庆。

posts.title: What is beautiful about traveling to Da Nang in August

posts.contentHtml:
What is beautiful about traveling to Da Nang in August is a question that many tourists are interested in, especially those who are coming to the coastal city for the first time, where not only are there famous landscapes, events, and exciting festivals, but visitors can also enjoy famous specialties in the autumn weather.

Da Nang welcomes visitors with beautiful landscapes such as Ba Na, Cu Lao Cham, Ngu Hanh Son or poetic beaches, besides there are also special festivals taking place all year round. However, if this is your first time coming to Da Nang, you will surely wonder what is beautiful about Da Nang in August, to answer that question, let’s find out the detailed content right below today.

The climate in August is relatively cool, it is a destination for travel enthusiasts, although Da Nang often has showers in August, the rain is not too long, so you should check the weather before coming here.

Da Nang is often divided into two distinct seasons, which are the dry season and the rainy season, the rainy season is from August to December, the dry season is from January to July.

If you do not want the hustle and bustle, the crowds, you should not travel to Da Nang in the summer from March to June, this is the peak season of Da Nang, so at the scenic spots you often have to queue and wait quite a long time, and the service costs are also high. If you travel to Da Nang on your own, you should proactively book tickets and rooms early to avoid being out of rooms.

Traveling to Da Nang in the low season from August to December, at this time Da Nang often enters the rainy season, however, you should check the weather in advance to still have a beautiful tour, and this is the low season so the services are often lower, and the scenic spots you also have to queue.

Activities taking place in August in Da Nang

Da Nang International Marathon

Traveling to Da Nang in August, visitors will be able to participate in the Marathon, this is an opportunity for visitors to exercise, challenge themselves and experience the exciting game in the coastal city.

B’estival Beer Festival

This is one of the big festivals taking place on the top of Ba Na, the festival takes place from April 30 to August 31, coming here on this occasion, visitors will join in the atmosphere of the festival with the sun in the music and enjoy giant bottles of beer and rich cuisine.

Helio Summer Festival

The festival takes place at Helio Center night market with many exciting activities, visitors will enjoy many dishes, or fresh seafood dishes, enjoy checking in at the Mediterranean film studio, participate in games with prizes at the carnival game area, … and many interesting games.

Places to visit when traveling to Da Nang in August

Linh Ung Pagoda

Da Nang has 3 pagodas with the same name in one city, Linh Ung Son Tra Pagoda has a majestic statue of Bodhisattva Guanyin, a spiritual tourist destination that many tourists visit.

Ngu Hanh Son

Coming here, visitors will encounter 5 mountains: Kim Son, Moc Son, Thuy Son, Hoa Son and Tho Son, of which Thuy Son is a large limestone mountain and is a tourist destination visited by many tourists, this is also an indispensable destination in the Da Nang tour itinerary.

Da Nang Sky Well

A virtual living spot that many tourists visit, especially those who travel to Da Nang in groups or groups can camp overnight right next to Sky Well to enjoy the cool breeze, and chat about thrilling stories together.

Da Nang Beach

Traveling to Da Nang, the first destination is the sea, the beaches in Da Nang include My Khe Da Nang beach, Non Nuoc Da Nang beach, Bac My An, Nam O beach, … tourists not only immerse themselves in the clear blue water but also participate in exciting games, such as paddle boarding, jet skiing, etc.

The indispensable dishes when traveling to Da Nang are: fresh seafood, grilled spring rolls, Quang noodles, Da Nang vermicelli with fish sauce, pork rolls, Da Nang pancakes, Da Nang beef noodles, Da Nang fish noodles … with the rich flavor of Ha Thanh.

So with the experience of traveling to Da Nang in August that Vietlook just shared above, we hope it will be helpful for your trip, wish you a happy vacation in the coastal city of Da Nang.
posts.excerptZh: 八月去岘港旅游有什么美景，是许多游客关心的问题，尤其是第一次来这座海滨城市的游客。这里不仅有著名的风景、活动和热闹的节庆，游
posts.contentHtmlZh:
八月去岘港旅游有什么美景，是许多游客关心的问题，尤其是第一次来这座海滨城市的游客。这里不仅有著名的风景、活动和热闹的节庆，游客还可以在秋日的天气里品尝著名的特色美食。

岘港以巴拿山、占婆岛、五行山或如诗的海滩等美丽景观迎接游客，此外全年还有各种特色节庆举行。不过，如果您是第一次来岘港，一定会好奇八月的岘港有什么美景，为了回答这个问题，今天就让我们一起来看看下面的详细内容。

八月的气候相对凉爽，是旅游爱好者的目的地，虽然岘港八月经常有阵雨，但雨不会下太久，因此来这里之前应先查看天气。

岘港通常分为两个明显的季节，即旱季和雨季，雨季从八月到十二月，旱季从一月到七月。

如果您不想要喧嚣和拥挤，就不应该在三月至六月的夏季 前往岘港旅游 ，这是岘港的旺季，因此在景点常常需要排队等候很长时间，服务费用也很高。如果您自由行前往岘港，应该主动提前预订门票和房间，以免订不到房。

在八月至十二月的淡季前往岘港旅游，此时岘港通常进入雨季，不过您应提前查看天气，仍然可以拥有一次美好的旅行，而且这是淡季，所以服务价格通常较低，不过景点也需要排队。

岘港八月举行的活动

岘港国际马拉松

八月前往岘港旅游，游客将能够参加马拉松，这是游客锻炼身体、挑战自我并在海滨城市体验精彩赛事的机会。

B’estival 啤酒节

这是在巴拿山顶举行的大型节庆之一，节庆从4月30日持续到8月31日，在此期间来到这里，游客将融入节日氛围，伴着音乐与阳光，享用巨型瓶装啤酒和丰富的美食。

Helio 夏季节

该节庆在 Helio 中心夜市举行，有许多精彩活动，游客将品尝各种美食或新鲜海鲜菜肴，在地中海风格的影视基地打卡，在嘉年华游戏区参加有奖游戏……以及许多有趣的游戏。

八月前往岘港旅游的游览景点

灵应寺

岘港同一座城市里有3座同名的寺庙，其中灵应山茶寺（Linh Ung Son Tra）拥有雄伟的观音菩萨像，是许多游客参观的精神旅游目的地。

五行山

来到这里，游客会遇到5座山：金山、木山、水山、火山和土山，其中水山是一座大型石灰岩山，是许多游客参观的旅游目的地，这里也是 岘港旅游 行程中不可或缺的目的地。

岘港天井

这是许多游客前往的虚拟生活打卡点，尤其是结伴或团体前往岘港的游客，可以在天井旁边露营过夜，享受凉爽的微风，一起聊惊险刺激的故事。

岘港海滩

到岘港旅游，第一个目的地是大海，岘港的海滩包括美溪海滩、Non Nuoc 海滩、Bac My An、Nam O 海滩等，游客不仅可以沉浸在清澈的蓝色海水中，还可以参加精彩的游戏，如桨板、水上摩托等。

到岘港旅游不可错过的美食有：新鲜海鲜、烤春卷、广南面、岘港鱼露米线、猪肉卷、岘港煎饼、岘港牛肉粉、岘港鱼粉……带着河城（Ha Thanh）的浓郁风味。

以上就是 Vietlook 刚刚分享的八月岘港旅游经验，希望对您的行程有所帮助，祝您在海滨城市岘港度过愉快的假期。

posts.title: Visiting Huong Quang Phu Cau Village and Handicraft Village
posts.excerpt: Visiting Huong Quang Phu Cau Village and Handicraft Village, visitors will be able to admire with their own eyes the beauty and meticulous craftsmanship of the skillful hands of the Chuong people, a p
posts.contentHtml:
