Visiting Huong Quang Phu Cau Village and Handicraft Village, visitors will be able to admire with their own eyes the beauty and meticulous craftsmanship of the skillful hands of the Chuong people, a place famous for its thousand-year-old Korean conical hat making craft.

Coming here, visitors will discover the richness and diversity of exquisite products, from bundles of incense arranged in a shape that looks like a flower from afar, a check-in spot that many tourists seek when traveling to Lang Huong Quang Phu Cau. No matter what angle you stand at, visitors can take beautiful photos for themselves, just raise the camera and you will take beautiful photos.

Visiting the handmade process from the lacquer stage or the coatings of the ancient craft village, and the final stage is decorated very delicately, visitors can experience making hats with the people here.

With that eye-catching decoration, it has highlighted the beauty of a traditional craft village. Moreover, when coming here, visitors can also meet the artisans and learn about the unique cultural way of making conical hats of this craft village.

The incense making village has gone through many generations, and is still preserved and developed to this day.

To experience those interesting things, come with Vietlook Travel to Quang Phu Cau incense village today, visitors will be able to visit and explore the most interesting things that this place brings to visitors.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi, visitors should once set foot in Chuong conical hat village to visit and enjoy the scenery of a rustic and simple traditional craft village, but it exudes the unique beauty of a village.

Many visitors who come here have made conical hats with their own hands, with the people here, with the gentle and hospitable people will make visitors not want to leave, and when leaving, they will not forget to come back.

In particular, visitors can use lacquer to make their own hats or paint animal shapes according to their preferences. Many foreign visitors are often very excited to paint lacquer themselves.

It can be said that when coming to the craft village, besides the incense bundles or hats, visitors can also paint lacquer paintings in the shape of animals, and bring them back as souvenirs. It will be very interesting for your trip to visit Quang Phu Cau incense, Chuong village hats, and lacquer villages.
posts.titleZh: 探访广富球香村与手工艺村
posts.excerptZh: 参观 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村和手工艺村，游客将亲眼欣赏到 Chuong 村人巧手的美丽与精细工艺，这里以千年历史的斗笠制作工艺而闻名。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
参观 Huong Quang Phu Cau 村 和手工艺村，游客将亲眼欣赏到 Chuong 村人巧手的美丽与精细工艺，这里以千年历史的斗笠制作工艺而闻名。

来到这里，游客将发现丰富多样的精美产品，从排列成远看像花朵形状的成捆线香，这是许多游客游览 Lang Huong Quang Phu Cau 时寻找的打卡点。无论站在哪个角度，游客都能为自己拍出漂亮的照片，只需举起相机就能拍出美照。

参观从上漆工序或古老手工艺村涂层开始的手工制作过程，最后一道工序装饰得非常精致，游客可以与当地人一起体验制作斗笠。

凭借那夺目的装饰，它凸显了传统手工艺村的美。此外，来到这里，游客还可以会见工匠，了解这个手工艺村制作斗笠的独特文化方式。

制香村已历经许多代人，至今仍在保存和发展。

想要体验这些有趣的事物，今天就跟随 Vietlook Travel 前往 Quang Phu Cau 线香村，游客将能参观并探索这个地方带给游客的最有趣的东西。

如果您有机会前往河内旅游，游客应该来一次 Chuong 斗笠村，参观并欣赏一座质朴简单的传统手工艺村的风光，却散发着一个村落独特的美。

许多来到这里的游客亲手与当地人一起制作了斗笠，温和好客的当地人会让游客不想离开，离开时也不会忘记再回来。

特别是，游客可以用漆制作自己的斗笠，或根据喜好绘制动物造型。许多外国游客往往对亲手涂漆非常兴奋。

可以说，来到手工艺村，除了线香束或斗笠，游客还可以绘制动物形状的漆画，并带回家作为纪念品。参观 Quang Phu Cau 线香、Chuong 村斗笠和漆画村，会让您的旅程非常有趣。

posts.title: Snacks in Ha Long
posts.excerpt: Ha Long not only welcomes visitors with clear blue beaches and beautiful stops, but Ha Long also welcomes visitors with delicious and attractive dishes. Let’s check out the snacks in Ha Long below wit
posts.contentHtml:
Ha Long not only welcomes visitors with clear blue beaches and beautiful stops, but Ha Long also welcomes visitors with delicious and attractive dishes. Let’s check out the snacks in Ha Long below with Vietlook.

Bun be be

This is a famous breakfast dish in Ha Long. Be be is a specialty in Ha Long sea area. The mantis shrimp here has firm and delicious meat. If you have the opportunity to visit Ha Long, enjoy a bowl of be be vermicelli to fully enjoy its own delicious flavor.

Bun cu ky

This is a breakfast dish in Ha Long that many diners choose. Cu ky is small but has big claws. The meat is sweet and fragrant. When eaten with vermicelli, it brings a delicious and attractive flavor.

Eggs, blood stewed with mugwort, this is a nutritious dish that tourists cannot miss when traveling to Ha Long, with the sweetness of blood, the bitterness of mugwort mixed together to create a delicious flavor.

Squid roll cake is a famous specialty of Ha Long, to enjoy this dish, tourists can enjoy it right at the street food stalls, the dish is very attractive and makes tourists remember it forever.

Sea cucumber, crab is processed into many different dishes such as sweet and sour stir-fry, making spring rolls, crab eggs… this is one of the dishes chosen by many diners.

Stir-fried snails: A quite famous snack, especially when night falls, tourists can take a walk to enjoy the dish while admiring the scenery or chatting together, there is nothing more interesting.

Ha Long pearl yogurt, a quite famous dish, especially for young people when they have enjoyed sightseeing, they can sit somewhere to enjoy pearl yogurt while admiring the scenery of the sea and islands.

Nodding Cake

A famous dish in Ha Long, looks like Northern Pho or Southern Banh Uot, the cake is spread very thinly then rolled up, when enjoying, diners will dip it in fish sauce with chicken fat, fried onions, minced meat, chili or khau nhuc… bringing a delicious flavor of its own.

Salt-roasted mantis shrimp

A typical seafood dish of the coastal region, processed very elaborately and accompanied by spices such as: lemongrass, oil, salt, pepper… and through skillful processing will bring diners the delicious flavor of the coastal region.

Geoduck

A dish chosen by many gourmet diners, when enjoying it once, you will forever remember the delicious flavor of geoduck, with a refreshing taste, especially when steamed and mixed with famous aromatic spices, a nutritious dish chosen by many diners when having the opportunity to set foot in Ha Long.

Tien Yen Crocodile

A delicious dish in its own right and can be prepared into many different dishes, including duck and goose, Tien Tien Crocodile meat… all of which bring a unique flavor to the coastal cuisine.

Ha Long Dried Shrimp Floss

This is one of the dishes that many diners not only enjoy but also buy as gifts, with accompanying dishes such as white rice, sticky rice, porridge, bread… many diners still choose to eat with hot white rice as the most attractive.

Cockles

They look like clams but are bigger, and are a nutritious specialty in Quang Ninh. Cockles are used to make many dishes such as: grilled, steamed, cooked in soup, stir-fried with noodles or eaten with vegetables and dipping sauce, or used on drinking tables…

In addition, when talking about Ha Long snacks, visitors should enjoy dishes such as: Not Gu cake, Quang Yen sour sausage, Hoanh Bo sticky rice wine, nem chao, balut, mussel porridge… visitors can enjoy them at markets or roadside eateries, there is nothing more interesting.
posts.excerptZh: 下龙不仅以碧蓝的海滩和美丽的驿站迎接游客，也以美味诱人的菜肴迎接游客。让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起看看下面的下龙小吃。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
下龙不仅以碧蓝的海滩和美丽的驿站迎接游客，也以美味诱人的菜肴迎接游客。让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起看看下面的下龙小吃。

螳螂虾米线（Bun be be）

这是下龙著名的早餐。螳螂虾（be be）是下龙海域的特产。这里的螳螂虾肉质紧实鲜美。如果有机会游览下龙，请品尝一碗螳螂虾米线，充分享受其独特的美味。

沙蟹米线（Bun cu ky）

这是许多食客选择的下龙早餐。沙蟹（cu ky）个头小但螯很大。肉质鲜甜芳香。与米线一起食用，带来美味诱人的风味。

鸡蛋、血块与艾草炖煮，这是游客 游览下龙时不可错过的营养菜肴，血的鲜甜与艾草的微苦融合在一起，形成美味。

鱿鱼卷饼（Chả mực）是下龙著名的特产，要品尝这道菜，游客可以直接在街头小吃摊享用，这道菜非常诱人，让游客永远难忘。

海参、螃蟹被加工成许多不同的菜肴，如糖醋炒、做春卷、蟹卵…这是许多食客选择的菜肴之一。

炒海螺：相当有名的小吃，尤其是在夜幕降临时，游客可以边散步边享用这道菜，边欣赏风景或一起聊天，没有什么比这更有趣了。

下龙珍珠酸奶，一道相当有名的美食，尤其是年轻人在游览观光之后，可以坐在某个地方，一边享用珍珠酸奶，一边欣赏海与岛的风景。

点头饼（Nodding Cake）

下龙的一道名菜，形似北方的河粉或南方的湿米饼，饼被摊得很薄然后卷起，食用时食客会蘸上加了鸡油、炸洋葱、肉末、辣椒或扣肉（khau nhuc）的鱼露…带来独特的美味。

椒盐烤螳螂虾

沿海地区典型的海鲜菜肴，加工非常精细，并配有柠檬草、油、盐、胡椒…等香料，经过熟练的加工将给食客带来沿海地区的美味。

象拔蚌

许多美食家选择的一道菜，品尝一次，您就会永远记住象拔蚌的美味，口感清爽，尤其是蒸熟后拌上著名的芳香香料，是许多食客有机会踏上下龙时选择的营养菜肴。

先安鳄鱼（Tien Yen）

本身就是一道美味，可以做成许多不同的菜肴，包括鸭、鹅、先安鳄鱼肉…都为沿海美食带来独特的风味。

下龙虾松

这是许多食客不仅享用还购买作为礼物的菜肴之一，配有白米饭、糯米饭、粥、面包…等佐餐，许多食客仍然选择配热白米饭食用，觉得最诱人。

蛤蜊（Cockles）

它们看起来像蛤蜊但更大，是广宁一种营养丰富的特产。蛤蜊可做成许多菜肴，如：烧烤、清蒸、煮汤、与面条一起翻炒，或配蔬菜和蘸酱食用，或用于酒桌…

此外，谈到下龙小吃，游客还应享用以下菜肴：Not Gu 饼、广安酸肠、Hoanh Bo 糯米酒、nem chao、鸭仔蛋、贻贝粥…游客可以在市场或路边小店享用，没有什么比这更有趣了。

posts.title: 5-star cruise on Bai Tu Long Bay
posts.excerpt: Experience a cruise on Bai Tu Long Bay, will bring visitors a feeling of excitement when the boat glides through small islands, with undulating limestone ranges creating unique shapes, the most beauti
posts.contentHtml:
Experience a cruise on Bai Tu Long Bay, will bring visitors a feeling of excitement when the boat glides through small islands, with undulating limestone ranges creating unique shapes, the most beautiful is when watching the sunrise from the cruise enjoying the cool breeze from the sea will make visitors remember that scene forever.

Although not as bustling as Ha Long Bay, Bai Tu Long Bay brings a unique beauty, a wild beauty, a quiet and peaceful space, very suitable for tourists who love peace, want to explore the wild beauty.

To experience Bai Tu Long cruise, visitors will depart from Hon Gai passenger port, rest at the cruise waiting room, check in and board the ship

To fully experience the cruise, visitors should take the 2-day 1-night Ha Long tour.

Day 1: Visitors depart from Hanoi, the car and tour guide will take visitors to Hon Gai, wait for the boat to check in and board the ship, and explore the beauty of Bai Tu Long Bay.

The ship takes visitors to visit and experience fun activities at sea such as: Kayaking, visiting Vung Vieng fishing village, at the end of the journey, visitors return to the main ship to rest, or take a cooking class right on the cruise.

Visitors enjoy dinner on the cruise, then freely relax and participate in activities on the cruise in the evening.

Day 2: Visitors wake up early to watch the sunrise on the bay, have breakfast, then the ship takes visitors to visit Thien Canh Son cave – the most beautiful cave in Bai Tu Long Bay.

Visitors return to the main ship, rest and check out of the room, then have a light meal on the cruise and return to Hon Gai, receive luggage and end the 2-day 1-night Bai Tu Long Bay tour.

The cruise has a service for gays on a 5-star cruise, with luxury bedrooms with a beautiful sea view. In addition, visitors can also experience services right on the cruise such as massage, soaking in hot water, or enjoying a cup of coffee watching the special fireworks right on the 4th floor of the cruise.

Especially when experiencing on the cruise, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes with Asian and European flavors prepared by professional chefs from different countries, bringing diners the delicious and attractive taste of the cuisine.

The cruises usually depart from Tuan Chau port and take visitors to visit the bay, when the cruise will take visitors through famous places such as: Ti Top Island, Sung Sot Cave, Thien Cung Cave, Luon Cave, Cua Van Fishing Village, visitors will be able to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

The best cruises on Ha Long Bay, let’s take a look to have the most enjoyable cruise.

Ambassador Cruise:

As one of the luxury 5-star cruises, the luxurious design meets 5-star standards, and the diverse menus will definitely bring you the most perfect vacation.

Paradise Cruise

A 5-star cruise, the cruise always operates with the motto of bringing customers the best choices, perfect service, and a team of professional staff will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation on the 5-star Ha Long cruise.

Margaret Cruise

With an Asian-European design, a 5-star cruise, and full amenities to meet all the needs of visitors, the cruise is currently chosen by many couples.

Pelican Cruise

Although only 4-star standard, Pelican Cruise also brings visitors wonderful experiences when exploring the beauty of the bay.

Stellar Cruise

The cruise meets 4-star standards, is designed in a traditional style with a touch of modernity, with affordable prices and relatively complete services, so many tourists when going on a cruise in Ha Long also choose Stellar Cruise for their vacation.
posts.excerptZh: 体验白龙尾湾游轮之旅，当游船滑过众多小岛，起伏的石灰岩山脉形成奇特的形状，会给游客带来兴奋的感觉，最美的是在游轮上观看日出，享受来自大海的凉爽微风，会让游客永远记住那一幕。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
体验白龙尾湾游轮之旅，当游船滑过众多小岛，起伏的石灰岩山脉形成奇特的形状，会给游客带来兴奋的感觉，最美的是在游轮上观看日出，享受来自大海的凉爽微风，会让游客永远记住那一幕。

白龙尾湾虽然不如下龙湾热闹，却带来独特的美，一种原始的美，安静祥和的空间，非常适合热爱宁静、想探索原始之美的游客。

要体验 白龙尾湾游轮，游客将从鸿基客运港出发，在游轮候船室休息，办理登记并登船

为了充分体验游轮之旅，游客应选择下龙湾2天1夜的行程。

第一天：游客从河内出发，车辆和导游将带游客前往鸿基，等候登船办理登记并上船，探索白龙尾湾之美。

游轮带游客参观并体验海上的趣味活动，如：划皮划艇、参观 Vung Vieng 渔村，行程结束时，游客返回主船休息，或在游轮上参加烹饪课。

游客在游轮上享用晚餐，然后在晚上自由放松并参加游轮上的活动。

第二天：游客早起观赏海湾日出，享用早餐，然后游轮带游客参观天景山洞——白龙尾湾最美的洞穴。

游客返回主船，休息并退房，然后在游轮上享用简餐并返回鸿基，领取行李，结束白龙尾湾2天1夜之旅。

这艘游轮为客人提供5星级游轮服务，拥有可观赏美丽海景的豪华卧室。此外，游客还可以在游轮上体验按摩、泡热水浴，或在游轮4楼一边品尝咖啡一边观赏特别的烟花表演等服务。

尤其是在游轮上体验时，游客还可以享用由来自不同国家的专业厨师烹制的亚欧风味美味诱人的菜肴，为食客带来美食的美味与诱惑。

游轮通常从 Tuan Chau 港出发，带游客游览海湾，游轮将带游客经过著名景点，如：Ti Top 岛、惊讶洞、天宫洞、Luon 洞、Cua Van 渔村，游客将能够欣赏美丽的风景。

下龙湾最好的游轮，让我们一起来看看，选择最愉快的游轮之旅。

大使游轮（Ambassador Cruise）：

作为豪华5星级游轮之一，豪华的设计符合5星标准，多样的菜单一定会带给您最完美的假期。

天堂游轮（Paradise Cruise）

一艘5星级游轮，该游轮一直以为客户带来最佳选择、完美服务为宗旨运营，专业的员工团队将为游客带来5星下龙湾游轮上最愉快的假期。

玛格丽特游轮（Margaret Cruise）

采用亚欧融合的设计，是一艘5星级游轮，配备齐全的设施以满足游客的所有需求，目前深受许多情侣的选择。

鹈鹕游轮（Pelican Cruise）

虽然只有4星标准，但鹈鹕游轮在探索海湾之美时同样为游客带来美妙的体验。

星辰游轮（Stellar Cruise）

该游轮符合4星标准，设计传统中带有现代感，价格实惠，服务相对完善，因此许多游客在下龙湾乘坐游轮时也选择星辰游轮度假。

posts.title: Ninh Binh Travel Experience 3 Days
posts.excerpt: 3 days is not too long but enough for tourists to fully explore the beauty of Ninh Binh, visit famous landmarks and enjoy delicious food. Especially to take beautiful photos. The most beautiful time t
posts.contentHtml:
3 days is not too long but enough for tourists to fully explore the beauty of Ninh Binh, visit famous landmarks and enjoy delicious food. Especially to take beautiful photos.

The most beautiful time to travel to Ninh Binh is from January to March of the lunar calendar. During this time, Ninh Binh is quite beautiful with cool weather, tourists can both visit and go to the temple to pray for good luck and a healthy and peaceful new year.

Traveling to Ninh Binh in early spring, tourists visit the ancient capital of Hoa Lu and immerse themselves in the festival taking place in early spring, a poetic and lyrical scene, in the spring weather.

The first stop on the Ninh Binh tour itinerary must be Mua Cave, this place is most beautiful in the early morning when the sunrise or sunset exudes a beautiful scene.

Mua Cave with its green mossy walls, next to ancient trees hundreds of years old, brings a unique beauty, both ancient and poetic.

The next destination is Co Vien Lau, one of the famous tourist destinations of Trang An, Co Vien Lau is an indispensable destination when having the opportunity to set foot in Ninh Binh. The place still retains the pristine beauty of a rustic village.

Bich Dong Pagoda, a place with both majestic and poetic landscapes, surrounded by towering limestone ranges, visitors can come here to visit, worship the temple, and burn incense to pray for peace.

Hoa Lu ancient town in early spring is sparkling in the light of lanterns, coming here visitors can experience releasing flower lanterns and sending wishes into them to pray for a healthy and happy new year.

To be satisfied with the beauty of Trang An, visitors should spend a session to fully explore the beauty, sit on a boat to admire the beauty and capture beautiful pictures for themselves.

The ancient capital of Hoa Lu is a destination for tourists who love to explore ancient beauty and learn about Vietnamese culture and history.

Tuyet Tinh Coc is a check-in point chosen by many tourists, with a vast blue lake of mountains and forests, visitors can walk through the stone steps and take beautiful pictures during their sightseeing journey at Tuyet Tinh Coc.

The last stop in the spring trip to Ninh Binh is Bai Dinh Pagoda, a pagoda with its own design, large campus, beautiful stupa, visitors can rent an electric car here for convenient sightseeing.

With the experience of traveling to Ninh Binh for 3 days and 2 nights, which Vietlook just suggested above, we hope to help you on your trip, wish you a happy trip.
posts.excerptZh: 3天不算太长,但足以让游客充分探索宁平之美、参观著名地标并享用美食。尤其是拍摄美丽的照片。前往宁平旅行最美的时间是农历1月至3月。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
3天不算太长,但足以让游客充分探索宁平之美、参观著名地标并享用美食。尤其是拍摄美丽的照片。

前往宁平旅行最美的时间是农历1月至3月。此时的宁平天气凉爽,相当美丽,游客既可以游览,也可以去寺庙祈福,祈求新的一年好运、健康平安。

早春前往宁平旅行,游客参观华闾古都并沉浸在早春举行的节日之中,在春日天气里,景象诗情画意。

宁平之旅行程的第一站必须是木洞(Hang Mua),这里在清晨日出或日落时分最美,散发出美丽的景象。

木洞以长满青苔的绿色岩壁和身旁数百年的古树,带来古朴而富有诗意的独特之美。

下一个目的地是古园楼(Co Vien Lau),它是长安著名的旅游目的地之一,当有机会踏足宁平时,古园楼是不可或缺的目的地。这里依然保留着质朴村落的原始之美。

碧洞寺,一个既雄伟又富有诗意的地方,四周是高耸的石灰岩山脉,游客可以来此参观、拜寺、上香祈求平安。

早春的华闾古镇在灯笼的光芒中熠熠生辉,来到这里,游客可以体验放花灯,将心愿寄托其中,祈求新的一年健康快乐。

为了尽享长安之美,游客应该花一个时段充分探索,坐在船上欣赏美景,并为自己留下美丽的照片。

华闾古都是热爱探索古老之美、了解越南文化和历史的游客的目的地。

雪情谷(Tuyet Tinh Coc)是许多游客选择的打卡点,拥有被山林环绕的广阔蓝色湖泊,游客可以沿着石阶漫步,在雪情谷的观光之旅中拍摄美丽的照片。

宁平春季之旅的最后一站是百顶寺,这座寺院设计独特、占地广阔、宝塔优美,游客可以在这里租一辆电瓶车,方便参观游览。

以上是Vietlook刚刚建议的宁平3天2夜旅行经验,希望能对您的旅程有所帮助,祝您旅途愉快。

posts.title: Discover the beauty of Ha Long caves
posts.excerpt: Come with Vietlook Travel to discover the beauty of Ha Long caves, you will feel the natural beauty, with the mysterious and majestic will bring you unique experiences in the island paradise, especial
posts.contentHtml:
Come with Vietlook Travel to discover the beauty of Ha Long caves, you will feel the natural beauty, with the mysterious and majestic will bring you unique experiences in the island paradise, especially in the summer when the weather in the North is hot, Ha Long brings visitors cool spaces, especially when going by boat to explore the beauty of the caves.

Ha Long is not only known for its beautiful stops, but also for its mysterious caves, including Sung Sot Cave, Luon Cave, Dau Go Cave, Trong Cave…

When talking about Ha Long, tourists not only know about the islands hidden in the middle of the ocean, surrounded by high, undulating rocky mountains, but also visit the mysterious caves when traveling to Ha Long.

Sung Sot Cave

The cave is located on Ho Bo Island, a large cave with beautiful stalactites and stalagmites, and there are stalactites that look like beautiful animals.

As one of the limestone caves of Bo Hon Island, Ha Long Bay, Hang Hang Sot consists of 2 main compartments with a short head and a ceiling filled with stalactites that look very unique. To reach the cave, you have to climb 50 stone steps while watching the forest canopy surrounding a peaceful scene.

The second compartment of the cave is one of the wild scenes, however, when going deep inside the cave, you will encounter stone slabs with unique shapes that will make you feel excited.

Luon Cave

The cave has its own beauty, right from the cave entrance, visitors will encounter an unusual beauty, the cave has a very cool arc shape, a beautiful sunny spot on summer days.

To get to the cave, visitors should experience it on a kayak or a small boat, which is an indispensable destination in the summer Ha Long tour itinerary.

Dau Go Cave

The cave is divided into 3 compartments, each compartment exudes its own beauty, with multi-colored rocks, right at the cave entrance there are rays of sunlight shining in, exuding a beauty that brings excitement to visitors.

It can be said that Dau Go Cave is a masterpiece that nature has bestowed upon Ha Long, surrounded by a magnificent space, the cave is located next to Thien Cung Cave. To reach the cave, you have to cross 90 stone steps, inside the cave are stalactites reflecting a unique beauty.

Trong Cave and Trinh Nu Cave

Coming here, visitors not only explore the beauty of the cave but also hear thrilling stories, to get to the cave, visitors will experience it on luxurious Ha Long cruise ships and when entering the cave, visitors will feel the coolness, with colorful stalactites.

Thien Canh Son Cave

The cave is located right in Ha Long Bay and Bai Tu Long, surrounded by wild scenery, inside there are beautiful stalactites, looking like animals, visitors can record beautiful pictures when exploring Ha Long Cave.

Coming here, you will feel the beauty of a fairyland, inside the cave there are unique shaped rocks, looking like lotus flowers or animals, with sparkling stalactites, to reach the cave you have to conquer 100 stone steps, but when you step into the cave, you will see a magnificent beauty that will make you feel amazed.

It can be said that the natural wonder of the world in Ha Long with beautiful stops, and mysterious caves with thrilling stories, inside the cave there are many beautiful stalactites with stalagmites that look like animals. According to the Ha Long tour in the summer, visitors will immerse themselves in the colorful natural picture, and explore the magical beauty of the sea and islands.
posts.excerptZh: 与 Vietlook Travel 一起来探索下龙湾洞穴之美，您将感受到自然之美，神秘而雄伟的景观将为您带来海岛天堂中的独特体验，尤其是在北部天气炎热的夏季，下龙湾为游客带来清凉的空间，特别是乘船探索洞穴之美时。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
与 Vietlook Travel 一起来探索下龙湾洞穴之美，您将感受到自然之美，神秘而雄伟的景观将为您带来海岛天堂中的独特体验，尤其是在北部天气炎热的夏季，下龙湾为游客带来清凉的空间，特别是乘船探索洞穴之美时。

下龙湾不仅以美丽的景点闻名，也以神秘的洞穴著称，包括惊讶洞（Sung Sot）、Luon洞、Dau Go洞、Trong洞……

说起下龙湾，游客不仅知道那些隐藏在大海中央、被高耸起伏的岩石山脉环绕的岛屿，还会在 前往下龙湾旅行时参观神秘的洞穴。

惊讶洞（Sung Sot）

该洞位于Ho Bo岛上，是一个拥有美丽钟乳石和石笋的大洞穴，其中有些钟乳石看起来像美丽的动物。

作为下龙湾Bo Hon岛的石灰岩洞穴之一，惊讶洞由2个主要洞室组成，洞口较短，洞顶布满了看起来非常独特的钟乳石。要到达洞穴，您必须爬50级石阶，同时欣赏环绕四周宁静景色的林冠。

洞穴的第二个洞室是野趣景观之一，不过，深入洞内时，您会遇到形状独特的石板，让您感到兴奋。

Luon洞

这个洞穴拥有自己的美，从洞口开始，游客就会邂逅不寻常的美景，洞呈非常凉爽的弧形，是夏日里一处阳光明媚的好地方。

要到达该洞穴，游客应乘坐皮划艇或小船体验，这是夏季 下龙湾之旅 行程中不可或缺的目的地。

Dau Go洞

该洞穴分为3个洞室，每个洞室都散发着自己的美，岩石五彩斑斓，就在洞口处有阳光照射进来，散发出让游客兴奋的美。

可以说，Dau Go洞是大自然赋予下龙湾的杰作，被宏伟的空间环绕，该洞位于天宫洞（Thien Cung）旁边。要到达洞穴，您必须走过90级石阶，洞内的钟乳石映射出独特的美。

Trong洞和Trinh Nu洞

来到这里，游客不仅探索洞穴之美，还能听到惊险的故事，要到达该洞穴，游客将乘坐豪华的下龙湾游轮体验，进入洞内时，游客会感受到凉爽，看到五彩缤纷的钟乳石。

Thien Canh Son洞

该洞位于下龙湾和白龙尾湾（Bai Tu Long）之间，周围是野趣的风景，洞内有美丽的钟乳石，看起来像动物，游客在探索下龙湾洞穴时可以拍下美丽的照片。

来到这里，您将感受到仙境般的美，洞内有形状独特的岩石，看起来像莲花或动物，钟乳石闪闪发光，要到达该洞穴，您必须征服100级石阶，但当您踏入洞中时，将看到令人惊叹的壮丽之美。

可以说，下龙湾的世界自然奇观拥有美丽的景点和带有惊险故事的神秘洞穴，洞内有许多美丽的钟乳石和看起来像动物的石笋。根据夏季的下龙湾之旅，游客将沉浸在多彩的自然画卷中，探索大海和岛屿的神奇之美。

posts.title: Ky Phuc Festival in Cam Gia Ninh Binh
posts.excerpt: The festival usually takes place on the 12th day of the 10th lunar month every year, at Cam Gia Communal House. This is one of the festivals with its own unique cultural values, imbued with the identi
posts.contentHtml:
The festival usually takes place on the 12th day of the 10th lunar month every year, at Cam Gia Communal House. This is one of the festivals with its own unique cultural values, imbued with the identity of the ancient capital.

Cam Gia Communal House is a sacred place to worship Prime Minister La Gia, Duke Le Trung Nghia, who contributed to the country, and is also a place to worship other gods.

In front of Cam Gia Communal House is a natural crescent lake with clear water all year round, the communal house has the architectural features of the Nguyen Dynasty, in front of the communal house are 2 rows of sacred animals, stone elephants, stone horses, to the right of the communal house is the literary area worshiping Confucius, and the stele house honoring the names of the Doctors.

After going through the resistance war, the communal house is still intact, currently Cam Gia Communal House has been recognized as a provincial historical relic.

The festival is also an opportunity for descendants to express their gratitude and remember the generation of ancestors who founded the village, and to wish for a peaceful and prosperous nation, and for everyone to be warm and happy.

The festival includes 4 ceremonies: the Cao Nieu ceremony, the An prayer ceremony, the incense offering ceremony and the Tat ceremony, with a sacrificial ceremony, a sacrificial ceremony for male and female officials, and is organized solemnly and solemnly, performed through traditional rituals with sincere hearts, in order to preserve the culture of the homeland, in the tray of offerings including sticky rice, pig’s head, betel, wine, fruit…

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ninh Binh in the 10th lunar month, visitors will be immersed in the unique festival, and participate in dragon dances, lion dances, art performances and folk games such as tug of war, human chess… which will bring visitors exciting experiences.

The highlight of the festival is the sticky rice making competition. Every year on the 11th night of the Lunar New Year, people will gather at the village cultural house to organize the cooking and making of sticky rice. When the sticky rice is soft, it will be made into trays and pig heads. One ceremony is held by the people at the cultural house, and the other ceremony is held at the village communal house. On the day, the organizing committee will score and award prizes to the teams.

It can be said that the Ky Phuc Festival is held every year in the early spring of the new year. If you have the opportunity to visit Ninh Binh in the spring, you will be able to immerse yourself in the festival and experience the culture of the Ancient Capital.
posts.excerptZh: 该节日通常在每年农历十月十二日于Cam Gia亭举行。这是拥有独特文化价值的节日之一,浸润着古都的特色。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
该节日通常在每年农历十月十二日于Cam Gia亭(communal house)举行。这是拥有独特文化价值的节日之一,浸润着古都的特色。

Cam Gia亭是供奉丞相La Gia、为国家做出贡献的黎忠义公(Le Trung Nghia)的神圣之地,同时也供奉其他神明。

Cam Gia亭前是一片天然的新月形湖泊,湖水终年清澈,亭子具有阮朝的建筑特色,亭前有2排神兽、石象、石马,亭子右侧是供奉孔子的文庙区,以及铭记进士姓名的碑亭。

经历了抗战之后,亭子依然完好无损,目前Cam Gia亭已被认定为省级历史遗迹。

该节日也是后人表达感恩、缅怀开辟村落的先辈的机会,并祈愿国泰民安,人人温暖幸福。

节日包括4个仪式:告祭(Cao Nieu)仪式、安祈(An)祈祷仪式、上香仪式和Tat仪式,设有祭祀仪式、男女官员祭祀仪式,庄严隆重地举行,以真诚之心通过传统礼仪进行,以保存家乡文化,供品托盘中有糯米饭、猪头、槟榔、酒、水果……

如果您有机会在农历十月前往宁平旅行,游客将沉浸在这一独特的节日中,并参与舞龙、舞狮、艺术表演以及拔河、人棋等民间游戏……这将为游客带来精彩的体验。

节日的亮点是糯米饭制作比赛。每年农历新年的十一日夜晚,人们会聚集在村文化屋,组织煮制和制作糯米饭。糯米饭变软后,将被做成托盘和猪头。一场仪式由人们在文化屋举行,另一场仪式在村亭举行。当天,组委会将为各队评分并颁奖。

可以说,祈福节(Ky Phuc Festival)每年在新年的早春举行。如果您有机会在春季游览宁平,就能沉浸在这一节日中,体验古都的文化。

posts.title: Visiting Cao Bang Tiger Cave
posts.excerpt: Visiting Cao Bang Tiger Cave you will be immersed in the natural beauty with mysterious caves, if you are a lover of fresh air and want to explore natural beauty, then Tiger Cave is the destination fo
posts.contentHtml:
Visiting Cao Bang Tiger Cave you will be immersed in the natural beauty with mysterious caves, if you are a lover of fresh air and want to explore natural beauty, then Tiger Cave is the destination for you.

Cao Bang Tiger Cave still retains its inherent wild beauty, with interesting stalactites inside. Visitors can visit and take beautiful pictures next to the Tiger Cave. Especially when coming here in the summer, you will feel the cool air.

According to the elders, the Tiger Cave means that the cave used to be the habitat of fierce tigers, however, there are also opinions that the Tiger Cave originated from the sound of the stream flowing in the cave, creating a roaring sound like a fierce tiger.

So to experience the truth of that story, let’s travel to Cao Bang with Vietlook to discover the beauty and listen to the mysterious stories about the Tiger Cave. To get here from Cao Bang city, visitors should conquer the Ma Phuc Pass, Khau Lieu Pass, then go to Nguom Ngao Cave.

Nguom Ngao Cave has stalactites with strange animal shapes, is a beautiful place to hide from the sun in Cao Bang, when the weather is right in the summer, when entering the cave, visitors will feel the natural coolness.

Entering the cave, visitors will see strange images like the pink dodder tree, the mother’s milk bottle, the magic toad, the stone guitar… a magical beauty, inside the cave there are slots leading to the sky, a natural beauty that nature has bestowed on Cao Bang.

The highlight in Nguom Ngao Cave is that there are strange shapes like the pink dodder tree, the mother’s milk bottle, the magic toad, the stone guitar, the coral tree and the ship, the golden waterfall, the silver waterfall, the upside-down lotus platform, the lonely stone pillar are enough for visitors to save for themselves beautiful pictures.

All of that beauty is natural without human intervention, here all year round there is the sound of flowing water, to go deep inside visitors have to go by boat with local people, the temperature in the cave only fluctuates between 18 and 25 degrees Celsius.

It can be said that Nguom Ngao cave is a gift that nature has bestowed upon Cao Bang, one of the caves worth visiting, to escape the sun in the summer days, to fully explore the beauty of Cao Bang, visitors only need to go on a 3-day 2-night Cao Bang tour to enjoy visiting the scenic spots, exploring the beauty of the cave or conquering the mountain pass, and enjoying delicious and attractive dishes.

What to eat when traveling to Cao Bang Tiger Cave

Roasted suckling pig

A delicious and nutritious dish, the suckling pig must weigh between 4 and 6 kg, cleaned and roasted with honey leaves, the outside of the pig is brushed with honey and spices, the pig is roasted on a charcoal stove until golden brown, crispy and fragrant with honey leaves.

Xoi tram

A specialty dish of the mountainous region, the sticky rice here is made from upland sticky rice and wild canarium fruit, when cooked the sticky rice has a very eye-catching purple color and the rich taste of canarium fruit…

Banh ap chao

One of the famous cakes in Cao Bang, the inside is made from duck meat, the cake is made from upland sticky rice so it is very sticky and fragrant, after mixing with the filling, it is fried to puff up like a fried cake, golden brown.

Cao Bang rolled rice paper

The rolled rice paper here is eaten with bone broth and minced meat with scallion oil, enjoying the hot cake in the cold weather, there is nothing more interesting.

Da Hien vegetable

This is one of the wild vegetables that grow naturally, the vegetable usually grows a lot from February to July of the lunar calendar, the vegetable is often used in parties. In particular, the vegetable is stir-fried with chicken gizzards, beef gizzards…

7-flavor roasted duck

One of the famous specialties, the cleaned duck is marinated with 7 spices and processed very elaborately, when enjoying it you will feel the unique flavor of Cao Bang.

Tram Huong fish

This is one of the most delicious dishes at Ban Gioc waterfall, after cleaning the fish will be marinated with dill, chili, onion, spices… bcj with banana leaves grilled on a charcoal stove, when enjoying it, diners will feel the sweetness.

So Cao Bang Cao Bang not only welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, winding mountain passes that always challenge drivers, or high rocky mountains undulating in the morning mist, but when coming here, visitors can also freely explore mysterious caves, the most prominent of which is Tiger Cave.
posts.excerptZh: 游览高平老虎洞，您将沉浸在拥有神秘洞穴的自然美景之中，如果您热爱清新的空气并想探索自然之美，那么老虎洞就是适合您的目的地。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
游览高平老虎洞，您将沉浸在拥有神秘洞穴的自然美景之中，如果您热爱清新的空气并想探索自然之美，那么老虎洞就是适合您的目的地。

高平老虎洞依然保留着其固有的原始之美，洞内有趣的钟乳石令人着迷。游客可以参观并在老虎洞旁拍摄美丽的照片。尤其是夏天来到这里，您会感受到凉爽的空气。

据老人们说，老虎洞的名字意味着这个洞穴过去曾是凶猛老虎的栖息地，不过也有观点认为，老虎洞得名于洞中溪水流动的声音，发出如同猛虎咆哮般的轰鸣声。

因此，要体验这个故事的真相，让我们与 Vietlook 一起前往高平，发现这里的美景，聆听有关老虎洞的神秘故事。从高平市前往这里，游客应翻越 Ma Phuc 垭口、Khau Lieu 垭口，然后前往 Nguom Ngao 洞。

Nguom Ngao 洞内的钟乳石形态各异，宛如奇异的动物，是高平夏季避暑的好地方，夏天天气适宜时，进入洞内，游客会感受到天然的清凉。

进入洞中，游客会看到各种奇特的景象，如粉红色的菟丝子树、母乳瓶、神蟾、石吉他…，神奇而美丽，洞内还有通往天空的缝隙，这是大自然赐予高平的天然美景。

Nguom Ngao 洞的亮点在于有各种奇特的形状，如粉红色的菟丝子树、母乳瓶、神蟾、石吉他、珊瑚树与船、金瀑布、银瀑布、倒立莲台、孤独石柱，足以让游客为自己留下美丽的照片。

所有这些美景都是天然形成、没有人为干预，这里全年都有流水的声音，要深入洞内，游客必须与当地人一起乘船前往，洞内的温度仅在 18 至 25 摄氏度之间波动。

可以说，Nguom Ngao 洞是大自然赐予高平的礼物，是值得参观的洞穴之一，可以在夏日躲避烈日。要充分探索高平之美，游客只需参加高平 3 天 2 夜之旅，即可参观名胜景点、探索洞穴之美或征服山口，并品尝美味诱人的菜肴。

游览高平老虎洞吃什么

烤乳猪

一道美味又营养的菜肴，乳猪重量须在 4 至 6 公斤之间，清洗干净后用蜜叶烤制，猪身外面刷上蜂蜜和香料，在炭炉上烤至金黄酥脆，并带有蜜叶的香气。

Xoi tram（紫色糯米饭）

一道山区特色菜肴，这里的糯米用旱地糯米和野生橄榄果制成，煮熟后糯米呈现非常引人注目的紫色，并带有浓郁的橄榄果味…

Banh ap chao（鸭肉煎饼）

高平著名的糕点之一，馅料由鸭肉制成，饼皮用旱地糯米制成，因此非常黏软而香，与馅料拌匀后下锅煎至鼓起，像炸糕一样，呈金黄色。

高平卷粉

这里的卷粉搭配骨头汤和葱油肉末食用，在寒冷的天气里享用热腾腾的米糕，再没有比这更有趣的了。

Da Hien 菜

这是自然生长的野菜之一，这种菜通常在农历二月至七月大量生长，常用于宴席。特别是，这种菜与鸡胗、牛胗…一起爆炒。

七味烤鸭

著名特产之一，将清洗干净的鸭子用 7 种香料腌制，并经过非常精心的加工，品尝时您会感受到高平独特的风味。

Tram Huong 鱼

这是板约瀑布最美味的菜肴之一，鱼清洗后用莳萝、辣椒、洋葱、香料…腌制，再用香蕉叶包裹在炭炉上烧烤，品尝时食客会感受到鲜甜。

高平不仅以著名的风光、始终考验驾驶员的蜿蜒山口、或在晨雾中起伏的高耸岩石山峦迎接游客，来到这里，游客还可以自由探索神秘的洞穴，其中最突出的就是老虎洞。

posts.title: What is beautiful about traveling to Sapa in August
posts.excerpt: What is beautiful about traveling to Sapa in August? is the question that most of you are interested in, especially those who are planning to travel to Sapa in August for the first time, so please ref
posts.contentHtml:
What is beautiful about traveling to Sapa in August? is the question that most of you are interested in, especially those who are planning to travel to Sapa in August for the first time, so please refer to this article before having the opportunity to set foot here.

Sapa has the first showers of the season, this is the time for tourists to trek long distances, on both sides are green terraced fields, tourists will admire the beauty of Sapa in August.

Should I travel to Sapa in August?

If this is your first time in Sapa, you will surely wonder what is beautiful about Sapa in August and should I travel to Sapa in August, however, Sapa in August is quite beautiful with cool weather, a beautiful stopover in every autumn, an interesting stopover in every vacation of tourists, especially the September 2nd holiday in Sapa.

Sapa weather in August

Sapa has light sunny weather in August, and there are sudden showers, so if you go on a tour to Sapa in August, tourists should bring umbrellas in case of sudden rain.

What means of transport to travel to Sapa?

Sapa is located very close to the capital Hanoi, visitors can choose cars, sleeper buses, or young people who like to travel often choose motorbikes, to both travel and admire the scenery in the autumn weather.

Accommodation in Sapa

Sapa is a fairly developed tourist destination, so the accommodation in Sapa visitors will have a wide choice from hotels to resorts or homestay services, all with mountain views, visitors can enjoy watching the scenery with clouds floating in the morning mist.

Sapa in August is an interesting cloud hunting spot, visitors should wake up early to admire the scenery and beautiful floating clouds, a romantic scene in the Northwest mountains.

Sapa in August, the terraced fields are preparing to enter the ripe rice season, the rice flowers are gradually turning yellow, in September the fields stretch out in a brilliant yellow color.

Trekking route from Ta Van – Lao Chai takes visitors to the villages of the H’Mong, Tay, and Giay people, when crossing the terraced fields that are turning yellow, and experiencing the unique culture of the people here.

Where to visit when traveling to Sapa in August?

Cat Cat Village

Not only does it have lyrical scenery, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, or experience the unique culture, visit the brocade weaving of ethnic minorities.

Ta Phin Village

The village in the autumn picture is so beautiful, when coming here, visitors can experience the Dao people’s leaf bath and experience the culture of the Northwest mountains with the villagers.

Sapa Heaven Gate

A virtual living spot sought after by many backpackers, Sapa Heaven Gate is located right on the top of O Quy Ho Pass, from the top of the pass, visitors will have a panoramic view of the beauty of the misty city.

What to buy as gifts when traveling to Sapa in August?

Wild shiitake mushrooms

August is the rainy season in Sapa, so shiitake mushrooms grow a lot, mushrooms can be used for hot pot or dried, visitors can enjoy mushrooms at restaurants or eateries and also buy them as gifts.

Cham cheo salt

One of the specialties of the Northwest, made from 10 typical spices of the Northwest, including typical ones such as: cardamom, mac khen, … used for dipping or as spices to marinate grilled meat.

Dried buffalo meat

Visitors can enjoy it on the spot or buy it as gifts when traveling to Sapa, the meat here will be selected from shoulder meat, thigh meat, and marinated with garlic, ginger, mac khen … and smoked for 6 months to 1 year, the finished product will have a dark brown color, the more you eat, the more you feel the unique sweet and chewy taste.

Above are the experiences of traveling to Sapa in August, hopefully through this article will help your tour to be the most attractive, when exploring a new land during your vacation, you only need to spend time traveling to Sapa for 3 days and 2 nights to explore the beauty of Sapa.
posts.excerptZh: 8月游览沙坝美在哪里？这是大多数人关心的问题，尤其是计划8月首次前往沙坝的人，所以请在有机会踏足这里之前参考这篇文章。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
8月游览沙坝美在哪里？这是大多数人关心的问题，尤其是计划8月首次前往沙坝的人，所以请在有机会踏足这里之前参考这篇文章。

沙坝迎来本季的第一场阵雨，这是游客进行长距离徒步的时节，两旁是绿色的梯田，游客将欣赏到8月沙坝的美景。

我应该8月去沙坝旅游吗？

如果这是您第一次来沙坝，您一定会好奇8月的沙坝美在哪里，以及是否应该8月去沙坝，然而，8月的沙坝天气凉爽，相当美丽，是每个秋季的美丽驿站，也是游客每个假期中有趣的一站，尤其是沙坝的9月2日国庆假期。

8月沙坝天气

沙坝8月天气晴朗轻柔，也会有突如其来的阵雨，因此如果您8月去沙坝旅游，游客应携带雨伞以防突然降雨。

去沙坝旅游乘坐什么交通工具？

沙坝距离首都河内非常近，游客可以选择汽车、卧铺大巴，或者喜欢旅行的年轻人常常选择摩托车，既能赶路，又能欣赏秋日天气里的风景。

沙坝的住宿

沙坝是一个相当发达的旅游目的地，因此游客在沙坝的住宿有很多选择，从酒店到度假村或民宿服务，均可欣赏山景，游客可以欣赏晨雾中云朵飘浮的风景。

8月的沙坝是一个有趣的追云胜地，游客应早起欣赏风景和飘浮的美丽云海，这是西北山区浪漫的景象。

8月的沙坝，梯田正准备进入稻谷成熟的季节，稻花逐渐变黄，到了9月，田野绵延，一片金黄灿烂。

从 Ta Van – Lao Chai 出发的徒步路线带游客前往苗族、岱族和 Giay 族的村寨，穿越正在变黄的梯田，体验当地人的独特文化。

8月游览沙坝可以去哪里参观？

Cat Cat 村

这里不仅风景如诗，来到这里，游客还可以品尝美味诱人的菜肴，或体验独特的文化，参观少数民族的织锦。

Ta Phin 村

秋天画卷里的村庄如此美丽，来到这里，游客可以体验瑶族的药浴，并与村民一起体验西北山区的文化。

沙坝天门（Heaven Gate）

这是许多背包客追捧的打卡地，沙坝天门位于 O Quy Ho 山口的顶部，从山口顶端，游客可以俯瞰云雾缭绕的小城全景。

8月游览沙坝买什么作礼物？

野生香菇

8月是沙坝的雨季，因此香菇生长很多，香菇可以用来涮火锅或晒干，游客可以在餐馆或小吃店品尝香菇，也可以购买作为礼物。

Cham cheo 盐

西北地区的特产之一，由西北地区10种典型香料制成，包括豆蔻、mac khen（马告）等典型香料… 用于蘸食或作为腌制烤肉的调料。

水牛肉干

游客可以现场品尝，也可以在游览沙坝时购买作为礼物，这里的肉选用肩肉、腿肉，用大蒜、姜、mac khen 等腌制… 并熏制6个月至1年，成品呈深褐色，越吃越能感受到独特的甘甜和嚼劲。

以上就是8月游览沙坝的经验，希望通过这篇文章能让您的旅程更具吸引力，在假期探索新天地时，您只需花时间 沙坝3天2夜游 来探索沙坝之美。

posts.title: Visiting Cu Chi Tunnels
posts.excerpt: Cu Chi Tunnels is an underground defense system in Cu Chi District. This system was dug by the Viet Minh resistance army and the National Liberation Front of South Vietnam during the Indochina War and
posts.contentHtml:
Cu Chi Tunnels is an underground defense system in Cu Chi District. This system was dug by the Viet Minh resistance army and the National Liberation Front of South Vietnam during the Indochina War and the Vietnam War. So let’s follow Vietlook to visit and learn about this historical site.

The tunnels include an infirmary, many rooms, kitchens, warehouses, offices, and a system of underground tunnels, with ventilation systems in bushy locations.

Cu Chi Tunnels is located at the end of the Ho Chi Minh Trail, on the land of steel praising the resilient defense of the army and people here. During the 1968 Tet Offensive, the Liberation Army of South Vietnam departed from this tunnel system to attack Saigon.

After the war ended, Cu Chi Tunnels became a national historical site, and received the title of Labor Hero… currently the historical site is a destination attracting tourists to visit and learn about historical sites.

If you travel to Cu Chi tunnels in a large group, you will hear an explanation about the historical relic site that bears the mark of a time.

Above the tunnels, there are many minefields, nail holes, spike pits… arranged in continuous clusters to create a solid battlefield in the guerrilla warfare, called a fighting commune.

The tunnel system is located deep underground, can withstand the destruction of the largest bombs of the US army, air into the tunnels is taken through vents, the areas of the tunnels can be isolated when needed.

The tunnel under the tunnels is only enough for one person to bend over, the tunnels have 3 floors, from the top of the tunnel down and have many branches, some branches are connected, some branches flow into the Saigon River, the first floor is 3m from the ground to withstand artillery shells and the weight of tanks and armored vehicles.

The second floor is 5-8m above ground, which can withstand small bombs, and the third floor is 8-12m above ground, with ramps and hatch covers, which are discreetly camouflaged to look like termite mounds.

Between the tunnels there are ventilation holes, resting places, places to store weapons and food, wells, Hoang Cam kitchens, command bunkers, surgical bunkers, etc.

Currently, Cu Chi tunnels are only about 120km long, and are an indispensable tourist destination in the Ho Chi Minh City tour. Visitors can visit and listen to explanations about the tunnel relics, and especially enjoy the rustic dishes of the local people.

Cu Chi Tunnels are a traditional meeting place for all generations and the admiration of friends around the world. Currently, Cu Chi Tunnels are a destination chosen by domestic and foreign tourists as a stopover when they have the opportunity to travel to Ho Chi Minh City.

Every year, thousands of tourist groups of all ethnicities in the world visit Cu Chi Tunnels, many tourists are moved by this heroic land.

Currently, Cu Chi Tunnels have entered the history of the heroic struggle of the Vietnamese people as a legend and have become a famous place in the world.

With about 250 km of tunnels spreading like a spider web underground from trenches, mounds, fighting nests, eating, sleeping, meeting, living, military medical, food storage, water wells, Hoang Cam kitchen… it is a wonder of our ancestors’ fight against invaders, and a historical mark engraved in future generations.

Today, Cu Chi Tunnels is a tourist attraction for domestic and foreign tourists, especially veterans and young people who come to visit and experience life in the tunnels.
If you have the opportunity to visit Ho Chi Minh City, visit the Cu Chi Tunnels relic site to visit and learn about this meaningful historical relic site.
posts.excerptZh: 古芝地道是位于古芝县的地下防御系统。这一系统由越盟抗战军和南越民族解放阵线在印度支那战争和越南战争期间挖掘而成。让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起参观并了解这处历史遗迹。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
古芝地道是位于古芝县的地下防御系统。这一系统由越盟抗战军和南越民族解放阵线在印度支那战争和越南战争期间挖掘而成。让我们跟随 Vietlook 一起参观并了解这处历史遗迹。

地道包括医务室、许多房间、厨房、仓库、办公室以及地下隧道系统，并在灌木丛生的位置设有通风系统。

古芝地道位于胡志明小道的尽头，在这片钢铁之地上，赞颂着这里军民坚韧不拔的防御。1968 年春节攻势期间，南越解放军就是从这个地道系统出发进攻西贡的。

战争结束后，古芝地道成为国家历史遗迹，并获得劳动英雄称号…目前该历史遗迹是吸引游客前来参观、了解历史遗址的目的地。

如果您以大团形式游览古芝地道，您将听到关于这处带有时代印记的历史遗迹的讲解。

地道上方设有许多雷区、钉孔、尖刺陷阱…连成一片片，在游击战中形成坚固的战场，被称为战斗公社。

地道系统位于地下深处，可以抵御美军最大炸弹的破坏，地道内的空气通过通风口获取，需要时可以将地道的各个区域隔离。

地道下方的隧道仅够一个人弯腰通过，地道分为 3 层，从地道顶部向下并有许多分支，有些分支相互连通，有些分支通向西贡河，第一层距地面 3 米，可抵御炮弹以及坦克和装甲车的重量。

第二层距地面 5-8 米，可抵御小型炸弹，第三层距地面 8-12 米，设有斜坡和舱盖，经过隐蔽伪装，看起来像白蚁丘。

地道之间设有通风孔、休息处、存放武器和粮食的地方、水井、Hoang Cam 厨房（无烟灶）、指挥掩体、手术掩体等。

目前，古芝地道仅剩约 120 公里长，是胡志明市旅游中不可或缺的旅游目的地。游客可以参观并聆听关于地道遗迹的讲解，尤其可以品尝当地人朴实的菜肴。

古芝地道是各代人传统的聚会地，也是世界各地朋友们敬仰的地方。目前，古芝地道是国内外游客有机会前往胡志明市时选择的中途停留目的地。

每年，世界各民族成千上万的旅游团参观古芝地道，许多游客为这片英雄的土地所感动。

目前，古芝地道已作为传奇载入越南人民英勇斗争的历史，并成为世界闻名的地方。

约 250 公里的地道如蜘蛛网般在地下蔓延，包括战壕、土丘、战斗据点、吃饭、睡觉、会议、生活、军医、粮食储存、水井、Hoang Cam 厨房…这是我们祖先抗击侵略者的奇迹，也是镌刻在后代心中的历史印记。

今天，古芝地道是国内外游客的旅游景点，尤其是老兵和年轻人前来参观并体验地道中的生活。
如果您有机会参观胡志明市，请前往古芝地道遗址参观，了解这处有意义的历史遗址。

posts.title: Spiritual tourism area in Ba Na
posts.excerpt: Ba Na, where the climate is 4 seasons in one day, is considered a paradise of Da Nang, and is also the place where many special festivals take place. Not only that, Ba Na is also a spiritual cultural
posts.contentHtml:
Ba Na, where the climate is 4 seasons in one day, is considered a paradise of Da Nang, and is also the place where many special festivals take place. Not only that, Ba Na is also a spiritual cultural space.

Linh Phong Bao Thap

Coming here, visitors will encounter floors with white stone statues of Buddha Shakyamuni, facing 4 directions East West South North, surrounded by statues of the Four Great Heavenly Kings.

The tower also has a bronze bell hanging on the 4 corners, symbolizing the sacred echo of a spiritual architectural work of the tower.

Linh Phong Thien Tu

This is a typical pagoda with its own architecture, the inside of the pagoda is made of ironwood, with a large campus, the pagoda has 18 statues of Buddha La Han, is an indispensable destination in the Ba Na tourism journey, visitors come here to pray for peace and happiness…

Tru Vu Tra Quan

A very suitable place to enjoy tea ceremony, and admire the floating sea of ​​clouds, the pagoda is built with its own design, the inside of the pagoda is decorated harmoniously, will bring visitors a quiet space, a feeling of peace and tranquility.

Mieu Ba

Is a spiritual place that many tourists visit, especially in early spring, many tourists come to pray for a healthy and peaceful new year, an indispensable destination in the spring travel journey to Da Nang.

Stele House

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ba Na, visitors should visit the stele house to feel a unique beauty, a beauty of a peaceful place, on the stele are carved romantic poems about the natural scenery of Ba Na.

Bell Tower

Built in Buddhist architecture, with a rather heavy gong placed right on top of Ba Na, when the temple bell rings on top of Ba Na, it is natural and relaxed, gentle as if blending into the quiet, empty world.

Linh Chua Linh Tu Temple

Located right at the intersection of heaven and earth, Linh Chua Linh Tu Temple is a place of worship to remember the merits of Ba Chua Thuong Ngan, a spiritual place in Da Nang, coming here visitors feel their souls are relaxed, all worries are dispelled, feeling serene.

Linh Ung Pagoda

In Da Nang, there are 3 pagodas with the same name in one city, and Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda is located in a beautiful campus, a spiritual destination in Ba Na that many tourists come to worship and pray for health and peace.

So to offer incense and pray for peace and happiness, you should come to Da Nang – Ba Na once and visit those spiritual tourist destinations to pray for peace and happiness for your family and loved ones. If you are wondering about the itinerary, come with Vietlook to Da Nang tour to see with your own eyes and pray for the best things.
posts.excerptZh: 巴拿（Ba Na）一天之内可体验四季气候，被誉为岘港的天堂，也是许多特色节庆举办的地方。不仅如此，巴拿还是一处灵修文化空间。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
巴拿（Ba Na）一天之内可体验四季气候，被誉为岘港的天堂，也是许多特色节庆举办的地方。不仅如此，巴拿还是一处灵修文化空间。

灵峰宝塔（Linh Phong Bao Thap）

来到这里，游客会看到几层楼供奉着白石释迦牟尼佛像，面向东西南北四个方向，周围环绕着四大天王雕像。

塔的四角还悬挂着铜钟，象征着这座灵修建筑作品神圣的回响。

灵峰禅寺（Linh Phong Thien Tu）

这是一座建筑独特的典型寺庙，寺内由铁木建成，占地宽阔，寺中有18尊罗汉像，是巴拿旅游行程中不可错过的目的地，游客来到这里祈求平安与幸福……

竹屋茶观（Tru Vu Tra Quan）

这里非常适合品茶，并欣赏飘浮的云海，寺庙设计独特，内部装饰和谐，将给游客带来一个安静的空间，一种平和宁静的感觉。

婆庙（Mieu Ba）

这是许多游客参观的灵修之地，尤其是在早春时节，许多游客来此祈求新的一年健康平安，是岘港春季旅行中不可错过的目的地。

碑亭

如果您有机会 前往巴拿旅游，游客应该参观碑亭，感受一种独特的美，一种宁静之地的美，碑上刻着描写巴拿自然风光的浪漫诗篇。

钟楼

钟楼采用佛教建筑风格，在巴拿山顶上设有一口相当厚重的铜钟，当寺钟在巴拿山顶响起时，自然而舒缓，轻柔得仿佛融入了寂静空灵的世界。

灵主灵祠（Linh Chua Linh Tu）

灵主灵祠位于天地交汇之处，是供奉以纪念上岸圣母（Ba Chua Thuong Ngan）功德的地方，是岘港的灵修之地，来到这里，游客会感到心灵放松，烦恼消散，心境宁静。

灵应寺（Linh Ung）

在岘港，一座城市里有3座同名的寺庙，而巴拿灵应寺位于风景优美的园区内，是巴拿的灵修目的地，许多游客前来礼佛、祈求健康与平安。

因此，若想上香祈求平安与幸福，您应该来一趟岘港 – 巴拿，参观这些灵修旅游目的地，为家人和亲人祈求平安与幸福。如果您对行程有疑问，欢迎与Vietlook一起参加 岘港旅游 ，亲眼看看，并祈求一切美好。

posts.title: Complete Ben Tre travel guide
posts.excerpt: Ben Tre looks like a green island floating in the middle of the river, a destination for tourists who love to explore the West, especially when traveling to the West during the flood season. When is t
posts.contentHtml:
Ben Tre looks like a green island floating in the middle of the river, a destination for tourists who love to explore the West, especially when traveling to the West during the flood season.

When is the best time to travel to Ben Tre?

Ben Tre has a warm and sunny climate all year round, visitors can come here at any time of the year, however, the best time to travel to Ben Tre is in the summer from June to August, this is an opportunity for visitors to admire the picture of Ben Tre, and enjoy delicious fruits such as: mangosteen, durian, rambutan…

Points of interest in Ben Tre

Con Quy is famous for its delicious fruits, shrimp and fish, Con Quy is a garden area of ​​the Mekong Delta, coming to Con Quy, visitors not only visit beautiful landscapes but also enjoy delicious dishes.

Con Phung is located on an island floating in the middle of Tien River. When coming here, visitors can experience the motorboats along Con Phung to see the scenery and visit the coconut candy production facility, and buy souvenirs made from coconuts during the Mekong tour. Especially, sitting next to the thatched house enjoying honey tea, and fishing will bring visitors the most enjoyable experiences during their vacation in the river area.

The fruit garden, visitors can pick ripe fruits and enjoy them on the spot, there is nothing more interesting than this place, each season will bring its own fruit.

Coconut garden: Ben Tre coconut is famous for its beautiful scenery. When coming here, visitors can experience the boat to see the scenery or take a car to see the peaceful scenery with the cool breeze.

Vam Ho bird sanctuary is home to many species of birds, there are rare birds coming here to live, visitors can save beautiful pictures for themselves.

The tomb of Nguyen Dinh Chieu is the resting place of the great poet of the nation. If you travel to Ben Tre on July 1st every year, you will be able to join the traditional festival to commemorate the famous poet, the son of the South.

Binh Dai beach is still quite wild, although not as crowded as other places, Binh Dai beach has its own beauty or visit spiritual tourist attractions, and enjoy fresh seafood, especially the fishing experience will bring visitors a sense of excitement.

Dong Khoi Guerrilla Village is where exhibitions often take place, and is also a place to display primitive weapons that Ben Tre people used to make weapons during the resistance war.

Craft villages, in Ben Tre there are many craft villages such as: Phu Le craft village, My Long rice paper craft village, Son Doc rice paper craft village, weaving craft village… tourists not only visit the scenery but also visit traditional craft villages and enjoy the peaceful scenery.

So if you have the opportunity to go on a Mekong tour, visitors should experience a sampan running through rows of water coconut trees growing around the canal banks, a cool and poetic scene.
posts.excerptZh: 槟椥（Ben Tre）宛如漂浮在河中央的一座绿色小岛，是热爱探索西南部的游客的目的地，尤其是在洪水季节前往西南部旅游的时候。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
槟椥（Ben Tre）宛如漂浮在河中央的一座绿色小岛，是热爱探索西南部的游客的目的地，尤其是在洪水季节前往西南部旅游的时候。

什么时候去槟椥旅游最好？

槟椥全年气候温暖、阳光充足，游客一年四季都可以前来，不过前往槟椥旅游的最佳时间是6月至8月的夏季，这是游客欣赏槟椥风光的好时机，还可以品尝山竹、榴莲、红毛丹等美味水果……

槟椥的景点

龟岛（Con Quy）以美味的水果、虾和鱼而闻名，龟岛是湄公河三角洲的果园区，来到龟岛，游客不仅可以参观美丽的风景，还可以品尝美味的菜肴。

凤岛（Con Phung）位于前江（Tien）中央的一座岛上。来到这里，游客可以乘坐机动船沿着凤岛观赏风景，参观椰子糖生产场所，并在湄公河之旅中购买椰子制成的纪念品。尤其是坐在茅草屋旁品尝蜂蜜茶、体验钓鱼，将给游客在水乡度假期间带来最愉悦的体验。

果园里，游客可以亲手采摘成熟的水果并当场享用，没有比这里更有趣的了，每个季节都有各自的水果。

椰林：槟椥的椰子以风景优美而闻名。来到这里，游客可以乘船观赏风景，或乘车欣赏微风清凉、宁静祥和的景色。

Vam Ho鸟类保护区是许多鸟类的家园，有珍稀鸟类来到这里栖息，游客可以为自己留下美丽的照片。

阮廷炤（Nguyen Dinh Chieu）墓是民族伟大诗人的安息之地。如果您在每年7月1日前往槟椥旅游，就可以参加纪念这位著名诗人、南部之子的传统节日。

平大（Binh Dai）海滩仍相当原始，虽然不像其他地方那样拥挤，但平大海滩自有其独特的美，还可以参观灵修旅游景点，品尝新鲜海鲜，尤其是捕鱼体验将带给游客兴奋的感觉。

东起（Dong Khoi）游击村是经常举办展览的地方，也是展示槟椥人在抗战期间用来制作武器的原始武器的地方。

手工艺村：槟椥有许多手工艺村，例如富乐（Phu Le）手工艺村、美隆（My Long）米纸手工艺村、山碌（Son Doc）米纸手工艺村、编织手工艺村……游客不仅可以观赏风景，还可以参观传统手工艺村，享受宁静的风光。

因此，如果您有机会参加 湄公河之旅，游客应该体验乘坐小舢板穿过运河两岸成排生长的水椰树，那是一幅清凉而富有诗意的景象。

posts.title: When is the best time to visit Ban Gioc waterfall
posts.excerpt: When is the best time to visit Ban Gioc waterfall, this is a question that many people are interested in, especially those who are coming to Cao Bang for the first time, so to have the answer, please
posts.contentHtml:
When is the best time to visit Ban Gioc waterfall, this is a question that many people are interested in, especially those who are coming to Cao Bang for the first time, so to have the answer, please refer to the article below.

Ban Gioc waterfall is located about 20km from the center of Cao Bang city, known as the most beautiful waterfall, with successive layers pouring down from above through the rocks, creating a beautiful picture.

Ban Gioc waterfall is sometimes dry and sometimes full, so many tourists who are planning to travel to Cao Bang often ask when is the best time to visit Ban Gioc waterfall.

However, according to the locals, the waterfall is often beautiful according to the season, the rainy season in Cao Bang is from June to September, at this time the water flows from above, creating white foam, the water is a bit cloudy.

Traveling to Cao Bang in the dry season is from October to May of the following year, at this time the weather is calmer, the water is calm and clear, very suitable for tourists’ sightseeing journey.

According to backpackers, the best time to travel to Ban Gioc waterfall is from August to September, because at this time the water flows down a lot, creating a beautiful picture.

If you travel to Ban Gioc waterfall combined with watching the ripe rice, you should go to Cao Bang in October, this is also an opportunity to admire the beauty of wild sunflowers, if you are satisfied with the buckwheat flower season, you should go to Cao Bang in November and December.

On the way to Ban Gioc waterfall, visitors will pass through the famous landscapes of Nguom Ngao cave, Thang Hen lake, Pac Po cave… visitors will be able to enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Northeast mountains.

What to eat when traveling to Ban Gioc Waterfall?

Cao Bang Roasted Duck with 7 Flavors

An attractive and delicious dish in Cao Bang, the duck is used with 7 spices before roasting, first marinating the duck with 7 spices of the Tay people.

The flavors are marinated very carefully, because the deliciousness of the meat depends on the seasoning, then use bamboo strips to tightly strung the spices, not letting the spices spill out, then dip in boiling water and brush honey and vinegar on the outside.

When enjoying the skin, it will not be dry and crispy, the meat is soft, the rich aroma will definitely be a delicious dish that you will never forget.

Grilled Tram Huong Fish

A dish that cannot be missed when traveling to Ban Gioc Waterfall, this type of fish is caught right in the river so the meat is firm and delicious, the fish is processed by the people here very deliciously, especially grilled on a charcoal stove, enjoying it in the cold weather in Cao Bang is nothing more interesting.

Smoked sausage

This is a popular dish of the Tay people, the ingredients to make Cao Bang smoked sausage are very unique, lean meat marinated with spices, the same type of fruit, the leaves of the Mac Mat tree, the toughness of the intestines and the meat and skin blend together to bring a delicious flavor unique to the highland cuisine.

Cao Bang smoked sausage can be fried until golden brown, or grilled on a charcoal stove and sliced ​​thinly then served with cucumbers, dipped in delicious chili sauce.

Cao Bang Lam Cake

A dish not to be missed when traveling to Ban Gioc Waterfall, the dough is made by the locals from sticky rice, peanuts, malt and ginger. When you eat it, you will feel the spiciness of ginger, the aroma of honey, the richness of peanuts, the stickiness of sticky rice.

Cao Bang Cake

With carefully selected ingredients, when enjoying you will feel the aroma of sticky rice, the sweetness of rock sugar, the cake filling is made of peanuts and pork fat mixed together to bring a unique delicious flavor.

Chung Khanh Chestnuts

A famous specialty, chestnuts here are very fresh and delicious, if you come to Trung Khanh in the chestnut flower season, you will feel the fragrant scent of flowers, with immense forests, at the end of the year, the fallen chestnuts are collected by the people to sell, so they are very fresh and delicious, visitors can buy them as gifts.
posts.titleZh: 什么时候去板约瀑布最好
posts.excerptZh: 板约瀑布什么时候去最好，这是许多人关心的问题，尤其是第一次来高平的人，因此想要得到答案，请参考下面的文章。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
板约瀑布什么时候去最好，这是许多人关心的问题，尤其是第一次来高平的人，因此想要得到答案，请参考下面的文章。

板约瀑布（Ban Gioc）位于高平市中心约20公里处，被誉为最美的瀑布，层层水流从高处穿过岩石倾泻而下，构成一幅美丽的画卷。

板约瀑布时而干涸，时而丰沛，因此许多计划 前往高平旅游 的游客常常问，什么时候去板约瀑布最好。

不过，据当地人说，瀑布往往随季节而美，高平的雨季是6月至9月，此时水流从上方奔涌而下，激起白色泡沫，水色略微浑浊。

前往高平的旱季是10月至次年5月，此时天气较为平静，水面平静清澈，非常适合游客的观光旅程。

据背包客说，前往板约瀑布旅游的最佳时间是8月至9月，因为此时水流量大，构成一幅美丽的画卷。

如果您前往板约瀑布旅游并结合欣赏稻谷成熟，应该在10月去高平，这也是欣赏野生向日葵之美的时机；如果您想看荞麦花季，应该在11月和12月去高平。

前往板约瀑布的途中，游客将经过著名的景点，如Nguom Ngao洞、Thang Hen湖、Pac Po洞……游客将能欣赏东北部山区的美丽风光。

前往板约瀑布旅游吃什么？

高平七味烤鸭

这是高平一道诱人的美味佳肴，鸭子在烤制前使用7种香料，首先用岱族的7种香料腌制鸭子。

调味料腌制得非常仔细，因为肉的美味取决于调味，然后用竹条把香料紧紧串起，不让香料洒出，再放入沸水中焯一下，并在外面刷上蜂蜜和醋。

享用时，鸭皮不干但酥脆，肉质软嫩，浓郁的香气一定会是您永远不会忘记的美味佳肴。

烤沉香鱼（Tram Huong）

这是前往板约瀑布旅游时不可错过的一道菜，这种鱼就在河里捕捞，因此肉质紧实美味，当地人烹制得非常美味，尤其是在炭炉上烤制，在高平寒冷的天气里享用，没有比这更有趣的了。

烟熏香肠

这是岱族人的一道大众菜肴，制作高平烟熏香肠的原料非常独特，瘦肉用香料腌制，同类的水果，Mac Mat树的叶子，肠衣的韧劲与肉和皮融为一体，带来高地美食独有的美味。

高平烟熏香肠可以煎至金黄，或在炭炉上烤制后切成薄片，搭配黄瓜，蘸上美味的辣椒酱食用。

高平Lam糕

这是前往板约瀑布旅游时不可错过的一道菜，面团由当地人用糯米、花生、麦芽和姜制成。吃的时候，您会感受到姜的辛辣、蜂蜜的香气、花生的浓郁和糯米的黏糯。

高平糕

选用精心挑选的食材，享用时您会感受到糯米的香气、冰糖的甜味，糕馅由花生和猪肥肉混合而成，带来独特的美味。

Trung Khanh板栗

这是一种著名的特产，这里的板栗非常新鲜美味，如果您在板栗花季来到Trung Khanh，将感受到花朵的芬芳，有广阔的森林，年底时，掉落的板栗被当地人收集起来出售，因此非常新鲜美味，游客可以购买作为礼物。

posts.title: Scuba diving to see corals in Cu Lao Cham
posts.excerpt: Scuba diving to see corals in Cu Lao Cham is one of the activities chosen by many tourists, especially in the summer, many tourists come to Cu Lao Cham Da Nang to experience snorkeling to see corals o
posts.contentHtml:
Scuba diving to see corals in Cu Lao Cham is one of the activities chosen by many tourists, especially in the summer, many tourists come to Cu Lao Cham Da Nang to experience snorkeling to see corals or take a canoe to the island, enjoying the cool breeze from the sea.

Cu Lao Cham is an island that still retains its pristine beauty, and is recognized by UNESCO as a world biosphere reserve.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang, visit Cu Lao Cham to feel the unique beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place, a peaceful beauty, surrounded by primeval forests creating a beautiful picture of the sea and islands.

From Cu Lao Cham, tourists will take a canoe to the island, and will be instructed on the steps to dive, even if you don’t know how to swim, you can still experience the exciting service of snorkeling to see corals.

Coming to Cu Lao Cham, visitors will encounter clear blue beaches, shimmering coral reefs, this is one of the islands with the most abundant and diverse coral reefs in the Central region.

To see with your own eyes the beauty of the shimmering coral reefs in Cu Lao Cham, visitors should choose the form of experience such as: Snorkeling, deep diving, walking under the sea of ​​Cu Lao Cham.

Each form of coral diving will bring visitors a unique experience. So to enjoy that interesting thing, let’s travel to Cu Lao Cham with Vietlook Travel today to experience the most interesting things that this place brings to visitors, especially every summer or when escaping the sun on the weekend.

 

What to eat when traveling to Cu Lao Cham?

Stone crab

This is a type of crab that often lives in caves, the crab meat is softer and sweeter than other types of crab. To enjoy the stone crab, visitors should travel to Cu Lao Cham from April to July. The remaining months are the crab’s breeding season. This is a rare specialty, so only Cu Lao Cham visitors can enjoy this specialty.

Abalone

This dish is chosen by many gourmet diners, it is very nutritious, abalone can be processed into dishes such as: boiled, steamed, stir-fried, … each dish brings its own delicious flavor.

Oc Vu Nang

This is a famous type of snail in Cu Lao Cham, the snail has delicious firm meat, it is a type of snail with high nutritional value and is very rare.

Sea urchin

A rare seafood, and is processed into many delicious and attractive dishes such as porridge, grilled with scallion oil, if you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang – Cu Lao Cham, you should enjoy this delicious and attractive dish once.

Oc Cu

A rare snail, loved by many tourists, snails can be processed into many different dishes such as grilled, stir-fried or boiled… all bringing their own delicious flavors.

Lobster

As one of the most nutritious dishes, lobster is processed into many different dishes such as: steamed with beer, grilled, with garlic butter sauce or eaten raw… and is a dish not to be missed when coming to Cu Lao Cham.

Rau dang

A rustic dish but brings its own delicious flavor, bringing the culinary culture of the Central coastal region, if you have the opportunity to set foot here, visitors should enjoy this delicious dish once.

Mantis Shrimp

A specialty only available in Cu Lao Cham, a famous dish on the island, the shrimp has a naturally sweet and chewy taste, mantis shrimp can be processed into many dishes such as: steamed with lemongrass, fried with tamarind, grilled with satay,…

Sea Cucumber

One of the rare seafood with high nutritional quality, it is a dish chosen by gourmets because of its high nutritional value and is more expensive than other types of seafood.
posts.excerptZh: 在占婆岛潜水观赏珊瑚是许多游客选择的活动之一，尤其是在夏季，许多游客来到岘港占婆岛体验浮潜观赏珊瑚，或乘快艇登岛，享受海上的清凉微风。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
在占婆岛(Cu Lao Cham)潜水观赏珊瑚是许多游客选择的活动之一，尤其是在夏季，许多游客来到岘港占婆岛体验浮潜观赏珊瑚，或乘快艇登岛，享受海上的清凉微风。

占婆岛是一座依然保持原始之美的岛屿，被联合国教科文组织认定为世界生物圈保护区。

如果您有机会前往岘港旅游，不妨游览占婆岛，感受大自然赐予这片土地的独特之美，一种宁静之美，被原始森林环绕，构成一幅美丽的海岛画卷。

从占婆岛出发，游客将乘快艇登岛，并会得到潜水步骤的指导，即使不会游泳，也可以体验观赏珊瑚的刺激浮潜服务。

来到占婆岛，游客会看到碧蓝清澈的海滩和璀璨闪耀的珊瑚礁，这里是中部地区珊瑚礁最丰富多样的岛屿之一。

要亲眼目睹占婆岛璀璨的珊瑚礁之美，游客应选择以下体验形式：浮潜、深潜、海底漫步。

每一种珊瑚潜水形式都会给游客带来独特的体验。所以，要享受这份乐趣，今天就与 Vietlook Travel 一起前往占婆岛，体验这里为游客带来的最有趣的事物，尤其是在每年夏季或周末避暑之时。

 

前往占婆岛旅行吃什么？

石蟹

这是一种常栖息在洞穴中的螃蟹，蟹肉比其他种类的螃蟹更嫩更甜。要品尝石蟹，游客应在4月至7月前往占婆岛。其余月份是螃蟹的繁殖季。这是一种稀有的特产，因此只有来占婆岛的游客才能品尝到。

鲍鱼

这道菜是许多美食爱好者的选择，营养非常丰富，鲍鱼可以做成水煮、清蒸、爆炒等菜肴……每一道都有自己的美味。

Oc Vu Nang(蛤螺)

这是占婆岛著名的一种螺，螺肉鲜美紧实，是营养价值很高且十分稀有的一种螺。

海胆

一种稀有的海鲜，可以做成多种美味诱人的菜肴，如海胆粥、葱油烤海胆，如果您有机会前往岘港-占婆岛旅行，应当品尝一次这道美味诱人的菜肴。

Oc Cu(陆螺)

一种稀有的螺，深受许多游客喜爱，螺可以做成许多不同的菜肴，如烧烤、爆炒或水煮……都有各自的美味。

龙虾

作为营养最丰富的菜肴之一，龙虾被做成多种不同的菜式，例如：啤酒蒸、烧烤、蒜蓉黄油酱，或生吃……是来到占婆岛不容错过的一道菜。

Rau dang(海藻)

一道朴实却自有美味的菜肴，体现了中部沿海地区的饮食文化，如果您有机会踏足这里，游客应当品尝一次这道美味。

皮皮虾(Mantis Shrimp)

一种只有在占婆岛才有的特产，是岛上的著名菜肴，虾肉天然香甜而有嚼劲，皮皮虾可以做成多种菜肴，例如：香茅蒸、罗望子炒、沙爹烤……

海参

一种营养品质极高的稀有海鲜，因其高营养价值而被美食家选择，价格也比其他种类的海鲜更贵。

posts.title: Visiting the incense making village of Quang Phu Cau
posts.excerpt: Visiting the incense making village of Quang Phu Cau, will bring visitors unforgettable experiences of a Vietnamese village, a traditional village, not only a destination for sightseeing but also to l
posts.contentHtml:
Visiting the incense making village of Quang Phu Cau, will bring visitors unforgettable experiences of a Vietnamese village, a traditional village, not only a destination for sightseeing but also to learn about the unique culture with the people here.

Quang Phu Cau incense making village is located in Ung Hoa district, about 35 km from the center of Hanoi, famous for its centuries-old incense making craft. It is currently a destination that attracts tourists from all over the world to visit and sightsee.

From Hanoi, visitors can travel by motorbike or bus to Quang Phu Cau incense making village. Here, visitors can buy incense or take beautiful photos of themselves in the traditional incense making village.

To take beautiful photos at Quang Phu Cau incense making village, visitors should listen to the weather in advance and choose sunny days to visit and sightsee.

To enter Quang Phu Cau incense village, visitors can pay a fee of about 50,000 VND/person, visitors can visit and take souvenir photos.

Many foreign visitors coming here are very excited by the beautiful scenery of the craft village, a peaceful village will exude its own beauty.

Each stage of making incense is a combination of machinery and manual methods. To serve tourists, the locals here arrange incense into symbols such as flowers and yellow stars, which are very eye-catching.
posts.excerptZh: 参观 Quang Phu Cau 制香村，将为游客带来难忘的越南村落体验，这里是一个传统村落，不仅是观光的目的地，也是了解当地人独特文化的地方。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
参观 Quang Phu Cau 制香村，将为游客带来难忘的越南村落体验，这里是一个传统村落，不仅是观光的目的地，也是了解当地人独特文化的地方。

Quang Phu Cau 制香村位于应和县，距河内市中心约 35 公里，以延续数百年的制香手艺而闻名。目前它是吸引世界各地游客前来参观游览的目的地。

从河内出发，游客可以乘坐摩托车或公共汽车前往Quang Phu Cau 制香村。在这里，游客可以购买香，或在传统制香村里为自己拍下美丽的照片。

要在 Quang Phu Cau 制香村拍出美照，游客应提前关注天气，选择晴天前来参观游览。

进入 Quang Phu Cau 制香村，游客可缴纳约 50,000 越南盾/人的费用，即可参观并拍摄纪念照。

许多来到这里的外国游客对手工艺村的美丽风景兴奋不已，一座宁静的村庄散发着自己独特的魅力。

制香的每一道工序都是机械与手工方法的结合。为了服务游客，这里的当地人将香摆放成花朵和黄色星星等图案，非常引人注目。

posts.title: Thung Nham Bird Garden Ecotourism Area
posts.excerpt: Thung Nham Bird Garden Ecotourism Area Ninh Binh, surrounded by tropical forests, with high, undulating rocky mountains, and located near Trang An scenic area, Tam Coc Bich Dong tourist area is a dest
posts.contentHtml:
Thung Nham Bird Garden Ecotourism Area Ninh Binh, surrounded by tropical forests, with high, undulating rocky mountains, and located near Trang An scenic area, Tam Coc Bich Dong tourist area is a destination chosen by many visitors.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ninh Binh, visitors should visit Thung Nham Bird Garden Ecotourism Area, where there are many mysterious caves and beautiful scenery. When coming here, visitors should visit But Cave, Tien Ca Cave and watch flocks of birds flying in the sky, visitors feel like they are with poetic nature.

In addition, visitors also visit the stork island, which is home to many species of birds such as storks, herons, egrets, le le… and rare species such as cranes, phoenixes…

To fully experience the beauty of Thung Nham, visitors should take a boat at 5:00 or 6:00 p.m. This is the ideal time to admire the majestic scenery and flocks of birds flying in the sky or right on the side of the boat, visitors can take beautiful pictures of the birds flying in Thung Nham.

If you go on a tour to Ninh Binh, visitors should visit Thung Nham to see the beautiful flocks of birds flying, in addition, visitors should visit the stork island in Van Long Wetland Reserve to admire and take beautiful pictures.

Especially when traveling to Ninh Binh in the summer, visitors also visit the blooming lotus season, the most beautiful is in May and June, visitors can freely take virtual photos next to the lotus fields or enjoy a cup of lotus tea, watching the poetic scenery, a lotus color spreading its fragrant scent.

What to eat when traveling to Thung Nham?

Coming to Thung Nham, grass carp is an attractive dish chosen by many diners when they have the opportunity to set foot here, it is a source of clean fish raised naturally, the fish weigh about 3 to 5 kg, the meat is firm and delicious.

Fish is processed into many dishes such as: steamed, grilled, cooked in soup… this is a typical dish of Thung Nham, with ingredients processed and eaten right on the spot so it is very delicious.

The fish intestines are chopped with wild vegetables and herbs grown right on the premises such as dill, perilla, betel leaves, chrysanthemum, mugwort, fig leaves, ginseng… before steaming the fish, mix the mixture just chopped into the fish and lemongrass tied with the fish to steam will have a delicious and nutritious flavor.

Grilled hill chicken

A very familiar dish to everyone, however, the chicken in Thung Nham is raised naturally so the meat is very firm, especially when enjoying the whole grilled chicken on a charcoal stove, it will bring a delicious flavor, enjoying it with sticky rice is the most interesting.

Steamed wild duck with sticky rice is a special dish in Thung Nham. Wild duck is fried with ginger, galangal, pandan leaves, turmeric… then stir-fried duck gizzard, minced and mixed with fragrant sticky rice. In addition, there is braised duck…

A must-have dish when coming to Ninh Binh is mountain goat. Goat is processed into many delicious and attractive dishes such as steamed goat with perilla, goat with fried gang, grilled goat, goat leg injected with Chinese medicine, raw goat with lemon leaves, goat leg stewed with mugwort leaves… all bring their own delicious flavor.

Braised eel with banana and bean curd, wild eel has chewy, sweet meat with the aroma of perilla leaves, exuding the delicious flavor of Ninh Binh cuisine.

Snail cake with fresh snails chopped and mixed with thinly sliced ​​pork, mixed with spices and rolled into bite-sized balls, steamed and enjoyed with chili sauce will bring an unforgettable delicious flavor.

With a love of nature and a desire to enjoy cuisine, you should once set foot in Thung Nham Ninh Binh to enjoy the scenery and enjoy the quintessential flavors of Vietnamese cuisine.
posts.excerptZh: 宁平 Thung Nham 鸟园生态旅游区被热带森林环绕，周围是高耸起伏的石山，毗邻长安景区和三谷碧洞旅游区，是许多游客选择的目的地。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
宁平 Thung Nham 鸟园生态旅游区被热带森林环绕，周围是高耸起伏的石山，毗邻长安景区和三谷碧洞旅游区，是许多游客选择的目的地。

如果您有机会 前往宁平旅游，应该参观 Thung Nham 鸟园生态旅游区，这里有许多神秘的洞穴和美丽的风景。来到这里，游客应该参观 But 洞、Tien Ca 洞，并观赏成群的鸟儿在天空中飞翔，让游客感觉仿佛与如诗的大自然融为一体。

此外，游客还会参观鹳岛，这里是鹳、鹭、白鹭、le le 等多种鸟类的家园，还有鹤、凤凰等珍稀物种……

为了充分体验 Thung Nham 之美，游客应在下午5点或6点乘船。这是欣赏雄伟风景和成群鸟儿在天空中或就在船边飞翔的理想时间，游客可以拍下 Thung Nham 飞鸟的美丽照片。

如果您参加 宁平之旅，游客应该参观 Thung Nham 观赏美丽的鸟群飞翔，此外，游客还应参观云龙湿地保护区的鹳岛，欣赏并拍摄美照。

尤其是夏季前往宁平旅游时，游客还可以欣赏荷花盛开的季节，最美的是五月和六月，游客可以在荷花田旁随意拍照留念，或品一杯荷花茶，欣赏如诗的风景，一片荷色散发着芬芳的香气。

去 Thung Nham 旅游吃什么？

来到 Thung Nham，草鱼是许多食客有机会踏足这里时选择的诱人菜肴，这是天然放养的清洁鱼源，鱼重约3至5公斤，肉质紧实鲜美。

鱼可以加工成多种菜肴，如：清蒸、烧烤、煮汤……这是 Thung Nham 的特色菜，食材就地加工、就地食用，因此非常美味。

鱼肠与就地种植的野菜和香草，如莳萝、紫苏、薄荷叶、茼蒿、艾草、无花果叶、人参叶等一起剁碎……蒸鱼之前，把刚剁好的混合物拌入鱼中，再与鱼绑在一起的香茅一起蒸，会有鲜美而营养的风味。

烤山地鸡

这道菜人人都很熟悉，不过 Thung Nham 的鸡是天然放养的，所以肉质非常紧实，尤其是享用炭炉烤整只鸡，会带来鲜美的风味，搭配糯米饭享用最有趣。

糯米蒸野鸭是 Thung Nham 的特色菜。野鸭用姜、高良姜、香兰叶、姜黄等煎香……然后将炒过的鸭胗剁碎，与香糯米拌在一起。此外还有红烧鸭……

来到宁平必吃的一道菜是山羊肉。山羊肉可以加工成许多美味诱人的菜肴，如紫苏蒸羊肉、gang 炒羊肉、烤羊肉、药膳注射羊腿、柠檬叶生羊肉、艾叶炖羊腿……都各有独特的美味。

香蕉豆腐红烧鳗鱼，野生鳗鱼肉质有嚼劲、鲜甜，带着紫苏叶的香气，散发着宁平美食的鲜美风味。

螺肉糕，将新鲜的螺肉剁碎，与切成薄片的猪肉混合，加入香料，卷成一口大小的丸子，蒸熟后蘸辣椒酱享用，会带来难忘的美味。

怀着对大自然的热爱和品尝美食的愿望，您应该来一次宁平 Thung Nham，欣赏风景，并品尝越南美食的精华风味。

posts.title: Lan Ha Bay Cruise
posts.excerpt: Let’s experience on a 5-star cruise with Vietlook, explore the beauty of Lan Ha Bay, will take visitors through famous places such as Cua Van Fishing Village, Thien Cung Cave, Dau Go Cave, Soi Sim Isl
posts.contentHtml:
Let’s experience on a 5-star cruise with Vietlook, explore the beauty of Lan Ha Bay, will take visitors through famous places such as Cua Van Fishing Village, Thien Cung Cave, Dau Go Cave, Soi Sim Island, Luon Cave, Ti Top Island, Sung Sot Cave… and many more interesting things.

Cua Van Fishing Village is nestled in the middle of Ha Long Bay, coming here visitors will see the undulating houses surrounded by majestic limestone ranges.

Currently, Cua Van Fishing Village is an indispensable destination in the Ha Long tour itinerary, especially visiting Cua Van Fishing Village, visitors can also experience the unique culture with fishermen in the sea.

Thien Cung Cave is one of the most beautiful caves in the bay, inside the cave there are beautiful natural rocks, a place to hide from the sun on summer days.

Dau Go Cave is located about 6 km from Bai Chay port, the cave has an ancient beauty inside the cave with beautiful naturally formed stalactites, when experiencing Ha Long cruise, visitors will admire the beautiful landscapes that nature has bestowed upon this place.

Tung Sau pearl village is a pearl farming place, coming here, visitors not only visit but also buy products made from pearls to bring back as gifts from nature.

Soi Sim Island is one of the most attractive islands in Ha Long, because of the pristine beauty of Soi Sim Island located next to Ti Top Island, Luon Cave and Sung Sot Cave…

Soi Sim Island is surrounded by primeval forests, and has many rare animals, the highlight of the island is the unique sightseeing area that attracts visitors from all over the world to come here to visit and enjoy the scenery on the island.

Luon Cave is located on Bo Hon Island, about 14 km from Tuan Chau Island, with poetic natural scenery. Luon Cave looks like a tunnel with a source of saltwater, surrounded by rocky cliffs, creating a beautiful scene.

When experiencing on a Ha Long cruise, visitors will admire the beauty of Luon Cave from the outside, here the boat is not allowed inside, visitors can experience kayaking when passing by, visitors will admire the peaceful lake exuding a unique beauty.

Ti Top Island is one of the beautiful stops in the bay, coming here visitors will encounter a clear blue beach curved in the shape of a crescent, visitors can swim, or enjoy cups of coffee overlooking the poetic sea and islands.

Sung Sot Cave is one of the most beautiful caves in the Bay, inside the cave are colorful stalactites, visitors can save beautiful pictures for themselves on the journey to discover the beauty of Ha Long by 5-star cruise.
posts.excerptZh: 让我们跟随 Vietlook 体验五星级游轮，探索蓝霞湾（Lan Ha）之美，将带游客游览 Cua Van 渔村、天宫洞、Dau Go 洞、Soi Sim 岛、Luon 洞、Ti Top 岛、Sung Sot 洞等著名景点，还有更多有趣的内容。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
让我们跟随 Vietlook 体验五星级游轮，探索蓝霞湾（Lan Ha）之美，将带游客游览 Cua Van 渔村、天宫洞、Dau Go 洞、Soi Sim 岛、Luon 洞、Ti Top 岛、Sung Sot 洞… 还有更多有趣的内容。

Cua Van 渔村坐落在下龙湾中央，来到这里，游客将看到被雄伟石灰岩山脉环绕、错落起伏的房屋。

目前，Cua Van 渔村是 下龙旅游 行程中不可或缺的目的地，尤其是参观 Cua Van 渔村，游客还可以与海上渔民一起体验独特的文化。

天宫洞是海湾中最美的洞穴之一，洞内有美丽的天然岩石，是夏日躲避阳光的好去处。

Dau Go 洞距白柴（Bai Chay）码头约6公里，洞内有古朴之美，天然形成的钟乳石十分漂亮，在体验 下龙游轮时，游客将欣赏到大自然赐予这里的美丽风景。

Tung Sau 珍珠村是一个珍珠养殖地，来到这里，游客不仅可以参观，还可以购买珍珠制品，作为大自然的礼物带回家。

Soi Sim 岛是下龙最迷人的岛屿之一，因为 Soi Sim 岛的原始之美，它毗邻 Ti Top 岛、Luon 洞和 Sung Sot 洞…

Soi Sim 岛被原始森林环绕，拥有许多珍稀动物，该岛的亮点是独特的观光区，吸引着来自世界各地的游客前来参观并欣赏岛上风光。

Luon 洞位于 Bo Hon 岛，距 Tuan Chau 岛约14公里，自然风光如诗如画。Luon 洞看起来像一条隧道，有咸水水源，周围是岩壁，构成一幅美景。

在体验下龙游轮时，游客将从外面欣赏 Luon 洞之美，这里游船不允许进入洞内，游客经过时可以体验划皮划艇，欣赏散发独特美感的宁静湖面。

Ti Top 岛是海湾中美丽的停靠点之一，来到这里，游客会看到弯成新月形状的湛蓝海滩，游客可以游泳，或一边品尝咖啡一边眺望诗意的海与岛。

Sung Sot 洞是海湾中最美的洞穴之一，洞内有五彩斑斓的钟乳石，游客可以在乘坐五星级游轮探索下龙之美的旅程中为自己留下美丽的照片。

posts.title: Mountain climbing beef a specialty of An Giang
posts.excerpt: This dish originated from Cambodia, but gradually the dish has become a specialty of An Giang, attracting diners from all over the world, and has become a dish used to entertain distinguished guests.
posts.contentHtml:
This dish originated from Cambodia, but gradually the dish has become a specialty of An Giang, attracting diners from all over the world, and has become a dish used to entertain distinguished guests.

When mentioning An Giang cuisine, in addition to delicious and attractive dishes such as Chau Doc fish sauce hotpot, Sam mountain beef seven dishes, Long Xuyen broken rice, palm cake…, we also remember a famous specialty, mountain climbing beef.

Mountain climbing beef with ingredients including fresh sliced ​​beef and vegetables, thinly sliced ​​beef, fresh eggs, vegetables such as okra, onions, carrots…

To have a firm and fragrant piece of beef grilled on a charcoal grill, first put the pork on the grill until it melts evenly around, and start putting the beef on top one by one, when the grill is hot and the fat melts, put the beef, and brush a little golden butter for a rich flavor.

Grilled beef served with rice paper, raw vegetables and green banana,… dipped with delicious and attractive anchovy fish sauce, mixed together to bring diners a delicious flavor, if you have the opportunity to travel to the West, visitors should enjoy this delicious dish.

Mountain climbing beef is often enjoyed in the evening, or every weekend, this dish is also used by An Giang people to entertain distinguished guests.

Many diners from Ho Chi Minh City come to the West – An Giang not only to visit and sightsee, but also to enjoy mountain climbing beef, a famous specialty in An Giang.

So to enjoy this delicious and attractive dish, you should visit An Giang once to enjoy this delicious and attractive dish – this famous specialty.
posts.excerptZh: 这道菜起源于柬埔寨，但逐渐成为安江的特产，吸引着世界各地的食客，并成为招待贵宾的一道菜。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
这道菜起源于柬埔寨，但逐渐成为安江的特产，吸引着世界各地的食客，并成为招待贵宾的一道菜。

提到安江美食，除了朱笃（Chau Doc）鱼露火锅、沙山（Sam）牛肉七吃、龙川（Long Xuyen）碎米饭、糖棕饼……等美味诱人的菜肴外，我们还会想起一道著名的特产——爬山牛肉。

爬山牛肉的食材包括新鲜切片牛肉和蔬菜、薄切牛肉、鲜蛋、秋葵、洋葱、胡萝卜等蔬菜……

要在炭烤炉上烤出紧实而香的牛肉，首先把猪肉放在烤架上，直到四周均匀融化，然后开始把牛肉一片片放在上面，当烤架变热、油脂融化时，放上牛肉，并刷上少许金黄色的黄油，增添浓郁的风味。

烤牛肉搭配米纸、生菜和青香蕉……蘸上美味诱人的鳀鱼鱼露，拌在一起为食客带来美味的风味，如果有机会 前往西部旅行，游客应品尝这道美味佳肴。

爬山牛肉通常在傍晚享用，或每个周末享用，安江人也用这道菜来招待贵宾。

许多来自胡志明市的食客来到西部——安江，不仅是为了参观观光，也是为了品尝爬山牛肉，这是安江的一道著名特产。

因此，要享用这道美味诱人的菜肴——这道著名的特产，您应该来安江一次。

posts.title: 10 Mountain Passes That Attract Backpackers
posts.excerpt: 10 Mountain Passes That Attract Backpackers, let’s take a look to have a trip to conquer and admire the scenery of the mountain pass and hunt for clouds, immersing yourself in the sea of ​​clouds. Wit
posts.contentHtml:
10 Mountain Passes That Attract Backpackers, let’s take a look to have a trip to conquer and admire the scenery of the mountain pass and hunt for clouds, immersing yourself in the sea of ​​clouds.

With Vietlook, experience the winding, dangerous pass, with the majestic beauty of the Northwest route, visitors will admire the scenery with the clouds floating on the mountainside, the most beautiful is in the early morning, visitors stand from above looking down at the valley covered in fog, or next to the corn fields, terraced fields covered in fog.

The first destination that backpackers hunt for is Fansipan

A place with a cool climate all year round, is one of the indispensable destinations in the Sapa travel itinerary, to conquer the roof of Indochina, visitors will experience the cable car route, and admire the scenery floating in the mist of the Northwest mountains and forests.

Phu Si Lung

A place with wild beauty, to reach the top of the mountain you must ask for permission from Pa Ve Su border post, located in Muong Te district, to get here, backpackers must conquer from Sin Chai A village.

Pu Ta Leng

Belonging to Hoang Lien Son range, a place with its own beauty, a pristine beauty with blooming rhododendron flowers, a beautiful flower of the Northwest mountains and forests.

Ky Quan San

The mountain is the border between Lao Cai and Lai Chau, visitors can conquer this mountain peak in Bat Xat, or from Den Sung village, Sin Sui Ho commune, Phong Tho district, Lai Chau province.

Phan Lien San

Located on the Vietnam – China border, Phan Lien San belongs to Phong Tho – Lai Chau, between marker 79 and marker 80, is the location of marker 79 – the highest border marker in Vietnam, at an altitude of 2,880m, a destination sought after by many backpackers.

Ta Lien (2,987m)

If you are a trekking lover, Ta Lien is the destination for you, Ta Lien peak is the border between Lai Chau and Lao Cai provinces, a virtual living spot that many tourists visit, especially at the end of the year when tourists come to hunt clouds.

Phu Luong Mountain (Yen Bai 2,985m)

To conquer this beautiful destination, visitors should start from Tram Tau, and cross the winding roads with many dangers, however, when conquering Pu Luong peak, visitors will be immersed in the sea of ​​clouds, visitors can save for themselves beautiful pictures next to the floating clouds.

Bach Moc Luong Lai Chau (2,967m)

It is the natural border between the Vietnam – China border, and is located between landmark 83, from here visitors can admire the beauty of the Hoang Lien Son mountain range, a beautiful and peaceful natural scene.

Coming here, visitors will be immersed in the beautiful nature, fresh climate, with the gentle and hospitable people, visitors should conquer the pass with the local people through the primeval forests with majestic scenery that will bring visitors the most unforgettable memories.

Nhiu Co San 2,950m

Located in Sang Ma Sao, Bat Xat district, Lao Cai, according to locals, this is the father Nhiu Co San, and the mother Nhiu Co San is Lao Than peak (2,860m high) in Phin Ho village, Y Ty commune, a cloud hunting spot sought after by many backpackers.

Chung Nghia Vu 2,918m

Located in Nam Khe area, Phong Tho district, Lai Chau, this is the natural boundary on the Vietnam – China border and near landmarks 83, 84, to get here you can go to Sapa, Y Ty, and to Nam Xe.

As one of the short mountain passes, the road here is very convenient, to get here you have to cross the bamboo forest, or the clear streams, you can sit right on the slab to admire the scenery in the middle of nature, and cross the cardamom forest to reach Chung Nghia Vu.
posts.titleZh: 吸引背包客的十大山口
posts.excerptZh: 吸引背包客的10座山峰与山口，让我们一起来看看，开启一次征服山口、欣赏风景、追逐云海的旅程，沉浸在云海之中。跟随 Vietlook……
posts.contentHtmlZh:
吸引背包客的10座山峰与山口，让我们一起来看看，开启一次征服山口、欣赏风景、追逐云海的旅程，沉浸在云海之中。

跟随 Vietlook，体验蜿蜒险峻的山口，感受西北线路的雄伟之美，游客将欣赏到云朵飘浮在山腰的景色，最美的是清晨，游客站在高处俯瞰雾气笼罩的山谷，或是玉米田、梯田旁云雾缭绕的景象。

背包客追逐的第一个目的地是番西邦峰（Fansipan）

这里全年气候凉爽，是 沙坝旅游 行程中不可或缺的目的地之一，要征服“印度支那屋脊”，游客将体验缆车线路，欣赏飘浮在西北山林云雾中的风景。

Phu Si Lung

这是一处拥有原始野性之美的地方，要登上山顶，必须向位于 Muong Te 县的 Pa Ve Su 边防哨所申请许可，要到这里，背包客必须从 Sin Chai A 村出发征服。

Pu Ta Leng
