属于黄连山脉（Hoang Lien Son），这里自有其独特之美，是一种纯净原始的美，杜鹃花盛开，这是西北山林中一种美丽的花。

Ky Quan San

这座山是老街与莱州之间的界山，游客可以从 Bat Xat 征服这座山峰，也可以从莱州省 Phong Tho 县 Sin Sui Ho 乡 Den Sung 村出发。

Phan Lien San

位于越中边境，Phan Lien San 属于莱州 Phong Tho，处于79号界碑与80号界碑之间，是79号界碑——越南海拔最高的界碑所在地，海拔2,880米，是许多背包客追寻的目的地。

Ta Lien（2,987米）

如果您是徒步爱好者，Ta Lien 就是为您准备的目的地，Ta Lien 山峰是莱州省与老街省的界山，是许多游客前来的拍照胜地，尤其是在年底，游客会来此追逐云海。

Phu Luong 山（安沛，2,985米）

要征服这个美丽的目的地，游客应从 Tram Tau 出发，穿越危险重重的蜿蜒道路，不过，征服 Pu Luong 山峰时，游客将沉浸在云海之中，可以在飘浮的云朵旁为自己留下美丽的照片。

Bach Moc Luong 莱州（2,967米）

这是越中边境的天然界线，位于83号界碑之间，从这里游客可以欣赏黄连山脉之美，一幅美丽而宁静的自然景象。

来到这里，游客将沉浸在美丽的大自然和清新的气候中，与温和好客的当地人为伴，游客应与当地人一起穿越原始森林征服山口，沿途风景雄伟，将带给游客最难忘的回忆。

Nhiu Co San 2,950米

位于老街 Bat Xat 县 Sang Ma Sao，据当地人说，这是“Nhiu Co San 父”，而“Nhiu Co San 母”是位于 Y Ty 乡 Phin Ho 村的 Lao Than 峰（海拔2,860米），是许多背包客追寻的追云胜地。

Chung Nghia Vu 2,918米

位于莱州 Phong Tho 县 Nam Khe 地区，这是越中边境的天然界线，靠近83、84号界碑，要到这里，您可以前往沙坝、Y Ty，再到 Nam Xe。

作为较短的山口之一，这里的道路非常方便，要到这里，您需要穿过竹林或清澈的溪流，可以直接坐在石板上欣赏大自然中的风景，穿过豆蔻林即可到达 Chung Nghia Vu。

posts.title: What is the best season to visit Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang
posts.excerpt: When is the best time to visit Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang? This is a question that many tourists are interested in, because this place not only has many famous attractions but also has many interesting
posts.contentHtml:
When is the best time to visit Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang? This is a question that many tourists are interested in, because this place not only has many famous attractions but also has many interesting games, especially fishing, diving and watching coral with sparkling and fascinating coral reefs. In particular, visitors can also see thousands of rare and precious species such as the red-shanked douc langur or the purple-shanked douc langur…

Coming to Son Tra Peninsula, visitors can also encounter many rare animals, including the Red-shanked Douc Langur, also known as the Brown-shanked Douc Langur, which can imitate visitors and is very close to humans.

Son Tra Peninsula is located about 10 km from the center of Da Nang city, surrounded by mountain ranges, located near the Hai Van pass, and has Thuan Puoc bridge…

Son Tra consists of 3 mountains rising high in the southeast, looking like a lion leaning out to the sea, so it is called Hon Nghe, the western mountain has the shape of a kite’s beak, and the northern one stretches towards Ngu Hai mountain on the other side of the sea gate, long like a horse’s neck, so it is called Co Ngu mountain…

In addition, when coming to Son Tra, visitors also encounter beautiful beaches such as: Bai Rang, Bai Da, Bai But… or resorts located right on the coast with beautiful views, besides there are also spiritual tourist attractions such as Linh Ung Son Tra Pagoda, an indispensable destination in the Da Nang tour itinerary.

Coming to Son Tra, visitors will also encounter clear blue beaches such as My Khe, Pham Van Dong beach, and experience at Furama resort, Sunny Beach, Olalani, or Silver Shore Hoang Dat…

Visiting Suoi Tien Son Tra, visitors will encounter a beautiful and pristine stone stream, in addition, there are ancient trees that are hundreds of years old or conquer the lighthouse, Ghenh Bang…

Beaches on Son Tra Peninsula

Nam O Beach

Coming here, visitors will immerse themselves in the cool water, or experience a cruise and visit the eco-tourism area, especially experiencing the unique culture of the Ka Tu Hoa Vang people.

Xuan Thieu Beach

Coming here, visitors will also encounter a quite pristine beach, clear blue water, white sand, with gentle waves, visitors can participate in games on the sea or on buoys floating on the sea surface, which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Pham Van Dong Beach

The beach stretches along the East Sea Park, with white sand and clear blue water like jade. This is also the place where international card activities take place such as: Paragliding, jet skiing…

My Khe Beach

As a beautiful beach and also a place where sea festivals often take place in the summer, if you travel to Da Nang in the summer, My Khe Beach is one of the indispensable destinations when you have the opportunity to set foot in Da Nang.

So with the experiences of traveling to Son Tra Peninsula that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, hopefully this article will help you in some way for your trip to Da Nang.
posts.titleZh: 什么季节游岘港山茶半岛最好
posts.excerptZh: 什么时候是游览岘港仙茶半岛的最佳时间？这是许多游客关心的问题，因为这里不仅有众多著名景点，还有许多有趣的活动，尤其是钓鱼、潜水和观赏珊瑚。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
什么时候是游览岘港仙茶半岛(Son Tra)的最佳时间？这是许多游客关心的问题，因为这里不仅有众多著名景点，还有许多有趣的活动，尤其是钓鱼、潜水和观赏珊瑚，那里的珊瑚礁璀璨迷人。此外，游客还能看到成千上万种珍稀名贵的物种，例如红腿白臀叶猴或紫腿叶猴……

来到仙茶半岛，游客还能遇到许多珍稀动物，其中包括红腿白臀叶猴(也称褐腿叶猴)，它会模仿游客，与人十分亲近。

仙茶半岛距岘港市中心约10公里，四面群山环绕，靠近海云关，并有顺福桥(Thuan Phuoc)……

仙茶由3座山组成，东南面高耸的山形似一头探身向海的雄狮，因此被称为 Hon Nghe；西面的山形如鸢的喙；北面的山脉则向海门另一侧的 Ngu Hai 山延伸，状如马颈，因此被称为 Co Ngu 山……

此外，来到仙茶，游客还能遇到白冉(Bai Rang)、白打(Bai Da)、白笔(Bai But)等美丽的海滩，或是坐落在海岸边、风景优美的度假村，另外还有灵应仙茶寺(Linh Ung Son Tra)等灵修旅游景点，这是岘港旅游行程中不可或缺的目的地。

来到仙茶，游客还会遇到美溪(My Khe)、范文同(Pham Van Dong)海滩等碧蓝清澈的海滩，并可体验富拉玛(Furama)度假村、阳光海滩(Sunny Beach)、Olalani 或银岸黄达(Silver Shore Hoang Dat)等……

参观仙茶仙泉(Suoi Tien)，游客会看到一条美丽而原始的石头溪流，此外还有数百年树龄的古树，或是登上灯塔、攀登 Ghenh Bang……

仙茶半岛的海滩

南澳海滩(Nam O)

来到这里，游客可以沉浸在清凉的海水中，或体验乘船游览并参观生态旅游区，尤其是体验华旺(Hoa Vang)卡杜(Ka Tu)族的独特文化。

春绍海滩(Xuan Thieu)

来到这里，游客还会遇到一片相当原始的海滩，海水碧蓝清澈，沙滩洁白，海浪轻柔，游客可以参与海上游乐项目，或在海面浮标上嬉戏，带来兴奋刺激的感受。

范文同海滩(Pham Van Dong)

海滩沿着东海公园(East Sea Park)绵延，沙滩洁白，海水碧蓝如翡翠。这里也是举办国际性活动的地方，例如滑翔伞、摩托艇等……

美溪海滩(My Khe)

美溪是一片美丽的海滩，夏季也常常在这里举办海洋节庆活动，如果您在夏季前往岘港旅游，当您有机会踏足岘港时，美溪海滩是不可错过的目的地之一。

以上就是 Vietlook Travel 刚刚分享的仙茶半岛旅行经验，希望这篇文章能对您的岘港之行有所帮助。

posts.title: Sun World Ha Long Park
posts.excerpt: Sun World Ha Long is a top-notch entertainment area, full of excitement that makes visitors not want to leave. It can be said that this is an international-class entertainment park complex consisting
posts.contentHtml:
Sun World Ha Long is a top-notch entertainment area, full of excitement that makes visitors not want to leave. It can be said that this is an international-class entertainment park complex consisting of two main areas: the coastal entertainment complex and the entertainment complex on the top of Ba Deo, connected by a cable car system.

Sun World Ha Long is the leading entertainment area in Ha Long, there are also resorts with famous projects such as Sun World Ba Na Hills, Asia Park, Sun World Fansipan Legend… with exciting games that promise to bring visitors the most ideal vacation in Ha Long.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ha Long, visitors should visit the coastal entertainment complex located on Bai Chay beach, to participate in experiencing interesting games such as: Dragon Park, adventure games with roller coasters, Water Park with the name of Tornado Bay, visitors will immerse themselves on the Ha Long beach with clear blue water like jade.

Experience the cable car route across the sea that will take visitors to the Sun Hill Entertainment Complex, and visit the top of Ba Deo such as Japanese Garden, the indoor game area of ​​the Mysterious Castle, especially the Sun Wheel… an interesting game that visitors cannot miss when coming to Ha Long.

Delicious dishes in Ha Long

When visiting Sun World Ha Long, visitors not only participate in interesting games, but also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, fully satisfying the tastes and satisfying all diners, even the most demanding ones.

When visiting Sun World Park, visitors should experience the Dragon Park with amusement parks such as: Ghost Tunnel, Pottery Village, Canival Game, Monorail, Flying Lizard, Death Wheel…

Water Park with amusement parks such as: Sun Bay, Continuous Tornado, Dragon Riding, Tsunami, Pirate Island…

The cable car will take visitors to amusement parks such as: Sword Forging Village, Samurai Slide Area, Upside Down Land – Magic Land, Wax Museum, Moc Tra Quan… and many other interesting games waiting for visitors to explore.

So, let’s join Vietlook Travel to Ha Long tour today to participate in the exciting games at Sun World Ha Long Park, which will bring visitors the most enjoyable experiences in the island paradise.
posts.excerptZh: 下龙湾太阳世界是一处顶级的娱乐区，充满刺激，让游客流连忘返。可以说这是一个国际级的娱乐公园综合体，由……
posts.contentHtmlZh:
下龙湾太阳世界（Sun World Ha Long）是一处顶级的娱乐区，充满刺激，让游客流连忘返。可以说这是一个国际级的娱乐公园综合体，由两大主要区域组成：海滨娱乐区和巴岛（Ba Deo）山顶娱乐区，两者由缆车系统连接。

下龙湾太阳世界是下龙湾首屈一指的娱乐区，同时还有度假村，拥有巴拿山太阳世界、亚洲公园、番西邦传奇太阳世界（Sun World Fansipan Legend）等著名项目，精彩的游乐项目将为游客带来下龙湾最理想的假期。

如果您有机会 前往下龙湾旅游，建议游览位于白寨海滩（Bai Chay）的海滨娱乐区，参与各种有趣的游乐项目，例如：龙公园、过山车冒险游戏、名为“龙卷风湾”的水上乐园，让您沉浸在碧蓝如玉的下龙湾海滩上。

体验跨海缆车线路，它将带游客前往太阳山（Sun Hill）娱乐区，并游览巴岛山顶的日本花园、神秘城堡室内游乐区，尤其是太阳摩天轮……这是来到下龙湾不容错过的有趣项目。

下龙湾美食

游览下龙湾太阳世界时，游客不仅可以参与有趣的游乐项目，还能品尝美味诱人的菜肴，充分满足各种口味，即使是最挑剔的食客也能满意。

游览太阳世界公园时，游客应体验龙公园，那里有各种游乐设施，例如：鬼屋隧道、陶瓷村、嘉年华游戏、单轨列车、飞蜥、死亡之轮……

水上乐园设有以下游乐设施：太阳湾、连续龙卷风、骑龙、海啸、海盗岛……

缆车将带游客前往以下游乐园：铸剑村、武士滑道区、倒立乐园——魔法乐园、蜡像馆、Moc Tra Quan……以及许多其他有趣的游戏等待游客探索。

那么，今天就加入 Vietlook 下龙湾旅游团 ，参与下龙湾太阳世界公园的精彩游乐项目，在这座海岛天堂里享受最愉快的体验。

posts.title: Quang Phu Cau Incense Village – Check in point in Hanoi
posts.excerpt: Quang Phu Cau Incense Village – Check in point in Hanoi is being chosen by many tourists, especially during short vacations or holidays, visitors to the incense village not only visit the scenery or t
posts.contentHtml:
Quang Phu Cau Incense Village – Check in point in Hanoi is being chosen by many tourists, especially during short vacations or holidays, visitors to the incense village not only visit the scenery or take virtual photos but also learn about the traditional craft village.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is one of the famous incense villages, located in Quang Phu Cau commune, Ung Hoa district, Hanoi. This is a traditional craft village that not only brings income to the local people but is also a tourist attraction that many tourists visit, especially young people who like to check in for beautiful photos.

If you are planning to travel to Hanoi, and are wondering where to visit, and where to check in for beautiful photos next to the traditional craft village, then according to Vietlook travel experience, you should visit Quang Phu Cau Incense Village to visit and record beautiful photos to show off to your friends.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is a very famous check-in point in the suburbs of Hanoi, although only about 35km from the center of Hanoi, Quang Phu Cau Incense Village has existed for a long time and is still maintained to this day.

From Hanoi capital, you can easily go by motorbike or bus to Quang Phu Cau village. If you like to sit on the bus to see the scenery of the suburbs, choose bus route 91 from Yen Nghia bus station, while traveling, you can admire the peaceful countryside scenery.

Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village is a traditional craft village associated with many generations of Vietnamese people. Currently, the craft village is still preserved and promoted by the skillful hands of the craftsmen of the craft village. Until now, the craft village is still developing strongly and is an attractive destination for tourists from all over the world to visit and enjoy.

Although it has existed for a long time, Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village still exists over the years, has become a unique beauty that clearly depicts the culture of the Northern Delta countryside.

If you are a lover of peaceful space, away from the dust of the city, want to experience rural life and learn about traditional Vietnamese craft villages, then follow Vietlook Travel to explore the beauty of Quang Phu Cau Incense Village today, to explore the beauty of the Vietnamese countryside, with the gentle and hospitable people, beside those gentle smiles, are the skillful hands working day and night to make products to supply to all regions.
posts.titleZh: 广富球香村——河内打卡点
posts.excerptZh: 广富求香村（Quang Phu Cau）——河内的打卡地正受到许多游客的青睐，尤其是在短假期或节假日期间，游客来到香村不仅是欣赏风景或拍照打卡，还可以了解传统手工艺村。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
广富求香村（Quang Phu Cau）——河内的打卡地正受到许多游客的青睐，尤其是在短假期或节假日期间，游客来到香村不仅是欣赏风景或拍照打卡，还可以了解传统手工艺村。

广富求香村 是著名的香村之一，位于河内应和县广富求社。这是一个传统手工艺村，不仅为当地居民带来收入，也是许多游客，尤其是喜欢拍美照打卡的年轻人前来参观的旅游景点。

如果您正计划 前往河内旅行，正在思考去哪里参观，以及在传统手工艺村旁哪里可以拍美照打卡，那么根据Vietlook Travel的经验，您应该参观广富求香村，拍下美丽的照片向朋友展示。

广富求香村是河内郊区一个非常著名的打卡地，虽然距河内市中心仅约35公里，但广富求香村已存在很长时间，至今仍得以保留。

从河内首都出发，您可以轻松乘坐摩托车或公共汽车前往广富求村。如果您喜欢坐公共汽车欣赏郊区风景，可选择从Yen Nghia汽车站出发的91路公交线路，旅途中，您可以欣赏宁静的乡村风光。

广富求线香手工艺村是与越南人民世世代代息息相关的传统手工艺村。目前，该手工艺村仍由村中工匠的巧手保存并发扬光大。直到现在，该手工艺村仍在蓬勃发展，是吸引世界各地游客前来参观和享受的迷人目的地。

虽然存在已久，广富求线香手工艺村历经岁月依然存在，已成为一种独特的美，清晰地描绘了北部三角洲乡村的文化。

如果您热爱宁静的空间，远离城市的尘嚣，想体验乡村生活并了解越南传统手工艺村，那么今天就跟随Vietlook Travel去探索广富求香村之美，探索越南乡村之美，这里有温和好客的人们，在那些温柔的笑容旁边，是日夜劳作、制作产品供应各地的巧手。

posts.title: Top 10 delicious dishes in Ninh Binh
posts.excerpt: Top 10 delicious dishes in Ninh Binh you should enjoy at least once in your life to feel the delicious flavors such as: crispy rice, mountain goat, mountain snails and many more interesting things are
posts.contentHtml:
Top 10 delicious dishes in Ninh Binh you should enjoy at least once in your life to feel the delicious flavors such as: crispy rice, mountain goat, mountain snails… and many more interesting things are waiting for you to discover.

Ninh Binh Crispy Rice

A delicious and attractive dish in Ninh Binh, visitors can not only enjoy it on the spot, but can also buy it as a gift for friends and relatives during their trip to Ninh Binh.

Mountain goat meat

Ninh Binh goats are raised on rocky mountains so the meat is very delicious, and when processed by talented chefs, it will bring a famous delicious flavor. Goat meat can be processed into many different delicious dishes such as: Grilled goat, steamed goat, raw goat with lemon, goat spring rolls, stir-fried goat, goat with ginger sauce, …

Ninh Binh mountain snails

This is a fairly common snail species, with many types of sea snails, river snails, … especially in Ninh Binh, snails often live in Tam Diep limestone mountain caves, to enjoy this attractive dish, visitors should go on a Ninh Binh tour from April to August, in addition, the snails will not come out and lie deep in the crevices of the rocks.

Snails can be processed into many different dishes, but steamed snails are the most attractive, and can also be processed into salads, steamed with ginger, stir-fried with tamarind … snails have a natural sweet and crispy texture, which will make diners remember Ninh Binh mountain snails forever.

Eel Vermicelli

The dish is very elaborately prepared, the broth from eel bones and marrow bones creates a natural sweet taste, diners enjoy the fragrant and fatty eel meat, eaten with shredded banana flowers, all blending together to create a delicious and attractive flavor.

Eel fish salad

This is a delicious and attractive dish you should try when you have the opportunity to visit Ninh Binh, at first glance the fish looks quite similar to eel, but the size is a bit larger, and has high nutritional value, a suitable dish for summer days.

Yen Mac sour sausage

This is a dish that many tourists often buy as a gift for their visit to Ninh Binh, the dish is based on Hue royal dishes, eaten with ginseng leaves, fig leaves or perilla leaves to bring a delicious and unique flavor.

Gia Vien Shrimp Paste

A dish with the rich flavor of the ancient capital of Ninh Binh, to have a delicious shrimp paste dish, it will be meticulously processed through skillful hands, bringing delicious food that visitors can buy as gifts when coming to Ninh Binh.

Nho Quan Can Wine

This is a typical wine of the Muong people living in the Nho Quan land. The ingredients are made from sticky rice, rice, potatoes, and wine yeast made from forest leaves such as guava leaves, ginger roots, galangal roots, etc. Through the skillful hands of the Muong people of Nho Quan, it will bring a delicious flavor.

Ninh Binh Floating Cake

A traditional snack made from sticky rice combined with molasses, peanuts and moldy chrysanthemum leaves to create a delicious flavor.

Gáo Fruit

This is a fruit used to cook soup, which will help to overcome the fishy smell of fish, creating a cool sour taste, visitors can buy it as a gift, the fruit is sold a lot in the markets.

It can be said that there is nothing more interesting than setting foot in the ancient capital of Ninh Binh, visitors can both enjoy the sights and enjoy the delicious dishes, in addition, there are famous specialties that visitors can buy as gifts for friends and relatives. Ninh Binh not only brings visitors beautiful landscapes, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes that attract travelers.
posts.excerptZh: 宁平十大美食，一生中至少要品尝一次，感受锅巴、山羊肉、山螺等美味，还有更多有趣的事物等待您去发现。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
宁平十大美食，一生中至少要品尝一次，感受锅巴、山羊肉、山螺等美味，还有更多有趣的事物等待您去发现。

宁平锅巴

这是宁平一道美味诱人的菜肴，游客不仅可以在当地品尝，还可以在宁平之行中买来作为送给亲朋好友的礼物。

山羊肉

宁平的山羊养在石山上，因此肉质非常鲜美，经技艺精湛的厨师烹制，会带来闻名遐迩的美味。羊肉可以做成多种不同的美味菜肴，例如：烤羊肉、蒸羊肉、柠檬生羊肉、羊肉春卷、炒羊肉、姜汁羊肉……

宁平山螺

这是一种相当常见的螺类，有许多种海螺、河螺……尤其是在宁平，山螺常栖息在三叠(Tam Diep)石灰岩山洞中，要品尝这道诱人的美食，游客应在4月至8月参加宁平旅游，此外，螺会躲进深深的岩石缝隙中不出来。

螺可以做成许多不同的菜肴，但蒸螺最为诱人，也可以做成沙拉、姜蒸、罗望子炒螺……螺肉天然香甜、口感爽脆，会让食客永远记住宁平山螺。

鳝鱼米线

这道菜制作十分讲究，用鳝鱼骨和筒骨熬成的汤底带有天然的鲜甜，食客品尝香浓肥美的鳝鱼肉，搭配切丝的香蕉花，一切融合在一起，形成美味诱人的风味。

鳗鱼沙拉

这是您有机会游览宁平时应当尝试的一道美味诱人的菜肴，乍看之下这种鱼与鳝鱼相当相似，但个头稍大，营养价值高，是适合夏日的菜肴。

Yen Mac 酸肉肠(Nem chua)

这是许多游客在宁平之行中常买来作为礼物的一道菜，其制作源自顺化宫廷菜，搭配人参叶、无花果叶或紫苏叶食用，带来美味而独特的风味。

嘉远(Gia Vien)虾酱

一道带有宁平古都浓郁风味的菜肴，要做出美味的虾酱，需要经过巧手的精心加工，游客来到宁平可以买来作为礼物。

如关(Nho Quan)罐酒

这是居住在如关地区的芒族人的特色酒。原料由糯米、大米、土豆和用番石榴叶、姜根、高良姜根等山林叶片制成的酒曲酿成。经过如关芒族人的巧手，将带来美味的风味。

宁平水饼(Floating Cake)

一种传统小吃，由糯米搭配糖浆、花生和发霉的菊叶(moldy chrysanthemum leaves)制成，味道香甜。

Gáo 果

这是一种用来煮汤的水果，能够去除鱼腥味，带来清爽的酸味，游客可以买来作为礼物，集市上大量出售这种水果。

可以说，没有什么比踏足宁平古都更有趣的了，游客既可以欣赏美景，又能品尝美食，此外，还有著名的特产可供游客买来送给亲朋好友。宁平不仅为游客带来优美的风景，来到这里，游客还能品尝吸引旅行者的美味诱人的菜肴。

posts.title: Danang specialty tuna vermicelli
posts.excerpt: Tuna vermicelli is a popular dish of Danang, the most outstanding feature of the dish is its rich nutritional flavor, with ingredients made from fresh tuna, bought when the boat just docked, so it is
posts.contentHtml:
Tuna vermicelli is a popular dish of Danang, the most outstanding feature of the dish is its rich nutritional flavor, with ingredients made from fresh tuna, bought when the boat just docked, so it is very fresh and delicious.

Tuna dishes are no longer strange to tourists when traveling to the sea, however, Danang tuna dishes are prepared by talented chefs, and tuna is bought from the sea, so it is very fresh and delicious, with its own flavor of Central cuisine.

Tuna can be processed into many different dishes, however, tuna vermicelli brings its own delicious flavor, when the weather is sunny in Danang, you have enjoyed sightseeing, then it is also the time for you to stop and enjoy a bowl of tuna vermicelli, there is nothing more interesting.

The fish is cleaned and sliced, marinated with a little seasoning to absorb and then fried, removed to a plate, sliced ​​tomatoes, put in a pan to stir-fry, season to taste before pouring in water to boil, when boiling, put the fish in the pot and simmer over low heat, so that when enjoyed with vermicelli, they will blend together to bring a delicious flavor.

The highlight of the tuna dish is the fatty aroma of the fish, and cooked just enough to keep its own, mixed with tomatoes, pineapple and the spicy taste of chili, of onion and coriander to bring an irresistible aroma.

So if you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang, visitors should enjoy the ocean tuna vermicelli dish to feel the delicious and delicate flavor that this place brings to visitors.

To enjoy Da Nang tuna vermicelli, visitors do not need to go to luxury restaurants, but can enjoy delicious dishes right at sidewalk eateries, or by the sea, which are also delicious and attractive, making visitors remember this famous specialty dish forever.
posts.excerptZh: 金枪鱼米线是岘港的一道热门美食，这道菜最突出的特点是味道浓郁、营养丰富，选用刚靠岸渔船上买来的新鲜金枪鱼，因此非常新鲜美味。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
金枪鱼米线是岘港的一道热门美食，这道菜最突出的特点是味道浓郁、营养丰富，选用刚靠岸渔船上买来的新鲜金枪鱼，因此非常新鲜美味。

对于到海边旅行的游客来说，金枪鱼菜肴已不陌生，不过岘港的金枪鱼菜肴出自手艺精湛的厨师之手，而且金枪鱼直接从海上买来，所以十分新鲜美味，带有中部美食独有的风味。

金枪鱼可以做成许多不同的菜肴，但金枪鱼米线有着自己独特的美味。在岘港阳光明媚的日子里，当您游览观光之后，正是停下脚步享用一碗金枪鱼米线的好时候，再没有比这更有趣的事了。

鱼洗净切片，用少许调味料腌制入味后下锅煎炸，捞出装盘；番茄切片下锅翻炒，调味后加水煮开，水开后放入鱼肉用小火慢炖，这样与米线一起食用时，味道相互交融，格外鲜美。

金枪鱼这道菜的亮点是鱼肉的油脂香气，火候恰到好处，保留了鱼肉本身的风味，再配上番茄、菠萝、辣椒的辛辣，以及洋葱和香菜，散发出令人难以抗拒的香味。

因此，如果您有机会 前往岘港旅游，建议品尝一下海洋金枪鱼米线，感受这里带给游客的鲜美而细腻的风味。

品尝岘港金枪鱼米线，游客无需前往豪华餐厅，在路边小店或海边用餐同样美味诱人，让游客永远记住这道著名的特色美食。

posts.title: Complete Thai Nguyen travel guide
posts.excerpt: Vietlook Travel will share with you the complete and most concise Thai Nguyen travel guide, please refer to it to have the most enjoyable tour. Coming to Thai Nguyen, tourists will visit famous attrac
posts.contentHtml:
Vietlook Travel will share with you the complete and most concise Thai Nguyen travel guide, please refer to it to have the most enjoyable tour.

Coming to Thai Nguyen, tourists will visit famous attractions such as: Tan Cuong Tea Hill, Nui Coc Lake, Hang Pagoda, or visit Linh Son Cave, or go boating on Che Rapid Lake, and experience the unique culture, so let’s follow Vietlook Trave to fully explore the beauty of Thai Nguyen right below.

Thai Nguyen Climate

Thai Nguyen has a hot and humid tropical monsoon climate, and is divided into four distinct seasons, and each region of Thai Nguyen has a different climate, the highest temperature usually falls in June.

The festivals in Thai Nguyen mainly take place in January, including traditional festivals and spiritual beliefs such as Duom Temple Festival, Long Tong Festival, Hich Festival, Hang Pagoda Festival, Van Mountain – Vo Mountain Festival. If you travel to Thai Nguyen in the summer, visitors will admire the cool green tea hills, and enjoy the famous Sane specialty.

When traveling to Thai Nguyen, you should choose to stay at hotels in Thai Nguyen City such as Habana, Da Huong, May Plaza, Dong Duong, Hai Au, The King Hotel, with prices ranging from 400,000 to more than 1 million VND per night.

In addition, if you travel to Thai Nguyen on your own with a group of friends, you can choose to camp overnight at Mojen’s Camp & Retreat stream, to enjoy the peaceful space that this place brings to visitors.

Thai Nguyen tourist attractions you should know.

Nui Coc Lake

A place likened to an oasis, including many small islands such as Nui Cai Island, Hoa Island, Co Island, Long Hoi Island, visitors can experience on basket boats, and visit mysterious caves, visit Thieng Thac Vang Pagoda…

Ghenh Che Lake

As an eco-tourism destination, visitors can experience fishing here, a very suitable place for weekend picnics, visitors can camp right next to the lake to feel the peaceful beauty.

Kem Stream and La Bang Tea Area

Coming here, visitors will encounter rocky cliffs, clear streams, and follow the cliffs with the cool water pouring down from above like a love song in the middle of the mountains and forests, and freely take virtual photos next to the lush green tea hills.

Phuong Hoang Cave – Mo Ga Stream

Phoenix Cave is associated with legendary stories, the cave mouth from the top of the mountain, the cave’s heart goes deep into the mountain, from the cave entrance runs down to form a small waterfall, in addition, when coming here, visitors can also experience swimming pool services, motels for visitors to stay.

Hang Pagoda

Located about 2 km from the center of Thai Nguyen city, where there are caves and steep cliffs, inside the cave there are stalactites… surrounded by beautiful natural scenery creating a peaceful beauty.

Duom Mountain – Duom Temple

From afar, the rocky mountain looks like a dragon’s head, the cliffs are vertical, covered with ancient moss, at the foot of the mountain is a temple to worship famous businessmen, Duom Temple has been ranked as a national monument in 1993, here also takes place the Duom Temple festival every January.

ATK Dinh Hoa National Special Relic Site

During the resistance war against French colonialism (1946 – 1954), Dinh Hoa, Dai Tu and Phu Luong districts were chosen as the Central Security Zone (ATK) military zone. Dinh Hoa ATK Dinh Hoa is ranked as a national monument. When coming here, visitors should visit Khau Ty hill – the place where President Ho Chi Minh’s first working headquarters was located at ATK Dinh Hoa, and the office of General Secretary Truong Chinh at Na Mon hill, Phong Tuong hill, where President Ho Chi Minh awarded the rank of General to the Commander-in-Chief of the Vietnam Army Vo Nguyen Giap, ATK Dinh Hoa exhibition house, President Ho Chi Minh memorial house, Uncle Ho’s hut in Khuon Tat, Quang village relic, Bao Bien relic, Cho Chu prison…

Museum of Vietnamese Ethnic Cultures

As a large-scale cultural project, visitors will be able to visit 40,000 original documents and artifacts about the traditional culture of 54 Vietnamese ethnic groups, in the exhibition rooms, introducing ethnic cultures divided by different languages ​​such as: Viet – Muong, Tay – Thai, Mong – Dao, Mon – Khmer, Nam Dao and Han…

Delicious dishes in Thai Nguyen

Thai Nguyen is not only famous for its famous landscapes but also known for its delicious dishes such as: Banh tro, Xoi ngu sac, Nham, Banh cooc mo, Com lam Dinh Hoa, Banh wormwood… and many more delicious and attractive dishes waiting for tourists to discover.

So, let’s join Vietlook Travel on the Cao Bang – Thai Nguyen tour today to experience the most interesting things that this place brings to visitors, hopefully this article will help you in some way on your trip.
posts.excerptZh: Vietlook Travel将与您分享最完整、最简明的太原旅游指南，请参考，以获得最愉悦的旅程。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
Vietlook Travel将与您分享最完整、最简明的太原旅游指南，请参考，以获得最愉悦的旅程。

来到太原，游客将参观著名景点，如：新羌茶山（Tan Cuong）、岩石湖（Nui Coc）、杭寺（Hang），或参观灵山洞（Linh Son），或在Che急流湖上划船，并体验独特的文化，因此让我们跟随Vietlook Travel，在下文中全面探索太原之美。

太原的气候

太原属炎热潮湿的热带季风气候，分为四个分明的季节，太原各地区的气候不同，最高气温通常出现在6月。

太原的节庆主要在1月举行，包括传统节日和灵修信仰活动，如Duom庙会、Long Tong节、Hich节、杭寺庙会、Van山 – Vo山庙会。如果您在夏季前往太原旅游，游客将欣赏清凉的绿色茶山，并品尝著名的Sane特产。

前往太原旅游时，您应选择入住太原市的酒店，如Habana、Da Huong、May Plaza、Dong Duong、Hai Au、The King Hotel，价格每晚从400,000至1百万VND以上。

此外，如果您与一群朋友自助前往太原旅游，可以选择在Mojen’s Camp & Retreat溪边露营过夜，享受这里带给游客的宁静空间。

您应该了解的太原旅游景点。

岩石湖（Nui Coc）

这是一个被比作绿洲的地方，包括许多小岛，如Nui Cai岛、花岛（Hoa）、Co岛、Long Hoi岛，游客可以体验乘坐竹筐船，参观神秘的洞穴，参观Thieng Thac Vang寺……

Ghenh Che湖

作为生态旅游目的地，游客可以在这里体验钓鱼，非常适合周末野餐，游客可以直接在湖边露营，感受宁静之美。

Kem溪和La Bang茶区

来到这里，游客会遇到岩石悬崖、清澈的溪流，沿着悬崖，清凉的水从上方倾泻而下，宛如山林间的一首情歌，并可以自由地在郁郁葱葱的绿色茶山旁拍照。

凤凰洞（Phuong Hoang）– Mo Ga溪

凤凰洞与传奇故事相关联，洞口位于山顶，洞心深入山中，从洞口流下形成一道小瀑布，此外，来到这里，游客还可以体验游泳池服务，并有汽车旅馆供游客住宿。

杭寺（Hang）

位于距离太原市中心约2公里处，这里有洞穴和陡峭的悬崖，洞内有钟乳石……周围是美丽的自然风光，营造出宁静之美。

Duom山 – Duom庙

远远望去，这座岩石山宛如龙头，悬崖垂直，覆盖着古老的苔藓，山脚下是供奉著名商人的庙宇，Duom庙于1993年被列为国家级古迹，这里每年1月还会举行Duom庙会。

定化ATK国家特别遗迹区

在抗法战争期间（1946 – 1954），定化（Dinh Hoa）、大慈（Dai Tu）和富良（Phu Luong）等县被选为中央安全区（ATK）军事区。定化ATK被列为国家级古迹。来到这里，游客应参观Khau Ty山丘——胡志明主席在定化ATK的第一个办公总部所在地，以及长征总书记在Na Mon山丘的办公室，Phong Tuong山丘，胡志明主席在此授予越南军队总司令武元甲大将军衔，还有定化ATK展览馆、胡志明主席纪念屋、Khuon Tat的伯伯茅屋、Quang村遗迹、Bao Bien遗迹、Cho Chu监狱遗址……

越南民族文化博物馆

作为大型文化工程，游客将能参观关于54个越南民族传统文化的40,000件原始文献和文物，展厅中介绍按不同语言划分的民族文化，如：京 – 芒（Viet – Muong）、岱 – 泰（Tay – Thai）、苗 – 瑶（Mong – Dao）、孟 – 高棉（Mon – Khmer）、南岛（Nam Dao）和汉族……

太原的美食

太原不仅以著名的风景闻名，还以美味的菜肴著称，如：灰水粽（Banh tro）、五色糯米饭、Nham、Banh cooc mo、定化竹筒饭、艾草糕……还有更多美味诱人的菜肴等待游客发现。

所以，让我们今天就加入Vietlook Travel的 高平 – 太原之旅 ，体验这里带给游客的最有趣的事物，希望这篇文章能在您的旅途中给您一些帮助。

posts.excerpt: What is beautiful about traveling to Sapa in July? is the question that most of you are interested in, especially those who are planning to travel to Sapa in July but are hesitant, so to meet the need
posts.contentHtml:
What is beautiful about traveling to Sapa in July? is the question that most of you are interested in, especially those who are planning to travel to Sapa in July but are hesitant, so to meet the needs of tourists, Vietlook will share with you the latest Sapa travel experience right below.

Sapa in July looks like a picture stretching out in the green of rice fields, trees, and wild flowers, and many exciting activities. Follow Vietlook Travel to explore Sapa this July.

When traveling to Sapa in July, visitors should choose to admire the lush green rice fields, a green color stretching across the mountain slopes, extending to the valleys or next to the stilt houses, a peaceful beauty.

If visitors choose to check in Sapa in July, Sapa has cool weather all year round and July is when the weather is gradually turning into autumn, so it is quite beautiful. Visitors can wake up early to take beautiful pictures.

Sapa in July is also the rainy season. If you come to Sapa, you should check the weather in advance to have a perfect trip. And Sapa in July is also the end of the fruit ripening season. But to have beautiful pictures, visitors should check in next to the sunflower season in Sapa.

Traveling to Sapa, visitors do not need to choose a very long journey, just choose a 3 day 2 night Sapa tour to explore the beauty of the Northwest mountains. No matter what season of the year you come here, Sapa also brings its own beauty.

Sapa in July is a beautiful check-in season, from the ifvaf land scenery surrounded by green terraced fields, and the fields will begin to ripen in late autumn, September, October, a golden color around the mountainside.

Experiencing Sapa in July, you can walk or rent a car to sightsee because the weather in Sapa in July is quite convenient for visitors to see the peaceful rustic countryside scenery, and experience life with the highland people, will bring visitors the most comfortable moments.

Virtual living spots in Sapa in July, you will float beside the green rice season, beside the drifting clouds, will definitely bring you the most beautiful pictures and unforgettable moments.

When you have enjoyed the sightseeing, choose restaurants with beautiful views to gather together and enjoy mountain food, while enjoying the scenery of the Northwest mountains and forests, you will feel the most relaxing moments.

With the experiences of traveling to Sapa in July that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, we hope it will be helpful for your trip, wish you a happy holiday.

Places to visit in Sapa in July

Nam Cang

Traveling to Sapa in July, visitors should visit Nam Cang, a place with wild beauty. If you are a lover of peaceful space away from the noise and dust, visit Nam Cang in July with endless green rice fields, you can take beautiful pictures.

Ta Van Village

A village located right on the hillsides, to get here you will go through Muong Hoa valley to see the blooming flowers, surrounded by terraced fields. In July, the terraced fields stretch out in a green color. In September and October, this place stretches out in a golden color.

Ngu Chi Son

To get here, you have to cross winding steep roads. To reach Ngu Chi Son, visitors can stop right at the shops or roadside or rent hotels with mountain views to admire the peaceful scenery.

Ý Linh Hồ

A place with terraced fields stretching out, in July and August the fields are a deep green, but in late September and early October the terraced fields here are covered in a golden yellow.
posts.excerptZh: 7月前往沙坝旅行有什么美景？这是大多数人都关心的问题，尤其是那些计划7月前往沙坝却犹豫不决的人，因此为了满足游客的需求……
posts.contentHtmlZh:
7月前往沙坝旅行有什么美景？ 这是大多数人都关心的问题，尤其是那些计划7月前往沙坝却犹豫不决的人，因此为了满足游客的需求，Vietlook 将在下面与您分享最新的沙坝旅行攻略。

7月的沙坝宛如一幅画，铺展在稻田、树木和野花的绿色之中，还有许多精彩的活动。跟随 Vietlook Travel，在今年7月探索沙坝吧。

7月前往沙坝旅行时，游客应选择欣赏郁郁葱葱的绿色稻田，那片绿色铺满山坡，延伸到山谷，或在高脚屋旁，是一种宁静之美。

如果游客选择在7月到沙坝打卡，沙坝全年天气凉爽，而7月正是天气逐渐转向秋季的时候，因此相当美丽。游客可以早起拍出美丽的照片。

7月的沙坝同时也是雨季。如果您来沙坝，应提前查看天气，以便拥有完美的旅程。而且7月的沙坝也是水果成熟季节的尾声。但为了拍出美丽的照片，游客应在沙坝向日葵花季时前来打卡。

前往沙坝旅行，游客无需选择很长的行程，只需选择一个 沙坝3天2夜游 就可以探索西北山区之美。无论一年中的哪个季节来到这里，沙坝都有其独特的美。

7月的沙坝是美丽的打卡季，从被绿色梯田环绕的高原风光开始，到了深秋，九月、十月，稻田将开始成熟，山腰一圈都是金黄色。

体验7月的沙坝，您可以步行或租车观光，因为7月沙坝的天气相当便于游客欣赏宁静质朴的乡村风光，并体验与高原人民一起生活，将为游客带来最舒适的时刻。

7月沙坝的拍照胜地，您将漂浮在绿色的稻田旁、飘动的云朵旁，一定会为您带来最美的照片和难忘的时刻。

游览观光之后，选择景色优美的餐厅聚在一起享用山区美食，一边欣赏西北山林的风景，您将感受到最放松的时刻。

以上是 Vietlook Travel 刚刚分享的7月沙坝旅行攻略，希望对您的旅行有所帮助，祝您假期愉快。

7月沙坝的游览景点

Nam Cang

7月前往沙坝旅行，游客应游览 Nam Cang，一个拥有原始野性之美的地方。如果您是喜爱远离喧嚣与尘土的宁静空间的人，7月参观 Nam Cang，那里有无尽的绿色稻田，您可以拍出美丽的照片。

Ta Van 村

这是一个坐落在山坡上的村庄，要到这里，您将经过芒华山谷（Muong Hoa）观赏盛开的鲜花，四周被梯田环绕。7月，梯田铺展出一片绿色。9月和10月，这里则铺展成一片金黄。

Ngu Chi Son

要到这里，您必须穿越蜿蜒陡峭的道路。到达 Ngu Chi Son，游客可以直接在路边商店或路旁停下，或者租住有山景的酒店，欣赏宁静的风光。

Ý Linh Hồ

这里梯田绵延，7月和8月稻田呈深绿色，而到了9月末10月初，这里的梯田则被金黄色覆盖。

posts.title: 5 Experiences when traveling to Mekong
posts.excerpt: Mekong welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, coming here visitors will experience the natural beauty and participate in exciting games such as: mountain hiking, river rafting, kayaking, scuba divi
posts.contentHtml:
Mekong welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, coming here visitors will experience the natural beauty and participate in exciting games such as: mountain hiking, river rafting, kayaking, scuba diving, windsurfing…

Mekong Ecotourism Area

If you have the opportunity to travel to Mekong, visitors should visit the ecotourism area to experience attractive services such as: mountain hiking, river rafting, kayaking, scuba diving, windsurfing… which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

In addition, visitors can also watch the sunrise at Phu Chi Fa, picnic on the clear Kuang Si waterfall, and take a boat on the Mekong River which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

If you travel to the West – Mekong, visit the U Minh Ha forest and admire the fresh nature, visit the Xeo Quyt resistance base (Dong Thap) while wandering through the forest and enjoying the delicious dishes of the river region.

Island tourism

When talking about islands, you probably think of Phu Quoc, Da Nang, Con Dao … but few people know that when coming to the Mekong, visitors will experience going by boat through the rivers, the green coconut trees … will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Agricultural tourism

Visitors will visit the peaceful rustic villages, experience the life of the people here, especially when traveling to the Mekong, visitors can also experience the garden house, which is a choice loved by many foreign tourists, with the gentle and hospitable people.

Spiritual tourism

Many tourists often choose spiritual tourism in early spring, often go to meditation areas, visit temples to pray for a year of good health and peace.

In the Mekong, there are many spiritual tourist areas, or pilgrimages through pagodas. When talking about the West, we must mention Vinh Trang Pagoda (Tien Giang), Xiem Can Pagoda (Bac Lieu), Kh’leang Pagoda (Soc Trang), Bat Pagoda (Soc Trang)…

Cultural and artistic tourism

This is a hot topic that many tourists are interested in, with visiting areas displaying artists’ studios, museums, ancient cultural heritages… are attractive destinations for tourists.

In addition, when you have enjoyed the sightseeing, it is also time for tourists to enjoy Western cuisine, or participate in cooking by preparing regional dishes with the chef.

It can be said that the Mekong will bring visitors exciting experiences, especially traveling on boats on the Mekong River or participating in floating markets and enjoying delicious and attractive dishes such as: Banh xeo, hot pot with fish sauce, Long Xuyen durian salad, My Tho noodles…
posts.excerptZh: 湄公河以著名的风光迎接游客，来到这里，游客将体验自然之美，并参与精彩的活动，例如：登山、漂流、皮划艇、潜水、风帆冲浪……
posts.contentHtmlZh:
湄公河以著名的风光迎接游客，来到这里，游客将体验自然之美，并参与精彩的活动，例如：登山、漂流、皮划艇、潜水、风帆冲浪……

湄公河生态旅游区

如果您有机会 前往湄公河旅游，游客应该参观生态旅游区，体验有吸引力的项目，例如：登山、漂流、皮划艇、潜水、风帆冲浪……这将给游客带来兴奋的感觉。

此外，游客还可以在Phu Chi Fa观看日出，在清澈的光西瀑布（Kuang Si）野餐，并乘船游览湄公河，这将给游客带来兴奋的感觉。

如果您前往西南部 – 湄公河三角洲，可以参观乌明下（U Minh Ha）森林，欣赏清新的大自然，参观Xeo Quyt抗战根据地（同塔），一边漫步森林，一边品尝水乡的美味佳肴。

海岛旅游

说到海岛，您可能会想到富国岛、岘港、昆岛……但很少有人知道，来到湄公河，游客将体验乘船穿梭于河流之间，欣赏绿色的椰子树……这将给游客带来兴奋的感觉。

农业旅游

游客将参观宁静质朴的村庄，体验当地人的生活，尤其是在湄公河旅游时，游客还可以体验花园民居，这是许多外国游客喜爱的选择，当地人温和好客。

灵修旅游

许多游客常常在早春选择灵修旅游，常去禅修区、参观寺庙，祈求一年身体健康、平安。

在湄公河三角洲，有许多灵修旅游区，也有串联各座寺庙的朝圣之旅。说到西南部，就必须提到永长寺（Vinh Trang，前江省）、暹罗寺（Xiem Can，薄辽省）、Kh’leang寺（朔庄省）、蝙蝠寺（Bat，朔庄省）……

文化艺术旅游

这是许多游客感兴趣的热门主题，参观展示艺术家工作室、博物馆、古老文化遗产的区域……都是对游客有吸引力的目的地。

此外，当您享受完观光之后，也是游客品尝西南部美食的时候，或者与厨师一起烹制地方菜肴。

可以说，湄公河将给游客带来精彩的体验，尤其是乘船游览湄公河，或参加水上市场并品尝美味诱人的菜肴，例如：越南煎饼（Banh xeo）、鱼露火锅、龙川榴莲沙拉、美托米粉……

posts.title: Cu Lao Cham Tourism
posts.excerpt: Cu Lao Cham Tourism will take visitors to the island sea trade route, which has been recognized by UNESCO as a world biosphere reserve. Coming here, visitors can not only visit but also experience exc
posts.contentHtml:
Cu Lao Cham Tourism will take visitors to the island sea trade route, which has been recognized by UNESCO as a world biosphere reserve. Coming here, visitors can not only visit but also experience exciting island games.

Cu Lao Cham is located 18km from Cua Dai beach, and is recognized by UNESCO as a world biosphere reserve, where there is a rich and diverse flora and fauna, and many famous landscapes.

Cu Lao Cham includes 8 small islands such as: Hon Lao Island (also known as Hon Cu Lao, the largest), Hon Kho Me, Hon Kho Con, Hon La, Hon Dai, Hon Mo, Hon Tai, Hon Ong..

If you are planning to travel to Da Nang, visit Cu Lao Cham and experience a canoe to visit the islands, visitors will feel the unique beauty that this place brings to visitors.

Cu Lao Cham Island is located on the route of Bach Ma – Hai Van – Son Tra, coming here visitors will admire the poetic beauty, and experience fishing or diving to see coral.

Cu Lao Cham, where the climate is cool all year round, is an indispensable destination in the Da Nang tour itinerary. Coming here, visitors can also visit famous scenic spots, especially the experience of walking on the seabed of Cu Lao Cham, discovering the beauty of the ocean floor.

Experience walking on the seabed of Cu Loa Hello, you don’t need to know how to swim, and still discover the beauty of the seabed, you will be guided and wear a helmet and flippers to explore the beauty with the school of fish swimming around.

Come to Cu Loa Cham with Vietlook Travel today to experience the most interesting things, experience high-speed canoeing, swimming, diving to see corals, fishing, and most exciting is walking on the seabed.

Tourist attractions on Cu Lao Cham Island

Cu Lao Cham welcomes visitors with poetic beaches, pristine natural scenery, long white sand beaches and rich fauna, so let’s take a look at the famous Cu Lao Cham tourist attractions below with Vietlook Travel.

Eo Gio Cu Lao Cham

Located in the east of the island, about 3km from Bai Lang, it is one of the destinations chosen by many tourists, the most beautiful sunset viewing spot on the island.

Ancient well

One of the remaining ancient wells of the Cham people and located in the forbidden residential area, according to the concept of the local people, the well water can cure seasickness and give birth to children as desired. Therefore, this place is increasingly attracting tourists to visit.

Hai Tang Pagoda

The pagoda is located majestically overlooking the vast fields, through many years but until now the pagoda still retains its own beauty, is a sacred destination attracting tourists to come here to worship and sightsee.

Beaches in Cu Lao Cham:

  • Bai Ong
  • Bai Xep
  • Bai Chong
  • Bai Huong

Watching the road of parasol flowers on Cu Lao Cham island, this place is most beautiful from July to August, the season of bright yellow flowers along the route of Bai Lang, Bai Xep, Bai Huong, visitors will be satisfied to admire the beauty of the blooming flowers.

Tan Hiep Market

The market is located at the wharf, visiting the market visitors can buy seafood as gifts, the market has fresh seafood, or dried seafood visitors can buy as gifts, in addition visitors can also buy unique shells, snails, and stones.

The Temple of the Ancestor of the Bird’s Nest Profession

is one of the large-scale architectural works. Every year, a ceremony to honor the Ancestor of the Bird’s Nest Profession is held here on the 10th day of the 3rd lunar month. The solemn ceremony attracts a large number of people and tourists to attend.
posts.excerptZh: 占婆岛旅游将带游客走上海岛贸易航线，这里已被联合国教科文组织认定为世界生物圈保护区。来到这里，游客不仅可以参观，还可以体验精彩的海岛游戏。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
占婆岛旅游将带游客走上海岛贸易航线，这里已被联合国教科文组织认定为世界生物圈保护区。来到这里，游客不仅可以参观，还可以体验精彩的海岛游戏。

占婆岛距古岱海滩18公里，被联合国教科文组织认定为世界生物圈保护区，这里有丰富多样的动植物和许多著名景观。

占婆岛包括8座小岛，如：Hon Lao 岛（又称 Hon Cu Lao，最大）、Hon Kho Me、Hon Kho Con、Hon La、Hon Dai、Hon Mo、Hon Tai、Hon Ong……

如果您计划 前往岘港旅游，参观占婆岛并体验乘独木快艇游览各岛，游客将感受到这里带给游客的独特之美。

占婆岛位于白马—海云—山茶一线上，来到这里游客将欣赏如诗的美景，并体验垂钓或潜水观赏珊瑚。

占婆岛全年气候凉爽，是 岘港旅游 行程中不可或缺的目的地。来到这里，游客还可以参观著名景点，尤其是体验在占婆岛海底漫步，探索海底世界之美。

体验在占婆岛海底漫步，您无需会游泳，也能发现海底之美，您将在指导下戴上头盔和脚蹼，与周围游弋的鱼群一起探索美景。

今天就与 Vietlook Travel 一起来占婆岛，体验最有趣的活动，体验高速快艇、游泳、潜水观赏珊瑚、垂钓，而最刺激的是海底漫步。

占婆岛旅游景点

占婆岛以如诗的海滩、原始的自然风光、绵长的白沙滩和丰富的动物群迎接游客，让我们与 Vietlook Travel 一起来看看下面著名的占婆岛旅游景点。

占婆岛 Eo Gio

位于岛的东部，距 Bai Lang 约3公里，是许多游客选择的目的地之一，是岛上最美的日落观赏点。

古井

占婆人遗留下来的古井之一，位于禁止居住区，按当地人的观念，井水可以治疗晕船并能如愿求子。因此，这个地方越来越吸引游客前来参观。

海藏寺

寺庙雄伟地俯瞰着辽阔的田野，经过多年至今仍保留着自己的美，是吸引游客前来祭拜和观光的神圣目的地。

占婆岛的海滩：

  • Bai Ong
  • Bai Xep
  • Bai Chong
  • Bai Huong

观赏占婆岛上的伞花之路，这里在七月至八月最美，沿着 Bai Lang、Bai Xep、Bai Huong 一路都是明黄色花朵盛开的季节，游客将满意地欣赏盛开的花朵之美。

Tan Hiep 市场

市场位于码头，参观市场时游客可以购买海鲜作为礼物，市场上有新鲜海鲜，也有干海鲜可供游客作为礼物购买，此外游客还可以购买独特的贝壳、海螺和石头。

燕窝职业祖师庙

是大型建筑作品之一。每年农历三月初十，这里都会举行祭祀燕窝职业祖师的仪式。庄严的仪式吸引大量民众和游客前来参加。

posts.title: Nguom Ngao Cave Mysterious Beauty
posts.excerpt: Nguom Ngao Cave is located very close to the Ban Gioc Waterfall scenic area. Nguom Ngao Cave was recognized as a national scenic spot in 1998 and is a destination that attracts tourists to visit and e
posts.contentHtml:
Nguom Ngao Cave is located very close to the Ban Gioc Waterfall scenic area. Nguom Ngao Cave was recognized as a national scenic spot in 1998 and is a destination that attracts tourists to visit and enjoy when they have the opportunity to set foot in Cao Bang.

Nguom Ngao Cave is a place that hides many wonders. Legend has it that the cave was formerly a habitat for tigers. Later, the villagers set traps to catch all these animals, and now the cave retains its peaceful beauty.

It can be said that Nguom Ngao Cave is a gift that nature has bestowed upon Cao Bang. The cave has 3 main entrances: Nguom Ngao, Nguom Lom and Ban Thuon… which are the best places to hide from the sun on a summer tour to Cao Bang.

When exploring the beauty inside, you will be overwhelmed by the beauty of nature, with stalactites forming arches hanging down in many different shapes that look very eye-catching, there are rocks in the distance that look like people, forest trees, animals, fairies combing their hair, lotus buds, mother’s milk…

The most beautiful check-in point in the cave is the upside-down lotus platform and the lonely stone pillar, which is a place where many young people hunt for photos, especially backpackers, often come here to visit to avoid the sun on summer days and record beautiful pictures next to Nguom Ngao cave.

The deeper you go into the cave, visitors will encounter the most wonderful beauty, a shimmering and charming beauty, there are paths that you have to bend over to pass, there are places that are terraced fields, or small streams created by nature, with the sound of cool water.

When visiting Nguom Ngao cave, tourists are completely overwhelmed by its natural beauty. That magnificent beauty increasingly attracts tourists to visit and enjoy the scenery in the mountains. Now, Nguom Ngao cave is an indispensable destination in the Cao Bang tour itinerary, the most ideal place to escape the sun every summer.
posts.excerptZh: Nguom Ngao洞距离板约瀑布(Ban Gioc)景区非常近。Nguom Ngao洞于1998年被认定为国家级风景名胜,是游客有机会踏足高平时前来参观和享受的目的地。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
Nguom Ngao洞距离板约瀑布(Ban Gioc)景区非常近。Nguom Ngao洞于1998年被认定为国家级风景名胜,是游客有机会踏足高平时前来参观和享受的目的地。

Nguom Ngao洞是一处隐藏着许多奇观的地方。传说这个洞穴以前是老虎的栖息地。后来,村民们设下陷阱捕捉了所有这些动物,如今洞穴保留着宁静之美。

可以说,Nguom Ngao洞是大自然赐予高平的礼物。洞穴有3个主要入口:Nguom Ngao、Nguom Lom和Ban Thuon……它们是夏季高平之旅中躲避烈日的最佳去处。

探索洞内之美时,您会被大自然的美景所震撼,钟乳石形成拱形垂挂下来,形态各异,十分夺目,远处有形似人物、森林树木、动物、仙女梳妆、莲花苞、母亲乳汁的岩石……

洞内最美的打卡点是倒置的莲花台和孤独的石柱,这里是许多年轻人寻觅拍照的地方,尤其是背包客,常常来此参观,在夏日躲避烈日,并在Nguom Ngao洞旁记录美丽的照片。

越往洞内深入,游客将遇到最奇妙的美景,闪烁而迷人,有些路径需要弯腰才能通过,有些地方是梯田状,或是大自然形成的小溪,伴随着清凉的水声。

参观Nguom Ngao洞时,游客完全被它的自然之美所折服。这份壮丽之美越来越吸引游客前来参观并欣赏山中风光。如今,Nguom Ngao洞是高平之旅行程中不可或缺的目的地,是每年夏季避暑的最理想之地。

posts.title: Special festivals in Hanoi
posts.excerpt: Join Vietlook Travel to review the unique festivals taking place in Hanoi, along with many exciting events and programs, which will bring you the most enjoyable vacation. It can be said that Hanoi has
posts.contentHtml:
Join Vietlook Travel to review the unique festivals taking place in Hanoi, along with many exciting events and programs, which will bring you the most enjoyable vacation.

It can be said that Hanoi has always been considered the cradle of unique culture, with many unique festivals expressing traditional culture through each historical period.

Giong Temple Festival

The festival commemorates our ancestors’ merit in repelling the An invaders. The festival usually takes place on the 6th to the 8th of the lunar calendar with many rituals such as: Offering flowers to the Upper Temple, carrying elephants…This is one of the traditional festivals that take place during the year with the meaning of remembering and praising the glorious victories of heroes.

The festival also reflects the culture that has been preserved and passed down through many generations. Although it has been through so much time, the Gióng Temple Festival is still preserved and forever in everyone’s heart. The festival includes the opening ceremony, the procession, the incense offering ceremony, the bamboo flower offering ceremony to the Upper Temple, the place to worship the hero Thánh Gióng…

Co Loa Temple Festival

The festival usually takes place in January every year. This is also an opportunity to attract tourists from all over the world to Hanoi to celebrate spring and join in the atmosphere of the Co Loa Temple Festival. During the festival, there will be many events such as wrestling, shooting, singing… In addition, visitors can also enjoy young dishes with the rich flavor of Hanoi such as: Mach Trang noodles, clam porridge…

Huong Pagoda Festival

The festival will take place from January to March of the lunar calendar every year, and the opening day will take place on the 6th of January every year, Huong Pagoda is located right in the Huong Son scenic area, which is likened to the land of Buddha, and this is one of the festivals that attracts Buddhists to come here to participate in pilgrimage.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi in early spring, visit the Huong Pagoda scenic area, with its large and spacious scale and admire the beautiful natural scenery that always captivates people. Coming here on the occasion of the Huong Pagoda Festival, visitors will be able to participate in events such as singing Ca Tru, the opening ceremony paint…

Dong Da Mound Festival

This is one of the quite familiar festivals for the people of Ha Thanh, the festival usually takes place on the 5th day of the first lunar month every year, it can be said that this is not only a festival to commemorate the glorious Ngoc Hoi victory, but also to express gratitude to those who sacrificed in the battle.

Dong Da Mound Festival is one of the major festivals to commemorate the great contributions of the hero Quang Trung – Nguyen Hue in fighting against foreign invaders and protecting the independence and freedom of the nation. Every year, on the holiday, thousands of people and tourists gather to attend the festival in a vibrant atmosphere.

Thay Pagoda Festival

The festival aims to clearly demonstrate the unique culture, with a palanquin procession program with colorful drums, gongs, flags and parasols. This is one of the unique traditional festivals, participating in the festival, visitors can also participate in many attractive activities such as: Blindfolded pot smashing, bamboo dance…

In addition to the above festivals, when traveling to Hanoi, visitors can also participate in many more unique festivals such as: Bat Trang Festival, Hai Ba Trung Temple Festival, Vong La Festival… and many more exciting programs are waiting for visitors to visit.
posts.excerptZh: 与Vietlook Travel一起回顾河内举办的独特节庆，以及众多精彩的活动和节目，将带给您最愉悦的假期。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
与Vietlook Travel一起回顾河内举办的独特节庆，以及众多精彩的活动和节目，将带给您最愉悦的假期。

可以说，河内一直被视为独特文化的摇篮，拥有许多独特的节庆，通过各个历史时期展现传统文化。

扶董庙会（Giong）

该节日纪念祖先击退殷朝入侵者的功绩。节日通常在农历初六至初八举行，有许多仪式，例如：向上庙献花、抬象等……这是一年中举行的传统节日之一，寓意缅怀并赞颂英雄的辉煌胜利。

这一节日也反映了世代传承下来的文化。尽管经历了漫长的岁月，扶董庙会（Gióng）依然被保留下来，永远留在每个人心中。节日包括开幕式、巡游、上香仪式、向上庙献竹花仪式，以及供奉英雄圣扶董（Thánh Gióng）的地方……

古螺庙会（Co Loa）

节日通常在每年一月举行。这也是吸引世界各地游客前来河内欢度春天、参与古螺庙会氛围的机会。节日期间将有摔跤、射击、唱歌等许多活动。此外，游客还可以品尝带有河内浓郁风味的嫩味菜肴，例如：Mach Trang米粉、蛤蜊粥……

香寺庙会（Huong）

节日每年农历一月至三月举行，开幕日在每年正月初六，香寺位于被比作佛地的香山风景区内，这是吸引佛教徒前来朝圣的节日之一。

如果您有机会在早春 前往河内旅游 ，可参观香寺风景区，规模宏大宽敞，欣赏始终令人着迷的美丽自然风光。在香寺庙会之际来到这里，游客将能参与诸如唱歌筹（Ca Tru）、开幕仪式等活动……

同达丘庙会（Dong Da）

这是河内（升龙）人民相当熟悉的节日之一，节日通常在每年正月初五举行，可以说这不仅是为了纪念辉煌的玉回大捷，也是为了感恩在战斗中牺牲的人们。

同达丘庙会是纪念英雄光中 – 阮惠（Quang Trung – Nguyen Hue）在抗击外来侵略者、保卫民族独立与自由方面伟大贡献的重要节日之一。 每年节日当天，成千上万的市民和游客聚集在一起，在热闹的氛围中参加庙会。

师寺庙会（Thay）

该节日旨在充分展现独特的文化，有以五彩缤纷的鼓、锣、旗帜和华盖组成的抬轿巡游节目。这是独特的传统节日之一，参加节日的游客还可以参与许多有吸引力的活动，例如：蒙眼打罐、竹竿舞……

除了上述节日，前往河内旅游时，游客还可以参加更多独特的节日，例如：钵场（Bat Trang）庙会、二征夫人庙会、Vong La庙会……还有更多精彩的节目等待游客前来参观。

不仅如此，在体验前往Bo Hon岛的 下龙游轮 时，游客还可以参观岛上的猴子、鹿等动物，或兰花和垂叶榕，美景将带给游客兴奋的感受。

在有机会踏上这片土地之前，了解下龙太阳世界花节，参与精彩的游戏，沉浸在热闹的节日氛围中，将带给您最难忘的假期。

posts.title: Ninh Binh Travel Experience
posts.excerpt: Ninh Binh is an attractive destination, with beautiful landscapes such as Trang An scenic area, Kim Son – Con Noi, Van Long lagoon and many unique festivals with delicious and attractive dishes. Trave
posts.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh is an attractive destination, with beautiful landscapes such as Trang An scenic area, Kim Son – Con Noi, Van Long lagoon… and many unique festivals with delicious and attractive dishes.

Traveling to Ninh Binh, visitors will visit the scenery of forests, mountains, rivers, seas with nature reserves, national parks, world biosphere reserves, a beautiful scene like a fairyland.

It can be said that Ninh Binh is the gateway to the North, a place with strong tourism development, with the routes Hanoi – Quang Ninh – Ninh Binh, or if visitors from other places travel to Ninh Binh by plane, they can go to Cat Bi, Noi Bai airport and then move to Ninh Binh to visit and sightsee.

If you have the opportunity to visit Ninh Binh, the destinations that tourists cannot miss are Trang An scenic area, Cuc Phuong National Park, Van Long lagoon… which are one of the indispensable destinations in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary regardless of the season of the year.

Ninh Binh, also known as Hoa Lu city, or Van Long wetland nature reserve, Con Noi town… is currently a friendly tourist destination attracting a large number of domestic and international tourists to visit and enjoy.

Especially Ninh Binh is home to many temples and shrines, especially the Hoa Lu ancient capital relic site, Trang An-Tam Coc-Bich Dong scenic spot, Non Nuoc Mountain, Trang An. The spiritual relic site of Bai Dinh Pagoda is located right on the mountainside and is a destination that attracts tourists to come here to worship in early spring…

 

Ninh Binh Eco-tourism Area

  • Ninh Binh is a place where forests, mountains, plains, seas… converge, including diverse eco-tourism areas such as Cuc Phuong National Park, a suitable destination for tourists who want to experience overnight camping.
  • Van Long Nature Reserve
  • Kenh Ga – Van Trinh Tourist Area
  • Tam Coc – Bich Dong such as Tam Coc, Bich Dong Pagoda, Thai Vi Temple, Thien Ha Cave…
  • Trang An Eco-tourism Area, which was recognized by UNESCO as a world heritage site in 2014.
  • Thung Nham – Bird Garden and mysterious caves such as Vai Gioi Cave, Ong But Cave, Tien Ca Cave, Thuy Cung Cave… or tourist attractions such as: Bai Ngang, Con Noi, Con Mo, Ne Island, Kim Son mangrove forest, Kim Dong seafood market, Kim Trung Church, Kim Son general port.

Accommodation in Ninh Binh, visitors can choose motels, homestays or hotels or high-class resorts. Ninh Binh is a place of tourism development, so there are many resorts that meet 5-star standards, but it all depends on the budget of visitors.

Shopping areas in Ninh Binh you should know such as: Southeast Asia Supermarket, Hapro Mart Ninh Binh Supermarket, Vinmart Ninh Binh Supermarket, Kien Anh Supermarket, Big C Ninh Binh Supermarket, Dong Thanh Supermarket, Ninh Binh Dragon Market, Dong Giao Doveco Supermarket, Pico Supermarket…

addition, if you want to visit the park, go to Non Nuoc Mountain Park, Ngoc My Nhan Mountain Forest Park, Tam Diep Green Park, Van River Park, Trang An Cultural Park, Ninh Binh National Wildlife Park and Dong Chuong Lake Park.

Festivals taking place in Ninh Binh during the year, Ninh Binh is home to many unique festivals but the main festivals take place in spring, including: Hoa Lu Cave Traditional Festival; Hoa Lu Festival; Thai Vi Temple Festival, Trang An Festival and Tran Ninh Binh Temple Festival, Nguyen Cong Tru Temple Festival… and Christmas at Phat Diem Church.

Ninh Binh Cuisine

It can be said that Ninh Binh is not only known for its famous landscapes, but this place also welcomes visitors with delicious and attractive dishes such as: Mountain goat, Kim Son wine, Tong Truong perch, Ninh Binh burnt rice, and delicious dishes that visitors should enjoy at least once in their life such as: Dong Giao pineapple, Kim Son vermicelli with meatballs, Yen Mac spring rolls, Gia Vien shrimp paste, Van Long grilled banana fish, Nho Quan wine, Hoang Long potatoes, Phat Diem eel vermicelli…. and many more interesting things are waiting for visitors to discover.
posts.excerptZh: 宁平是一个迷人的目的地,拥有长安景区、金山–Con Noi、云龙湿地等美丽风光,以及众多独特的节日和美味诱人的菜肴。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
宁平是一个迷人的目的地,拥有长安景区、金山–Con Noi、云龙湿地等美丽风光,以及众多独特的节日和美味诱人的菜肴。

前往宁平旅行,游客将欣赏到森林、山脉、河流、海洋的风光,这里有自然保护区、国家公园、世界生物圈保护区,美景如同仙境。

可以说,宁平是北部的门户,是旅游业蓬勃发展的地方,有河内–广宁–宁平的线路,或者来自其他地方的游客乘飞机前往宁平,可以先到吉碑(Cat Bi)、内排(Noi Bai)机场,然后前往宁平参观游览。

如果您有机会游览宁平,游客不容错过的目的地是长安景区、菊芳国家公园、云龙湿地……无论一年中的哪个季节,它们都是宁平之旅行程中不可或缺的目的地之一。

宁平,又称华闾城,或云龙湿地自然保护区、Con Noi镇……目前是一个友好的旅游目的地,吸引着大量国内外游客前来参观和享受。

尤其是宁平拥有众多寺庙和祠堂,特别是华闾古都遗迹、长安–三谷–碧洞景区、Non Nuoc山、长安。百顶寺的灵修遗址就坐落在山腰,是吸引游客在早春前来参拜的目的地……

 

宁平生态旅游区

  • 宁平是森林、山脉、平原、海洋……汇聚之地,包括菊芳国家公园等多样的生态旅游区,适合想要体验野外露营的游客。
  • 云龙自然保护区
  • Kenh Ga – Van Trinh旅游区
  • 三谷–碧洞,如三谷、碧洞寺、Thai Vi祠、天河洞(Thien Ha)……
  • 长安生态旅游区,于2014年被联合国教科文组织认定为世界遗产。
  • 洞岩(Thung Nham)–鸟园以及神秘的洞穴,如Vai Gioi洞、Ong But洞、Tien Ca洞、Thuy Cung洞……或旅游景点如:Bai Ngang、Con Noi、Con Mo、Ne岛、金山红树林、Kim Dong海鲜市场、Kim Trung教堂、金山总港。

宁平的住宿,游客可以选择汽车旅馆、民宿、酒店或高档度假村。宁平是旅游发展之地,因此有许多达到5星标准的度假村,但一切取决于游客的预算。

您应该了解的宁平购物区,例如:东南亚超市、Hapro Mart宁平超市、Vinmart宁平超市、Kien Anh超市、Big C宁平超市、Dong Thanh超市、宁平龙市场(Dragon Market)、Dong Giao Doveco超市、Pico超市……

此外,如果您想参观公园,可前往Non Nuoc山公园、Ngoc My Nhan山林公园、Tam Diep绿色公园、Van河公园、长安文化公园、宁平国家野生动物公园和Dong Chuong湖公园。

宁平全年举办的节日,宁平有许多独特的节日,但主要节日在春季举行,包括:华闾洞传统节日;华闾节;Thai Vi祠节、长安节和宁平陈朝祠庙节、阮公著祠节……以及发艳教堂的圣诞节。

宁平美食

可以说,宁平不仅以著名的风景闻名,这里还以美味诱人的菜肴迎接游客,例如:山羊肉、金山酒、Tong Truong鲈鱼、宁平锅巴,以及游客一生中至少应品尝一次的美味佳肴,如:Dong Giao菠萝、金山肉丸米线、燕麦(Yen Mac)春卷、嘉远(Gia Vien)虾酱、云龙烤香蕉鱼、Nho Quan酒、Hoang Long土豆、发艳鳝鱼米线……还有更多有趣的事物等待游客去发现。

posts.title: Ba Na Hills culinary space
posts.excerpt: Coming to Ba Na, visitors not only visit the scenery or experience the world record cable car, but also enjoy delicious dishes, in a spacious and airy space, very suitable for tourists’ vacation. Four
posts.contentHtml:
Coming to Ba Na, visitors not only visit the scenery or experience the world record cable car, but also enjoy delicious dishes, in a spacious and airy space, very suitable for tourists’ vacation.

 

Four Seasons Buffet Restaurant

The restaurant is designed spaciously, inspired by the colorful landscape space of the year, Four Seasons restaurant has 3 floors serving Asian – European buffet including 90 dishes, one floor is coffee and cakes, the buffet is located on the remaining 2 floors with summer and autumn buffet dishes, in which the main menu is delicious dishes with Korean flavors.

Rosa Fried Chicken Restaurant

This is an address for fast food lovers when traveling to Ba Na, you cannot miss this address, with menus such as: fried chicken, Bulgogi beef rice, burgers of all kinds…

Rosa Sushi Bar Restaurant

The restaurant with 50 traditional Japanese dishes, from fresh ingredients that look very eye-catching, with an airy space will bring diners delicious flavors, and forever remember the dishes of the Restaurant in Ba Na.

Taiga Buffet Restaurant

The restaurant has 3 floors, the menu includes 90 dishes, bringing the rich flavor of the Central region with dishes such as: Bana wild chayote salad, Lotus root salad with shrimp and meat, Steamed grouper with soy sauce, Artisan roasted duck, Grilled Deo Le chicken with mac mat leaves, Roasted suckling pig, Crispy fried pork belly, Grilled veal…

Le Petrin Restaurant

Le Petrin bakery attracts diners with its strong aroma, and the romantic space will bring diners the most comfort.

Street food

If you have the opportunity to visit Ba Na, visitors should enjoy street food such as: made-in-Ba Na sausages, hotdogs, hamburgers, fragrant grilled skewers, Ba Na orange cakes…

Vietnamese restaurant

The restaurant has a traditional design, and traditional dishes such as green rice ice cream, La Vong fish cakes, spring rolls, Hanoi beef pho,… with the traditional flavors of Vietnamese cuisine.

Lotteria

With fast food, visitors can enjoy while admiring the scenery and ancient buildings, which will bring visitors the most perfect vacation.

So let’s join Vietlook Travel to Ba Na tour today, to enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, and take a walk to admire the poetic scenery, or immerse yourself in the unique festivals that this place brings to visitors.
posts.excerptZh: 来到巴拿山，游客不仅可以欣赏风景、体验创世界纪录的缆车，还能在宽敞通透的空间里享用美食，非常适合游客度假。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
来到巴拿山(Ba Na)，游客不仅可以欣赏风景、体验创世界纪录的缆车，还能在宽敞通透的空间里享用美食，非常适合游客度假。

四季自助餐厅(Four Seasons)

餐厅设计宽敞，灵感来自全年缤纷多彩的景致，四季餐厅共有3层，供应亚欧自助餐，共90道菜品，其中一层是咖啡和蛋糕，自助餐位于其余2层，提供夏秋季自助菜品，主打菜单是韩式风味的美味佳肴。

Rosa 炸鸡餐厅

这是前往巴拿山旅行时快餐爱好者的好去处，您不容错过，菜单包括炸鸡、韩式烤牛肉饭(Bulgogi)、各式汉堡等……

Rosa 寿司吧餐厅

餐厅供应50道传统日式料理，选用新鲜食材，外观十分诱人，通透的空间将为食客带来美味的享受，让人永远记住巴拿山这家餐厅的菜肴。

Taiga 自助餐厅

餐厅共有3层，菜单包含90道菜品，带来浓郁的中部风味，菜肴有：巴拿野生佛手瓜沙拉、莲藕虾肉沙拉、豉油蒸石斑鱼、匠心烤鸭、用 mac mat 叶烤制的 Deo Le 鸡、烤乳猪、酥炸五花肉、烤小牛肉……

Le Petrin 餐厅

Le Petrin 面包店以浓郁的香气吸引食客，浪漫的空间将带给食客最大的舒适。

街头小吃

如果有机会游览巴拿山，游客应当品尝街头小吃，例如：巴拿山自制香肠、热狗、汉堡、香喷喷的烤串、巴拿橙子蛋糕……

越南餐厅

餐厅采用传统设计，供应青米冰淇淋、罗旺(La Vong)鱼饼、春卷、河内牛肉河粉等传统菜肴……带来越南美食的传统风味。

乐天利(Lotteria)

游客可以一边享用快餐，一边欣赏风景和古老的建筑，带来最完美的假期。

所以，今天就加入 Vietlook 的巴拿山旅游吧，享用美味诱人的菜肴，漫步欣赏如诗如画的风景，或沉浸在这里为游客带来的独特节庆活动之中。

posts.title: Overview of Hoi An
posts.excerpt: Join Vietlook Overview of Hoi An with its famous landscapes, cultures, culinary quintessence and unique festivals, which will surely bring visitors the most memorable vacation. Hoi An used to be a bus
posts.contentHtml:
Join Vietlook Overview of Hoi An with its famous landscapes, cultures, culinary quintessence and unique festivals, which will surely bring visitors the most memorable vacation.

Hoi An used to be a bustling international trading port, and includes its own unique architectural heritage, along with many famous landmarks such as: Chua Cau, An Bang beach, Hoi An market, Phuoc Kien Assembly Hall… Not only that, this place has also been recognized by UNESCO as a world cultural heritage since 1999.

Hoi An city is located on the poetic Thu Bon river, a place with a poetic beauty, coming here visitors can stroll to admire the beauty along the river, and take beautiful pictures in the old town.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Hoi An, visit the traditional craft village, here visitors will encounter occupations such as: carpentry, pottery making, vegetable growing, medicine, lantern making… not only bringing income to the people here but also attracting tourists to visit.

Kim Bong Carpentry Village

A place that still retains its quintessence, especially the craft of carving, wood carving, … until now the craft village still retains the quintessence of a traditional craft by talented artisans, creating sophisticated works that attract tourists to visit and learn about that quintessential culture.

Thanh Ha Pottery Village

Located about 1.5 km from Hoi An, this place is famous for ceramics, after so much time but the pottery village still preserves a traditional craft village, coming here visitors will experience pottery making, and listen to thrilling stories from the elders here.

Tra Que Vegetable Village

Located about 3 km from the center of Hoi An ancient town, but this place has its own beauty, coming here visitors will encounter a green vegetable field, very eye-catching care, each season is a different type of vegetable.

Phuoc Kieu Bronze Casting Village

If you have the opportunity to travel to Hoi An, walking along the road, you will see many products displayed that look very eye-catching, you can visit and buy them as souvenirs.

The Museum of History and Culture

It is a place that displays 212 original artifacts and valuable documents made of ceramics, porcelain, bronze, iron, paper, wood… showing historical periods, when visiting, you will feel the historical culture…

Hoi An Cuisine:

Cao Lau

A famous dish of Quang Nam, and also a specialty of Hoi An, with chewy yellow noodles mixed with shrimp, char siu pork and various vegetables in the broth, creating a delicious and famous flavor.

Quang Noodles

A famous dish of Quang Nam, the noodles are made from rice flour, chewy noodles, served with basil, fresh lettuce, young cabbage, white bean sprouts, onions, banana flowers, pork, shrimp, chicken, snakehead fish… and broth, giving diners a rich flavor.

Crispy fried pancakes

A dish you must try when you have the opportunity to visit Hoi An, a very attractive dish that you can enjoy right at small restaurants or on the sidewalk, there is nothing more interesting than eating and enjoying.

Banh Canh With smooth white noodles, mixed with broth will bring diners an unforgettable rich flavor, the cake is eaten with roasted pork, fish cakes, raw vegetables, seafood, green chili and chili sauce to enhance the flavor.

Wet rice paper rolls with grilled meat
The cake is made very elaborately, especially the step of marinating with spices such as five-spice powder, onion, lemongrass, after making it, put it on a plate to cool, add a little sesame to keep the aroma of the cake for a long time…

if you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang – Hoi An, you should enjoy this dish to remember the delicious taste of the Central region forever.
posts.excerptZh: 跟随 Vietlook 一起概览会安，这里有著名的风光、文化、美食精华和独特的节庆，必将为游客带来最难忘的假期。会安曾是繁华的国际贸易港口。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
跟随 Vietlook 一起概览会安，这里有著名的风光、文化、美食精华和独特的节庆，必将为游客带来最难忘的假期。

会安曾是繁华的国际贸易港口，拥有独特的建筑遗产，以及许多著名地标，例如：来远桥（Chua Cau）、安邦海滩、会安市场、福建会馆…不仅如此，这里自 1999 年起还被联合国教科文组织认定为世界文化遗产。

会安市坐落在诗意的秋盆河畔，这里有着如诗如画的美景，来到这里，游客可以漫步欣赏沿河风光，并在古镇中拍摄美丽的照片。

如果您有机会前往会安旅游，不妨参观传统手工艺村，在这里游客会接触到木工、制陶、种菜、草药、制作灯笼等职业…不仅为当地人带来收入，也吸引游客前来参观。

金榜木雕村

这是一处依然保留着精华的地方，尤其是雕刻、木雕等手艺…直到现在，这个手工艺村依然保留着由能工巧匠传承的传统手艺精华，创作出精美的作品，吸引游客前来参观并了解这份精华文化。

青河陶瓷村

位于距会安约 1.5 公里处，这里以陶瓷闻名，历经漫长岁月，陶瓷村依然保留着传统手工艺村的风貌，来到这里，游客将体验制陶，并聆听这里老人们讲述的精彩故事。

茶桂蔬菜村

位于距会安古镇中心约 3 公里处，但这里自有其美，来到这里，游客会看到一片绿油油的菜地，非常引人注目，每个季节都种植不同种类的蔬菜。

福侨铜铸村

如果您有机会前往会安旅游，沿着道路行走时，您会看到许多陈列的产品，看起来非常引人注目，您可以参观并购买作为纪念品。

历史文化博物馆

这里展示着 212 件由陶器、瓷器、青铜、铁、纸、木材等制成的原始文物和珍贵文献…体现了各个历史时期，参观时，您将感受到历史文化…

会安美食：

高楼面（Cao Lau）

广南的著名菜肴，也是会安的特产，嚼劲十足的黄色面条拌上虾、叉烧肉和各种蔬菜，浇上汤汁，形成美味而著名的风味。

广式面（Quang Noodles）

广南的著名菜肴，面条用米粉制成，嚼劲十足，搭配罗勒、新鲜生菜、嫩卷心菜、白色豆芽、洋葱、香蕉花、猪肉、虾、鸡肉、黑鱼…和汤汁，给食客带来浓郁的风味。

酥脆炸饼

有机会参观会安时必尝的一道美食，非常诱人，您可以直接在小餐馆或路边享用，再没有比边吃边享受更有趣的了。

粿条汤（Banh Canh）：爽滑的白色面条拌上汤汁，将给食客带来难忘的浓郁风味，这种面食搭配烤猪肉、鱼饼、生菜、海鲜、青辣椒和辣酱一起食用，以增添风味。

烤肉湿米卷
这种饼制作得非常精细，尤其是用五香粉、洋葱、香茅等香料腌制的步骤，制作完成后放在盘子里晾凉，加入少许芝麻，让饼的香气长时间保留…

如果您有机会前往岘港 – 会安旅游，您应该品尝这道美食，永远记住中部地区的美味。

posts.title: Top 5 tourist attractions in Cu Chi you should know
posts.excerpt: Cu Chi is known for its famous landmarks, delicious food, unique festivals, and more than that, it is also a place with a strong historical mark, and let’s take a look at the 5 famous tourist attracti
posts.contentHtml:
Cu Chi is known for its famous landmarks, delicious food, unique festivals, and more than that, it is also a place with a strong historical mark, and let’s take a look at the 5 famous tourist attractions in Cu Chi below.

Cu Chi Tunnels

The first destination that cannot be missed in the Southern Vietnam tour, the relic site has a strong historical mark, during the war this place was an underground defense system, if you go in a group, you will hear an explanation about this historical relic site.

Cu Chi Water Park

A suitable entertainment spot for families with children, the whole family can participate in water games here, which will bring visitors the most perfect vacation.

Trung An Fruit Garden

Every year in the summer, which is also the season of ripe fruit, tourists from all over the world often come here to visit and enjoy the ripe fruits right in the garden, which will bring them a sense of excitement.

Binh My Eco-tourism Area

Coming here, visitors will be immersed in a poetic space, as if rushing back to their childhood memories, where there are village ponds, monkey bridges, bamboo fences and cool green coconut trees, simple roofs where visitors can experience fishing on the pond bank, cruising on the river, catching fish with a net, … folk games but bring visitors a sense of excitement.

Fosaco Eco-Village

Located about 10km from the city center, where there is a cool green space, a peaceful space is an ideal stop for visitors’ vacation.

Join Vietlook Travel on a Cu Chi tour today to experience the most interesting things this place has to offer, sightseeing, sightseeing, and participating in exciting games.
posts.excerptZh: 古芝以著名的地标、美味的食物、独特的节庆而闻名，更重要的是，它还是一个有着浓厚历史印记的地方，让我们来看看下面古芝的5大著名旅游景点。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
古芝以著名的地标、美味的食物、独特的节庆而闻名，更重要的是，它还是一个有着浓厚历史印记的地方，让我们来看看下面古芝的5大著名旅游景点。

古芝地道

越南南部之旅中不可错过的第一个目的地是 越南南部之旅，这处遗址有着浓厚的历史印记，战争期间这里是一个地下防御系统，如果您跟团前往，将听到关于这处历史遗址的讲解。

古芝水上乐园

适合带孩子的家庭的娱乐场所，全家人都可以在这里参加水上游戏，将为游客带来最完美的假期。

忠安果园

每年夏季也是果实成熟的季节，来自世界各地的游客常常来到这里参观，并在果园里直接品尝成熟的水果，给他们带来兴奋的感觉。

平美生态旅游区

来到这里，游客将沉浸在如诗的空间中，仿佛回到童年的记忆，这里有村塘、猴桥、竹篱笆和清凉翠绿的椰子树、朴素的屋顶，游客可以体验塘边垂钓、河上泛舟、用网捕鱼……这些民间游戏却能给游客带来兴奋的感觉。

Fosaco 生态村

距市中心约10公里，这里有清凉的绿色空间，宁静的氛围是游客度假的理想一站。

今天就与 Vietlook Travel 一起参加 古芝之旅 ，体验这里最有趣的东西，观光游览，并参加精彩的游戏。

posts.title: Quang Phu Cau Incense Village A Unique Virtual Living Spot in Hanoi
posts.excerpt: Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is a newly emerging virtual living spot in Hanoi, not only attracting domestic tourists but also attracting international tourists to visit, enjoy and take pictures in th
posts.contentHtml:
Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is a newly emerging virtual living spot in Hanoi, not only attracting domestic tourists but also attracting international tourists to visit, enjoy and take pictures in the incense village.

Although located about 35 km from the center of Hanoi, this place brings a unique beauty of a peaceful countryside, with a traditional craft village that no one knows when it started.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village not only brings income to the local people but is also a unique new tourist destination, many tourists come here to hunt for pictures and save beautiful pictures for themselves.

If you plan to travel to Hanoi, visit Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, if you are a lover of traditional beauty, visiting the countryside scenery, Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is the destination for you.

From the center of Hanoi city, visitors can take a bus to visit the incense village, or you can ride a motorbike to enjoy the scenery, the peaceful scenery of the Vietnamese incense village.

The incense stick craft village of Quang Phu Cau, no one knows when it was created, but until now the incense stick craft village is still one of the traditional craft villages associated with many generations of Vietnamese people, by skilled craftsmen.

Currently, Quang Phu Cau incense village has become the most famous incense stick craft village in the suburbs of the capital. When visiting the incense village, you will encounter the beauty of a rural area with both ancient and modern features.

What to eat when traveling to Quang Phu Cau incense village?

This place is not only known for its traditional craft village, or learning about the culture of Vietnamese villages, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes. Let’s take a look at the delicious and attractive dishes at Quang Phu Cau incense village.

Although it is about 40km from Hanoi, Quang Phu Cau is a place with many famous delicious dishes, with unique ways of processing that will bring visitors the quintessence of unique culinary culture.

Especially when coming to Quang Phu Cau, visitors can enjoy the unique porridge dish, talking about porridge is certainly no longer strange to anyone, however, in Quang Phu Cau, porridge is processed to bring a very unique flavor.

In addition, you should enjoy delicious dishes such as: Noi Xa sticky rice cake, Thanh Am rice paper, Hoa Phu sticky rice cake, Quang Nguyen floating cake, Hoang Xa flower porridge…

The delicious dish that makes diners remember forever is the go porridge, the main ingredients are fresh perch, sticky rice and added dried onions and spices… when enjoyed, it will bring a unique delicious flavor that diners will remember forever.

Go porridge served with banh khuc is a popular dish in the northern region, and is sold all year round, but is most popular in winter, when the weather is cold, enjoying a hot bowl of go porridge is nothing more interesting.
posts.titleZh: 广富球香村——河内独特的拍照胜地
posts.excerptZh: Quang Phu Cau 线香村是河内新兴的网红打卡地，不仅吸引国内游客，也吸引国际游客前来参观、游玩并在线香村拍照。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
Quang Phu Cau 线香村 是河内新兴的网红打卡地，不仅吸引国内游客，也吸引国际游客前来参观、游玩并在线香村拍照。

虽然距河内市中心约35公里，这里却带来宁静乡村的独特之美，还有一座没人知道始于何时的传统手工艺村。

Quang Phu Cau 线香村不仅为当地人带来收入，也是一个独特的新兴旅游目的地，许多游客来到这里打卡拍照，为自己留下美丽的照片。

如果您计划 游览河内， 参观 Quang Phu Cau 线香村，如果您热爱传统之美、喜欢乡村风光，Quang Phu Cau 线香村就是适合您的目的地。

从河内市中心出发，游客可以乘坐公交车前往线香村，也可以骑摩托车，欣赏越南线香村宁静的风景。

Quang Phu Cau 线香手工艺村，没人知道它创建于何时，但直到现在，线香手工艺村依然是与越南人世世代代相伴的传统手工艺村之一，由技艺精湛的工匠制作。

目前，Quang Phu Cau 线香村已成为首都郊区最著名的线香手工艺村。参观线香村时，您将遇到兼具古朴与现代特色的乡村之美。

游览 Quang Phu Cau 线香村时吃什么？

这里不仅以传统手工艺村而闻名，也能了解越南乡村文化，来到这里，游客还可以品尝美味诱人的菜肴。让我们看看 Quang Phu Cau 线香村那些美味诱人的菜肴。

虽然距河内约40公里，Quang Phu Cau 却是拥有许多著名美味菜肴的地方，独特的加工方式将为游客带来独特饮食文化的精华。

尤其是来到 Quang Phu Cau，游客可以品尝独特的粥品，说到粥，想必人人都不陌生，然而在 Quang Phu Cau，粥经过加工，带来非常独特的风味。

此外，您还应品尝美味菜肴，如：Noi Xa 糯米糕、Thanh Am 米纸、Hoa Phu 糯米糕、Quang Nguyen 浮糕、Hoang Xa 花粥…

令食客永远难忘的美味是 go 鱼粥，主要食材是新鲜鲈鱼、糯米，并加入干葱和香料… 品尝时会带来令食客永远难忘的独特美味。

Go 鱼粥搭配 banh khuc（鼠曲草糕）是北部地区的热门菜肴，全年都有售，但冬季最受欢迎，天气寒冷时，享用一碗热腾腾的 go 鱼粥，再有趣不过了。

posts.title: Visit Mua Cave Ninh Binh
posts.excerpt: Ninh Binh is not only an attractive destination for tourists with Tam Coc-Bich Dong, Bai Dinh-Trang An but when coming to Ninh Binh tourists also visit the mysterious Mua Cave. Mua Cave is located in
posts.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh is not only an attractive destination for tourists with Tam Coc-Bich Dong, Bai Dinh-Trang An… but when coming to Ninh Binh tourists also visit the mysterious Mua Cave.

Mua Cave is located in the Trang An scenic complex, surrounded by limestone mountains, exuding a unique beauty. The highlight of Mua Cave is Mua Mountain, especially the unique constructions.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ninh Binh, visit Mua Cave, to get here, visitors must go up to the top of Mua Mountain through the stairs on both sides of the stone blocks that are very eye-catching, with carvings of majestic dragons and phoenixes in the folk culture of the Vietnamese people.

When conquering 486 stone steps, visitors will reach the top of Chua Mountain, from here visitors can fully admire the beauty of Tam Coc, below are the rice fields in autumn, the rice fields become a golden color, the undulating mountains, the boats drifting downstream, creating a beautiful countryside picture.

The most beautiful time to travel to Mua Cave is in May and June when the rice is ripe, stretching out in a brilliant yellow color, the natural scenery appears like a harmonious picture.

Mua Cave possesses natural beauty, in the ripe rice season combined with the green of the surrounding mountains and forests, a cool blue stream, visitors can experience rowing a boat to admire the picture that nature has graciously bestowed upon Ninh Binh.

In addition to the top of Mua Mountain, Ninh Binh also offers visitors beautiful sightseeing spots such as: the image of a dragon behind the statue of Buddha Quan Am, a waterfall that pierces the sky, and is also one of the highest peaks in Ninh Binh, and is also one of the virtual living spots that many tourists come to take virtual life. It can be said that Mua Cave, a place with beautiful natural scenery, has now become a diverse eco-tourism destination, combined with mountain climbing experiences, will bring visitors new experiences.
posts.excerptZh: 宁平不仅以三谷-碧洞、百顶-长安等景点吸引游客，来到宁平的游客还会前往神秘的穆洞参观。穆洞位于长安名胜群内，四周群山环抱，景色独具特色。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
宁平不仅以三谷-碧洞(Tam Coc-Bich Dong)、百顶-长安(Bai Dinh-Trang An)等景点吸引游客，来到宁平的游客还会前往神秘的穆洞(Mua Cave)参观。

穆洞位于长安名胜群内，四周群山环抱，石灰岩峰林，景色独具特色。穆洞的亮点是穆山(Mua Mountain)，尤其是山上独特的建筑。

如果有机会前往宁平旅行、参观穆洞，游客需要沿着两侧由巨石砌成的台阶登上穆山山顶，这些台阶十分引人注目，上面雕刻着越南民间文化中威严的龙与凤。

登上486级石阶后，游客便可到达山顶，在这里可以尽情欣赏三谷的美景：脚下是秋季的稻田，稻田染成一片金黄，群山起伏，小船顺流漂行，构成一幅美丽的田园画卷。

最适合前往穆洞旅行 的时间是五、六月稻谷成熟之时，金黄的稻田一望无际，自然风光宛如一幅和谐的画卷。

穆洞拥有天然之美，在稻谷成熟的季节，与周围青翠的山林和清凉碧蓝的溪水相映成趣，游客还可以体验划船，欣赏大自然慷慨赐予宁平的这幅美景。

除了穆山山顶之外，宁平还为游客提供了其他美丽的观景点，例如：观音佛像背后的龙形雕塑、直插云霄的瀑布，这里也是宁平最高的山峰之一，同时也是许多游客前来拍照打卡的热门景点。可以说，穆洞这处自然风光优美的地方，如今已成为多元化的生态旅游目的地，结合登山体验，将为游客带来全新的感受。
