posts.contentHtmlZh:
Vietlook Travel 与您分享游览岘港–会安需要了解的事项，请参考，以获得最完美、最愉快的旅程。除了岘港著名的风景外，游客还可以沉浸在大海和岛屿的碧蓝海水中，参与海上的精彩游戏。

1. 前往岘港–会安的最佳时间是什么时候？

前往会安的理想时间是一年的前3个月或农历新年期间。这是一个美丽的时节，气候凉爽，阳光柔和。如果您想沉浸在热闹的氛围中，应该在春节期间前往会安。

如果您喜欢观海、游泳或享受热闹的海上节庆，请在每年4月至7月底的夏季前往岘港，因为秋季海上常有大风浪，不适合去海滩，冬季天气相当寒冷，适合度假 岘港之旅。

因此，如果您想沉浸在春天的色彩中，请在春季前往岘港–会安，加入欢乐的春日氛围，春花盛开，尤其是巴拿山顶在热闹氛围中举行的郁金香节。

2. 岘港与会安之间的出行方式

岘港和会安相距不远，因此您可以通过不同的交通工具往返两地，例如：

摩托车：从岘港前往会安一日游，您可以跨过韩江大桥，然后沿着岘港–会安省道行驶，全长约30公里。或者您可以沿1号国道向南行驶，左转进入 Vinh Dien 街，再转入 Huynh Thuc Khang 街即可到达会安，全长约40公里。

公交车：岘港和会安之间有公交车服务。您可以在岘港或会安公交站乘坐01路公交车往返两地。行程时间可能较长，不过这种公共交通对游客来说不如骑摩托车或乘出租车方便。

出租车：是游客游览的便捷交通工具，司机会为您指路，岘港和会安之间的车费不算太贵。

3. 前往岘港–会安住在哪里？

在您规划行程时，这个问题已经变得非常常见。岘港是旅游业发展强劲的中心，无论是酒店服务、汽车旅馆还是高端度假村都很齐全。不过，如何选择酒店取决于您的预算。

在岘港–会安，如果您的预算充裕，可以选择四至五星级酒店，客房都拥有美丽的海滩或城市景观，例如岘港铂尔曼海滩度假村（Pullman Danang Beach Resort）和岘港悦榕庄（Fusion Maia Danang），一定会给游客带来绝佳的体验。

会安有许多不同类型的住宿，包括招待所、汽车旅馆、中档酒店和豪华度假村。如果您想要更经济的体验，可以选择招待所或中档酒店，但如果您预算充足，选择四星或五星级酒店和度假村是正确的选择。

因此，当您前往会安或岘港时，有不同的价位可供选择。您应该选择靠近美溪海滩或韩江大桥的酒店，方便观光。

4. 会安–岘港必游旅游景点

来到岘港–会安，这里有数不尽的绝美风光，当您选择这两个目的地度假时，一定会带给您最愉快的假期，您应该了解的景点有

山茶半岛（Son Tra）

被比作城市中心一颗珍贵宝石的地方。除了充满活力、多样而富有诗意的风景外，山茶半岛还是一处拥有迷人地标的精神旅游目的地。

山茶之旅的第一站是 Ban Co 峰。要到达 Ba Co 峰，您需要穿越一条沿海蜿蜒曲折的小径，穿过原始森林，沿途可欣赏壮丽的山脉景色。从 Ban Co 峰，您会感觉仿佛进入了仙境，风景如诗，还有一尊看起来像金刚坐着的巨型雕像。

美溪海滩（My Khe）

这是地球上最美丽的海滩之一，海水碧蓝清澈，沙滩绵长，是每年夏天最美的避暑之地。此外，游客还可以体验冲浪、划船或摩托艇。尤其是观赏日落或日出，构成一幅美丽的画面。

岘港猴岛

山茶半岛又称猴山，栖息着许多珍稀濒危的动植物物种，如红腿白臀叶猴——灵长类动物中的“女王”、金丝猴、蟒蛇、红脸鸡等。

在山茶山顶，有一尊巨大的石猴雕像，象征着这些灵长类动物的栖息地。此外，游客可以在 DRT 无线电站从500多米的高度欣赏岘港海滩的全景。探索建于20世纪60年代的美军雷达站，绰号为“东海之眼”。

穿越森林徒步前往直升机停机坪，探索茂盛的热带动植物。尤其是在近千年树龄的榕树上观察顽皮的叶猴。

山茶岬（Mui Nghe）

位于山茶半岛东南部，Mui Nghe（又称 Hon Nghe），当第一缕阳光照在 Mui Nghe 上时，看起来像是一块伸入海中的岩石，宛如一头卧在水面上的雄狮。

从山茶岬，游客可以看到碧蓝清澈的海水，这里栖息着石斑鱼和鲷鱼。游客可以放下鱼竿钓鱼，将渔获带回去加工后立即享用，再没有比这更有趣的事了。

如果游览岘港–会安，除了欣赏风景，游客还可以前往 Mui Nghe 体验水肺潜水，探索璀璨迷人的珊瑚礁。

李山岛（Ly Son）

这是许多游客每年夏天都会前来的目的地，这里不仅以著名的风景或绿色的蒜田吸引游客，来到李山岛，游客还会邂逅拥有美丽海景的豪华度假村。

李山由三座岛屿组成：大岛、小岛和 Mu Cu 岛，象征着人与自然的和谐连接。来到李山，您可以租帐篷，欣赏风景，沉浸在大自然中，品尝当地特色美食，如：木薯叶饼、蛤蜊壳、帝王蟹和李山蒜拌沙拉等……

此外，如果您有机会前往岘港–李山岛旅行，参观著名景点如：To Vo 门、洞寺（Hang Pagoda）、Cau 洞和 Thoi Loi 峰等……将给您带来最难忘的体验，尤其是夏季天气炎热晴朗、没有风暴，是您游览或在海边露营的理想时节。

占婆岛（Cu Lao Cham）

这里被誉为大洋中的绿色明珠。全年气候凉爽，郁郁葱葱的绿意覆盖全岛，占婆岛被联合国教科文组织认定为生物圈保护区，是旅行者的旅游天堂。

占婆岛生态保护区栖息着许多种鱼类、海洋生物、色彩斑斓的珊瑚礁、海藻、海草以及珍稀的动植物。

除了丰富多样的自然风光，占婆岛还是一处保存着许多占族人文化和宗教遗迹的地方，这些遗迹留存至今。此外，还有可追溯至数百年前的古老建筑。

岘港珍珠岛

又称 Hon Son Tra Con、Hon Son Cha、Cu Lao Han、玉岛（Dao Ngoc）、Hon Cho、Hon Chao 岛。该岛离韩江上的码头非常近，从远处看，岛屿隆起如一只平底锅。来到这里，您可以一起点燃篝火，参与冲浪、滑翔伞、皮划艇或钓鱼等水上运动……将给游客带来最完美的假期，尤其是外国游客前往岘港–会安旅行时，常会游览 Hon Chao 岛，欣赏大自然赋予这里的美景。

5. 前往 岘港 –会安旅行吃什么？

岘港–会安不仅以著名的地标欢迎游客，这里还为游客带来美味诱人的菜肴，包括：

广南面（Quang noodles）：广南地区的著名菜肴，任何游客前往岘港旅行都会品尝广南面，感受中部美食带给游客的美味风味。

各类甜汤：这是清淡的小吃之一，但深受许多食客尤其是年轻人的喜爱，当中部地区天气进入夏季时，您可以享用一杯甜汤，看风景，享受海风吹来的清凉，再没有比这更有趣的事了。

海鲜：岘港会安以众多新鲜海鲜而闻名，岘港的海鲜是人们在渔船刚靠岸时直接购买的，因此有机会踏足这里时一定要品尝。

Banh Can、Banh Xeo（煎饼）：虽然这些饼清淡，但会给食客带来非常独特的风味，因为这里的饼有着非常独特的味道、香气和酥脆感。

Cao Lau（高楼面）：这道面食看起来与广南面颇为相似，但面条是用米粉和树灰手工制成的。这道菜配以用猪皮、新鲜蔬菜、虾和肉熬制的浓汤，形成美味独特的中部美食风味。

Vietlook Travel 为您带来了一些关于游览岘港–会安的经验信息，包含游览景点、美食和住宿的详细资讯，希望能帮助您的旅程最愉快，无论您去哪里，Vietlook Travel 始终是您的旅伴，陪伴您探索新的土地。

posts.title: Things to know when traveling to Vietnam
posts.excerpt: You are planning to visit Vietnam to enjoy the scenery and experience the diverse culture. So today Vietlook Travel will share with you the most complete and concise things to know when traveling to V
posts.contentHtml:
You are planning to visit Vietnam to enjoy the scenery and experience the diverse culture. So today Vietlook Travel will share with you the most complete and concise things to know when traveling to Vietnam. Please refer to the content below.

1. Essential items when traveling Vietnam you should know

Passport

A passport is the first necessary document no matter where you go, when leaving the country you live in you need to bring it, this is a mandatory identification document that must be carried with you, and must be valid for at least 6 months. If you are planning to go abroad and do not have a passport, please contact the Immigration Department (under the local police in the province/city where you reside) to apply, or apply directly online. In case you already have a passport but it is torn, please immediately notify the Immigration Department where you applied for a passport and request a reissue.

Visas

Except for countries that have visa exemption agreements for Vietnamese passport holders, all other countries require tourists to have a visa when entering their country. To apply for a visa, you need to go through the visa application process at the Embassy or Consulate General.

Foreign tourists who are currently abroad and want to enter Vietnam can directly apply for an e-visa to Vietnam or through an inviting organization or individual to be sponsored. The Vietnam e-visa is valid for a single entry and is valid for no more than 30 days.

Visa application procedures vary by country and the level of difficulty in applying for a visa also varies. Some countries that are difficult to apply for a visa include: the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, Japan, Korea and Macau.

Wallets and bank cards

Wallets and bank cards are essential items that you need to prepare and check carefully before traveling anywhere, they are very necessary for you to pay for your travel expenses. You should prepare both cash and money in your ATM account higher than your initial spending plan because there may be unexpected expenses.

If you are traveling abroad, you can go to the bank to exchange money in advance instead of exchanging money at the airport, because the fee will be lower.

Luggage

You should learn about the places you are going to, check the weather to match the beautiful clothes, and what to carry and what to check in before going on a tour of Vietnam.

Carry-on luggage: According to the regulations of airlines, Business class passengers are allowed to carry 02 pieces of carry-on luggage, while Economy class passengers are allowed to carry 01 piece of carry-on luggage, each piece weighing no more than 7kg and measuring no more than 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 × 14 × 9 inches).

Checked baggage: Depending on the airline, service class and flight route, there will be different regulations on checked baggage. Normally, low-cost airlines will charge for checked baggage, while other airlines will exempt a certain weight of checked baggage.

Travel Guides and Maps

Whether you are booking a Vietnam tour or traveling independently, travel guidebooks and maps are always necessary. Guidebooks can be purchased at bookstores, and maps can be purchased at the airport.

2. Basic notes when preparing to travel to Vietnam

Choose the best travel agency in Vietnam. If this is your first time in Vietnam, you should consider reputable travel agencies, which is important when you do not know reputable travel agencies for the first time. Therefore, you should pay attention to the following priorities:

The address of the travel agency must be public, the website must be deleted, the phone number must be public and not blocked from strangers, the tour content must be transparent even outside of business hours, departure time, tour price, conditions for complete cancellation, children’s prices, airfare, airport pick-up time… must be displayed publicly and displayed on the website or group tours in Vietnam.

Age of operation: Before registering for the best Vietnam tour, visitors should also learn about the history of the company’s formation and development. Of course, reputable travel agencies will exist for a long time, because tourism is not a new industry, and tourism has been discovered for a long time and is developing very strongly.

Professional working style: An honest and legitimate travel agency will certainly train a team of professional staff. Through the way of working and guiding Vietnamese tourism when customers book a tour, customers can evaluate which company is of high quality or a scam tool.

Choose a Vietnam tour service that suits your needs and interests

There are often some travel companies that are willing to sell Vietnam tour services at very cheap prices, or 0 VND tours, however, these tours will not guarantee quality, and they will also introduce you to famous tourist attractions with high fees. Therefore, you should consider and choose for yourself suitable and affordable tours so that you can visit happily and not incur any additional costs when you have registered for a package tour.

Therefore, if you want to go on a quality tour, the amount of money you spend must correspond to the value of the tour, you should not choose tours that are too cheap, poor quality will affect your trip. Therefore, you should consider carefully before going on a tour to Vietnam or anywhere else.

Learn about Vietnamese culture and laws before you arrive.

Cultural and legal differences are one of the common reasons for misunderstandings between locals and tourists. In some cases, locals may even feel offended.

When you come to Vietnam, a country with friendly and hospitable people and an open culture to the world, preparing some knowledge about the culture in advance will make your visit to Vietnam more convenient and meaningful than ever.

Buy travel insurance

After preparing all the necessary items in your suitcase, don’t forget an essential item for every trip: international travel insurance. Many people ignore this important factor, feeling that it is unnecessary. However, when something unexpected happens, they may regret not having enough budget or language skills to handle it.

In some cases, overseas travel insurance is mandatory when applying for a visa to enter another country, such as Australia. If you have never purchased this product before, you can refer to and choose to buy insurance for your own safety.

3. Top 10 tourist destinations in Vietnam you should visit at least once in your life.

Sapa

A destination chosen by many tourists, a year-round tourist destination, Sapa will bring visitors a unique beauty each season, spring weather with flowers competing to show off their bright colors such as cherry blossoms, apricot blossoms, plum blossoms… In the summer, Sapa welcomes visitors with the pouring water season, in the fall with golden rice fields, in the winter Sapa is immersed in pure white snow…

In addition, when coming to Sapa, visitors can experience campfires, visit villages or freely take virtual photos at luxury resorts, and enjoy delicious and attractive dishes and experience the life of the people in the Northwest highlands.

Hue

A place with a solemn and ancient beauty, a gentle beauty expressed through traditional ao dai, conical hats and the graceful beauty of Hue girls, with elegant culture and poetic scenery? Hue has left visitors with the most beautiful impressions during the tour. If you come to Hue, remember to visit the citadel to admire and learn about the historical significance of this place.

Hue Citadel is the home of many kings throughout history, and you will discover many interesting things, especially the excellent Hue cuisine, especially for those who love spicy food.

Phan Thiet

When talking about Phan Thiet, people immediately know that there are clear blue beaches and luxurious resorts that will bring visitors the most interesting experiences.

Phu Quoc

A destination chosen by many tourists, you can go to Phu Quoc at any time of the year. If you have the opportunity to travel to Phu Quoc, visit destinations such as Bai Dai, Bai Sao, VinWonders Phu Quoc, Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc, Grand World…

It can be said that Phu Quoc still retains its pristine beauty with turquoise beaches, long stretches of white sand, and rows of coconut trees swaying in the wind. This is an ideal resort destination for tourists who love to admire the beauty of nature and admire the beauty of the sea and islands.

 

Nha Trang

A 4-season stopover, a place to welcome visitors with poetic beaches, visitors should visit the 4-island tour and scenic areas of Hon Tre, Hon Tam, Hon Mun, Hon Mot or famous destinations such as: VinWonders Nha Trang, Hon Mun Island, Ponagar Tower…

In addition, visitors can also visit the beautiful beaches or experience walking on Diep Son beach with clear blue water, admire the panoramic view, and enjoy fresh seafood, especially lobster of Binh Ba island… and many more famous specialties waiting for visitors to discover.

Da Nang – Hoi An

Famous tourist destination in the Central region, with famous landmarks, exciting sea games, and a 5-star resort located majestically on the sea will bring visitors the most interesting experiences.

Hoi An Ancient Town, visitors will immerse themselves in the space of the Old Town with lantern lights, or stroll along the Thu Bon River, ancient houses hundreds of years old, or check-in areas chosen by many tourists.

Ha Long Bay

As one of the famous tourist destinations in Northern Vietnam, with thousands of large and small islands, the natural landscape always captivates people. In addition, this is also a place where you can enjoy fresh seafood. For tourists looking for a tour near Hanoi, Ha Long Bay is the destination for you.

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour of Vietnam, you should choose to visit Ha Long Bay, you will be able to see with your own eyes the most interesting things that nature has bestowed upon this place, and enjoy delicious and attractive dishes or experience on a 5-star Ha Long cruise will bring visitors the most unforgettable experience.

Da Lat

Da Lat is a dreamy city that makes any visitor who sets foot in Da Lat admire, with the sound of pine trees chirping, flowers blooming in competition, or green vegetable fields, besides, if you want to experience a peaceful feeling, experience cycling to admire the beauty of the city.

Ca Mau

A place with beautiful natural scenery, with gentle and hospitable people, when traveling to the West of Ca Mau, visitors can take a boat to admire the beauty of the river or visit the floating markets with goods displayed right on the boats, a bustling market between buyers and sellers of the typical culture of the river region.

Ca Mau with its lush green forests and sparkling sea like a paradise on earth. For a complete travel experience, let’s travel with Vietlook to explore the beauty of Ca Mau today.

Currently, Vietlook Travel is proud to be a reputable Vietnam tour provider in Hanoi, a unit that connects, guides and brings interesting experiences to tourists on each journey to the beautiful lands of Vietnam and the cultures of countries around the world.

Vietook Travel always aims to meet the diverse needs of customers and flexible tour packages according to the requirements and preferences of each desired trip. The types of tours are diverse based on the geographical characteristics, purposes, activities and cultural characteristics of each region. Tourists can choose to experience an 8-day Vietnam tour or a tour in Vietnam according to a private tour schedule, Vietnam resort tours, including:

  • Vietnam Northern Tour
  • Vietnam Hanoi Tour
  • Vietnam Da Nang Tour
  • Vietnam Saigon Tour
  • Vietnam Small Group Tour
  • Vietnam Motorbike Tour
  • Vietnam Small Town Tour
  • Vietnam Hiking Tour
  • Vietnam Jeep Tour
  • Vietnam Mountain Climbing Tour
  • Vietnam Mekong River Tour
  • Vietnam Luxury Golf Tour

All Vietnam tours promise to bring you interesting and attractive experiences, exploring many destinations at affordable prices. For first-time travelers, choosing to go on a package tour is also a reasonable choice, because Vietnam tour packages will help you have a meaningful and fun-filled trip.

posts.contentHtmlZh:
您正计划前往越南欣赏风光、体验多元文化。 因此，今天 Vietlook Travel 将为您分享最完整、最简明的越南旅行须知。请参阅以下内容。

1. 越南旅行 必备物品须知

护照

无论去哪里，护照都是第一份必备证件。离开所居住的国家时必须随身携带，这是必须随身携带的强制性身份证件，且有效期至少需在6个月以上。如果您打算出国但还没有护照，请联系出入境管理部门（隶属于您居住的省/市地方公安机关）办理，或直接在线申请。如果您已有护照但已破损，请立即通知办理护照的出入境管理部门并申请补发。

签证

除与越南护照持有人互免签证的国家外，其他所有国家都要求游客入境时持有签证。申请签证需要前往大使馆或总领事馆办理签证申请手续。

目前身在国外、想要入境越南的外国游客，可以直接申请越南电子签证，或通过邀请机构或个人担保办理。越南电子签证为单次入境，有效期不超过30天。

各国的签证申请程序各不相同，申请难度也不一样。签证较难申请的国家包括：美国、加拿大、欧洲、澳大利亚、日本、韩国和澳门。

钱包和银行卡

在前往任何地方旅行之前，钱包和银行卡都是需要准备并仔细检查的必备物品，它们对支付旅行费用非常必要。您应准备现金，并让银行账户中的资金高于最初的开支计划，因为可能会有意外支出。

如果您出国旅行，可以提前到银行兑换货币，而不是在机场兑换，因为手续费会更低。

行李

您应当了解将要前往的地方，查看天气以搭配合适的漂亮衣物，并了解在参加越南旅行前哪些物品随身携带、哪些需要托运。

随身行李：根据航空公司的规定，商务舱乘客可携带2件随身行李，经济舱乘客可携带1件随身行李，每件重量不超过7公斤，尺寸不超过56 x 36 x 23厘米（22 × 14 × 9英寸）。

托运行李：根据航空公司、舱位等级和航线的不同，托运行李的规定也有所不同。通常，廉价航空公司会对托运行李收费，而其他航空公司则会免除一定重量的托运行李。

旅行指南和地图

无论您是预订 越南旅游团 还是自由行，旅行指南和地图始终都是必需的。旅行指南可以在书店购买，地图可以在机场购买。

2. 准备前往越南旅行的基本注意事项

选择越南最好的旅行社。如果这是您第一次来越南，应该考虑信誉良好的旅行社，在初次不了解哪些旅行社值得信赖的情况下，这一点非常重要。因此，您应注意以下几个优先事项：

旅行社的地址必须公开，网站必须正常运营，电话号码必须公开且不会拒接陌生来电，即使在营业时间以外，行程内容也必须透明，出发时间、团费、完全取消的条件、儿童价格、机票、接机时间等都必须在网站或越南团体游中公开展示。

经营年限：在报名最好的越南旅游团之前，游客还应了解公司的成立和发展历史。当然，信誉良好的旅行社会长期存在，因为旅游业并非新兴行业，旅游早已被发掘并蓬勃发展。

专业的工作作风：诚实合法的旅行社一定会培训一支专业的员工队伍。通过客户预订行程时的工作方式和越南旅游讲解，客户可以评判哪家公司品质优良，哪家是诈骗工具。

选择符合您需求和兴趣的越南旅游服务

常常有一些旅行社愿意以非常低廉的价格，甚至0越南盾的价格销售越南旅游服务，然而，这些行程无法保证质量，而且还会把您带到收费很高的著名景点。因此，您应该自己考虑并选择合适且价格实惠的行程，这样在报名跟团游后才能开心游览，不会产生任何额外费用。

因此，如果想参加高品质的行程，您花费的金额必须与行程价值相符，不要选择过于便宜的行程，质量差会影响您的旅行。所以，在前往越南或其他任何地方旅游之前，应仔细考虑。

抵达之前先了解越南的文化和法律。

文化和法律上的差异是当地人与游客之间产生误会的常见原因之一。在某些情况下，当地人甚至可能感到被冒犯。

来到越南这个人民友好热情、文化对世界开放的国家，提前准备一些文化知识，将使您的越南之行比以往任何时候都更加便利而有意义。

购买旅行保险

在行李箱中备齐所有必需品之后，别忘了每次旅行都必不可少的一样东西：国际旅行保险。许多人忽视了这个重要因素，觉得没有必要。然而，当发生意外时，他们可能会后悔没有足够的预算或语言能力来应对。

在某些情况下，申请入境他国的签证时，海外旅行保险是强制性的，例如澳大利亚。如果您从未购买过这类产品，可以参考并选择购买保险，以保障自身安全。

3. 一生中至少应该去一次的越南十大旅游目的地。

沙坝

沙坝是许多游客选择的目的地，一年四季皆宜旅游，每个季节都会给游客带来独特的美景：春天百花争艳，樱花、杏花、梅花等竞相绽放；夏天迎来水量充沛的雨季；秋天是金黄的稻田；冬天的沙坝则沉浸在纯白的雪中……

此外，来到沙坝，游客可以体验篝火晚会、参观村寨，或在豪华度假村自由拍照，品尝美味诱人的菜肴，体验西北高原人民的生活。

顺化

这里有庄严古朴的美，通过传统奥黛、斗笠和顺化姑娘的优雅之美展现出温婉的美，拥有优雅的文化和如诗如画的风景。顺化给游客留下了旅途中最美的印象。如果来到顺化，记得参观皇城，欣赏并了解这里的历史意义。

顺化皇城是历代许多帝王的居所，您会发现许多有趣的事物，尤其是出色的顺化美食，特别适合喜欢吃辣的人。

潘切（Phan Thiet）

说起潘切，人们立刻会想到这里有清澈蔚蓝的海滩和豪华度假村，将为游客带来最有趣的体验。

富国岛

富国岛是许多游客选择的目的地，一年四季任何时候都可以前往。如果有机会去富国岛旅行，可以游览长滩（Bai Dai）、星滩（Bai Sao）、富国岛珍珠乐园（VinWonders Phu Quoc）、富国岛珍珠野生动物园（Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc）、Grand World 等景点……

可以说，富国岛依然保留着原始的美，拥有碧绿的海滩、绵长的白沙滩和随风摇曳的排排椰树。对于喜爱欣赏自然之美、欣赏海岛风光的游客来说，这里是理想的度假目的地。

 

芽庄

芽庄四季皆宜，以诗意的海滩迎接游客，游客应参加四岛游，游览蚕岛（Hon Tre）、Hon Tam、Hon Mun、Hon Mot等景区，或前往著名景点，如：芽庄珍珠乐园（VinWonders Nha Trang）、Hon Mun岛、婆那加占婆塔（Ponagar Tower）……

此外，游客还可以参观美丽的海滩，或体验漫步在水清澈湛蓝的Diep Son海滩，欣赏全景风光，品尝新鲜海鲜，尤其是平巴岛（Binh Ba）的龙虾……以及更多著名特产等待游客去发现。

岘港 – 会安

这是中部地区著名的旅游目的地，拥有著名的地标、刺激的海上游乐项目，以及巍然矗立在海边的五星级度假村，将为游客带来最有趣的体验。

在会安古镇，游客将沉浸在挂满灯笼的古城氛围中，或漫步秋盆河畔、欣赏数百年历史的古屋，或前往许多游客选择的打卡地点。

下龙湾

作为越南北部著名的旅游目的地之一，这里有成千上万大大小小的岛屿，自然景观总是令人着迷。此外，这里也是品尝新鲜海鲜的好地方。对于寻找河内周边行程的游客来说，下龙湾就是您的目的地。

如果有机会参加越南之旅，您应该选择游览下龙湾，亲眼目睹大自然赐予这片土地的最有趣的景象，品尝美味诱人的菜肴，或体验五星级下龙湾游轮，将为游客带来最难忘的体验。

大叻

大叻是一座如梦般的城市，让每一位踏足大叻的游客都为之赞叹，这里有松涛阵阵、百花争艳，或绿油油的蔬菜田。此外，如果您想体验宁静的感觉，可以体验骑自行车欣赏城市之美。

金瓯（Ca Mau）

这里拥有美丽的自然风光，人民温和好客。前往金瓯西部旅行时，游客可以乘船欣赏河流之美，或参观水上市场，货物就直接摆在船上，买卖双方热闹非凡，体现了河网地区的典型文化。

金瓯有郁郁葱葱的绿色森林和波光粼粼的大海，宛如人间天堂。想要获得完整的旅行体验，今天就与 Vietlook 一起去探索金瓯之美吧。

posts.contentHtml:
Accompanying Vietlook Travel to conquer the top hottest tourist destinations in Nha Trang that always captivate people, experiencing luxury resorts and enjoying delicious and attractive dishes, and freely checking in for yourself beautiful pictures on the beach of Nha Trang island is one of the fun vacations that Vietlook wants to accompany you.

1. About Nha Trang – Vietnam

Nha Trang is located in the East of Khanh Hoa province, 1,290km north of Hanoi, 45km from Cam Ranh city and 441km south of Ho Chi Minh city.

The East of the city borders the East Sea and has many beautiful beaches that are destinations chosen by many tourists. You can choose to travel Nha Trang and Khanh Hoa by any means such as: plane, train, bus, private car…

Nha Trang is located in the South Central Coast region of Vietnam. Therefore, Nha Trang city has a tropical monsoon climate, so the climate here is relatively mild with temperatures ranging from 26-27°C, so Nha Trang is a year-round destination.

2. Where to stay when traveling to Nha Trang?

Nha Trang has many 5-star hotels located in prime locations, with many different prices. In the summer, the beachfront hotels and Nha Trang island resorts are often fully booked early, while smaller hotels located in the city center are often cheaper and have more available rooms, making it convenient for those traveling to Nha Trang on their own.

Some high-quality hotels in Nha Trang city include: Queen Ann, TTC Hotel Premium, Eastin Grand, Ariyana Smart Condotel and Muong Thanh Luxury. For those who like to relax, you can choose Champa Island Resort, Amiana Resort, Diamond Bay Resort Spa or Merperle Hon Tam island resorts and Vinpearl Nha Trang.

3. Nha Trang tourist attractions

Hon Mun Island

As one of the most beautiful islands in Nha Trang Bay, Hon Mun is a destination chosen by many tourists, especially those traveling to Nha Trang in the summer. Hon Mun is located about 10km from Cau Da port and it takes about 20 minutes by canoe to get to the island for tourists to admire the vast scenery.

The highlight of Hon Mun is the prominent black rocks, clear blue sea water and beautiful natural scenery. When coming here, visitors can walk on the rocks and take memorable photos during their trip.

Hon Mun has a total area of ​​up to 160 km2, including 122 km2 of sea surface and 38 km2 of total island area, has a marine reserve with many rare marine species such as fish, coral, and is a place where swallows fly back to nest in black rock caves.

The wonderful thing about Hon Mun – Nha Trang is the convergence of two hot and cold ocean currents. One current flows down from the North and one flows up from the Equator. Therefore, marine species like to migrate here to live and reproduce, especially tropical corals and marine species.

Hon Mun has the highest coral yield in Vietnam and is ranked by WWF as the most diverse marine life area in Vietnam.

Coral Bay

Famous for its clear blue water, and home to many underwater activities such as: Scuba diving, sea walking and glass-bottom boat tours, visitors can admire the sparkling coral reefs, the ideal time to visit Nha Trang Coral Bay is from January to August. The peak season is from June to August, which is also the busiest time of year for Nha Trang tourism.

If you like to experience scuba diving to see Nha Trang coral, you should go to Coral Bay to experience it with a cost of 450,000 VND/dive, each dive usually lasts 30 minutes, you will dive with a professional guide. So you can rest assured to participate in the scuba diving service at Coral Bay.

Bai Tranh

About 500m long, surrounded by majestic mountains and forests. On one side is a fine white sand beach, on the other side are beautiful natural rocks, giving this place its own beauty, different from other scenic areas in Nha Trang, and is a destination chosen by many tourists.

Below is a clear blue beach, long stretches of white sand, surrounded by rows of cool green trees creating a beautiful picture that is both wild and poetic.

Tri Nguyen Aquarium

Tri Nguyen Aquarium, also known as Tri Nguyen Fish Pond, is located on Hon Mieu Island in the Nha Trang Bay archipelago, about 2km from Nha Trang Port. The aquarium is designed in the shape of a giant ship covered with moss, with mysterious stones and is a check-in point chosen by many tourists, especially young people who often visit this scenic area when coming to Nha Trang.

Nha Trang Aquarium is designed like a giant ship floating on the sea. Inside the ship there are many floors. The first floor is a fish pond, the second floor is a souvenir shop and the third floor is a restaurant.

The fish pond floor is located near sea level and is decorated in a cave style with many types of rocks, including four large fish tanks and some small tanks. Many marine creatures are displayed in their natural environment.

There are special fish species here where visitors can find small fish such as seahorses, a unique fish species with males carrying eggs and giving birth. Other rare fish species include Japanese carp, Napoleon fish, Picasso fish…

Nha Phu Bay

Nha Phu Bay, also known as Nha Phu Lagoon, is located about 15km north of Nha Trang city center. The tourist port is currently located in Luong Son commune, Vinh Luong, Nha Trang city. Nha Phu Bay is famous for its diverse terrain, including small islands, streams, seas, lakes, mountains and bays.

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour of Nha Trang, visit Nha Phu Bay to feel the natural beauty with long white sand beaches and diverse flora. In addition, there are many rare species of plants here.

Binh Ba Island

Nam in Cam Ranh is known as Lobster Island, one of the most beautiful tourist destinations that nature has bestowed on Nha Trang – Khanh Hoa. Binh Ba has many pristine beaches but still exudes a captivating charm, along with a rich and delicious seafood cuisine system that promises to bring unique and unforgettable experiences to visitors.

Binh Ba Island is quite far from the center, there are no restaurants or hotels like in the city. There are only homestays run by local people. However, you will experience the daily life of a fishing village with island fishermen.

Robinson Island

Located 20km from the mainland, Robinson Island Nha Trang is a small island in Cam Ranh Bay, Khanh Hoa Province. Robinson looks like a small valley in the middle of the ocean, where the climate is cool and peaceful with a 100km long white sand beach and clear blue sea water. Coming here, you will enjoy diving in the clear water or relax and enjoy the beautiful scenery with a cool glass of coconut water, giving visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

Diep Son Island

One of the most pristine and romantic islands in Nha Trang is a place blessed by nature with a natural and pristine beauty. From afar, Diep Son Island looks like a green silk strip with small islands gathered together, creating a colorful picture.

The special thing that attracts tourists to Diep Son Island is the unique sea walking path. This path is like a white silk strip separating the two islands. When walking on the path, visitors will feel like they are walking on the sea. Surrounded by the vast ocean, calm and gentle, it promises to be an extremely interesting experience that this place brings to visitors.

Hon Tre Island

Coming here, you will encounter a more bustling scene than other islands. Here, visitors also visit two large villages, Bich Dam and Vung Anh.

Hon Tre Island in Nha Trang has a small, beautiful and pristine beach, diverse and rich natural vegetation. If you look from above, you will see the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.

In addition, when you come to the island, you can also participate in many famous entertainment activities, resorts, and spas in Nha Trang. Especially when you come to Vinpearl Land, you can participate, besides that, there is also the Con Se Tre scenic area, which is a popular destination for many tourists.

Yen Island – Hon Noi

This is a cluster of islands, about 25km from Cau Da port, equivalent to 13 nautical miles, quite far, so if you go by boat, it will take you about 1 hour and 20 minutes to get to the island, but if you go by canoe, you can shorten the time for you to visit a lot.

Yen Island – Hon Noi is the habitat and living place of many species of swallows that nest and live on the island, every afternoon the birds fly in the sky, looking like a beautiful multi-colored picture that nature has bestowed on Nha Trang.

4. What to eat when traveling to Nha Trang?

Bird’s Nest: Nha Trang is one of the specialties that Nha Trang brings to tourists, tourists can not only enjoy but also bring back as gifts.

Sea ribs, Nha Trang lobster are attractive dishes chosen by many gourmet tourists when coming to Nha Trang, in addition, tourists also enjoy popular dishes such as snails, boho fish…

Jellyfish noodles are one of the freshest seafood in Nha Trang, jellyfish noodles with a cool taste, the dish chosen by most tourists in the summer.

Squid with tamarind sauce: A dish chosen by many tourists, a famous specialty of the Nha Trang island region.

Ninh Hoa sour sausage, tourists not only enjoy but also bring back as gifts when coming to Nha Trang.

5. Notes when visiting Nha Trang Island

Transportation: You can choose means of transportation in Nha Trang such as: Motorbike, taxi, canoe…, and you should find out in advance, especially means of transportation that require tickets and have schedules such as canoes, to avoid inconvenience during your tour.

Because of the hot summer weather, when going to Nha Trang Island, you should prepare sun protection items such as long-sleeved shirts, sunglasses, hats, sunscreen…

When visiting the islands in Nha Trang, you need to prepare personal documents, and find out which islands to visit, means of transportation, ticket prices to the islands in Nha Trang,…

You can also learn about local specialties to buy as gifts, and don’t forget to survey the prices before buying to avoid being charged too high.

Vietlook Travel hopes that through this article, we will share with you the most useful information about Nha Trang Island, Vietnam for your upcoming trip. Under the gentle sunlight, the shyness of Nha Trang beach appears like a watercolor painting with its own unique features.

Discover the sea and islands of Nha Trang – Vietnam, this is also an attractive destination for tourists to visit. It can be said that when you come here, you can not only immerse yourself in the cool sea water but also enjoy endless entertainment, delicious and attractive dishes, and when you return, you will not forget to make a date to return. Especially for foreign tourists when going on a tour Vietnam, they all visit and admire the beauty of Nha Trang.
posts.excerptZh: 与Vietlook Travel一起征服芽庄始终令人着迷的最热门旅游目的地，体验豪华度假村，品尝美味诱人的菜肴，并在芽庄岛的海滩上自由拍下美丽的照片，是Vietlook希望陪伴您的有趣假期之一。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
与Vietlook Travel一起征服芽庄始终令人着迷的最热门旅游目的地，体验豪华度假村，品尝美味诱人的菜肴，并在芽庄岛的海滩上自由拍下美丽的照片，是Vietlook希望陪伴您的有趣假期之一。

1. 关于芽庄 – 越南

芽庄位于庆和省东部，距河内以北1,290公里，距金兰（Cam Ranh）市45公里，距胡志明市以南441公里。

城市东部与东海接壤，有许多美丽的海滩，是许多游客选择的目的地。您可以选择乘坐飞机、火车、长途汽车、私家车等任何交通方式 游览芽庄 和庆和。

芽庄位于越南中南部沿海地区。因此芽庄市属热带季风气候，这里的气候相对温和，气温在26-27°C之间，所以芽庄是全年适宜的目的地。

2. 前往芽庄旅游住哪里？

芽庄有许多位于黄金地段的5星级酒店，价格各异。夏季，海滨酒店和芽庄岛度假村往往很早就订满，而位于市中心的小型酒店通常更便宜，空房更多，方便自助前往芽庄的人。

芽庄市的一些高品质酒店包括：Queen Ann、TTC Hotel Premium、Eastin Grand、Ariyana Smart Condotel和Muong Thanh Luxury。对于喜欢放松的人，可以选择Champa Island Resort、Amiana Resort、Diamond Bay Resort Spa或Merperle Hon Tam岛度假村以及芽庄Vinpearl。

3. 芽庄旅游景点

黑岛（Hon Mun）

作为芽庄湾最美的岛屿之一，黑岛是许多游客选择的目的地，尤其是夏季前往芽庄旅游的游客。黑岛距离Cau Da港约10公里，乘快艇约20分钟即可抵达岛上，供游客欣赏辽阔的风光。

黑岛的亮点是突出的黑色岩石、清澈碧蓝的海水和美丽的自然风光。来到这里，游客可以在岩石上漫步，并在旅途中拍下难忘的照片。

黑岛总面积达160平方公里，其中海面122平方公里，岛屿总面积38平方公里，设有拥有鱼类、珊瑚等许多珍稀海洋物种的海洋保护区，也是燕子飞回黑岩洞穴筑巢的地方。

黑岛 – 芽庄的奇妙之处在于冷暖两股洋流的交汇。一股洋流从北方流下，一股从赤道流上。因此海洋物种喜欢迁徙到这里生活和繁殖，尤其是热带珊瑚和海洋物种。

黑岛是越南珊瑚产量最高的地方，被世界自然基金会（WWF）评为越南海洋生物最多样化的区域。

珊瑚湾（Coral Bay）

以清澈碧蓝的海水而闻名，是许多水下活动的家园，例如：水肺潜水、海底漫步和玻璃底船游览，游客可以欣赏闪闪发光的珊瑚礁，游览芽庄珊瑚湾的理想时间是1月至8月。旺季是6月至8月，这也是芽庄旅游一年中最繁忙的时候。

如果您喜欢体验水肺潜水观赏芽庄珊瑚，应该前往珊瑚湾体验，费用为450,000 VND/次潜水，每次潜水通常持续30分钟，您将在专业向导的陪同下潜水。因此您可以放心参加珊瑚湾的水肺潜水服务。

Bai Tranh

长约500米，被雄伟的山脉和森林环绕。一侧是细腻的白沙滩，另一侧是美丽的天然岩石，使这里拥有独特的美，不同于芽庄的其他风景区，是许多游客选择的目的地。

下方是清澈碧蓝的海滩，绵长的白沙，周围是成排清凉的绿树，构成一幅既原始又富有诗意的美丽画卷。

Tri Nguyen水族馆

Tri Nguyen水族馆，又称Tri Nguyen鱼塘，位于芽庄湾群岛中的Hon Mieu岛上，距离芽庄港约2公里。水族馆设计成一艘覆盖苔藓的巨型船只形状，带有神秘的石头，是许多游客选择的打卡点，尤其是年轻人，来到芽庄时常参观这个风景区。

芽庄水族馆设计得像一艘漂浮在海上的巨型船。船内有很多层。一楼是鱼塘，二楼是纪念品店，三楼是餐厅。

鱼塘层靠近海平面，以洞穴风格装饰，有多种岩石，包括四个大鱼缸和一些小鱼缸。许多海洋生物在自然环境中展出。

这里有特殊的鱼类，游客可以发现海马等小鱼，海马是一种独特的鱼类，由雄性携卵并产仔。其他珍稀鱼类包括日本锦鲤、拿破仑鱼、毕加索鱼……

芽富湾（Nha Phu）

芽富湾，又称芽富泻湖，位于芽庄市中心以北约15公里处。旅游港口目前位于芽庄市永良（Vinh Luong）的良山（Luong Son）社。芽富湾以多样的地形而闻名，包括小岛、溪流、大海、湖泊、山脉和海湾。

如果您有机会参加芽庄之旅，请参观芽富湾，感受那里绵长白沙滩和多样植物的自然之美。此外，这里还有许多珍稀的植物物种。

平巴岛（Binh Ba）

位于金兰的南部，被称为龙虾岛，是大自然赐予芽庄 – 庆和最美的旅游目的地之一。平巴有许多原始的海滩，却依然散发着迷人的魅力，加上丰富美味的海鲜美食体系，有望给游客带来独特而难忘的体验。

平巴岛离市中心相当远，没有像城市里那样的餐厅或酒店。只有当地人经营的民宿。不过，您将与岛上渔民一起体验渔村的日常生活。

鲁滨逊岛（Robinson）

芽庄鲁滨逊岛距离大陆20公里，是庆和省金兰湾的一座小岛。鲁滨逊看起来像大洋中的一个小山谷，气候凉爽宁静，拥有100公里长的白沙滩和清澈碧蓝的海水。来到这里，您将在清澈的海水中潜水，或放松身心，一边享用一杯清凉的椰子水一边欣赏美丽的风景，给游客带来最愉悦的假期。

Diep Son岛

芽庄最原始、最浪漫的岛屿之一，是受大自然眷顾、拥有天然原始之美的地方。远远望去，Diep Son岛宛如一条绿色的丝带，小岛聚集在一起，构成一幅色彩缤纷的画卷。

吸引游客前往Diep Son岛的特别之处是独特的海上步道。这条路像一条白色的丝带，分隔着两座岛屿。走在路上，游客会感觉像是走在海面上。周围是辽阔的海洋，平静而温和，有望成为这里给游客带来的极其有趣的体验。

Hon Tre岛（竹岛）

来到这里，您会遇到比其他岛屿更热闹的景象。在这里，游客还会参观两个大村庄，Bich Dam和Vung Anh。

芽庄的Hon Tre岛拥有小巧、美丽而原始的海滩，自然植被多样而丰富。如果您从空中俯瞰，将看到大自然赐予这里的美。

此外，来到岛上，您还可以参加芽庄许多著名的娱乐活动、度假村和水疗。特别是来到Vinpearl Land，您可以参与其中，此外，还有Con Se Tre风景区，是许多游客的热门目的地。

燕岛（Yen）– Hon Noi

这是一个岛群，距离Cau Da港约25公里，相当于13海里，相当远，所以如果乘船，大约需要1小时20分钟才能抵达岛上，但如果乘快艇，可以大大缩短您的参观时间。

燕岛 – Hon Noi是许多种燕子在岛上筑巢生活的栖息地和生活场所，每天下午鸟儿飞翔在空中，宛如大自然赐予芽庄的一幅美丽的多彩画卷。

4. 前往芽庄旅游吃什么？

燕窝：芽庄是芽庄带给游客的特产之一，游客不仅可以品尝，还可以带回去作为礼物。

海排骨、芽庄龙虾是许多美食游客来到芽庄时选择的诱人菜肴，此外，游客还享用螺、boho鱼等大众菜肴……

海蜇面是芽庄最新鲜的海鲜之一，海蜇面口感清凉，是大多数游客在夏季选择的菜肴。

罗望子酱鱿鱼：许多游客选择的一道菜，是芽庄岛地区著名的特产。

宁和（Ninh Hoa）酸肠，游客来到芽庄时不仅品尝，还会带回去作为礼物。

5. 游览芽庄岛的注意事项

交通：您可以选择芽庄的交通工具，例如：摩托车、出租车、快艇……并且应提前了解，特别是需要购票且有班次的交通工具如快艇，以避免在旅途中造成不便。

由于夏季天气炎热，前往芽庄岛时，您应准备防晒用品，如长袖衬衫、太阳镜、帽子、防晒霜……

参观芽庄的岛屿时，您需要准备个人证件，并了解要参观哪些岛屿、交通工具、前往芽庄各岛的门票价格……

您还可以了解当地特产以购买作为礼物，别忘了在购买前调查价格，以避免被收取过高的价格。

Vietlook Travel希望通过本文，与您分享关于越南芽庄岛的最有用信息，为您即将到来的旅程提供帮助。在柔和的阳光下，芽庄海滩的羞涩宛如一幅带有独特风格的水彩画。

探索越南芽庄的海洋和岛屿，这也是吸引游客参观的目的地。可以说，来到这里，您不仅可以沉浸在清凉的海水中，还可以享受无尽的娱乐、美味诱人的菜肴，回去时您不会忘记约定再次回来。尤其是外国游客在参加 越南之旅时，都会参观并欣赏芽庄之美。

Top spiritual tourist destinations in Vietnam, please refer to before traveling Vietnam, to have the most enjoyable trip, especially those who are looking for spiritual tourist destinations that not only help connect with the gods but also help people find peace in their souls.

On a pilgrimage trip, you will find the sacred, which will bring you many wonderful experiences. You will discover many things after each pilgrimage. Go on a pilgrimage today to find serenity to dispel the hustle and bustle of daily work. Below are the best destinations that Vietlook Travel wants to introduce to you!

Top 8 most sacred pagodas in Vietnam, please refer to before setting foot here, visit and pray, and wish for health and peace, please refer to them.

Perfume Pagoda

As one of the top spiritual destinations in Vietnam, it attracts many Buddhists and tourists to burn incense and pray for health and peace. Every year, during the Perfume Pagoda festival (January of the lunar calendar), thousands of people from all over the world come here to worship at the pagoda, including foreign tourists who travel to Vietnam. They come to the pagoda to burn incense and pray and join in the atmosphere of the pagoda festival.

If you are planning to go on a pilgrimage, join Vietook Travel to Perfume Pagoda, you will immerse yourself in a peaceful, quiet space and feel the spiritual power of people with the same faith and belief.

Perfume Pagoda is considered a spiritual paradise with pristine beauty, fresh nature and unique architecture, surrounded by limestone mountains, waterfalls, caves and green forests or clear streams. You will enjoy the quiet spiritual space and feel the serenity and peace in this spiritual space.

In addition, you can participate in Buddhist ceremonies, pray, perform rituals and burn incense, or you can also find a quiet corner to meditate, focus on your inner self, and pray for health, happiness and peace for your loved ones and family.

A trip to Huong Pagoda will help you find empathy and connection with the Buddhist community, helping you reduce stress and anxiety while seeking peace and direction for the future.

Yen Tu Pagoda

A famous spiritual place in Vietnam, attracting many tourists to pray for peace of mind. A pilgrimage to Yen Tu Pagoda will bring you a sense of serenity, peace and a brighter soul.

Coming to the pagoda, you can participate in spiritual activities such as worshiping Buddha, praying, releasing statues and burning incense.

Especially when conquering the top of Yen Tu mountain, it will be a memorable experience, you will see the beautiful and peaceful panorama.

Yen Tu Pagoda has a special history and spirituality in Buddhist beliefs. This is where King Tran Nhan Tong practiced and founded Yen Tu Zen sect, one of the largest Zen sects of Dai Viet during the Tran Dynasty.

In addition, Yen Tu Pagoda also has unique architectural works such as: Kinh Thien Bridge, Bao Linh Pagoda, Dai Bi Palace, Tran Nhan Tong Temple, … All create a sacred and solemn space, helping you feel the peace and tranquility in your soul.

It can be said that on a pilgrimage to Yen Tu Pagoda, you will feel the unique and distinctive features of spiritual beliefs in Vietnam. You will find peace in your soul and feel the power of faith and Buddhism.

Bai Dinh Pagoda

As one of the famous spiritual tourist destinations in Vietnam, attracting thousands of Buddhists and tourists to visit, pray and seek peace of mind. Bai Dinh Pagoda is a large spiritual architectural work in the North.

Every year, the pagoda holds many traditional Buddhist prayer sessions to pray for blessings and peace. If you are planning to go on a pilgrimage, Bai Dinh Pagoda is a destination for you, especially for tourists who travel Ninh Binh for the first time in the spring, they all visit Bai Dinh Pagoda to visit and offer incense to pray to feel the feeling of lightness and serenity. Besides performing the pagoda’s prayer rituals, you can also explore the unique architectural works and the most notable highlight of Bai Dinh Pagoda – the giant Amitabha Buddha statue 10 meters high and weighing up to 60 tons.

This is one of the largest Buddha statues in Vietnam and is considered a unique sculpture by Vietnamese artisans.

Besides the Amitabha Buddha statue, Bai Dinh Pagoda also has many other beautiful and unique sculptures such as: Tam Thap statue, Buddha statue, Bai Dinh Pagoda gate, …

Ba Vang Pagoda is known as an ancient pagoda, where many Buddhists come to pray. Especially on traditional holidays, the first or middle of the lunar month, or Buddhist prayer chanting sessions are often held at the pagoda.

Ba Vang Pagoda

The pagoda has many spiritual festivals, Ba Vang Pagoda also has unique architecture. The pagoda is located in a primeval forest with waterfalls, lakes and green hills all year round, a peaceful scene.

The pagoda exudes a quiet space. Coming here, visitors can pray in a peaceful setting, you will feel your soul lighter than ever.

The incense offering area at Ba Vang Pagoda is built very specially. There are professional sculptors who create all the Buddha statues, bringing authenticity to the spiritual world.

The Buddhist prayer tour at Ba Vang Pagoda brings visitors many spiritual values, you can learn more about the unique features of Vietnamese Buddhism and participate in many other spiritual activities. Buddhists and monks in the pagoda will pray with you.

Thien Mu Pagoda

One of the most ancient and sacred pagodas in Hue. The pagoda is located majestically on Ha Khe hill, about 5 km from the center of Hue city. This is a spiritual tourist destination and famous for short pilgrimage tours of tourists traveling to Vietnam.

Thien Mu Pagoda was built in the traditional architectural style of Vietnam. There are many unique architectural works such as Phuoc Duyen Tower, Pho Minh Tower, Quan Am Statue, Thien Mu Lake, … All create a unique and harmonious architectural space.

Thien Mu Pagoda has high cultural and religious value, considered a sacred pagoda of Central Vietnam. The pagoda has many valuable cultural heritages such as Buddha statues and beautiful sculptures.

Every year, on the 15th day of the third lunar month, Thien Mu Pagoda holds a special festival that attracts many participants. This is an opportunity for you to learn more about the culture and beliefs at Thien Mu Pagoda in Hue.

It can be said that a pilgrimage to pray at Thien Mu Pagoda will leave visitors with a wonderful impression. Buddhist rituals and prayers will help you have a peaceful and relaxed soul.

Thien Hau Pagoda

If you are looking for a pilgrimage tour, Thien Hau Pagoda is the destination for you. The pagoda is a spiritual tourist destination for many Buddhists and visitors from all over the world to pray.

It can be said that Thien Hau Pagoda (also known as Ba Temple) is one of the famous pagodas in Vietnam. The pagoda was built in the traditional Chinese architectural style, combined with Western architectural elements. The pagoda has many unique architectural works, such as arched bridges, high towers and beautiful artifacts.

Thien Hau Pagoda has high religious and cultural value, and is a place where Buddhists and visitors come to burn incense and pray. This place has many valuable cultural heritages, imbued with the culture of both China and Vietnam.

The pagoda has a special festival, which is the Ba Dam Festival (also known as the Source Festival), which takes place annually on the 23rd day of the first lunar month.

The Ba Dam Festival is a traditional Chinese festival held to pray for a bountiful harvest. This festival helps people avoid natural disasters and brings good luck to their families and communities. On this day, Chinese families in Vietnam will go to Ba Thien Hau Temple to burn incense and pray to Ba Dam.

During the Ba Dam Festival, Ba Thien Hau Temple takes place in a solemn and brilliant atmosphere and has many Buddhist activities. If you plan to travel to Vietnam, visit Ba Thien Hau Temple during the festival to immerse yourself in the solemn atmosphere of the festival. It can be said that this is the most memorable pilgrimage for visitors.

Tam Chuc Pagoda

If you are looking for a pilgrimage destination, Tam Chuc Pagoda is the destination for you, especially in early spring. The pagoda covers an area of ​​up to 5,100 hectares, and includes many towers and beautiful architectural works.

Tam Chuc Pagoda is built in the traditional Vietnamese architectural style, combined with Western and Chinese architectural elements, creating a unique and impressive architectural space.

Tam Chuc is considered an important spiritual site in Vietnam, with many works and relics of spiritual and historical value. The pagoda attracts many tourists and people to visit and pray for peace and health.

In addition to praying with Buddhists, visitors also participate in a special hooijd ceremony at the pagoda that takes place annually on the 15th day of the 4th lunar month.

Tam Chuc Festival is one of the largest religious festivals in Vietnam. The festival attracts thousands of Buddhists and tourists to participate. This festival lasts for three days, starting from the 14th to the 16th of the fourth lunar month, with many unique religious and cultural activities.

During the Tam Chuc festival, Buddhists come to the temple to pray and make offerings, wishing for a new year of peace, luck and prosperity. Especially on the festival day, Tam Chuc pagoda is brilliantly decorated with many diverse religious activities.

The temple is one of the spiritual tours for Buddhists, people and tourists in Vietnam.

Truc Lam Zen Monastery

The temple is located in Da Lat city, Lam Dong province, Vietnam. This is the largest Zen Buddhist monastery in Vietnam and a famous tourist destination in Da Lat.

Truc Lam Zen Monastery is designed in the traditional Vietnamese architectural style, combining harmony and diversity. Surrounding the temple are mountains, waterfalls and blue lakes.

Truc Lam Zen Monastery is a tourist destination and a place for spiritual practice and academic study of Zen Buddhist monks. The Zen Monastery is also open to visitors to visit and participate in courses on meditation, living methods and Buddhist philosophy.

This is a place to train and nurture Zen Buddhist monks to help them have the best training and academic study. All of this is to spread Buddhist teachings and help the community.

In addition, when visiting the temple, visitors can also participate in the prayers and meditation of Buddhists, and you will find your soul more peaceful, because Buddhist teachings contain many profound spiritual values.

This pilgrimage will give you many opportunities to participate in exchanges with Vietnamese Buddhism, especially meditation.

In addition to the spiritual tourism destinations that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, you can take note of the experience when traveling spiritually in Vietnam.

When going to a temple in Vietnam, praying is something you need to pay attention to. To have the best experience and be suitable for the religious culture in Vietnam, you need to pay attention to the following:

Dress: You should wear formal and respectful clothes when going to the temple. Avoid wearing short skirts, shorts or revealing clothes.

Shoes: When going to the temple, you should leave your shoes outside when entering the temple. The place of worship in the temple is usually very solemn. You can bring a pair of socks to keep your feet warm.

In the temple grounds, you must always stay calm and avoid making noise or being too disorderly. You should also avoid smoking, eating or bringing food into the temple grounds.

Offerings: If you want to make offerings or burn incense, you should ask the people in the temple or local people to know how to do it properly.

Respecting religious beliefs: You should respect the cultural beliefs of local people in each region and the temple.

Bringing equipment: If you want to take photos or film, ask the temple keeper or local people for advice to avoid violating regulations.

Visiting: When visiting the temple, you should follow the temple’s rules, do not tear, cut or damage objects in the temple grounds.

In addition, you should ask local people or temple keeper for more information about notes when visiting the temple, to avoid violating the religious regulations and cultural ethics of Vietnamese people.

People can pray to Buddhism in many different places depending on the beliefs and religions in each locality with places of prayer including

Temples or temples: These are places to perform religious rituals, pray, Temples are often solemnly decorated with statues of Buddha and masters, altars, oil lamps, incense, candles, rosaries, … for praying and offering.

Parks, gardens and temples: These are natural, peaceful and beautiful places that can bring a sense of peace and closeness to nature. Many people go to these places to seek tranquility and pray for a more relaxed soul.

At home: Some people can pray and make offerings at home, on the altar, in the altar or Buddha statue to worship to bring a sense of peace in their own home.

Meditation center: A place where people can learn and practice meditation, an important meditation method in Buddhism. People can participate in classes, seminars, full moon retreats and events related to Buddhism and meditation.

These are the prayers that should be consulted before traveling on a sacred pilgrimage, however each locality will have different religious customs.

To pray at a Buddhist monastery, you can follow these steps:

Understand the monastery: Before praying at a Buddhist monastery, it is important to learn information about the monastery such as the schedule of activities, rituals, regulations, … of the monastery.

Prepare appropriate clothing: When visiting a monastery, you should wear appropriate, respectful, modest and simple clothing, dress politely.

Worship at the temple: When entering the temple, you must be respectful and avoid causing disorder or noise. You can bow, clasp your hands, offer incense or do anything appropriate according to the temple’s regulations.

Participate in activities: If there are any activities at the monastery, you can participate to connect with the Buddhist community and improve your mental health.

Participate in Buddha worship: If there is a Buddha worship ceremony taking place at the monastery, you can pray and honor the Buddha.

Behavior: Do not disturb or offend the beliefs of others.

Learn Buddhist teachings: If you have the opportunity, you can learn more about Buddhist teachings to gain a deeper understanding of the religion and the meaning of prayer.

These are some general steps for praying at a Buddhist monastery. However, specific practices may vary depending on the rules and traditions of each monastery and locality.

How to choose a pilgrimage site

Choose a peaceful temple, and pray for health, success, happiness or any positive outcome you desire. Show respect and gratitude to the Buddha by bowing, reciting a prayer or visualizing an image of the Buddha.

End your prayer with sincere gratitude, respect and humility. You can donate a small amount of money to a Buddhist organization or charity to show your appreciation and compassion.

Remember that the most important aspect of Buddhist prayer is not the words you say but what you feel deep in your heart.

A Buddhist prayer pilgrimage can bring many spiritual and material values ​​to an individual. If you are a Buddhist and interested in learning about Buddhism in different countries, then Vietnam is a great place for you to pray.

If you are wondering which pilgrimage sites or tours to choose, please contact Vietlook Travel immediately for the fastest advice on pilgrimage tours and the most spiritual places that Vietlook wants to introduce to you in your Vietnam tour itinerary.

posts.contentHtmlZh:
越南顶级灵修旅游目的地，建议在游览越南之前先行参考，让您的旅程更加愉快，尤其适合那些寻找灵修目的地的游客——这些地方不仅能让人与神灵相通，还能帮助人们找到心灵的平静。

在朝圣之旅中，您将遇见神圣之境，收获许多美好的体验。每一次朝圣之后，您都会有新的领悟。今天就踏上朝圣之路，寻找宁静，驱散日常工作的喧嚣与忙碌。以下是 Vietlook Travel 想要向您介绍的最佳目的地！

越南最灵验的八大寺庙，在踏足此地、参拜祈福、祈求健康平安之前，请先参考以下介绍。

香寺（Perfume Pagoda）

作为越南顶级的灵修目的地之一，香寺吸引了众多佛教徒和游客前来上香，祈求健康与平安。每年香寺庙会期间（农历正月），来自世界各地的数千人齐聚于此拜佛，其中也包括前来越南旅游的外国游客。他们来到寺中上香祈福，融入庙会的节日氛围。

如果您计划朝圣，跟随 Vietook Travel 前往香寺，您将沉浸在祥和宁静的空间里，感受到同一信仰之人所汇聚的精神力量。

香寺被视为一处灵修天堂，拥有原始的自然之美、清新的山水风光和独特的建筑，四周环绕着石灰岩山峦、瀑布、洞穴、绿色森林和清澈溪流。您将享受宁静的灵修空间，感受其中的安详与平和。

此外，您可以参加佛事、祈祷、举行仪式和上香，也可以找一个安静的角落打坐冥想，专注于内心，为亲人和家人祈求健康、幸福与平安。

前往香寺之行将帮助您与佛教群体产生共鸣与联结，在寻求内心平静和未来方向的同时，缓解压力与焦虑。

安子寺（Yen Tu Pagoda）

这是越南著名的灵修胜地，吸引众多游客前来祈求心灵安宁。前往安子寺朝圣，将带给您宁静、平和以及更加明朗的心灵。

来到寺中，您可以参加拜佛、祈祷、放生和上香等灵修活动。

尤其是登上安子山顶，将是一段难忘的经历，您会看到美丽而宁静的全景。

安子寺在佛教信仰中有着特殊的历史与灵性意义。陈仁宗国王曾在此修行，并创立了竹林禅派，这是陈朝时期大越规模最大的禅派之一。

此外，安子寺还拥有独特的建筑，例如：Kinh Thien 桥、Bao Linh 寺、Dai Bi 殿、陈仁宗庙……这一切共同营造出神圣庄严的空间，让您感受到心灵的平静与安宁。

可以说，在前往安子寺朝圣的过程中，您将感受到越南灵性信仰的独特与与众不同。您会找到内心的平静，感受到信仰与佛法的力量。

白亭寺（Bai Dinh Pagoda）

作为越南著名的灵修旅游目的地之一，白亭寺吸引了成千上万的佛教徒和游客前来参观、祈祷并寻求心灵的平静。白亭寺是北部一座大型的灵修建筑群。

每年，寺中都会举行许多传统的佛教祈福法会，祈求福报与平安。如果您计划朝圣，白亭寺是适合您的目的地，尤其是春季首次游览宁平的游客，都会前往白亭寺参观并上香祈愿，感受轻松与宁静。除了参加寺中的祈福仪式，您还可以探索独特的建筑作品，以及白亭寺最引人注目的亮点——高 10 米、重达 60 吨的巨型阿弥陀佛像。

这是越南最大的佛像之一，被视为越南工匠的独特雕塑杰作。

除了阿弥陀佛像之外，白亭寺还有许多其他精美独特的雕塑，例如：三世佛像、佛像、白亭寺山门……

巴王寺（Ba Vang）是一座古老的寺庙，许多佛教徒前来祈祷。尤其在传统节日、农历初一或十五，或举行佛教诵经法会的时候，寺中常常人头攒动。

巴王寺（Ba Vang Pagoda）

寺中有许多灵修节庆，巴王寺的建筑也别具一格。寺庙坐落于原始森林之中，四季皆有瀑布、湖泊和青山相伴，景色宁静祥和。

寺庙散发着静谧的氛围。来到这里，游客可以在平和的环境中祈祷，您会感到心灵前所未有的轻盈。

巴王寺的上香区建造得非常特别。所有佛像均由专业雕塑家创作，为灵性世界增添了真实感。

巴王寺的佛教祈福之旅为游客带来许多灵性价值，您可以进一步了解越南佛教的独特之处，并参加许多其他灵修活动。寺中的佛教徒和僧侣将与您一同祈祷。

天姥寺（Thien Mu Pagoda）

这是顺化最古老、最神圣的寺庙之一。寺庙巍然矗立在 Ha Khe 山丘上，距离顺化市中心约 5 公里。这里是灵修旅游目的地，也以前来越南旅游的游客的短途朝圣之旅而闻名。

天姥寺按照越南传统建筑风格建造。寺中有许多独特的建筑，如福缘塔、普明塔、观音像、天姥湖……共同营造出独特而和谐的建筑空间。

天姥寺具有很高的文化与宗教价值，被视为越南中部的圣寺。寺中拥有许多珍贵的文化遗产，如佛像和精美的雕塑。

每年农历三月十五日，天姥寺都会举办一场特别的庙会，吸引众多参与者。这是您深入了解顺化天姥寺文化与信仰的好机会。

可以说，到天姥寺朝圣祈福会给游客留下美好的印象。佛教仪式和祈祷将帮助您拥有平和而放松的心灵。

天后宫（Thien Hau Pagoda）

如果您在寻找朝圣之旅，天后宫就是适合您的目的地。这座寺庙是众多佛教徒和来自世界各地的游客祈祷的灵修旅游目的地。

可以说，天后宫（又称婆庙）是越南著名的寺庙之一。寺庙采用传统的中式建筑风格，并融合了西式建筑元素。寺中有许多独特的建筑，例如拱桥、高塔和精美的文物。

天后宫具有很高的宗教与文化价值，是佛教徒和游客前来上香祈祷的地方。这里有许多珍贵的文化遗产，融合了中国与越南两种文化。

寺庙有一个特别的节日，即婆殿节（又称源节），每年农历正月二十三日举行。

婆殿节是为祈求丰收而举办的中国传统节日。这个节日帮助人们避免自然灾害，为家庭和社区带来好运。这一天，越南的华人家庭会前往天后婆庙上香，祈拜婆殿。

婆殿节期间，天后婆庙庄严而辉煌，并举行许多佛教活动。如果您计划前往越南旅游，不妨在节日期间参观天后婆庙，沉浸在庄严的节日氛围中。可以说，这是游客最难忘的朝圣之旅。

三祝寺（Tam Chuc Pagoda）

如果您在寻找朝圣目的地，三祝寺就是适合您的目的地，尤其是在早春时节。寺庙占地面积多达 5,100 公顷，拥有许多宝塔和精美的建筑作品。

三祝寺采用越南传统建筑风格建造，并融合了西式和中式建筑元素，营造出独特而令人印象深刻的建筑空间。

三祝被视为越南重要的灵修圣地，拥有许多具有灵性和历史价值的建筑与遗迹。寺庙吸引了众多游客和民众前来参观，祈求平安与健康。

除了与佛教徒一同祈祷之外，游客还可以参加寺中每年农历四月十五日举行的特别法会。

三祝庙会是越南规模最大的宗教节庆之一。庙会吸引成千上万的佛教徒和游客参加。庙会持续三天，从农历四月十四日至十六日，举办许多独特的宗教与文化活动。

三祝庙会期间，佛教徒来到寺中祈祷并供奉，祈愿新的一年平安、幸运与兴旺。尤其是在庙会当天，三祝寺装饰得富丽堂皇，并举行各种丰富多样的宗教活动。

这座寺庙是越南佛教徒、民众和游客的灵修之旅之一。

竹林禅院（Truc Lam Zen Monastery）

寺庙位于越南林同省大叻市。这是越南最大的禅宗寺院，也是大叻著名的旅游景点。

竹林禅院按照越南传统建筑风格设计，融合了和谐与多样性。寺院四周环绕着群山、瀑布和蓝色的湖泊。

竹林禅院既是旅游目的地，也是禅宗僧侣修行与学习的场所。禅院同时向游客开放参观，并可参加有关禅修、生活方式和佛教哲学的课程。

这里是培养和滋养禅宗僧侣的地方，帮助他们获得最好的修行与学习。这一切都是为了弘扬佛法并帮助社区。

此外，参观寺院时，游客还可以参加佛教徒的祈祷和禅修，您会发现自己的心灵更加平静，因为佛法蕴含着许多深刻的灵性价值。

这次朝圣之旅将给您许多机会与越南佛教进行交流，尤其是禅修。

除了 Vietlook Travel 上文分享的灵修旅游目的地之外，您还可以留意在越南进行灵修旅行时的经验与注意事项。

在越南前往寺庙祈祷时，有些事项需要您注意。为了获得最佳体验并符合越南的宗教文化，您需要注意以下几点：

着装：前往寺庙时，应穿着正式且得体的服装。避免穿短裙、短裤或暴露的衣服。

鞋子：进入寺庙时，应将鞋子留在外面。寺中的礼拜场所通常十分庄严。您可以带一双袜子保暖。

在寺庙范围内，您必须始终保持平静，避免喧哗或过于散漫。您也应避免吸烟、进食或将食物带入寺庙范围。

供品：如果您想供奉或上香，应向寺中人员或当地人请教正确的做法。

尊重宗教信仰：您应尊重各地区当地居民和寺庙的文化信仰。

携带设备：如果您想拍照或摄像，请先询问寺庙管理人员或当地人的意见，以免违反规定。

参观：参观寺庙时，应遵守寺庙的规定，不要撕扯、切割或损坏寺庙范围内的物品。

此外，您还应向当地人或寺庙管理人员询问参观寺庙的更多注意事项，以免违反越南人的宗教规定和文化礼仪。

根据各地的信仰和宗教，人们可以在许多不同的地方进行佛教祈祷，祈祷场所包括：

寺院或庙宇：这些是举行宗教仪式和祈祷的地方，寺庙通常庄严地布置着佛祖和高僧的塑像、祭坛、油灯、香、蜡烛、念珠……用于祈祷和供奉。

公园、花园和庙宇：这些是自然、宁静而美丽的地方，能带来平和并亲近自然的感觉。许多人前往这些地方寻求宁静，祈祷以获得更放松的心灵。

在家中：有些人可以在家里的祭坛、佛龛或佛像前祈祷和供奉，为自己的家带来平静的感觉。

禅修中心：人们可以在这里学习和练习禅修，这是佛教中一种重要的修行方法。人们可以参加课程、研讨会、满月静修以及与佛教和禅修相关的活动。

以上是在踏上神圣朝圣之旅前值得参考的祈祷方式，不过各地的宗教习俗会有所不同。

要在佛教寺院祈祷，您可以按照以下步骤：

了解寺院：在佛教寺院祈祷之前，了解寺院的相关信息很重要，例如活动时间表、仪式、规定……等。

准备合适的服装：参观寺院时，应穿着合适、庄重、朴素而简单的服装，衣着得体。

寺中礼拜：进入寺庙时，必须保持恭敬，避免造成混乱或喧哗。您可以鞠躬、合十、上香，或按照寺庙规定做任何适当的事情。

参加活动：如果寺院有任何活动，您可以参加，以便与佛教群体建立联系并改善心理健康。

参加礼佛：如果寺院正在举行礼佛仪式，您可以祈祷并向佛陀致敬。

行为举止：不要打扰或冒犯他人的信仰。

学习佛法：如果有机会，您可以多了解佛法，以便更深入地理解这一宗教以及祈祷的意义。

以上是在佛教寺院祈祷的一些通用步骤。不过，具体做法可能因各寺院和地区的规定与传统而有所不同。

如何选择朝圣地点

选择一座宁静的寺庙，为健康、成功、幸福或任何您期望的美好结果祈祷。通过鞠躬、诵读祈祷文或观想佛陀的形象，向佛陀表达尊敬与感恩。

以真诚的感恩、尊敬与谦逊结束您的祈祷。您可以向佛教组织或慈善机构捐一小笔钱，以表达您的感激与慈悲之心。

请记住，佛教祈祷最重要的并不是您说出的话语，而是您内心深处的感受。

佛教祈福朝圣之旅可以为个人带来许多精神和物质上的价值。如果您是佛教徒，并有兴趣了解不同国家的佛教，那么越南是一个非常适合您祈祷的好地方。

如果您不确定该选择哪些朝圣地点或旅游线路，请立即联系 Vietlook Travel，我们将为您提供最快的朝圣线路咨询，并在您的越南旅游行程中介绍 Vietlook 想要推荐的最具灵性的地方。

posts.title: Explore Phong Nha Cave Quang Binh
posts.excerpt: Explore Phong Nha Cave Quang Binh, visitors will admire the beauty of pristine nature, the picturesque landscape that captivates people’s hearts. Phong Nha Cave in Quang Binh not only brings visitors
posts.contentHtml:
Explore Phong Nha Cave Quang Binh, visitors will admire the beauty of pristine nature, the picturesque landscape that captivates people’s hearts.

Phong Nha Cave in Quang Binh not only brings visitors majestic natural scenery, but also experiences a unique culture, bringing visitors memorable adventures. Phong Nha Ke Bang is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Let’s explore this spectacular destination with Vietlook Travel today.

1. About Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park

Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park has a tropical monsoon climate, hot and humid, with an average temperature ranging from 20-24 degrees Celsius. There are limestone blocks millions of years old with more than 300 caves and underground river systems. Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park has a total area of ​​85,754 hectares, including:

  • Strictly protected area: 64,894 hectares
  • Ecological restoration area: 17,449 hectares
  • Administrative service area: 3,411 hectares

Coming here, visitors will encounter beautiful natural landscapes, such as picturesque mountains and rivers, and is a destination chosen by many tourists, with beautiful natural scenery and diverse cultures that have brought visitors the most interesting experiences.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Quang Binh, visitors should visit Phong Nha Cave to feel the beauty that nature has bestowed on Quang Binh. Coming here, you will be overwhelmed by the beauty that Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park brings to visitors, a beautiful color of limestone inside, this is also one of the large caves.

This is considered a highlight in the Quang Binh tourism industry, the cave is about 7,729m long, 10m high and 83m deep. In addition, it also owns 12 main caves and many connecting sub-caves, forming an attractive cave system that anyone wants to admire and explore Phong Nha when having the opportunity to set foot in Quang Binh.

2. When is the best time to visit Phong Nha Ke Bang?

Summer is always the best time to book a tour to Phong Nha Cave, because at this time the weather is most beautiful, the sun is clear, the sea is calm, especially when coming to the cave, visitors will feel the coolness of nature, the most beautiful travel to Quang Binh is from June to August, the high temperature is very suitable for soaking in the cool water from natural streams or visiting the cave is very suitable, especially you can also record beautiful pictures.

From August to October, Quang Binh will be the rainy season, however, if you want to experience a resort and not too crowded, go to Quang Binh at this time. This is when the weather turns winter and there are sudden showers, so it is very suitable for you to stay at high-class resorts that will not affect your tour.

The rainy season is also the time of flooding, causing many dangers for local people and tourists when the water level of rivers and lakes rises. The dry season is sunny, convenient for visiting and exploring the rivers and lakes of Phong Nha-Ke Bang by boat.

In addition, this is also the ideal time to explore the famous caves of Phong Nha because it is still dry and easy to move. You should avoid coming to Quang Binh during the rainy season.

Especially from August to October, when the water level of Quang Binh River rises, causing floods and the possibility of dangerous landslides. However, in November, the rainfall gradually decreases and you can still visit dry caves such as Tien Son Cave and Thien Duong Cave…

3. Explore the famous caves of Phong Nha

Phong Nha Cave

Among the caves, Phong Nha stands out with a length of nearly 8km, and a long underground river. The scenery on both sides of the Son River is like a majestic picture of mountains, rivers, and villages exuding the soul of the Vietnamese countryside.

Coming to Phong Nha, visitors will feel truly excited, relaxed and comfortable during their vacation. Especially when traveling on the waterway of more than 600m inside the cave, visitors can admire the spectacular natural beauty of the main cave. Especially when exploring Bi Ky, Co Tien, and Cung Dinh caves, where you can admire the colorful stalactites.

Explore the famous Phong Nha cave, listen to the music at the mountain god’s party and admire the majesty of the caves. The limestone corridors are decorated with naturally sparkling stalactites, visitors can capture the most beautiful moments in Quang Binh.

Tien Son Cave

The road to Tien Son Cave is beautiful, winding along the cliffs. Halfway up the mountain, you can stop to admire the peaceful beauty of quiet villages in the dim sunset, or small fields interspersed with winding hills and Chay and Trooc streams.

When entering the cave, you will feel the beauty of nature, a beautiful scene like a painting, it can be said that the cave looks like an underground maze that will bring visitors the most unforgettable beautiful impression when visiting Quang Binh.

Thien Duong Cave

It is one of the caves with a majestic, majestic and mysterious structure that makes visitors think of a palace in heaven on earth, a destination not to be missed when tour travel Vietnam and visit Quang Binh.

When entering the cave, visitors will be amazed by countless stalactites with many different shapes that have been given interesting names by explorers.

It can be said that when exploring the famous Phong Nha caves, there is Thach Hoa Vien (Stone Flower Garden) with stalactites that look like statues leaning against the mountain in a very majestic way, surrounded by legendary creatures such as unicorns and phoenixes…

Hang En

As one of the beautiful caves, any visitor who sets foot here will feel the majestic beauty. Hang En has been highly appreciated by many famous magazines in the world, one of which is The New York Times.

When trekking Hang En, visitors will feel excited and overwhelmed by the majestic beauty of Hang En, which is known as the third largest cave in the world. To fully explore the beauty of Hang En when traveling to Quang Binh, visitors only spend 2 hours to visit and enjoy all the beauty that nature has bestowed on Quang Binh.

Hang En has a total length of 1,645m, running through a mountain, and has three cave entrances facing southeast, and northwest along the flow of Rao Thuong stream. In particular, this place also has a unique ecosystem and climate, along with a primeval forest and a beautiful river, which will bring visitors unique experiences during their vacation in the Central region.

Suoi Mooc Ecotourism Area – Water source erupting from underground

From Phong Nha, follow the Ho Chi Minh trail (east branch) north to Khe Gat intersection, turn west along the Ho Chi Minh trail (west branch) about 10km to reach Suoi Nuoc Mooc Ecotourism Area. Visitors can also take a boat upstream of the Son River, turn into the Chay River for more than 6km to reach Suoi Mooc tourist area.

The stream is green all year round, on days when Quang Binh is quite hot, but when you come to the stream you will feel the cool climate, the stream is strangely clear. The source of the stream is a towering mountain peak, water erupting from underground. The main spray point is the beginning of Suoi Nuoc Mooc.

Coming to Phong Nha – Nuoc Mooc Ecotourism Area, visitors will discover the diversity and rarity of the world natural heritage on the trail deep into the forest. Admire the waterfall, the water columns spraying from the ground, weaving under the forest canopy and blending into the dreamy Chay River.

In addition, visitors can lie in a hammock swinging under the forest canopy, listen to the sound of the stream flowing, and cool off in the clear Nuoc Mooc stream. Participate in services such as kayaking, swimming, fishing, and bathing in the stream. Enjoying mountain specialties right next to the stream and watching the games by the stream will bring visitors the most enjoyable feeling during their vacation.

Nuoc Mooc Eco-tourism Area is truly different from other tourist destinations in Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park. This place still retains its pristine, pure beauty, which will bring visitors the most attractive experience.

It can be said that when going on a tour of Quang Binh, visitors will be immersed in the poetic beauty, picturesque landscapes, and fresh air, especially Nuoc Mooc stream, which is an attractive tourist, resting, and relaxing destination for visitors from near and far when coming to Quang Binh.

Thuy Cung Cave

To reach Thuy Cung Cave, you have to cross the vast grassy hills to reach the primeval forest of Dau Rai, with many ancient trees and four people hugging the tree trunks.

Then, you will walk upstream of Tien stream to Hang Nuoc Lan, the back door of Hang Toi. With specialized equipment provided by Phong Nha – Ke Bang Tourism Center, you will explore the 500m long pristine Nuoc Lan Cave with a mysterious beauty. Then walk through the forest to reach Thuy Cung Cave, where the water has a strange blue color that cannot be found anywhere else.

After a night of camping at Thuy Cung Cave, in the morning, you will admire the sunrise at the Survival Valley of more than 2000 hectares, surrounded by majestic limestone mountains and endless primeval forests that will bring visitors the most relaxing vacation.

Dark Cave

Dark Cave of the Chay River is a destination chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to set foot in Quang Binh. Dark Cave was formed about 400-500 million years ago.

In 1992, the cave was discovered by the British Royal Cave Association and named “Toi” due to the dense darkness covering every corner inside the cave.

The cave is 5,258m long, 80m high, 50m wide, with two entrances: the front door facing the Chay River (more than 30m high, 10m wide) and the back door facing the forest (more than 50m high, about 20m wide).

Inside the cave, there are many stalactites and stalagmites with many colors and diverse shapes. The ancient stalactites have many colors such as yellow, white, and green moss. In particular, Dark Cave owns stalactites with parasites living inside, which is a rare sight in other caves.

Wind Waterfall – Botanical Garden

To get here, visitors should follow Quyet Thang road, at km9 they will reach the Botanical Garden, a new destination for tourists who love to admire the natural scenery, explore the primeval forest with diverse and rare flora and fauna ecosystems and majestic natural landscapes.

Here, visitors can visit the exhibition house, which displays a collection of specimens of unique and rare flora and fauna from Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park.

Along with geological formations and four-rayed coral species are scientific evidence of the ancient geological and topographic system formed more than 400 million years ago, rarely seen anywhere else.

Exploring the famous Phong Nha cave, visitors can explore the diverse and rich ecosystem by walking through the cool primeval forest under the canopy of trees and conquering Wind Waterfall originating from Vang Anh stream, about 30m high.

Stop at the wooden steps to admire the white foam of the Wind waterfall, enjoy the cool air, forget all the noise and bustle of the bustling and suffocating city, listen to the sound of the waterfall, the chirping of birds in the mountains and forests.

So it can be said that when exploring Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park in general and Phong Nha cave in particular, visitors will certainly not forget the beautiful stalactites in the cave and the poetic landscape blending with the surrounding wilderness will bring visitors the most unforgettable vacation in Quang Binh.
