posts.contentHtmlZh:
探索广平省的峰牙洞，游客将欣赏到原始自然之美和令人心醉的如画风光。

广平峰牙洞不仅为游客带来雄伟的自然风光，还有独特的文化体验，带来难忘的探险之旅。峰牙-己榜是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。今天就让我们与 Vietlook Travel 一起探索这个壮观的目的地吧。

1. 关于峰牙-己榜国家公园

峰牙-己榜国家公园属热带季风气候，炎热潮湿，平均气温在20-24摄氏度之间。这里有数百万年历史的石灰岩山体，拥有300多个洞穴和地下河系统。峰牙-己榜国家公园总面积为85,754公顷，包括：

  • 严格保护区：64,894公顷
  • 生态恢复区：17,449公顷
  • 行政服务区：3,411公顷

来到这里，游客将邂逅美丽的自然景观，如如画的山川河流。这里是许多游客选择的目的地，拥有优美的自然风光和多元的文化，为游客带来了最有趣的体验。

如果有机会前往广平旅行，游客应该参观峰牙洞，感受大自然赋予广平的美。来到这里，您将被峰牙-己榜国家公园带给游客的美景所折服，洞内是美丽的石灰岩色彩，这也是大型洞穴之一。

这被视为广平旅游业的亮点，洞长约7,729米，高10米，深83米。此外，它还拥有12个主洞和许多相连的支洞，构成了一个迷人的洞穴系统，任何人有机会踏足广平时，都会想要欣赏并探索峰牙洞。

2. 参观峰牙-己榜的最佳时间是什么时候？

夏季始终是预订峰牙洞旅游团的最佳时间，因为此时天气最美，阳光明媚，大海平静，尤其是来到洞穴时，游客会感受到大自然的清凉。前往广平旅游最美的时间是6月至8月，高温非常适合浸泡在天然溪流的清凉水中，或参观洞穴也非常合适，尤其是您还可以拍下美丽的照片。

8月至10月，广平进入雨季，不过，如果您想体验度假且人不太多，可在此时前往广平。此时天气转凉，会有突然的阵雨，因此非常适合您入住不会影响行程的高档度假村。

雨季也是洪水季节，当江河湖泊水位上涨时，会给当地居民和游客带来许多危险。旱季阳光充足，便于乘船游览和探索峰牙-己榜的江河湖泊。

此外，这也是探索峰牙著名洞穴的理想时间，因为此时仍然干燥，容易行动。您应避免在雨季来到广平。

尤其是8月至10月，广平江水位上涨，造成洪水，并有发生危险山体滑坡的可能。不过，到了11月，降雨量逐渐减少，您仍然可以参观天山洞（Tien Son）和天堂洞（Thien Duong）等干洞……

3. 探索峰牙著名洞穴

峰牙洞

在众多洞穴中，峰牙洞以近8公里的长度和绵长的地下河脱颖而出。山河（Son）两岸的风景宛如一幅雄伟的山川、河流和村庄的画卷，散发着越南乡村的灵魂。

来到峰牙洞，游客在假期中会真正感到兴奋、放松和舒适。尤其是乘船沿着洞内600多米的水路前行时，游客可以欣赏主洞壮观的自然之美。尤其是探索Bi Ky、Co Tien和Cung Dinh等洞穴，在那里可以欣赏五彩缤纷的钟乳石。

探索著名的峰牙洞，聆听山神盛会的音乐，欣赏洞穴的雄伟。石灰岩长廊被天然闪闪发光的钟乳石装点，游客可以捕捉广平最美的瞬间。

天山洞

通往天山洞的道路很美，沿着悬崖蜿蜒而行。行至半山腰，您可以停下来欣赏朦胧夕阳下宁静村庄的平和之美，或点缀在蜿蜒山丘与Chay溪和Trooc溪之间的小块田野。

进入洞中，您将感受到大自然之美，景色如画。可以说，这个洞穴宛如一座地下迷宫，将给游览广平的游客留下最难忘的美好印象。

天堂洞

它是结构雄伟壮观又神秘的洞穴之一，让游客联想到人间的天宫，是 越南旅游 参观广平时不容错过的目的地。

进入洞中，游客会被无数形态各异的钟乳石所惊艳，探险者们还给它们起了有趣的名字。

可以说，探索著名的峰牙洞穴时，有石花园（Thach Hoa Vien），那里的钟乳石宛如雕像，威严地倚靠着山体，周围环绕着独角兽和凤凰等传说中的生物……

恩洞

作为美丽的洞穴之一，任何踏足这里的游客都会感受到其雄伟之美。恩洞（Hang En）受到世界上许多知名杂志的高度评价，《纽约时报》便是其中之一。

徒步恩洞时，游客会为恩洞的雄伟之美感到兴奋和震撼，它被誉为世界第三大洞穴。要在前往广平时充分探索恩洞之美，游客只需花2个小时，即可游览并享受大自然赋予广平的所有美景。

恩洞总长1,645米，贯穿一座山，有三个洞口，朝向东南和西北，沿着Rao Thuong溪的水流方向。特别是，这里还拥有独特的生态系统和气候，以及原始森林和美丽的河流，将为游客在中部地区的假期带来独特的体验。

Suoi Mooc生态旅游区 – 从地下涌出的水源

从峰牙出发，沿胡志明小道（东线）向北至Khe Gat路口，然后沿胡志明小道（西线）向西行约10公里，即可抵达Suoi Nuoc Mooc生态旅游区。游客也可以乘船沿山河上游行驶，转入Chay河6公里多，抵达Suoi Mooc旅游区。

这条溪流终年碧绿，在广平相当炎热的日子里，来到溪边您会感受到凉爽的气候，溪水清澈得出奇。溪流的源头是一座高耸的山峰，水从地下涌出。主要的喷涌点就是Suoi Nuoc Mooc的起点。

来到峰牙 – Nuoc Mooc生态旅游区，游客将在深入森林的小径上发现世界自然遗产的多样性与稀有性。欣赏瀑布，水柱从地面喷涌而出，在林冠下交织，并融入如梦如幻的Chay河。

此外，游客可以躺在林冠下摇晃的吊床上，聆听溪水流淌的声音，在清澈的Nuoc Mooc溪中消暑。还可以参加皮划艇、游泳、钓鱼和在溪中沐浴等项目。在溪边品尝山区特产，观看溪边的游戏，将为游客带来假期中最愉快的感受。

Nuoc Mooc生态旅游区与峰牙-己榜国家公园的其他旅游目的地确实不同。这里依然保留着原始、纯净的美，将为游客带来最迷人的体验。

可以说，前往广平旅游时，游客将沉浸在如诗的美景、如画的风光和清新的空气中，尤其是Nuoc Mooc溪，它是远近游客来到广平时旅游、休息和放松的迷人目的地。

水宫洞

要到达水宫洞，您必须穿过广阔的草地山丘，抵达Dau Rai原始森林，那里有许多古树，树干需要四人合抱。

然后，您将沿着Tien溪上游步行至Hang Nuoc Lan，即Hang Toi的后门。借助峰牙-己榜旅游中心提供的专业设备，您将探索长500米、原始而神秘的Nuoc Lan洞。随后穿过森林抵达水宫洞，那里的水呈现出别处找不到的奇异蓝色。

在水宫洞露营一夜后，清晨您将在占地2000多公顷的生存谷（Survival Valley）欣赏日出，四周环绕着雄伟的石灰岩山脉和无边的原始森林，将为游客带来最放松的假期。

黑洞

Chay河的黑洞（Dark Cave）是许多游客有机会踏足广平时选择的目的地。黑洞形成于约4亿至5亿年前。

1992年，该洞穴被英国皇家洞穴协会发现，并因洞内每个角落都笼罩着浓重的黑暗而被命名为“Toi”（黑暗）。

洞长5,258米，高80米，宽50米，有两个洞口：前门朝向Chay河（高30多米，宽10米），后门朝向森林（高50多米，宽约20米）。

洞内有许多颜色各异、形态多样的钟乳石和石笋。古老的钟乳石呈现黄色、白色和绿色苔藓等多种颜色。特别是，黑洞拥有内部寄生着生物的钟乳石，这在其他洞穴中十分罕见。

风瀑布 – 植物园

要到达这里，游客应沿Quyet Thang路行驶，在9公里处即可到达植物园，这是喜爱欣赏自然风光、探索拥有多样而珍稀动植物生态系统的原始森林以及雄伟自然景观的游客的新目的地。

在这里，游客可以参观展览馆，馆内陈列着来自峰牙-己榜国家公园的独特而珍稀的动植物标本。

连同地质构造和四射珊瑚物种，它们是4亿多年前形成的古老地质和地形系统的科学证据，在其他地方很少见到。

探索著名的峰牙洞，游客可以穿行在树冠下凉爽的原始森林中，探索多样而丰富的生态系统，并征服发源于Vang Anh溪、高约30米的风瀑布。

在木台阶处驻足，欣赏风瀑布的白色水沫，享受清凉的空气，忘却繁华而令人窒息的城市的一切喧嚣，聆听瀑布的声音和山林间鸟儿的鸣唱。

因此可以说，探索峰牙-己榜国家公园，尤其是峰牙洞时，游客一定不会忘记洞中美丽的钟乳石，以及与周围荒野融为一体的诗意风光，这将为游客带来广平最难忘的假期。

posts.title: Visiting traditional handicraft markets in Vietnam
posts.excerpt: Visiting traditional handicraft markets in Vietnam will bring you the most interesting experiences, with unique and sophisticated works, clearly showing the culture of each locality. Let Vietlook Trav
posts.contentHtml:
Visiting traditional handicraft markets in Vietnam will bring you the most interesting experiences, with unique and sophisticated works, clearly showing the culture of each locality.

Let Vietlook Travel take you to explore the famous traditional handicraft markets in the article below. It will definitely bring you wonderful and meaningful travel experiences.

1. Top 8 traditional handicraft market tours in Vietnam

Bat Trang Pottery Market

Bat Trang Pottery Market is a traditional handicraft market in Vietnam. This market is located right in the traditional craft village of Bat Trang, Hanoi. The products are mainly made from terracotta, ceramics and porcelain, produced by skilled craftsmen, so they are very sophisticated.

Bat Trang Pottery Village has existed and developed for more than 500 years, always carrying the traditional culture of Vietnam, and is one of the localities with the most strongly developed craft villages, always producing sophisticated ceramic works.

When coming here, visitors can not only visit but also enjoy shopping for ceramic souvenirs and capture beautiful moments in the scenery of the pottery village.

Especially when visiting Bat Trang market, visitors will encounter exquisite works in many different forms. In the market, there are many stalls for visitors to visit, you can buy ceramic products such as: bowls, plates, worship items, decorations, cups, .. All of which exude their own beauty.

In addition to admiring the products, you can take pictures of traditional products, especially the ceramic wall. There are many beautiful ceramic products on display at the stalls, creating beautiful photos at the Vietnamese countryside market. In addition, you can also visit the production facilities to produce exquisite works.

Dinh Yen Mat Market – Dong Thap

Is the “cradle” of the traditional mat weaving profession famous throughout Vietnam. It is a destination that many tourists seek out, especially those who want to learn and enjoy the space of the village and learn about the traditional craft village market.

Dinh Yen mat village was formed hundreds of years ago. Located on the Hau River, the land has many sand dunes and alluvial soil to develop raw materials such as dandelions and sedges to make products.

When coming here, visitors will encounter gentle and hospitable people. According to the elders here, Dinh Yen mat village originated from the coastal plains in the North. When going to the South, the people brought with them the traditional mat weaving profession, from which the craft village has developed until now.

When coming to Dinh Yen mat village, you will not only visit but also experience the way of weaving mats with the people here, from the rudimentary product to the finished product, which will be a unique experience for visitors.

In the past, Dinh Yen mat village was best known as Cho Mat (ghost market). Because the market was held at night, lasting about 2 hours every day.

It can be said that Dinh Yen mat village carries within it the unique traditions of the people here and no other place has such exquisite products.

Although people now hold the market during the day, the beauty of the night market still leaves many unforgettable impressions on visitors. If you want to explore the traditional beauty of traditional markets or craft villages, visit Dinh Yen mat village.

Soai Kinh Lam Fabric Market

When talking about fabric, we cannot fail to mention Soai Kinh Lam fabric market in District 5, Ho Chi Minh City. This is a place that gathers natural fabric products and handicrafts typical of the Southern people, produced and handcrafted.

Currently, Soai Kinh Lam market has more than 500 fabric stalls. This will be the first impression when you enter the market, a large and spacious clothing space, you will be overwhelmed by the diverse products. You may feel overwhelmed by the stalls. This handicraft market also has many special fabric stalls.

At Soai Kinh Lam fabric market, you can find many types of fabrics such as silk, linen, brocade, lychee, hemp, woven fabric, brocade, … The fabrics at this market are all made from natural materials, woven and hand-sewn by local artisans.

In addition, Soai Kinh Lam fabric market is also a place for you to find other handicraft products such as clothes, bags, scarves, pillows, cushions, etc. In particular, products made from natural fibers are very beautiful, and help you learn more about unique products in Vietnam.

Phu Khe Wood Market – Bac Ninh

Unlike other traditional markets, Phu Khe Wood Market, Tu Son City (Bac Ninh) only sells rare woods such as rosewood, huong wood, lim wood. The market is very special because it only sells raw wood and some fine art wooden products.

At Phu Khe Wood Market, visitors can find many types of raw wood such as: Chip wood, boxwood, camphor wood, purchased from many different regions across the country. In addition, this market is especially famous for high-quality wood such as: ebony, cam xe wood, teak wood…

The market has more than 500 stalls selling many different types of wood. The sellers clearly state the prices. If you are interested in wooden handicraft materials, you can ask the sellers.

In addition to trading raw wood, Phu Khe Wood Market is also an attractive cultural and tourist destination for visitors who love traditional wood art and architecture. Visitors can explore handicrafts and learn about traditional Vietnamese wood carving and woodworking techniques.

Visiting this traditional handicraft market in Vietnam will help you discover more about the art of wooden architecture in Vietnam, and experience the largest wood market in Northern Vietnam.

Hoa Hao Leather Market

One of the largest markets in Saigon, built in 1950 on Thap Muoi Street, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City. The market has become the city’s shopping and cultural center, attracting many tourists to visit and shop when traveling to Saigon.

At Hoa Hao Leather Market, visitors can find a variety of products such as: Clothes, shoes, handbags, cosmetics, household goods, food and children’s toys. The market sells many good quality products at affordable prices, many visitors come here to buy souvenirs, the products sold in the market are mainly fashion clothes, souvenirs, leather goods and handicrafts.

In addition, Hoa Hao Leather Market is also a shopping place and an interesting tourist destination to explore the unique culture of Saigon people. The highlight of the market is the diversity of products and the blend of many different cultures.

It can be said that when traveling to Saigon, tourists not only visit and sightsee but also visit, explore and experience the unique culture, the vibrant and colorful spaces. The atmosphere at Hoa Hao leather market is always bustling with the laughter of street artists and the sound of guitars, creating an extremely vibrant and dynamic atmosphere that tourists will remember forever.

Dong Xuan Market

As one of the largest markets in Hanoi, Dong Xuan Market is an ideal shopping destination for tourists who want to explore the culture of Hanoi. Dong Xuan Market was built in 1889-1890, and this is one of the first markets in Hanoi. Initially, the market only sold fresh goods such as: vegetables, meat, seafood and handicrafts.

However, with the development of Dong Xuan Market, many stalls selling clothes, shoes, handbags, watches, household goods and many other items have been expanded.

The market is divided into many different areas for the convenience of trading and customers to search and shop more effectively. The area specializing in selling pets and ornamental birds will be located right behind the market. In the North, there are also restaurants serving both day and night.

Dong Xuan Market Hanoi opens from 6am to 6pm every day. Vendors will come to the market earlier to display their goods. However, the market’s food court will be open until 22:30. On weekends, the market may open later.

So if you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi, visit the market to experience and shop, and also explore the food court to enjoy dishes with the bold flavors of the North.

Ben Thanh Market

The market has a special architecture, and is considered a symbol of Saigon. because the market has been associated with the people here for a long time, and has existed for more than 100 years. Although it has been renovated many times, the market still retains its old architectural features and is a favorite check-in place for tourists every time they have the opportunity to set foot in Saigon.

Coming to Ben Thanh Market, visitors can find handicraft products and many other items. The market specializes in retail, the market has an area of ​​​​up to 13,000 m2, and has more than 1450 different stalls. With many handicraft items from high-end to popular.

Ben Thanh Market is always bustling with people and tourists coming to visit and shop, including small traders coming to buy and sell at the market. With many stalls, if it is your first time here, it will be difficult to find the stalls you want, so you should have a tour guide with you. Especially when foreign tourists on a tour Vietnam want to visit and shop at Ben Thanh market, they need to go with a tour guide to be introduced to the products or stop by the food stalls to enjoy delicious dishes.

Ben Thanh market has 4 main gates and 12 side gates, spreading out in 4 directions, each direction has a typical product such as:

The South Gate of Ben Thanh market (the main gate of the market) specializes in selling fabrics, clothes, dried foods, …

The North Gate of Ben Thanh market is where food, raw food and fresh fruit are sold.

The East Gate of Ben Thanh market is a paradise of candy, snacks and cosmetics.

The West Gate of Ben Thanh market is where you can buy shoes, souvenirs or handicrafts.

However, all the gates are crowded and bustling between buyers and sellers. So if you have the opportunity to come to Saigon, visit and shop at the market to experience the unique culture here.

Quang Ba Flower Market (Quang An)

A place where flowers from large fresh flower farms in Hanoi converge. Coming here, visitors will be overwhelmed by the colorful flowers, from popular flowers to imported flowers.

Visiting the traditional handicraft flower market in Vietnam will help you learn more about popular flowers. Quang An flower market operates all day, but is most bustling at night.

At around 11pm, the flower market begins to bustle when trucks carrying fresh flowers “dock” for small traders begin to arrive and unload their goods. A spacious space and overwhelmed by the beauty of the flowers next to the high-pressure lights illuminating the entire market and the hustle and bustle between buyers and sellers.

Especially at the end of the year, when Tet comes, Quang An flower market is more crowded than ever. From the full moon of December, the whole road from Nghi Tam street to Au Co street is filled with flowers, kumquat trees, and peach trees.

With a large space, Quang An Flower Market always attracts many tourists to visit, in addition, people also come to the market to buy fresh flowers and decorate for Tet. Flowers at Quang An Flower Market are very rich and diverse, from apricot blossoms, peach blossoms, chrysanthemums, orchids,…

2. Things to know when visiting traditional handicraft markets in Vietnam

Tourists can participate in many interesting activities and learn about local culture at traditional handicraft markets. Below are some notes before visiting traditional markets when traveling Vietnam.

Shopping for handicrafts

Is the main activity when visiting traditional handicraft markets. Visitors will find unique, beautiful and highly cultural handicraft products.

If you love art and creativity, try to learn and buy handicrafts at the market stalls, the enthusiastic locals will introduce them to you.

Enjoy local cuisine

Traditional handicraft markets often have many stalls selling local food and specialties. Visitors can enjoy regional specialties and learn about the culinary culture of each locality.

The dishes are also very diverse, so you can choose according to your preferences. Usually, each dish will have a very unique flavor, giving visitors the most unforgettable experiences.

Learn about local history and culture

Handicraft markets are often built a long time ago and have high historical and cultural value. Visitors can visit the stalls and buildings around the market to learn about local history and culture.

Participate in cultural activities

Handicraft markets often have certain times of the year when special cultural activities take place. This is a great time for you to experience more deeply when visiting traditional handicraft markets in Vietnam.

Visit historical sites and scenic spots

In addition to stalls and cultural activities, traditional handicraft markets are often located near historical sites and scenic spots. Visitors can spend more time to explore more about the culture and characteristics of these traditional markets.

Learn about the production process of handicraft products, visitors can go to the stalls and see the artisans and learn more about the production process of handicraft products. This will help you appreciate the value of the product and learn about the craftsmanship and quintessence of the craft.

3. Who can help you have a great trip?

Tourists may remember Vietnam through famous tourist destinations such as Ha Long or Phu Quoc, Nha Trang, Ninh Binh…. Besides, there are peaceful traditional handicraft markets that bring completely different rustic experiences.

So when visiting traditional handicraft markets in Vietnam, tourists will have the opportunity to learn more about the culture of each different region, especially traditional handicraft techniques that also make you feel more excited about your trip.

Therefore, besides famous tourist destinations, you should visit some traditional craft villages, you will learn more about the culture, history and a more realistic view of the daily life of local people.

If you are choosing a tour to visit traditional markets, traditional craft markets in Vietnam, please contact Vietlook Travel immediately to design a private tour for you. With many years of experience in the tourism industry, Vietlook Travel will be the most reliable travel companion for tourists.
posts.titleZh: 探访越南传统手工艺市场
posts.excerptZh: 参观越南的传统手工艺市场将带给您最有趣的体验，这里的作品独特而精致，鲜明地展现了各个地方的文化。让 Vietlook Travel 带您在下文中探索著名的传统手工艺市场。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
参观越南的传统手工艺市场将带给您最有趣的体验，这里的作品独特而精致，鲜明地展现了各个地方的文化。

让 Vietlook Travel 带您在下文中探索著名的传统手工艺市场。它一定会为您带来美妙而有意义的旅行体验。

1. 越南八大传统手工艺市场之旅

钵场陶瓷市场(Bat Trang)

钵场陶瓷市场是越南的传统手工艺市场。这个市场就位于河内的钵场传统手工艺村内。产品主要由陶土、陶器和瓷器制成，出自技艺精湛的工匠之手，因此十分精致。

钵场陶瓷村已有500多年的存在与发展历史，始终承载着越南的传统文化，是手工艺村发展最为蓬勃的地方之一，不断制作出精美的陶瓷作品。

来到这里，游客不仅可以参观，还可以选购陶瓷纪念品，并在陶瓷村的风光中留下美好的瞬间。

尤其是参观钵场市场时，游客会看到各种不同形式的精美作品。市场里有许多摊位供游客参观，您可以购买碗、盘、祭祀用品、装饰品、杯子等陶瓷产品……每一件都散发着自己的美。

除了欣赏产品之外，您还可以给传统产品拍照，尤其是陶瓷墙。摊位上陈列着许多精美的陶瓷产品，在越南乡村市场中拍出漂亮的照片。此外，您还可以参观生产作坊，了解精美作品的制作。

丁安草席市场(Dinh Yen)——同塔省

是闻名越南全国的传统编席行业的“摇篮”。这是许多游客前来寻访的目的地，尤其是那些想了解并享受村落空间、了解传统手工艺村市场的人。

丁安草席村形成于数百年前。位于后江(Hau)畔，这片土地有许多沙丘和冲积土，适合种植蒲草和莎草等原料来制作产品。

来到这里，游客会遇到温和好客的人们。据这里的长者说，丁安草席村起源于北部的沿海平原。前往南方时，人们带来了传统的编席手艺，手工艺村由此发展至今。

来到丁安草席村，您不仅可以参观，还可以与这里的人们一起体验编席的方式，从粗坯到成品，对游客来说将是一次独特的体验。

过去，丁安草席村以“鬼市(Cho Mat)”而闻名。因为市场在夜间举行，每天持续约2小时。

可以说，丁安草席村承载着这里人们独特的传统，没有其他地方能有如此精美的产品。

虽然如今人们改在白天开市，但夜市之美仍给游客留下许多难忘的印象。如果您想探索传统市场或手工艺村的传统之美，请参观丁安草席村。

Soai Kinh Lam 布料市场

说到布料，就不能不提胡志明市第5郡的 Soai Kinh Lam 布料市场。这里汇聚了南部人民特有的天然布料产品和手工艺品，均为手工生产制作。

目前，Soai Kinh Lam 市场有500多个布料摊位。当您走进市场时，这将是第一印象：宽敞开阔的大型服饰空间，琳琅满目的产品会让您应接不暇。您可能会被众多摊位弄得眼花缭乱。这个手工艺市场还有许多特色布料摊位。

在 Soai Kinh Lam 布料市场，您可以找到多种布料，如丝绸、亚麻、锦缎、荔枝纹布、大麻布、织布、织锦……这个市场的布料都由天然材料制成，由当地工匠织造并手工缝制。

此外，Soai Kinh Lam 布料市场也是您寻找其他手工艺产品的地方，如衣服、包、围巾、枕头、坐垫等。特别是用天然纤维制成的产品非常漂亮，有助于您进一步了解越南的独特产品。

福溪木材市场(Phu Khe)——北宁省

与其他传统市场不同，北宁省慈山市(Tu Son)的福溪木材市场只出售花梨木、香木、铁木等珍稀木材。这个市场非常特别，因为只出售原木和一些精美的木制艺术品。

在福溪木材市场，游客可以找到多种原木，例如：Chip 木、黄杨木、樟木，购自全国各个不同地区。此外，这个市场还以高品质木材而特别闻名，如：乌木、cam xe 木、柚木……

市场有500多个摊位，出售多种不同的木材。卖家明码标价。如果您对木制手工艺材料感兴趣，可以向卖家咨询。

除了原木交易之外，福溪木材市场对于热爱传统木雕艺术和建筑的游客来说，也是极具吸引力的文化旅游目的地。游客可以探索手工艺品，了解越南传统的木雕和木工技艺。

参观这个越南传统手工艺市场，将帮助您进一步发现越南木构建筑的艺术，并体验越南北部最大的木材市场。

和好(Hoa Hao)皮革市场

西贡最大的市场之一，于1950年建在胡志明市第10郡的十茂街(Thap Muoi)上。这个市场已成为这座城市的购物和文化中心，吸引许多游客在前往西贡旅行时来此参观购物。

在和好皮革市场，游客可以找到各种各样的产品，如：衣服、鞋子、手提包、化妆品、家居用品、食品和儿童玩具。市场出售许多品质优良、价格实惠的产品，许多游客来这里购买纪念品，市场上出售的产品主要是时装、纪念品、皮具和手工艺品。

此外，和好皮革市场也是购物的好去处，是探索西贡人独特文化的有趣旅游目的地。市场的亮点是产品的多样性以及多种不同文化的交融。

可以说，前往西贡旅行时，游客不仅是参观观光，还要参观、探索和体验独特的文化，以及热闹多彩的空间。和好皮革市场的氛围总是充满街头艺人的笑声和吉他声，营造出极其热闹而充满活力的气氛，让游客永远难忘。

同春市场(Dong Xuan)

作为河内最大的市场之一，同春市场是想要探索河内文化的游客的理想购物目的地。同春市场建于1889-1890年，是河内最早的市场之一。最初，市场只出售蔬菜、肉类、海鲜和手工艺品等生鲜商品。

不过，随着同春市场的发展，出售衣服、鞋子、手提包、手表、家居用品和许多其他物品的摊位也不断扩大。

市场被划分为许多不同的区域，以方便交易，也方便顾客更有效地寻找和购物。专门出售宠物和观赏鸟的区域就在市场后面。在北侧，还有昼夜营业的餐馆。

河内同春市场每天早上6点至下午6点开放。摊贩会更早来到市场陈列商品。不过，市场的美食区会营业至22:30。周末，市场可能会晚些开门。

所以，如果您有机会前往河内旅行，请到市场体验购物，也别忘了探访美食区，品尝带有北方浓郁风味的菜肴。

滨城市场(Ben Thanh)

这座市场建筑风格独特，被视为西贡的象征。因为市场与这里的人们长期相伴，已存在100多年。虽然经过多次翻修，市场仍保留着旧有的建筑特色，是游客每次有机会踏足西贡时钟爱的打卡地。

来到滨城市场，游客可以找到手工艺产品和许多其他物品。市场以零售为主，占地面积达13,000平方米，有1450多个不同的摊位。手工艺品从高档到大众化一应俱全。

滨城市场总是熙熙攘攘，游客前来参观购物，也有小商贩来此买卖。摊位众多，如果您是第一次来，很难找到想要的摊位，所以最好有导游陪同。尤其是参加越南旅游的外国游客想要参观并在滨城市场购物时，需要有导游陪同，由导游介绍产品，或顺道光顾美食摊品尝美味佳肴。

滨城市场有4个主门和12个侧门，向4个方向展开，每个方向都有代表性的商品，例如：

滨城市场南门(市场正门)专营布料、衣服、干货等……

滨城市场北门出售食品、生鲜食材和新鲜水果。

滨城市场东门是糖果、零食和化妆品的天堂。

滨城市场西门可以购买鞋子、纪念品或手工艺品。

不过，所有的门都人来人往，买卖双方熙熙攘攘。所以，如果您有机会来到西贡，请到市场参观购物，体验这里独特的文化。

广巴花市(Quang Ba，广安 Quang An)

河内各大鲜花农场的鲜花汇聚于此。来到这里，游客会被五彩缤纷的花朵所震撼，从常见的花卉到进口花卉应有尽有。

参观越南传统手工艺花市，将帮助您更多地了解常见的花卉。广安花市全天营业，但夜晚最为热闹。

晚上11点左右，当载着鲜花的卡车“靠岸”，小商贩们开始到来并卸货，花市开始热闹起来。宽敞的空间，高压灯照亮整个市场，在花朵之美和买卖双方的喧嚣之间，让人目不暇接。

尤其是年底春节来临之际，广安花市比以往任何时候都更加拥挤。从腊月十五开始，从 Nghi Tam 街到 Au Co 街的整条路上摆满了鲜花、金桔树和桃树。

凭借宽阔的空间，广安花市总是吸引许多游客前来参观，此外，人们也来到市场购买鲜花，装点春节。广安花市的花卉非常丰富多样，有杏花、桃花、菊花、兰花等……

2. 参观越南传统手工艺市场须知

游客可以在传统手工艺市场参加许多有趣的活动，了解当地文化。以下是游览越南时参观传统市场前的一些注意事项。

选购手工艺品

这是参观传统手工艺市场的主要活动。游客会发现独特、美观且富有文化底蕴的手工艺产品。

如果您热爱艺术和创意，不妨在市场摊位上了解并购买手工艺品，热情的当地人会向您介绍。

品尝当地美食

传统手工艺市场通常有许多出售当地食品和特产的摊位。游客可以品尝地方特色，了解各地的饮食文化。

菜品也非常多样，您可以根据喜好选择。通常，每道菜都有非常独特的风味，带给游客最难忘的体验。

了解当地历史和文化

手工艺市场通常建于很久以前，具有很高的历史和文化价值。游客可以参观市场周边的摊位和建筑，了解当地的历史和文化。

参与文化活动

手工艺市场通常在一年中的特定时间举行特别的文化活动。这是您参观越南传统手工艺市场时更深入体验的绝佳时机。

参观历史遗迹和名胜

除了摊位和文化活动之外，传统手工艺市场往往位于历史遗迹和名胜附近。游客可以多花些时间，进一步探索这些传统市场的文化和特色。

了解手工艺产品的生产过程，游客可以前往摊位观看工匠，进一步了解手工艺产品的生产过程。这将帮助您体会产品的价值，并了解这门手艺的工艺与精髓。

3. 谁能帮助您拥有一次美好的旅行？

游客可能通过下龙湾、富国岛、芽庄、宁平等著名旅游目的地来记住越南……此外，还有宁静的传统手工艺市场，带来截然不同的质朴体验。

因此，参观越南传统手工艺市场时，游客将有机会进一步了解各个不同地区的文化，尤其是传统手工艺技艺，这也会让您对旅行更加兴奋。

因此，除了著名的旅游目的地之外，您还应该参观一些传统手工艺村，您将更多地了解文化、历史，以及当地人日常生活更真实的一面。

如果您正在选择前往传统市场、越南传统手工艺市场的旅游，请立即联系 Vietlook Travel，为您设计专属行程。凭借多年的旅游行业经验，Vietlook Travel 将是游客最可靠的旅行伙伴。

posts.contentHtml:
With Vietlook Travel Visiting Vietnamese countryside, visitors can admire the peaceful beauty, with the hospitable and gentle people. Besides, visitors can also visit traditional craft villages such as: Quang Phu Cau incense village, Ha Thai craft village, Chuong conical hat village… visitors can learn more about Vietnamese culture. Below is the detailed content for your reference.

Guide to choosing places to visit when you first come to Vietnam, and want to choose places that are Vietnamese villages, admire the beauty and learn about traditional craft villages.

Choose the right place you love

Vietnam has many attractive villages to explore. Each village will have its own characteristics of the local people. However, you need to choose a destination that suits your interests, budget and time. So if you come to Vietlook Travel, we will suggest you to choose the destination you like.

Find information and activities at the place you want to visit

After choosing a destination, you need to find out information about the place you want to visit. Information may include culture, history, regional specialties, activities and outstanding events. You can consult consultants or social networking sites before arriving.

Finding out activities and information when visiting the village will help your trip, and you will save the best moments for yourself.

Make a detailed plan

You need to make a detailed plan for your trip, including the itinerary, places to visit, means of transportation, personal food you bring along with the budget for your trip.

If you love to admire the peaceful countryside, visit the Vietnamese countryside from here you will visit the culture of cultural and artistic events, chat with skilled craftsmen. In particular, you can also draw pictures, learn to cook with the locals.

Book a hotel or travel
If you want to explore on your own without having to go through a travel agency when choosing a tour, you can go online to book your hotel and transportation tickets yourself to ensure your trip is convenient and safe for yourself.

Prepare necessary clothes and items before visiting a Vietnamese village.

Before going, you should prepare your personal documents, maps and necessary documents. You should also prepare clothes suitable for the location and weather in Vietnam to have the most enjoyable trip.

Enjoy the trip

When visiting the villages, in addition to walking and sightseeing or cycling, you can also enjoy the rich cuisine, experience cooking with the locals, and relax in the Vietnamese countryside.

Top Traditional Craft Villages in Vietnam You Should Visit

Each craft village will bring visitors its own beauty, each culture is unique to each region, let’s explore the following craft villages.

Tra Que Vegetable Village – Hoi An

Up to now, Tra Que Vegetable Village has been around for more than 300 years. Coming here, you will encounter vast vegetable fields, with many different types of vegetables. If you are a lover of peaceful spaces, Tra Que Vegetable Village is the destination for you.

The vegetable village is one of the prominent destinations, with a green space that visitors can visit and take beautiful pictures. Tra Que is no longer a traditional vegetable village, but this place also brings a peaceful scene that has helped attract many visitors to experience.

The ideal time to visit is from February to April and from August to December every year. This is the time when the weather in the Central region and Hoi An – Quang Nam is cool, dry, the vegetables are freshest and greenest of the year. The space is fresh, cool and green.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village

As one of the famous incense villages, from Hanoi to get to the incense village, visitors can take a coach or bus while admiring the poetic scenery.

Coming to Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, visitors can not only visit but also experience making colorful incense bundles, listen to thrilling stories, and freely check in next to the incense bundles to record the beautiful scenery and visit the traditional incense making method with the ladies, mothers… from the rudimentary stages to creating unique products.

Bat Trang Pottery Village

A destination chosen by many tourists, and one of the traditional craft villages of Vietnamese culture is one of the famous traditional craft villages in Vietnam.

Coming here, visitors will encounter craftsmen specializing in producing high-class handmade ceramic products. The designs are very diverse and eye-catching.

Visitors will experience pottery making with the locals here, the pottery village is over 200 years old, Van Van ancient house is an architectural masterpiece with ceramic motifs, blue-glazed teapots, dragon-shaped vases, and pottery molds dating back to the 15th century….

Bat Trang communal house is a place to worship Thanh Hoang and is also the place to hold many different festivals throughout the year.

Quynh Son Community Tourism Village – Lang Son

Lang Son is famous for its beautiful natural landscape, surrounded by high rocky mountains, clear streams, and is a dream destination for many tourists. The most prominent of which is the community tourism village.

In addition, Lang Son is also a typical historical and cultural heritage and the commune’s scenic spots include Quynh Son communal house, an ancient temple worshiping King Quy Minh, with traditional stilt houses of the Bac Son Tay ethnic group.

Coming here, visitors can experience traditional community life by eating, resting and participating in agricultural production activities with local people in simple stilt houses where the Tay people mainly live.

In addition, visitors coming here on January 12 and 13 can also join the Long Tong festival (going down to the fields) which is held with traditional rituals to pray for a good harvest, and many folk games such as Then singing and Tan Dan dancing are also typical cultural features in the daily life of local people.

In addition, when coming to Quynh Son, visitors can enjoy the culinary culture with typical traditional dishes here such as: Black Chung cake, purple sticky rice, Chinese sausage, red marinated meat,…

Unique activities during a tour Vietnamese craft villages and countryside are opportunities to experience the local lifestyle, culture, history and cuisine. Here are some experiences you should try at least once in your life.

Visiting and experiencing daily life with local people is also one of the unique experiences that Vietlook Travel wants to accompany you to explore when you have the opportunity to visit Vietnam.

Experiencing with local people such as: cutting grass, harvesting rice, picking fruit or herding cattle is a simple life that many foreign tourists when coming to Vietnam are interested in.

Experiencing traditional craft villages

Vietnam has many traditional craft villages, such as Bat Trang pottery village, Vu Dai fishing village and Ninh Van stone village, Quang Phu incense village, conical hat village… You can visit and learn how to make traditional handicrafts. Each craft village will bring visitors a unique experience.

Enjoy the local cuisine

A tour of the Vietnamese countryside will give you a complete experience and enjoy the local cuisine. You can join a cooking class or have dinner with a local family to enjoy traditional dishes and chat with the locals.

In each region and tour of the Vietnamese countryside, visitors will experience unique specialties. Most of the dishes are delicious and attractive and have the distinct flavors of each region.

Participate in unique cultural activities of each locality such as festivals, and exchange diverse cultural activities, depending on the time, visitors will be able to participate in different festival activities, and depending on each locality, visitors will have different experiences.

The most unique and impressive activities that visitors will participate in are festivals, folk games, or experience picking fruits, and learn how to weave, mold green rice, make incense to produce colorful incense bundles, or paint paintings at Ha Thai lacquer village.

This is an opportunity for visitors to experience local culture and learn about the unique life and culture of the Vietnamese people.

Accompanying Vietlook Travel will take you to fully explore the beauty of Vietnam and bring visitors unique experiences. Each craft village and famous landscape will bring visitors their own experiences and be the most unforgettable memories for visitors.

posts.contentHtmlZh:
与Vietlook Travel一起参观越南乡村，游客可以欣赏宁静的美景，感受热情温和的人们。此外，游客还可以参观传统手工艺村，例如： 广福球（Quang Phu Cau）香村、河泰手工艺村、枪村（Chuong）斗笠村……游客可以更多地了解越南文化。以下是详细内容，供您参考。

初次来到越南，想选择越南村庄、欣赏美景并了解传统手工艺村的游览地点选择指南。

选择您喜爱的合适地点

越南有许多有吸引力的村庄可供探索。每个村庄都有当地人各自的特点。不过，您需要选择适合您的兴趣、预算和时间的目的地。因此，如果您来到Vietlook Travel，我们将建议您选择您喜欢的目的地。

查找您想参观地点的信息和活动

选择目的地后，您需要了解您想参观的地方的信息。信息可能包括文化、历史、地方特产、活动和突出的事件。您可以在抵达前咨询顾问或社交网站。

了解参观村庄时的活动和信息将有助于您的旅程，您将为自己留下最美好的时刻。

制定详细计划

您需要为旅程制定详细计划，包括行程、参观地点、交通工具、自带的个人食物以及旅行预算。

如果您喜爱欣赏宁静的乡村，参观越南乡村，从这里您将了解文化艺术活动的文化，与技艺娴熟的工匠交谈。特别是，您还可以画画，与当地人一起学习烹饪。

预订酒店或旅游
如果您想自行探索而不通过旅行社选择旅游团，可以上网自行预订酒店和交通票，以确保您的旅程方便且安全。

参观越南村庄前准备必要的衣物和物品。

出发前，您应该准备好个人证件、地图和必要的文件。您还应该准备适合越南当地地点和天气的衣物，以获得最愉悦的旅程。

享受旅程

参观村庄时，除了步行观光或骑自行车外，您还可以享用丰富的美食，与当地人一起体验烹饪，并在越南乡村放松身心。

您应该参观的越南顶级传统手工艺村

每个手工艺村都会为游客带来独特的美，每种文化在每个地区都是独一无二的，让我们探索以下手工艺村。

茶桂蔬菜村（Tra Que）– 会安

至今，茶桂蔬菜村已有300多年历史。来到这里，您会遇到广阔的菜地，种植着许多不同种类的蔬菜。如果您是热爱宁静空间的人，茶桂蔬菜村就是适合您的目的地。

蔬菜村是突出的目的地之一，拥有绿色空间，游客可以参观并拍下美丽的照片。茶桂已不再是传统的蔬菜村，但这里也带来了一幅宁静的景象，吸引了许多游客前来体验。

理想的游览时间是每年2月至4月和8月至12月。此时中部地区和会安 – 广南的天气凉爽干燥，蔬菜是一年中最新鲜、最翠绿的。空间清新、凉爽、碧绿。

广福球（Quang Phu Cau）香村

作为著名的香村之一，从河内前往香村，游客可以乘坐长途汽车或公共汽车，同时欣赏如诗如画的风景。

来到广福球香村，游客不仅可以参观，还可以体验制作五彩缤纷的香束，聆听扣人心弦的故事，并自由地在香束旁打卡，记录美丽的风景，与女士们、母亲们一起参观传统制香方法……从最原始的工序到制作出独特的产品。

钵场（Bat Trang）陶器村

这是许多游客选择的目的地，也是越南文化传统手工艺村之一，是越南著名的传统手工艺村之一。

来到这里，游客会遇到专门生产高档手工陶瓷产品的工匠。设计非常多样且引人注目。

游客将与这里的当地人一起体验制作陶器，陶器村已有200多年历史，万万（Van Van）古宅是一座带有陶瓷图案的建筑杰作，有蓝釉茶壶、龙形花瓶，以及可追溯到15世纪的陶器模具……

钵场亭（communal house）是供奉城隍的地方，也是全年举办许多不同节庆的地方。

琼山（Quynh Son）社区旅游村 – 谅山

谅山以优美的自然风光而闻名，被高耸的岩石山脉和清澈的溪流环绕，是许多游客梦寐以求的目的地。其中最突出的是社区旅游村。

此外，谅山也是典型的历史文化遗产所在，该社的景点包括琼山亭（Quynh Son）、一座供奉归明王（Quy Minh）的古庙，以及北山岱族（Bac Son Tay）的传统高脚屋。

来到这里，游客可以在岱族人主要居住的简朴高脚屋里，与当地人一起吃饭、休息并参与农业生产活动，体验传统的社区生活。

此外，游客在1月12日和13日来到这里，还可以参加下田节（Long Tong），节日以传统仪式举行，祈求丰收，还有许多民间游戏，如唱“然”（Then）和“弹”（Tan）舞，也是当地人日常生活中典型的文化特色。

此外，来到琼山，游客可以品尝这里典型传统菜肴所代表的美食文化，例如：黑粽（Chung）、紫糯米饭、腊肠、红腌肉……

独特的活动：在 游览越南 手工艺村和乡村时，您有机会体验当地生活方式、文化、历史和美食的机会。以下是您一生中至少应该尝试一次的一些体验。

参观并与当地人一起体验日常生活，也是Vietlook Travel希望在您有机会参观越南时陪伴您一起探索的独特体验之一。

与当地人一起体验，例如：割草、收割稻谷、摘果子或放牛，是许多外国游客来到越南时感兴趣的简朴生活。

体验传统手工艺村

越南有许多传统手工艺村，如钵场陶器村、Vu Dai渔村和宁云（Ninh Van）石村、广福（Quang Phu）香村、斗笠村……您可以参观并学习如何制作传统手工艺品。每个手工艺村都会给游客带来独特的体验。

品尝当地美食

越南乡村之旅将给您完整的体验并享受当地美食。您可以参加烹饪课，或与当地家庭共进晚餐，品尝传统菜肴并与当地人聊天。

在越南乡村之旅的每个地区和每趟行程中，游客将体验到独特的特产。大多数菜肴都美味诱人，带有每个地区独特的风味。

参与每个地方独特的文化活动，如节庆，并交流多样的文化活动，根据时间不同，游客将能参与不同的节庆活动，并且根据每个地方的不同，游客将获得不同的体验。

游客将参与的最独特、最令人印象深刻的活动是节庆、民间游戏，或体验摘果子，学习编织、制作青米片（com）、制作香以生产五彩缤纷的香束，或在河泰漆器村绘画。

这是游客体验当地文化并了解越南人民独特生活与文化的机会。

与Vietlook Travel同行，将带您全面探索越南之美，并为游客带来独特的体验。每个手工艺村和著名风景都将给游客带来独特的体验，成为游客最难忘的回忆。

posts.contentHtml:
Vietnam is one of the top tourist destinations in Southeast Asia, with beautiful landscapes, diverse culture, and delicious cuisine. Vietnam package tours from India help make your trip more convenient and amazing.

If you are planning a trip to Vietnam, many tour packages and ideas are available. Refer to the following suggestions to find the right Vietnam package tours from India!

Ideas Vietnam The Best Places To Visit

If you want the cheapest Vietnam tour package while still visiting great places to travel, the following ideas are for you. It will help you complete your search for the best Vietnam tours package.

5 Days 4 Night Tour

The Vietnam tour package 5 days 4 nights is usually very popular with many foreign tourists. This is a suitable period if you want to spend more time experiencing Vietnam when coming from India.

With this time, you can choose to go on tours by region. In Vietnam, you can consider some of the following tours:

  • Northern Vietnam Tour: Explore the beauty of Hanoi; visit cultural heritage sites; cruise on Halong Bay, and experience the traditional village crafts. If you have time to travel, you can visit some natural sites in the highlands.
  • Middle Vietnam Tour: Visit the ancient city of Hoi An; admire the beauty of the Cu Chi tunnels; and participate in typical cultural activities of Central Vietnam.
  • Southern Vietnam Tour: Explore the bustling city of Saigon; experience the life of people in the Southern countryside; visit cultural heritage sites such as the Mekong Delta and Chau Doc.
  • Comprehensive Tour: Combine destinations from all three regions, North, Central, and South, to enjoy even more unique experiences. However, the Vietnam 5 days tour package may only allow you to experience some of the three regions.

Continuous travel over a considerable distance can make tourists exhausted. To save time and energy, you should choose to travel in a region.

Hoi An

Hoi An is one of the Vietnam package tours from India. Hoi An is known as “the city of lanterns” with its unique ancient architecture and small and charming streets. This is one of the most popular tourist destinations in Vietnam.

There are many available tour packages from India to Hoi An. These tours usually include round-trip flights, accommodation, visits to famous tourist destinations, and local food experiences.

You can learn more about these tour packages from travel companies or online travel websites. Athai Travel is one of the top choices; this travel agency can provide many high-quality travel services.

You can explore UNESCO World Heritage Sites such as the Japanese Covered Bridge, Hoi An Ancient Town, and the Ong Ba Da Tomb during your trip to Hoi An. 

Additionally, you can visit traditional craft villages such as Thanh Ha Pottery Village and Phuoc Kieu Silk Village. Tourists can learn and experience the secrets of production from skilled local artisans.

If you love food, Hoi An is also a paradise with typical dishes such as Banh Mi, Cao Lau, Mi Quang, Banh Bao, and many other delicious dishes. Enjoy unique experiences and taste great food when you come to Hoi An.

If you have more time, the Vietnam 3 days tour package to Hoi An is a highly anticipated trip.

With the combination of cultural heritage, typical cuisine, and beautiful natural scenery, Hoi An is a great destination for Indian tourists who want to explore Vietnam.

Co To Island Tour 2 Days 3 Nights

Co To Island has many beautiful beaches and crystal-clear waters, making it a desirable tourist destination during the summer. In addition, Co To also has ancient forests on the mountainous terrain and historical relics with a critical position in national defense.

Vietnam package tours from India during the summer season certainly cannot miss the beautiful beaches on this Island. When visiting Co To, you will enjoy the scenery of a beautiful island, clear blue beaches, and a fresh climate.

The peak time for tourism in Co To is during the summer months, from May to August. However, few people know that the best time to visit Co To is in September, at the end of summer. At this time, the sea is clear and blue, and the sun is mild.

During September, tourists are fewer, and you will enjoy comfort, tranquility, and freedom to explore the Island. Here, you don’t need to pay too much attention to the Vietnam tour package from India price. Everything is reasonably priced.

You can visit Co To from April to October, depending on your plan. But if you go during the summer months and on weekends, remember to book your hotel and services early to get the desired service; and avoid running out of hotel rooms.

越南最佳游览地点推荐

如果您想要最实惠的越南旅游套餐，同时又能游览绝佳的旅行地点，以下创意正适合您。它将帮助您完成对最佳越南旅游套餐的搜寻。

5天4晚之旅

越南5天4晚旅游套餐通常深受许多外国游客欢迎。如果您从印度出发，想花更多时间体验越南，这是一个合适的时长。

有了这些时间，您可以选择按地区游览。在越南，您可以考虑以下几种行程：

  • 越南北部之旅：探索河内之美；参观文化遗产地；乘游轮游览下龙湾，体验传统村落手工艺。如果有时间，还可以游览高原的一些自然景点。
  • 越南中部之旅：参观会安古城；欣赏古芝地道之美；参与越南中部典型的文化活动。
  • 越南南部之旅：探索繁华的西贡；体验南部乡村人们的生活；参观湄公河三角洲和朱笃(Chau Doc)等文化遗产地。
  • 综合之旅：结合北、中、南三个地区的目的地，享受更多独特的体验。不过，越南5天旅游套餐可能只能让您体验三个地区中的一部分。

长距离连续旅行会让游客疲惫不堪。为了节省时间和精力，您应当选择在一个地区内游览。

会安是印度出发的越南跟团游套餐之一。会安被誉为“灯笼之城”，拥有独特的古建筑和小巧迷人的街道。这是越南最受欢迎的旅游目的地之一。

从印度前往会安有许多现成的旅游套餐。这些行程通常包括往返机票、住宿、著名旅游景点的参观和当地美食体验。

在会安之行中，您可以探索联合国教科文组织世界遗产地，如日本桥、会安古镇和翁婆坟(Ong Ba Da)。

此外，您还可以参观传统手工艺村，如青河陶瓷村(Thanh Ha)和福桥丝绸村(Phuoc Kieu)。游客可以向当地技艺精湛的工匠学习并体验生产的秘诀。

夏季印度出发的越南跟团游套餐当然不能错过这座岛上的美丽海滩。游览吉婆岛时，您将欣赏到美丽海岛的风光、碧蓝的海滩和清新的气候。

吉婆岛的旅游旺季在夏季，即5月至8月。然而，很少有人知道，游览吉婆岛的最佳时间是夏末的9月。此时海水清澈湛蓝，阳光温和。

9月游客较少，您将享受到舒适、宁静和自由探索海岛的乐趣。在这里，您不需要过多关注印度出发的越南旅游套餐价格。一切价格都很合理。

posts.title: Top 6 most beautiful places you should visit
posts.excerpt: Top 6 most beautiful places you should visit at least once in your life, and to know more about those places, let’s go through the detailed places below with Vietlook Travel. Vietnam welcomes visitors
posts.contentHtml:
Top 6 most beautiful places you should visit at least once in your life, and to know more about those places, let’s go through the detailed places below with Vietlook Travel.

Vietnam welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, festivals, and special events. In addition, there are also famous tourist destinations, beautiful stops for every vacation, bustling cities, vast rice fields, rivers reflecting shadows, clear streams, fierce waterfalls, surrounded by majestic mountains creating a poetic picture, making Vietnam tours increasingly rich and diverse.

If this is your first time coming to Vietnam, let’s take a look at the top 6 most beautiful tourist destinations to have the most memorable vacation in Vietnam. Today, Vietlook Travel will suggest to you.

Hanoi

With a long history, diverse culture and unique ancient architecture, Hanoi is one of the destinations with many historical relics, traditional craft villages and spiritual places.

Hanoi’s climate is divided into 4 different seasons. Each season, the capital brings its own beauty so you can visit Hanoi at any time of the year. Besides the hustle and bustle of urban life, there is still an ancient and peaceful corner of Hanoi from ancient times.

The time from autumn to early winter is the most attractive time to visit Hanoi. At this time, the weather is no longer hot, the air is cool and fresh, Hanoi’s autumn with rows of trees with beautiful leaves, the streets are covered with yellow leaves. If you are a lover of romantic space, travel to Hanoi in the fall.

When you come to Hanoi, visit the following attractions:

Hanoi Old Quarter: A place with many small streets, narrow alleys, ancient houses, traditional cafes, preserving many cultural values ​​of the capital.

Thang Long Imperial Citadel – World Cultural Heritage: an important historical relic and a symbol of Hanoi.

Temple of Literature – Quoc Tu Giam: The first university in Vietnam and a place that preserves many cultural and historical values ​​of the country.

Hoan Kiem Lake: Come here, take a walk by the lake to admire the scenery and enjoy snacks around the lake, capturing the most beautiful moments, especially in the autumn weather.

One Pillar Pagoda is a famous pagoda with a long history and special architecture

Vietnam Museum of Ethnology: A place to display and preserve many cultural artifacts of Vietnamese ethnic groups.

Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum: A place to remember and honor the great leader of Vietnam.

Hanoi Opera House was built in the 20th century, is the place where many art and cultural performances of the country take place

In addition, Hanoi also welcomes visitors with famous places such as: Ba Den Tower, Turtle Tower, Huong Pagoda, Dong Xuan Market, Tay Ho Street, … Surely Hanoi will not disappoint you when visiting and exploring.

Son Doong Cave

Do you want to visit and explore a mysterious place? Son Doong Cave is a special cave that many tourists seek out, especially those who want to challenge themselves and explore mysteries.

The cave has a giant tunnel with water flowing through it. In the soft rock sections, the cave ceiling collapses to form holes, becoming a cave dome, and is a unique heritage, the largest natural cave, with a unique environment inside, with primeval forests and underground river systems.

It can be said that the cave is a magnificent masterpiece of nature, with giant stalactites hanging from the cave ceiling or protruding from the ground, looking like strangely shaped alien creatures.

Phu Quoc

Phu Quoc is an island famous for its long white sand beaches and magnificent luxury resorts, one of the must-see destinations when traveling to Vietnam to explore the beauty from North to South.

National Geographic once honored Phu Quoc as one of the 3 most beautiful winter destinations. It also topped the list of 10 most ideal beach destinations in Asia by AsiaOne.

Coming to Phu Quoc, you will encounter poetic beaches such as Bai Dai, Bai Sao and other pristine beaches. Coming here, visitors can not only enjoy swimming but also experience walking on the seabed and visit the following places:

Vinpearl Safar Phu Quoc is a zoo and conservation park. Visitors will see more than 3,000 animals of 150 different species. Most are free to roam, while dangerous species live in fenced areas.

Japanese Pearl Farm: Learn about pearl production and buy cultured pearls as souvenirs.

Phu Quoc Prison Historical Site: Learn about the war crimes of the US empire.

Tranh Stream: Hike, swim in the stream and enjoy the cool water from Ham Ninh mountain range.

In addition, Phu Quoc pearl island also has many interesting activities such as diving, fishing, yachting, enjoying local cuisine and visiting factories producing fish sauce, a famous specialty.

Saigon

Visiting the magnificent Saigon, tourists can feel all the beauty that the city brings to visitors. In particular, Saigon also welcomes visitors with diverse cultural, spiritual, natural attractions…

With a rich history and many attractive tourist destinations, Saigon is a destination not to be missed when traveling Vietnam. Below are the attractions you should visit when coming to Saigon:

Independence Palace: A remarkable architectural work, built in 1966, where the President of the Republic of Vietnam as well as the President of North Korea once visited.

  • Ben Thanh Market: One of the traditional markets in Saigon, with many attractive and diverse goods
  • Tao Dan Park: Located right in the city center, is a place for everyone to relax and exercise.
  • Saigon Notre Dame Cathedral: A beautiful architectural work built in the 19th century, a place of worship for Catholics
  • Nguyen Hue Walking Street: The city’s main street with many entertainment, shopping and culinary activities
  • Saigon Fine Arts Museum: Displaying many works of art by international and Vietnamese artists.

In addition, Saigon also has many other tourist attractions such as: Bui Vien Western Street, Ton That Thiep Street, Saigon Night Market, Ngoc Hoang Temple, Opera House will bring you an interesting vacation when visiting this city.

Hoi An

If you are planning to visit Vietnam’s famous landmarks, Hoi An is an indispensable destination in your itinerary, where there are many ancient architectural works and preserve the ancient Vietnamese culture, the ideal time to visit the old town is from February to April.

Hoi An is recognized by UNESCO as a World Cultural Heritage. With picturesque scenery, ancient architecture and diverse culture, Hoi An is currently an attractive destination for domestic and international tourists to visit, below are the places to visit in Hoi An that you should visit at least once in your life.

Hoi An Ancient Town: Located right in the city center, with ancient buildings, retail shops, restaurants and cafes, it is a check-in point chosen by many tourists.

  • Japanese Bridge: One of the symbols of the city, with unique architecture and legendary history.
  • Phung Hung Ancient House: One of the oldest houses in Hoi An, built in the 18th century and preserved to this day.
  • Hoi An Museum is a place to preserve and display works of art, artifacts and documents related to the history and culture of the city.
  • Ba Thien Hau Pagoda is one of the largest pagodas in Hoi An, with unique architecture and beautiful works of art.
  • Thanh Ha Pottery Village is located about 3km from the city center and is the place where traditional ceramics of Hoi An are produced and traded.

In addition, Hoi An also has traditional craft villages, An Bang or Cua Dai beaches, where visitors can enjoy local specialties of Hoi An. So it can be said that Hoi An is one of the great places to explore for those who love customs, culture, history and ancient architecture.

Ha Giang

One of the ideas in the journey to discover the beauty of the Northwest arc, where there are ancient towns, festivals but the blooming flower seasons, or winding and dangerous mountain passes are destinations for tourists who love and admire the peaceful scenery.

Here are the outstanding tourist attractions in Ha Giang:

  • Ma Pi Leng Pass: One of the most famous passes in Vietnam, with a steep slope that always challenges drivers, from the pass, visitors can admire the wild nature of the rocky plateau.
  • Meo Kings Temple Area: This mausoleum and temple area is dedicated to the Meo Kings – an ancient tribe in Ha Giang. This is one of the places that preserves many special values ​​about the history, architecture, and culture of the locality.
  • Lung Tam Waterfall: A majestic waterfall with white foam all year round, visitors will encounter a pristine and beautiful scene.
  • Dong Van Market: A traditional weekly market in Dong Van, attracting many tourists to visit and experience traditional cultural activities of the Northwest highlands.
  • Buckwheat flower fields: A new tourist destination in Ha Giang, famous for its colorful buckwheat flower fields creating a colorful and vibrant natural picture.
  • In addition, you can also join trekking tours, backpacking, explore terraced fields, or enjoy local specialties with the people of the rocky plateau.

It can be said that Ha Giang will bring visitors the most unforgettable experiences when visiting the rocky plateau. No matter what season of the year, Ha Giang always brings visitors the most beautiful memories.

How much does a trip to Vietnam cost?

This is always the top concern of many foreign tourists when they first set foot in Vietnam. However, the cost will vary depending on the preferences or budget that the tourist chooses.

  • Travel time
  • Location
  • Means of transportation
  • Accommodation
  • Entertainment and dining activities you choose

However, the prices are all listed, depending on whether you choose budget or luxury services, so the cost will be different, many people often choose luxury resorts, but on the contrary, some people choose budget to experience with the locals, and enjoy snacks.

Notes when exploring the beauty of Vietnam

Although Vietnam discovery tours bring many interesting experiences, you also need to pay attention to some issues. Help you find a suitable travel destination and ensure safety for the trip.

Carefully research the tour package before registering and the destinations so that your trip is complete and safe.

Prepare all documents: You need to prepare documents such as passport, visa (if required), travel insurance and other necessary documents as required by the travel company.

Make a reasonable schedule: A reasonable schedule is necessary to ensure that you have enough time to explore the destinations in the most comfortable way.

Be careful with personal belongings and equipment: If you bring electronic devices or important personal belongings, you should make sure they are stored safely.

Always be careful: You should always comply with safety regulations when participating in outdoor or adventure activities. Ensure you and your team members are as safe as possible.

Vietnam Tour from North to South

Many tourists want to experience a tour to explore Vietnam that will bring unforgettable experiences. However, to have a perfect trip, you should choose a tour schedule that suits your trip.

If you are wondering about choosing a tour to explore the beauty of Vietnam, Vietlook Travel is always a reliable companion for you to choose the most enjoyable tours.

posts.contentHtmlZh:
一生中至少应该去一次的6大最美景点，想进一步了解这些地方，让我们跟随 Vietlook Travel 一起浏览下面的详细介绍。

越南以著名的风景、节庆和特别的活动迎接游客。此外，还有著名的旅游目的地、每个假期的美丽驿站、熙熙攘攘的城市、辽阔的稻田、倒映着身影的河流、清澈的溪流、湍急的瀑布，群山雄伟环绕，构成一幅诗意的画卷，使越南之旅日益丰富多样。

如果这是您第一次来越南，让我们来看看6大最美旅游目的地，度过最难忘的越南假期。今天，Vietlook Travel 将为您推荐。

河内

河内历史悠久，文化多元，拥有独特的古建筑，是历史遗迹、传统手工艺村和灵修场所众多的目的地之一。

河内的气候分为4个不同的季节。每个季节，首都都有其独特的美，所以您可以在一年中的任何时候游览河内。除了城市生活的喧嚣，河内依然保留着一个自古以来古朴宁静的角落。

秋季至初冬是游览河内最迷人的时节。此时天气不再炎热，空气清凉清新，河内的秋天有一排排树叶漂亮的树木，街道铺满黄叶。如果您热爱浪漫的氛围，请在秋天前往河内旅游。

来到河内，请游览以下景点：

河内老街区：这里有许多小街、窄巷、古屋和传统咖啡馆，保留着首都许多文化价值。

升龙皇城——世界文化遗产：重要的历史遗迹，也是河内的象征。

文庙——国子监：越南第一所大学，也是保存着国家许多文化和历史价值的地方。

还剑湖：来到这里，沿湖漫步欣赏风景，享用环湖小吃，捕捉最美的时刻，尤其是在秋天的天气里。

独柱寺是一座历史悠久、建筑特别的著名寺庙

越南民族学博物馆：展示和保存越南各民族许多文化文物的地方。

胡志明陵：缅怀和敬仰越南伟大领袖的地方。

河内歌剧院建于20世纪，是国家许多艺术和文化演出举办的地方

此外，河内还以著名景点迎接游客，例如：巴蝶塔（Ba Den）、龟塔、香寺、同春市场、西湖街…河内在您游览探索时一定不会让您失望。

山洞洞（Son Doong）

您想参观和探索一个神秘的地方吗？山洞洞是许多游客寻访的特别洞穴，尤其是那些想挑战自我、探索奥秘的人。

洞内有一条巨大的隧道，水流从中穿过。在较软的岩层处，洞顶坍塌形成天窗，成为洞穴穹顶，是一处独特的遗产，也是最大的天然洞穴，内部环境独特，有原始森林和地下河系统。

可以说这个洞穴是大自然的壮丽杰作，巨大的钟乳石从洞顶垂下或从地面突起，看起来像形状奇特的外星生物。

富国岛

富国岛以绵长的白沙滩和华丽的奢华度假村而闻名，是游览越南、探索从北到南之美时必去的目的地之一。

《国家地理》曾将富国岛评为3大最美冬季目的地之一。它还在 AsiaOne 评选的亚洲10大理想海滩目的地中名列榜首。

来到富国岛，您会遇到长滩（Bai Dai）、星滩（Bai Sao）等诗意的海滩和其他原始海滩。来到这里，游客不仅可以享受游泳，还可以体验海底漫步，并游览以下地方：

富国岛珍珠野生动物园（Vinpearl Safari）是一座动物园和保护公园。游客将看到150个不同物种的3,000多只动物。大多数动物可自由活动，危险物种则生活在围栏区内。

日本珍珠养殖场：了解珍珠生产并购买养殖珍珠作为纪念品。

富国岛监狱历史遗址：了解美帝国主义的战争罪行。

Tranh 溪：徒步、在溪中游泳，享受来自咸宁（Ham Ninh）山脉的清凉溪水。

此外，富国珍珠岛还有许多有趣的活动，如潜水、钓鱼、驾驶游艇、品尝当地美食以及参观著名特产鱼露的生产工厂。

西贡

游览壮丽的西贡，游客可以感受这座城市带给游客的所有美好。尤其是，西贡还以多元的文化、灵修和自然景点迎接游客…

西贡历史丰富，旅游景点众多，是 游览越南时不可错过的目的地。以下是来到西贡您应该游览的景点：

统一宫（独立宫）：一座卓越的建筑作品，建于1966年，越南共和国总统以及朝鲜总统都曾到访。

  • 滨城市场：西贡的传统市场之一，商品丰富诱人
  • 涛丹公园：位于市中心，是供大家休闲和锻炼的地方
  • 西贡圣母大教堂：建于19世纪的一座美丽建筑，是天主教徒的礼拜场所
  • 阮惠步行街：城市的主要街道，有许多娱乐、购物和美食活动
  • 西贡美术博物馆：展出许多国际和越南艺术家的艺术作品。

此外，西贡还有许多其他旅游景点，例如：裴援（Bui Vien）西式街、Ton That Thiep 街、西贡夜市、玉皇殿、歌剧院，将为您带来游览这座城市的有趣假期。

会安

如果您计划游览越南的著名地标，会安是行程中不可或缺的目的地，这里有许多古建筑，保存着越南古老的文化，游览古镇的理想时间是2月至4月。

会安被联合国教科文组织认定为世界文化遗产。凭借如画的风景、古老的建筑和多元的文化，会安目前是国内外游客喜爱的迷人目的地，以下是您一生中至少应该游览一次的会安景点。

会安古镇：位于市中心，有古老的建筑、零售商店、餐厅和咖啡馆，是许多游客选择的打卡点。

  • 日本桥：城市的象征之一，建筑独特，历史传奇。
  • 进兴古屋：会安最古老的房屋之一，建于18世纪，保存至今。
  • 会安博物馆是保存和展示与城市历史和文化相关的艺术作品、文物和文献的地方。
  • 天后宫是会安最大的寺庙之一，建筑独特，艺术作品精美。
  • 清河陶瓷村距离市中心约3公里，是生产和销售会安传统陶瓷的地方。

此外，会安还有传统手工艺村、安邦（An Bang）或古代（Cua Dai）海滩，游客可以在这里品尝会安的地方特产。因此可以说，对于热爱民俗、文化、历史和古建筑的人来说，会安是绝佳的探索之地。

河江

这是探索西北弧线之美的旅程中的选择之一，这里有古镇、节庆和盛开的花季，蜿蜒险峻的山口则是热爱并欣赏宁静风光的游客的目的地。

以下是河江的突出旅游景点：

  • 马皮岭（Ma Pi Leng）山口：越南最著名的山口之一，坡度陡峭，始终考验着驾驶员，从山口，游客可以欣赏石高原的野性自然。
  • 苗王宫（Meo Kings）景区：这个陵墓和寺庙景区供奉苗王，他们是河江的古老部落。这是保存着当地历史、建筑和文化诸多特殊价值的地方之一。
  • Lung Tam 瀑布：一座雄伟的瀑布，全年水花泛白，游客将遇到一幅原始而美丽的景象。
  • 同文（Dong Van）市场：同文的传统周集市，吸引许多游客前来参观，体验西北高原的传统文化活动。
  • 荞麦花田：河江新的旅游目的地，以色彩斑斓的荞麦花田闻名，构成一幅五彩缤纷、生机勃勃的自然画卷。
  • 此外，您还可以参加徒步旅行、背包游，探索梯田，或与石高原人民一起品尝地方特产。

可以说，河江将给游览石高原的游客带来最难忘的体验。无论一年中的哪个季节，河江总会给游客带来最美好的回忆。

越南之旅的费用是多少？

这始终是许多外国游客初到越南时最关心的问题。不过，费用会因游客选择的喜好或预算而异。

  • 旅行时间
  • 地点
  • 交通工具
  • 住宿
  • 您选择的娱乐和餐饮活动

不过，价格都是明码标价的，取决于您选择经济型还是豪华型服务，因此费用会有所不同，许多人经常选择豪华度假村，而相反，有些人选择经济预算，与当地人一起体验，享用小吃。

探索越南之美的注意事项

虽然越南探索之旅会带来许多有趣的体验，但您也需要注意一些问题。帮助您找到合适的旅行目的地并确保旅途安全。

在报名之前，请仔细研究旅游套餐和目的地，让您的旅程完整而安全。

准备好所有文件：您需要准备护照、签证（如有需要）、旅行保险以及旅行社要求的其他必要文件。

制定合理的行程：合理的行程对于确保您有足够的时间以最舒适的方式探索各个目的地是必要的。

小心保管个人物品和设备：如果您携带电子设备或重要的个人物品，应确保妥善存放。

始终保持谨慎：参加户外或探险活动时，您应始终遵守安全规定。确保您和团队成员尽可能安全。

越南之旅 从北到南

许多游客希望体验一次探索越南的旅程，带来难忘的体验。然而，要拥有完美的旅程，您应该选择适合自己行程的旅游安排。

posts.title: Traditional village market tour in Vietnam: Top markets you must-visit
posts.excerpt: Traditional village markets are one of the distinctive features of the life of Vietnamese people. A traditional village market tour in Vietnam can help you learn and explore more about a new culture.
posts.contentHtml:
Traditional village markets are one of the distinctive features of the life of Vietnamese people. A traditional village market tour in Vietnam can help you learn and explore more about a new culture.

These markets are not only places to find regional specialties but also a reflection of the culture of each ethnic group. There are many unique and attractive village markets throughout Vietnam. In this article, we will introduce you to the top traditional village market tours in Vietnam that you cannot miss.

Must-visit traditional village market tours in Vietnam

Each traditional village market tour in Vietnam in different locations has its distinctive characteristics. Depending on the lifestyle of the local people, these village markets will have unique highlights.

You can explore more through the traditional village market tours that we share below:

Bac Ha Market – Lao Cai

Bac Ha Market is one of the oldest and most famous traditional markets in the northern mountainous region of Vietnam. The Bac Ha Market takes place every Sunday from early morning to 3 pm on the same day.

This traditional village market tour in Vietnam is not just a place to buy and sell goods but also to exchange and meet the local ethnic groups. The market is imbued with the cultural identity of the highlands.

At Bac Ha Market, the main products are handicrafts, family items such as blankets, pillows, colorful scarves and decorations, handbags, jewelry, and traditional clothes of ethnic minorities such as Hmong, Dao, etc.

In addition, the market also has specialty products such as horse meat, pork armpit, honey, wine, and delicious fresh fruits and vegetables.

These products are displayed in a colorful, bustling, and crowded market space. Besides, you can enjoy typical dishes of the northern mountainous region, such as thang co, five-color sticky rice, hot bread, etc.

In the market’s lively atmosphere, you can also participate in activities such as horse racing, buffalo fighting, etc. This is a fascinating destination for tourists who want to explore and experience the unique culture of ethnic minorities in the northern mountainous region of Vietnam.

Dao San Market – Lai Chau

Dao San Market is a famous traditional village market tour in Vietnam located in Lai Chau province, in the northwest mountainous region of Vietnam. Dao San Market meets every Thursday and Sunday in the center of Dao San commune, Phong Tho district.

Here, you can find typical products of ethnic groups, such as traditional clothing, handcrafted bags, handicrafts, pottery, and other household products. In the market, visitors can witness the cultural diversity that creates the cultural identity of the ethnic communities here.

It is not difficult to spot young girls of the Red Lao ethnic group, graceful Giay ethnic girls, or the H’mong mothers who sit and embroider during the market.

Dao San Market has an ample space filled with colors and the sounds of ethnic minorities’ songs and dances. Besides shopping, visitors can also enjoy local dishes such as raw pork with lime, grilled chicken, and lam rice etc. In addition, there are many entertainment activities and traditional games to enjoy.

Dao San Market is an interesting destination for tourists who want to learn about the culture and life of ethnic minorities in the northwest mountainous region. If you plan to visit Lai Chau, do not forget to visit Dao San Market to experience the exciting and colorful things here.

Dong Van Market – Ha Giang

Dong Van Market is located in the center of Dong Van town, Ha Giang province, famous for its unique ethnic products and ancient houses’ architecture. The market is held every Sunday and attracts many people from inside and outside Ha Giang province for shopping and exchanging goods.

At Dong Van Market, visitors can find handicraft products such as silk, batik, embroidery, forest animals, and other household products. In addition, the market also has many delicious local dishes; such as stove-side buffalo meat, grilled pork, rib porridge, hot rolled rice pancakes, and iced beer.

Not only a shopping destination, but Dong Van Market also has special historical and cultural values, with ancient houses built since the 19th century. On festive occasions, there will be traditional games such as jumping, tug-of-war, bridge-crossing, kicking shuttlecock, etc.

Tourists can visit the ancient houses and learn more about the ethnic groups in Ha Giang land.

Dong Van Market is considered one of the attractive destinations in Ha Giang. If you want to explore the beauty and life of the ethnic people in the highlands when exploring Vietnam tours. Especially Ha Giang, you should plan to visit Dong Van Market.

Khau Vai “love” market – Ha Giang

The Khau Vai “love” market in Ha Giang is a highland festival often held in the spring when the farmers have more free time. People usually organize rituals to pray for favorable weather conditions throughout the year. The Khau Vai love market follows the same tradition.

Every year, on the 27th of March, in the lunar calendar, the market is held.

According to historical sources, this tradition has existed for almost 100 years since the market started in 1919. In the past, the market only took place on one day, on the 27th of March, in the lunar calendar. However, the market is usually held for about three days due to the combination of cultural activities and tourism.

This traditional market is suitable for tourists to come and explore when on a traditional village market tour in Vietnam. Couples who are in love and facing complicated relationships can meet, exchange, and end their relationship.

Initially, the market was not meant for trading products but as a place where people could come together. These people may have been separated by fate, family disapproval, or other reasons that kept them from being together. Each person carries a heart full of unresolved emotions, like the legend of the old lovers.

Therefore, this day is for them to confide in each other after one or many years of separation to inform each other of their current situation. These interrupted love stories are all in the past for each individual. 

Those who have started families come here without jealousy toward their spouses. They respect each other, respect their past, and consider it a responsibility for their spiritual life. After the market session, they return to their daily lives and promise to return to the market the following year.

The Khau Vai love market has a long history and is considered a symbol of love and emotion of the ethnic people in the Ha Giang region. Here, tourists can visit and experience the lively atmosphere of the market session.

Read also:Vietnam Village Tour: Explore The Best Of Local Life

Meo Vac Market

The Meo Vac Market in Ha Giang is a destination that few tourists know about. However, it is a market session with a unique cultural characteristic of the local people. The Meo Vac market is located in the town area of Meo Vac, which is not difficult to find.

Once arriving at the town of Meo Vac, tourists can experience many attractive cultural features.

Meo Vac Market is also one of the largest markets in the Ha Giang province area and is organized and held only once a week. It is a destination for locals to gather and exchange culture on weekends.

The market is held on Sundays, and visitors can admire the unique and fascinating beauty of the mountainous people. Although there are a few village market days, they are exceptional.

At Meo Vac Market, you can find various products such as food, jewelry, clothing, herbs, and handmade items. The market also sells different types of pets, such as chickens, pigs, buffalos, cows, dogs, cats, and more.

Among them, the Meo Vac Cat Market is known as a particular destination where local ethnic minorities sell black cats and wild cats. They are considered traditional pets of the local people.

Not only a shopping destination, but Meo Vac Market is also a place for tourists to experience and explore the unique culture of the Mong, Dao, H’Mong, and Giay ethnic groups. You can participate in activities such as singing, dancing with local people, and enjoying traditional food.

This traditional village market tour in Vietnam will definitely bring you many exciting experiences.

Cai Rang Floating Market – Can Tho

Floating markets are one of the most unique features of the Mekong Delta. This type of market has many unique features that no other locality in Vietnam has.

The Cai Rang Floating Market is famous for the bustle of boats every morning. People will exchange and trade on boats. You will feel scared when floating on the water but it is characteristic.

In your traditional village market tour in Vietnam, this attractive floating market is indispensable. You can experience the floating market from morning until noon. The market starts early every morning, around 4-5 am, and lasts until about 9-10 am.

The main products sold at Cai Rang Floating Market are fresh vegetables, fruits, and local specialties of the Mekong Delta; such as Linh fish, dried shrimp, rice wine, rice paper, and fruits. In addition, you can also find household items, souvenirs, clothing, and fashion accessories.

The Cai Rang floating market features colorful boats filled with goods and vendors along the river. Tourists can rent a boat to explore the market and enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Mekong Delta. 

In addition, visitors can also taste local specialties such as snakehead fish hot pot, Xeo cake, crab noodle soup, chicken vermicelli, etc. It is a familiar village market, even though it sways on the water.

Cai Rang floating market is an attractive and unique destination for tourists who want to experience the culture and cuisine of the Southwest region of Vietnam. This traditional village market tour in Vietnam is definitely suitable for those who want to share a unique market.

Nga Bay Floating Market – Hau Giang

Unlike the traditional village market in Japan, the characteristics of Vietnamese traditional markets vary depending on the region. Nga Bay Floating Market is a famous floating market in the Mekong Delta. All trading activities take place on the river.

Nga Bay Floating Market opens early in the morning. From 5 to 8 am is the peak time for buying fresh agricultural products. The market will still operate from mid-morning until evening. Boats will be busy running along the river to sell goods.

People here sell a variety of items ranging from seasonal fruits to specialty dishes. You can choose your favorite fruit. However, the fruit will be sold seasonally; so you can do your research before going to this traditional village market tour in Vietnam.

An unforgettable highlight is when the sun rises and the boats carrying goods spread out in different directions. Tourists will experience the robust flavors of rustic dishes sold on small ships.

From the dreamy early morning, when the sky is still covered with a thin veil of mist, hundreds of boats of local people come here like a festival. Some many different colors and sounds create a lively and joyful atmosphere.

Especially, there is no need for advertising or sales promotion here. Each boat has a long pole hanging the items it sells, like a “live brand.” Buyers do not have to spend time looking for what they want. In addition, there are also small boats selling food that skillfully maneuver among the larger ships.

There is no village market entrance fee when entering the market; so visitors can freely enjoy their traditional village market tour in Vietnam and shop at the c village stores.

Ideas for activities when going on a traditional village market tour in Vietnam

After finding a village market near you, you should participate in the activities of the local people when going to the market. Here are some exciting activities that we suggest for you:

Explore local specialties

At traditional markets, tourists can find many specialties of each region, such as fruits, vegetables, souvenirs, handicrafts, and local specialty dishes.

Learn about local culture

Tourists will have a chance to learn about local people and interesting things in their daily life. You can discover more through traditional activities such as playing folk games and interacting with local people.

Take photos and capture memorable moments

The remarkable thing about traditional village market tour in Vietnam is the lively, unique, and local atmosphere. Therefore, this is an excellent opportunity for tourists to take photos and preserve memorable moments.

Participate in entertainment activities

At traditional markets, tourists can participate in entertainment activities; such as watching dance performances, singing, martial arts demonstrations, and many other activities. Traditional village market tours in Vietnam can provide many activities for you throughout the day.

Shop at reasonable prices

Traditional markets in Vietnam are also known for their reasonable prices and are often traded through negotiation between sellers and buyers. Therefore, this also allows tourists to shop at reasonable prices.

Enjoy local cuisine

Traditional markets in Vietnam are not the only place to shop but also place to enjoy local specialty dishes. Tourists can find typical dishes of each region; such as central Vietnamese pancakes, Hanoi grilled pork with vermicelli, Saigon pho, and many other dishes.

Learn about traditional trades

Traditional markets in Vietnam are often a place to display and sell local handicraft products. Tourists can learn about the production process and handicraft stages and about local people’s traditional trades.

Experience the feeling of a local person

Participating in a traditional village market tour in Vietnam is also an opportunity for tourists to experience the feeling of being a local person to learn about the life, culture, and traditional values of Vietnamese people.

How to get a Traditional village market tour in Vietnam?

Finding a tourism service for a traditional village market tour in Vietnam is a good option to avoid organizing and arranging everything for your trip. The tourism service will help you save time and effort researching, booking hotels, transportation, and visiting destinations.

Vietlook Travel is the perfect choice for those who want to have the best traditional village market tour in Vietnam. Tourists will be advised on a clear itinerary with many suitable destination options.

Before deciding to go to the traditional village market, you must research and plan your trip. This will help you avoid risks and have a great travel experience when visiting Vietnam’s traditional village markets. Vietlook Travel’s professional team will assist you in your research.

Joining a traditional village market tour in Vietnam is a great experience for tourists who want to explore and learn about the local people’s daily lives. Here, tourists can visit, shop for local products, taste local foods, and interact and chat with local people.

With these exciting experiences, tourists will indeed have unforgettable memories and a colorful travel experience in Vietnam.
posts.titleZh: 越南传统乡村集市游：必去市场
posts.excerptZh: 传统乡村集市是越南人生活的鲜明特色之一。一次越南传统乡村集市之旅，可以帮助您了解和探索一种全新的文化。
posts.contentHtmlZh:
传统乡村集市是越南人生活的鲜明特色之一。一次 越南传统乡村集市之旅 可以帮助您了解和探索一种全新的文化。

这些集市不仅是寻找地方特产的地方，也是各民族文化的缩影。越南各地有许多独特而迷人的乡村集市。在本文中，我们将为您介绍不容错过的越南顶级传统乡村集市之旅。

不容错过的越南传统乡村集市之旅

每一次 越南传统乡村集市之旅 所到之处都有其独特的风貌。根据当地人的生活方式，这些乡村集市各有亮点。

您可以通过下面分享的传统乡村集市之旅进一步探索：

北河集市 – 老街

北河集市是越南北部山区最古老、最著名的传统集市之一。北河集市每逢周日举行，从清晨一直持续到当天下午3点。

这次 越南传统乡村集市之旅 不仅是买卖商品的地方，也是与当地少数民族交流相会的场所。集市洋溢着高原地区的文化特色。

在北河集市，主要商品有手工艺品、家居用品，如毯子、枕头、色彩缤纷的围巾和饰品、手提包、首饰，以及苗族、瑶族等少数民族的传统服饰。

此外，集市上还有马肉、猪腋下肉、蜂蜜、酒以及新鲜美味的水果和蔬菜等特色产品。

这些商品陈列在色彩斑斓、热闹拥挤的集市空间中。此外，您还可以品尝北部山区的特色美食，如 thang co（马肉锅）、五色糯米饭、热面包等。

在集市热闹的气氛中，您还可以参与赛马、斗牛等活动。对于想要探索和体验越南北部山区少数民族独特文化的游客来说，这是一个迷人的目的地。

Dao San 集市 – 莱州

Dao San 集市是一个著名的 越南传统乡村集市之旅 位于越南西北山区的莱州省。Dao San 集市每周四和周日在封土县 Dao San 乡中心举行。

在这里，您可以找到各民族的特色商品，如传统服饰、手工包、手工艺品、陶器和其他家居用品。在集市上，游客可以见证文化的多样性，这种多样性塑造了当地各民族社区的文化特色。

不难看到红老族的年轻姑娘、优雅的岱依族姑娘，或在集市上坐着刺绣的苗族母亲。

Dao San 集市空间开阔，充满色彩，回荡着少数民族的歌舞声。除了购物，游客还可以品尝当地美食，如酸橙拌生猪肉、烤鸡和竹筒饭等。此外，还有许多娱乐活动和传统游戏可以参与。

对于想要了解越南西北山区少数民族文化与生活的游客来说，Dao San 集市是一个有趣的目的地。如果您计划前往莱州，别忘了来 Dao San 集市体验这里热闹而多彩的一切。

同文集市 – 河江

同文集市位于河江省同文镇中心，以独特的民族产品和古屋建筑而闻名。集市每周日举行，吸引了河江省内外许多人前来购物和交换货物。

在同文集市，游客可以找到丝绸、蜡染、刺绣、山林动物产品及其他家居用品等手工艺品。此外，集市上还有许多美味的当地菜肴，如灶边水牛肉、烤猪肉、排骨粥、热腾腾的卷米饼和冰啤酒。

同文集市不仅是购物的好去处，还具有特殊的历史和文化价值，这里的古屋始建于19世纪。逢节庆之际，还会举行跳跃、拔河、过桥、踢毽子等传统游戏。

游客可以参观古屋，进一步了解河江这片土地上的各个民族。

同文集市被认为是河江极具吸引力的目的地之一。如果您想在参加 越南旅游团时探索高原地区各民族的美丽与生活，尤其是河江，那么您应该计划前往同文集市。

Khau Vai “爱情”集市 – 河江

河江的 Khau Vai “爱情”集市是一个高原节日，通常在春季农闲时举行。人们通常会举行仪式，祈求全年风调雨顺。Khau Vai 爱情集市也延续了同样的传统。

每年农历三月二十七日，集市如期举行。

据史料记载，这一传统自1919年集市开办以来已存在近100年。过去，集市只在农历三月二十七日这一天举行。不过，由于文化活动与旅游相结合，如今集市通常会持续约三天。

这个传统集市很适合游客在参加 越南传统乡村集市之旅时前来探索。身处情感纠葛的恋人们可以在这里相见、倾诉，并了结彼此的关系。

最初，这个集市并不是为了交易商品，而是为人们提供一个相聚的地方。这些人或许因命运、家人反对或其他原因而无法在一起。每个人心中都怀着未解的情感，就像古老情人的传说一样。

因此，这一天是留给他们的：在分别一年或多年之后，彼此倾诉，告知对方各自的近况。这些被中断的爱情故事，对每个人来说都已成为过去。 

已经成家的人来到这里，对配偶没有嫉妒之心。他们彼此尊重，尊重各自的过去，并把这视为对精神生活的一种责任。集市结束后，他们回到各自的日常生活，并约定来年再回到集市。

Khau Vai 爱情集市历史悠久，被视为河江地区少数民族爱情与情感的象征。在这里，游客可以参观并体验集市热闹的氛围。

延伸阅读：越南乡村之旅：探索当地生活的精华

Meo Vac 集市

河江的 Meo Vac 集市是一个鲜为游客所知的目的地。然而，它是一个具有当地人独特文化特色的集市。Meo Vac 集市位于 Meo Vac 镇区，不难找到。

抵达 Meo Vac 镇后，游客可以体验到许多迷人的文化特色。

Meo Vac 集市也是河江省境内最大的集市之一，每周只举办一次。它是当地人在周末聚会和交流文化的地方。

集市在周日举行，游客可以欣赏山区居民独特而迷人的风采。虽然乡村集市的日子不多，但它们都非同寻常。

在 Meo Vac 集市，您可以找到各种商品，如食品、首饰、服装、草药和手工制品。集市上还出售各种宠物，如鸡、猪、水牛、牛、狗、猫等。

其中，Meo Vac 猫市是一个特别的去处，当地少数民族在这里出售黑猫和野猫。它们被视为当地人的传统宠物。

Meo Vac 集市不仅是购物的好去处，也是游客体验和探索蒙族、瑶族、苗族和岱依族独特文化的地方。您可以参与唱歌、与当地人一起跳舞以及品尝传统美食等活动。

这次 越南传统乡村集市之旅 一定会给您带来许多精彩的体验。

芹苴 – Cai Rang 水上集市

水上集市是湄公河三角洲最独特的特色之一。这类集市有许多越南其他地方所没有的独特之处。

Cai Rang 水上集市以每天清晨船只云集的热闹景象而闻名。人们在船上交换和买卖商品。漂浮在水面上，您可能会有些害怕，但这正是它的特色。

在您的 越南传统乡村集市之旅中，这个迷人的水上集市不可或缺。您可以从早晨一直体验到中午。集市每天清晨约4至5点开市，一直持续到上午9至10点左右。

Cai Rang 水上集市出售的主要商品有新鲜蔬菜、水果和湄公河三角洲的特产，如 Linh 鱼、虾干、米酒、米纸和各种水果。此外，您还可以找到家居用品、纪念品、服装和时尚配饰。

Cai Rang 水上集市上，满载货物的彩色船只和商贩沿河而聚。游客可以租船游览集市，欣赏湄公河三角洲的美丽风光。 

此外，游客还可以品尝当地特色美食，如鱼火锅、Xeo 煎饼、蟹肉米线汤、鸡肉米粉等。尽管它在水上摇曳，却是一个亲切熟悉的乡村集市。

对于想要体验越南西南部文化与美食的游客来说，Cai Rang 水上集市是一个迷人而独特的目的地。这次 越南传统乡村集市之旅 无疑很适合想要分享独特集市体验的人。

Nga Bay 水上集市 – 后江

与日本的传统乡村集市不同，越南传统集市的特点因地区而异。Nga Bay 水上集市是湄公河三角洲著名的水上集市。所有交易活动都在河上进行。

Nga Bay 水上集市清晨开市。早上5点至8点是购买新鲜农产品的高峰时段。集市从上午中段到傍晚仍会继续营业。船只沿河忙碌穿梭，叫卖货物。

这里的人们出售从应季水果到特色菜肴的各种商品。您可以挑选自己喜爱的水果。不过，水果是按季节出售的，所以在前往这次 越南传统乡村集市之旅之前，您可以先做些功课。

一个令人难忘的亮点是日出时分，载满货物的船只向四面八方散开。游客将品尝到小船上出售的乡土菜肴的浓郁风味。

清晨梦幻般的时分，天空还笼罩着一层薄薄的雾纱，当地人的数百艘船只像过节一样汇聚到这里。各种各样的色彩和声音营造出热闹欢快的氛围。

尤其是，这里无需广告或促销。每艘船上都有一根长竿，挂着它出售的商品，就像一个“活招牌”。买家无需花时间寻找想要的东西。此外，还有出售食物的小船在大船之间灵巧地穿梭。

进入集市无需支付乡村集市入场费，因此游客可以自由享受他们的 越南传统乡村集市之旅 并在乡村小店里购物。

参加越南传统乡村集市之旅时的活动建议

找到附近的乡村集市后，您应该在逛集市时参与当地人的活动。以下是我们为您推荐的一些精彩活动：

游客将有机会了解当地人以及他们日常生活中的趣事。您可以通过玩民间游戏、与当地人互动等传统活动来进一步发现。

令人称道的是 越南传统乡村集市之旅 那种热闹、独特、充满地方特色的氛围。因此，这是游客拍照留念的绝佳机会。

参与娱乐活动

在传统集市上，游客可以参与各种娱乐活动，如观看舞蹈表演、唱歌、武术表演等许多活动。越南传统乡村集市之旅可以为您提供一整天丰富多彩的活动。

以合理的价格购物

越南的传统集市也以价格合理而闻名，通常由买卖双方讨价还价成交。因此，这也让游客能够以合理的价格购物。

品尝当地美食

越南的传统集市不仅是购物的地方，也是品尝当地特色菜肴的地方。游客可以找到各地的代表性美食，如越南中部煎饼、河内烤肉米线、西贡河粉等许多菜肴。

了解传统手工艺

越南的传统集市通常是展示和销售当地手工艺品的地方。游客可以了解生产过程和手工工序，以及当地人的传统手艺。

体验当地人的感受
